tei:div.tei:p: sngags mang dpe tshogs/༄༅// nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/

reg 'dzin dpa la1na bka'i sa kyi gsu— rtsom phyo gas bsgyugs/chos rgyal— ka sa — da ra rgyas kyi rdzogs ma ma— ga kun sem/1sa dkar tshogs drug rang grol lamadod bu gtsang gsum1bam bon bdag gi cem ba bstod bsngag pa5dkar po'i zung ba/ga grub dbang nam mas sku phreng rim pyon snye gsung rtsom phyogs bsgyugs/mas gas kun bza— slobs snyan ba— 'dir 'i snam —shad tshoro6)— skyes sna— mdza rdorje'i gsu— rtsom dro gas— sgrogs/ sngags bcos be'u bum phyo gas bsgrag (re bkong jig mang gi ra mig phyog bsgrigs/(༷ ༷༷ bye ༷ sngagasaX— ma lo rgyus phyogs bzags
za ༄(she1—ra (stan sgyu ༷ ze — —— rshado mo3 ) 1 1 shā ‘ ༄ 5 ba༄ ba tsā — )—‘ ( — dzwa pa — sto) — —ri)1 — /rte1 — hūṃ ) tsho tsa snyo— ———— —rngo —kyo ba — rdo 6
༄ / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mig rigs dpe skrun khang /

bas/ / sngags mab dme tshogs rtsom pe khobs mi lhan rgyas/blo 'dri sa/mkhan dkon mchog rin chen/ dkar brjid sku lo bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma/gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma1 rdo grub sprul sku klong yangs1 grub dbang nas mkha'/ka ring rta mgrin1 mag gsar snang srid rdo rje/ mi bskyod mkhas grub rgya mtsho1rtse gzhung lha ston nol ba rtsal/ sngags 'chang rta mgrin rgyal/ sbyi khrab rtsom sgrib pa/hūṃ chen ho ru ka nyi zla ho du kaspyi khrab rtsom sgrig gzhon pa/yon tan rgya mtsho/ ye shes 'od zer sgrol ma1 rig 'dzin 'od gsal rdo rje/rtsom sgrig pa/ka nong 'jigs med rang grol/ rong skyes snang mdzad rdo rje/dbang za padma rig 'dzin/ 'jigs med 'gro phan/smin gling 'gyur med rab rgyas/ thub bstan sgrol ma1

rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod dang dpe sgrun gsal bshad/nga / /rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod dang dpe skrun gsal bshad/de yang 'gro mgon zhabs dkan tshogs drug rang grol gyi sras kyi thu bo'am bka'i bsdu ba po nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'am nyang mtshams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zhes pa'i sngags 'chang chen po gang ni/ reb kong gser mo ljongs kyi smad kyi char gtogs nyang sde bar/yab sngags pa tshe ring don grub dang yum snying mo byums gnyis kyi sras su bod dab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa rta ste spyi lo179ka lo'i zla dang po'i tshes gsum gyi dgung mo dbang gi dus su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug gi steng nas bzung dang gi mes po sngags 'chang dkon mchog mdun nas yi ge bslabs/ khu bo gad dbang rdo rje las ri mo dang / ma zhang gu du rdo rje rdo~X gtor med kyi bri sab ༈༵ ༵/na/ a khu mchog ldan dang bris pa mkhar lo gnyis las dbu can ༄ de nas snga rjes su grub dbang padma rang grol/ (1shāX5lon) spyang lhang dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med/ (1shāXre lor) khyung lung nas pa dam tshig rdo rje/(1shā1༷lor) rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gdung rgyud sngags 'chang bkra shis 'bum/ (1shā11lor) khams bla nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ (1shā14lod) sde dge 'jigs med skal bzang /(1shā17lon) mdo mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/(1rdo21lon)mag gsad kun bzang stobs ldan dbang bo/ (1shā26lor) zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol/ (1shā24lor) kaḥthog bla ma ngag dbang smin grol rgya mtsho/ (1shā༈7lor)sngags 'chang rta mgrin/ (1shā61lor) grub dbang mi bskyod rdo rje/ (1shā6rdo lor)sngags 'chang o rgyun 'phrin las rnam rgyal(1shā6re lod)sogs kyis mtshon pa'i rang yul reb kong sngags mang gi grub brnyes rig 'dzin chen po dag dang khams yul nas byon pa'i mkhas chen dam pa mang po'i drung nas snga 'gyud bka' gter spyi'i smin grol gdams khrid chig rdzogs su gsan zhing nyams len mthar phyin mdzad pas mkhas shing grub pa'i sna mthor

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdorje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsnyegs/ gzhan yang sprul sku drung yig dbon po/ ( 1shā12lor) sku phyogs bde chen/(1shā22lon) rje gser khang ba/ (1shā22lor) sku phyogs a nol(186༈lon)sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma las kyang dbang lung gsan/de bzhin du sngags 'chang 'di ba reb kong sngags mang spyi dang sgos su srib lta sngags mang la bka' drin shin tu che ste/ khong gis grub dbang padma rang grol gyi yang srid dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang skal ldan nang grol gyi sprul sku/ rgyal bo bzhi ba rdo rje rnam rgyal/khyung dgon khyab gdal klong yangs/ dgu nong sna tshogs dang grol/ zhabs dkan gnyis pa dig 'dzin rgyu mtsho/ mag gsar sprul sku rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje/ a lags dgu steng / bstan 'dzin nye ma tshang / ka ring rta mgrin sprul sbu gan dbang 'gro 'dul rdo rje/ sgo me sprul sku/ sris nag sprul sku la sogs bu slob 'bor chen gces par bskyangs nas reb kong rig 'dzin sngags kyi grong khyen gyi pha chos rnal ma'i brgyud pa'i gzhung bsrings pa dang / reb kong stod smad dang gcan tsha nyin sbob/ gtsos hor gtsang sogs kyi sngags sde so sar zhabs sor bkod de/ chos thog gsar 'dzugs dang sngags khang gsar bzhengs/ dbang skun lung stsol/ mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyi drag las sogs kyi bgyi ba rgya ched spel nas sngags pa'i 'phrin las nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel du btang / mthar dgung lo don bdun bzhes pa gnam lo shing khye'i (spyi lo1shā74)zla11pa'i tshes༈nyin gyi spre'u dus la/ zhal lho nub tu gzigs te zhabs gnyis skyil thung dang / phyag gnyis sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya dang bcas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings gdod ma'i klong du mnal/ sku gdung las ring bsrel phebs pa dang rta phag yab yum gyi sku dang sngags gsal bor babs pa sogs phal ba'i blo las 'gongs pa byung /bla ma 'di ba'i thugs bskyed sbon lam las khong gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gnyis te 'gro mgon zhabs dkan pa dang grub dbang padma rang grol mchog zung gi gsung chos ma lus phyogs bsgrigs gnang nas/ so sor po ti sum cu so gnyis dang po ti bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi gsung 'bum gnyis phyi rabs sngags pa dag gi dad pa'i gsos su 'jog gnang mdzad la/ dus phyis gsung 'bum snga man par shing brkos pas da lta kha tshang mjal rgyu yod pa las gsung 'bum phyi mar shing pan ma yod pas da lta tho re ba zhig las mjal du med pa phangs pa'i gnas su che/ gzhan yang lo gnyis sngon la nged zhib 'jug khang gis sngags khyim spyo~X stes rnyed pa'i(〈'gro mgon zhabs dkan tshogs drug nang grol la mdo dbus gtsang

rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod dang dpe spun gsal bshad/gsum sgob ma yon bdag gis phul ba'i bstod bsngags padma dkad po'i zeng ba〉〉zhes pa zhig bsgrigs yod la/ de ni sngon mar khyon nas ma grags pa'am lo rgyus dang ngag rgyun du ye nas byung med pa zhig yin khar/ bla ma zhabs dkad pa'i gsung skyes bu slob dang rgyu sbyon yon bdag bla chen mi chen sogs kyis khong la phul ba'i rtogs 'bul dang 'phrin yig sogs phyogs bsgrigs gnang ba zhig yin pas na rin thang ha cang che/ 'di ga mi 'gyangs ༵bye bye/ba gcig byas nas dpar skrun 'grem spel byed rgyu yin pa thugs la 'jags pan khong rang nyid kyi gsung rtsom skon la'ang rang rnam pod gcig dang mgur 'bum pod gcig bca' yig chos spyod skon pod gcig bzhugs pa sogs deb 'dir drangs yod cing / de min〈(skar gling bsam pa'i don 'grub〉〉zhu ba'i sna thung pod gcig bzhugs pa ni〈〈reb kong sngags mang gi skar yig phyogs bsgrigs〉〉su bsdus yod pas bskyar zlos kyi dgos pa med snyam nas 'di du ma bkod/ de dag las khong gi〈〈rang rnam〉〉la lo tshogs zhib cing gsal ba dang brjod byu'i lo rgyus de don med tshig tshogs kyis ma bsgribs pa'i thun min khyad chos shig 'bur du thon yod pa la/ snga ma'i lo rgyus rnam thar gang gis kyang 'gran mi bzod pa zhig 'dug lhag par du skabs de'i reb kong sngags mang gi lo rgyus lo lhags gsal ba la g.ya' bral me long 'di las lhag pa med do/ /khong gi rang rnam du gsal ba'i brtsam chos ka shas da dung lag son ma byung ba dang / de las kyang bla ma zhabs dkar ba'i bka' bzhin khong nyang rin po ches mdzad pa'i grub dbang spyang lung dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi rnam than skon la dogs gzhi chen po zhig 'dug ste/ da lta mthong du yod pa'i sprung lung ba'i rnam thar de'i yig chung du zhabs dkar pas mdzad ces snang yang don la de ni nyang gi min nam snyam pa zhig 'dug ste/ rgyu mtshan yang / (〈nang rnam rin chen phreng ba〉〉du/nyin gcig khyed tsho'i bla ma spyang lung rin po che'i rnam thar zhig phyi rabs rnams kyi don du dgos pas/ zin bris shig phobs la khyer shog gsungs pas/ ma ṇi'i steng nas bde kha'i sman pa sogs gong ma'i dngos slob rnams bsdun nas zin bris phab/ nyung sob bsam tshe sgrub chen gyi thor thun skabs nyams rngis 'dres mar 'du khang gi nang thams cad brda yig gis gang zhing / thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'dus nas yi ge dbu can gyis 'dod chung chog shes nor gyi mchog ces shan ba ded 'khod rnams la bshad tshe rnam thar bsdu ba'i brda red zen/ zin bris skyabs mgon rin po che'i sku mtshams nang du phul tshe/ rdo sde khyod

gas /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyis khyer la mtshams nang nas rig pa bsgrims la rnam thar zhig rtsoms la bzhi ba'i bcu gcig gi nyin mar khyer shog gsungs pa ltan mtshams la bsdad nas brtsams te bzhi ba'i bcu gcig gi nyin sku mdun du phul tshe/ rnam thar 'grig na bdag rkyen dang ma 'grig na gser srang gang gi chad pa yod gsungs gzigs nas gsol zho dkar yol gang gi khar bsod dan zhig bzhag nas gnang / yag po 'dug gsungs mjug rtsom gsungs nas gnang / 'di ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' yin gsungs/ zhes pa ltar na/ mjug rtsom gnang nas byin gyis brlabs phyir bla ma'i mtshan bkod pa'am yang na snga mo'i dus su rang rtsom la bla ma'i mtshan bkod na sri zhur 'gro ba'i srol zhig kyang yod pa thos la/ gal te bla ma zhabs dkan tshang gis spyang lung ba'i rnam than zhig mdzad yod tsho nyang mtshams pan rtsom skul gnang ba'i dgos pa dben pa'i phyin na dpyad pa'i gnas so/ /mjug mthar deb 'di'i par skrun la thugs khur zab bzhes gnang mkhan skyabs rje 'jigs med 'od gsal nol ba'i blo gros dang / ma yig g.yar gnang mkhan nyang gi bla ma rin chen byums/ zhu dag pa 'jigs med chos mchog dang shes bya kun mkhyen/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po a ri'i kun phan thebs rtsa tshogs pa bcas la thugs rje che che zhu zhu/sngags mang zhib 'jug khang gis/2༷༷5lo'i zla5bar zi ling du/

dkar chagadakar chaganyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i rnam thar rin chen phreng ba/ (1)mgur tshogs/ (du3)skyabs mgon bla ma zhabs dkar pa rin po che'i rnam thar gsol 'debs dad pa'i sgo 'byed/ (144)reb kong sngags mang la khrims su bca' ba'i gtam mi phyed rdo rje'i tha tshig (1du6)bca' yig thar pa'i them skas/ (166)rdo 'bum dkar po brtsegs tshul rin chen lhan po/ (169)ci ti brtsigs tshul rab brjid ri rab lhan po/ (176)lab tse'i dpangs bstod dgos 'dod kun 'byung / (180)lha rten gnas ri sogs la khrus gsol byed tshul rab dkar shel gyi bum bzang / (188)bcu gsum 'khor zhag gi rde'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad/ (193)ser bsrung me yi gur khang / (211)zab chos 'khor ba dbyings sgrol sgrub chen gyi phyag len zin bris padma dkan po'i phreng ba/ (216)zab lam 'khor ba dbyengs sgrol gyi kha skong sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od snang 'bum brdal/ (221)bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lag len gsal byed me long / (233)rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ye shes me 'od/ (240)seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum gyi gtor bzlog bya tshul gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog rgod bdud dpung phye mar 'thag byed/ (246)skyes bu chen po rdo rje legs pa'i gsol mchod 'khyer bde/ (269)mgon po'i dbal chu bskol tshul dag byed bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng / (260) 1

rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dgra 'ching dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i zhags pa/ (271)gas 1 spyan/ bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje rin po che'i sku tshe tha ma'i rnam than byung tshul utpa la'i chun po/ (280)

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so mtsho/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i rnam than rin chen phreng pe bzhugs so/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang / / longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho/ / sprul sku shāka thub padma 'byung gnas sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal/ / tshogs gnyis mthu las 'gro drug 'dren mdzad cing / /nang gzhan smin grol lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bun snying nas 'dud/ /'bral ba med par thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /padma kā na'i zhal skyin rang gzhan mgon/ /smin grol gdams pa stsol mdzad bla ma sogs/ /'brel thogs yongs 'dzin rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ / rang gzhan don gnyis 'thub par byen gyis rlobs/ /yi dam zhi khro sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro brgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde/ / chos ldan skyong mdzad srung ma'i tshogs la 'dud/ / 'gal rkyen kun sol las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ / sngon bsags khyung sngon skyes kyis legs drangs pa'i/ /skyabs mgon nam mkha'i nor bu'i gzi 'od kyis/ /rab bskyangs nyam chung 'dam skyes bdag 'dra la/ / skyes stobs yon tan sbrang rtsi'i nor dbul yang / / rang slob dad dam ldan pa 'ga' zhig gis/ / yang yang bskul ngor ngan rtog bgrang yas las/ / legs pa'i cha yi rtogs brjod nyung ngu zhig / 'bri la rtsa gsum lha yis gnang ba stsol/ /de yang nyang skyes zan po mtshams ming bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am snang mdzad rdo rjen 'bod pa'i rmongs tsul chos pa'i gzugs brnyan blun po nyam chung bdag lta bu la/ bzang rtog ri bong rwa dang 'dra zhing / ngan rtog gram pa'i rdo las mang bas rnam thar rtsom pa'i 'os med kyang / shing yos dbyur chos chen mo'i steng nang slob sngags pa 'ga' na re/ khyed sbas pa'i rnal 'byon pa chen po 'ig yin rabs sogs nang la mi 'os pa'i bsngags brjod mang po byas/deng skabs khyed kyang mtshan snyan grags che zhing dgung lo bgres pa'i sgang 'dir khyed kyi rnam than zhig phris la zhog dang / phyi rabs nged slob bu rnams kyi dad pa'i gsos su 'gyur zhes yang yang no ba gzir yang don gnyen ma byas/ de'i rjes su lha khang mtshams pa ka ba

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo ji'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigasanon bu/ kun dga' rgyul mtshan/ stag yan klu 'bum dpal/ klu 'bum rgyal/ padma rig 'dzin sogs nas yang yang bskul cing / bla ma'i gdan sa bkra shis 'khyel ba nas rang gi slob bu rdzong dkar dkon mchog non bus lha dzas bcas zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/ snang ba thams cad chos kyi sku du shan/ / mdzad pa 'jin las bod khams yongs la khyab/ / rdo ༷rje theg pa'i bstan pa spel mdzad pa'i/ ༷/ dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ ༷/bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / skyabs gcig dam pa khyed dang mi 'bral zhing / /gsung gi bdud rtsis bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ / rang gzhan don gnyis lhun kyis 'grub pan shog / pha rgan khyed kyi ci mdzad rnam thar bzhin/ / bdag gis sgrub par smon lam 'debs dgos pas/ / rjes 'jug bdag sogs bu slob thams cad kyi/ / dad pa'i gsos su nyid kyi rnam thar zhig / sba gsang med par brtse ba chen po yis/ / gsungs zhes thal mo spyan nas lan brgyar zhu/ /re 'bras don ldan mdzod cig bla ma rje/ /pha rjes bu yis zin pan byin gyis rlobs1 / zhes phul bar 'di smras/ skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu la/ /sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma rje'i/ /rnam thar zin par byin gyis rlobs/ / e ma slob bu khyod nyon dang / / skyabs rje dam pa'i rnam than la/ /ltos dang byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung / khrun po nga 'dra'i rnam than la/ lhogs pa'i cha zhig 'bri rgyu med/ /ngan rtog bris na dad pa 'grib/ /de bas kha nog nyal du chugs/ /khyod kyis gong ma'i rnam thar spyongs/ / pha rgan bdag la dad pa de/ / sngon gyi smon lam yod pa'i rtags/ / gsol ba thob dang de kas 'ongs/ / zhes smras tshe/ kho na re/ bdag la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang dad pa yod pas zhus pa yin pas cis kung gsungs pa zhig mkhyen zhes phyag 'tshal nas nan du zhu ba'i tshe/ bdag gi bsam pa la/ rang yang na so rgas lo lnga bcu nga dgu la bslebs/ 'jig rten pa'i gtam dpe la/ lo lnga bcu lon na lo med/byu pho 'go ma grags na nam med zer ba ltar/ da 'dug khom chen po ye yod ci shes/ skyabs mgon bla ma zhabs dkan pa rin po che'i bka' las/ khyod kyis rang gi rtogs brjod rnam than zhig dang mgun ma yod pa rnams glegs bam du phris la zhog dang mi shi na dga'/ lo na ning dga' zer ba ltar rjes ma 'ongs pa na bla ma zhabs dkar pa'i slob ma nyang gi mtshams pa byer brdo dgo mgur sa zer red ces lta mkhan bzhi bka'am mags pa tshos khre'/ 'bri zhe/ gal srid gtiX she sgro da/ zer 'byu nga ngo /ma tha/ra nyung du ga gzhan mkhas pa —sa —la yang 'a —sa pas kho

rang rnam rin chen phreng ba bzhugs so/ /da ni rnam thar dngos la/ rang nyid skyes pa'i yul ni reb kong gser mo ljongs kyi smad kyi cha yin la/ rigs ni spyol rigs su gtogs pa tsho 'du'i che bo tshang nas chad cing / nong bo'i mar nang gi nang so blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis nyang gi sa cha 'dir tsho 'du nas a mye klu rgyal thar zer ba de bos nas nyang gi sa'i gzer bu btab/ mes po de la spun snying byums mkhar/ ban rgan/ dab 'byams pa skal ldan rdo rje zhes gur mgon dngos su 'khor ba dang bzhis sa bzung / mi nabs gnyis pa gcod pa don yod rdo rje zhes gnyan po zhig dang / klu 'bum rgyal/ tshe gzungs skyabs bzhi/ mi dbas gsum pa bka' 'bum/ 'phags lo/tshe gzungs skyabs/ rta mgrin skyabs dang bzhi/ mi nabs bzhi ba nyang gi bla ma zhes gnyan po grags can de dang / klu 'bum/ yum me gsum/ mi rabs lnga ba nang la yon tan bslabs pa'i mes po sngags 'chang dkon mchog skyabs zhes zab mo gcod kyi nyams len gtso bo dang / rta mgrin dung phyur sogs yi dam mang po'i bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol zhing drag po mngon spyod kyis pha nol cham la 'bebs nus pa de nyid dgung lo don lngar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te gshegs dus gdung ring bsrel 'ja' 'od sogs kun gyis mthun snang du grub pa gcig po skyes/ mi rabs drug pa nyang gi mtshams pa zhes phyi 'dul ba nang gsang sngags pa lo grangs mang po mtshams la gzhol cing / 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa sa ya/ rta mgrin dung phyur/ gsang sngags kyi yi dam bdun tsam gyi bsnyen tshad rtags thon du song ba de la/ spun tshe ring don grub/ ngag dbang ste gsum/ mi rabs bdun pa ni bdag yin la/ pha ni sngags pa che ring don grub ces rgyud 'jam zhing gzhan la phan thogs pa de dang / ma ni snying mo byams zhes rgyud drang ba gnyis la bu ma skyes par/ mes po dkon mchog de nyid sku phyogs bses khri rgan tshang gi dpon yin stabs thugs shin tu mthun pas lung bstan zhus par/ ma lo nyer brgyad steng klu dbang rgyal bo zhig sgrubs dang tsha bo ya mtshan can zhig skye zhes gsungs par klu dbang rgyal bo bsgrubs tshe mngal du chags yod dus/ khu bo mtshams pa tshang gi rmi lam la gzhis ka nas stag pa'i sdong bo zhig skyes pa rmis tshe khu bo na re/ gnyan shing stag pa yin pas tsha bo gnyan po zhig skye rgyu red zed skad/ gzhan 'ga' res rmi lam yag po 'ga' rmis rabs zer/ de nas sa rta lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum gyi dgung mo dbang gi dus tshod la skyes pas/ mes pos lha bsang btang nas padma dbang rgyul zhes ming btags/ skyes ma thag nas byis pa gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing / byis pa'i dus nas 'don pa dang nol mo dkrol ba/gtor ma bca' ba sogs kyi lad mo byed pa zhig yin zer/ nga'i rje /nas spun che ci1 rig

gas/ nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dzin/ mgon po rab brtan gnyis skyes/chu khye lo lnga'i steng bsam cung zad shes tshe nga brdo byed rgyu yin zhes nang gi gon pa'i steng du bsde zhes yi ge bris/ sdig pa sogs la 'dzem zhing chos tshugs bzung / ri mgo tshor song che sa dang lci ba sogs la gtor ma 'dra ba bcos nas rtsed grogs byis pa rnams la 'phen du bcug rdo leb ngos la yi ge dang ri mo bris pa yang dran/chu phag lo drug gi steng / smras pa/ mthu stobs nus pa'i dbang phyug rigs sngags 'chang / / dkon mchog mtshan can mes po de nyid kyis/ / yi ge bslabs dang chos sgon bcug pa yi/ /bka' drin dran bzhin lag pad snying gar zum/ /zhes mes po dkon mchog gis yi ge bslabs pa tshegs med du shes pa byung /shing byi lo bdun steng 'brum pa'i nad thu mo byung dus mgo g.yog tu zan 'chang re lag tu bzhag na gtor ma lta bu bcos nas de la g.yengs nas bsdad pa yang dran/ chung dus nga mthu la dga' bas yig ngo cung chod tshe ra zhig la tshe thar btags yod pa spyang kis bsad tsho bsang gsur gyi che dam can la 'jin bcol byus/ rdo leb steng spyang ki'i liṅgā bris gdong sna gnyan sa mang pon song nas bcag nas mnan pa'i rjes nas rngon pa zhig gis spyang ki zhig bsad tshe de yin zhes dga'/ 'gro dus dal mo byus rgan tshul bzung nas 'khyog pon song tshe/ bla rgan zhig gis 'di'i dpyi la skyon zhig med dam zhes pa'i tshe/ sngan sgyu spyang ki ltar dmod mo byus 'phral/ bla rgan shi bas nga'i mthu yin snyam dga'/shing glang lo brgyad kyi steng / smras pa/ sdom gsum nor bu'i rgyal mtshan grags pa'i mtshan/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag nus ldan rje/ /gan dbang rdo rje zhes grags khu bo des/ /bdag ni lugs gnyis kyis bskyangs bka' drin kad/ /ces drin can khu bo mtshams rgan dam pa des bu gcig ltar gces par bskyangs nas bslab bya gnang / ri mo phran bu zhig bslabs/ a yi rban mo zhig dang ma yar gnyis nas gces spras byas za ma bzang po byen nas bskyangs pa yang yang dran/ de dus smras pa/ padma 'byung gnas rnam 'phrul 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rang gzhan grol byed gdams pa legs bstsal bas/ / drin can gang des rjes bzung byen rlabs pas/ / nang rgyud dam pa'i chos kyis phyug 'di rmad/ / ces tso ba'i bla ma grub dbang padma rang grol rin po che phebs pa la dga' nas thag ring bod bsu ba la song /mjal nas sba mkhar khun nas sngon la yong / mdun nas sngon 'gro kha shas dang tsho sgrub sogs kyi lung ka phyag mdud ser po zhig gnang nas 'di chos pa bzang po zhig yong gsungs pa ni

rang rnam rin chen greng ba bzhugs so/ /rjes nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/me stag lo dgu'i steng mes pos rtsed mtshar du sgo drung du mtshams tho bzhag nas skad gseng mthon pos/ hūṃ steng sgo srung ba'i phra men ma/ / phyi mtshams chod la nang mtshams sdoms/ / zhes bton nas da khyod nang sgo 'di la bud mi chog ces nang du bcug nangs nub tu skyabs 'gro/ badzra gu du/ a na pa tsa/ chos srung gi gtor bsngos sogs shes tshad khral bzhag byus pa bton/ gsan rnying gi chos spyod sogs blo 'dzin dang / rnying ma'i cho ga mang po la ngo sbyang byas tshe/ khong ha cang gtum drag nas ngo dkad po mi ston pa la sun nas dgra du bzung / lkog nas zan la zod chung mang po bcos/ ngo spyang gtong ba'i ba'i la ba rnams bton nas mes po la dmigs nas 'phangs/ nyin gcig gtor zlog 'dra ba chung ngu zhig bcos/ rtsang gi tshab tu rtswa thun btsugs/ zan ling dang ling zung zhig bris/ cho ga ltar bton nas dpal 'ban zhig sban nas shod du phab tshe mes po yong nas sdang mig gis ci yin zen/ skrag nas bsdad tshe cung zhig 'dzum nas khyod kyis thon dang gtor ma khos 'khyer zhes 'phangs nas rjes su bzlog pa byas tshe/ kho la dmigs pa ma shes snyam/ ha cang bcum nas bdeg brdung byas tshe da lta lcebs sam shi na 'dod/ de skabs dgra du bzung ba ma gtogs phan btags pa ma bsam/ da lta bsam na mes po drin can de'i drin las yi ge gang la thogs rgyu med pa 'di byung bsam bsngo smon yang yang tses/ ma zhang gu du rdo rje nas gtor ༵ slab ༈/ga len/ a khu mchog ldan dang bris pa mkhar lo gnyis nas yi ge dkar nag 'bri rgyu me yos lo bcu tham pa'i steng pha shi ba la byes pa'i spyod pa byas dga' sdug ma byung /sa 'brug lo bcu gcig steng / smras pa/ nam mkha' bzhin du rdzogs chen lta ba rtogs/ / 'jigs med dam chos nga nos 'gro ba sdud/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas gdams pa stsol mkhas pa'i/ / grub dbang dam pa de la bdag kyang dad/ / ces grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po spyang lung dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med rin po che zho bong la ka'i sngags mang gis gdan drangs par song / bka' brgyad dbang chen gnang dus byin 'bebs skabs bdag la byin babs tshe/ nyid rin po che thugs dgyes nas 'di byis pa yin stabs g.yo sgyu mi shes pas byin babs pa rten 'bre' bzang / 'di skal ldan zhig red gsungs brtse bar mdzad/bsam pa lhun thub ma'i dbang lung dang byu rgyud thugs rje chen po sogs mang po thob tshe dad pa skyes/ — 5 —

gas1 nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sa sbrul bcu gnyis steng ma drin can ma shi tshe bsngo smon gang shes bton/lcags rta bcu gsum steng / smras pa/ sngon bsags khyung sngon skyes kyis legs drangs pa'i/ /lung rtogs yon tan kun mnga' nam mkha'i nor/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul ba grub pa'i dbang / / dam lhag rdo rjes bdag rgyud byen gyis zlobs/ / zhes khyung lung nas pa dam tshig rdo rje rin po che phebs par bkra shis 'khyel bar song nas mjal/ klong chen snying thig gi dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ rje btsun mi la'i dbang / le'u bdun ma'i lung / rgyud 'bum bka' gtad sogs thob/ rjes su rang khyim la phebs nas tshogs 'khor dang mgun hūṃ༈bye~X /blangs pas yid drangs/ khyod grwa sa nas ma 'dug mtshams pa yag po zhig gyis ༄ lcags lug bcu bzhi'i steng / smras pa/ padma kā ra'i rnam 'phrul grub pa'i dbang / /rdo rje theg pa'i gdams pa stsol mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang chen po ma ba'i mtshan can gyis/ /bdag la zab dgu'i gdams pa gnang 'di rmad/ / ces rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis rin po che'i gdung rgyud rgyal bo'i sngags 'chang bkra shis 'bum rin po che'i mkha' 'gro seng gdong bdud 'dul drag mo'i srog dbang dmar nag bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs thob/zu sprel bco lnga'i steng mes pos nong bo'i dgon chen du khrid nas/ smras pa/ sngon bsags bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal mnga' ba'i/ / rje btsun bla ma'i dbang lung man ngag dang / / khyad par rab tu byung ba'i bka' drin ni/ / stong gsum gsed gyis bkang yang gzhal dkar 'khums/ / zhes sprul sku drung yig dbon po bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i mdun nas rab byung gi sdom pa mnos/ ming bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor btags/'jigs byed/ rta mgrin/ gcod sogs kyi dbang / thar mdo sogs lung mang po thob/chu bya bcu drug steng mes pos mtshams la 'dug tu bcug nas/ snga dro skyabs sems sogs sngon 'gro dang yi dam bsnyen pa/ badzra gu du/ a ra pa tsa/ khros nag seng gdong / rta mgrin sogs 'bum gten re grangs bzung nas 'don du bcus skabs der rmi lam du shel dgon gyi thad kyi nam mkhar 'ja' gur zlum po rnga tsam pa lnga sgrom gyi nang nas rgyul ba rigs lnga gsal bad mthong ba rmis pa de sngon gyi bag chags shig yin nam snyam/shing khye bcu bdun steng dang shing phag bco brgyad steng gnyis la/ bla ma padma rang grol ba du mdun du yang yang song nas bsdad/ yid bzhin mdzod kyi khrid dang / klong

rang rnam rin chen zang ba bzhugs so/ /chen snying thig gi khrid gnad smin/ 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang / grub thob brgyud cu sogs dbang lung mang po thob/ thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung / sku mdun nas yig bskud dang phyag dpe mang po bris/ shar thams cad mkhyen pa dang / mkhan chen tshang / shing bza' tshang / brag dkar sngags rams pa/ rdzong dkad zhabs drung sogs kyi mdun nas lung mang po thob/ khams bla ma gten ston mdun nas tshe dbang thob/me byi bcu dgu'i steng drin can mes po de nyid zhi ban gshegs tshe gdung dbyangs 'di ltar/ na mo gu du/ skyabs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / bdag sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / ban mgon med bstan 'dzin rgyu mtsho la1 / pha bla mas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /mgon grub dbang padma rang grol rje/ /phas bor ba'i dwa phrug bdag la gzigs/ /bdag pha ma gnyis kyis chung dus bskyur/ / de'i rjes su mes pos shi bskyur byas/ / nga'i pha las lhag pa'i sku drin can/ /mgon dkon mchog mthu stobs rnam rgyal zhes/ /sngags nus pa can de dag thing gshegs/ /tsha mgon med 'khor ba'i 'dam du lus/ /bu mtshams rgan grags pa rgya mtsho sogs/ /nged rjes na yod pa'i nye du yis/ /lam ston pa'i bla ma bcu tsam zhus/ / 'bul ba dang bsngo rten gya nom phul/ / zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar dag tu/ /thugs dgongs pa rdzogs thabs gnad smin bgyis/ / pha sku drin can sgyu dge rtsa du/ / stong gsum po gser gyis bkang phul kyang / / drin gzhal mtha' med kyang 'byor tshad kyi/ / rgyu nor dang chos kyis drin lan bsabs/ / gdung zhugs 'bul skabs su 'ja' tshon dang / /ring bsrel gyi ril bu babs pa sogs/ / ltas ya mtshan shar bas dad pa skyes/ / de'i dus su bdag gi rmi lam la/ / rdor sems dang sgrol dkar rnam gnyis kyi/ / sku mang pos gdung la brgyun pa rmis/ / pha bla ma padma rang grol nas/ / gzigs snang la 'ja' 'od lam brgyud nal/ / gnas mkha' spyod zhing du gshegs zhes gsungs/ / rgyul dge 'dun bstan pa'i nyi ma yis/ /gzim mis su gzan dkan 'ig gsol nas/ /zhing bde ba can du gshegs zhes gsungs/ /bdag ltos bcas dga' bas thal mo spyar/ /bya rgod pos nam 'phang bcad pa bzhin/ /bdag mes pos bskyur bas zhe re rgongs/ /rje mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje de/ /gnas mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs pa bzhin/ /mgon sku drin can de mkha' sbyod gshegs/ /pha nor bu 'dra ban gang nas mjal/ / sbu da mthong ma red de mthong red/ / gsung da thos ma red de thos red/ /mi re res khog nas snying re phyung / /mig mchi mas bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor bkrus/ / dbugs kha du 'tshangs nas gnon mi nus/ / phas mi mngon dbyengs ga ba/san

sa nyang skyes snang mdzad rdorje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lags sam/ /kye hud ces mang po ngus na yang / /sngags nus pa can de gang nas 'byon/ /sgyu lus la nad kyis btab pa'i che/ /der byin rlabs gnang mkhan dag zhing gshegs/ /lo tog la ser bas gdung ba'i tshe/ /de srung mkhan dag pa'i zheng du gshegs/ /bdag skyabs gnas re ltos su la 'tshol/ /de bsam na sems kyis mi nus gi /pha bla ma mchog gsum byin rlabs dang / / lha rta mchog nol ba'i nus mthu dang / / mgon de yi thugs bskyed sbon lam mthus/ /thugs dgongs pa zab mo yongs rdzogs shog /ces blangs/ drin gzo ru gsal 'debs dang zhi khro'i skong bshags/ thos grol/ thar mdo sogs la 'bad/ dgongs rdzogs su bla ma bcu tsam dang / dgon pa lnga la dge rtsa bcos/ gdung dus la ril bu babs/'ja' tshon shan ba sogs mthong snang du gyur/me glang nyi shu tham pa'i steng / smras pa/ 'jigs bral dpa' bo mi yi seṅge mchog /mtha' med 'gro ba'i don du thugs bskyed nas/ / skal bzang gdul byar chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i/ / bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' drin gzhal du med/ / ces bla ma dam pa 'jigs med skal bzang rin po che phebs pa'i mdun nas mdo sngags smon lam gyi khrid/dge ba gsum gyi don khrid/ nyi ma grags pa'i gur drag dbang / thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol dang 'khon ba dong spru gas gnyis kyi dbang lung / bskyed rim khrid sogs dbang lung mang po thob/ a ye drin can ma 'das par thos grol dang dge rtsa bsgrubs/shing stag nyer gcig steng khu bo dang lhan du nong bo nas sku phyogs bde chen tshang gi zhabs brtan la rgyal bo gser mdos bsgrubs/ sku phyogs byang rtse tshang la lha chen zhig bsgrubs/shing yos nyen gnyis steng brag dkar nang nas thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gyi ma ṇi'i sgrub chen kyi mchod g.yog byas/ bla ma padma rang grol rin po che'i mdun nas gzhan la dbang lung mang po gnang ba'i mchod g.yog byas/lcags 'brug nyer gsum steng lo mtshams dam pon bsdad nas/ yi dam mang po'i las dung gi bsnyen pa dang gtso bo rta mgrin gyi bsnyen pa sa ya lhag tsam song / bla ma padma rang grol rin po ches khyod la rtags mtshan gang byung yi gen phobs gsungs pas/ 'di ltar/ e ma ho/ mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi gten mdzod che/ / bdag gzhan skyabs gcig grub dbang 'khod lo'i mgon/ /skyabs su bsten na gtan gyi bde sten ba'i/ /bka' drin 'khod med mi pham mgon por 'dud/ / bgrang byu'i mtshams la ming btags rnam g.yeng dang / /yi dam lha ḍi bsnyen pa'i(pan)bsnyad btags kyang / /bskyed rdzogs la sogs dmigs pa mi

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /shes par/ /rtags mtshan rmi lam tsam la re ba mtshar/ /gzhi dbyings khyad chos drug ldan ma lags pa/ / thams cad rdzun ma'i rnam 'gyud chen po zhes/ / kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rjes gsungs pas na/ /tha mal 'khrul ba'i rmi lam lta ci sbos/ /'on kung mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhal snga nas/ / rmi lam gang rmis yi ger 'beb dgos zhes/ / gsungs dang dngos nyams rab 'bring tha ma du/ / rmi lam zhes gsungs don ltar bri bar bya/ / sgrol dkar bsnyen skabs ri rtsen me tog dang / /nyi shar nol mo mang dkrol myu gu rgyas/ /bud med gsum gyis bsus kyang rgan mor bsgyur/ / de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ / 'chi bdag g.yul spyol bsnyen skabs me tog rgyas/ / khri la 'dug cing gzhan la dbang bskur rmis/ / seng gdong gtor sgrub dang bcas gegs med grub/ / de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ / gsang bdag dregs 'dul bsnyen skabs klu gnod sar/ /rdo 'bum brtsigs snyam de ma thag tu grub/ /bro brdung sgyus btab gan stabs mang po byas/ /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /rig byed dbang mo bsnyen skabs ri bo'i rtsed/ / phyin dang dbang gi mtshan ma mang po rmis/ / bdud 'dul drag mo'i bsnyen sgrub dang bcas thub/ / de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ / non lha lha mang sgrub dus bla ma yi/ / mtha' skor dar zab mang brtsigs mi zhig gis/ / ban rgan tshul gyis 'gab 'dre tshan gcod rmis/ /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /klu gten sgrub skabs drin can bla ma yis/ /ma dzod yig kha phye bstan sogs dngos grub kyi/ /rtags mtshan dang bcas gegs med mtha' du phyin/ /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bsnyen sgrub skabs/ / tshur la rgol ba'i mi gnyis mtshon cha yis/ /de ma thag tu bsad nas med par byus/ /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /lo ka'i gton sgrub skabs su ban rgan zhig /khros nas gos byen ma spyon phag tu bsgyur/ /bsad nas zag pa 'bur song mang po bsad/ /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /yi dam rta mtshog nol ba'i rgyun bsnyen skabs/ /ban man zhig gis 'gran 'tshol shed tshad tshe/ /bla ma'i drung nas sa la bsgyel cing brdung / /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ / nub cig gza' yin snyam pa'i mgo dgu pa/ / nag po ri tsam 'ig gis gnod 'tshe'i tshe/ / rta mgrin skur bzhengs bsad pas khu bor gyur/ / de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /nam zhig khang chung zhig na bdag gnas dus/ /bud med cig gis gsod snyam bros pa'i che/ /ri rtser 'phun nas rjes su ma chod rmis/ /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /nub cig sgrub khang steng du phyin pa'i tshe/ /khang steng me tog dmar pos khyab pa dang / /nyi shar dbyar gyi dus ltad ka dī rmi1/ /

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /de dus bla ma dngos su phebs pa dang / /mi lam du yang rgyun du skyob cing srung / /bslab ston gnang sogs mi lam bzang po this/ /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /mkhyen brtse sprul sku phebs zhes thos pa'i nub/ /rmi lam cha nas nyid kyi zhal dkyil mjal/ /'od dpag med kyi dbang skun gnang ba rmis/ /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /yang zhig mkha' nas mkhyen brtsen mjal shes na/ /lnga bcud 'tsho zhing sang nyin lce yi steng / / yi ge gnas pa'i dbang skud gnang zhes mis/ / de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /phyi nyin mkhyen brtse sprul sku dngos su phebs/ /'phags mgon thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang zhing / /brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ /bla ma'i thugs smon bzhin du lo gcig la/ / rta mchog nol ba'i rtsa bsnyen sa ya grub/ / bcad rgyar bar chad med par mtha' ru phyin/ / de yang drin can bla ma khyod kyi drin/ / deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ / mtshan ldan bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i snying bo lon pa dang / /skad cig tsam yang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs pad bskal brgyan brtan/ /mched grogs rnams kyang thugs mthun dam tshig gtsang / / pha mas gtso byas 'brel thogs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bdag cag ltos bcas che ring nad med shog /sngon tsho byis pa lo brgyad nas bzung ste/ /da lta lang tsho dar bab yan chad du/ 1dam pa'i chos sgon zhugs pa khyed kyi drin/ /drin lan sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes/ / deng nas tshe rabs kun tu pha khyed las/ / skyabs gnas gzhan du nam yang mi 'tshol bas/ /'di dang phyi ma bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /skyongs pan mdzod cig rtsa ba'i bla ma rje/ / rmi lam 'di rnams bdag gi rdzun yin na/ / bka' srung skyes bu'i drag rtsal nus mthu dpang / / 'di bris dge bas rgyal bstan dar ba dang / / bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs pad brtan gyur cig / ces bris/ de dus dad pa dga' mo yin stabs rtags mtshan ya mtshan pa byung /lcags sprul nyer bzhi'i steng / smras pa/ mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro kun rjes su 'dzin/ /ye shes rdo rje'i rnam nol sprul ba'i sku/ /dbang lung gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin gang de yis/ /bdag la bu gcig bzhin du nab tu brtse/ /zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug mkhyen brtse ba'i sprul sku rin po che phebs pa'i drung nas klong chen snying thig gi dbang lung yongs rdzogs dang gzhan dbang lung mang po thob/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i brag khung gsan bzhengs byas nas bzhuX/sa ste~X ༷༷mas g.yog byas/ sbyin sreg khri tsho blugs pa'i sku g.yog bsgrubs/ stag mo

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /rdzong nas yun ring bzhugs dus mdun nas bsdad/ nang khyim nas sbyin sreg blugs/tshogs 'khon zhig gi skabs khro bo 'cham dang keng dus gnyis bcos nas ma ṭi bsgral nas sgrub chen zhig gi rten 'brel bsgrigs/ de dus ma ṇi'i sgrub chen 'di tshugs pa'i lung bstan/yul lha'i bsang yig dang lab tse'i sa 'dul gnang / glu gar sogs rtsed mo sna tshogs byus thugs spro gnang / lha di'i rin chen gsang phug nas bzhugs dus sku mdun nas bsdad/phyag dpe mang po bris/ phebs khar tshe da'ang dus tshe mda' 'phel ba/ lha ri gdan drangs pa sogs dang lung bstan thog tu khel ba mang po gnang / yul lha lcang shad gyi lab tse gzhi brtsigs byus/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i ma ṇi'i tshogs dbun spyang lung dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med rin po che gdan drangs/ bka' chos zhus/ 'bul chen btegs1 dgyes nyams kyis phebs/ rjes nas zhi bad gshegs dus gdung dbyangs 'di blangs/ skyabs bslu med yo rgyan chen po dang / / don dbyer med grub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / mgon dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med de/ / dus da lta dran no thugs rjes gzigs/ / deng snyigs ma'i dmu rgod gdul bya rnams/ /thabs du mas dge la sgyur byed pa'i/ /rje sna nam yang sprul grub pa'i dbang / / pha sangs rgyas gnyis pa gang du byon/ / yul reb kong gser ljongs sngags rlom rnams/ / las dge sdug 'jol nyog spyod pa'i tshe/ / 'grigs bsdams nas chos la btsud pa yi/ / mgon nam mkha'i mtshan can dbyings nas dgongs/ / bdag slob 'bangs bsod nams dman pa'i mthus/ / khong nam mkha'i nor bu 'od gsal ba/ / dus da lta chu lha'i pang du gzims/ / bdag slob tshogs mun pa'i gling du lhang / / bstan padma'i tshal de su yis skyong / /da lhar du shar ri'i phrag pa nas/ /'od gsal ler byon na dga' ba la/ /bdag pad tshal bskyangs na spyid pa la/ /sngags bstan pa'i srung ma rā hu la/ /spyan stong gis byu na byed do skad/ / pha bstan pa'i bdag po mi bsrung na/ / khyod gdug pa'i spyan mang des ci bya/ / rje grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / / nang gdul byu sngags mang snying rje nas/ / sku'i yang srid myur du byon nas kyang / / bdag gdul bya sngad bzhin brtse bas skyongs/ /mgon rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byen rlabs dang / / dpal chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i mthus/ / rje bla ma'i sprul sku nyi ma che/ / mar 'gro ba'i don du gsal ban shog / pha bla ma zhing khams gar bzhugs kyang / / bdag 'brel thogs zhing du 'dren pa dang / / chos smin grol lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ / mgon khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog / rje dran pas gdung dbyangs blangs pa'i mthus/ /rang 'bral med rjes su 'dzin pa dang —/ /1ga ba

sa / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chen dan rgyas 'gro ba rnam sa/ / dus rtag tu bde zheng spyid par shog / ces blangs nas dang rte ༵nga 'a bod byu/ sa/sbu phyogs tsho 'du'i grub chen tshang gshegs song ba'i gdung gi do dam chu rta nyer lnga'i steng / smras pa/ blo bzang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal mtshan che/ /ngur sprig gar gyis rnam nol mkhan chen rjes/ / dbang lung man ngag gdams pa bstsal pa dang / /khyad par bsnyen par rdzogs pa bka' drin che/ /zhes nong bo nas sku phyogs bde chen rin po che blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs brtan du zla ba gsum gyi ring la bka' 'gyur dag 'don byas/ bla ma padma rang grol nas rnam sbyar zhig gnang nas bsnyen rdzogs sgrubs gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud pa'i grwa ba 'ga' dang lhan du mkhan po blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mkhan po dang / rgyud pa'i dge bskul nas gsang ston byas dge 'dun grangs tshang gi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ skra la dmigs gsal gyi gnang ba gnang / gung tshigs chab len sogs yun ring du byus/ lo ltan gyi spyang lung ma ṇi'i sgrub chen la song nas sbyin sreg blugs/chu lug nyer drug steng / smras pa/ blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi mchog /'gro khams rgya mtshor chos kyi chad 'bebs pa'i/ / rje btsun bla mas byen gyis brlabs pa'i mthus/ / nang la phyogs med dad gus che ba byung / / zhes sku phyogs gsen khang rdo rje 'chang rin po che'i drung nas shel dgon dang rdong bo gnyis nas lam rim khrid dang / sems bskyed mchod pa sngang kha shas thob/ de dus bdag la ral ba yod stabs chos gos khyer nas chos nyan snre yin rteX tsho~X rnyi bye sdi~X sdo bye ༵/gas nga'i chos gos 'then nas sngags rban chos gos btsong rgyu shing sprel nyer bdun steng tsha bo padma bstan 'dzin skyes pa la ming btags/ ḍā dril dkrol shes tsam nas khu bo dang lhan du grong chog la song / khen 'go byas nong bo'i nang chen phal cher gling rgya smad pa zho bong la dpyi tsho 'du byang chub tres tsi bzhi sogs la grong chog la song nas nyi ma nam tsha btang gtor sha sogs spengs/ mo rtsis byas che 'bum khang brgya lhag tshogs brgya tshe thar ma ṇi sogs la bskul mod kyang dkor zas zos pa la 'gyod/shing bya nyer brgyad steng bla ma padma rang grol rin po che gdan drangs/ rig 'dzin zhi ba'i spyin sreg cig gnang rgyu'i gra bsgrigs tshe nyid bdud rtsis pad nas phud pa'i sbyin sreg gan— gci/—sa 'di sngags pas gang ba'i nyams shan/ phyin chad phur pa'i chos rgyun

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /'dzugs dgos gsungs/ phun pa'i sgo nas sbyin sreg rgyas par gnang / phun bu'i dbang lung sngags pa 'ga' la gnang nas phur pa'i chos thog btsugs/ bca' yig gnang / dam pa gang de bdag la thugs brtse bas/ skabs der spyid sdug legs nyes gang gi dus skyabs 'jug zhu sa khong las med/ chos 'jig rten gyi bslab ston gnang / bka' bzhin sku mdun nas bdud 'dul lha chen glang gdong la brten pa'i nor sgrub dang sbyin sreg ku du ku lle dang dam can ra gdong sogs bsgrubs/ dam can na gdong gi mgon khang du gzhan 'gro mi nyan kyang / nga rang gis gtor ka gso ba sogs gang byas kyang thugs dgyes pa'i rtags byung /khong dbus su phebs dus mdzo gcig phrug gcig lha dan bcas phul nas phebs rdzongs 'di ltar phul/ skyabs gnas gcig chog drin can bla ma la/ /kha zhe ngo lkog med par gsol ba 'debs/ / bdag sogs bu ngan thugs rjes ma dor ban/ /brtse bas gzigs la bsam pa'i re 'dod skongs/ /stod kyi dgung sngon mthon po'i yan steng na/ /ze ral ldan pa'i g.yu 'brug sngon mo khyod/ /da ni mi bzhugs dgung gzhan 'byon gsungs na/ /ze ral ma rdzogs 'brug chung ngas ci byed/ /ban gyi gangs ri dkar po'i rked pa na/ 1rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i seng ge dkar mo khyod/ /da ni mi bzhugs gangs gzhan 'grims gsungs na/ /lus shed ma rdzogs seng phrug ngas ci byed/ / smad kyi 'o ma'i spyo mtsho'i dkyil shed na/ / gshog zung ldan pa'i ngang ba'i rgyal bo khyod/ / da ni mi bzhugs mtsho gzhan myul song na/ / gshog rtsal ma rdzogs ngang phrug ngas ci byed/ /dben pa'i gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyel gling na/ /mtshan dpes mdzes pa'i drin can bla ma khyod/ / da ni mi bzhugs dbus gtsang phebs song na/ /bskyed rdzogs mi shes slob ngan ngas ci byed/ / rang yang pha khyed zhabs phyir 'gro 'dod kyang / /pha yul gnyen bshes 'khor ba'i btson khang du/ / chags zhen 'dzin pa'i sgrog gis dam du bcings/ /bgrang byas dub pa'i khu bo btson sru nga gis/ /nang gi dbang du ma btang zhe re 'apyod/ / chags zhen 'dzin pa'i sgrog las bla mas khrol/ / bdag ni chung nas nyid kyi sras bzhin du/ 1brtse bas bskyangs nas dbang lung rgya mtsho tsam/ /gnang yang rang sems gyong bo thul ma gyun/ / dper na rgya mtsho'i gling nas stong log bzhin/ / 'od gsal rdzogs chen ma thob zhe re 'gyod/ /ngo sprod gnad smin zhu'o thugs rjes zungs/ /reb kong mun pa'i gling gi snang byed mchog / dbus 'gyur chos kyi 'dun sa der pyon na/ / thos bsam mig ldongs rgongs rtul slob ngan bdag /gti thug spongs pa'i myun pa'i mdzod khang du/ /da lta nyid nas lhung bas zhe re 'gyod/ / slad nas snang gsal sgron me sbar du gsoX / 1/3drid can

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bla ma dbus su byon gyur na/ / mgon med bdag gi mgon skyabs su la re/ / phas bor mas stor dwa phrug 'khyam po nga / / byams brtse'i mnga' bdag thugs kyis 'dor phod dam/ / mya ngam thang du lhung ba'i khu byug nga / / bskyed rdzogs sbrang char ma bab gre ba sgog / thugs rje bsil ba'i char rgyun 'beb mi 'beb/ / dgung sngon nam mkhar zhu'o thugs rjes skyongs/ /tshon leb nags su lus pa'i ka byu nga / /ngo sprod g.yu 'brug ma ldid rna ba 'on/ /sgra dbyungs sprin gyi nang nas sgrog mi sgrog / g.yu 'brug sngon mor zhu'o thugs rjes skyongs/ / myun pa'i gling du lus pa'i slob bu nga / / rdzogs chen don zab ma thob rmongs shing rtul/ / zab rgyas gdams pas bdag rgyud 'dul mi 'dul/ /drin can bla man zhu'o thugs rjes skyongs/ /pha las lhag pa'i drin can bla ma khyod/ / yongs 'dzin gsungs bzhin dbus gtsang byon na yang / /myur du phyid la phebs pa'i bka' drin zhig / rtsa ltung bcu gnyis dpang bor bzhag nas zhu/ /bdag sogs 'di phyi bad do thams cad du/ /nyid kyi thugs gsang dpal gyi be'u nas/ /nam yang 'dor med rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /skad cig tsam yang 'bral ban ma gyun cig /ces phul nas phebs/ dbus gtsang gi sku don rnams grub nas phyir phebs1 rten bta~X /phrug sogs gnang / de'i skabs ma yar ma zhig yod pa shi nas thos grol dang dge rtsa me khyi nyen dgu'i steng khams phyogs nas 'khor ba dong sprugs zhes byu btang sha stag cig phebs/ khyim du mi phebs par srang bar sogs nas cog bu phub nas bzhugs pa/ thugs gtum mo'i rnam pa la snying rje thugs la 'khrungs nas spyan chab mang po bsil ba zhig phebs/nyang gi phyogs bzhi'i sa gnad sogs gnyan sa gang yod nas zhag re gnyis bzhugs/ nyin gcig ri rtse'i mtshams khang gi sar khyod tshos bsang thongs la bsu ba gyis gsungs/ der phebs nas sa 'dul gnang / khong gi nyams la gnas bdag sngags pa'i tshul can zhig gis kho la mchod pa bcu gsum thongs/ 'di nas mtshams khang rgya che ba zhig bzhengs dgos gsungs zer/ zhag mang por bzhugs/ smras pa/ chos sku kun bzang dgongs pa mngon du gyud/ /stobs bcu'i dpal ldan grub dbang 'khod lo'i mgon/ /'gro kun dbang bo dang 'tsham chos char 'bebs/ / rnam 'dren dam pa gtsug gi spyon du 'dzin/ / bla ma padma rang grol rin po che'i thugs bkod ltan dmag gsad kun bzang stobs ldan dbang bo gdan drangs nas phun pa'i dbang lung zhus/ ri rtse nas mtshams khang chung ngu zhig bzhengs/—me ḍi~X sum cu'i steng byang chub ska gsad tsho 'du gling rgya sogs kyi lab tse gzhi brtsigs

rang rnam rin chen greng ba bzhugs so/ /byas/ reb kong sngags mang gi chos thog gral du yang yang song / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i las khur lan 'ga' blangs/sa byi so gcig steng khu bo mtshams rgan dam pa zhi ban gshegs pas mya ngan byas gdung dbyangs 'di thal lo/ / pha dran pas gdung sel rin po che/ / mgon grub dbang padma dang grol rje/ /bdag nyam chung spyi bo'i rgyan bzhugs nas/ /sems sdug bsngal zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ / nga'i dpral ba'i mig dang khog pa'i snying / / dus da lta chos kyi dbyengs su gshegs/ /tsha mgon med bdag ni shul du lus/ /da bya thabs med do ci zhig byed/ /mgon nam mkha'i nor bu nub rin gshegs/ / nga sdug bsngal nun pa'i dbyings su bon/ / khog don snying 'dra ba'i khu bo gshegs/ / da snying med dran pa su yis gso/ / nga'i 'dod 'byung nor bu chom pos 'phrog /da gang 'dod re ba su yis skong / /de bsam na sems kyis mi nus shing / /mig mchi mas gang nas lam mi mthong / / sems ci bya gtol med gyur pa 'di/ /khyed gzigs sam drin can khu bo lags/ / don de phyir sprul sku'i nyi ma yis/ / nga'i ma rig nun pa bsal du gsol/ / lha rtsa gsum srung ma'i byen rlabs dang / / mgon de yi thugs bskyed smon lam mthus/ /thugs dgongs pa yongs su dzogs pa dang / /mchog sangs rgyas thob par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes blangs shing dgongs rdzogs gsal 'debs thos grol sogs gnad smin bsgrubs/ gdung ring bsrel sogs bar dor grol ba'i rtags byung ngo / / de skabs sdug bsngal gyi khung bur tshud yod skabs/ smras pa/ tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs phyin drug nyams blangs nas/ /rang don mngon gyur gzhan don grol byed kyi/ /gdams pas rjes bzung skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor/ /bdag la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che/ /zhes sngon gyi smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mthu las rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug gi nor bu/ 'brel tshad don ldan skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa rin po che dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing nas mdo smad 'din phebs pan mjal ma thag nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ thugs brtse bas zhal gsung snyan mo gsungs/ zhag 'ga' la sku mdun nas sdod gsungs pa ltar bsdad/sa glang so gnyis steng gdan sa bkra this 'khyil bar gsan du phebs nas bka' chos thog ma'i dbu btsugs/ phyag dpe mdun du blangs pa dang / nga sku mdun du thon tshe thugs dbyes pa'i zhal nas zla ba lta bu bstan nas/ 'o khyod chos kyi thog mar glebs pa bzang /khyod nga'i chos kyi bdag po zhig 'ong / da khyod yul du ma 'gro sdod gsungs/ da nas bka'i bsdu ba po byas gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs 'bri dgos gsungs tshe/ lam rim gsa~X brdo sgron

sa nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/me zhig bris kha dar che legs gcig gis dkris nas skyabs 'jug 'di phul/ bdag gi 'di phyi'i skyabs mgon bla ma la/ / bdag yid dad pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ / bdag sogs 'gro la gsungs pa'i mgun 'bum rnams/ / bdag gis khyed gsungs bzhin du bsdu bar sbon/ / pha rgan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i/ / pha nol phyin drug la sogs rgyal ba'i bka'/ /pha ma sems can don du mgur dbyungs rnams/ /pha non bu la stsol bzhin gsungs 'di rmad/ / ma lus phyogs gcig bsdu ba'i skal bzang de/ / ma kad bsod nams stobs kyis byung ba 'di/ / ma shi bar du 'bad pas nyams su len/ / ma nor lam ston khyod thugs dgyes pan mdzod/ / rgyul ba'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong kun/ / kun gyi bcud bsdus mgur 'bum yid bzhin nor/ /nod gyi mchog gyur 'di ko bdag gis thob/ /thob bya bla na med do skal ba bzang / / khyed gsungs gsung snyan dbyud gyi rnga bo che/ / che 'dod 'dod khams gnas nas brdung na yang / /yang dag dag zhing nas bzung gling bzhi'i ban/ /bar mi mi chad snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis khyab/ / mang mang 'gro rnams re re bzhin du yang / / snyan snyan zhal gdams zab zab gang bstsal gyis/ / lhod lhod snang ba 'gyur 'gyur gzhan mkhas pas1 / mang mang bslab bya yang yang bstan kung dka'/ / chos pa'i bogs 'don skye bo'i bslab byu'i chos/ /chos brgyad mgo gnon bzang po'i blo bskyed dang / /dang po'i gang zag rnams la dge ba'i bshes/ /bshes gnyen khyed gsung 'di las gzhan na ci/ /de phyin khyed thugs tshos sku'i mkha' dbyings su/ / mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin dkrigs nas bdag sogs 'gro'i/ / dad pa'i 'dzin mar lhun grub mgun dbyangs kyi/ / char ba rgyun mi chad par dbab tu gsol/ / bdag kyang deng nas che nabs thams cad du/ / mtshan ldan dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung nas/ / zab rgyas chos kyi bdag por 'gyur ba dang / / nyams su blangs nas khyed gsungs sgrub par shog / gsung mgur re re'i mjug gi smon tshig ltan/ /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis dge legs 'phel/ / kun kyang chos bzhin spyod pas nyin mtshan 'da'/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pan shog /bdag gis 'di 'dra'i smon tshig phul ba'i mthus/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i sku tshe mdzad 'jin rgyus1 1mgon de'i gsung 'bum brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams/ / phyogs gcig bsdus nas 'gro don byed pad shog / ces phul bas thugs dgyes/ zla ba bzhi ba'i nang chos da'i bzhugs khri'i g.yon phyogs nas bsdad/bka' chos nyan zhor la mtsho snying nas gsungs pa'i mgur 'bum gyi rtsom gzhi gzhan la 'khyar song〉 bas/16 mgo mjug mi tshang zhing shog bu kha shas mi tshang ba mnyam bzhag nas bris/ shog

rang rnam rin chen phreng ba bzhugs so/ /bu than rkyang gi nyin srib gnyis la bris yod pa gzhan zhig gis spyan song ba chu la sbang / kha bkan nas bris pa'i chad song ba ma shes par mdun du zhus tshe/ 'o khong la khom pa mi 'dugabla mar gsol ba thob dang shes 'ong gsungs/ saṃ ṭa da phab nas yang zhus pa sogs dka' las byas bris/ rjes nas sku mtshams khong nas chad pa rnams bsabs te gnang / rjes nas phyogs phyogs la rtsad bcad pas thams cad 'dzoms/ khong gis bsabs pa rnams khrid par gyur pas dad pa lhag pan skyes/ bris tshan ba dang yang sngar bris tshad po gzab tu bris gsungs pa ltan mgur 'bum thams cad gzab tu bris/lcags stag so gsum steng bka' las khyod kyis brtson pa chen bskyed la lha khang zhig gi nang du o rgyun rin po che sku mi tshad cig bzhengs dgos zhes skyabs 'jug gnang che gzhi sngon nas khyim tshang drug gis sa las byas/ dar grong nas shing cha blangs/ ston kha tshun la lha khang dang sku skya bzo grub che khong rin po che phebs nas rab gnas gnang /lhags yos so bzhi'i steng gsen tshon shing ris bcas grub nas khong din po che phebs nas zhag gsum bzhugs rab gnas gnang / byang phyogs su mchod rten zung du zhig bzhengs par nab gnas gnang / ri rtse'i mtshams khang du phebs nas rab gnas dang mgur dbyangs gnang / bkra shis chos gling zhes mtshan btags/ mdor na bkra shis 'khyel ba nas lo rer zla re la bka' chos ma chag par nyan/ nang gi dbang khong la phul nas gnang ba ma gnang ban ༵ dhi ste/ ma yong / yul du yong yang mgron po ltan bsdad pa las khyim tshang gi gnyer kha chen po chu 'brug so lnga'i steng sbu mtshams dam por bzhugs dus/ khri rtsa nas mal sa bzos khong dang lhan du mtshams la bsdad/ gsung 'bum rnams la zhu dag gnang zhor la lung thob/nangs dgong la chos dang mthun pa'i bslab byu gnang / nang gis kung skal ba bzang snyam nyams len ci thub byas/ sems kha cung zad yangs su song ba ni khong gi sku drin yin/ nyin gcig bka' las/ 'o da khyod kyis sbos tshad po bres kha spyob gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs rnams khun la shog gsungs/ khong bde ba can gyi mdun ngos su bzhugs par khur nas song tshe thugs brtse bas bzhad bzhin/ tshos dpon la 'bul ba 'khyogs dgos gsungs/'bul ba la/ tshe ring bkra shis gsungs nas 'bul dngos de yin/ khyod kyi sngon 'gro'i go chod gsungs mgo la phyag bzhag nas khyod la lag tshegs ma byen pa de khyod kyi 'phyor ba dang nyams rtogs la gnod pas/ deng phyin chad nor gyis mi phongs shing 1maX sgyu 7 skye ba'i

sa /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skyabs 'jug byed gsungs/ mgur 'bum gshad gyis bris tshad dang rtsom gzhi po ti 'ga' gnang nas 'di dad rten gyis dang bkra shis po yong gsungs/ 'gro don la phebs skabs rnams su dkon la 'jigs nas sku rjes su ma song yang zhar shon la gsol ras zos pa la 'gyod/chu sbrul so drug steng khyung dgon la song / ma ṇi'i steng nas tsha ba thu mo byung / yul du yong dus na ba'i tshe/ skyabs mgon thugs rje can gyis sman dang skyabs 'jug gnang / tsha ba'i 'khrul snang la sngags mang gi las sne ba rnams nas nad g.yog dang / khyod la gnod pa'i gdon ni sngags mang gi chang 'dre red/ khyod kyis gu du drag po'i sgo nas 'brub khung bskyed la 'gug gzhug gyis dang khrid yong zer bar de ltar byas tsho/ dam sri 'ug pa'i mgo can zhig khrid 'ongs nas 'thub khung du bcug thun gyis brab che skad ngan bton/ sngags pa zhal 'bag can gnyis kyis 'cham stabs byus te bsgral nas zhal bstab byed pa sogs dngos su shar/ de dus ma shi ba khong gi sku drin yin/shing rta so bdun steng chu stod zla ba'i bco lnga'i nyin skyabs mgon rin po che ri rtsen phebs nas tshe ring ma'i lha tho brtsigs nab gnas byas/ nyen gcig khyed tsho'i bla ma spyang lung rin po che'i rnam thar zhig phyi nabs rnams kyi don du dgos pas/ zin bris shig phobs la khyer shog gsungs pas/ ma ṇi'i steng nas bde kha'i sman pa sogs gong ma'i dngos slob rnams bsdur nas zin bris phab/ nyung song bsam che sgrub chen kyi thor thun skabs nyams this 'dres mad 'du khang gi nang thams cad brda yig gis gang zhing / thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'dus nas yi ge dbu can gyis 'dod chung chog shes nor sgyu mtshog ces shar ba der 'khod rnams la bshad tshe rnam than bsdu ba'i brda red zer/ zin bris skyabs mgon rin po che'i sku mtshams nang du phul tshe/ 'o de khyod kyis khyer la mtshams nang nas rig pa bsgrims la rnam than zhig rtsoms la bzhi ba'i bcu gcig gi nyin mar khyer shog gsungs pa ltar mtshams la bsdad nas brtsams te ba'i ba'i bcu gcig gi nyin sbu mdun du phul tshe/ rnam thar 'grig na bdag rkyen dang ma 'grig na gsen srang gang gi chad pa yod gsungs gzigs nas gsol zho dkar yol gang gi khar bsod dar zhig bzhag nas gnang / yag po 'dug gsungs mjug rtsom gsungs nas gnang / 'di ni byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' yin gsungs/ skyes 'phreng gsol 'debs shig kung gsungs/ de dus rmi lam la dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med rin po che dang mjal ba'i zhal nas/ 'o nga la rnam thar rgyas pad po ti gnyis yod kyang khyod kyi de ba ga18 ༷༷ rnam thar brtsams pa la dga'/ phyin chad sngags mang gi 'grigs khrims

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /sna~Xl/ nas shig /rdo sngi dī rmis /brgyad kyi nang nas rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub ster gsungs shing lug so brgyad steng skyabs mgon rin po che phebs nas mchod rten chung ba la ar chog gnang / mchod rten che ba'i sa 'dul gnang /me sprel so dgu'i steng skyabs mgon rin po che phebs nas mchod rten la rab gnas gnang / sku 'dra dang mchod rten gnyis la sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel gyis thog drangs rten sna khyad 'phags gnang / smras pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms shing / /smin grol gdams pas 'gro khams rgya mtsho rnams/ / brtse bas skyong mdzad kā thog grub chen gyis/ /zhal mjal dbang lung gnang ba'i skal bzang thob/ /ces kā thog bla ma ngag dbang smin grol rgya mtsho phebs nas klong gsal zhi khro'i dbang lung sogs thob/me bya bzhi bcu tham pa'i steng rang khyim nas smad pa'i sngags mang gis thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi sgrub chen gsar du btsugs/ sgrub chen gyi cha rkyen thams cad rang 'grigs la song / ril bu 'gyed dus sa la mang po 'thor bas rten 'brel 'grigs/ sde ba so sor gtad pas rgyun tshugs pa byung /sa khyi zhe gcig steng gling rgya'i zhong za tshang nas btsugs/ mthun rkyen rang 'grigs su byung / khyung dgon sprul sku rin po che gdan drangs/ smras pa/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul khyab brdal chos kyi dbyengs/ / klong las nam yang g.yo med sprul ba'i sbu/ / mkha' ltar yangs pa'i rdzogs chen don rtogs pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma de la snying nas dad/ /ces sprul sku rin po ches thugs rje chen po 'khod ba dbyings sgrol gyi dbang lung gnang / lo re ba'i na ma ṇi'i 'jig hūṃ~Xbye —sam) nas skyabs rje'i gsung 'bum sogs rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad byas/—sa jog gi lam phag bko hūṃ sdams gnyis/ steng ya ru nas ma ṇi'i sgrub chen steng nas mchod rdzas bsgrigs/ spyi 'a ga lca bkogs bye rno gsum/ steng byang chub sde ba la thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyengs sgrol gyi sgrub chen gsar du btsugs pa'i tshogs mgor song chos bshad byus/ lo re bzhin yong rgyu byas/tshogs nas bton pa dang khas blangs byas pad ma ṇi dung phyur lnga song / 'jam gyi ma ṇi'i sgrub chen la song sngar bzhin chos bshad/ lcags glang zhe bzhi'i steng dar grong gi lha khang dang rten bzhengs shes di mi byas/

sa / 1lhang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi ma ṇi btsugs/ sngags mang dang byang chub/ dar grong gi ma ṇi'i steng tshogs brgya dang sbyin sreg gi dpe btsugs/ de la brten nas phyogs phyogs kyis ma ṇi btsugs/ lo de dang lo 'gan skyabs mgon rin po che'i bka' bzhin/ gling rgyu/ 'jam/lha khang / du rtsa/ dkar rtse gdong / nag rgya/ seng ge gshong / dar grong / sa dkar shar/ lug ra sogs kyi rten bzhengs thams cad la srog shing dang gzungs gzhug phul/nyang gi ma ṇi'i shog gu khri bam can/ rang gi stong bam bzhi'i ma ṇi/ sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum dang zhing mdo dngul gyis bris/ nang gis 'bum khang bco lnga/ gzhan rnams bskul nas 'bum khang brgya lhag bsgrubs/ lha khang ma ṇi'i steng nas spyi 'jog dong tse khron brgya btsal nas bzhag 'grigs khrims bldams/chu stag zhe lnga'i steng bla ma padma dang grol rin po che mang ra nas zhi bar gshegs pa thos pas snying thon 'gro ba lta bu'i mya ngan dang gdung dbyangs 'di ltar/ mgon rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i gzugs/ / mtshan brjod pan dka' ba'i drin po che/ / pha bla ma padma rang grol rje/ / bus gdung dbyungs thal lo thugs rje can/ / sku rab mdzes mthong na mi mthun med/ / gang mthong tshad dad gus thal mo sbyor/ / sku mtshan dpes spras pa gang nas mthong / / 'di bsam zhing mig nas mchi ma g.yo/ / gsung yan lag drug cu'i tshangs dbyangs kyis/ / chos zab dgu'i chos kyi char 'beb pa'i/ / gsung da nas rna bas ga la thos/ /'di bsam zhing smre sngags dbyungs su gyer/ /thugs rgyal sras phyag na padma ltan/ /ma 'gro ba kun la lhag pan brtse/ / thugs sangs rgyas las lhag 'dir dran na/ / bu nyam chung shugs ring rgyun du 'don/ / mgon dam pa'i gsang gsum rnam thar la/ / deng bsam na dad gus skyo shas skye/ / bu ska' chad las nyon nad kyis zin/ / dgra le lo'i mal du sgyun che bas/ /pha bla ma'i gser zhal ma mjal skyo/ /'di bsam zhing snying rlung gting nas ldang / /rang rkang thang song yang slebs pa'i tshe/ / phyis mjal snyam bsam pa'i blo ring bo/ / da rta mchog brgya phrag zhon na yang / / pha bla ma'i gser zhal gang nas stogs/ / don dbyings su 'du 'bral med mod kung / / da dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba zhig / nor phung bo yod kung gang nas 'thob/ / 'di bsam zheng bsam 'ing skyo ba skye/ / dbugs stod du 'tshangs nas skad ma thon/ /mig mchi mas gang nas lam mi mthong / /gling mi re'i mgo nas nyi re nub/ /'di gzigs sam skyabs mgon snying rje'i gter/ / mgon rgyal ba'i bstan srung ma gza' rdor—/ /pha2 ༵sta1 'dzin skyes bu mi srung na/ /bdag sgrub pas mchod pa don re chung / /don

rang rnam rin chen greng ba bzhugs so/ /de phyir thugs rje'i mthu dpung bskyed/ / rje da lta chu lha'i pang mnal yang / / bdag bu slob shar ri'i phrag pa nas/ / sku gnyis pa'i nam mkha'i nor bu mchog/ 'od gsal ler myur du 'byon par mdzod/ / mgon gnyis pa'i zhal dkyil nyi ma yis/ / bdag blo gros pad tshal bskyangs pa'i mthus/ / don sbrang rtsis gdul bya bung ba'i tshogs/ / dus ring du skyong ba'i bka' drin stsol/ / ces blangs/ khyung dgon sngags mang dang lhan du gdung mchod btang /rang khyem nas kyang gdung mchod btang / skyabs mgon rin po che mang ra na bzhugs dus sngags pa 'ga' dang lhan du mjal du song / tho no ci'i mtshams khang na bla ma padma dang grol rin po che'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i mdun nas tshogs 'khor phul/ mang po ngus/ skyabs rje'i bka' chos la nyan/ bla sngags 'ga' la thod rgal gyi 'dug stangs bslabs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rig 'dzin lha khang nang du/ sngags mang bskul nas sbu 'dra dang sku gdung mchod rten bzhengs/ du rtsa'i ma ṇi dang byang chub ma ḍi la song chos bshad byas/chu yos zhe drug steng mtshams khang bkra shis chos gling nas mtshams la bsdad/ spro ba'i shugs kyis gnas bstod 'di ltan/ na mo gu nu/ skyabs kyi dam pa rdo rje 'chang / / skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu la/ / bdag yid dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ / bdag sogs thugs rje'i brtse bas skyongs/ / rang gnas bkra shis chos gling 'dir/ / rang gis bstod bsngags me tog 'thor/ /dam pa du mas zhabs kyis bcags/ /dam pa'i lha chos sgrub pa'i gnas/ /nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i rtse/ /nyams rtogs can gyi bzhugs pa'i yul/ /gnas 'di'i yon tan brjod pa'i che/ / gnas bdag dkar phyogs lha rnams dgyes/ / ri dbyebs rgyal bo gdan bzhugs 'dra/ / ri rnams blon pos bskor bzhin mdzes/ / mdun ri skyes lha lcang shan de/ / mdun du sgo srung tshul du bzhugs/ / g.yas ri yu zur phyug mo des/ /g.yas nas rnal 'byon bsrung ba'i tshul/ /g.yon ri stag rdzong lha rgod des/ /g.yon nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i tshul/ / rgyab ri zur gsum bdag mo dang / / rgyab nas klu mos mchod pa 'bul/ /'dabs na grong sde chung ngu chags/ /'dabs nas rnal 'byod mthun rkyen sgrub/ /rab mdzes mdun gyi ri ngogs su/ /rab legs lo tog g.yur du za/ /ri rtse mthong rgya che ba'i stabs/ /ri khrod 'dzin rnams snang ba spro/ /dbyar ston shing tog sngo ngad sogs/ /dbyar zas gang mkho 'byor ba sla/ / ri klung nor phyugs mang po bkra/ / ri rtser na chung glu dbyangs len/ / sdig pa'i phyogs dang rgyang bsrings nas/ / sdig pa'i dri mas gos mi 'gyud1 /dge sbyod ma gtogs gzhan med pas/ / dge ba gong 'phel ba du 2ga/ /

mas /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mthun rkyen kun tshang dben gnas 'di/ /mthun pa chos mdzad yongs la mthun/ /dus bzhi rim gyis 'gyur tsa na/ /dus kun nges 'byung skyo shas skye/ /rang sems ngo bo skyong dus su/ /rang gsal rjen pa myur du mthong / /yul las 'das pa'i dben pa 'din/ /yul gyi 'khon 'dzin skyon mi gos/ /gnas 'did sdod pa'i gang zag la/ /gnas bdag sdong grogs rgyun du byed/ /bkra shis rtags kyis kun nas spras/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i brda/ /de 'dra'i phun tshogs g.yang chags pa/ / de 'dra'i sdod pa skal ba bzang / / phyi rabs rnams dang dad can tsho/ / phyi ma'i sa lam 'di nas sgrubs/ / mtshams sgrub khas blangs byus pa rnams/ / mtshams la 'dug na 'di nas sdod/ / rdzogs chen sbyor dngos rjes gsum rnams/ /rdzogs par 'dod rnams 'di nas sdod/ / yul gyi bza' bar mi 'cham rnams/ /yul ngan spongs la gnas 'dir sdod/ / yon tan ci yang mi shes rnams/ / yon tan slob phyir gnas 'dir sdod/ /'dug dus gzhan phan sems bskyed dang / /'dug nag bar du dge sbyon rems/ / dge spyor chen po mi thub kung / / dge ba ma gtogs sdig ma bsog /gnas 'din sdod dus chos srung dang / /gnas bdag rnams la lha bsang thongs/ /gnas 'dir bstod pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /gnas 'din bkra shis lo legs shing / /chos mdzad skye bo mang 'dus nas1 /tshos bzhin spyod pas 'da' bar shog /bkra shis dpal 'byor gong 'phel zhing / / bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog / ces blangs/ skyabs rje'i phyag dpe mang po bris/ slob ma 'ga' la rdzogs chen gyi khrid btab/ dge sbyor gnad smin byas/ de nas nag rgya dang byung chub kyi ma ṇi la song nas sngan rgyun byas/shing 'brug zhe bdun steng lha ri'i pad dkad chos gling nas mtshams la bsdad/ rmi lam la a mye lha ri bla ma'i tshul gyis sman khug cig byen nas/ 'di thams cad la byen dang phan thogs gsungs/ gling rgya'i sngags pa 'ga' la rdzogs chen gyi khrid btab/ lha ri'i dmag dpon gsar bzhengs dus/ rmi lam du ma mye lha ri bla ma'i rnam pas kho'i sku rten gyi gzungs gzhug cig phris dang khyod la dngos grub 'di 'dra ster zhes shog gu ring mo'i ngos la gsed dngul rta nor sogs bris pa bstan pa rmis pa ltar bris nas phul/ gling rgya za lar la thug dus sku rim bsgrubs rjes/ rmi lam la khang ba bkod mdzes shig gi nang khri steng du bla ma zhig bzhugs pa'i khri'i rtsar 'bol gdan sum brtsegs rgyab yol can yod par/ nga bos nas song tshe/ bla ma de bzhengs nas bsus/ mdun gyi khri steng du bsdad che/ bla ma na re nga a mye lha ri yin skyi 2 ba nangs snga nyi nag la dgra chos shig nyi ma lnga la thon dang / dgra cham la

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /'bebs nges zhes pa rmis/ phyi nyin nyi nag la dgra chos nyi ma lnga la bton tshe za lar cham la phab tshe 'phral du dga' yang / rjes nas bsam tshe 'gyod nas bshags pa byas/ lha ri'i lab tse gnyis rmog pa'i lab tse gnyis srid rgan skya 'bur mda' rdzong rnams kyi lab tse gzhi brtsigs byas/ gling rgya'i sde bar rim gro gang bcos lam du song ba ni kho nang tsho'i dad pa'i stobs yin nam snyam/ rang yul dang dad grong gi yul lha yu zur nag phyogs pa yin stabs mi rnams kyang sdig la dga' zhing jag rkus sogs ma nabs kyi byu ba lam du rgyug phyin/ dman mchod mang po brgyab/ spyod sna kha mchu je mang du song / thams cad kyi kha thur du song tshe/yid skyo nas skyabs mgon rin po chen skyo mgur 'di phul/ bod gangs can gyi lha gcig spyan nas gzigs/ /ma 'gro ba yi 'dren mchog zhabs dkad pa/ /bdag spyi gtsug gi bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ / byams snying rje gnyis 'byongs par byen gyis rlobs/ /deng rtsod ldan gyi snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir/ /lha dkan phyogs rnams mthu stobs chung du song / / bdud nag phyogs kyi mgo 'phang dgung la reg / yul gzhi bdag rnams rim gyis sdig la rngam/ /sa dar grong na 'jig rten lha la skyabs/ /chung nyes med kyi re'u chung gson bsregs byas/ /ma nyam thag gi rkang phran dmyal thag gcod/ /bdud nag phyogs pas brlams pa'i lha ba la/ /blo ling gis gtad gang bshad bden par 'dzin/ / dus bco lnga sogs srog chags bsad tshad la/ / khos sdong grogs byed zer ltar sdig spyod byas/ / 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa'i rtags/ / des mthus bskyed dmag 'khrug nad lhag mang / / sa'i bcud nyams shing nyam thag dbul bo mang / /dus gnas skabs kyi bya bar sems pa skyo/ /mig mchi ma yis gang zhing 'o dod bos/ / rje drin can gyi bla ma rin po che/ /thugs brtse ba yis bdag sogs ma 'dor bar/ / lha 'di nyid la snying rje'i chu rgyun stsol/ / mi 'di rnams kyi blo kha chos la sgyun/ /dmag 'khrug pa dang 'thab rtsod rab zhi nas/ /chos bkra shis dang dge legs 'phel bad shog /ces phul ba'i rjes su skyabs mgon rin po che dad grong la phebs nas yul lha dam la bzhag lha khang dang mchod rten bzhengs/ sdong nger spyod la thug yod skabs bod lo'i nyi shu la tsho ba gsum gyis ra gsum nyos nas rgya lo'i tshes mgod dmar mchod brgyab nas tho das(rangs)sdong nge'i mi gsod du 'gro bar chas che/ nga glo bud mtshams nang nas song skyabs mgon phyag yig lta bu dang rten 'dus dang phyag dpe bzung nas nyid kyi gsung yin khul byas nas 'gro ba bshol/ ra gsum ma gsod byas kyang khar ma nyan/ tshur lam gnas ri mthong ba nas yul lha la gnyer gtad byas tsho tshes mgor lha bas da gsum tshe thar byuX / ༵ gags shi

sa /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na tshab dgos tshul dang thams cad la dmar mchod ma rgyag tshe thar thongs zhes bshad/ de nas bzung dman mchod bcad/ thams cad kyis ma ṇi smyung gnas sogs chos phyogs la blo bsgyur ba sogs/ bla ma skyabs mgon rin po che'i bka' drin yin/ smad pa gling rgya gnyis yon bdag gi mthil du song / 'jam gyi sngags pa 'ga' la seng gdong gi dbang / tsho 'du'i sngags pa rnams la mgon po tshogs bdag gi dbang / spyang lung sngags pa rnams la tshogs bdag dang ki ka gi lung / hor tshang gi sngags pa rnams la seng gdong gi dbang lung /dkan rtse gdong sngags pa rnams la phur pa dang lo ka'i dbang 1 dregs pa sde gsum gyi sgrub pa dang dmag dpon gyi bsang brtsams/ byang chub sman pa dang nu bo dge slong gnyis la dur khrod bdag mo'i srog gtad dang sgrub pa brtsams/ lha khang dbu mdzad pha bu gnyis la phun ༵rdo spyi ༵bye ༵ ga 'a ༵ bton/ rnams mngon chung byas byen/ skyabs mgon gsung 'bum phal shing sbul zhe brgyad steng dge 'phel gyi nor jag pas ded pa'i rjes su a mtshog la song dus sngags pa 'ga' la lung kha shas byin/ skyabs mgon sku mtshams la bzhugs dus reb kong nang stod blod du bsod stoms la song nas lo gsum tsam la gro nas do bo brgya lhag re rnyed pa phul bas thugs dgyes/ bka' bzhin mtshams la bsdad dus byang sgra mi snyan gyi che gzungs 'bum gter zhabs brtan du bsgrubs nas sku mdun du 'di phul/ lhag bsam tshogs gnyis rtsa ba rab brtan zhing / / phyin drug bsdu dngos bang rim mngon par mdzes/ /rang gzhan grol byed nyams rtogs kyis mtho ba'i/ / skyabs mgon ri dbang lhan po'i zhabs drung du/ / slob bu'i tha shal nyang skyes mtshams ming nas/ / shugs drag dad pas sor bcu snying gar zum/ / gus pas lha phyag grangs med 'tshal bzhin du/ / gsol ba 'debs pa'i don gyi snying bo ni/ /pha khyed sku tsho bskal brgyar brtan pa yi/ /ched du dmigs nas 'chi med rang gzungs kyi/ / sngags ring 'bum gter mchod pa'i tshul du dmigs/ / bsgrubs nas phul mthus drin can bla ma khyod/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa dang / /dgra bcom blo gros lo stong bzhugs pa ltar/ / sku che bskal ba brgya phrag du ma'i bar/ / bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ / mi 'gyun rdo rje lta bur bzhugs su gsol/ / mi shigs g.yung drung lta bur bzhugs su gsol/ / mi nub lhal mtshan lta bur bzhugs su gsol/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje khri la bzhugs su gsol/ /mgon po tshe dpag med kyi thugs rje dang— / /༵ ka rgyud pa'i bla ma'i byin rlabs stobs/ /gzungs sngags zab mo bgrangs pa'i

rang rdam rin chen zang ba bzhugs so/ /bden mthu yis/ /dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /bla mar zhabs brtan phul ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ / drin can bla ma'i sbu tshe rab brtan zhing / / rang gzhan 'chi bdag dgra las rnam par rgyal/ /'chi med rig 'dzin myur du thob par shog /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad myug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ / char chu dus babs lo 'bras phun sum tshogs/ /kun kyang tshos bzhen spyod pas nyin mtshan 'da'/ / rdzogs ldan nyin mo'i dpal la spyod par shog / ces dang rnam thar gsol 'debs gnyis phul tshe thugs dbyes nas lha rdzas che legs shig dang rten gsum le tshan bcas bstsal/ nyin gcig bka' las khyod kyi gter gsan rta phag gi skon 'bri dgos gsungs/ 'don cha'i skor dang bsnyen yig sogs bris/ dbang chog rnams ma bris par bka' bkyon gnang nas dbang chog rnams kris dang khyod kyis gzhan la dbang lung ster dgos gsungs dbang lung spel ba'i bka' gnang / nyid dbus gtsang du phebs rgyu'i thugs bkod ltar/ gsung 'bum kha tshang re phyogs mang po na yod na bzang khyod kyi lag na yod pa'i gsung 'bum kha tshang bo gyis gsungs/ sbu phyogs gser khang rin po che dang nong bo sngags mang sogs kyis bshol nas bzhugs pa'i zhal lan gnang / mgon shul na bzhugs skabs gdan 'dren la song sku mdun nas zhag mang po bsdad/ de phyogs kyi bla sngags rnams la lung kha shas phul nas lug 'ga' phul ba ma ṇi'i thebs su phul/ 'brong lung bye bsa~X ste/sa yang song nas mgon shul dpa' los lug lnga bcu phul ba sngags mang ma ṇi'i sdu ) zhe dgu'i steng lo gcig sku mdun nas 'dug rgyu byas/ bka' ltar bde ba can gyi gzim khang gi sa las smad pa'i sngags mang gi kha 'go byus lcags ri dang bcas pa ston kha tshun la shing ris dang bcas grub/ ston kha nas bsod stoms la song dang lo mtshams kyi go chod gsungs1 bsod snyoms tshar nas dgu ba'i nyi shu tham pa'i nyin sku mdun du song tshe/ khyod gzim khang gsar ba'i nang nas nyer lnga tshun la rten 'brel gyis sdod nyi shu lnga la tshogs 'di nas gsungs/ tshogs rdzas khyod gtso byas kun gyis dga' ston gyis/ de'i ban lha dang chos srung rnams la lha bsang thongs la spyan 'dren gyis gsungs pa ltar bsdad nas nyed lnga'i nyin sku mdun du song tshe mtshams pa thon song zhes bzhad/ de'i phyi dro sku phyogs nam mkha' tshang phebs nas nga bsdad sar bzhugs/ bcu ba'i tshes gcig gi snga dro nged rnams kyis mchod rdzas sogs thogs nas bsu ba byus/ rin po ches na bza' gsar ba bzhes nas dgyes nyams kyis gzim khang gsar ba'i nang du phebs/ tshogs 'khor dang ba ka 5bkra shis

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnang nas sbu mtshams dam por bzhugs/ phyi nyin sgo drung nas phyag 'tshal nas yul la yong khar nyid nas/ lo kho da nga spro mo red/ khyod tshe ring bkra shis gsungs/ khyung dgon ma chos ༵ shad/ par lo re gnyis tsam ma gtogs song / shog ka'i ma rten sngan rgyun ltar song nas me lug lnga bcu tham pa'i steng bdag la gsung 'bum 'don cha'i skon dang / yig skud skon la mchod brjod dang phyogs gcig tu bsdus/ bla ma padma nang grol rin po che'i gsung 'bum la mchod brjod dang phyogs gcig tu bsdus la mjug rtsom spyob gsungs pa rnams bsgrubs/ gzhan nad pa nyam chung rnams la sku rim sgrubs gsungs/sa sprel nga gcig steng 'brong lung na bzhugs dus sku mdun du song ban khyod kyi sngar gyi lha khang de ri rtse bkra shis chos gling du spor dgos/ nang du o rgyan rin po che/ g.yas su thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso dang / g.yon du nga'i sku 'dra bzhengs pa'i nang du nged kyi rtsom gzhi rnams zhog dang / phyin chad bla ma zhabs dkar pa'i bka'i bsdu ba po nyang gi mtshams pa zer ba'i rtsom gzhi rnams yod ces mjal mkhan yong gsungs pa ltar khyim tshang bzhis shing ris bcas legs par bsgrubs/ ko'u sde spyang lung gnyis kyi gyod chen lo 'gar ma 'grigs ༵bye ༈sde du' sbyo gas tsha/ba tu song dang 'grigs yong gsungs pa ltar song nas zhal gsung bsgyur ༄sa bya nga gnyis steng 'brog phyogs la phebs tshe zhabs phyin 'gro gsungs nas song skabs bdag gcig pu khrid nas spang gzhong rnams su bzhugs nas gang spro spro gnang / mad bsod brgyab nas sngags mang gi ma ṇi'i thebs su phul/lcags khyi nga gsum steng shog gu lnga brgya tsam sbyor dang 'bri rgyu mang po yod gsungs pa ltar bsgrubs tshe/ 'o da dung dpe cha 'bri ba las kha brda byus pa dga'/ mi'i skye 'chi la khrig khrig med/ khyod dang nged gnyis kyi su yin yang 'chi nyen gda'/ ma shi gong 'dir zhu rgyu yod na zhus/ bskrub rgyu yod na bsgrubs sogs dogs gzhi can 'ga' gsungs/ nga'i rmi lam du chos ra'i khri zhig song ba rmis pas/ zhabs brtan re zhus par bka' ma khrol/ bcu ba'i nyi shu'i nang sbu sbung lta bu bzhes tshe/ khyung dgon sprul sku rin po che dang nged sngags pa sum cu gan nga/sa bka' brgyad nyi ma nyer gcig la bsgrubs/ tshe sgrub sogs phul bas sku dwangs tshul —lca~X phab/ nga bzhi'i steng bka' chos skabs/ khyung dgon sprul sku tshang dang nged gnyis

rang nom rin chen phreng ba ba bzhugs so/ 1la bslab bya dang / khyad par sngags mang la bka' bkyon dang 'brel ba'i bsgab ston dang khyad par bab sa la ma 'gro chos thog skud pa 'dra ba chad du ma 'jug dang bstan pa zer ba de yin gsungs/ nga la khyod kyis sngar bshad pa'i glegs bam rnams la mjug rtsom lhob/ bsdu dgos pa rnams sdus/ nga la 'bri khom chen po med sogs zhal gsungs dogs gzhi can mang du gsungs tshe/ lags rnam jir rjes ma'i mjug dang zhal gsung rnams kyang legs po mi 'dug pas nyid rin po che bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bad du brtan pad bzhugs dgos zhes ngu ngag gis zhus tshe/ 'o lo kho/ de la rnam rtog mi dgos ngas rgyun du mi rtag pa gsungs pa yin gsungs/ tsha bo padma bstan 'dzin yong tshe/ 'o da reb nged dpon slob gsum gyis lhan du ja zhig 'thung zhes gsol ja bzhes zhor la da mtshams pa la kha brda byas tshar/ da khyod kyis ya khu la do dam rems sogs 'jig rten gyi bslab bya rgyas pa dang / khyod kyis nga'i gsung 'bum dang rta phag gi skon gyi glegs bam la mchod pa phul dang khyod la khyim tshang bzang po zhig nyan yong zhes zhal chems gnang / lags/ rtsom gzhi 'bebs rgyu yod na ngas da nas bris na zhus tshe rjes nas sten gsungs/ de nas 'gro don la phebs nas gling rgya na bzhugs tshe/rtsom gzhi nyung ngu zhig gnang ba'i nang na sprul sku myur 'byon zhig yod pa mthong nas/ ngu ngag gis yang sngar ltad zhus tshe/ 'o de la skyon med/ da lo khyod la 'bri khom yod med ci shes/nged gnyis ma shi na dbu sngas na rtsom gzhi po ti gnyis yod/ de'i nang na 'jog rgyu med/ da khyod slob ma la dag las yod pas rtsom gyi mjug bsdu dgos pa rnams sdus/ gzhan slob ma tshos bla ma'i rjes nas ci byas 'dug de ka gyis dang sngon 'gro mi dgos nyams len gyis/nyams len gyi gtso bo nga'i gsung 'bum 'chad spel gyis/ da khyod song la mgar rtse'i jo khang gi gzungs 'jug 'bul du song / da dung nged pha bu gnyis thug yong sogs gsung gi tha mar gnang / rjes su ya bo skyabs nas zhi bar gshegs tshe sbu gdung bkra shis 'khyil bad thon pa dang snying thon 'gro ba lta bu'i mya ngan gyis gdungs bzhin gdung dbyangs 'di thal lo/ / lha snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /mgon bshes gnyen dam pa'i rnam nol ba/ / pha skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang / / bus gdung dbyangs thal lo thugs rje can/ /spyin rgyal khams yongs la nyi ma nub/ / sgos skal chad nga dang nga 'dra ba'i/ / mig don snying dang bral dgos 'dod kyi/ / yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag nas shor/ / bdag 'gro rnams mgon med skyabs med gyun/ /pha snying rje'i gter chen gang nas mjal/ /da ci byed skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang / /bu'i gdungs pa sol cig bka' drin can/ /lhag dkam sbyo7 rtsa 1 rab

sa nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tu brtan/ /snying rje yi kho lag phyogs brgyad g.yo/ /gzhan phan gyi 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ /pha dpag bsam ljon shing glo bur 'gyel/ / dad gsum gyi rta bdun shugs kyis drangs/ /byams brtse yi 'od stong 'bum du 'gyed/ / skal ldan gyi gdul byu'i padmo spyong / / pha 'dzam gling nyi ma nub rir bzhud/ / zab rgyas kyi chos chad 'gro la 'beb/ / nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba rgyun du skyong / / phyogs med kyi gdul ga bu bzhin skyong / / pha mtshan ldan bla ma glo bur gshegs/ /gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rtse mo na/ /kha lho lta'i gzim chung nyams dga' na/ /rje bla ma bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ / ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ / sa bkra shis g.yang 'khyil chos ra na/ / phyogs ris med dad 'dus stong phrag la/ / chos dbang lung gnang tshul yid la shan/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /rang skal dman mdun du mjal dus su/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos legs gzigs nas/ /zhal 'dzum gyis gsung tshul yid la shar/ / ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ / gsung bslab byas dbugs dbyung gsol nas gnang / /chos zab rgyas bcud kyis smin mdzad de/ /rang 'dod pa skong tshul yid la shar/ / ngas bsam 'ing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ / sa mdo smad phyogs kyi dad 'dus rnams/ /blo chos la bsgyur nas rten bzhengs sogs/ /chos dge la bskul tshul yid la shan/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /phyogs phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i grwa btsun dang / / dman ngan slong lho gos tshos gsum gyis/ / dus rgyun du skyong tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ / nor dngos po phul tshad mi 'dzin pad/ / yar dkon mchog mchod dang rten bzhengs dang / / mar dbul bod sbyin tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ / gnas sgrub gnas ri khrod nyams dga' rnams/ /khong slob ma bu chen mang pos bkang / / kun chos kyis bskyangs tshul yid la shar/ / ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ / grong ri dgon thams cad rten bzhengs dang / / chos sgyung gnas ma ṇi'i rgyun bzang btsugs/ /phyag mchod par bskul tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sa reb kong 'khrug pa yod tshad rnams/ /gsung bka' shog tsam res mthun pan bsdums/ /kun bde bad bkod tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /yul kun tu lo legs 'ongs pa'i phyir/ /char 'bebs sogs 'gro ba'i bde thabs gnang / / yul bde zhing spyid tshul yid la shar/ / ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ / sa stod smad 'brel thogs pho mo yis/ / gsung bsgrubs nas dge ba ga snro~X gis/ /sa dkar por btang tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam 'ing mtshan ldan

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma dran/ / sbu'i bkod pa bsdus tshe nam mkha' dwangs/ / 'ja' kha dog sna lnga rgyun du shan/ /kun snang ba bsgyur tshul yid la shar/ / ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /gdung ring bsrel lha sku yig 'bru sogs/ /ngo mtshar ba'i dngos grub bgo skal spres/ /drin legs par bskyangs tshul yid la shar/ / ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ / phyogs gang du song yang bla ma dran/ /sa gang du bsdad kyang bla ma dran/ /brda ci ltar shad kyang bla ma dran/ / dus nyin mtshan kun tu bla ma dran/ / dran drags tshe sems kyis mi nus gi /dbugs stod du 'tshang nas mi non gi /mig mchi mas gang nas mi gzung gi /'di gzigs sam skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang / / bus dran pa'i sems la bzod glags med/ / phas mi mngon dbyengs nas gsan lags sam/ / dus da lta nyams dang rmi lam du/ / sku'i dkyil 'khor myud du bstan du gsol/ / gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis bslab bya ston/ / thugs dgongs pas bdag la byen gyis rlobs/ /bu skal chad bdag la sems gso gnong /
