/khyed gar bzhugs zhing khams de ru drongs/ /bus de ltar gdung dbyungs blangs pa'i mthus/ /pha bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shing / / dus ring min sprul sku'i nyi gzhon gyis/ /bstan 'gro ba'i pad tshal legs skyongs shog / ces blangs/ gdung mchod kyi kha 'go byas/sku gdung mchod rten gyi gzungs gzhug phul nas rab gnas byas/ ring bsrel lnga sgrom zhig dbu thod tshal bu la babs pa thems pa mchod rten khru tshad cig bzhengs pa'i nang du phul/ thi lam la nyid dang mjal tshe/ g.yas phyogs na 'ja' tshon pa ṭa dpag bsam gyi shing gi dbyibs nub tu 'then/ g.yon na 'ja' drang bo shar du 'then pa bstan nas/ 'o lo kho/g.yas phyogs kyi 'ja' nub tu 'then pa 'a mnyam zhog gsungs/ spyan lta stangs tses bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal mgo sku pang du bzhag nas gsol ba btab pa rngis/ yang sku gdung rin po che bsnyel thabs su bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i thad nas na bza' shog thum chung ngu zhig tshun byung ba kha phye than bcad che mi spyob khebs pa zhig byung tshe/ zhal nas 'o 'di rnam snang gangs chen mtsho'i na bza' dang khyad med gzhan la ma ster rang gis zungs dang dgos pa yod/ nga'i skyes rabs na khyod la bshad yod pa ltar gyis zhes gsung phebs pa rmis pas mya ngan cung zhig zhi/ ston kha gdan sa'i bsod snyoms la song / thams cad la gdung dus dang gdung tshwa bkram sa nas mchod rten brgya lhag bzhengs su bcugachu bye nga lnga'i steng a bo skyabs nas mchod rten bzhengs pa'i kha 'go byus/ rgyal bo'i sngags ma nga dang lhan du rab gnas byas tshe nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang /—mi9 re ༷༷na

sa / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'ja' 'od shar/ yong dus 'ja' 'od kyis khyab pa mthong snang du grub/ dus mchod la ma ṇi'i sgrub chen btsugs pa'i kha 'go byas/ gdan sa'i 'bul sdud la ka pha rin song /'jog ti'i sa nas tshogs btang / gnam ya thang nas rang ngan sde ba'i bla sngags pho mo brgya phrag tsam la che dbang / seng gdong / gur drag gi dbang lung / rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad/tshogs brgya btang / glang chen zer sa nas tshogs brgya btang / rab kha nas sngags pa mang po la rta mgrin gyi dbang dang lung mang po bton/ lha bkya'i thang nas zur tshang mtshams pa la lung mang po dang / ngang tshang nas bon brgya'i dpal mkhan rgyal la skyabs rje'i gsung 'bum kha shas bton/ lam skabs rnams nas lhang mang po bton/ lug bzhi brgya rta rgod ma nyi shu nor sum cu rnyed pa gdan san phul/ nang gi rnyed pa'i nang nas rta gcig sngags mang la phul/de'i lo sdig pa mang po byas pa la 'gyod/ dri med bshags rgyud rgyun du kha bton byas/skyabs mgon zhi bar gshegs pa nas bzung yar mar gyi tshes bcu la tshogs re ma chag pa byas/gsung 'bum mjug rtsom/ dbu sngas kyi po ti gnyis po bris nas gsung 'bum gral du bzhagachu glang nga drug steng gling rgya'i sde ba gsum gyi sngags pas bka' brgyad chos thog gsan 'dzugs la song / lo re bzhin song nas bslab ston byus/ nong bo nas skyabs mgon sprul sku 'khrungs yod pa la kha dan phul/ skyabs rje'i gdan sar do dam khyas/shing stag nga bdun steng khyung dgon sprul sku din po che zhi bar gshegs tshe gdung dbyangs su/ dpal yo rgyan padma 'byung gnas dang / / don dbyen med pha cig grub pa'i dbang / /mgon dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi/ / sku'i yang srid gang de snying nas dran/ /dus bskal ngan snyigs ma'i mar gsham 'din/ / mgon rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyams re dma'/ /khong bshes gnyen thams cad dag zhing gshegs/ / bdag skal dman 'khod ba'i 'dam du lus/ / khong sprul ba'i sku mchog rin po che'i/ / sku'i rnam 'gyur gsung dbyungs snyan mo dang / / thugs brtse tshul yid la dran pa'i mod/ / rang gdungs pa'i sgre sngags dbyangs su gyer/ /dbus nab brjid lhan po glo bud 'gyel/ /da 'dod lha'i rten pa gang du byed/ /dpag bsam gyi shing chen thad nas chag /'dod pa yi dngos po gang nas 'byung / /sgyu mtsho che glo bur nyid du skam/ /chu gnas rnams skam la ci ltar tshugs/ / mtshan ldan gyi bla ma glo bun gshegs/ / rang cag gi lam sna su yis 'dren/ / kye ma hud sprul sku nam mkha'i nor/ /dus da lta chu lha'i pang du gzim/ / pha snying rje'i bdag nyid rin po che/ / 'bangs ba ci kyis ba kyis 'dod phod dam/ /sngon thugs bskyed dam bca' nyer dgongs la/ /

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /slad sprul ba'i sku yi dang zhal ston/ / bdag bu slob sngar bzhin brtse bas skyongs/ / zhes blangs nas gdung mchod sngags mang dang lhan du phul/shing yos nga brgyad steng / smras pa/ padma'i rnam 'phrul gdul bya thams cad la/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis nang grol lam ston cing / / dbang lung man ngag gdams pa stsol mdzad pa'i/ /grub dbang dam pa de la snying nas dad/ / ces sku phyogs dgu nong sprul sku rin po che sprul sku'i do dam la skebs nas bzhugs tshe dus mchod steng sngags mang la bka' brgyad rnal 'byon rgyun dbang gnang dus a dar cha ga'i sngags 'chang mkha' 'gro tsho ring la chos skyong gi sku babs nas tshe kegs yod gsungs tshe smad pa'i sngags pa bcu tsam gyis rang khyim nas gur drag gi sgo nas ar gtad bsgrubs/ nang yang mtshams la bsdad nas tshe sgrub byus/ hor tshang nas sha nye sku skyes kyis rgya nag nas bzos pa'i padma mthong grol dngul gyi rdo rje'i tog can bskur ba dang / lha khang mkhar 'bum byams kyis dbang yon du gdan cha dom ral gnyis phul ba'i rten 'brel gyis tshe kegs las grol/ chung nas 'dris pa'i bris pa mkhan lo 'chi nad kyis zin tsho zhag 'ga' la thos grol bton/ shi ba dang gsal 'debs dang 'pho ba btab/ nong rdo tsug ༵/tshan sgrogs mkhan rin po che'i zhabs brtan du lo 'ga' la bka' brgyad khyung dgu ma ༄ me 'brug nga dgu'i steng dpyid ka hor tshang du song / de phyogs kyi dpon po 'ga' dang rta pa bcu tsam rgan rgya'i gzhung la bsu ba la 'ongs/ slebs pa dang a lags sku skyes tshang nas sna len dang / sku phyogs zhal dkar tshang nas gus 'dud gnang / a lags tshang dang 'go ba kha gsum gyi sngags mang gi 'dod pa ltar/ gsang bdag drag 'dul/ seng gdong /phun pa/ gur drag lo ka/ mgon po tshogs bdag rnams kyi dbang dang / gzhan rjes gnang kha shas/ rdzogs chen a ti zab don gyi lung khrid dang mkho ba'i lung mang po phul/sngags pa bcu drug gis sngon 'gro re khas blangs/ dge ba'i khas len mang po lhas dong tse khron bcu gsum phul/ 'bru 'brus sngags pa lhun grub kyis bos nas/ nyer mkho'i gdams pa dang lung byin/ gdan dkar gcig dang sman rakta'i snod ka pa la chung ngu gnyis phul/ ban sgan nas zhal dkar tshang dang grwa mang gi sku rim du rta mgrin sgo nas rdo 'bum bshig gso byus/rta mgrin gyi lung phul/ dong tse khron bco lnga byin/ dpon po rdo phrug la sku rim bsgrubs nas rta gcig byen/ a lags khu dbon nas rta gcig gnang / sngags mang gis rgan rgya'i gzhung bar bskyal nas yul du yong / dgu ba'i bcu bzhi'i nyin skyabs mgon sdig ci ḍiX ༷ che

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gdan sar bkod che nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon ngo mtshar ba shar tshe thams cad la dad pa skyes/bdag gis maṇḍal bshad pa brgyab/ sprul sku nas ngos 'dzin gnang bas thams cad kyi the tshom bsal/ zhabs brtan la rta mgrin gtor zlog cig bsgrubs/ nang khyim nas smad pa'i sngags mang gi ma ṇi'i sgrub chen btsugs/ thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang drang srong sbog gtad phul/ ma ṇi dung phyun longs pa'i ston mo la rta gcig phul/me sbrul drug cu tham pa'i steng khyung dgon nas sngags mang shog ka gsum gyi sngags pa nyi shu tsam gyis mgon bsdad nas gur drag gi sgo nas gnad 'bebs nyi ma bcu la bsgrubs nas lung bstan ltar gyi sa gnas su rdo 'bum brtsigs/ sku phyogs bses tshang gi sku don la rgyal bo'i rig 'dzin rab 'phel gling nas dregs pa sde gsum gyi sgrub pa btsugs pa'i sgrub dpon byas/snga phyi gnyis kyi gton ma'i sra rtags legs po byung / nong bo nas sku phyogs bses tshang gi zhabs brtan la bka' brgyad khyung dgu ma btsugs/sa rta drug cu re gcig steng bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sprul sku'i zhabs brtan la zla ba gcig gi ring la gcod kyi sgo nas 'dul dang rta mgrin sgo nas mnan pa bsgrubs/ 'chi med rang gzungs 'bum gted dang tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul/ sku phyogs dgu nong tshang la sngags mang nas bka' brgyad dbang chen zhus pa'i gral du nyan/ khong la phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi dbang / gsang bdag 1 ga dka gnyis kyi dbang phul/ sha za hor mo'i rjes gnang yang phul/ rwang gi che kegs zlog phyid phur pa'i sbyin sreg dang che sgrub byus/ khu bo ngag dbang lo brgyad cu gya gnyis steng shi ba la gsal 'debs thos grol sogs bton nas dge rtsa bcos/ya du'i sngags pa spyi la lo ka'i rig gtad dang lung byen/ su du dkar nag gi las sbyor byas/yu zud gyi dbu rtse nas dpal mkhar dang / ri sked nas 'bum khang blugs/ bzhi ba'i nang bkra shis 'khyil nas zhabs brtan du bka' brgyad kyi zlog pa zhig bsgrubs/ a lags skal ldan sprul sku la skyabs mgon rin po che'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs dang gur drag gi dbang phul/ lo der rgyun mtshams byas nas sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub/ 'chi med ring gzungs 'bum gter gsum/ che gzungs 'bum gter gcig phur pa dang rta mgrin gnyis kyi sngags 'bum gter lnga re/ yum dang bskal bzang ting 'dzin bka' thang dag tshar/ gcod pa brgya/ chos skyong rnams kyi bskang gsol khri tshar re/ nyin rer bla ma'i mtshan sngags la las bzhi'i spel tshig btags pa brgya re 'don rgyu byas pas gegs sri las grol/ ma ṇi'i chos thog la sngar ci2 ltan sang / byang chub ma ṇi'i steng nas dam sri mnan pa brgyab/

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ 1sa lug re gnyis steng khyung dgon ma ṇi'i steng nas sprul sku 'khrungs yod pa khrir 'god rgyu'i bkod pa byas/ gnyis pa'i nang bkra shis chos gling nas smad pa'i sngags pa 'ga' la rdzogs chen gyi khrid btab/ sngon 'gro re khas blangs/ 'jam mo thang gi sngags pa rnams la phur pa'i dbang lung byas/ sngags pa gsum la khrid btab/ gling rgya byang chub nyang gi sngags pa rnams nas o rgyan rin po che'i sku 'bum lha ri'i rin chen gsang phug nas blugs shing nab gnas byas/ dgun kha shog ka'i sngags pa bcu tsam gyis rang khyim nas gur drag gi sgo nas mnan tta zhi sna gso rgyas/bas tshad ldan bsgrubs nas mnan pa nags 'dabs kyi rdo 'bum du lcags sprel re gsum steng byang chub sde ba'i lab tse gzhi brtsigs dang ri khrus byus/nad tsha zhig rkyen rgyun bsnyen byus nas/ khyung khra'i sngags bye ba bzhi/ tsā ga dka bye ba gnyis/seng ge sgra 'bum gted noms bton/ sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub sgo nas tshogs brgya brgya mchod phul/ lo den brgya rtsa chag med kyi 'go btsugs/rang ngan sde ba'i sku rim la mgon po tshogs bdag gi sgo nas dgra mnan bsgrubs/ dge 'phel bla brang dang dgon pa'i 'grigs khrims bsdams/ lha ri'i pad dkar chos gling nas skal ldan sprul sku dang sngags pa 'ga' la/ 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang / nyi ma grags pa'i gur drag rta mgrin/ seng gdong / lha chen rnams kyi dbang / klong chen snying thig gi dbang yongs rdzogs/ ratna'i seng gdong / bdud 'dul/ 'khod ba dbyings sgrol/mgon po tshogs bdag rnams kyi dbang lung / rdzogs chen gyi lung sogs phul/ lha khang nas sgrub chen steng 'khrod ba dbyings sgrol gyi dbang bskur/ chang 'grigs dam du bsdams nas lha khang dbu mdzad dge bskul la bskos/ byang chub sde ba'i ma ṇi'i steng skyes pho mo sum brgya tsam la 'khor ba dbyengs sgrol gyi dbang dang ratna'i seng gdong gi dbang / rta mgrin bgegs dpung mthar byed kyi lung rnams bgyis/lcags byu re bzhi'i steng khyung dgon du song / sngags pa rnams gros mthun gyis nga nang khri khar sdod zer ba ltar bsdad/ zhal bkod dang chos bshad byus/ 'grigs khrims bsdams pa'i stabs 'du khang nang du mi chud pa tsam 'tshogs/ spyang lung rgyal bo gnyis kyi 'grigs khrims bsdams/ rdzong dkad nas sngags pa rnams la rig 'dzin 'dus pa rta nag gsang bdag rnams kyi dbang / ma mgon lcam dral dang dregs pa sde gsum gyi srog gtad/sde ba rnams la thugs rje chen po'i dbang bskur/ chang dud sogs khas blangs rdo~X/ —rang

ga / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yul nas bka' thang tshar lnga gzhan khas blangs pa bco lnga song / pad dkar chos gling nas skal ldan sprul sku/ rnam rgyal tshe ring sogs sngags pa 'ga' la bka' brgyad dbang chen/zab chos padma drag khros dbang / 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi dbang lung / rig byed ma'i dbang lung / klong chen snying thig gi dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ ma mgon lcam dral gyi sbog gtad/ lo ka'i man ngag kha tshang gi lung rnams bton/ mkhar sngon gyi mkha' ri'i lab tse gzhi brtsigs dang / sngags pa rnams la phun pa'i dbang byin/ dar grong dang spyi tshang gnyis kyi spyod kyi don la mgon po tshogs bdag gi dgra mnan dang sku rim bton/ lkog nas gzu bskul byas/ yul lhas kyang ngas bshad pa'i steng gnon byas nas kha mchu 'grigs/ nga la gsang nas dman mchod bcu drug tsam brgyab par/ nga'i rmi lam du yul lha la mi bzhin kha brda byas par/ khyod kyis dman mchod btang ba khos bzhes snyam/ nga'i skal ma zos zhes ra zhig gi sha lpags kyi phyed ka bstan pa this pas yul lha dkar phyogs par bsgyur ba la yid ches/bkra shis 'khyil ba'i bsod snyoms la song dus sku zhabs dgu nong tshang gi chibs bsud yid dga'i dgon par song / khyung dgon sprul sku tshang yang phebs/ sku phyogs gdan drangs/nas bsod do bo bco lnga bla brang la phul/ bkra shis 'khyel ba nas bdag dang skal ldan sprul sku/dkon mchog nor bu dang gsum gyis rta mgrin gtor zlog zhag bdun la bsgrubs/ sku phyogs dgu nong tshang bzhugs pa'i zhabs brtan la gun drag gi gtor zlog 'phangs/ khong la sku gong ma'i rgyun gyi bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i dbang lung dang mgon po tshogs bdag gi dbang lung / nyi grags brgya rtsa'i lung rnams phul/ khong gis dri med bshags rgyud dang bka' thang bsdus pa'i lung gnang / sprul sku tshang gi phyag rdzas rnams kyi rtsis grangs blangs nas do dam byas/ nag rgyu'i ma ṇi'i steng nas 'khor ba dbyengs sgrol gyi dbang bskur rjes nas/ smras pa/rig 'dzin chen po surya kirti yi/ / chos rgyun 'dzin la 'gran gyi zla bral ba/ / sngags 'chang spya sgre wa'i zhal snga nas/ / smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi thob 'di rmad/ / ces sngags 'chang rta mgrin gyi zhal snga nas bla ma bde mchog gi dbang / sngags bdag 'ban ma'i dbang thob/ nag rgya'i sngags pa rnams la bla ma bde mchog rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon/seng gdong / lha chen/ sngags bdag 'ban ma rnams kyi dbang / mgon po gza' dam can sngags srung ma rnams kyi srog gtad byas/ dkar rtse gdong dmag dpon nang du rkun ma 'dzul nas mnol phab pa la/ rma bya'i dug 'joms kyi gtsang dang byad grol bgyis/ byang ba nga 3ka 4 sbyong nas sbyin sreg dang tshogs brgya dang / dgun bkra shis chos gling nas

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /mtshams la bsdad/zu khyi re lnga'i steng khyung dgon ma ṇi'i steng nas 'khor ba dbyings sgrol sgyu dbang lung bgyis/ khyung dgon sprul sku tshang la bsam pa lhan 'thub ma'i dbang / tshe dbang / ma gza' rdor gsum gyi spog gtad phul/ rdzong dkad nor bu'i khyim nas sbyin sreg blugs/skyabs mgon sprul skur me tog bgos pa'i do dam la zla ba gcig dang phyed tsam la bsdad/sngags pa 'ga' dang lhan du gur drag gi sgo nas gnad 'bebs tshad ldan bsgrubs/ de nas me tog bzhes skabs tshe gzungs 'bum gter/ bka' thang dang thang yig sde lnga gser 'od rnams bton/ nyen re bzhin klu gton dang bsang / sde brgyud mchod pa bka re 'gro ba byas/ rmi lam du khri ka'i yul lha yin zer ba'i rgya zhig gis me tog ster zen gangs thig lta bu nyung du zhig byin pa rngis/ me tog yag po bzhes/ skal ldan sprul sku la rje btsun mi la'i dbang / bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i dbang / lha chen glang gdong gi dbang dang lung mang po bton/ dbyan thog 'brog du nas bsdad/ non rgyun ma'i gzungs 'bum gter g.yang 'bod chos skyong bskang gsol la 'bad/chu phag re drug steng khyung dgon ma kar song sngags mang la lung kha shas dang / khyung dgon sprul sku tshang dang spyang lung sngags pa sum cu tsam la/ bka' brgyad dbang chen/'dod 'jo'i bum bzang / bdud 'dul kyi lha ya'i dbang lung / lha chen glang gdong gi dbang lung / ku du ku ka'i dbang lung / gzhan lung mang po phul/ bkra shis 'khyil ba nas zla ba bzhi la sprul sku tshang gi dge rgan gyi tshab byas nas bsdad/ sprul sku tshang gi thugs 'dod ltar/— skyabs mgon gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung phul/ gzhan lung mang po phul/ 'dod pa can 'ga' la/ dkon mtshog spyi 'dus/ gun drag seng gdong / 1 ga dka sogs kyi dbang / dam can sbog gtad/ dzam dkar rjes gnang sogs byin/bstan 'dzin nor bu dang snyan grags gnyis kyi 'dod pa ltan che ring mched lnga'i gtor chog brtsams nas lung byen/ dgon pa'i lab tse gzhi brtsigs byus/ phyag dpe rnams bsgrigs/smras pa/ blo bzang rgya' ba'i lung rtogs dam chos kyis/ /rigs can thar bar 'khrid mkhas rdo rje 'dzin/ /'gro khams rgya mtshor chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa gang de 'gro ba'i skyabs/ / zhes dge steng nas sku phyogs a nol rin po che'i mdun nas/ kun rig gi dbang / gzhi gsum tsho ga 'bum chung / 'da' ka ye shes/ bsam pa lhun 'grub myur 'grub sogs kyi lung thob/ tho rgya'i tsong yes ya mun du bos nas bku~X bste gas/

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogasaXbasgrigs/gur drag gi bzlog pa 'phangs/ dar grong gi 'bum khang gsum nags 'dabs nas blugs/bcu ba'i nang bis thang mtshams pa kun dga' man nang gi mgur chung stong skor gyis gdan 'dren du btang ba ltar song / ja thab chibs bsu spyo cher byas/ mgur chung nas ri khrod pa dge slong skal bzang gi gtsos sngags pa rnams dang / chu bzang gi sngags pa 'ga'/ mgur chung stong skor gyi skyes pho mo brgya phrag tsam la/ bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i dbang / rig 'dzin gdung sgrub/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/ gur drag nyi grags seng gdong rnams kyi dbang dang lung / gdugs dkar/ gsang bdag gi rjes gnang sogs lung mang po byas/ thams cad kyis khas blangs byas pan/ sgyung gnas sum brgya/ sgrol ma 'bum gter/ ma ṇi sa ya sogs khas blangs nas dong tse sogs khron lnga bcu phul/ mtshams khang padma chos rdzong nas/ pa shi'i sngags rgan phag mo thar sogs thams cad la rje btsun mi la'i dbang / thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal nang grol dang / rig 'dzin 'dus pa/ mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo gsum gyi dbang lung byas/ mtshams kang la rab gnas dang gnas bstod brtsams/ stong skor du song sde ba la seng gdong gi gtor zlog bsgrubs/ so sor 'pho lung bsngo zhus dang lung dang chos bshad byas/ spyi thog nas gdan cha mar nag ba lang nas sogs dong tse khron brgya'i rtsis phul/ chu bzang du song / a lags rta mgrin sprul sku tshang dang / chu bzang ka ring bes thang sogs mtsho lnga'i sngags pa lnga bcu tsam la bka' brgyad dbang chen/ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub/ gun drag rig 'dzin 'dus pa/ mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo rnams kyi dbang lung / chos srung gi srog gtad sogs phul/ sprul sku la shing rta rnam gnyis klong chen snying thig gi lung phul/ a mchod rnams nas bos/ klong snying seng gdong gi dbang / gdugs dkan rjes gnang / mkha' 'gro bde chen sprel mo'i dbang /gu ru le'u bdun/ skyabs 'gro/ smon lam lnga ka/ gdugs dkan sogs kyi lung byus/thams cad nas rta gcig dong tse gdan snam bu sogs mang po phul/ byang chub ma ṇi'i steng nas bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i dbang / rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi dbang / sdom lung sogs byin/ dgun mtshams la bsdad nas rta mgrin gyi sbyin sreg blugs/shing byi re bdun steng khyung dgon ma ṇi'i steng nas 'du khang gi don la bkod pa brgyab/skal ldan sprul sku la rig 'dzin gdung sgrub/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa/ sdug bsngal rang grol gsum gyi dbang byen/ dad grong padma rdo rje la mgon po ma ning dang dam can gyi sbog gtad byas—/ kyi du ༷༷ bco lnga la dar grong nas gso sbyong dang sdom lung byus/ smad pa gling rgya

rang rnam rin chen zang ba bzhugs so/ /gnyis pyod la thug nas mi mang po bsad tshe gling spyo'i sku rim la 'gro dgos byung nas mgon po tshogs bdag bsgrubs/ rmog pa'i lab tse men bsregs pa gzhi brtsigs byas/ skyabs mgon sprul sku dang rgyal bo yar nang gi sngags mang gi rgan pa rnams bos nas gzu bskul byus kyang phan ma thogs/ tsho mgon skyabs shi ba la thos grol dang dge rtsa bcos/ gling rgyu'i nag gi tshang gi tsho ba'i rdo 'bum zhig gso byus/ dang yul nas seng gdong gtod zlog cig 'phangs/ bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sprul sku tshang gi zhabs brtan la rta mgrin gtod zlog dang /dpa' bo las nab tsol gyi tshe sgrub dang / 'chi med ring gzungs gnyis 'bum gter re bton/ nang yul nas sprul sku tshang la sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang rgyas pa dang dze dbang brgya rtsa phul/ dkar rtse gdong gi ma kar song / 'jam dpon po dang sde bdun gyi 'grigs bdag rnams nas skyabs 'jug zhus pa dang du blangs/ byang chub ma ṇi'i steng nas skyes pho mo drug cu tsam gyis smyung gnas bsrung ba la gso sbyong / dan grong tsho ba la seng gdong sgo nas gtod zlog gos 'ad nga rdo nga thod rdong hūṃ/ dī ༵/chog non bu'i khyem nas sbyin sreg blugs/ yang dā ser po shing glang re brgyad steng rgya lo'i nang / mgan rtse nas dge slong nor bu ma bde bar song /nyi ma bco lnga tsam la bsdad nas sku rim bcos/ dpyid sa'i sa lags brag dkar tshang bzhugs pa la mjal/ rdo rje go khrab kyi lung byen/ rdzong dkar sde ba la bka' brgyad gsar 'dzugs byus/ ha ra pa dun dpyid chos la song / sbu phyogs dgu nong tshang 'bod du 'ongs pa la ma song ban rjes nas yong rgyu byas/ gling rgya'i chos thog la song 'jam gling gi khyod bar nas byis pa zhig smad pas bzung ba blu du song ngo chen zhus nas sprad de tshe than bad byas/mar nang nas slob bu skal bzang / bis thang kun dga'/ dpal mgon gsum 'tshams zhur yong ba la lung kha shas phul/ rgya nag nas pā rin ta wang nas snga phyi ban gsum la dngul srang bdun tsam 'byor ba la 'byor 'a na yi ge dang rwa bsrung srung 'khor sogs phul/ ser rgya'i dbyar chos la song sngags mang la gur drag dbang dang / ser rgya'i sngags pa rnams la seng gdong gi dbang lung / chos spyod kyi lung / rgan rgon rnams la sdom lung byin/ bkra shis 'khyil ban song / rab byung la da lo sprul sbu tshang tsub pas ma phebs na byas kyang kha ma blangs par phebs/ nye ba tsha bo sha tsha ba zhig yod pa na nas sku rim mang po bsgrubs kung ma phan par shi song ba la dmigs nas thar mdo lnga bcu bton/ brgyad pa'i nyi shu'i nang rmi lam du nyi ma gzas zin pa sogs sprul sku rin po che la rmi lam ngan pa rmis pas rdoX ci7 gi da/tor

༄ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsngos/ tshe sgrub 'bum gter bsgrubs/ de dus 'brog nas spul sku rin po cher tshad pa 'gos/ grwa ba gcig shi ba byung / bkra shis 'khyil ban phebs dus sprul sku tshang shin tu thu mor song dus sku mdun du song nas phur pa'i sgo nas mnan sreg 'phang gsum/ bka' brgyad zlog chen rnams bsgrubs pas sku dwangs/ de dus thi lam du skyabs mgon rin po che sngar rgyun ltar bzhugs pa'i zhal nas bdag la 'di gsungs/ e ma skal ldan snying gi bu/ /nga yi sprul ba'i sku mchog der/ /zhabs brtan rim gro bsgrubs lags sam/ /sku khams bde bar yod lags sam/ /gsungs pa'i lan du/ ngas 'di zhus/ sprul ba'i sku mchog rin po che/ /skabs 'din cung zad snyung na yang / /mgon po khyod kyi byin rlabs dang / /zhabs brtan rim gro bsgrubs pa'i mthus/ /mi bde ma mchis bde bar mchis/ /slad yang thugs rjes 'dzin pa mkhyen/ / zhes zhus pas thugs dgyes nas mang po bzhad tshe dga' drags nas zhwa nag cig khyon nas sku mdun nas 'cham stabs mang po byas tshe/ mdun na yod tshad bzhad pa byung ba rbis tshe sprul sku 'khrul med yin bsam dad pa lhag par skyes pa byung / zho bong dpyis kyi nye ba zhig la rta mgrin gyi sgo nas mnan bsreg 'phang gsum byas/ rdzong dkan bsod nams 'bum gyis bka' thang dpar ma zhig phul/ dkon mchog nor bu dang gnyis la bal mo sgrub pa'i chog sgrig gi lung byin/ bkra shis chos gling du mtshams pa blo bzang nod bu bzhag stag yan ma ṇi'i steng du song las sna spor/ lha khang dgun chos la song / skyabs mgon sprul sku tshang phebs pa la bka' chos zhus/ sku'i do dam sngags mang nas bsgrubs/dbu mdzad kyi khyem nas rta mgrin gtod zlog dang phun pa'i sbyin sreg blugs/ rdzong dkan nas bsod nams 'bum gyi khyim nas rta mgrin gyi sbyin sreg blugs/ byang chub ma kar song /dar grong nas sngags pa 'ga' la chos thog bzung nas sbyin sreg blugs/me stag re dgu'i steng khyung dgon la song sgrub chen steng nas 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi bkod pa dang / nyi ma bdun la rta mgrin gyi gtor zlog dang sbyin sreg blugs/ khyung dgon sprul sku rin po che la rig 'dzin gdung sgrub/ dpal chen 'dus pa/ rig 'dzin/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyi dbang dang tshe dbang gnyis/ gur drag rdor sems/ stag tshang phun pa/nyi grags seng gdong rnams kyi dbang / 1 ga dka rnams kyi rjes gnang dang lung / rdzogs chen rig 'dzin zhal lung / dri med bshags rgyud rnams kyi lung phul/ rta zhig gnang /sngags mang dang lhan du smad pa gling rgya'i gzu bskul byas kyang ma nyan/ rang khyim nas bka' ba kyi 8bsgrubs/ tsho ba'i seng gdong dang rdo 'bum gsos/ bkra shis 'khyel ba nas

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /sprul sku tshang gi sku cung ma bde ban song / khyung khra dang 'khrug bcos kyi sngags 'bum gter re/snying gter bcu gsum/ 'khor 'das mchod pa dang brgyag ba ngon/ dzam nag gi zu sbyin 'bum gten gsum bcas bsgrubs/ lha khang dbu mdzad gshegs pa la bsngo smon byus/gling rgya'i ya du'i chos thog la song / tshogs brgya gnyis/ mtshod rten/ gur drag dzam nag gsum la gzungs gzhug phul/ bzhi ba'i bco lnga la sgyung gnas bsrung / rdzong dkar sngags pas bka' brgyad gsan 'dzugs la song / bkra shis 'khyil ba nas a lags dgu steng / bstan 'dzin nyi ma sogs nged cag 'gas gur drag bye za'i sgo nas zhi drag gnyis kyi sbyin sreg blugs/ zho bong dpyis kyi tsho ba gcig la rta mgrin sgyu sbyin sreg blugs/ zho bong la kha'i sngags mang gis bos/ bka' brgyad dbang chen/ rdor sems/ phur pa yang gsang bla med/ 'jam dpal/ ratna'i seng gdong / rta mgrin/ gcod/ gsang bdag rnams kyi dbang lung / chos spyod sogs tshogs nas 'don tshad kyi lung phul/ dong tse khron lnga bcu phul/ bcu ba'i tshes gsum nyin skyabs mgon sprul sku rin po che dang lhan du a chung gnam rdzong la song / dgu nong / dgu steng / lha sa/ nya mo/ sprul lce/ skya reng /rdo reng / sngo skya/ gnam steng / a 'byung / do rgya/ ska phug bod bya tshang / ya mkhar/ sngo rgya sogs sngags sde rnams kyis chibs bsu 'bul ba sogs rgya chen byas/ bcu gsum nyin gnam rdzong la thon/ ja thab chibs bsu rgyas par byas/ bco lnga'i nyin rab gnas byas/ ston mo byas pa dang 'bul ba phul/ maṇḍal bshad pa byas par bshad lan bdag gis bshad/ bcu bdun la grwa ba rnams phyir log bcu dgu'i nyin sprul sku tshang dang tsha bo rgya mtsho nged gsum gnam rdzong rtser song nas bod lo'i bcu bdun bar mtshams la bsdad/rta phag gi bsnyen pa bye ba/ phur pa'i sngags 'bum gter gyi sgo nas gtor zlog 'phangs/'chi med ring gzungs 'bum gter zhabs brtan la phul/ mtshams nang nas sku phyogs dgu nong tshang dang skyabs mgon sprul sku/ a lags dgu steng / bstan 'dzin nyi ma tshang sgo me sprul sku/ zhabs drung sprul sku/ sris nag sprul sku sogs ston 'khor rnams la grub thob brgyud cu'i dbang / phud pa bdud 'dul/ lo ka/ lha chen/ sngags bdag 'bar ma rnams kyi dbang dang / de'i skor rnams kyi lung / bden gnyis shing rta/ rnam mkhyen shing rta/ rgyud 'bum dkad chag rje btsun mi la'i dbang rnam thar/ yon tan mdzod kyi rtsa ba/'bru 'grel/ thar mdo/ gcod pa sogs gang mkho'i lung mang po phul/ bod lo'i bcu bdun nas nyer dgu'i bar nyi grags seng gdong gi gtor zlog gur drag sgo nas3 :la ba

'o sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs ga7ra snro ༵ ༵ 1rdo rdo sbyo ba~X/ pa'i steng lo gsar gyi tshes gtor dang ston mo noms byas/ 'du khang nang nas nyi ma gsum la bla ma mchod pa bton/ ches drug nas bco lnga'i bar khams ra'i sngags mang gi ma ṇi'i steng nas zhal bkod dang phyag len bslabs/ bco brgyad nas nyer lnga ban bka' brgyud khyung dgu ma btsugs nas bslabs/ zhi khro'i lung bton/ dong tse khron lnga dang gdan gcig phul/ a lags gong ba tshang nas dong tse khron drug sku phyogs nas khri rgyab yol/ gdan dkad/ dngul srang do/ dong tse khron gcig rnams gnang / tshur lam sngags pa rnams la lung mang po bton/ gnyis pa'i tshes la rang yul du thon/ a lags gong ba tshang la bka' brgyud bde mchog gi dbang phul/ gos gcig phul/ khong la gzan gcig phul/ tsha bo rgya mtsho bkra shis chos gling nas lo mtshams la bsdad/ gling rgya'i bsod nams bkra shis khyim nas byad grol dang tshogs brgya bskor/ dong tse khron bdun phul/ sdong skam dpyid chos la song / sngags pa sangs rgyas dang padma rig 'dzin gnyis la gza' dbang bskur/ gling rgya'i chos thog steng nas rdon sems kyi dbang bskur/ sngags pa drug cu tsam gyis yig brgya 'bum gten re khas blangs/ dong tse khron gsum phul/ smad pa'i dbyur chos steng nas rdor sems dang mgon po tshogs bdag gi dbang lung byas/ yig ma 'bum gter re khas blangs/ dong tse khron bcu gcig phul/ stag yan sde ba la rta mgrin btsugs/ rdo 'bum brtsigs/ dong tse khron so lnga phul/ 'jam padma rig 'dzin dang ha ra pa dur rdo rje 'bum gnyes la rta mgrin btsugs sbyin sreg blugs/ dong tse khron lnga re phul/ dbyar thog a lags dgu steng phebs nas 'du khang gi chas ka bsdus/ tsha bo dang mnyam du bsdad/ ston kha zho bong la kha'i sngags mang gis bos/ so so nas ja zhus byas/ bsod stoms phul/rgyal bo'i ston chos chad yod pa mthud nas/ sku phyogs rgyal bo tshang gi sprul sku dang sa lags mi skyod nas shog kha gsum la bzung / sprul sku la dbang lung gnang chad byas/ rang khyem nas ma ṇi bzung / skyabs mgon sprul sku rin po che tshogs dbur phebs par 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/ bsam pa lhun 'grub/ rdor sems/ gur drag gi dbang phul/ tsha bo zhig skyes pa la padma dbang pyol zhes ming btags/ byang chub ma ṇi la song /sa 'brug don gcig steng khyung dgon la song / dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med rin po che'i sbu gdung mdun nas nyid kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar mtshan sngags ba ka ༷ bton/ rgyu lo'i bcu gsum la sku gdung dang mgon khang gi rten rnams sbu gong

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ma'i mtshams khang nang du gdan drangs/ bcu bzhi'i nyin dmag gsar la song / rgyal bo tshang gi sprul sku dang / ma lags mi skyod/ khyung dgon sprul sku/ dmag gsar sprul sku/ya lags padma rang grol sprul sku/ hor sprul sbu sogs de phyogs kyi sngags mang rnams la bka' brgyad dbang chen/ 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang / bdud 'dul/ phur pa/ bka' brgyad/rdod sems/ ratna'i seng gdong / nyi grags seng gdong / mgon po tshogs bdag sogs kyi dbang lhang yongs rdzogs/ gzhan rig byed ma'i dbang dang lung sogs lung mang po bzhe ba'i tshes brgyad ban du phul/ smras pa/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul gan/ /bsgyur mdzad rgyal sras mi bskyod rdo rje des/ /rjes bzung smin grol gdams pa bstsal pa'i mod/ / rab gus thal mo spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'dzin/ / zhes grub dbang mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ thugs rje chen po ma rig mun sel gyi dbang / bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong dbang / rdzogs chen ston pa bcu gnyis kyi dbang sogs thob/ smras pa/ rig 'dzin chen po shī wan mad yi/ /gdung 'tshob gsang sngags bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /yo rgyan 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhal snga nas/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i dbang bskur thob 'di mtshar/ /zhes sngags 'chang o rgyan 'jin las rnam rgyal gyi drung nas 'jam dpal gyi dbang lung las gshin rjes gnang / rta mgrin bgegs dpung mthar byed kyi lung thob/ a lags mi bskyod nas rta gcig phrug gcig dong tse kha dar mang po gnang / gnyis pa'i bcu gcig nyin 'du khang la ar chog byus/ smad pa'i sngags mang nas bskyod/ nged dang a lags dgu steng sa lags nyi ma nged gsum bzhi ba bar bsdad/ bzhi ba'i nang sku phyogs dgu nong tshang phebs nas kha 'go gnang / lnga ba'i tshes dgur ka kha bslangs/ bco lnga la thog bkab/ skabs der nu bo shi ba'i stabs yul du yong nas dge rtsa bcos/ tho rgya'i bod skor gyi sngags pa rnams la rta mgrin gyi dbang bskur/ sngags pa 'gas ral ba sngags chas byas/ slob bu ka do zer ba la sku rim bton dong tse khron bco lnga phul/ yul nas gun drag gi bzlog pa zhig 'phangs/ mtshams la bsdad yod dus wa shul cho go(khro kho) nas karma don grub gtsos ma bstan gyis nga yod sar mngags pa chu chal dge slong dang 'jam rmo 'i sngags pa klu 'bum rgyal gnyis kyis khrid 'ongs par/ rta mgrin lo nyi gnyis kyi dbang / ma gza' rdon gsum dang hor mo'i srog gtad sogs byus/ dong tse khron bcu gcig phul/ chu chal dge slong dang nged cag 'gas bka' brgyad khro nol zhig bsgrubs/ tshogs brgyu bskor/ mdo khri tshar ga te 'bum gter sgos shen snying bdud bzlog bsgrubs/ — 41 —

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sa sbul don gnyis steng khyung dgon 'du khang gsan ba'i nang nas ma ḍi btsugs/ sku phyogs a nol rin po ches tshogs btang / nyi ma bdun tsam la nged cag sngags pa 'gas gur drag gi gnad 'bebs bsgrubs/ mnan pa mchod rten zhabs kyi rdo 'bum 'og tu mnan/ra gnam kho la chos 'brel bzhag 'jam mo'i sngags pa bcu gsum tsam la rta nag dang re ti/sngags bdag 'bad ma gsum gyi dbang bskud/ lung 'ga' byas/ dong tse khron bdun tsam phul/ dar grong nas seng gdong chos thog btsugs/ dkon mchog non bu'i khyim nas sbyin sreg blugs/ bkra shis chos gling nas rgyal bo'i sprul sku/ khyung dgon sprul sku/ dge rgan/dmag gsar sprul sku/ khri kha'i phyogs kyi sngags pa lnga/ bud med dang jo mo 'ga' bcas la skyabs mgon zhabs dkan pa'i gsung 'bum kha tshang gi lung yongs rdzogs/ rdon gcod sogs lung kha shas/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang / rig 'dzin 'dus pa mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyul mo gnyis kyi dbang lung / nag zla'i tshes bcu la tshogs brgya btang / khyung dgon nas 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi sku la gzungs gzhug phul/ mar lam 'jam mo nas sngags pa rnams la bka' brgyud dbang chen/ gun drag 'jam dpal sogs kyi dbang bskur/dong tse khron bcu gnyis phul/ bkra shis 'khyil bar song / drug pa'i tshes gcig nas bdun pa'i tshes gcig bar/ sku phyogs dgu nong tshang dang sprul sku tshang rnam gnyis la skyabs mgon rin po che'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs/ yid bzhin mdzod/ rje btsun mi la'i mgun 'bum/ 'ol dga'i chos tshan lung thob tshad kyi lung / bka' brgyad dbang chen rnams phul/ston kha sprul sku tshang gi bsod snyoms la smad par song / gro nas do bo bcu gsum rnyed pa phul/smad pa'i 'jam dpon po han thus brgyad cus bos par song / mgon po tshogs bdag btsugs/ dong tse khron nyer gsum phul/ bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sku phyogs dgu nong tshang gi mdun nas/ rdor sems/ rta mgrin yang gsang / dpal chen 'dus pa/ nyi grags seng gdong rnams kyi dbang dang lung kha tshang / rdzogs chen kun bzang snying byang / bka' brgyad las byang khro nol/ rjes 'brang / seng gdong 'don cha kha tshang / dam can gsol kha chen po dngos gru' nam mkha' sogs kyi lung gnang / lha lnga rgya mtsho'i bskang ba/ zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung / dge ba gsum gyi don khrid/ grub dbang padma nang grol rin po che'i chog sgrig zhi khro'i lung sogs khong rnam gnyis la phul/ ka ring a lags rta mgrin gyi sprul sku phebs pan rta mgrin yang gsang dang ratna'i seng gdong gi dbang phul/ bes mdo'i sman pa dge slo~X2 da1 / zho bong la kha'i sngags pa 'ga' la ratna'i seng gdong gi dbang dang lung /

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /rig byed ma'i dbang lhang / sngags srung ma dang dam can srog gtad byas/ dngul dang kha dar che legs dong tse sogs phul/ the'u'i ban sngags gcig la seng gdong / gur dragahor mo gsum gyi dbang / lung kha shas bton/ dong tse khron 'ga' phul/ ha ra pa dur ri seng sna do bye ༵ ༷/ ༵ ti/ zab don dge ba lam stegs sogs lhang 'ga' bton/ tsho ba'i sku rim lcags rte don gsum steng lo gsad la che dbang bskur/ zhong za tshang gi bde spyid bsam gtan gling nas sngags pa rnams la bla ma bde mchog gun drag rta mgrin/ seng gdong / lha chen sogs nyi grags kyi yi dam 'ga'i dbang dang lung / tsho ba'i skyes pho mo brgya lhag tsam la thugs rje chen po ma rig mun sel gyi dbang / bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong dbang bskur/ sngags pa rnams la rdod sems dbang / sngags srung ma/ sngags bdag 'ban ma/ gza'/ dam can rnams kyi srog gtad byas/ nyen mkho'i lung mang po bton/dong tse khron nyi shu phul/ bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sprul sku tshang la/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi lung phul/ gur drag gtor zlog 'phangs/ ya du'i chos thog rjes nas ya du'i sngags pa rnams la gur drag gi dbang bskur/ dong tse khron lnga phul/ dar grong nas bzhi ba'i gso sbyong dang thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang bskur/ rdzong dkar nas sngags mang rnams phyogs gcig 'tshogs nas chos thog steng kun mthun ngos nas 'grigs khrims bsdams/ mgud chung stong skod nas 'bod du 'ongs pad/ lnga ba'i bcu gsum la song / bis kya nas ja thab dang chibs bsu thon/ stong skor mtshams khang du song / a lags nor bu tshang bzhugs pas gus 'dud gnang / stong skor sde ba la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang / sgrol ma dkar sngon gdugs dkar dzam dkar dzam dmar dzam nag sogs kyi rjes gnang / tshe dbang rnams bskun/ mgur chung du song sde ba la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang /sgrol ma dkar sngon/ dzam dkar dzam dmar dzam nag gdugs dkar rnams kyi rjes gnang /che dbang rnams bskur/ sde ba gnyis kyis khas blangs byas par/ sgyung gnas sum brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa lnga yang mchog brgyad gnyis/ sgrol ma 'bum gter gnyis/ sgrol ma nyin re bzhin ma chag par khas blangs pa brgya dang nyer dgu re/ sgrol dkar 'bum gter gnyis khri tsho bzhi/ badzra gu nu 'bum gter gcig ma ṇi bye ba brgyad 'bum gten gsum/ bzang spyod 'bum gter gcig yig brgya 'bum gter gcig stong tsho gsum/ gdugs dkar khri tsho bdun nyin rer khas blangs pa brgyu/ phyag 'bum gter gnyis khri tsho bzhi—/ ka 3 ba

gas nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/stong tsho gnyis/ skor ba stong tsho gcig rnams khas blangs/ sngags pa rnams la 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub/ rdor sems/ gur drag rta phag nyi grags seng gdong rnams kyi dbang dang lung / mgon po/ sngags srung ma/ gza'/ dam can rnams kyi srog gtad/ gsang bdag 1 ga dka gnyis kyi dbang / a ti zab don gyi dge ba lam stegs/ skyabs mgon rin po che'i rnam thar rnams kyi lung byus/ sde ba gnyis nas dong tse khron bdun cu lhag gdan dkar nag sum cu/ bsod stoms khal drug rnams phul/chu bzang nas a lags rta mgrin sprul sku tshang dang dge rgan/ dpal mgon rnams la 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang yongs rdzogs/ chu bzang sngags pa rnams la nyi grags seng gdong / zhi khro/rdor sems/ dpal chen 'dus pa/ sdug bsngal rang grol/ 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rnams kyi dbang lung / a ti zab don gyi dge ba lam stegs/ bka' brgyud chog bzlog gnyis/ gur drag chog bzlog gnyis/ seng gdong kha tshang sogs kyi lung phul/ sku gsung thugs rten maṇḍal dong tse khron bcu gdan dkad bcas phul/ rdo this sngags pa gnyis yong ba la/ gur drag gi dbang dang / lung kha shas bton/ rdo bis sngags phrug cig la zhing skyong seng gdong gi dbang dang lung byen/ skyabs mgon sprul sku rin po che ri khrod du phebs rgyu'i bkod pa thos nas dkon mtshog nod bu dang nged gnyis bkra shis 'khyil bar song /gur drag zlog pa 'phangs/ sprul sku tshang sku phyogs dgu nong tshang gi mdun du phebs/ khong gis bshol nas bkra shis 'khyel bar phebs nas bzhugs/ byang chub ma ṇi'i steng nas 'khor ba dbyengs sgrol rdon sems gnyis kyi dbang bskur/ dri med bshags rgyud kyi lung byas/bsod nams 'bum dang / dkon mchog nor bu gnyis la mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya' mo dang khros nag gi dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed dang lung sogs byen/ padma rdo rje la bde chen zhing dbang bskur/ nang khyim nas tsho ba'i seng gdong bsgrubs tshogs brgya btang / rnga ba'i phyogs kyi bla ma ngag dbang 'jigs med dpon slob gsum phebs pa la dregs pa sde gsum gyi ma~X /gtad/ mngon spyod skor sna tshogs kyi lung khrid/ rta mgrin rta phag sogs lung mang po ༄ lcags lug don bzhi'i steng khyung dgon ma ṇi'i steng nas rdor sems dang 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi dbang phul nas 'grigs bsdams/ nong bo nas skyabs mgon sprul sbu rin po che bzhugs pa la sngags mang dang lhan du bshol 'debs dang brtan bzhugs phul/ 'jam mo ba ga1 4pa rnams la nyi grags seng gdong gi dbang lung dang dri med bshags rgyud kyi lung

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /bgyis/ skyabs mgon sprul sku rin po che rang khyem du phebs par bde chen zhing dbang gi tshe dbang phul/ smras pa/ snying rje'i gter chen 'gro mgon zhabs dkar pa'i/ /yang sprul nyi ma gzhon nu'i zhal dkyil mjal/ /bdag blo'i yid kyi mun pa nab bsal zhing / /deng dus chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung 'di kad/ / ces sprul sku rin po che la chos kyi thog ma tshe dbang zhig zhus pa legs par gnang / dri med lha jos che legs gsum dang / rkyal mar gcig dong tse khron 'ga' phul/ zhag mang por bzhugs nas brtse brtse gnang / bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sprul sku rin po che'i thugs bkod ltar nged sngags pa drug gis bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon pa'i gzhung gis gu du drag po'i sgo nas gnad 'bebs tshad ldan nyi ma bcu la bsgrubs nas la rtsa nas rdo 'bum brtsigs/ this mdo'i sngags pa rnams 'bod du 'ongs nas gsum pa'i bco lnga'i nyin song / ja thab chibs bsu rgyas par byus/ bis mdo'i 'dab ma nas dkyil 'khor tshun gyi sngags pa che chung bzhi bcu tsam la bka' brgyad dbang chen/ gur drag 'jam dpal/'khon ba dbyings sgrol/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa/ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub1 bde chen zhing dbang rnams bskur/ de rnams kyi 'don cha kha tshang gi lung / mgon po/ sngags srung ma1lha mo/ gza'/ dam can/ ma mgon lcam dral rnams kyi sbog gtad sogs bgyis/dong tse khron bdun cu/ gro nas khal lnga phul/ dge slong sman pa blo bzang sbyin pa la 'dod bum kha tshang / lung kha shas phul bas/ sku gsung thugs rten/ mdzod dan/ dril gdan/sbub cha/ gos gzan/ dong tse sogs phul/ sngags rgan snying dkar rgyal gyis 'pho lung zhus nas spub cha gcig phul/ ra gshong sgob bu sangs rgyas dpal gyis bos par song /zhag 'ga' bsdad/ spub cha gcig nas khal gcig phul/ skyes pho mo rnams la gdugs dkan ma ṇi sogs kyi lung byas/ ma ṇi bye ba gsum 'bum gted gnyis/ smyung gnas mchog brgyad gsum/ phyag 'bum gter gsum rnams khas blangs/ khrab mig sngags pa tre bo'i khyim nas zhag gcig bsdad/ sbub cha gcig ting shag gcig phul/ sa lags skal bzang phebs pa la lung phul/ sngags pa rnams kyis khas blangs la/ sangs rgyas dpal lo mtshams gcig gzhan mi 'gas lo mtshams gcig badzra gu du bye ba lnga/ sngon 'gro gtong mkhan lnga/ ma ṇi sa ya gcig bcas khas blangs/ bes mdo dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi sngags pa nyi shu tsam gyis bskyal nas yong / dar grong nas bzhi ba'i bco lnga la gso sbyong dang bde chen zhing dbang bskud/ slob bu dkon mchog non bu ri khrod du song ba la 'al gdams byin/ nag rgya'i chos thog la song / sde ba la chu rdzogs shig bzhag 'jam ༵ rdong gi ma

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ṇi'i sgrub chen steng nas 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/ rdor sems/ bde chen zhing dbang sogs dbang gsum/ gza' dang mgon po/ sngags srung ma/ sngags bdag 'bar ma/ lha mo/dam can rnams kyi srog gtad rnams phul nas chang dud sogs khas blangs byed du bcug nas 'grigs khrims zhib pan bsdams/ sde ba la thugs rje chen po nam mkha' rgyal bo dang sngags pa rnams la phur pa'i dbang phul/ dge steng nas sku phyogs shar sprul sku dang sku phyogs a nol tshang rnam pa gnyis la mjal/ dbyad thog 'brog nas bsdad/ tsha bo zhig skyes pa la kun dga' nor bu zhes ming btags/ khyim gzhi'i a ye dus las 'das par thos grol 'pho ba dge rtsa sogs bsgrubs/ ma du'i ma ṇi'i steng nas 'khon ba dbyings sgrol gyi dbang bskun/tshogs brgya btang / byang chub ma ṇi'i steng nas mgon po/ sngags srung ma/ sngags bdag ma/ lha mo/ gza'/ dam can rnams kyi srog gtad/ tshe dbang / nor dbang rnams bsgrubs/ tsho ba'i seng gdong bsgrubs/ gor gyis nor rnams shi nas mi rtag sgyu ma'i ltad mo mthong / bes mdo'i sngags mang gis 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi ma ṇi'i sgrub chen gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i rgyu mtshan zhu ru slob bu sangs rgyas dpal 'ongs nas lo gsan bad du bsdad/sa ti zab don gyi lung khrid/ rang gi rnam mgur gyi lung byen/chu sprel don lnga'i steng slob bu sangs rgyas dpal la tshe dbang dang rig byed ma'i dbang /sangs rgyas dpal dang 'jam mo'i lha bzo klu 'bum rgyal/ padma rnam rgyal gsum la phur pa'i dbang lung byin/ tshes bcu la spro ba'i tshogs brgya btang / bkra shis 'khyel ba nas sprul sku tshang ri khrod du phebs pa'i skabs zla ba gnyis bsdad/ gun drag gi gtor zlog bsgrubs/dge slong 'ga' la hor mo'i dbang / jo mo rnams la lung gang mang / sngags pa 'ga' la dri med bshags rgyud kyi lung byas/ gling rgya'i zhong za tshang gi skyes pho mo nyis brgya la sa ga zla ba'i sgyung gnas la gso spyong dang chos bshad byus/ slob bu rin chen 'bum na ba la nyi ma bdun la rta mgrin sngags bsgrubs byas pas nad las grol/ bkra shis 'khyel ba nas zla ba gcig la byang sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub gzungs ring 'bum gter bzhi lhag sgrub dus skyabs mgon sprul sku rin po che la tshe dbang dang brtan bzhugs 'di ltan/ tsho dang ye shes mtha' yas tshe dpag med/ /che lo stong phrag thub pa'i blo gros dpal/ /tshe dbang stsol mdzad tshogs drug rang grol rje/ /tshe lha rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis byin chen phobs/ /tshe gcig grub brnyes zhabs dkar spru' ba'i skun/ /che lo mthar phyin snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ /tsho sgrub 'chi med ring gzungs 'bum phrag ba4/ 6 /—— rdzas dang bcas phul ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ / tshe dpag med mgon dgra

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /bcom blo gros ltad/ / tshe srog mi shigs rdo rje ltar brtan zhing / / tsho chos gong 'phel bskal ba brgya khri'i bar/ /tsho ring sku tsho brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /tshe bum lha yi dkyil 'khon sra zhing brtan/ / tshe chang bdud rtsi'i btung ba lha mtshon bskyil/ / tshe ril sman bcud 'chi med grub pa'i dzas/ / tshe mda' phyogs bcur g.yab pa'i tshe g.yang bkugs/ / che bsod dpal 'byor dbyan gyi mtsho la 'gran/ /tshe lo grangs med bzhugs nas bstan 'gro'i don/ /tshe 'din myur 'grub sku tshe brtan par shog / tshe yi gzungs ring bzlas pa'i byin rlabs dang / /tshe lha rnam gsum drang sbong grub pa'i mthus/ / tshe ring ma sogs bstan srung rgya mtsho yis/ / che yi rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog / ces phul pas thugs mnyes nas lha rdzas che legs shig bstsal/ sku phyogs dgu nong tshang la 'di phul/ tshe yi lha mchog mgon po tshe dpag med/ / che lo stong phrag thub pa'i blo gros dpal/ / che yi dbang bskur stsol mdzad zhabs dkar rje/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin rnams kyis byin chen phobs/ /tshe gcig grub brnyes sna tshogs nang grol drung / / tshe ring mi rgan snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ / tshe sgrub 'chi med ring gzungs 'bum gter bzhi/ /tshe rdzas dang bcas bkra shis 'khyil nas phul/ /tshe sgrub phul mthus rje btsun bla ma yi/ /tshe sbog 'gyun med mi shigs rdo rje ltar/ /tshe lo brgya phrag du man brtan bzhugs nas/ / che chos ga lha'i rgyun bzhin 'dzad med shog/ tsho lha rnam gsum rig 'dzin grub pa'i mthus/ /tshe ring sbu che bskal brgyan zhabs brtan zhing / /che rabs 'phreng ban 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ / tshe yi rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces lha dzas bcas phul/ ka ring a lags rta mgrin sprul sku phebs par tshe dbang dang lung phul/gdan dkar kha dad phul ba blangs/ tsha bo rgya mtsho mtsho snying dang / brag dkad sprel rdzong /ka chen gangs gsum la song ba yul du 'ongs/ dan grong nas zun gsum bdag mo'i lab tse nyil song ba gzhi brtsigs byus/ drug pa'i nang bkra shis 'khyil bar song / gzim khang gsan ba'i nang lto 'phye'i thig dang bsang brgyag brngan 'khon 'das mchod pa sa bdag 'khrug bcos sogs bsgrubs nas nyi ma bco lnga bsdad/ sbu phyogs tsho 'du'i thug chen rin po che'i zhabs brtan la dge steng nas phur pa'i sgo nas mnan bsreg 'phang gsum bsgrubs/ tshe dbang dang dri med bshags rgyud kyi lung phul/ khong nas rta gcig dngul grang do dā dman kha dan bcas gnang / bkra shis 'khyel bar song / gnyer ba ma bde ban gur drag zlog pa/rta mgrin sngags 'bum gter gsum mdo kha shas sogs bsgrubs/ gzim khang la khrus gsol dang gtor kha spon/ zla ba gcig bsdad/ slob bu sangs spyos dpal yong ༷༷ ba~Xb ga sas/

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo ji'i gsung rtsom rtsogs bsgrigs/smad pa'i ma ṇi sgrub chen la song / sgrub chen gyi phyag len slob rgyu byas/ sngags pa 'ga' la sgrub chen gyi phyag len bslabs/ dan grong nas tshogs brgya dang sbyin sreg blugs/ a lags mkhan po dang grwa ba gsum la gur drag dang ma gza' rdod gsum gyi srog gtad dang lung 'ga' phul/ dong tse khron bzhi ma lug bzhi/ ja mar kha dar bcas phul/ sgo me sprul sku tshang la skyabs mgon rin po che'i rnam mgun gyi lung dang / dud khrod ma'i srog gtad phul/ dom ral gcig dang dngul srang gang phul/ padma bstan 'dzin gyi phung bo ma bde ban rta mgrin 'bum gter gsum dang gtod zlog 'chi med ring gzungs 'bum gter/ bka' thang rgyas pa dang bsdus pa brgya tshar/ bar chad lam sel brgya/ gcod pa nyis brgya/ phal bo che tshan gcig sogs bsgrubs pas bde/chu bya don drug steng lo gsan la tshe dbang dang / zho bong la kha'i sngags pa gsum la lung kha shas bgyis/ rjes nas seng gdong 'bum gter gyi sgos mnan pa dang gton zlogagacod pa brgya/ phal bo che/ gnam sa snang brgyad brgya/ gser 'od tshar gsum/ klu 'bum dkar po sogs bsgrubs/ dad grong nas gling rgya'i sde ba gsum gyi sngags mang gi chos thog bzung / slob bu sangs rgyas dpal yong nas gtor ma sogs kyi nogs byas/ zur nas seng gdong bzlog pa zhig bsgrubs/ bsod nams 'bum lo mtshams grol nas mjal du yong ba la bslab bya byus/ rwang khyim nas sel dkar zhig bsgrubs/ lnga ba'i nyer lnga la tshogs brgya bsgrubs/ la kha'i sngags pa gsum la sde brgyad srog dbang dang lung 'ga' byas/ drug pa'i bcu gsum nyin sku phyogs bses tshang nas bka' shog dang sna rta khyer 'ongs nas/gter lung du song / dgon pa'i nub na nyag khel gyi sa dgra yod pa la rigs gsum mgon po'i mchod rten brtsigs nas bcad/ dgon pa'i mdo nas rdo 'bum brtsigs/ sde ba che chung dgu la gted sgrub dang sa bcud gsos/ g.ya' ri'i rtse nas lab tse brtsigs/ srog shing 'dzugs dus 'brug grags nas rten 'brel 'grigs/ sku phyogs kyang phebs nas dga' ston byas/ bla brang nang nas gur drag gi sgo nas mnan pa bsgrubs/ sde ba la mgon po tshogs bdag btsugs nas dgra mnan dang dgra lha bstad/ sku phyogs nas cod paṇa dril gdan phreng ba gos kha dar che legs rta gcig gnang / sgan grong nas dngul grang bcu dong tse khron drug cu bcas khron brgya'i rtsis phul1 hor tshang 'go ba kha gnyis gnam lha 'gab ma'i sngags pa 'ga'/ gter lung gi grwa ba 'ga' bcas la phyag rdor/ gur drag 'khod ba ba rdo~X/— rdor sems/ rta mgrin/ mgon po tshogs bdag rnams kyi dbang /

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /lung mang po phul/ nas ras dā dong tse kha dan mang po phul/ dang yul nas sku phyogs a nol tshang la mjal du yong / ston kha 'jam mo'i sngags pa rnams kyis bos par song / gur drag gton zlog dang tshogs brgya/ ma gza' rdor gsum gyi srog gtad/ a ti zab don gyi lung khrid sogs byas/ thams cad kyis ja zhus dang bsod snyoms phul/ dkar rtse gdong sngags pa rnams la gur drag seng gdong / rta mgrin rnams kyi dbang / sngags srung ma dang /ma gza' rdor gsum sgyu srog gtad/ gu du le'u bdun/ gdugs dkad sogs lhang mang po byas/ bsod snyoms dong tse sogs phul/ tho rgya'i bod skor nas gza'i sku bzhengs pa'i gzungs gzhug dang rab gnas byus/ gud drag klong chen seng gdong / rta mgrin/gsang bdag sogs kyi dbang lhang / lung mang po bton/ bka' brgyad kyi chog bzlog lung /thugs rje chen po'i lung byas/ de gnyes kyi chos rgyun 'dzugs chad byas/ dā dmar gcig dang dong tse khron bcu phul/ sngags pa'i 'dus ra'i steng rta mgrin 'bum gter sgo nas tshogs brgya dang sri mnan bsgrubs/ byang chub ma ṇi'i steng nas tshogs brgya dang sbyin sregadar grong ma ṇi'i steng nas sbyin sreg blugs/ dge 'phel gyi a lags mkhan po dang grwa ba 'ga' la gur drag dang gza'i dbang dang lung byas/ nu bo tshe dbang rig 'dzin sa mthad 'khyams nas yong ba glo bur du shi ba la 'pho ba dang dge rtsa bcos/shing khyi don bdun steng hor tshang nas 'go ba kha gnyis kyi sngags pa bdun 'tshams zhu la yong bar lung 'ga' byas/ bod skor sngags pa rnams kyis lo gsar khyer yong ba la chos bshad/ bkra shis 'khyel du song / sprul sku rin po che la mjal/ sprul sku tshang dang zhal brgya tshang / zhabs drung rgyal bo tshang gi sprul sku nged rnams kyis yang gsang dang gur drag gnyis nyi ma bdun re la bsgrubs nas 'ongs/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug gi nod bu re sa'i skyabs gnas dgu nong sprul sku sna tshogs nang grol rin po che glo bun du gshegs pa'i gtam ngan thos tshe snying thon 'gro ba lta bu'i mya ngan byus/ bla ma mchod pa'i sgo nas nyid rin po che'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi blangs thugs yid gcig tu bsres/ slar yang bla ma'i sku'i dbyibs gsung gi gdangs thugs kyi brtse ba'i yon tan rnams dran nas gdung dbyangs 'di blangs/ mgon rab 'byams rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku/ /mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i drin can rje/ /pha sna tshogs rang grol rin po che/ /bu'i gdungs pa'i dbyangs la gsan mdzod dang / /spyir 'gro rnam sa nyam thag duḥkhas mnar/ /sgos nged cag slob 'bangs thams cad kyi/ /mi re re'i mgo nas nyi re nub/ /'di gso1 dbye ḍi ma do rje

gas1 /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'chang / /dgung 'od stong nyi zla nub rir yibs/ /bdag rmongs pa'i mun pa su yis sel/ /dbang bzhi yi bum pa glo bun dbral/ / da byin rlabs dngos grub su la zhu/ / khog don snying glo bur nad kyis khyer/ /da snying med dran pa su yis gso/ /rje yid bzhin nor bu lag nas shor/ / da dgos 'dod re ba su yis skong / / de bsam na snying rlung gting nas langs/ /mig mchi mas gang nas lam mi mthong / / ngag gdungs pa'i 'o dod drag po bos/ / 'di gsan nam drin can chos kyi rgyal/ / mgon nyi ma chu lha'i pang mnal yang / / 'din bdag sogs gdul byu rjes 'dzin phyir/ / sku'i yang srid shar ri'i phrag pa nas/ / dus ring min myun du 'byon par mdzod/ /lha bla ma mchog gsum byin rlabs dang / /chos skyong mdzad srung ma'i nus mthu yis/ / rje bla ma'i sprul sku myur byon nas/ / bdag sngar bzhin brtse bas rjes 'dzin shog /ces blangs/ dngul phran bu dang kha dar bskur/ gdung skal la phrug gcig ra sag ka gang lhag kha dar gnyes bcas gnang / de nas sprul sku myur du 'byon pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon byas/ bkra shis 'khyel bad song / zla ba gcig dang zhag bcu lhag bsdad/zhabs drung tshang / sa lags mi bskyod/ rgyul bo'i sprul sku sogs nged cag rnams nas tshes bcu yar mar la tshogs btang / skyabs mgon sprul sku'i zhabs brtan du bka' thang nyer gsum/ 'khor ba dbyengs sgrol gyi rdzas gcig la brten pa'i sbyin sreg 'bum gter/ a lags mi bskyod tshang gi sa las kyi don bsang brgyug brngan btang / tsha bo chung dus a lags bzang po tshang yin zhes kha lab/ sku phyogs a nol rin po che sa dkar shar du phebs dus thugs thag bcad/ khang chung spro mo zhig phub yod pa'i nang nas bla chas bsgrigs/ rgan pa rnams dang gling rgya'i 'grul ba 'gas kha dan btang / de rnams la ston mo gya nom pa byas/sa dkan shar gyi dge 'dun pa dang 'grul ba rnams rang yul du log der 'khod pa rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi gar dang glu la sogs pa blangs nas dga' ston bzang po byus tshe/ rin po che 'di nyid kyi zhal nas ngas sngon chad chos srid gang sgrub kung gegs med bde blag tu thub byung ba 'di skyabs mgon yab sras kyi sku drin yin/ deng phyin chad khyed rnams tshos lugs gnyis kyi byu ba gang byed kyang bla ma dkon mchog la blo rtse gtod dang bsam pa'i nang ltar du 'grub yong / nga'i bkra shis kyi glu 'di la nyon cig gsungs nas/ bla ma gcig chog de skyabs mgon zhabs dkan/ / byin rlabs gzhan la re dgos ni med do/ / rgyal kun 'dus zhal bdag nyid khong yin no/ / bla ma bzang po de'i bkra shis shog shog / yi dam gcig chog de ba du~X brgyad/ / dngos grub gzhan la re dgos ni med do/ / zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha

rang rnam rin chen zeng ba bzhugs so/ /mchog de yin no/ /yi dam bzang po de'i bkra shis shog shog /chos skyong gcig chog de skyes bu rdon legs/ / 'phrin las gzhan la re dgos ni med do/ / mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal shugs can yin no/ / chos spyong bzang po de'i bkra shis shog shog / 'di ltad brjod pa'i rnal 'byod nga'i skyid pa/ / skyid pa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad la bkra shis/ / bkra shis dpal gyis dus kun tu 'tsho zhing / / zhing mchog lnga du 'brel thogs kun skye shog / ces blangs pas thams cad dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de ltar gsang gsum gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas shing / bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gyi don la rab tu gzhol ba/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i mkhas grub chen po 'di nyid skyabs mgon zhabs dkan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs sras kyi mchog tu gyur cing bka'i bsdu ba mdzad pa po/7nyang mtshams snang mdzad rdo rje zhes grags snyan gyi ba dan dkar po rgyang na g.yo ba gang de'i rnam thar rin chen zeng ba 'di ni skal ldan slob ma rnams kyis yang yang du bskul nga'i ngo ma ldog pan rwags rim tsam zhig dam pa nyid kyi thugs gsang dpal gyi be'u nas thon zhing phyag bris 'khrul med du bkod de/ rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams kyi gtsug nor dam pa du bsnal ba'i bka' drin ni bla na med pa'o/ /sbras pa/ rgyal kun 'dus zhal snang mtha'i nol ba mchog / bee no'i sgyu 'phrul gar mdzad rigs brgya'i bdag / rdo rje 'dzin pa sbas pa'i ngang tshul can/ / bka' drin 'khor med mgon khyod gtsug na rgyal/ / phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ / mtha' yas 'gro la dga' ston 'byed pa'i gsung / /zab yangs rgya mtsho'i 'jings ltar dpag dka'i thugs/ / rje btsun bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'dud/ / skyabs mgon dam pa'i thugs gsang kai la sha yi lhun po las/ / legs 'ongs gsung 'bum sna tshogs chu klung 'bum phrag du mar bcas/ / rnam gsum dad pa'i sor rtses yur ba bzang por legs drangs nas/ /tsista ka yi rdzing bur bsgyil byed bka' yi bsdu ba po/ /nyang mtshams zhes grags mgon de'i gsung gsang zu gter chen po 'a sa/ / thon pa'i rmad byung mdzad bzang rin chen do shal mtshar sdug pa/ / gang gis mgul bar 'chang ba'i dpal 'phreng g.yo ba'i gzi 'od la/ / rnam sad sgeg mo'i rgyun gyis bsgrun nus min zhing bstod bsngags brjod/ / de ltar mdzad bzang 'od ris can/ /gdul byu gsen ri'i phrag gong nas/ /yongs shar thun gsum mthar byas te/ /bstan 'gro'i pad tshal bzhad gyun cig /de phyir lhag bsam ri bo bsgril ba las/ /legs byas dbyungs gsal 'od dkar zer zeng gis/ /'gro blo'i yid kyi ku mud rab brtas shing / 1bde skyid bcud bzang zhim mngar 'phyur bar shog /de mthus skal ldan bhra ma ra yi tshogs/ /zeg rtse'i bcud kyis rtag par rab sgyus te/ / tshogs gnyis 'dab rgyang chos dbyings dag pa'i mkhan/ /don gnyis lhun grub 'phur lding rtsen gyur cig /gzhan yang mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa zhi/ /tsho nor chos kyi rgyul khams bde zhing 'tsho/ /snying po'i bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyas1 /phun tshogs dpal la nol ba'i bkra shis shog / — 51 —

ces gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po nyang gi mtshams pa zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi rnam thar rin chen preng ba'i mjug gi smon tshig 'di'ang / gang gi zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i tha shal ba ma ṇi'i ming gis bris pa yongs su dge ban sgyun cig / sarba mad ma/

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /nyang skyes sngags pen snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ /nang dang ska' mnyam spro ba bskyed pu'i phyin/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khon lo'i rdza rnga sgrogs/ /nyams mtshan phyin du nyon dang sko' ldan tshogs/ /

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ra / /na mo gu du/ stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / zhi ba chags bral mdo sngags dam pa'i chos/ / tshogs kyi zhing gyud 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ /bka med dkon mchog gsum gyis dge legs stsol/ / chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems/ /sprul sku pad 'byung gten ston brgyud pan bcas/ /rtsa gsum chos srung tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin drug pa rdo rje 'chang / / snyigs dus nang gzhan sbon grol lam 'god pa'i/ / skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu'i zhabs pad la/ /yang dang yang du gus pas lan brgyar 'dud/ /padma ku na'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog / nang grol lam bzang ston mdzad drin can rje/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis btud de phyag 'tshal lo/ / sngon byon dam pa'i rjes su kha mig yan/ 1 bltas nas bya rgod lad mo byi'u rngung bzhin/ /dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa'i glu dbyangs 'ga'/ /'di ru spro la gnang ba'i skabs dbye zhig / snyan legs tshig gi sdeb sbyor ma mchis shing / / mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs dro1rdo sdi rnyi la / ya/nga / /rang 'dra'i blun po spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /rtsom nyog tshig gi zeng na mo gu du/ byin rlabs 'byung gnas bla ma dang / / dngos grub sten ba'i yi dam lha/ /bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro dang / /'phrin las sgrub pa'i chos srung la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags/ / mdzad spyod kun la rjes yi rang / / chos kyi 'khod lo bskor bar bskul/ 1mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs 'gro kun yongs la bsngo/ /e ma rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs/ /bdag gis glu dbyungs blangs tshod kyis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba thams cad la/ /phan thogs 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon byon gong ma thams cad kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir glu dbyangs blangs/ /de phyir bdag 'dras nyams spro phyid/ /dge sgrub sdig spong byed tshul dang / / rang dang gzhan la bslab bya'i mthil/ / ston phyin tshigs su bcad pa 'ga'/ / 'di du phyogs gcig yi ger 'god/ / nang slob rnams kyis ba du ༵/—/'di ltar bris pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /dpal ldan bla mas rjes su bzung / /

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ / 'gro la phan thogs 'byung par shog / ces pa pa'o /ya/nga nyang skyes sngags ban bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am snang mdzad rdo rjes bkra shis chos gling nas sbyar gnas spyi gtsug 'ja' gur 'od klong na/ / skyabs kun 'dus tshogs drug rang grol bzhugs/ / bdag sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bu bdag gi shes rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / mi bdag dang bdag 'dra'i nyams chung rnams/ / blo rtse gcig chos la phyogs pa 'di/ /pha drin can bla ma khyed kyi drin/ /drin che bar nges so bla ma rje/ /bdag 'di phyi ban do thams cad du/ / thugs brtse bas ma 'dor rjes su zungs/ / pha sku drin 'khon med bla ma la/ /lus grangs med sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ / nang lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs 'bul/ / tshe thog med nas bsags sdig lhang bshags/ / mgon dam pa'i mdzad par rjes yi rang / / dus rgyun du chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ / nang gdul bya grangs med 'dul don du/ /sku g.yo med brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /dge 'dis mtshon rnam dkar legs byas kun/ / ma 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob phyid bsngo/ / rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /khyed ma gtogs re sa gzhan na med/ / dus rtag tu thugs rjes brtser dgongs la/ / chos snyan brgyud zab mo'i dbang bzhi skur/ / mchog thun mong dngos grub char ltar phobs/ /zhes dī 'di pa ya rdo shā nga mdzad sbyo sna sa bri ༈/ra/ / nyams rtogs pa 'chan ban byin gyis zlobs/ /mgon rab 'byams rgyal ba 'dus pa'i gzugs/ / mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i drin can rje/ / pha tshogs drug dang grol snying nas dran/ / bdag gus ldan bu la brtse bas dgongs/ /bdag nyams chung byis pa'i dus nas bzung / / dbang bka' drin stsal ba'i drin po che/ /mgon padma rang grol dun gyis dran/ /bus chos bzhin nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /pha bla ma zung gis bskyangs pa'i bu/ / bdag dge slong bstan 'dzin spyo mtsho yis/ / spyir 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa log /sgos nam 'chi cha med snying nas dran/ /che 'di snang blo yis gtong 'dod kyang / /dus re zhig rten 'bre' dus ma 'dzoms/ /sa grong las dben pa'i ri khrod 'dir/ / bdag yun ring sdod 'dod yid la shan/ / rje skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs bkod dang / / sa reb kong sngags mang 'go 'dren du/ / dus da lta mtshams kyi dam bca' bzung / / dus rgyun du nang gi dge sbyo ra dang / / nyin ltar gyi ka ton byed rgyu la/ / nangs snga bar chos spyod yig brgya brgya/ /tshe sgrub dang gu du sirnyi stong / /bsam lhun sogs dge sbyor sngar rgyun dang / 1 rang spros med bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs/ / sems rang ༷ ༵dī ri1 skyong

sa / nyang skyes snang mtshud rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba dang / / gzhan brgya rtsa la sogs tshogs bsags byas/ / rje bla ma'i phyag dpe sdeb 'ga' re/ / bris tshar 'phror gsan ma'i chos spyod dang / / le'u bdun sogs kha 'don bsgrigs tshad bklags/ / lha yi dam 'ga' yi cho ga dang / / chos srung gi gtor bsngos rgyas pan btang / /gzhan mdo sgrol gdugs dkan gcod dmigs dang / / ma ṇi yang stong tsam chag med byed/ /mtshams 'di'i ring nang du chud rgyu la/ / mgon skyabs rje'i sku don sgrub mkhan dang / / dang snying nye'i gnyen dang mched grogs sogs/ / dmigs bsal gyis chud pa ma gtogs pa/ / nang gang yin rnams la ngo mi thug / don gal chen bla ma'i sku don dang / /gzhan rten bzhengs chos thog bla ma'i bka'/ / de ma gtogs grong chog rang don dang / /don med pa'i don la 'gro mi bya/ /dang bsdu dngos rnam bzhi chos spyod bcur/ /don mthun pa'i bya ba ci nus sgrub/ / chos mthun gyi grwa ba slob 'dod la/ / rang 'khos dang mthun par gang phan bya/ /gsung 'bum dang glegs bam 'gangs can rnams/ / dad mos kyis bklags shing don la bsam/ /chos skyong dang dkar phyogs skyong rnams la/ / bsangs gser skyems bsngo zhing 'phrin bcol byed/ / dus kun tu rang sems ngo bo skyong / / skabs 'ga' rer rdzogs chen sngon 'gro nas/ /dngos gzhi rnams khrid bskyar bag chags 'jog /gzhan slob 'dod rnams la de ltar slob/ / de ltar gyi dam bca'i glu dbyangs 'di/ / sngon byon gyi gong ma'i phyag sbol lags/ / mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /yi dam gyi lha yi bden pa dang / /chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i mthu nus kyis/ /de don bzhin gegs med 'grub pad shog/bag med kyi bya bar mi g.yeng bar/ /bag yod kyi brtson 'grus brtson par shog /chos min gyi byu ba mi byed par/ / chos sbyod pas nyin mtshan 'da' ban shog / dam sdom la ngo lkog mi byed par/ /dam tshig rnams sbog bzhin bsrung bar shog /yun thung gi bad chad mi 'byung bar/ /yun ring du sgrub pas 'da' bar shog / tshe 'di yi shom rar mi 'gro bar/ / tsho phyi ma'i sa lam sgrub par shog / theg dman gyi rang mthong mi che bar/ / theg chen gyi 'bras bu thob par shog / sems can rnams sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i phyir/ / sems bskyed kyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar shog / snyeng rje yis gzhan phan sgrub pa dang / / snying bo yi gnas lugs rtogs par shog /sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin nyams blangs nas/ /sangs rgyus kyi go 'phang smras/ thob shog / ces pa 'di yang mtshams la 'dug dus bkra shis chos gling nas snang mdzad rdo rjes ——e ༵ 6ho/— mgon nab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sku/ / pha bla ma tshogs drug rang

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /grol la/ /bdag sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / gnas phun tshogs nyams dga'i dben pa nas/ / nga rnal 'byon dga' ba'i glu dbyangs len/ /skye dka' ba 'dzam gling mi lus thob/ /mjal dka' ba skyabs mgon gser zhal mjal/ /thob dka' ba rdzogs chen gdams pa thob/ /dang bskal pa bzang po'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /bsrung dka' ba so thar sdom pa bsrungs/ /lon dka' ba bla ma'i gdams ngag lon/ /shes dka' ba rgyu 'bras 'don len shes/ /rang bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /pha bla ma yab sras zhabs pad bsten/ /gsung zab mo bsdu ba'i skal par ldan/ /chos gsung 'bum glegs bam mang po bris/ / rang las ldan tshogs bsags 'bras bur gda'/ / rten bzhengs pa du ma'i zhabs tog sgrub/ / 'gro nyam thag nad par phan mang btags/ / chos dge rgyun sgrub chen gsar du btsugs/ / 'di bsam na bskal pa shin tu bzang / /mgon bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs kyis zin/ /de'i nang nas skyabs mgon zhabs dkad pas/ / thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung ba 'di/ / dus gtan gyi 'dun ma'i yang rtse lags/ / nyams dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje spun/ / rang dga' spyid 'dzoms pa'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /mtshams bcad rgya'i thun gseng blangs pa'i dges/ /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog / ces pa'ang snang mdzad rdo rjes so1 /rje rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sbu/ / mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i sku drin can/ /pha bla ma tshogs drug dang grol la/ / bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas khyad 'phags bkra shis chos gling 'dir/ / bdag da lo 'dug rgyu'i bskal pa ldan/ /mgon dam pa'i gsung bzhin bsgrubs pa'i mthus/ / mi bdag gi bsam don chos bzhin 'grub/ /lo me rta gsar bzhad tshes nas bzung / / mtshams bsnyen sgrub byed khul mdzad na yang / /gnas ri khrod 'di yi chan mi nye/ /dus da ltar bag phebs snang ba spro/ /rang nus tshod kha ton bzlas brjod las/ /gnas 'di du mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ /blo las su dung 'di bla ma'i drin/ /nyams dga' zhing spro ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /gnyen nye du 'khor ba'i 'ching thag rnams/ /kha gso byed grong tshog phor kha dang / /rang las don bya bzhag la sogs pa/ /deng skabs 'dir spangs pas blo re bde/ / sems 'gyu ba mang du 'phro na yang / / rang phan med gnod med rjes ma zhugs/ / sems gsal stong rjen par bzhag pa'i che/ /gegs gol sa med snyam blo re bde/ / gnas phyogs med 'grims pa'i skal dman yang / / sa grong las 'das pa'i ri khrod 'di/ / dus da lo bsten rgyu byung ba yi/ / rtags rten 'bre~X ka tshe

sa / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/blo re bde/ /rang na so rgas pas gtugs na yang / /mgon yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs kyis zin/ / chos dbang khrid lung gsum grangs med thob/ / dus da lta bsam tshe blo re bde/ /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong snying po'i bcud/ /chos gcig gis sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i thabs/ /khong rgyu bod mkhas grub gdams pa'i mthil/ /chos rdzogs chen thob pas blo re bde/ /dus da nas nam 'tsho'i bar dag dang / / sgos da lo dben pa'i ri khrod 'dir/ / sgom mnyam bzhag kho nar gzhol ba yi1 / rang dam bca' bzung bas blo re bde/ / don de phyid mthar phyin mdzad pa yi/ / rang skyabs 'jug rtsa gsum lha la zhu/ / lha mchog gsum srung ma'i mthu nus kyis/ /rang sbon pa bzhin du 'grub pan shog /yul 'di du nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /kun dam pa'i chos la gzhol ba dang / / ma 'gro kun gnas skabs bde zhing skyid/ / mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa'ang snang mdzad rdo rjes so/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo/ /lung rtogs dam chos kyi 'byung gnas/ / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi mnga' bdag / drin can bla ma la 'dud do/ / dben gnas ri khrod na 'dug pa'i/ / rnal 'byor skyid tshul gyi glu dbyangs/ / mgrin pa cung zad cig btegs nas/ /dga' bzhin spro bzhin du len no/ /dal 'byor mi lhas ni thob nas/ /dam pa'i lha chos dang mjal byung / / da lta chos sgo du zhugs pa'i/ / rnal 'byor nga 'dra yi skyid pa/ /mtshan ldan bla ma yi zhabs zin/ /dbang khrid man ngag ni thob byung / /da lta nyams len la gzhol ba'i/ /rnal 'byor nga 'dra yi skyid pa/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi sogs spangs nas/ /dben par mtshams sgrub la gnas byung / /gu yangs blo bde du 'dug pa'i/ /rnal 'byor nga 'dra yi skyid pa/ / sgyu lus g.yar bo yang 'di nas/ / dge sbyor gang nus re byed bzhin/ /'du shes gsum ldan du gnas pa'i/ / rnal 'byor nga 'dra yi skyid pa/ / gzhan gyi ngo bsrung yang mi dgos/ / rnyed 'tshol sems khur yang mi snang / / rang dbang dang nyid kyis chod pas/ /nol 'byor nga 'dra yi skyid pa/ /nor med dbul po yang ma yin/ /'byod ldan phyug po yang ma yin/ / bar ma sems khur dang bral ba'i/ / rnal 'byor nga 'dra yi spyid pa/ /'dul rgyu'i dgra bo yang mi 'dug / 'jal dgos bu lon yang mi snang / / zas gos mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i/ / rnal 'byod nga 'dra yi spyid pa/ / spyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs nas/ /spyid nyal dben pa 'did byed do/ /skyid 'dod nga dang 'dra yod na/ /spyid kyi nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /bde med 'khor ba na gnas pa'i/ /bde 'dod sems ldan re yod na/ /ba na du bya ba su sdod dang / /bde skyid nyi ma zhig 'chad no/ / zhes pa snang mdzad

rdorje so mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ / sa she/ dag/ gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang / / kha ba can gyi skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rje'i/ / ga la ba der gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / nga cag slob ma'i shes rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /ca co'i g.yeng ba'i 'du 'dzi la gnas shing / / cha lugs wa skyes seng ldags spyon bzhin du/ /ja mar la sogs 'dod yon gang la yang / /nya mo chu la zhen 'dra'i mtshams ming bdag /ta tha ga ta'i bstan pan zhugs lags kyang / /tha chad 'khor ba'i g.yang sar lhung bas skyo/ / da nas bzung ste mgon khyod zhabs drung nas/ / na 'chir bsgugs nas nyams len cis mi byed/ / pa ra mi ta'i nye lam gsang bstan la/ / pha rgan mchog gis thugs khun cher bskyed nas/ / ba lang lta bur blun po'i sngags rlom rnams/ / ma lus 'dren phyir pad 'byung glegs bam zhu/ / tsa ri gangs ri 'grims pa'i snying dus dben/ / tsha grang khyad du gsod pa'i brtson 'grus rnams/ /dza yas gsungs pa ji bzhin dka' mod kyang / /lha len sems ngo 'phrod nges gdams pa zhu/ /zha yi mdog gi grub mtha' gang la yang / /za ma bzhin du spang blang dka' bas na/ /'a 'ur dben pa'i bsam gtan khang ba ru/ /ya mtshan rtags bzang thon nges gdams pa zhu/ / da ltad spyong ba'i sems 'di 'dul thabs su/ / la lung glob man gsungs pa'i bka' chos rnams/ /sha stag 'bad pas nyams su len pa dang / /sa lam myur du bsgrod pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /ha ha blo dman bdag gi zhu tshig 'dis/ /ha cang 'khor ban zhen pa'i sems can rnams/ /a ti yo ga'i lam gyis yongs smin nas/ /ma don skye med rtogs pa'i rgyu du bsngo/ / zhes pa 'di ni skyabs mgon rin po ches khyod kyis ma bsam par myur du phris zhes pa ltar snang mdzad rdo rjes phul pa'o/ /pha skyabs kyi mthar thug rdo rje 'chang / / rje 'gro ba'i mgon po zhabs dkar pa'i/ /zhabs padmo dri ma med pa'i drung / /bdag tha shal slob bus gsol 'debs 'bras/ /bdag khyed kyi bka' drin la brten nas/ /nang 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba las grol te/ 1dus da lta bag phebs gnas pas bde/ 1'di yun ring gnas pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / nang rnam rtog 'phro ba mang na yang / /phyi sgyu lus mtshams la gnas stabs kyis/ /rang kha ton bzlas brjod nus tshod sgrub/ / sems khur med sdod 'di bla ma'i drin/ / yul nang 'khor lan chags 'ded mkhan rnams/ / dkor nag pos kha gso rgyub 'geb phyir/ / rang nang nas bsdad na mi dga' yang / /bdag blo kha skyabs rjes khrid pas bde/ /bdag yid tsam nang nas bsdad pa 'di/ /pha bla ma'i drin las gzhan du min/ /bdag drin lan sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bdag slob bur sgo gsum byen gyis rlobs/ /phran rang la re ltos yon bdag bdu9/ ba/kan

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo ji'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nad kyis gtses tshe rna ba gzir/ / rang skyabs rje'i zhal gsung dpang bzhag nas/ 1 nan drag pos zlog pa lan 'ga' byung / /gzhan na tsha kha mchu la sogs pas/ /mtshams sgrub pa'i bar chad byung ba'i tshe/ / de chos bgegs yin snyam blo ma bde/ 1 pha bla ma'i chos bgegs de las skyobs/ / rje bla man skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i mthus/ / rkyen phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing / / nyams rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba dang / / rang sgrub pa'i spyol mtshan 'dzin pan smon/ /mgon dgu ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / / bdag rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab ༵spyi~Xng/ snang/ hūṃ rdo rdorje lci rdo~X/ srid bya ba kun/ / chos bzhin du 'thub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ /'di phyi'i skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs drung du/ / gus phran slob bu nyang gi mtshams ming nas/ /dad pas lha phyag grangs med 'tshal bzhin du/ /gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad nas dbyings su 'bul/ / da lo las bzang mthu las skyabs rje'i drung / / yun ring brten nas sku tshab ming btags nas/ / stod smad nyul nas bsod stoms do bo brgya/ / 'bul rgyu byung 'di e ma ngo mtshar kad/ /'dir 'bad mthu las tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje btsun bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing / / nyid kyi sku g.yog zhabs tog legs sgrub nas/ / gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms med spyod pad shog / re ltos 'brel thogs tshe 'das tshe ldan rnams/ /'khor kyi thog mar skyes nas dbugs dbyung ste/ / mngon dga' la sogs dag pa'i zhing kams rnams/ / bsgrod pa'i skal bzang mngon du 'gyun bar shog / gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad lhag 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /tshe ring nad med bsam don lhun gyis grub/ / phun tshogs dpal la nol ba'i bkra shis shog /e ma ho/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang / / gang dang dbyed med drin can sprul ba'i sku/ / skyabs su bsten na gtan gyi bde sten ba'i/ / pha gcig mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /mgon khyod sngon nas mngon pan sangs rgyas kyang / /bdag cag ris med 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs su/ /bsam bzhin sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur mdzad pa/ /skyabs mgon dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshogs gnyis mthar phyin drus pa rdo rje 'chang / /rang gzhan rnams la grol byed gdams pa ston/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog zhabs dkar pa'i/ 1 sku tshe bskal brgya'i ban du brtan pad bzhugs/ / dang po ri khrod dben pan skrub pa mdzad/ /bar du stod kyi mnga' ris skon gsum dang / /dbus gtsang du bzhi ༷༷ga~X ༈ ༷༷ don grub/ /drang don rgyu 'bras chos kung mang po gsungs/ /smad kyi mdo

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /khams sgang gsum chos la bkod/ /da lta 'khrungs yul gdul byar gyur pa la/ /phyag mchod zhing sa rten bzhengs bsgyu lhag grub/ /stod smad 'gro don thams cad thub lags pas/ /da ni dang cag gdul bya ma don ban/ /nges don rdo rje theg pa spel bzhin du/ /lo grangs brgya phrag mang por sa phyogs 'dir/ / bzhugs zhes thal mo sbyar nas lan brgyan zhu/ / bdag cag las ldan slob ma lnga bo yang / /skyabs mgon dam pa'i zhabs 'degs brtson pa las/ /ma nabs zhabs 'dren mi byed dam bca' 'bul/ /de'i phyid phyogs 'dir yun ring bzhugs pa mkhyen/ / reb kong phyogs 'di'i skya ser pho mo rnams/ / skyabs mgon dam par bcos min dad pa dang / /gang gsungs bka' sgrub sdig spong dge sgrub mang / /bag med sdig 'phro bcad nas chos dang mthun/ /yul la sngon med bde skyid gsan du byung / /de'i phyir skyabs mgon phyogs 'dir bzhugs pa mkhyen/ /reb kong stod smad sngags pa yod tshad rnams/ /da lo phyogs 'dir bsdus nas chos thog bzung / / pad 'byung sprul ba'i glegs bam zhal phye nas/ /rdzogs chen tshos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa mkhyen/ /mgon khyod ris med gdul bya khyad med kyang / /rang cag me tog phog pa'i lha skal du/ /thob pa lags na phyogs 'dir yun ring du/ / bzhugs pa'i bka' drin brtse bas skyong ba mkhyen/ / de ltar zhu tshig dpyid kyi pho nya yis/ /lha dar 'dab gshog brgyangs nas yongs 'dzin drung / / ge sar rtse nas dar dir sgra dbyungs kyis/ / phul tshe mchid lan sbrang char 'jam po yis/ /bdag sogs dad pa'i zhing sa rab brlan nas/ / nyams rtogs myu gu smin pa'i bkra shis stsol/ zhes pa 'di yang nyang gi rgya mtsho/ dpon po dkar dris/ gnas brtan/ stag yan/ dbu mdzad skal bzang skyabs lngas phul/skyabs gnas kun 'dus rigs kyi bdag po mchog / 'gran gyi do med rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / / mi yi rnam nol gos dkad lcang lo can/ / pha gcig mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i drung / /thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan nab dben cing / / nyon mongs bran khol slob bu'i zhu gsol 'bras/ / gang sbu nam mkha'i non bu rab gsal ba/ / chu 'dzin dri mas ma gos 'gro blo yi/ / mun pa sel bzhin bzhugs pa thos 'dzin gyis/ / tshor bas sems la dga' spro mchog tu 'phel/ / phran chung slob bu bdag kyang mtshams ming du/ / btags rbang rnam rtog lhag ma'i 'od bzhin 'khyug / 'on kyang mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ / dge blo ma dor tsam du bde bar mchis/ / skabs don bdag la nyid kyis bka' stsal bzhin/ / tshe lha zung dang phyag rdod bsnyen sgrub rnams/ / rtags mtshan dang bcas gegs med mthar phyin nas/ /pha gcig khyed kyi drin las gzhan na gang / /da lta rta mchog nol ba dkan ༵ga ka/ /

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bgrang bya gcig tsam gnas kung skyo ngal med/ / nyid nas sku don sgrub phyir bka' phebs rnams/ / tshad mar 'dzin las thugs bkod gang gnang sgrub/ 1 bsnyen sgrub skabs su 'od zer spro bsdu dang / / spyod yul lam du 'khyer tshul zhal gdams shig / mkhyen zhes thal mo spyar nas lan brgyur zhu/ / bdag kung tshe rabs kun tu pha khyed las/ / gzhan du re ba'i skyabs gnas mi 'tshol bas/ /nyid kyi thugs gsang dpal gyi be'u nas/ /nam yang 'dod ba med pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / zhes pa'i zhu mchid 'jo sgeg lus phra mas/ / bgrod pa zung gi gan stabs bsgyun bzhin du/ / mkha' spyod dpal gyi ri bo der song la/ / lha rdzas dang mtshaX ༷sdi1 ༷di ༷'o ban mdzod/ / ces pa 'di yang bla ma padma rang grol rin po cher lo ma—mas na ༵ ༵bye phul tu rdo bye// /'jig rten dbang phyug sems ma'i tshul bzung nas/ / 'gro la tshe yi dngos grub stsol mdzad pa/ / rje btsun sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo dang / / dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla mar snying nas 'dud/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun 'chi bdag g.yul spyol nas/ /arya twa re'i go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo/ / bla ma'i bka' bzhin bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho des/ /lha mo yid bzhin 'khon lo'i tshe sgrub skabs/ / rgyal bstan spyi dang bstan 'dzin tshogs rnams dang / / khyad par bdag gi rigs bdag gtan gyi skyabs/ / drin can bla ma padma dang grol sogs/ / brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs kyi zhabs brtan dang / / dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje mched grogs rnams/ /tshe bsring ched du 'dod don gsol ba'i che/ /rtags mtshan ngo mtshan byung ba'i rten 'brel de/ / pha gcig mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin lags/ / de ltar lhag bsam dag pas kun bslangs pa'i/ / dge ba 'di'i mthus rgyul bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin 'bas brtan mdzad 'phrin gong 'phel nas/ / bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyul mtshan tshugs par shog /mched grongs dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje spun/ /kun gyi dam tshig ngo lkog med pa dang / /chags bral dam tshig khas blangs ltan bsrung zhing / /sngags pas dam tshig srog bzhin bsrung bar shog /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med lus sems bde/ / rang don ring min myur 'grub gzhan gyi don/ / sgrub nus sgrub la skyo ngal med pa yi/ / bla ma'i bla ma ras pa lta bur shog / bdag kung srid pa'i mtsho las yongs bsgral zhing / / zhing gi mchog gyur g.yu lo bkod pan skyes/ / skyes ma thag nas slar yang de ma thag / theg pa dim dgu'i 'gro la chos ston shog / pha nol phyin pa'i don de rab rtogs nas/ / pha ma 'gro drug rnam ba sa ༵༵da kar/ / pha rgod bla ma'i rnam than ltar mdzad de/ / pha nol phyin drug nyams

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /su len pan shog /ma lus 'gro ba'i don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /ma rgan 'gro rnams sangs rgyas go 'phang mchog / ma thob de srid 'gro ba'i don byed cing / / ma rnams don du dka' ba spyod pan shog /bsngo byu'i dge ba 'khon gsum yang dag bsngo/ /smon pa'i gnas rnams myur du 'grub par sbon/ / myur myur smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang po du/ / yang yang gsol 'debs bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ / mang mang 'khor ba'i mtsho las rab bsgral te/ /bzang bzang zhing khams rnams su bsgrod pan shog / ces bris tshe lha mo'i ming gis dkar skyems phul bas rten 'brel 'grigs pa lags/sku gsum 'dus zhal rje rigs kyi bdag po mchog /mchog gsum rtsa gsum gyi bdag gi bla ma rje/ /rje btsun mi pham mgon spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /bzhugs nas mchog thun gyi dngos grub rgyu mtshor bsnyil/ /gang thugs thugs bskyed kyi mthu las bstan dang 'gro/ /skyong mdzad mdzad bzang gi pha rgan bla ma rje/ /bu yis yi rang gi gsol ba lan brgyar 'debs/ /rab lhar lhar ba ru byin sgyus brlab tu gsol/ / rab mdzes byu du yi lhun po dang mtshungs shing / /rab snyan gsung dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i ngag sgrib 'dag /nab gsal thugs rje yis 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba yi gsang gsum ngo bor rdzogs/ /gsal gsal 'gro ngo du shan ba'i bla ma rje'i/ / zab zab gdams pa yis bdag blo'i pad tshal bzhad/ /mang mang rtags mtshan gyis yid la dga' spro shar/ / yang yang gsol ba 'debs thugs rje'i che dbang stsol/
