/gcig tu dam tshog dang sdom pa srog bzhin bsrung / /gnyis su bla ma rje bsam sbyod gnyis kyis bsten/ / gsum du ci gsungs kyi bka' bzhin gus pas sgrub/ /bzhi du bsnyen sgrub dang gzhan don sems bskyed bsgom/ / 'di ko zeg chen gyi lta ba yin pas so/ / so skyes nang don sgrub byed dang 'di mi 'dra/ / 'dra zhes smra ba zhig yod pa bdud kyi rigs/ / rigs kyi bu rnams sems bsam blo thong dang shes/ / kun mkhyen padma 'byung dbyer med bla ma dang / / kun bzang che ba'i mchog yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ / kun gyi bka' gter skyong bstan srung mthu byen gyis/ / kun bzang nang lugs skyong tshogs rnams zhabs brtan shog /padma 'byung gnas sogs sngon byon dam pa'i sras/ /padma'i rang lugs skyong grol byed gdams pa'i mdzod/ /padma rang grol zhes mtshan snyan phyogs 'gengs pa'i/ /padma kā ra yi rnam 'phrul zhabs brtan shog / padma'i mtshan can gyis rjes bzung slob bu mchog/ mchog gsum thugs rje yis bsam don lhun gyis grub/ / grub mchog rje ltar mtshungs 'gro khams rgya mtsho rnams/ / rnam kun mchog ldan gyi go 'phang 'thob nus shog / ces 'chi bdag g.yul rgyal bsnyen pa'i smon tshog tu padma lhun grub rgya mtsho'am bstan 'dzin rgya ༷༷sa 6gci ༷༷/ /

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rnam 'dren 'dren mchog thub dbang nye ma'i gnyen/ / de sprul sprul ba'i zlos gan padma 'byung / /gang 'dul 'dul dka' 'dul mdzad blo bzang grags/ /rnam gsum gsum ldan co ba'i bla ma mchod/ /blo gros bzang po'i gzhung lugs bstan 'gro'i don/ /don de 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mnga' bdag mchog / mchog gsum kun 'dus rgyal ba'i zhal skyin rje/ / rje btsun mtshan snyan srid na mdzes den 'dud/ / gang sbu 'pho med rdo rje chos bdun du/ / du ma'i 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa'i ched/ / ched gnyer chen pos ngal ba dang du blangs/ /blang go chod pa bu dam shing ba'i bka'/ /bka' 'gyur zhes grags klog pa'i skal ldan gyur/ /'di ko 'dun ma'i yang rtse bla ma'i drin/ /drin de gzhal phyir bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yis yi ge lhag chad med pan gus pas bklags/ /bklags pa'i dge bas yongs 'dzin zhabs brtan shog / gangs can ljongs 'din bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i bka'/ / gang yod bdag gis bkags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ / gang la gang 'dul de ston mtshan ldan mchog / gang de'i zhabs pad bskal brgyun rtag brtan shog /thos bsam non gyis phyug pa'i dge 'dun sde/ /sde sgod gsum sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom pa rnams/ /rnam pa kun tu ri mor byed pa dang / /dang du len rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang shog / kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i bka'/ /kha ton byed cing sa phyogs 'gro rnams kyi/ / kha lo bsgyun zhing 'gro kham sa rgyu mtsho rnams/ / kha tsam min par dge la spyod pan shog / bzang bzang smon lam zab mo 'di btab mthus/ / mang mang pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ / zab zab rgyal ba'i bka' la 'brel thogs nas/ / myun myur sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog / ces pa 'di yang rdong bo nas bka' 'gyun bton dus su bris/mchog thun mong dngos grub gter gyi mdzod/ 1 pha bla ma zhabs dkan rdo rje 'chang / /mgon grub dbang padma rang grol rje/ /bdag mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs yab sras rjes su bzung ba'i bu/ /mi kho bo bstan 'dzin rgyu mtsho yis/ /chung gzhon nu'i dus nas chos sgon zhugs/ /las bya ba gang yang chos ltar byed/ /rje bla ma su dang mjal na yang / /der sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes yod/ / chos 'bri 'don tshegs med khong du chud/ / lo bco lnga'i steng nas rab tu byung / / mtshams bsnyen pa la yang 'dug khul byas/ / pha skyabs rje padma nang grol zhabs/ / lo brgyad kyi steng nas mjal ba'i tshe/ / dpe ma bu 'phrad 'dra'i dga' spro skyes/ / thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung / / mgon dpal chen nam mkha' ba du 4 ༷/la/ /gsung snyan mos rjes su 'dzin par mdzad/ /pha ras pa dam tshig rdo

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /rje nas/ /khyod gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis shig gsungs/ /gzhan gsar rnying bla ma du mar mjal/ / dbang lung khrid mang po legs par thob/ / lo nyer lnga'i steng nas bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ /chos 'dul ba'i bcos khrims dka' na yang / /dang chung nas mi tshangs spyod pa spangs/ /dus da bar khrims ldan gtsang mar gnas/ /da mi thub snyam pa'i dogs pa med/ /bdag byes pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar/ / lo gcig dang zla ba 'ga' zhig la/ /mtshams bsnyen sgrub mdzad dus thams cad du/ /lha 'jam dbyungs bzlas pa bye ba gcig /yang sgrol dkan tshe sgrub bye ba gcig /rje las rab tshe sgrub 'bum gted brgyad/ /yang badzra gu ru bye ba gcig /gcod khros nag bsnyen pa 'bum gten 'ga'/ /ma rig byed dbang mo bye ba gcig /lha rta mgrin bsnyen pa sa ya gcig /dus rgyun gyi bsnyen pa grangs ma bzung / /gzhan bka' brgyad drag 'dul lo ka dang / / bdud 'dul dang dbyangs can phur pa sogs/ /thams cad la las dung 'bum phrag lhag / phyag yig brgyu skyabs sems 'bum phrag dang / /lo bcu la brgya rtsa chag med bsngos/ /dus rgyun du yig brgyu brgya re dang / /tshe sgrub dang badzra gu du stong / / kha ton gyi glegs bam chag med bton/ / mdo thar ba chen po brgya tshan gsum/ /'bum tshar lnga rdor gcod stong tsho gnyis/ /tshos sna mang klog dang smyung gnas bcu/ / rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgyu mtsho'i drung / / chos bka' 'gyur zla ba gsum la bton/ /gzhan nus tshad kha ton grangs ma bzung / /mgon 'od dpag zhing mdo dngul gyis bris/ /sku 'bum khang bdun dang ma ḍi bzhengs/ /gzhan 'dra sku 'ga' sogs rten bzhengs dang / / lha khang dang ma ṇi mchod rten bzhengs/ / rje bla ma rnam gsum mnyes pa'i phyir/ /gsung glegs bam po ti mang po bris/ / gzhan yon bdag mang por bskul nas su/ / sku tsha 'bum so lngar sbog shing bris/ /rten bzhengs pa mang por gzungs 'bul sogs/ /rang nus tshad tshogs bsags las la bskul/ /sdig spyod pa'i skye bor rgyab kyis phyogs/ /grogs mched rnams thabs kyis dge la bskul/ / lo so gcig skyabs mgon gser zhal 'jal/ / mgon de yis zhabs pad bsten nas bzung / / chos dge sdig blang dor cung zad shes/ / dus da lta rang lo so drug skebs/ /rwang dge med sdig med ngang du gnas/ /da tha mal dbang du mi 'gro bar/ / chos tshul bzhin nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /spyol ba 'od dpag med dang dbyer med pa'i/ / dpal ldan bla ma spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnams bde ba can du drongs/ /'od dpag med kyi zhal bzang mjal bar smon/ /mi nga nub cig nyal ba'i dri lam na/ /rgya dmag lta bus ded dī~X 'jigs

ga / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dngangs byung / / sa phyogs cha med bros nas bar dor slebs/ / shi bar ngo shes las kyi rlung gis ded/ /dmyal khams brgyad du lhung la khad kyi tshe/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab/ / rang sems ngo bo bskyangs pas de las than/ / mgon po 'od dpag med la gsol ba btab/ / bde ba can gyi zhing khams yid la byas/ / ri ngos kyen la song bas shug nags khrod/ / dgon pa shin tu mdzes pa mthong ma thag / bde ba can gyi zhing kams yin bsam nas/ /sgo nas ma bud glo sgor bud nas song / /rin po che las grub pa'i khang bzang la/ / byu du'i dra mig yod pas de nas bltas/ / khang ba'i dbus su rma rgyas btags pa'i khrir/ /mgon po 'od dpag med pa mngon sum bzhugs/ /sku mdog dmar po chos gos rnam gsum dang / / sngon po'i bla gos gsol zhing dkyil drung bzhugs/ / g.yas g.yon sems dpa' gnyis ka dge slong gi/ /rnam par bzhengs nas bzhugs pa mthong ba'i mod/ /rab tu dga' nas gsol ba btab pa'i tsho/ /'od dpag med mgon bzhengs nas dra mig thad/ /phebs nas dra mig ban nas phyag brkyangs nas/ / bdag gi mgo la bzhag nas gsung byon nas/ /da reb phyir song rjes nas yong chog gsungs/ /sems dpa' g.yon mad 'di la tsho ril gnong / /gsungs tshe maṇḍal steng nas pad rag gi/ /lhung bzed chen po btegs nas nga'i lag tu/ / tshe ril gnang che rlangs pa thol le 'dug / nga yi khan zos no bcud mngar ba byung / / lhag ma bzung nas phyin la yong bsam tsho/ / bla ma'i gdan sa bde ba can du gyur/ /bar do'i snang ba shar nas 'jigs pa'i tshe/ /'jigs rngams can gyi mi zhig 'ong nas su/ / shing rta'i steng bzhag 'ur sgras gnyid sad byung / / de ltar ya mtshan can gyi rmi lam bzhin/ / bdag sogs zhing khams de du 'gro bar shog /gnas dben pa'i gnas su grub pa brnyes/ / pha bla ma skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang / /bdag sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ / mchog thun mong dngos grub char ltar phobs/ /mgon dam pa'i zhabs kyis bcags pa'i sa/ / ri yer ba lta bu gnyis pa yi/ /gnas khyad 'phags pad dkar chos gling 'dir/ / bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'di ltar 'bul/ /shar lha ri dung seng gnam 'phyong 'dra/ /su bsdad kyi rtogs pa mtho ba'i brda/ /lho yu zun khyim bdag 'byor ldan 'dra/ / nyams rtogs pa'i yon ston rgyas pa'i brda/ / nub rmog pa byu du'i lhun po 'dra/ / phyi snod bcud dbang du bsdu ba'i brda/ / byung brag dkad bla ma gdan bzhugs 'dra/ /ting 'dzin la rtse gcig gzhol ba'i brda/ /mtha' skon rnams 'du ba 'bye ḍi 'dra/ /rig 'dzin gyi 'du ba rgyas pa'i bad/ /mdun gyi thang maṇḍal bshams

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /'dra la/ / dkar ser gyi me tog sna tshogs bkra/ / ljon shing dang lo tog tshad du dngar/ /mtha' bskor rnams bkra shis rtags kyis spras/ / nye 'dabs kyi grong sde mchod bshams 'dra/ /'did gnas la 'tsho ba 'bad med 'byung / / de ltar du yon tan rab tshang ba'i /gnas khyad 'phags ri khrod 'din bzhugs na/ / rtags rten 'brel e ma ngo mtshar che/ /chos mdzad rnams rgyun du gnas 'din bzhugs/ /grong yul las ring ba'i ri khrod 'din/ /nyon mongs rnams rim gyis nyung ba dang / /dge sbyor sogs gong 'phel bag yangs 'gyur/ /don de phyir chos mdzad gnas 'dir bzhugs/ / nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan gong du 'phel/ /bcos min gyi nges 'byung skyo shas dang / / dad pa dang mos gus tshad med skye/ /don de phyir chos mdzad gnas 'dir bzhugs/ /gnas bdag mchog lha ri dkar po yis/ /'dir bzhugs kyi mgon skyabs sdong grogs byed/ / don de phyir rgyun du mchod pa na/ /'phrin las kun sgrub par the tshom med/ /de ltar du bstod pa'i rnam dkar dges/ /gnas 'di du sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ / nyams rtogs kyi myu gu gsad du 'khrungs/ / don gnyis kyi 'bras bu smin pan shog /yul phyogs 'din nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /tshe bsod dang dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyus/ /bkra shis dang bde spyid dpal gyis 'tsho/ /dus kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog / ces lha ri'i mtshams khang pad dkar chos gling nas bsdad dus lha ri bla ma'i tshul gyis sman khug zhig gnang nas kun la byin ces smras pas/ sngags 'chang gnam lha byums/rin chen 'bum/ rin chen rgyal/ dpal lo sogs kyis bskul ngor snang mdzad rdo rjes smras/rgyal kun mkhyen brtse rta bdun gzi 'od kyis/ /rgyal bstan pad tshal skyong mdzad ni ka ka/rgyul dbang ye shes rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /spyol ba'i bstan pa rgyas pan byin gyis rlobs/ /bod kyi gnas chen thams cad zhabs kyis bcags/ / bod yul kha lo chos la bsgyur mdzad pa'i/ / bod kyi skyabs mgon tshogs drug rang grol rjes/ / bod khams bde zhing sgyid pa'i bkra shis stsol/ /e ma ngo mtshar rin chen gsang phug 'di/ /mkhas grub du mas zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas/ / rgyab ri shel dkar lhan po mkha' la bsnyegs/ / sgrub brgyud bstan pa srid rtser bsgreng ba'i brda/ / g.yas ri brag dkar bla ma gdan bzhugs 'dra/ / ting nge 'dzin la g.yo ba med pa'i brda/ / g.yon ri yu zur khyem bdag 'byor ldan 'dra/ —/ 'dir gnas 'tsho ba 'bad med 'byung ba'i brda/ /mdun ri rmog pa byu du'i lhun po 'dra/ /khams gsum skye 'gro dbang du bsdu ba'i brda/ /ri ngos bkra shis rtags kyi mtshan mas spras/ /bkra shis dge mtshan rgyun du 'byung ba'i brda/ / ri phran du mas 'khor yug kun nas bskor/ /gnas 'din rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgyus pa'i brda/ / 'dabs na grong sde1 lo du 7 sdod du

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dngar/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gong du 'phel ba'i brda/ /mdun na nyal 'gro'i rgyun chen dal gyis 'bab/ /thugs dam dge sbyor rgyun chad med pa'i brda/ /'di ltar yon tan kun tshang dben gnas 'di/ /phyi nabs las ldan rnams kyis sgrub pa'i gnas/ /sngon dus mkhyen brtse sprul sku'i gnas sgo phye/ /phyi ltad nu ṭa'i khog pa lta bu la/ 1nang ltar dkyil 'khor brda don rtags gsum tshang / / gsang ba dur khrod brgyad kyi pho brang mtshungs/ / bar du skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rin po che/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs nas spyod 'dre thabs kyis btul/ /yul khams dkar po chos kyis bde ban bkod/ / sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs/ / da lta skyabs mgon bka' ltan gsar bzhengs tses/ / mtshams rgyun btsugs nas 'chad med sgrub la brtson/ / kun gyi blo kha chos la phyogs pa 'di/ / skyabs rje dam pa'i drin las gzhan du ci/ /de phyin dben gnas rin chen gsang phug 'dir/ /thog man yul nas yong dus sems bskyed kyi/ / gzhi bzung 'dug dus gnyid rmugs le lo spangs/ 1dge sbyon brtson zhing mjug tu bsngo sbon mdzod/ / sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs dngos gzhi khyegs chod dang / / thod rgal lam gyi myur lam la brten nas/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs dam pa/ / dben gnas 'di ru sgrub dang skal ldan rnams/ / grong yul lo mtshams bsdad las dben gnas 'dir/ / zhag gcig bsdad la phan yon dpag med yod/ /dben gnas bsam nas gom pa bdun spos na/ /sa bdun thob ces sngon sgyu rgyal bas gsungs/ / de ltar bsnyen sgrub brtson 'grus 'di phyi'i don/ / 'bad med nab 'grub lag rjes bzang po yis/ /phyin chad gnas 'did mtshams kyi dge rgyun tshugs/ /snyan grags ba dan dkar po phyogs bcun g.yo/ /phyi rabs mos ldan rnams kyis mtshams rgyun 'dir/ /do dam gang drag byus nas dus rgyun du/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa gnas pa'i thabs dam pa/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin 'bad pa gal re che/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje dang / /gnas bdag lha ri dkan po'i mthu stobs kyis/ /gnas 'dir sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i g.yang chags shing / / bkra shis dpal gyis dus kun 'tsho bar thog / de skad smra ba nyang skyes ral ba can/ /bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos thol byung tshul du smras/ /dge bas gnas 'dir sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ / yul khams bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /gnas dben par nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs/ / mgon grub dbang tshogs drug rang grol rje/ / steng spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ / bdag mos ldan slob mar byin ba stso~X8/ ba/kan grub chen dran pa nam mkha' yis/ /tshe gcig la thub pa thob pa'i sa 1

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /byang gung mo'i gur khang zhes grags pa'i/ / gnas 'di ru bstod bsngags me tog 'thor/ /brag rin chen sna tshogs brtsegs 'dra'i ngos/ / gsung yig 'bru rang byon zhabs rjes sogs/ /ngo mtshan ba'i ltad mo sna tshogs bkra/ /de mthong ba tsam gyis dang pa 'dren/ /ri'i rtse mo lha lam bsnyegs pa 'dra/ / nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan mtho ba'i brda/ / brag kha dog sna tshogs 'ja' ltar bkra/ /mchog las bzhi'i 'phrin las 'grub pa'i brda/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis dar dkar 'then pa 'dra/ / bdud ban chad dgra las rgyal ba'i brda/ / bkra shis rtags kyi mtshan mas spras/ / bkra shis dang dge mtshan 'byung ba'i brda/ / shug pa dang rtsi shing me tog rgyas/ /chos sgrub rnams 'byor ba rgyus pa'i brda/ /gnas de yi gzhi bdag chos la dkar/ /de rnal 'byor 'phrin las sgrub pa'i brda/ /de ltar du ngo mtshan rmad byung ba'i/ /dben gnas 'dir sngon byon grub thob kyis/ / byin phab cing grub pa'i mtshan ma brtes/ /sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srol bzang btsugs/ / de'i rjes su gser khang rdo rje 'chang / /mgon zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang gnyis kyis/ /gnas 'di du mtshams khang mang po bskrun/ /mchod pa dang mtshams rgyun gsar du btsugs/ / phyogs ris med rnal 'byor du ma yis/ /mtshams sgrub pa byas nas nyams rtogs 'khrungs/ / gzhan dad gus che ba'i pho mo rnams/ /gnas 'di du phyag mchod gnas 'brel zhog /gzhan ri khrod las kyang gnas chen 'dir/ /'brel thogs na dge ba gong 'phel 'gyun/ / gnas 'di yi lha dang srung ma la/ / bsangs mchod gton phul dang 'phrin las sgrub/ /gnas 'di nyid bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /gnas 'di du sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar/ /gnas 'di la 'brel ba thogs tshad kun/ /gnas bde ba can du skye ban shog / yul 'di ru bkra shis g.yang chags shing / / kun chos dang mthun ༵dzad rje spyo rje 1 spyan ba'o/ / / 'di ni gnas der bsdad tshe mtshams pa dge 'dun nor bus bskul ngon snang mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi gten mdzod rje/ / drin can bla ma tshogs drug rang grol la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gnas 'di'i gang zag la/ /byin rlabs char chen 'bebs pan mdzad du gsol/ / sngon dus o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis/ / bod yul sa phyogs thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ / sa nong btsan po rnams su sgrub gnas mdzad/ / de ltar rma klung dben pa'i gnas mchog 'di'i/ /ri dbyibs seng ge gnam du 'phyong ba 'dra/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mtho ba'i brda/ / shan gyi paṇa ri shel dkar brtsegs pa 'dra/ /'jigs brgyad la sogs bar chad zhi ba'i brda/ / lho ri g.yu 'brug gyen ba gro ༵ 'a1/ /

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/snyan grags mnga' thang legs tshogs rgyas pa'i brda/ / nub ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ / snang srid brtan g.yo dbang du bsdus pa'i brda/ / byung ri lob po gnas sgo bsrung ba'i tshul/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe ma lus bsrung ba'i brda/ / 'dabs na rma chu chad med 'bab pa de/ /sgrub pa po la yo byad 'dzoms pa'i brda/ / mdun na chu bo 'o ma'i rgyun 'bab 'dra/ /byin rlabs dngos grub 'dzad med 'byung ba'i brda/ / de ltar yon tan kun tshang dben pa 'di/ /chos mdzad sgrub pa po yi bsten pa'i gnas/ / 'di ru sgrub pa mdzad rnams tshe 'di du/ /smin cing grol ba'i rten 'brel ngang gis 'grub/ / dben pa bsam nas gom pa bdun bor na/ /sa bdun thob ces rgyal ba'i bka' las gsungs/ /de phyir dben gnas 'di du 'dug pa'i dus/ / sems skyed ngang nas tshogs bsogs dge sbyon sogs/ / rnam g.yeng le lo'i dbang du mi gtong bar/ / brtson 'grus drag po'i sgo nas 'bad par mdzod/ /'din gnas lha dang chos srung gzhi bdag la/ /tshogs dang bsang mchod phul na 'phrin las sgrub/ /de ltad byas na nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / /mthar thug sangs spyos thob pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /gnas 'di cung zad bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ / sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i g.yang rnams 'di ru 'khyil/ / rang don mthan phyin gzhan don lhan gyis grub/ / phun tshogs dpal la nol ba'i bkra shis shog / ces mgur chung mtshams khang padma chos rdzong gi gnas bstod 'di ni/ ma lags snanga~X dzad rdo rjes bris/'a nor bu gnyis dang / mgur chung stong skor gyi sngags pa rnams kyis bskul ngor pha skyabs kyi dam pa rdo rje 'chang / / mgon tshogs drug rang grol gtsug na rgyal/ /bdag slob bu'i chos 'go mthar phyin nas/ /don gang bsam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus da lo sa pho sprel gyi lor/ / rje bla ma'i lung gis dbugs dbyung nas/ / gnas dben pa bkra shis chos gling gi/ / rten lha khang bzhengs rgyu'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ / rang nyam thag nyang gi khyem tshang bzhi/ / rgyu dngos po bu lon blangs nas su/ / sems rgya bskyed brtson pa'i las khun blangs/ /rten gtsug lag khang 'di legs par grub/ /nang sku rten drug pa'i ches bcu'i nyin/ / gdan drangs tshe ma nyams legs par 'grigs/ / pha skyabs mgon dam pa'i sbyin rlabs kyis/ /sngar bzhengs pa'i lha khang las kung lhag /las sgrub mi kha grangs nyung na yang / /sems dad pa'i nang don bzhag nas su/ /shugs bskyed nas legs par bzhengs pa'i tshe/ / bgegs bar chad med par lhar du 'grub/ / 'di'i dge bas rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /pha bla ma'i sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan/ /chos sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /ba na ḍi~X da gams gnas par shog / gnas 'di du 'du tshogs rab 'phel zhing / /

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /las rab 'byams 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / / de'i mthun rkyen legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /dus dbyur gyi mtsho ltan 'phel bar shog / rten gtsug lag khang 'di dad pa yis/ / lus bkol nas sa shing khun ba dang / /rdo brag bshig la sogs 'bad pa rnams/ /tshe 'did bde phyi mar spyid par shog / sgos lha khang 'di la 'brel thogs rnams/ / dpal o rgyan padmas rjes bzung nas/ / dus gnas skabs tsho ring nad med cing / / nor longs spyod 'dzad pa med par shog / dus ma 'ongs skye ba phyi ma du/ / zhing bde ba can dang padma 'od/ / rang gang 'dod rnams su skyes nas kyang / /ma 'gro rnams de du 'dren par shog /phyogs kun tu nad mug 'khrug rtsod 'i/ /char dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /kun dam pa'i chos la spyod pa dang / / dus rdzogs ldan dpal la 'gran par shog / mgon o rgyun chen po'i byin rlabs dang / / pha tshogs drug nang grol byin rlabs kyis/ / gnas 'di du bkra shis g.yang chags shing / / dus gtan du bde zhing spyid par shog / ces pa 'di ni skyabs rje'i bka' ltar lha khang thub tshe snang mdzad rdo rjes smras/kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab dang / / shrī seng ha lo rgyan padma dang / /dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma dam pa la/ / dngos po kun gyis btud de phyag mtshal lo /brgyud pa de las 'ong ba'i gsang sngags chos/ / spel mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon po zhabs dkan rje/ / padma rang grol kun bzang stobs ldan dbang / / mi 'bral spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ / sngon smon las kyis 'brel ba'i da lta'i dus/ / 'brel dam gcig gis bsdus pa'i hor tshang gi/ /'go ba kha gsum sngags pa tshogs rnams la/ /nyang skyes rgan pos rgyangs nas 'phrin 'di 'bul/ / rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i dal 'byon rten bzang thob/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan dang mjal/ / smin byed dbang dang gdams pa thob dus 'din/ / dam pa'i lha tshos sgrubs shig sngags 'chang rnams/ / dge sdig 'bras bu so sod smin tshul la/ /bsam nas sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa dang / /las 'bras rnam dbye legs par shes gyur nas/ /nang rgyud legs pad thul cig sngags 'chang rnams/ /lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ / ci gsungs bka' sgrub mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten/ / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sgrib sbyong tshogs bsags dang / / bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgoms shig sngags 'chang rnams/ / dngos gzhi khregs chod thod rgal nyams blangs nas/ / snang bzhi mthar phyin tshe gcig sangs rgyas pa'i/ /khyad chos rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len la/ /'bad rtsol gyis la sgoms shig sngags 'chang rnams/ / khyad par sngags 'chang gong ma'i lag rjes rdo/1 〈/ rnam

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dkar chos rgyun phyag rdor chos thog dang / /gsar 'dzugs gu du drag po'i ches bcu sogs/ /mi nyams gong 'phel mdzod cig sngags 'chang rnams/ / chos thog skabs su nang don dka' tshegs dang / / nom g.yeng le lo'i dbang du mi gtong bar/ / sems bskyed bzang po'i sgo nas phebs pa dang / / gral nas 'grigs lam rtsis shig sngags 'chang rnams/ / na bza' dmar po ḍa drol zhwa gos sogs/ /'grigs shing skal ldan dang pa 'dren pa dang / /chang dud g.yang gzhi bsngos sha la sogs pa/ / tshogs nas dug bzhin spongs shig sngags 'chang rnams/ /mdor na kun gyis tshos bzhin sgrub gyun na/ / rgyal rnams dbyings nas dgyes shing bdag kung dga'/ /chos srung rnams kyis 'phrin las sgrub pa sogs/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'thub po sngags 'chang rnams/ / de ltar lhag bsam dag pa'i slob bu rnams/ / chos la bskul ba'i glu dbyungs 'di blangs dges/ /gsang sngags bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /mang lag da ༵nā pa'o/ ga pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang hor tshang 'go ba kha gsum gyi sngags rnam 'dren 'dren mchog thub dbang nyi ma'i gnyen/ / de'i sprul sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / /gang gdul gdul bya sgrol mdzad min byon pa/ /pha gcig gcig chog mi pham mgon por 'dud/ /sngon sbyangs sbyangs pa'i blo gros kun mnga' zhing / 1mkhyen dpyod dpyod pa'i pad tshal nab tu rgyas/ /'dren mchog mchog gi dpon por mnga' gsol ba'i/ /snying grogs grogs po gang de'i zhabs pad drung / /rnam g.yeng g.yeng ba'i mal na blun sgom gyi/ /sngags bgrang bgrang bya'i mtshams nas des zhu 'bras/ / rab zab zab dgu'i man ngag drang sbong gi/ /rgyun 'khyed 'khyed bde sor mo'i 'du byed kyis/ /myud bskrun bskrun pas bris nas phul ba 'di/ / rab brtson brtson 'grus drag pos nyams su longs/ /'jam bde bde ba'i mal du phur tshugs sdod/ /nam yang yengs med bla mar gsol ba thobs/ /rtsa bsnyen bsnyen pa chu bo'i rgyun ltad bsgrongs/ / bstan srung srung ma'i gsol mchod 'bad pa mkhyen/ / zhu mchid mchid 'dir dgos pa chung na yang / /snying grogs grogs po dge la bskul ba'i phyir/ /nyang ban ban chung rgya mtsho'i ming gis phul/ / dge mtshan mtshan mas grogs la phan par shog /rab tu dben pa'i ri khrod gnas mchog tu/ / rab zab rdzogs chen don la gzhol ngos nas/ /rab dkan ras gzhi'i ngos la lha sku rnams/ / rab tu bzhengs mkhas sngags 'chang chen po'i drung / / phran chung chung nas 'brel ba'i mtshams ming nas/ / dab dad dad pa'i ba gas 1༵da ༷di gsol/ / gang sku sku mchog shel gyi a dar sha/ / nyon sgrib sgrib pa'i

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /g.ya' yis gos min par/ /bstan don don chen 'bad pas sgrub ngos nas/ /bzhugs zhes zhe sa'i sor bcu snying kar zums/ /skabs don skabs 'dir nyid kyi lag rjes dang / /rjes 'jug rjes su yi rang skye ba'i phyir/ /lha yi lha mchog sdug bsngal rang grol gyi/ /sku brnyan sku grangs bcu dang bla sku sogs/ / gang 'tshams gang gi thugs bkod ji bzhin du/ / mkhyen zhes mkhyen pan sku gsung thugs mkhyen no/ / mang mang sngon du 'brel ba bzhag rnams la/ /'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i zhal ras bstan pas na/ / snyan snyan da res lan tshig gsungs pa zhig / yang yang gsol 'debs thugs rje mi chung zhu/ / zhes pa'i zhu mchid na chung lus phra mas/ /snyan 'jebs glu dbyungs len bzhin dbang ldan phyogs/ /brtul zhugs mchod pa'i 'a ༵ rdo/ ḍi~X phal// / bsgrod pa zung gis gar stabs bsgyur te thal/ / 'di yang lha bzo dus gsum sangs rgyus ma lus 'dus pa'i sku/ / 'gran gyi do med thub dbang 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rgyal ba 'od dpag med dang dbyer med pa'i/ /pha cig padma rang grol gtsug na rgyul/ / skye mang gong nas sbon lam 'brel ba yi/ / mched grogs bris pa mkhar lo snyan gson dang / / sgrub brtson padma lhan grub rgya mtsho yis/ / rang cag 'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad la/ / bsam glo zhib tu btang nas dpyad pa'i tshe/ / mi rtag yid brtan mi 'dug sdug bsnga la rgyu/ /'di las thar ba'i sa mkhan dkon mchog gsum/ / ma gtogs gzhan na med pa'i tshul bsam nas/ /dam pa'i lha chos sgrub la yid re spro/ /tshig re tsam yang bskal brgyar rnyed dka' ba'i/ /thub pa'i gsung nab thar ba chen po gnyis/ / sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum dang bcas khyed rang nas/ / rin po che yis bzhengs pa e ma ho/ / da yang 'od mtshan stong 'bar rgyal ba yi/ / zhing mdo rin po che yis bzhengs pa rmad/ / 'di ltan bgyis pa'i dge bas rgyal bstan dan/ / bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde gnyis 'phe' dar rgyas/ / bdag cag rnams kyi don gnyis lhan gyis 'grub/ / phun tshogs dpal la nol ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang snang mdzad rdo rjes bris1na mo gu du/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ / ras pa dam tshig rdo rje/ /'bral med spyi bor bzhugs la/ / byin rlabs dngos grub chan phobs/ / ye ma ban chung khyod la/ / phan pa'i gros shig 'debs ya/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rje la/ /rgyun du gso' ba thob cig /co ba'i bla ma'i bka' bzhin/ /bsnyen sgrub la'ang brtson cig /dal 'byor snying po lon tshe/ /mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du/ / tshul khrims rnam dag srungs la/ / mtha' du thon par mdzod cig/phyag skon sgrib sbyong la sogs/ /gzhon dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /brtson pa dag ༵ snrod pa/ /

gas1 /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnad du bsnun par mdzod cig /tho nangs snga bar longs la/ /bla ma'i nol 'byor bsgom dus/ / bla mar gsol ba thob la/ / dbang bzhi legs pan longs shig / rta mchog nol ba la sogs/ / yi dam lha yi bzlas pa/ / lus sbyin mang nyung ci rigs/ / 'chi rag bar du ma skyur/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal nas/ /khyod rang grwa sar ma 'dug /mtshams pa legs po gyis zhes/ /gsungs la khyod kyis mnyam zhog /rang kha nang gi glen tshog /smras pa yid la zungs dang / / 'phral phugs kun tu dge legs/ / bkra shis mtshan ma 'byung nges/ /zhes pa dang / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs/ / pha gcig grub dbang 'khor lo'i mgon po/ /drin can padma rang grol zhabs la/ /'du 'bral med par gus pas 'dud do/ /nyang skyes ban chung lhun grub rgyu mtshos/ / rang gis rang la gros 'di bsnyad do/ / ma yengs rna ba'i bdud rtsir longs shig / da lta'i tshe thung dgun nyi lta bu'i/ / ngang tshul soms la da nas tsho phyed/ / gnyid la ma gzad dge sbyor 'bongs shig / phan pa'i snying gtam dang po yin ya/ /da lta'i mi rnams 'dre la 'dre gtam/ /kha la nyan na log pan 'khrid pa'i/ /ngang tshul soms la sdig grogs ma bsten/ / phan pa'i snying gtam gnyis pa yin ya/ / da nas bzung ste 'chi nag bar du/ /blo snying brang gsum bla ma ma gtogs/ /khrel med mi la blo rtse ma gtad/ / phan pa'i snying gtam gsum pa yin la/ / da nas rdzogs pa chen po'i lam la/ /slob dang 'chi khan 'gyod med nges pa'i/ /g.yo sgyu khram gsum sdig sbyod ma byed/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bzhi ba yin ya/ / de 'dra'i snying gtam rig byed chu bo/ / ban min sngags min chu 'dzin gseb nas/ /dbyad rnga'i sgra chen gtsug phud can la/ /phan par bsam nas bris pa dge'o/ / zhes pa 'di gnyis padma lhun grub rgya mtshos rang lo bco lnga'i steng nas bris/ /bde legs stsol mdzad bla ma rje/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bde med 'khon ba'i sems can la/ / bde skyid 'byung bar byin gyis zlobs/ / bde ba'i 'bras bu dge ba zhes/ /bde legs gzhi gcig bla mas gsungs/ /bde gshegs rgyul ba dgyes pa'i lam/ / bde chen byang chub sgrub la spro/ 1 bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu/ / bde smon la sogs kha ton dang / /bde ldan zhing bkod mdo la sogs/ /bde lam myur lam nyams su longs/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro 'dod na/ / bde ban gshegs pa'i gsung rab ltos/ / bde skyid 'joms pa'i jag rkus sogs/ /bde ba med pa'i sdeg las spongs/ /bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ / bde skyid kun 'dzoms dben pa bsten/ / bde rnams lha chos byas las 'ong— / /ka 4 blda dod na dam chos sgrubs/ / bde sgyid nyi ma 'char bar nges/ / bde ba'i

mgur rtsags bzhugs so/ /dpal ster bla ma lha/ / bde gshegs rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ / bde legs bkra shis 'byung gyun cig /nab 'byams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don la mkhas/ / nyes skyon dam sel dri mas ma gos btsun/ /thugs rgyud bzang zhing 'gro ba'i skyabs gyur pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs kyi padma'i drung / / sdug bsngal gsum gyi 'byung gnas 'khor ba'i mtshor/ / dab zhen 'du shes gsum ldan slob bu yis/ / khyed drung mngon phyogs thal mo sbyan nas su/ / zhu tshig ma rdo na yi 'phreng ba 'bul/ / gang sku rta ljang dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor la/ / nyed 'che chu khur phra mos ma sgrib pan/ / 'od snang 'bum du 'byed nas bstan 'gro yi/ / pad tshal skyong bzhin bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ / skyabs 'og snyom las bdag kyang 'du ba stoms/ / dge blo ma dor tsam du khyod drung phyogs/ /skabs don phyogs 'di'i slob bu thams cad la/ /brtse bas gzigs nas chibs bsgyur gnang ba dang / /gsang chen chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa zhig /thugs la dgongs yod mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag rje/ / slad mar gang sku rdo rje chos bdun du/ /brtan pad bzhugs nas gsung 'jin ga lha'i rgyun/ / bdag blo dad pa'i zhing sar rab nong ༵ ngan ༵ pha/la/ / nyams rtogs myu gu 'khrungs pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / 'di ni sku phyogs dgu spyan )sa gzigs dbang 'gro mgon zhabs dkar pa'i/ / thugs kyi sras mchog bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /'dzin chags med par dam pa'i rnam thar skyong / /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i bshes gnyen drung / /phyi du chos pa'i gzugs kyi tshul 'chos mkhan/ /nang du rnyed bkur lhun len khram pa dngos/ / gyi na'i ngang la tsho shor rgan po yis/ / sor bcu spyi bor bkod de gsol 'debs 'bras/ 1mi shes shes rdzus gzhan gyi mgo bo bskor/ /ma grol grol rdzus gzhan la chos bshad byas/ / rnam g.yeng g.yeng bas ngang la mi che zad/ / rab rmongs rgongs pa bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ / dam pa khyed nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ / ri khrod 'grim nas nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs/ / deng dus spros med ngang la smra bcad gnang / /de la bka' drin che zhes yi rangs 'bul/ /nyid sku gar bzhugs zhing khams yin pa'i phyin/ / reb kong phyogs su phebs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ / re 'bras don ldan zhal chen gnang ba mkhyen/ / skyabs rje ni ka ka la snga sor yang / / zhabs tog phul ba legs kyang da dung yang / / gdan sa bkra shis 'khyel du bzhugs nas kyang / / don dam zhabs brtan 'bul ba'i bka' drin skyongs/ /slad mar gang sku mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i ba/ 75/bsdig pa

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brgya khrir g.yo med brtan bzhugs nas/ /bdag sogs thugs gsang dpal gyi be'u nas/ /dī~X/ yang 'dor med gnang ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / zhes pa 'di ni ya lags nor bu tshang la ༄ rab yangs mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin dkrigs/ / nab mang 'gro la phan bde'i chan chen gyis/ / rab legs myu gun bde ba'i dpal ster ba'i/ / rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus gzugs mkhan chen drung / /nab gus mtshams ming 'dzin pa'i slob 'bangs nas/ /rab tu gus pas lha phyag dang bcas te/ /rab legs tshig gi me tog lag thogs nas/ /nab gdungs sems kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'bras/ /gang sku sku mchog ri dbang lhun po la/ /gzhan phan phan bde bsdu bzhi'i bang rim brtan/ / rab mdzes mdzes pa'i nyams rtogs nyi zlas spras/ / legs bzhugs bzhugs nges thos pas bdag yid spro/ / 'di na na tshod yol ba'i mtshams ming bdag / bdag 'dzin 'dzin pas dab bsdams grong yul kun/ / kun nyul nyul yang rang mgo ma thon lus/ /lus sems sems khun che ba'i ngang na gnas/ /mang mang 'byor ba rgyas pa'i yul de nu/ / bzang bzang chos srid 'grub pa legs mod kyang / /yang yang drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan 'dir/ / mdzes mdzes zhal bzang ston pa 'phyis lags so/ /deng dus dus kyi rgud pas mnar ba'i 'gror/ /mi bzod bzod dka'i duḥkhas nab mnar yang / /mgon skyabs skyabs mgon dam pa bzhugs skabs dang / /ma rgan rgan mon dgongs nas myun phebs mkhyen/ /'din gnas ral khur ldan pa'i sngags mang yang / /yang dag rnam dkar chos rgyun 'dzin pa dang / / deng dus khyed la zhabs brtan 'bul bzhin gnas/ /gnas tshul zur zhus ltan lags thugs 'dzin zhus/ /rlabs chen tshogs bsags la sogs sngad mu bzhin/ / rgyal chen rten 'brel 'grigs dus brtson pa dang / / sgrub chen 'di la mkho ba'i yo byud rnams/ /brtse chen thugs nas mi 'don skyabs 'jug zhu/ /don sgyu gtso bo ma rgan 'tsho gzhes skabs/ / skabs su gang bab 'khon tshogs dang bcas 'dir/ /'dir gnas bdag cag rnams kyi mgon skyabs su/ / su yis bshol yang mi gsan phebs pan zhu/ /myun lhar phyogs 'din ma phebs phyir bshol na/ /dung dung brtse ba'i ma rgan dus 'das tshe/ / yang yang phebs kung thugs skyo'i rgyur nges pas/ / bzang bzang gsol ras bsnams nas phebs grogs mkhyen/ / dge ldan bstan la zhabs tog sgrub mkhan mang / /gsang sngags bstan la gzigs mkhan dkon pas na/ / sngags mang bstan la dgongs nas gso' ra~X ༵gas/ /bsnams nas bstan la bya ba byed du phebs/ /slad mar bdag sogs

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /rnam byang thugs gsang nas/ / rgyun man mi 'don brtse bas rjes dgongs nas/ / pha mar gyur pa'i 'khrungs yul gdul lha yi/ / bla mar dgongs nas phebs pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zhes pa'i zhu 'phrin 'phrin gtam lus phra mas/ /snyan 'a rjebs glu dbyangs dbyangs bcas khyed drung du/ / lha dan che ril ril bu lag thogs nas/ / bgrod zung gar stabs stabs bden bsgyun te thal/ / stobs tshang rgya nag pa la phul/rgyal kun snying rje'i nang gzugs pad dkar 'chang / /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' zhabs dkar pa/ / rgyal ba'i yang sprul sna tshogs nang grol rje/ / rgyal mchog yab sras rnam gnyis spyi bos mchod/ / sngon byon grub dbang yang sprul rnam gnyis la/ / sngon rabs dam pa'i rnam than ji bzhin du/ / sngon sbon las kyis 'brel ba'i mtshams rgan ngas/ / sngon du phyag byas bslab bya tshig 'ga' 'bul/ /dam pa khyed gnyis sngon bsags 'bras bu bzang / /dam gtsang mkhyen nab phul byung dus skabs 'dir/ / dam chos zab mo nyams su len pa dang / /dam sdom lhod du ma 'jug snying gi gtam/ / da res chos kyi rten 'brel 'grigs dus 'dir/ / da lta gzhon dus lha chos myur du sgrubs/ / da dung phyi bshol le lo rab spangs nas/ /da nas brtson 'grus rem dgos snying gi gtam/ /yang dag rten bzang thob pa'i dus 'di du/ / yang zab rdzogs chen nyams su ma blangs na/ / yang yang rten 'brel 'grigs pa dka' bas na/ /yang ma lam du ma gtong snying gi gtam/ /chos kyi spyan ldan bla ma'i rnam than bzhin/ /chos brgyad spangs nas nyams len gnang gyud na/ /chos kyis 'gro ba kun la phan pas na/ /chos dang mthun par mdzod cig snying gi gtam/ /ma rnams don du byang chub sgrub pa'i tshe/ / ma rab nag chang la sogs ma spangs na/ / ma dad log ltas gzhan don mi 'byung bas/ /ma kad chos mthun mdzod cig snying gi gtam/ /mang mang bla ma'i gdams ngag thob dus 'din/ /nges nges rtse gcig chos la gzhol gyun nas/ /bzang bzang 'gro don zhor la 'byung nges pa'i/ / myud myur nyams su longs shig snying gi gtam/ / pha rgod bla ma'i zhabs pad zin dus 'din/ / pha nol bla ma 'tshol dgos mi 'dug pas/ / pha non bu yis len bzhin gdams pa zhus/ /pha no' gzhan la spel dgos snying gi gtam/ /'di 'dra'i 'chal gtam dgos pa med na yang / / yang sprul rnam gnyis dge la bskul ba'i gtam/ / gtam 'di phul bas tshe nabs thams cad du/ /du ma'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i bkra shis thog / ces pa 'di yang ma lags dgu steng dang ma lags bstan 'dzin nyi ma gnyis la phul/ka dag chos sku'i rang zhal ston mdzad pa'i/ / kha ba can gyi skyabs ba phyog ba

ra / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdorje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i/ /ga la pa der gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /nga yis grogs la dge ba'i gsal 'debs byed/ /ca co'i g.yeng ba thams cad nab spangs nas/ /cha lhags btsun pa'i tshul 'dzin ri khrod pa/ /ja rkyang 'thung nas dge sbyor byed pa la/ /nya mo chu la zhen khyod snyan gson dang / /ta tha ga ta'i bstan la zhugs dus 'dir/ / tha chad mi dge spangs nas dam pa'i chos da ltar rang la yod dus sgrub nus na/ / na 'chi'i gtug dus mi 'apyod blo re bde/ / pa sangs ltan dkar snying rje phan sems kyis/ / pha ma 'gro drug don du dka' spyad mdzad/ / ba lang lta bun blun pa'i nyam thag 'gro/ / ma lus sgrol phyin theg chen sems bskyed mdzod/ / tsa ri lta bu'i dben gnas khyad 'phags nas/ / tsha grang khyad bsad sgrub pa lhur blangs na/ / dza ya'i byin rlabs rang sems chos sku du/ /wa ler mthong ba gsang sngags khyad par chos/ zhwa yi mdog gi grub mtha' gang la yang / /za ma lta bur spang blang ma byed pan/ /'a 'ur dben pa'i gnas su dag snang sbyongs/ /ya mtshan chos kyi snying bo de las gang / /na ltan spyong ba'i sems nyid 'dul thabs chos/ /la lung kun tu brgyugs kung mi rnyed pas/ /sha khrag 'bad pa'i dge spyor byed pa'i gnas/ /sa phyogs gcig gis tshugs na gtan 'dun 'grub/ /ha ha 'di ltar gdams pas grogs mched kyis/ / ma don chos sku myur du rtogs par shog /'di ni sog tsha'i ri khrod pa sangs rgyas rin chen la gdams pa'o/ /grangs med gong nas mngon pan sangs rgyas kyang / / ris med skye 'gro'i mgon du shar ba yi/ / zla med bla ma tshogs drug rang grol la/ / g.yo med sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /nyang skyes rgan po bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yis/ /skal ldan las 'phro ldan pa'i snying gi bu/ / dge slong dge 'dun non bu gang de la/ / phan pa'i snying gtam yi ge'i lam nas 'bul/ / khyed nang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgo du zhugs/ / pha yul pha ma blos btang bsnyen par rdzogs/ / da ltad dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba du/ / skyabs rje'i drung nas 'dug rgyu'i skal ldan gyur/ /de yi don po tshe gcig sangs rgyas pa'i/ /thabs su nyams len gnad smin cis mi mdzad/ / ri dwags bzhin du bag med ri khrod nas/ / mi tshe gzad las pha ma'i drin bsab phyir/ / pha yul dge sbyon byas na cis mi chog / de phyir pha yul spangs pa'i lag rjes su/ / nyin mtshan med par sha stag nyams len rems/ / lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas/ /dngos gzhi sems ngo skyong tshul thug gi bar/ /sngon nas spyangs 'bras da lta spros med kyi/ / gsal stong rjen pa'i dga' ston myong bar mdzod/ / de yi lam rtags ba mi) ༈da bye dang / / 'gro la phan pa'i thabs tshul la sogs pa/ / sngar bas brtson pa

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /che bar mdzad pa sogs/ /dam pa'i rnam thar bzhin du skyong bar mdzod/ /don med sa las dpe blta la sogs pa/ /nyams len gegs kyi dbang du mi gtong bar/ /rig pa nang gnas bsam gtan rjen pa 'di/ / rim gyis skyong dang tshe gcig sangs spres 'gyur/ / pha rgan bdag gis tshe lhag 'di nyid du/ /nyams len byed khul dam bca' bca' nas su/ /dben gnas ri khrod bkra shis chos gling nas/ / bu yis dge ba'i lcags 'debs phul ba lags/ /'di yi dge bas bu yi bsam don 'thub/ / chos 'go mthan phyin dang gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ / mthar thug 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur bar shog / bkra shis dge legs sarba mgi ma/ / 'di yang lha khang mtshams pa dge 'dun nor bu la gdams pa'o/ /skyabs kun 'dus tshogs drug rang grol la/ / /bdag sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ / rje grub thob gong ma'i sprul sku la/ / snying thag pas bslab byu tshog 'ga' 'bul/ /sku dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i ljon shing la/ /rje gong ma'i mtshan gyi 'bras bu brjid/ /nyams rtogs pa'i kho lag cher rgyas par/ /deng bsngags brjod me tog 'thor la spro/ /mgon dam pa'i thugs bskyed yid bzhin non/ /yongs bstan pa'i lha dza'i rtsed bkod che/ /chos zab rgyas dgos 'dod 'beb dgos phyin/ /mi bdag gis dad pas kun bslangs nas/ /dbang rjes gnang lung sogs phul ba'i 'bras/ ltam thun mong sngon 'gro'i rgyud spyangs nas/ /chos rdzogs chen don la gzhol ba gal/ / phyi lta ba mkha' ltar mtho na yang / / nang sdom gsum gtsang na snyigs dus 'dir/ /mi skye bo thams cad dad pas na/ /rang sbyod lam zhib pa gal re che/ /gzhan phyogs med 'gro don gnang ba'i che/ /thugs brtse ba snying rjes kun bslangs nas/ /chos dbang lung khrid gsum la sogs pa'i/ /blo chos la bsgyun ba gal re che/ /don snying bo lam rim blo sbyong dang / / lha'i bsnyen pa rdzogs chen nyams len sogs/ / rang rgyud dang 'dres nges rab brtson nas/ / rgyud chos dang mthun pa gal re che/ / tshul 'di ni sprul ba'i sku mchog la/ /ban mdo med snang mdzad rdo rjes yis/ /gnas padma lhog nas phul ba'i dges/ / mchog gsang chen bstan pa dan bar shog / ces pa 'di ni ka ring a lags rta mgrin sprul sku rin po che la phul ba'o/ /rgyal dbang padma'i rnam 'phrul 'gro ba'i mgon/ / rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag gsang bstan gyi/ /rgyal mtshan tog gis mngon pad mtho ba yi/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs dpal ldan bla ma'i drung / / rab nyung nyang gi sa du skyes pa yi/ / rab blun bgrang bya'i khur gyis non pa yi/ /nab dman sa nas son bcu chos 'khor zums/ / rab tu dad pas gi sag7 byeng ༷༷da

gas/ lhang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'bul/ /gang sku rta bdun bdag po'i gzi 'od kyis/ /gang 'dul padma'i tshal yangs dab bskyangs ngos/ /gang gi gsung shog rgya yang ma nyams par/ /gang gi gsung skyes gdong nas spyi bor 'byor/ /'di na na tshod yol ba'i rgan khog bdag /bdag 'dzin 'ching bas rab bcings grong du lus/ /lus kyi khang rgan thigs pas ma bcom yang yang ma lam la mi che shor nas thal/ / sa thag gnas kyis bskal yang skyabs mgon rje/ / sa gzhi zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas chen gyi/ /sa phyogs 'di du yang yang 'byon pa dang / /sa 'di'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa mkhyen/ / zhu don don gyi gtso bo nyid kyi sku/ / mi 'jigs 'jigs bral gdong lngas btegs pa'i khrir/ / nab bzhugs bzhugs ngos 'dir gnas glob bu la/ /gsung 'phrin 'phrin kung ga lha'i rgyun bzhin stsol/ / sku phyogs dgu nong tshang la phul/dge bcu'i dpal gyis rab brgyan pa'i/ / gong ma'i lung gis zin pa'i gnas/ / mi 'gyur rdo rje'i pho brang la/ / bstod bsngags bkra shis me tog 'thor/ / de du bzhugs pa'i sprul ba'i sku/ / nyi ma gzhon nu'i snyan dbang du/ / zhu tshig lha yi me tog 'bul/ / brtse ba chen pos dang du longs/ /rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa ltar/ /tshogs kyi dbus nas brtan par bzhugs/ /dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i phyir/ /cho ga chos spyod snyan pan gsungs/ /byis pa phal gyis spyod ngan spongs/ /dam pa'i rnam thar skyong par mdzod/ /rig pa'i gnas la brtson 'grus gnong / / gzhan don gnang dus dgos pa yod/ / yi dam lha yi bzlas bsnyen 'bungs/ /chos srung rnams la gsol mchod kyis/ /de ltar gnang na sku tshe brtan/ /mi mthun bar chad g.yul las rgyal/ / mi rgan nga yi bslab byu 'di/ / thugs la 'dzin pa'i bka' drin skyongs/ / mtshan ldan bla ma sprul ba'i sku'i/ / sbu tsho spyol mtshan brtan par shog/ces dang / ka dag don ston dpal chen bla ma'i mtshan/ / kha ba can gyi skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa'i/ / ga la ba den gus pa'i phyag 'tshal nas/ / nga yis sprul ba'i sku la bslab bya 'bul/ /ca co'i g.yeng ba rab dben tā thang na/ /cha shas tsam gyi yo byad la brten nas/ /ja mar zas la ma zhen nyams blang na/ /nya lto ba ltar che gcig grub pa brnyes/ /ta tha ga ta'i bstan pa rin po che/ / tha gru yangs par khyab pa de'i sgo du/ / da lta zhugs dus sgrub la rab brtson na/ /na so smin dus yang dag lta ba rtogs/ /pa sangs ltar dkan phan sems bzang po yis/ /pha ma sems can nyam thag thams cad la/ /ba spu g.yo ba'i snying rje'i thugs mnga' na/ /ma rmad rgyal ba'i rnam than de nyid lags/ /tsa ri lta bu'i dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /tsha ba da skyid kab la gzhol ba na/ / dza ya gong ma'i nyams bzhes rdzogs chen don/ / wa

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /ler thugs la 'char ba'i dus shig yong / /zhwa bzhin drin can bla ma gtsug tu khun/ /za ma la sogs phud kyis mchod bzhin du/ / 'a 'un 'du 'dzi'i dbang du ma song na/ / ya mtshan dngos grub thob pa rgyang mi ring / /ra ba gangs ris bskor ba'i yul ljongs 'di'i/ /la lung slob ma rnams la dbang khrid sogs/ /sha stag 'bad pas stsal nas slob tshogs la/ /sa lam mthon por son pa'i thugs 'dun mdzod/ /ha ha mi rgan sems la shan ba 'di/ /ma lags khyung dgon tshang la gus pas 'bul/ /'gro tshogs skyabs mgon drug pa rdo rje 'chang / / rang gzhan smin grol lam bzang ston mdzad pa'i/ /pha gcig mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa'i drung / /gus phran skyabs 'og nyang gi mtshams ming nas/ / sor bcu'i thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs 'bras ni/ /mgon khyod sngon nas mngon par sangs rgyas kyang / /ris med gdul bya spyi dang reb kong gi/ /dmu rgod 'gro rnams sgrol par thugs bskyed nas/ /bdag sogs mgon du byon khyed deng 'dir dgongs/ / rgyul ba rnams kyi rnam thar lhar bzhes shing / / ri khrod dben pan nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs/ / rang don mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /deng 'din mgon khyod ma gtogs gzhan na gang / / sku tshe stod la stod smad bar gsum gyi/ /'gro don thams cad legs par grub lags na/ /sku tsho smad 'dir dam pas lung zin pa'i/ /dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil nas bzhugs re ran/ /'gro ba rnams la mtha' dang mu med pas/ /thams cad kun la phebs pa ga la langs/ /de bas ring min gdan sa 'dir phebs nas/ /thugs bskyed smon pa'i 'gro don mdzad pa mkhyen/ /yul 'di'i slob ma sngags mang thams cad kyis/ /nyid gsungs sgrub nas dam bca' ltan gnas na/ /'gro mgon khyed nas 'a 'a chen gnang ba yi/ / dam bca' nyer dgongs phyogs 'dir phebs pa mkhyen/ /sngags mang rnams nas rkus chang g.yang ga'i bcad/ / nyid la phyogs nas gang gsungs sgrub legs na/ /chos thog srol bzang btsugs nas skyong ba yi/ /zhal bzhes ji bzhin thugs la 'dzin pa mkhyen/ / sngon gyi rgyal ba gong ma thams cad kyang / / gdan sa gcig tu bzhugs nas 'gro don mdzad/ /de bzhin mgon khyod gdan sa 'did bzhugs nas/ /zab rgyas chos chan 'bebs pa'i bka' drin skyongs/ / skyabs mgon dam pa phyogs 'dir ma byon na / /bdag sogs pha mas bor ba'i dwa phrug 'dra/ 1dge sdeg blang dor mi shes 'jol nyog spyod/ /de phyir skyabs mgon phyogs 'dir 'byon pa mkhyen/ / mgon khyod gdan sa 'di du bzhugs pa na/ /bdag sogs pha mas bu phrug skyong ba 'dra/ /thams cad dge ba'i phyogs ༵ ngang gis

gas /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dad/ /de phyir mgon khyod gdan san phebs pa mkhyen/ /bdag sogs 'khrungs yul gdul bya thams cad kyis/ / khye'u pha mar 'bod 'dra'i gsol 'debs na/ / thugs kyis ma don brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ /myur du 'byon khyod snying rje'i mnga' bdag mkhyen/ /phran kung da lo dben par lo mtshams shig khongs par 'dug pa'i dam bca' mdzad nas su/ /nyid la gsol ba 'debs bzhin gnas pas na/ /chos 'go mtha' du phyin pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /de ltar zhu yig phul ba'i dge ba yis/ / rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyan zhabs brtan cing / /ring min gdan sa 'dir phebs bka' chos gsungs/ / bdag sogs smin grol lam la lhan 'god mdzod/ / 'di yang rma phan ka na bzhugs dus phul/rmad byung tshogs gnyis nab rdzogs ke la shar/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i nyal 'gro'i bcud kyis gtams/ /rang grol mtshan dpe dbang bzhi'i gos kyis bklubs/ /skyabs mgon shel dkar bum bzang gtsug na rgyal/ /byums dang brtse ba'i yon ston kun mnga' mkhas/ /tshul khrims bslab pa ma lus bsrung bas btsun/ / thugs rgyud chos dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa bzang / / rgyal bstan dan sgyus mdzad pa gang de'i drung / 1'di na na so rgas pa'i slob ngan bdag / bdag 'dzin 'dzin pas rab bcings grong yul gnas/ / gnas lugs lugs gnyis don ma shes pas dman/ /dman slob slob ngan bdag gis mchid 'di 'bul/ /gang de'i sku dkyil dkyil 'khon 'od stong ni/ / gangs can ljongs 'din 'dir gnas chu skyes tshal/ / gang 'dod chos gsungs gsungs mgur 'od kyis bskyangs/ / gang la gang 'dul 'dul khyod deng 'dir dgongs/ /mkhyen ldan khyed kyis las ldan gdul bya la/ /dam chos gsung 'bum bka' tshos char ba phab/ / rten bzhengs mang po legs bzhengs mdzad bzang de/ /bka' drin che'o khyed drin gzhal bar 'khum/ / da dung bdag sogs gdul bya ma lus kun/ / kun bzang rang ngo ma 'phrod de srid du/ / du ma'i snang ngon bkra shis g.yas 'khyil bar/ / bar mtshams med par rgyun du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ / mdzes mdzes sku mchog ri dbang lta bur bzhugs/ / snyan snyan dam chos rnga chen rgyun du sgrogs/ / zab zab thugs kyis gdul bya'i sa 'dir dgongs/ /mang mang 'gro rnams thar ba'i lam la drongs/ /gsang chen snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje/ / rje btsun khyed thugs shel dkar bum bzang las/ /las ldan rnams la dbang bzhi'i rgyun stsol zhing / /zhing 'di'i 'gro rnams smin cing grol mdzod cig / sngan yang yang dag lam bsten rjes su bzung / / da yang yang gsang ba skyi ༵dpas pa gnang / /'dir yang yang dag slob ma'i gral du bzhag /dang yang

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /yang zab sgom la gzhol 'di rmad/ / rang phyogs sngags rlom 'dzin rnams rang tshod kyi/ /nyams len byed 'dod ngang la nyams ma lon/ / khyim pa'i shan shor gnyen dang khyim tshang don/ /sgrub rnams da dung khyed gsungs sgrub nges lags/ / rab mang sngags 'chang tshogs kyang mgon khyod la/ / rab tu dad pas gsol ba 'debs lags la/ / nab zab thugs brtses dgongs la dbang khrid lung / / rab stsol smin cing grol ban thugs rjes zungs/ /yang nas yang du zhus pa'i tshig rnams kun/ /kun nas kun tu thugs kyis 'don min don/ /don de'i don 'bras lhan smin rtag bzhugs mkhyen/ / mkhyen mdzod mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag bla ma rje/ /phran chung bdag gis da nas khyed gsungs sgrub/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa dus kun rgyun du 'bul/ / 'bul rgyu'i non jos dben khang sgrub mchod dga'/ / dga' bde nyams rtogs skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bdag la bslab bya'i zhal gdams mgun dbyangs shig /bdag gi spyi bor brtse bas legs bstsal nas/ /bdag kung thugs kyis nam yang ma 'don zhes/ / bdag gis thal mo sbyar nas lan brgyad zhu/ / 'dag cag da bar nyams dma' 'das rag bar/ / 'di phyi gnyis kyi phyi rtsis mi zin gyis/ / dus kun rgyun du lhun bskul thugs su zungs/ /dge legs ches cher spel te bde dge bskyed/ /'dod don mchog stsol mgon khyod dgongs mdzod gsol/ /slad mar gang gi sku mchog gdong lnga'i khrir/ khyun man mi 'gyur rdo rje ltan bzhugs nas/ /du mar chos kyi 'khor lo dab bskor zhing / /'dzin mad bstan pa'i bhā dza bsgrengs par shog / zhu mchid mchid 'dir sdeb spyor tshig dben yang / /zhu don don gyi gtso bo blun tshig 'di/ / skyabs mchog mchog gi zhabs pad khri'i drung du/ / blo dman dman pa bdag gis gus pas phul/ / skyabs mgon rin po cher phul/mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi gten mdzod rje/ /skyabs mgon dam pa tshogs drug rang grol la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bu yi bsam don kun/ /lhan gyis grub pa'i dge mtshan deng 'dir stsol/ / ye ma sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad pa yi/ / snying gi bu mchog dkon mchog non bu la/ / 'di phyin phan pa'i snying gtam tshig 'ga' smra/ / ma yengs rna ba'i bdud rtsir dang du longs/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' thob pa da res tsam/ /yun ring mi sdod nam 'chi cha med pa/ /bsam nas dkad nag las 'bras 'khor ba yi/ /nyes dmigs bsam nas skyo shas skye pad rigs/ / mi lhas thob cing dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang / / gsang sngags bstan dang mjal ba da res tsam/ / dper na ded dpon gser gling phyin nas su/ / non bu len ltar mi lus snying bo longs/ / bshes gnyen dam pa bsam dang sbyor ba yis/ /——ste~X naX ༷'i

sa / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsungs bzhin du skyabs 'gro dang / / sems bskyed sgrib sbyong maṇḍal gsol 'debs sogs/ /thun mong sngon 'gro'i grangs tshad sngon du thongs/ / byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / /'brel ba'i gsol 'debs gdung shugs drag po yis/ / thugs rgyud bskul nas dbang bzhi blangs gyur na/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs yon tan skye bar nges/ /thun mongs min pa'i sngon 'gro du shan dang / / hūṃ spyangs la sogs rgyud dang 'dres nges byas/ / sems kyi byung gnas 'gro gsum la sogs pa/ / bla ma'i man ngag bzhin du 'bad par rigs/ /khregs chod thod rgal snang bzhi'i don rtogs na/ / che gcig sangs rgyus thob pan the tshom med/ /de phyir 'dir snang bya ba blos thongs la/ / ri khrod dben pan rtse gcig nyams len rem/ / mar gyur 'gro la snying rje sgom pa dang / / bdag pas gzhan gces byang sems rin po che/ /rgyud la skyes na bstan 'gror phan nges pas/ / e skyes rems shig skal ldan snying gi bu/ / de ltar chos dang mthun pa'i bslab bya 'di/ / bu mchog dkon mchog nor bur gdams pa'i dges/ / skal ldan slob bu'i chos 'go mthar thon nas/ / rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog/gtan gyi skyabs mgon tshogs drug rang grol rje/ / 'bral med spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs mdzod la/ / bdag dang bu slob yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ / chos 'go mtha' du phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ / chos sgor zhugs pa'i skal ldan las 'phro can/ / snying gi bu mchog bsod nams 'bum khyod la/ /'di phyir phan pa'i snying gtam lhag 'ga' smra/ /sgo gsum ma yengs nyon cig snying gi bu/ / dal brgyad 'byon bcu'i mi lus rin po che/ / yang yang rnyed dka' 'jig pa'i tshul bsam nas1 /dkar nag las 'bras zhib du brtsi ba dang / /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms shig snying gi bu/ / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems sgom bzlas dang / / tshogs bsags maṇḍal bla ma 'i rnal 'byor gyi/ / sgo nas dbang bzhi blangs shing thugs yid bsres/ /thun mong sngon 'gro thongs shig snying gi bu/ /sgo gsum ru shan rigs drug sa bon bsregs/ / hūṃ sbyangs rdo rje'i 'dug stangs sems 'tshol dang / / rnal dbab sor gzhug la sogs khregs chod dang / / lhun grub thod rgal sgoms shig snying gi bu/ / mdor na bla ma'i drung nas dbang skur zhus/ / dbang dus kas blangs dam bcas srog ltar srungs/ /bskyed rim lha yi nga rgyal gsal snang brtan/ /rdzogs rim 'od gsal sgoms shig snying gi bu/ /mtshan ldan bla ma spyi bo'i rgyan du zungs/ / yi dam lha yi bsnyen bsgrub gnad du bsnun/ /ba skyi ༵sa skyong srung mar gsol mchod brtson/ / gang bsam 'phrin las 'grub bo snying

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /gi bu/ / dus rnams kun tu rang sems ngo bo spyongs/ / ri khrod dben pa mgo yi zhwa bzhin bsten/ 1lhas ngag yid gsum chos kyi phyogs su thongs/ / 'phral yun legs tshogs 'byung ngo snying gi bu1 / 'di do dge rnyis slob gyis bsam do1 'grub/ /rdos 'go mthan thon rang ba'i dī ༵ shis rdo~X /'di/da trel ga/—sa/ lhan —sa 'grub pa' dga' ston —/ /'bad med 'byung ka dag chos dbyings dgongs pa mngon gyun pa'i/ 1 kha ba can gyi skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rje'i/ / ga la ba den gus pas phyag byas nas/ / nga yi glob mar phan pa'i gros shig 'debs/ / ca co'i g.yeng ba spangs nas ri khrod du/ / cha shas tsam gyi yo byad la brten nas/ /ja mar 'dod yon dbang du ma song ban/ / nya lho ba bzhin gnas pa'i tshe brtan nyon/ /ta tha ga ta'i bstan la zhugs dus 'dir/ / tha chad rnam g.yeng dbang du mi 'dug par/ /da res dal 'byor lus rten thob pa'i dus/ /na 'chi ma skebs gong 'dir dge sbyor 'bod/ / pa ra mi ta'i nye lam gsang sngags chos/ / pha gcig bla ma'i drung nas thob yod pas/ /ba lang bzhin du ma nyal nyams len rnams/ /ma rnams don du brtson pas 'bad par rigs/ /tsa na shi yong snyam pa'i skyo shas kyis/ /tsha grang la sogs ngal ba khyad bsad nas/ /dza yas bsngags pa'i lam bzang sgom mdzod dang / / lnga ler chos sku'i rang ngo myur du mthong / /zha long 'on sbugs sogs su ma skyes shing / / za ma la sogs mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i dus/ / 'a 'ud g.yeng ba spongs la dge sbyor gyis/ / ya mtshan dngos grub thob po snying gi bu/ / rwa ltar gyong ba'i nang rgyud ma thul na/ / la lung gang nas bsgoms kyang don med pas/ /sha stag 'bad pas rang sems 'dul brtson na/ /sa lam mthon por myur du son par nges/ /ha cang 'khor ba'i zhen pa bcad nas su/ /a ti yo ga'i lam 'di nyams su longs/ /ngo bo spros bral chos sku nam mkha'i dbyings/ / rang bzhin ma 'dres lhan grub longs spyod rdzogs1 /thugs rje sprul ba'i rnam nol yo rgyan rje/ /dbyer med tshogs drug rang grol spyi bor bzhugs/ /mgon des rjes bzung snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ /bde spyid bsam gtan gling gi 'dus sde la/ /chos dang mthun pa'i bslab bya tshig 'ga' 'bul/ /ma yengs legs par nyon cig sngags 'chang rnams/ / dal 'byor rten thob dam pa'i chos dang mjal/ / dkar nag las 'bras rnam dbye shes dus 'dir/ / sgo gsum bag med spangs nas bag yod dges/ /dam pa'i lha chos sgrubs shig sngags 'chang rnams/ /lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen dam pa bsten/ / dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag 'chi ba bsam/ / blo ldog bzhi yis8 du bskul

sa /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skyabs sems sogs/ /rgyud dang 'dres nges gyis shig sngags 'chang rnams/ /thog med nas bsags sdig lhung gnyen po du/ /rdor sems bsgom bzlas tshogs bsags maṇḍal dang / /bla ma'i rnal 'byor dbang bzhi len pa sogs/ /thun mongs sngon 'gror 'bod cig sngags 'chang rnams/ /sgo gsum du shan rnal dbab sor gzhug dang / / byung gnas 'gro gsum la sogs sngon 'gro yis/ / rgyud spyangs dngos gzhi khregs chod thod rgal gyi/ / don la gzhol pan mdzod cig sngags 'chang rnams/ /theg dgu'i yang rtse yo ga rnam gsum gyi/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin bskyed rdzogs nyams blangs nas/ / tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs /'bad pas nyams su longs shig sngags 'chang rnams/ / rang re'i bgo skal surya ki rte yi/ /chos rgyun nyams len chos thog dus bzang sogs/ /gong 'phel dngos nas rab 'byams las bzhi yi/ / 'phrin las mthar phyin mdzod cig sngags 'chang rnams/ / chos thog skabs su 'grigs lam kun spyod rnams/ /dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig ltos kyis/ /bskyed rim gsal ngos sngags zeng spro bsdu sogs/ / rang nus gang 'tshams kyis shig sngags 'chang rnams/ /ma rabs dud chang bsngos sha la sogs pa/ / srungs nas bla man mos gus mched grogs la/ / brtse gdung 'gro la phan sems bzang po sogs/ / rang gi rgyud la sbyon cig sngags 'chang rnams/ / de ltar bris pas mthun pa'i bas ru bya 'di/ / snang mdzad rdo rjes bde zhing spyi dpa 'i bkra shi rdo/shog/ sa/ pas kun kyang dam pa' chos dang mthun/ /thams cad mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi gten mdzod rje/ /byin rlabs ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mchog / skyabs mgon dam pa tshogs drug rang grol la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /ye ma gson dang rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams/ /dal 'byor rten thob gsang sngags chos dang mjal/ / che gcig sangs rgyas gdams pa thob dus su/ /kun gyis nyams su longs shig sngags 'chang rnams/ / skye mtha' 'chi nges nam 'chi cha med pas/ / rnam g.yeng le lo'i dbang du ma gtong bar/ / thun mong sngon 'gro'i chos kyis rgyud spyangs nas/ / rang rgyud chos la bskul cig sngags 'chang rnams/ /skyabs sems yig brgya maṇḍal 'bum gten dang / /bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom nas dngos gzhi yi/ /khregs chod thod rgal snang bzhi mthan phyin nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrubs shig sngags 'chang rnams/ /ma rabs spyod ngan dud chang la sogs pa/ / dkar po dge ba'i chom rkun rgyangs bsring nas/ /yi dam lha 8༵ ba sgrub 'bad pa dang / / dam tshig tshul bzhin srungs shig sngags 'chang

mgur tshogs mi bzhugs so/ /rnams/ /de ltar gdams pas dge tshogs rlabs chen gyis/ /rig 'dzin 'dus sde'i legs tshogs mtsho ltar rgyas/ /sbu gsum gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin pa dang / /mthad thug kun bzang lcog na~X sbya dī dī~X /bad/ shog / ces pa 'di yang chu bzang sngags pa rnams la snang mdzad rdo rjes padma skyabs gnas bslu med bla ma padma 'byung / / spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /mos ldan sngags 'chang yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rab 'byums las bzhi lhun grub dga' ston mdzod/ /skal par ldan pa'i slob bu sngags 'chang rnams/ ga phral yun kun tu bde ba'i gtam 'dir nyon/ / skye dka' 'dzam gling mi lus rten bzang thob/ /mjal dka' gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgo nu zhugs/ / sgrub dka' rnam dkar chos thog dus bzang tshugs/ /rted dka' don chen byung chub sgrub pa la/ /snying nas dga' ba sgoms la lha chos sgrubs/ /mi nag skye bo sdig la gzhol skabs 'dir/ /chos mdzad rnams kyis lha chos ma sgrub na/ 1mi lus thob pa don med chud re zos/ /de phyir snying nas lha chos sgrub re ran/ /so thar khrims bsrung ngur sprig gis mdzes pa'i/ / skal ba med kyang mi nag rtags spangs nas/ /sngags chos byas nas sgo gsum zhi dul byus/ / rnam dkad dge la gzhol na mi legs sam/ / de phyin khyed cag 'dus pa'i tshom bu rnams/ / chos thog dus bzang tshes bcur 'tshogs pa'i dus/ / 'grigs lam kun spyod sngags mang spyi dang bstun/ / na bza' dmar po ḍa dril glegs bam sogs/ /mkho ba'i yo byad tshang ngos thugs mthun sgos/ /nyi ma rtse shar dus su 'tshogs pa dang / / 'tshogs dus lhas po g.yas g.yon mi g.yo bar/ / drang por bsring nas dge sems dang ldan pa'i/ /cho ga chos spyod dbu mdzad dag dang bstun/ /phyag len phra zhib gyis dang phyi nabs kyi/ / mig ltos bzang po yin pas gal re che/ / dus rnams kun tu 'grigs lam brtsi ba dang / / khyad par tshogs la 'tshogs dus dud chang sogs/ /mig ltos ngan pa spangs nas sgo gsum po1 /chos dang mthun par 'gyur bar byas gyur na/ /dbyings na bzhugs pa'i lha yis byin rlobs shing / / srung mas grogs byed don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub/ /ma rabs spyod ngan byas na srung ma yis/ / gang la gang 'tsham chad pa gcod pa dang / /gsang sngags chos sgor zhugs pa don med 'gyur/ /de phyir 'grigs lam kun spyod chos dang bstun/ /gzhan snang dge la bsgyun ba'i thabs la 'bod/ /de skad bca' khrims 'brel ba'i bslab bya 'di/ / ska gsar sngags 'chang 'dus pa'i tshom bu la/ / nyang skyes mtshams ming bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bris/ / mthong thos kun la dge ba'i dag shi~X shog /

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skyabs gnas kun 'dus gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang / / 'gran gyi do med thub dbang 'khor lo'i mgon/ / pha gcig mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ / zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa'i drung / / gus phran slob bu'i tha shal mtshams ming nas/ / sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs 'bras ni/ /gang sku bsam 'phel yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /'gro ba'i dad gsum rgyal mtshan rtser bzhugs nas/ /ris med 'gro la dgos 'dod 'jo bzhin du/ / bzhugs zhes thos pas nyam chung bdag yid spro/ / skabs kyi zhu gsol nyid kyi rnam than ni/ / bdag 'dra'i blo yis dpag par dka' mod kyang / /brtse ldan khyed kyis mchog dman 'gro ba la/ /nye ring med par ma yis bu la bzhin/ / rjes su 'dzin pa bas na bdag 'dra yis/ / gsol ba 'debs la gsan pan som nyi bral/ /'gro mgon nyi ma phyogs gzhan bzhugs na yang / /bdag sogs bu slob pad tshal skyong mod kyang / / zhabs drung 'khod de gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /dang sems spyong bo 'dul la khyad par che/ / gzhan yul dge la sbyor ba'i 'gro don ni/ /bka' drin che yang 'khrungs yul gdul byu yi/ /me tog phog pa'i lha skal yin pas na/ /bdag sogs yal bar ma don skyabs mgon rje/ / ris med dgon sde mchod pa'i rnam than ni/ /thugs rje che yang reb kong sngags mang gi/ / chos thog bar ma do du lus yod pas/ /zhal bkod cha rkyen gnong zhig skyabs mgon rje/ / lto gos med pa'i nyam thag dbul bo rnams/ /brtse bas bskyangs pa bka' drin che mod pyong / /phyogs 'dir lha khang bzhengs rgyu'i non med na/ / gsol ras rim bzhin gnong zhig skyabs mgon rje/ / mched grogs 'dab bzang mkha' lding dbang bo'i tshogs/ / khyed drung 'khod nas sku g.yog sgrub lags pas/ /slob ngan khyem bya 'dra ba'i rgya mtsho bdag / brtse ba'i thugs kyis ma dod skyabs mgon rje/ /skyabs 'og sde chung nyang gi lha khang gi/ / rten bzhengs gser tshon dang bcas grub lags pas/ /nyid nas ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ / nab gnas bsngo smon gnong zhig skyabs mgon rje/ /phran kyang che 'di'i bya bzhag nyung du btang / /mtshams sgrub nyams len gang nus byed bzhin du/ / yang yang snying nas gsol ba 'debs lags na/ / gyin gyis rlobs shig skyabs mgon snying rje'i gter/ / bdag sogs 'khrungs yul gdul byur gyur pa rnams/ /rjes su 'dzin pa'i dam bca' nyer dgongs nas/ /lha khang brgya rtsa'i rab gnas bkra shis ched/ / ring min myur du 'byon pa'i bka' drin skyongs/ / slad mar 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rin po che'i/ / zhabs zung gdong lnga'i khri la brtan bzhugs nas/ / bdag ba thu~X dam bsrung ba'i do ra nas/ /nam yang 'dor med skyabs 'jug yang yang zhu/ /

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /zhes pa'i zhu mchid na yig gnyis pa yis/ / lha dar 'dab ma brkyangs nas yongs 'dzin drung / /pad dkar ze'u 'bru'i rtse nas dan dir gyis/ / gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig 'di 'bul par mdzod/ / sba nag na bzhugs dus phul/rgya chen tshogs gnyes dpal las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i bang rim mngon par mtho/ /rang gzhan grol byed nyams rtogs nyi zlas spras/ /skyabs mgon ri dbang lhan po yud tsam dgongs/ / mgon khyod ring mo'i gong nas sangs spyos kyang / / 'khrungs yul gdul bya'i don du gzugs kyi skur/ /bsam bzhin byon pa'i pha rgan rdo rje 'chang / /bu yis gdung pa'i dbyungs la dar cig gson/ / sngon byon dam pa du mas bor ba'i shul/ /bstan pa'i me no gzugs brnyan 'gyun la nye/ / las nyon mun pa'i smag dum 'thibs dus 'dir/ /skyabs mgon nyin byed dbang bo 'byon nam ci/ / spyir na bod khams snyigs ma'i rgud pas mnan/ / sgos su reb kong mya ngan mun par tshud/ / yang sgos sngags rlom rnams kyang lam ma zin/ /deng skabs bstan pa'i sgron me gang du 'byon/ /phyi ltar gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gyis/ / rgyal khams dog pod bgyis pa drin che yang / / nang ltan smin cing grol ba phan la zhog /sems ngo tsam yang ma 'phrod slob bu mang / /dper na pha mas bu phrug byis pa'i dus/ / sa zhing pha mkhan sprad nas pha ma de/ / gzhan du song na byis pas khyim ye zin/ / mkhyen ldan khyed kyis dgongs la thugs bsam bzhes/ / dbus gtsang nyi mas khyab pa'i dag zhing gi/ / chos ldan slob mar dgongs nas gdul zhing 'di/ / mun par btang nas skyabs mgon nyi ma yis/ /nyi ma bsnyegs la dgos pa ci zhig mchis/ /dbus gtsang lha yul 'thab rtsod ming med pa'i/ / zhing der dgongs nas reb kong lha min ltar/ / 'thab rtsod 'khrugs pas du 'dzing dus 'di ru/ / 'khrungs yul yal bar 'dod phod thugs rje can/ /rgyul sras sems dpa' rnams kyis me dong yang / / pad tshal ltan gzigs 'gro ba'i don byed na/ / snying rje'i mnga' bdag byang chub sems dpa' khyed1 / reb kong phyogs su thugs sun gyun ram ci/ /pre ta pu ru dang mtshungs reb kong 'did/ /tshogs bsags sbyin gtong 'byor ba dman pa'i stabs/ /'byor ldan dbus gtsang phyogs su thugs gtad na1 /nor med slob bu rnams kyang thugs nas don/ /skal ldan rgyu mtsho'i yang sprul zhing gzhan du/ /dgongs pa'i mya ngan mun rum gtib dus 'din/ / bstan pa'i sgron me gnyis pa bzhugs dgos zhes/ / mchi ma g.yo bzhin zhus kung mi gsan na/ / khyed kyi byams dang snying rje gang du thal/ / ral khur ldan pa'i slob ngan kun 'dus nas/ / ma la bu bzhid ba 8 9 ༷༷ 'o

gas /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dod kyis/ / bzhugs zhes gsol ba btab na mi bzhugs na/ / sems sun 'byin pa'i rtsa lhang ma yin nam/ / khyim pa'i shan shon khyed gsungs mi sgrub kung / / sngon chad spyod ngan bshags shing phyin chad sdoms/ / rang nus dang 'tshams nyams len byed nges zhes/ / dam bca' phul yang mi gsan pa 'di ci/ / rmongs rtul slob ngan nga dang nga 'dra bas/ / bya spyod ngan par thugs khyel gyur na yang / /las ldan re gnyis bka' bzhin sgrub nges na/ /thams cad don nas skyabs rje gang du 'byon/ / kun gyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig da dung yang / /gsol ba 'debs la byums brtse'i mnga' bdag khyed/ / gtan du bzhugs 'dun med kyang lo 'ga' la/ /rang cag bstan 'gro'i mgon du cis kung bzhugs/ /'gro mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho yab sras kyis/ /'khrungs yul gdul bya'i zhing 'dir bstan pa btsugs/ /de bzhin nang cag gdul bya'i lha skal khyed/ / reb kong gdul byar dgongs nas bzhugs par zhu/ /nyams len byed mkhan med la thugs skyo na/ /'di du bzhugs dang nged cag rang tshod kyis/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i dam bca' 'bul/ /de phyir gdul bya'i zhing 'dir bzhugs pa mkhyen/ / mchod sbyin cha rkyen med la thugs skyo na/ / nged cag phyogs kun nyul nas sku don sgrub/ /tshogs bsogs sbyin gtong thugs bskyed gong 'phel gtong / /de phyir phyogs 'dir bzhugs pa'i bka' drin skyongs1 / 'thab rtsod 'khrug long mang bar thugs skyo na/ /bzhugs 'dun mdzod dang nyid kyi thugs rje yis/ / 'khrug pa rnams kyang nges par zhi 'gyur bas/ / skyabs mgon dam pa phyogs 'dir bzhugs pa mkhyen/ / bstan pa'i bka' srung ma mgon gza' rdor sogs/ /sngon tshe rgyul ba'i bka' las ma 'da' ban/ /drin can bla ma'i thugs bsgyur yul phyogs 'dir/ / bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel gnyer kha dang du bzhes/ /rtsa gsum bden mthu rang cag dad mos kyi/ / mthu las bstan pa'i sgron mes sa phyogs 'di'i/ /rgud pa'i mun pa bsal nas bde la bkod/ /yul 'din dge mtshan snang bas khyab gyur cig /de ltar zhu tshig phul ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ /rang cag dad pas mchi ma dor nas su/ / thal mo spyar te lan mang zhus pa la/ / thugs kyis nyer dgongs snying rje'i mnga' bdag mchog /dman pa bdag gis dngos su zhu ma spobs/ /yi ged phab nas zhus pa nyer dgongs te/ /reb kong skya ser sngags mang thams cad kyi/ /re 'bras don dang ldan pa'i bka' drin stsol/ / slob ngan nyang mtshams bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yis/ / gdungs pa'i dbyungs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ / dpal ldan bla ma phyogs 'di'i gdul bya yi/ /ba ra 9༵skaX ༷rgya'i bar du bzhugs su gsol/ / dang cag slob bu rnams kyi chos srid

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /don/ /'bad med yongs grub nyams rtogs mthar phyin nas/ / nang don rdzogs nas gzhan don byed pa la/ / dam pa khyod dang mtshungs pan byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba'i 'dren mchog spyan nas gzigs dbang de/ /slar yang bshes gnyen dam pa'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ / skyabs rje mtshan ldan co ba'i bla ma yi/ / zhabs kyi padmo rnam par bzhad pa'i drung / /gus phran slob bu mtshams ming rgya mtsho dang / /mkhar lo tshag lo dbu mdzad ngag dbang bcas/ /rab tu dad pas lha phyag grangs med byas/ /gsol ba 'debs la thugs rje can khyod dgongs/ /sngon byon bshes gnyen du mas ma thul ba'i/ /ma dungs dmu rgod reb kong kha gnon du/ / bsam bzhin byon pa'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ / phyogs gzhan ma phebs phyogs 'dir myun du byon/ /mgon khyod dbus 'gyur chos kyi mdun sa der/ /ring min phebs rgyu'i thugs bkod gnang ba thos/ /nged cag skal dman slob ma yon bdag gi/ /byang khog tsitta mi bde gzer gyis btab/ / kye ma grog tshang kha yi rdo blangs ltar/ / reb kong phyogs kyi skye bo pho mo rnams/ / yal bar dor tshe mya ngan kang bu du/ / da lta nyid du 'jug pa phod dam ci1 / 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon snying rje'i gten chen pos/ / nged cag bu slob snying rje'i yul gyur rnams/ / yal bar ma 'dor snying rje chen po'i sgos/ / phyogs 'dir 'byon mdzod snying rje'i mnga' bdag mkhyen/ / dung dung gdungs pas gsol 'debs bu lnga la/ /brtse brtse dgyes pa'i zhal ras ngom bzhin du/ / snyan snyan phyogs 'dir bzhugs pa'i gsung dbyangs shig / myur lhar stsol cig skyabs mgon thugs rje can/ / rang cag sgob ma rnams nas rang tshod kyi/ /rang gi don phyir nyams len rang dpag nas/ /rang res sgrub nges lags na nang phyogs 'did/ /nang gzhan mgon du skyabs rje rang yul phebs/ /bsru med mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden stobs dang / / bdag sogs rtse gcig dad pas gsol btab mthus/ /'gro ba'i 'dren mchog skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa'i/ / zhal gyi dkyil 'khor myur du mjal bar shog / skyabs rje par yon na bzhugs dus phul/reb kong sngags mang gi zhu shog rnams 'di ltar/ rgya chen tshogs gnyis zla ba'i ma ma las/ /legs 'ongs phyin drug rta ljang gzi 'od kyis/ / rang gzhan thun gsum las grol drin can rje'i/ /zhabs pad gser gyi rtsibs stong bkra ba'i drung 1 /'di na nyid kyi thugs rjes legs bskyangs pa'i/ / reb kong smad pa'i sngags mang 'dus spyi nas/ / rab tu dad pas lag pa chos 'khor ngos/ /zums te brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas zhu ba'i 'bras/ /mgon khyod ris med 'gro la dam chos kyi/ /dga' ston 'gyed ngos bzhugs zhes thos 'dzin gyi/ ——/bu ༵ra spyod tshe

ga / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dga' spro'i gter mdzod rdol/ /'on kyang zhal dkyil ma mjal skyo bzhin gnas/ / skabs kyi zhu gsol phyogs 'dir khyed byon rjes/ / rgya bod 'khrug rtsod sogs kyi duḥkha yis/ /mtshams rgyun la sogs nyid gsungs cung lhod kyang / / deng nas sngar zhus mi 'dor dam bca' 'bul/ /mgon po khyod kyi bka' drin thugs rje la/ /nye ring med kung phyogs 'dir ma bzhugs na/ /bdag sogs dam chos sgrub la bar gcod rkyen/ /gcig rjes gcig mthud 'byung 'di ma gzigs sam/ / dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing na skyabs mgon rje/ / rgyal ba yab sras la sogs sa thob kyi/ / byung chub sems dpa' mang bzhugs bka' drin gyis/ /yul de a mi de ba'i zhing dang mtshungs/ /srin yul dang mtshungs reb kong kha gnon du/ /o rgyan gnyis pa khyed nyid ma bzhugs na1 / srin po dang mtshungs chos pa 'jig rten pas/ /dge sdig 'jol nyog spyod 'did thugs kyis dgongs/ /na rag zhugs la bo dhi sa twa rnams/ /chu skyes tshal ltar bzhugs na mgon po khyed/ / phyogs 'di dor nas dbus phyogs phebs gyud na/ /'gro rnams sgrol ba'i dam bca' nyams 'gyur ram/ /gdul bya'i 'gro ba mtha' dang mu med pas/ / thams cad kun la 'byon sgyus ga la langs/ / gdul zhing gcig nas bzhugs te 'gro ba'i don/ / mdzad pa de ni sngon gyi dam pa'i srol/ / de ltar yang yang rang don zhus pa la/ / dgongs tshom ma gnang chos kyi rgyul bo yi/ / zhal gsungs lan gcig lags pas sngan zhus ltar/ / ring min chibs kyi kha lo phyogs 'dir sgyur/ / slad mar sngar zhus thugs kyis ma don bar/ /phyogs 'di'i sngags rgan la sogs slob bu rnams/ /thugs la btags nas ring min gdan sa 'dir/ /chibs kyi kha lo myur du bsgyur ba mkhyen/ /zhes pa'i zhu yig gnyis skyes 'khor lo'i lag /reb kong sngags mang 'o ma'i rgyu mtsho nas/ /sgrub ༵dī da/chod/ pa lha dan ga thog brkyangs nas/ / skyabs mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i mdun sar ༄ hūṃ myur mdzad mgon po sngags srung re ma ti/ / khyab 'jug chen po dam can rdo rje legs/ /tshe ring mched lnga bstan srung spyo mtsho'i tshogs/ / dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod tshogs 'di bzhes la/ / bdag sogs rnams kyi skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa'i/ / sku tshe bskal brgya'i bar du brtan pa dang / /zhabs zung rab dkan bkra shis g.yang 'khyil bar/ /myud 'byon 'phrin las ma g.yel sa ma ya/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag drin can chos kyi rje/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i mgon/ / 'di phyi'i skyabs mgon mtshan ldan bla ma rje'i/ 92/ zhabs kyi padma dri ma med pa'i drung / / gus phran reb kong smad pa'i sngags ma nga

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /nas/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs 'bras ni/ / gang sku rta ljang dbang bo'i gzi byin gyis/ / ris med 'gro blo'i mun pa rab bsal nas/ / lugs gnyis non gyis skyong bzhin bzhugs pa la/ /'dir gnas skal dman tshogs kyis yi rang 'bul/ /'di na rmongs rtul chos gzugs sngags ming rnams/ /sngon gyi sngags 'chang du ma'i gshegs shul na/ /khyim gyi don du gnyen bshes sgrog gis bcings/ / dgra 'dul gnyen skyong bya bas nyin mtshan 'das/ /dus bzhi'i chos thog chen por 'tshogs na yang / / mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma(grub dbang sbyang lung rdo rje 'chang)zhing gzhan gshegs/ /ban chad dbang gis re zhig lhod na yang 1 /skyabs mgon dam pa'i zhal gsungs la brten nas/ /deng skabs phan tshun thugs mthun sor chud yod/ /'on kung nged cag 'dus pa'i tshom bu rnams/ /yul dus dbang gis 'byor ba phra ba dang / /'go 'dren gnang mkhan yongs 'dzin med pa'i stabs/ /nyam thag brtse bas thugs rjes 'dzin par mkhyen/ /sngon nas skyabs rje dam pa khyed kyi drung / /sngags mang chos thog chos srid legs tshogs don/ / lan mang zhus kung 'gro don rgya che stabs/ / nyid nas thugs bkod yid tshom gnang ma gyur/ / deng skabs nged cag bstan pa'i phra nyag skabs/ /nyid nas brtse chen thugs rjes mi 'dzin na/ /nged rnams skyabs gnas re ltos su la 'cha'/ /ris med dgon sde mang por zhabs tog dang / / 'go 'dren gnang ba bka' drin che mod kyang / /nged cag mgon med skyabs med sngags mang la/ /brtse bas bslab bya gnang ba'i dus la bab/ / phur thogs stong gi grangs la gzigs nas su/ / reb kong phyogs kyi sngags pa thams cad sdus/ / chos thog 'dzin zhes gsungs pa'i zhal bzhes te/ / da lta bskul lo thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu/ / skyabs mgon nyi ma phyogs gzhan bzhugs na yang / / thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'gro kun skyong mod kyang / /dka rgod reb kong phyogs 'dir ma bzhugs na/ /dad pa ngo lkog che zhing 'gyun ldog mang / / de phyid ring min gdan sa 'dir phebs nas/ /chos srid gnyis kyis skyongs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ / slad mar 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon dam pa'i sku/ /mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la brtan bzhugs nas/ /bdag sogs re ltos sngags 'chang 'dus pa'i sde/ /thugs nas mi 'dor ba yi skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zhes pa'i zhu mchid na zung bhā ma ras/ / lha dan gshog pa brkyangs nas khyed drung thal/ / brtse bas gzigs nas bka' mchid bdud rtsi yis/ / bdag sogs nyon mongs gdung ba bsal du gsol/ /lhag bsam tshogs gnyis rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /gzhan phan phyin drug yal 'dab phyogs brgyar khyab/ /rang gzhan grol byed nyams rtogs 'bras bus brjid/ /skyabs ༵sbyon dpag

sa /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsam ljon pa'i zhabs drung du/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi 'byung gnas khyem sgyu mtshor/ /nyon mongs gsum gyis rtag tu rab mnar yang / / skyabs gnas gsum gyi zhabs pad zin zlom pa'i/ /'du shes gsum ldan sngags mang des zhu 'bras/ /sngon bsags bsags sbyangs smon lam bzang po'i mthus/ / gnas skabs skabs 'dir dam pa'i mgon dang mjal/ / chos tshul tshul bzhin spyod pa'i bskal bzang 'di/ / pha gcig gcig chog skyabs mgon khyed kyi drin/ /bka' drin gzhal phyin 'din 'khod sngags mang nas/ /rgyu nor dngos po 'bul rgyu ma mchis rung / / sgrub pa'i mchod pa ci gsungs dang len gyi/ / rgyu mtshan yig chung mchod sprin deng 'dir spro/ / mgon khyed mi la skal ldan rgya mtsho yi/ / rnam thar lhur bzhes phyogs med ri khrod 'grims/ /skal ldan glob mas sa steng bkang nas su/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs 'di rmad/ / 'di na sngags ming 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde yis/ / nyid kyi gsungs bzhin rkus jag g.yang gzhi chang / / gtan nas bcad cing 'grig bzhag tshags 'dzin byus/ / skabs 'dir mtshams rgyun 'dzugs bzhin nyid la phyogs/ / slar yang ched gsol don gyi snying bo ni/ / skyabs rje nyid nas sngar gyi zhal bzhes bzhin/ / da lo dgun gsum tshun la 'dir phebs nas/ /sku mtshams bzhugs nas phyi lo bzhi ba'i nang / /bka' chos gnang bzhin chos thog 'dzin pa mkhyen/ / stod smad bar gsum 'gro don thams cad 'grub/ /slob ma rnams kung dam pa'i chos dang mthun/ /reb kong jag rkus 'khrug pa rang sar zhi/ / de phyin skyabs mgon phyogs 'dir bzhugs pa mkhyen/ / phyogs 'din sngon med lha khang mchod rten grub/ /dgon sde mang po'i nyams gso zhabs tog grub/ /phyogs 'dir bde skyid nyi ma gsar du byung / / de phyin skyabs mgon phyogs 'din bzhugs pa mkhyen/ /'gro mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho yab sras kyis/ /sku tshe stod la 'gro don phyogs med mdzad/ /sku tshe smad la nong bo'i dgon chen btab/ /de phyir skyabs mgon phyogs 'dir bzhugs pa mkhyen/ /rig 'dzin chen po dpal ldan bkra shis dang / /grub dbang dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi/ / phyag bzhes ji bzhin bkra shis 'khyil ba nas/ / dus kun rgyun du bzhugs pa'i bka' drin skyongs/ /slad mad 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ /ring min myur du gdan sa 'dir phebs nas/ /chos srid zung gis nged cag skyongs pa dang / /rdzogs chen chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa mkhyen/ / 'dir gnas gdul bya skal ldan seng phrug rnams/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' drin la brten nas/ / bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rtsal ba lu~X ༵ rdzogs/ / nyams rtogs g.yu ral rgyas pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / zhes pa'i zhu

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ / mchid 'jo sgeg lus phra mas/ / sgrub pa'i mchod sprin lha dar lag thogs nas/ / skyabs mgon zhabs pad lha yi dga' tshal du/ / bsgrod pa zung gis gar stabs bsgyur te thal/ /rgya chen tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bsrub pa las/ /legs 'khrungs phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i bang rim mdzes/ / rang gzhan grol byed nyams rtogs nyi zlas spras/ /skyabs mgon ri rab lhun po'i zhabs drung du/ /sngon byon sngags 'chang du mas rjes su bzung / /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos sgon zhugs/ /skyabs rje'i zhabs pad tshud pa'i 'dus pa'i sde/ /reb kong sngags mang 'dus spyi'i gsol 'debs 'bras/ / deng skabs gang sku rta ljang dbang bo mchog /gnas chen bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rtse mo nas/ / 'khrungs yul gdul bya'i padmo tshal chen po/ /skyong bzhin bzhugs pa bka' drin mchog tu che/ / 'dir gnas sngags mang rnams nas chos thog steng / / 'grigs khrims bsdams nas mna' bcad tshags 'dzin byas/ / gzi bon mi gnas 'ga' yis 'grigs 'gal gyi/ / jag rkus chang dud g.yang gzhi blangs pa rnams/ /sngon gyi srol bzhin rgyu nor bshags pa dang / / phyin chad mna' tshig blangs nas dam bca' byus/ / da ni sngon med kha 'go yong ba 'di/ / skyabs mgon khyed kyi drin las gzhan na gang / /da ni sngags rgan rnams dang yon bdag kun/ / mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig gsol ba 'debs pa'i don/ / mgon khyed dbus gtsang phyogs su phebs gyur na/ / nged rnams mgon med mgon skyabs su la re/ / dmu rgod reb kong lha srin gnyis pa 'dir/ / chos gsungs kha gnon mdzad nas ma bzhugs na/ / 'thab rtsod 'khrugs long la sogs mi dge las/ / las la 'jol nyog spyod pa ma gzigs sam/ / chos mdzad rnams kung jag zas za ba'i dus/ / chos kyi bdag po gsan la phebs gyur na/ / chos min spyod pas rang gzhan gnyis phung nas/ /chos pa'i zhabs 'dren byed pa ma gzigs sam/ /dmu rgod yul 'dir byung chub sems dpa' rnams/ /dmyal ba'i me dong yin yang bzhugs gsungs na/ /phyogs 'di'i 'gro la brtse chen thugs rje yis/ / gzigs nas bzhugs dgos sngon gyi dam pa'i srol/ /sngon chad lan mang zhus kyang bka' mchid kyis/ / bdag sogs gnyis 'dzin the tshom chod ma gyur/ / deng dus nged cag sngags mang 'dus spyi nas/ / gsol ba btab na gsan nas bzhugs pa mkhyen/ /da dung phyogs 'di'i gdul byu ga la rdzogs/ /sngags pa sems ngo 'phrod pa gcig kyang med/ /bskyed rdzogs dmigs pa shes pa nyin skar tsam/ /dge sdig ngo mi shes pa bgrang las 'das/ /'di rnams chos gsungs khrid kyis ma bskyangs na/ /skyabs mgon phyogs 'din phebs pa'i bka' drin gang / / dper na grog tshang sa ༵ rdo blangs

ga / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzhin/ /skyabs mgon phyogs gzhan phebs na nged cag gi/ / chos pa 'jig rten pa rnams spyod ngan gyis/ /gcig za gnyis za byed pa'i dus kung 'byung / /mgon khyod bzhugs na pha ma yod pa'i dus/ /ngan lang mi 'chor lam la 'gro ba ltar/ /chos bzhin spyod cing chos ldan bya ba byed/ /de phyir dus kun bzhugs pa'i bka' drin skyongs/ /de ltar gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ / ma yis bu bzhin yal bar mi 'dor ban/ / mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i rdo rje'i khrir/ / bskal ba rgya mtshor brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /bzhugs nas bdag
