sogs ltos bcas sngags mang rnams/ / chos sped gnyis kyis bskyangs ka sna na gyu ra ci ga// /tshom bu gcig tu smin cing grol ba dang / /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su mgon rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ / pha 'gran gyi do med rdo rje 'chang / /mtshan snyan pa zhabs dkan rin po che'i/ / zhabs padmo dri ma med pa'i drung / / sa reb kong smad pa'i sngags mang nas/ / phyag dad pas sor bcu spyi bor zums/ / yid gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs pa la/ /dus yid tsam dgongs shig thugs rje can/ /bdag 'dir gnas slob ma yon bdag gis/ /lan mang por spyan drangs ma byon pas/ /sems yi chad drag pos smre sngags kyis/ / dus da yang yang bskyar spyan 'dren dgongs/ / lha snying rje'i bdag nyid pad dkar 'chang / /rang so skyes mchod pa'i skal dman yang / /dus skad cig spyan drangs 'byon nges na/ / khyed lan mang zhus 'bras gang du thal/ / mi 'jig rten pa yang tha tshig las/ /'da' mi dung 'das na khyel med lags/ / skyabs snying rje'i bdag nyid dam bca' las/ /'da' dung ngam sngon gyi zhal bzhes dgongs/ /sa dka nod reb kong sa cha 'dir/ /sdig spyad 'bras nad mug 'khrug rtsod kyis/ / yongs mnar ba'i tshul 'di mi gzigs na/ /mgon khyod kyi snying rje gang du thal/ / don de phyid da reb khrur gsungs bzhin/ / chibs kha lo phyogs 'din ma bsgyur na/ /nged slob ngan rnams kyi ske dus gcig /bcad tshar las ma 'das khyed rang mkhyen/ /mgon dam pa phyogs 'dir ma byon na/ /dpe pha mas bu phrug dor ba bzhin/ /dge mi sgrub sdig la gzhol bas na/ /don de phyin myud du phebs grogs mkhyen/ /dus da lta zhu tshig phul ba'i mthus/ /rje skyabs mgon gser zhal myud mjal nas/ /phyogs 'di nu chos kyi 'khod lo bskon/ / yongs 'gro rnams smin grol lam 'god shog /ngo bo gdod nas spros bral chos kyi sku/ / rang bzhin gsal la ma 'dres longs spyod rdzogs/ / thugs rje cir snang grol ba sprul ba'i sku/ / sku gsum yongs rdzogs skyabs mgon — 96 —

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /gang de'i drung / / gus phran dal khur ldan pa'i sngags mang nas/ / gus pas lha phyag dri med 'tshal bzhin du/ /gus btud gsol ba 'debs la brtsen dgongs nas/ /gus ldan yongs la thugs rjes byin rlabs stsol/ /gang de'i gsang gsum mdzad bzang rnam thar la/ /gang gi sa nas dpag par dka' mod kung / /gang thugs brtse ba chen pos nyer dgongs nas/ /gang sku phyogs 'dir bzhugs la dga' spro 'phel/ / 'di na grong sngags rnams ni 'du 'a stoms/ / 'di med phyi med ngang la nyin mtshan shor/ / 'di zhes ston rgyu med pa'i ngang la gnas/ /'di go slob ngan rnams kyi gnas tshul lags/ /skabs don skabs 'did nyid nas bka' drin bskyangs/ /dben gnas dben pa bkra shis 'khyil ba nas/ / rtag tu rtag par bzhugs 'di rab dga' nas/ / mtshams dang mtshams res la sogs ma chad tsam/ / yang yang sngon nas zhus pa'i don 'bras la/ / mdzes mdzes gzim kang bkod legs 'grub pa 'di/ /snyan snyan gtam gyis phyogs kun khyab pa'i che/ /nges nges phyogs 'dir bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ / bdag sogs rnams kyis ngal ba dang du blangs/ /blangs go chod pa bde can sa las grub/ /grub dang chabs gcig nyid kyang bzhugs la dga'/ /dga' bzhin 'grigs lam kun spyod gang zhib byed/ / slad nas gang gsungs sgrub rgyu'i khas len yod/ /yod kyang grong shan shor pas dka' snyam yang / / yang dag 'grigs lam bsdams tshe thugs zin nges/ /nges par che 'di don yod 'gyun snyam dga'/ / bdag sogs rnams kyi gtsug nor thugs rje can/ /slob ma rnams kyi snang ngor phyogs 'di du/ /dam pa rnams kyi(thub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho)phyag bzhes ji bzhin du/ / nang cag rnams kyi mgon du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ / mgon khyed phyogs 'dir rgyun du bzhugs gyur na/ / rang re'i phyogs 'din 'byor ba phra na yang / / reb kong phyogs 'dir nyid la dad pa mang / / mthun rkyen phyogs 'dir bsdus na cis mi rnyed/ /de phyir yul gzhan phebs 'dun mi gnang bar/ /rang cag yul 'dir rgyun du bzhugs dgos zhes/ / nged rang yul gnas sngags mang zhu lags na/ /snying rje'i yul du gzigs nas bzhugs par zhu/ /slad man gang sku rdo rje chos bdun du/ /mi 'jigs gdong lnga rdo rje'i khrir bzhugs nas/ /gsang sngags 'dus sde rdo rje slob ma rnams/ /thugs gsang dpal be'u rdo rje'i ra bad zungs/ /zhes pa'i zhu mchid dpyid kyi pho nya yis/ /lha rdzas gsol gon snye ma mchur thogs nas/ /skyabs rje'i mdun san ljon shing rtse mo nas/ /bris na~X sdus dar dir mchid 'di 'bul bar mdzod/ / 'di rnams sngags mang gi zhu thog tu lha snying rje'i mnga' bdag pad dkar 'chang / /mgon bshes gnyen dpa pa~X rnaX ༷la

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigasab/ /pha tshogs drug rang grol rin po che/ /bus snying nas dran no brtse bas skyongs/ /yul mtha' 'khob reb kong srin yul 'din/ /sdig spyod pa'i skye bos sa steng khengs/ /sgos dar grong sa na nag phyogs kyi/ / lha bsten nas dmar mchod mang po btang / / ma nyam thag rkang phran tshar gcod pa/ / 'di gzigs sam skyabs mgon snying rje'i gter/ / lha de yi bka' bzhin nyes med kyi/ / nor dngos po jag rkus thabs kyis blangs/ / chos dkan po dge la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /sdig mi dge sgrub 'di gzigs lags sam/ /lha dkon mchog mchod la mi rtsom pan/ / kho nag phyogs bsten la dmar mchod byed/ / nor stong tshe go log shan phyes nas/ / mi nyes med gleng 'gel na yang nyan/ / don blang don skabs su mi nges kyang / /gzhan mo rtsis mi byed lha bar 'dri/ / chos dkar po dge la bskul na yang / / kun mi 'du thabs kyis byol bar 'gyur/ / sdig sgrub mkhan lha bas gang bshad la/ / rang las don bzhag nas brtson 'grus byed/ /lha mchod pa'i dmar mchod dgos pa'i tshe/ /rang rgyu nor mi sems 'bad pas 'tshol/ /sdig de'i rkyen thams cad dbul zhing phongs/ /'di mi dge'i rnam smin yin nam skyo/ / rang nyams chung nyang gi sa cha yang / / sdig mi dge sgrub mkhan de rjes zhugs/ /'di ma byed byas kung kha mi len/ /da bya thabs med do skyabs mgon mkhyen/ /las dkar po dge la bskul na yang / / rang phyogs la 'ong ba gcig kung med/ / las nag po jag rkus byed pa'i phyogs/ /rang las don bskyur nas myur du rgyug /lar gang la bsam kung skyo ba skye/ /snying ma bde skabs ren mchi ma shor/ /thabs ma rnyed bla ma rin po cher/ /ngag gdungs pas 'o dod 'di ltan bos/ /don de phyir skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang / /lha phyag na padmo'i skur bzhengs nas/ 1 lha 'di la snying rje'i chu rgyun stsol/ /mi 'di rnams blo kha chos la sgyur/ /rje skyabs mgon dam pa'i byin rlabs dang / /lha dkad phyogs skyong ba'i mthu byin snro~X/sa/ // yul 'di yi sdig rgyun rab bcad nas/ / kun chos dang mthun par byin gyis rje snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / mgon tshogs drug nang grol zhabs la 'dud/ /'bangs mgon med bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho la/ / thugs brtse bas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ / bdag tshe sngon bsags rgyab dman pa'i mthus/ / sa mtha' 'khob nang nas yang 'khob 'din1 /rang lta spyod mi mthun lhan du skyes/ /sems rgya cher bskyed nas lha khang dang / /rten sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa grub/ /lha rdo rje phur pa'i chos thog btsugs/ /mi re re ka 8 du dpe cha bris/ / gzhan mkho ba'i yo byud gang dgos bsgrubs/ / las dge

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /sgrub sdig spong bslab bya bstan/ /chos log 'dren 'bad pas sgrub snyam yang / /bdud nag phyogs dam sris yid bskyod nas/ /gzhan sdig can dar grong rjes su zhugs/ /nga ban rgan phyogs la ltag pa bstan/ / jag rkus la song nas chos thog bcad/ / rang blo sems ma bde yid mug nas/ / lha yi dam chos skyong rgyud bskul yang / / mi sdig rgan rnams la rmi lam tsam/ /rtags cho 'phrul ma bstan 'o dod bos/ /sngags bstan pa'i srung ma ral gcig ma/ /gza' khyab 'jug dam can rdo rje legs/ /rje bla ma'i tha tshig ma g.yel bar/ /mi 'di rnams blo kha bsgyun re nan/ /khyed bag yengs bzhugs na bstan pa 'di/ /bdud dam sri'i dbang du 'gro nyen che/ /don de phyir gang 'tshams rtags mtshan ston/ /tshos dge rgyun tshugs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ /mgon rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /dpal mkha' 'gro chos ༈bye sdi~X shog yis// /phyogs 'di du dge ba'i rgyun tshugs nas/ /kun chos bzhin spyod pa'i byams snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / mgon bshes gnyen dam pa'i rnam nol ba/ /pha bla ma zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang / /steng spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /lha dkar phyogs rnams la dbang bzhi skur/ /yul 'di la byin rlabs chu rgyun stsol/ /sdeg mi dge'i rgyun bcad dge ba yis/ / phyogs kun tu khyab par byin gyis zlobs/ / sngon mi dge sdig pa'i las dbang gis/ / lha nag phyogs mchod tshe nad mtshon mang / / dus da lta skyabs mgon bka' drin gyis/ / lha dkan phyogs sgyur tshad bde zhing skyid/ / pha snying rje'i mnga' bdag zhabs dkar pas/ /lha lha zur dam bzhag byin gyis brlabs/ /yul dkar po dge la bsgyun ba'i tshe/ / mi bdag gi blo sems rab tu bde/ / lha de yis rgyu 'bras gsung phebs nas/ /sdig spangs shing dge la thabs kyis bsgyur/ /lo re re bzhin du ma ṇi bzung / /mi kun gyis lag na 'phreng ba 'dzin/ / chos sha stag sgrub pa dka' na yang / / blo chos la cung zad phyogs pa 'di/ / pha skyabs mgon dam pa'i bka' drin yin/ / 'di yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon dmar mchod mang po rgyag dgos pa/ /da mi gsod tshe thar byed pa 'di/ / pha skyabs mgon dam pa'i bka' drin yin/ / phyis sdig rgyun chad par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos rten bzhengs ma ṇi thugs rje yis/ /yul bde zhing lo legs byung ba 'di/ /pha skyabs mgon dam pa'i bka' drin yin/ / dus rgyun du spyid par byin gyis rlobs/ / lha dkad phyogs bsgyur pa'i thugs rje yis/ / spyod kha mchu med par bde ba 'di/ / pha skyabs mgon dam pa'i bka' drin yin/ / dus rgyun du bde bar byen gyis ba 9/9rje phyobs

sa 1 /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mgon dam pa'i byin rlabs dang / /lha lha zud phyug mo'i mthu stobs kyis/ /yul 'di du dam chos dar ba dang / / kun bde zhing spyid pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di yang dar grong lha bas dmar chod bcad pa la dga' nas snang mdzad rdo rjes sbyar/non gyi dngos grub stsol mdzad padma 'byung / / slar yang bshes gnyen tshul 'dzin drin can rje/ /dpal ldan bla ma padma nang grol la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dgos 'dod chan chen phobs/ /gang de'i bka' bzhin bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su/ /dbang phyug nor lha'i g.yang sgrub bgyis pa'i tshe/ /bar chad 'byung bo'i 'tshub slong ngang gis zhi/ /dngos grub thob pa'i rtags mtshan rmad du byung / / 'di ko mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin lags/ / de ltar nor sgrub byas pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen legs tshogs grub/ /gzhan yang nor sgrub byas pa'i dge ba yis/ / rgyul bstan dan rgyas bstan 'dzin sku tshe bzang / /yul phyogs kun la dbyig non 'dzad med sbyin/ / 'dzad pa med pa'i nor la mnga' brnyes skyid /pan /shog zhi/nga phongs pa'i ming yang mi grags shing / /rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing 'gro ba'i mgon po padma ku ra rje'i/ / byin rlabs zed gyis bskyangs pa'i sa skyong mchog/pā rin dza sag tā wang zhes grags drung 1 /zhu yig nol mo'i mchod pa deng 'dir spro/ /'di na sngags gzugs mtshams ming rgan po yis/ / reb kong sngags mang 'go 'dren rlom bzhin du/ / 'du shes gsum gyi spyod pas dus 'da' bzhin/ / 'du ba snyoms shing dge blo ma dor gnas/ / skabs don khyed nas mtshan sgogs phyag mdzod kyis/ / nga yi gnas tshul smras tshe thugs spro'i ngos/ / 'phreng ba dngul srang do dang lha rdzas bcas/ / gnang ba spyi bor 'byor bas dga' spro 'phel/ /dam pa gang de'i bsrung 'khor dgongs gsungs kyang / / brel ba'i dbang gis da res 'bul ma thub/ / rjes nas 'phrod nges zhig gi gdong nas 'bul/ /sngags bstan sgon zhugs dbang lhang gsan pa de/ /bskal brgyar bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu lags/ / yi dam lha la 'dor len med pas na/ / dang nyid gang mos lha de byin rlabs myur/ / 'on kung padma dbang chen bsnyen na legs/ / gzhi la rgyal chen phun kha'i ngo yod pa/ /bzlog phyin rta mgrin seng gdong bzlog bsgyun dang / /tshogs brgya la sogs rim gro bgyis na bzang / /rjes nas gang dgos gsung shog gnang ba sogs/ /phan tshun 'phros tshogs ga sgyu'i rgyun bzhin zhu/ / 'di nas skyabs 'jug yang dag sgrub nges lags/ / zhu 'de//sa gas0 rte/ rdon bzhi lha rdzas bcas/ / rang gnas bkra shis chos kyi gling nas phul/ /

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/'gro ba'i mgon po padma ku ra dang / / dbyen med grub dbang dpal chen nam mkha'i mtshan/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag tshogs drug nang grol rje/ /dngos brgyud bla mas byang chub bar du skyongs/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin rdo rje me chan gyis/ /phas rgol tshang tshing gzhom la ches dpa' ba'i/ / 'bum za bu brgyud phyogs kyi rig 'dzin sde'i/ / tshom bu lhan rgyas dbus su mchid 'di 'bul/ /khyed cag thugs gsang lha lam chu 'dzin las/ /gsung shog dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldin ba'i mod/ /'din gnas sngags 'chang gtsug phud 'dzin rnams kyis/ /nab tu dga' bas zlos gar cid yang bsgyur/ /o ṭi ya na'i zab chos spel mkhas pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin rim byon thugs kyi nal klung las/ / legs 'ong gdams pa dza hu'i bu mo'i rgyun/ /bdag sogs non 'dzin dga' mar bskyel 'di mtshar/ /snga 'gyur bka' babs bzhi yi nyal 'gro yis/ /rab smin yo ga gsum gyi nyams len mthil/ /tshe gcig 'tshang rgya'i gsang chen zab mo'i lam/ / nyams su len pa rang re'i skal ba'i chos/ / yin phyir der bzhugs rig 'dzin tshom bu rnams/ /dbang bzhi'i dam tshig gzhir bzhag bla ma yis/ /gnang ba'i bcas khrims zhib par gnang gyur na/ / las bzhi'i 'phrin las 'thub ces rgyal bas gsungs/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyon rdo rje rtse brgyu pa/ / rang cag dam ldan legs bris dbang bo yis /gsor che sbyin skyes phru ma yongs bcom nas/ /rgyal bstan rwa dza srid pa'i bla na mtho/ /sa skyong srog la bsdo ba'i nyes can dgra/ / nyams pa bdun ldan zhing bcu tshang pa 'di/ / chos srung rnams kyis bsgral pa'i 'os yin pas/ /'di nas las sbyon mtshon gyis cis mi sgrol/ /slad mar rang cag rdo rje mched grogs rnams/ / sa thag ring thung gnas kyis bskal na yang / /gsung skyes ga sgyu'i rgyun bzhin gnang ba'i ngor/ / thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / rtsa gsum lha dang chos srung tsha zen gyis/ / rang cag thun gsum mthar bskrad 'od zer gyis/ / gsang bstan padma'i tshal yangs rab bzhad nas/ / don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /thugs dgongs pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs/ / byams snying rje nyi 'od ltar gsal ba'i/ /pha skyabs mgon spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ / bu'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin dngos grub stsol/ /nang chung nas chos sgor zhugs rlom yang / /phyi thos pas sgro 'dogs chod ma gyur/ /nang bsam rgyu ma khom dpe thog lus/ /sgom 'dzin pas bcings nas rnam rtog mang / /dus da lta bla ma'i gsung ji bzhin/ / dang lus ngag yid gsum khong lhod nas/ / phyi'i rnam rto1 rjes su ma 'brang tsho/ /rang rig pa gsal stong rjen pa mthong / /sngar sbug btsi~X ga1 pa'

ga / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'ching ba de/ / phas legs bshad gser gyi thun mas phye/ / da gsal stong rjen pa'i dga' ston la/ / rang spyod tshe gu yangs blo re bde/ / don ched du gnyer nas blta ma dgos/ /sems gang dgar bzhag pas chog par gda'/ /skabs la lar rnam rtog phyi la 'brang / /ci 'di yin med par lus pa'i tshe/ / den cer gyis bltas pas rang sar grol/ / yang skabs rer the tshom skyes pa'i che/ /gsung lta mgur sogs la cung bltas tshe/ /rang gol sa med snyam blo re bde/ / dus da dung brtan pa ma thob pas/ / sgom 'dzin pas bcing che ma bcos pan/ /rang rjen par bzhag kyang 'gyun sdog che/ / 'did gegs sel bogs 'don skyabs 'jug zhu/ / sems cung zhig brtan pa thob pa'i tsho/ / nang 'gro 'dug spyod lam sna tshogs skabs/ /sgom ma dgos par yang 'chad snyam gda'/ /de don thog khel ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /dus da nas tshig phyid mi 'brang bar/ /don rang gnas bsam gtan ngang nyid du/ /'jog dgos snyam dam bca' snying la yod/ / de mtha' du phyin pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /skabs la lar bla ma dran pa dang / /ma 'gro la bcos min snying rje dang / /rang blo sna thung zhing skyo shas 'byung / / de 'gyur ldog med pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / rjer gsol btab dbang blangs thugs yid bsres/ /de'i ngang la sprul sgyur la sogs pa/ /mgon khyod gsungs bzhin du mos blo byus/ / der brtan pa thob pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / dus da nas brtan pa ma thob bar/ /mgon khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang / / gsung bzhin du rtogs pa gong 'phel nas/ /tshe 'di du 'tshang rgya'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / rang cung zad rtogs tshul zhus pa'i mthus/ /pha bla ma'i thugs kyi rtogs pa de/ /rang rgyud la myur du 'thob nas kyang / /mgon khyod dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bsru med bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /'bral med spyi gtsug rgyun du bzhugs/ / thar med 'khon ba'i btson khang du/ /dbang med 'dug pa'i rnal 'byon bdag /zla med bla ma'i zhabs zin dus/ / yengs med sgrub la brtson par mdzod/ / khrel med pha tshan sdig can rnams/ / nyes med zas nor 'phrog pa mthong / / bzod med skyo shas gting nas skyes/ /zhen med yal bar dor na 'dod/ / mnar med sdug bsngal rgyu sgrub pa'i/ / dad med mi la snying rje skyes/ / g.yo med blo sna chos phyogs su/ / 'gags med bsgyur 'di bla ma'i drin/ /ris med skyabs mgon bla ma rjes/ / tshad med thugs rjes rab dgongs la/ / 'di med phyi med 'di dag gi /bag med sdig 'phro rab bcad nas/ /bcos med dad pas khyed gsungs ba/ 10/ ༵na med jag rkus rab spangs nas/ / yengs med sgrub la brtson par shog /

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /rtsa gsum 'dus sbu dngos grub gter gyi mdzod/ /re sa'i skyabs mgon zhabs dkad rdo rje 'chang / / grub dbang padma nang grol yab sras la/ / gsol ba 'debs so byang chub bar du skyongs/ /bdag sogs dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /skyabs mgon dam pa zung gis thugs rjes gzigs/ /las ngan 'khor ba'i 'dam du ma 'jog par/ /bde chen thar ba'i skam sar lhad du drongs/ /bdag gis bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /'bral med rtag tu rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /tha chad mi dge'i g.yeng ba'i dbang song na/ /blo ka chos la sgyud cig bla ma rje/ / mi dge grogs kyis 'khor ban 'khrid pa na/ / sdig grogs dbang du ma gtong bla ma rje/ /dad dang snying rje byang sems rgyun bskams na/ /bsil ba'i chu rgyun stsol cig bla ma rje/ / las ngan dbang gis log lta skye srid na/ / yid ches dad pa stsol cig bla ma rje/ /log 'tsho sdig zas ngan pas bsnyegs pa na/ / thabs kyis bral bar mdzod cig bla ma rje/ /mthun rkyen med par dbul zhing phongs pa na/ /chos mthun 'tsho ba stsol cig bla ma rje/ /nang rig nang ngo ma shes 'thims pa na/ /gsal stong rjen pa ston cig bla ma rje/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa dang 1 /khyod dang mtshungs par mdzod cig bla ma rje/ /mdor na gang bsam thams cad myur 'grub pa'i/ / bkra shis dge mtshan stsol cig bla ma rje/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsol mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ / tshe dang ye shes dpag med rgyal ba dngos/ /tshe gcig grub brnyes dpal ldan bla mar 'dud/ /tshe yi dngos grub myur du bstsal du gsol/ /tshe 'dir chos srid gang yang ma zin cing / 1tshe ring nad med 'dod kyang na zug mang / / tshe sdug bu nga thugs kyis ma 'dor bar/ / tsho ring lus sems bde bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon las dus smin snga sor nad kyis btab/ /sngon gyi nad gzhi'i tha ma rlung gzer zhig /sngon bzhin da lta byung nas 'chi la nye/ /sngon ltar skyabs rjes nad 'di myur du sol/ /'di na na 'chis gtug pa'i slob ngan la/ /pha yul yul ngan mi tshos bslab byu ni/ /dug cher dzer ma lta bu mang ston yang / / ma nyan nyan na dam pas khrel ba'i rgyu/ / pha mes gong mas gdan rdol ngag nus thon/ / khyod nang lo ltar 'bri rgyu'i nang na brel/ / zer yang ma nyan bla ma'i phyag dpe 'bri/ /ngag nus med na bla mas nus pa stsol/ /sngon mas grong chog bdas nas rgyu nom btsal/ /khyod rang grong chog mi 'gro zas nor zad/ /zed yang ma nyan bla ma'i zhabs tog sgrub/ / zas nor zad na bla mas dngos grub stsol/ / sngon mas mthu sgrub rtags thon gzhan rnams 'jigs/ /khyod rang rnga skad tsam yang sgrogs mi shes/ /zer yang ma nyan ba phran yal bar dor/ /mthu nus med na bla mas mthu nus stsol/ /sngon mas dgra 1gci ba

sa / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skyong rang las rem/ / khyod rang khyim tshang don la bslab byu med/ / zen yang ma nyan bla ma'i bka' chos bsdu/ / dbul zhing phongs na bla mas zas nor stsol/ / sngon mas rten bzhengs las kung rang don sgrub/ / khyod rang rgyun du sa las 'dam las bskul/ / zer yang ma nyan gzer rag 'an du las/ /'chi la thug na bla mas nad las grol/ /sngon mas sha bzan bshas nas kha spyid rgyag /khyod nang chos pa yin zen lug mi bsha'/ /zer yang ma nyan shi yang sdig la 'dzem/ / rlung gis shi na bla mas lam sna drongs/ / sngon mas na tsha byung dus sku rim bca'/ /khyod dang ngad glud tsam yang bsngo mi shes/ / zer yang ma nyan bla man gsol ba 'debs/ / gdon gyis gtses na bla mas rtag tu skyobs/ / pha mes sngon mar mi mthun rang tshugs can/ /gzhan gyi chos sar mi mthun yul na lus/ /da lta'i sdig grogs mi bsnyun rgyab ston pas/ /tha chad bdag 'drar bla mas thugs rjes gzigs/ /da dung bla mas drin gyis ma shi na/ / sngar bzhin bla ma'i gsung 'bum bsdu snyam yod/ / nad 'di myud du sos nas lus sems bde/ /'di phyi kun tu bde ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /de ltar spyid sdug bla man zhus pa'i mthus/ / 'gro kun skyid cing chos dang mthun par shog / ces pa 'di yang shing rta'i lo na bzhin phyag dpe bris pa la las srel brdas byas dus snang mdzad rdo rjes bris/pha dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rin po che/ / bu bdag rgyud la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /steng 'od gsal gyi nyi ma nub rid yib/ /lho 'dzam gling la mun pa'i bskal pa byung / /dbyur nam zla yi rgyal mos nang yul bsnyegs/ / kho rtsi shing la mi rtag bskul ma byung / / pha bla ma rnams gzugs sku dbyings su bsdus/ / rang slob ma yis gsung dbyangs go skabs bral/ /lus bskyed byed kyi pha ma chung dus shi/ /bu dwa phrug nga skyong ba'i skal ma ldan1 /khog don snying dang 'dra ba'i khu bo lus/ / bdag gtol med du sdug bsngal khang bur chud/ / khyim bza' tshang rnams rim bzhin so sor bral/ / khyim stong ba ru rang nyid gcig pun lus/ / grogs gzhungs bzang rnams shi bral gson bral gyur/ / rang mi rtag pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas song / /dus kun tu rang mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /gar song ba dang bsdad kung khu bo dran/ /ci byed pa dang 'dug kung grogs po dran/ /mi 'chi tshul la bltas tshe mi rtag dran/ /pha mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ / bu nyam chung gi skyed sdug khyed rang shes/ /gangs can mgon po spyan nas gzigs dbang dang / /dbyer med skyabs mgon zhabs dkan rdo rje 'chang / /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes nyer dgongs nas/ /bdag sogs ba ga0 rten ba grub stsol/ /skyabs rje dam pa gang de'i tha ma yi1 /mdzad pa bstan

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /pa'i bas mtha' nyams dga' ban/ /ma yig rang byon gsal ba'i spang gzhong du/ /skyabs mgon sku yi me tog thor ba'i sar/ / rjes 'jug gdul bya'i bsod nams bsogs pa'i rten/ /sku gdung mchod rten bzhengs rgyu'i skal ba byung / / rgyal po tsho 'du byang zub la sogs pa'i/ / dad 'dus pho mo brgya phrag du ma yis/ / lnga ba'i tshes gcig nyin par rmang btings nas/ /bzhengs pa'i skabs su rgyun du 'ja' tshon shan/ / sa rdo skyel mi kun gyis nam mkha' la/ / blta zhing bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / / mchod rten gzungs gzhug la sogs las khur gyi/ / 'go 'dren bdag dang slob ma 'ga' yis byus/ / nang na byin rten khyad 'phags mang po bzhugs/ / mthun rkyen nong 'brog yon bdag rnams kyis phul/ 1 legs pan thub tshe rgyal po'i sngags mang dang / / lhan du rab gnas me tog gtor ba'i tshe/ / nam mkhar 'ja' tshon bkra zhing me tog gi/ /char babs nyi gzhon lam lam shan ba byung / /den 'tshogs dad 'dus sum brgyu lhag tsam gyis/ /rab tu dad pas phyag mchod bskor ba byas/ /bsngo ba smon lam rgya cher btab nas su/ /dga' zhing spro bas bkra shis brjod pa byung / /de ltar mchod rten bzhengs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shing / /bdag sogs 'khor gyi thog mad skyes nas kyang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams de du 'dren par thog / mchod rten 'di la rab tu dad pa'i sgos/ / sa rdo khur sogs ngal ba byas pa dang / /rgyu nor phul dang rjes su yi rang ba/ /kun kyang las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag pan shog /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir snyigs ma'i rgud pa zhe/ /char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /rdzogs ldan dus bzhin bde zhing spyid pa dang / /phun tshogs dpal la nol ba'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di yang ma bo skyabs nas bris/bla ma'i gdan sa'i rtse nas sprin dkan zhig /nam mkhar 'phyun ba mthong ba'i rkyen byas nas/ / mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yid la shar/ / bka' drin dran nas mig nas mchi ma shor/ /bla ma'i sku yi dbyibs dang gsung gi gdangs/ / thugs kyi byams brtses bskyangs tshul yid la shar/ / skyabs mgon dam pa mngon dga'i 'ing du gshegs/ / bu ngan da lta 'khor ba'i 'dam du lus/ /rab mdzes me tog mang po mthong ba'i tsho/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i mdzes sku yid la shad/ /gzugs sku da mthong ma red de mthong red/ /bsams shing mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ /khu byug sngon mas gsung snyan sgrogs pa'i dus/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung dbyangs yid la shar/ /gsungs dbyangs da thos ma red de thos red/ /bsams shing mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ / rab gsal sprin bral nyi ma mthong ba'i tshe/ /ba ༵na phyo ga'i

sa 1 nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thugs gsang yid la shar/ /thugs rjes da spyong ma red de skyong red/ /bsams shing mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ / nyi gzhon 'od snang lam lam shan ba'i tshe/ / mtshan ldan bla ma'i mkhyen brtse yid la shar/ / brtse bas da gzigs ma red de gzigs red/ / bsams shing mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ / skabs skabs mdun du song nas mjal pa'i tshe/ / 'dzum 'dzum bsu ba byed tshul yid la shar/ / bla mar da mjal ma red de mjal red/ / bsams shing mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ /'dod pa'i don 'bras legs nyes zhu dus su/ /legs nyes bslab ston gnang tshul yid la shar/ / bslab don da gnang ma red de gnang red/ /bsams shing mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ / lo re bzhin du dad 'dus mang po la/ / dam chos char ba phab tshul yid la shar/ /bka' chos da gnang ma red de gnang red/ /bsams shing mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ /bka' chos skabs su dad ldan mched lcam rnams/ /bla ma'i drung du 'tshogs tshul yid la shar/ / mched lcam da 'tshogs ma red de 'tshogs red/ /bsams shing mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ / slob ma rnams la gsung gleng snyan mo yis/ /dbugs dbyung dga' spro byus tshul yid la shar/ /gsung gleng da thos ma red de thos red/ /bsams shing mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ / kye ma kye hud skal chad las ngan ngas/ / non bu lag na yod pa lag nas shor/ / da ni mgon med mgon skyabs su la re/ / mi mngon dbyings nas gzigs sam skyabs mgon rje/ / snyigs ma'i rgud pas nyam thag gdul bya rnams/ /lam ston dge ba'i bshes kyis bod ba'i tshe/ /slar yang sprul ba'i sku mchog nyi gzhon gyis/ / gdul bya'i pad tshal skyongs shig skyabs mgon rje/ / de ltar bdag gis gdung dbyungs blangs pa'i mthus/ /bla ma zhing khams gang na bzhugs pa'i drung / /bu nga skyes nas zhal mjal gsung thos nas/ / 'gro rnams bla ma'i drung du 'dren par shog / ces gdung dbyangs 'di ni snang mdzad rdo rjes gle skya'i sgang nas blangs pa'o/ /pha dran pa'i gdung sel rin po che/ / mgon tshogs drug nang grol spyi bor bzhugs/ /mi bdag dang bdag 'dra'i rnam g.yeng mkhan/ /sems skyo ba skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nga nyin gcig gles mgo'i ri rtser phyin/ / sems gtan la phab nas bsam blo btang / / sngar 'grogs tshad bza' tshang dun gyis dran/ /sems skyo nas smre sngags dbyangs su byer/ /sngon pha ma khu mdzad 'dzoms pa'i dus/ /sbra thang sprug kha du spang la brgyang / /zog khya khyu mang pos sa steng bkang / / khyim bza' tshang go re sgyu ler 'dzoms/ / gcig gcig la brtse tshul yid la shad/ 10/6du1 da lta 'dzoms na dga' ba la/ / ngas kun kyang byams pas bskyangs na

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /'dod/ /dus ban du nged cag khu dbon 'dzoms/ / dbyur khams sang gle'i mgo'i sa 'dir byas/ /ma yan ma bzang mo khyim bdag tu/ /byas yod dus sngon bsu lhag 'jam smra/ /nang ma las lhag pa'i drin can de/ /dus da lta yod na dga' ba la/ /ngas drin lan byams pas bskyangs na 'dod/ /de'i rjes nas nged cag khu mdzad gnyis/ /chos mthun pa'i byu bzhag mang po bsgrubs/ /skabs rnams su ri rtser skyo sangs phyin/ /gtam gleng mo byus tshul yid la shan/ /dus da lta yod na dga' ba la/ /nga zhabs tog chung dung bkur snying 'dod/ /rang gces par bskyangs nas yi ge bslabs/ / chen lon tshe bslab byus dbugs dbyung byas/ /rang bya bzhag che bzhag chung skyun byus1 / nged khu mdzad glo bun so sor bral/ / dus ring du sdod pa'i blo rgya bskyed/ / nang yo byad kun la tshags 'dzin byas/ / rang 'chi brod dam chos phyi 'then mdzad/ / nged khu mdzad glo bud so sor bral/ / phyi 'dul ba'i chos kyis sku lus gtsang / / nang rig gnas yon tan non gyis phyug / rgyud 'jam zhing gzhan yid dge la sbyor/ / ngag nus pa che bas thub rtags thon/ / dus snyigs ma'i sems can mgon gcig pu/ /khong nyin byed 'od snang 'bad ba can/ / dus da lta chu lha'i pang du gzim/ / da shar phyogs sa 'dzin phrag pa nas/ / 'od gsal ler byon na dga' ba la/ / ngas sngar bzhin gtsug tu brgyan na 'dod/ / nga da lta mgon med skyabs med du/ / ri mthon po'i rtse du bye'u bzhin/ /dus lan gcig bud dus sems skyo nas/ /sngar tshogs tshad bza' tshang thams cad dran/ /yang dgos su khu bo dur gyis dran/ /sngad song tshul bsdad tshul thams cad dran/ /sems skyo shas dran pa'i sprin nag cig /dus da lta ya thod skya mor 'khrigs/ /mig mchi mas chan rgyun drag po yis/ / rgyud pyong bo'i zhing sa brlan pa'i mthus/ / chos mi rtag lha gu sor gsum skyes/ /de rtag 'dzin sen bas mi bcom par/ /tshos thar ba'i 'bras bzang legs smin nas/ / ma 'gro ba'i gsos su 'gyun bad shog /'khor ba'i chos rnams rgyab tu don byus nas/ /phyi ma'i sa lam dang du len mkhan rje/ /'gran gyi do med 'dul 'dzin rin po che/ / dar cig nga yi smre sngags 'di la gson/ / 'di na 'di med phyi med gyi na ba/ / 'chi bdag bdud kyis ma zin lus bde yang / / sems la bde ba'i skabs med duḥkhas mnar/ / zhi ban gshegs pa'i khu bo drin can de/ / nyin mtshan dus drug sems kyis mi brjed 'dug / gcig pur grogs med bsdad che yang yang dran/ /mig nas mchi ma ma thor nyi ma med/ / mtshan mo gnyid yar nyin par zas mi dran/ /rmi lam du yang zhal mja' gsung thos pa/ / nga yi sems gsor byon snyam 11 ga |༵ dran / /

na / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir nyin zhag re re la/ / yig brgya brgya re ma ṇi stong tsho re/ / dong sprugs tshan re thar mdo gnyis gsum re/ /sgrol ma bcu re 'don pa'i dam bca' byus/ /rmi lam du yang skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rjes/ / bdag dang lhan du rdon sems bum sgrub byas/ /zhi bar gshegs la khrus gsol byed pa dang / / nyid kyi khri steng gdan phyed bzhag nas su/ /rigs lnga la sogs chos 'jug rgyan byus nas/ /zhabs phyi rnams la mjal du 'jug pa rmis/ / de la bltas na sa lam thob snyam dga'/ / bshes gnyen khyed nas thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs phyin/ /bsngo smon la sogs dus rgyun gnang ba dang / /thugs nas mi 'dor ba yi skyabs 'jug zhu/ / zhes bla mchod dar grong a lags la phul/lha snying rje'i gter gcig spyan nas gzigs/ / de dbyer med zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang / / de'i thugs gras sna tshogs rang grol rje/ / bdag spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi kho bo snang mdzad rdo rje la/ /rtags rten 'brel e ma ngo mtshar rmad/ /bod mkhas pa mi gsum bzhugs pa yi/ / gnas khyad 'phags a chung gnam rdzong 'dir/ /mtshams dge sbyor byed pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /nyams snang ba spro zhing lus sems bde/ /nang dge sbyor byed 'dod shugs kyis byung / / 'di rje btsun bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ / lha rta phag bsnyen pa bye ba gcig /dpal phud pa'i bsnyen pa 'bum gten gcig /rje bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa'i phyin/ / byang sgra mi snyan gyi tshe gzungs 'bum/ / rje sna tshogs rang grol gtso byas pa'i/ / khong sprul sku rnams nas gsung bskul ltar/ / rje grub thob brgyad cu la sogs pa'i/ / lha yi dam mang po'i dbang dang ni/ / lung mang po zla gcig legs par phul/ /gnas de yi byen rlabs kad byung bas/ /nang don gnyis lhun gyis thub pa byung / /rang skal ba bzang po'i glu dbyungs 'di/ / gnas gnam rdzong dpal gyi rtse mo nas/ / lo bdun cu'i steng nas blangs pa dge /tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das/ / tshe lo stong phrag thub pa'i slob dpon dpal/ / che dbang stsol mdzad tshogs drug rang grol rje/ / che lha rgya mtshos tsho yi dngos grub stsol/ / tshe gcig grub brnyes sna tshogs rang grol drung / / tshe lo mthar phyin snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ / tshe snying ring gzungs 'bum phrag phul ba'i mthus/ / tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes nas bzhugs gsol 'debs/ / tshe lha rnam gsum la sogs lha rnams dang / / che dbang rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas sogs/ / tshe la dbang ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams kyis/ / tshe dang ye ba ba 1 ༵sa ba grub stsol/ / tshe dbas 'bral med dpal ldan bla ma yis/ / tshe chos

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /nor sogs 'bad med lhun grub nas/ /che 'di nyid la 'gro khams rgya mtsho rnams/ /tshe ring bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog / ces snang mdzad rdo rjes gnam rdzong rtse nas phul/gnas chen khyad 'phags a zung gnam rdzong gi/ / bla ma lha dang chos srung gnas bdag rnams/ /rjes su bzhag nas yong ba phangs na yang / /rang yul phyogs la 'gro ba'i dus tshod byung / / de na bzhugs pa'i bla ma mched grogs dang / / bral ba'i skyo ba byung yang bya thabs bral/ / da ni khyed rnams bde bar bzhugs mdzod dang / / mi rgan nga yang reb kong phyogs su 'gro/ / zhal ni yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ / bkra shis chos mthun sgo nas mjal bar smon/ / sa ni kha thag ring zhing mi rgan nga / / rgas pas non nas lha 'dir ma mjal na/ / phyi ma dag pa'i zhing nas mjal bar shog / gnam rdzong nas yong khar bris/mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan kun mnga' zhing / / skal ldan 'gro la chos kyi char 'beb pa'i/ /sprul ba'i sku mchog gang de'i zhabs kyi pad/ /mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri'i drung du/ /chung nas chos tshugs ma zin grong nas lus/ /cha lugs chos par 'dzin pa'i rgan po yis/ /bla man 'os kyang slob ma'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /skyes mchog de la brtse ba'i bslab bya 'bul/ /lta ba mkha' ltar mtho yang snyigs dus 'dir/ /spyod pa bag phye las kyang zhib dgos zhes/ / o rgyan chen pos gsungs phyir so thar gyi/ / dam sdom lhod du ma 'jug snying gi gtam/ /skye srid gong ma'i mtshan gyis rwab bsngags shing / /chos brgyad spengs nas bya btang tshul 'dzin pa/ /ngo mtshar che bas dang don ma 'grub pan/ /gzhan don ltar snang ma dga' snying gi gtam/ /gsang sngags chos sgor zhugs kyang gsang spyod sogs/ /'gro don la gnod spangs nas sdom gsum gyis/ / brgyan na bstan pa'i mig ltos mchog yin pas/ /dam sdom srog bzhin srungs shig snying gi gtam/ / chos la bzang ngan phyogs ris ma byed par/ /rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su longs/ /spang blang ma byed chos rnams thams cad la/ /bag chags ci thebs mdzod cig snying gi gtam/ /yi dam lha yi bsnyen mtshams mthar phyin na/ / zhi rgyas dbang drag gang dgos sgrub nges pas/ / lha sgom sngags bzlas la sogs 'bad pa'i phyir/ /gcig pur bsnyen mtshams gal che snying gi gtam/ /sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyangs gnad smin sngon song nas/ / dngos ga'i khregs chod thod rgal la sogs pa/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len la gzhol nas/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrubs shig snying gi gtam/ /skal ldan slob ma'i 'du tshogs skyong ba'i che/ / skyon mtshang sun dbyung snod la brtags nas su/ /rang rang blo kha dang 'tshams dbang lung sogs/ /zab rgyas ba ga~Xrdo zhi1 snyeng

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo ji'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gi gtam/ / mgon khyod mdzad 'jin phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i phyir/ /'phags nor bdun gyi grangs kyi snying gtam 'bul/ /dge bas mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ma lags skal ldan la phul/rgyal kun snying rje'i gter chen pad dkar 'chang / / rgyal sras ngur sprig gar nol zhabs dkar rje/ /rgyul kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor phyag byas nas/ /rgyul ba'i rnam 'phrul dam pan bslab byu 'bul/ /dab dman nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ /nab mtho bla mar 'os kyang slob ma'i tshul/ / rab dang phul byung ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis/ / rab tu bskul ba'i gsung ngo ma bcag par/ /dab 'byums rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin tshig 'di 'bul/ /dam pa nyid nas dal ba'i rten bzang thob/ / thob che gsang sngags sgrub pa snying bor mdzad/ /mdzad bzang thos bsam sgom dang lta sgom spyod/ /spyod lam yo ga gsum gyi don la gzhol/ /de phyir bdag 'dra'i gdams pa dgos lhang yang / /yang zab gdams pa rdo rje rtse brgya mchog/mchog gi rnal 'byor mig stong ldan pa'i phyag / phyag len phul bas sbyin skyes gzhom 'di rmad/ /bla ma mchog la mi phyed dad pa dang / /yi dam mchog la bsnyen skrub tshad du bskyal/ /bstan srung mchog la gsol mchod 'bad pa na/ / rnal 'byod mchog gi las bzhi'i 'jin las 'grub/ /rang don mngon gyur gzhan don gsang ba'i tshe/ /che gcig 'tshang rgya'i thabs mchog dbang lung rgyun/ /rgyun mar gnang nas snod ldan slob ma kun/ /kun bzang dang ngo 'phrod pa'i thabs la 'bod/ /slad mar gang sbu dpag bsam ljon pa la/ /rgyun mar brtan pa'i thabs la 'bad pa dang / / du mar 'gro don gnang ba'i skabs rnams su/ / yar man gang nas 'gal spong mthun sgrub gal/ / gzhan gyi mig ngor spyod lam gang zhib dang / /gzhan snang zil gnon phyir du tshul 'chos dang / / gzhan rnams dang ba 'dren pa byus gyur na/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las lhun grub gdon mi za/ /gdan sa gsar 'dzin don du bsangs gser skyems/ / gdan sa'i rtse nas o rgyan sku 'bum dang / / gdan sa'i 'gab tu dam sri mnan pa sgrub/ /gdan sar tshogs brgyu sogs la 'bad na bzang / /bzang bzang gnas mchog gsang sngags chos gling du/ /yang yang rig 'dzin tshogs rnams 'du ba dang / /zab zab gsang bstan bhā dza srid na mtho/ / legs legs bkra shis legs tshogs gong 'phel shog/rnga ba'i bla ma ngag dbang 'jigs med la phul/ skyabs gnas bsru med bla ma bka' drin can/ / mtshan du gsol na tshogs drug rang ba / 11/hūm̐ gsag bde chen 'khor lo'i spyon du bzhugs/ / bu la byin rlabs dngos grub

mgur tshogs kyi bzhugs so/ /char du bsnyil/ / chung nas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen pan rdzogs/ / yongs 'dzin bcu phrag gsum gyi zhabs pad bsten/ / ris med gsar rnying chos la 'brel ba bzhag / tshul 'di bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ / bla ma rnam gsum dgyes phyir phyag dpe bris/ /skyabs mgon gsung 'bum bka' yi bsdu ba byas/ /bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas rjes su bzung ba yi/ /tshul 'di bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /reb kong sngags mang ma ka'i sgrub chen btsugs/ / byang chub dan grong gnyis la ma ṇi btsugs/ / dung phyun mang po sgrub pa'i skal ba byung / / tshul 'di bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ / lha khang mchod rten ma ṇi gsan du bzhengs/ /rten bzhengs brgya rtsa tsam la gzungs gzhug dang / /'bum khang brgya rtsa lhag la srog shing phul/ / tshul 'di bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ / bla ma'i sprul sku bco lnga gtso byas pa'i/ /sngags mang phur thogs stong la dbang lung byas/ /skye bo brgya phrag mang por chos bshad byas/ / tshul 'di bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ / kun kyang thabs kyis dge la bskul nas su/ /dge ba'i khas len mang po byas pa dang / /dge sgrub sdig spong byed pa mang po byung / / tshul 'di bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ / yang gsang rdzogs pa chen por nyams len byus/ / khyegs chod thod rgal gnyis la mos blo byas/ / gu yangs blo bde'i ngang la gnas pa byung / /tshul 'di bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bshes gnyen dam par mjal/ / myur lam che gcig 'tshang rgya'i gdams pa thob/ /'chi khan mi 'a spyod tsam gyi blo gdeng rnyed/ /tshul 'di bsam na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /de ltar 'dun ma legs pa'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /snang mdzad rdo rjes re ༵nā1 sa rgya sa tho ba par/ shog/dge /bas bdag sogs don gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /tshe 'di nyid kad byung bsod nams ye shes khams las grub/ /'gro kun pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /skyabs mgon nam mkha'i nor bu zhabs dkar pa/ /deng 'dir dran no bdag blo'i pad tshal skyongs/ / rang gis rang la gros shig ma btab na/ / gzhan na gros 'debs dben pa'i da lta rang / /sha tsha'i snying gtam 'chi med nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /tsikta'i 'dzin mar phab 'di 'dren par mdzod/ / da' 'byod thob kyang le los dus 'da' zhing / / bgrang bya mthan son lnga ba'i lam nye che/ / thos mang ci byu bla ma'i pham phab(pha 'bab)kyi/ / u ba de sha deng 'din dran par mdzod/ / 'chi nges nam 'chi cha med 'chi dus su/ / nor rdzas smug 'dzin dbang po dang 'bral yang / /skyur nas 'gro na nor sgyus ci zhig bya/—/de 1ka 1 'phag sa

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom rtsogs bsgrigs/pa'i nor bdun yod na dga'/ /bcu phrag sas bstad gtug pa'i 'dug yun ni/ 1e yod med na ma na ma shi gong / /ma hwa pa lha'i nyams len ma byas na/ /ya ma rā dza slebs tshe ci zhig byed/ /lha rnams bla ma sngags rnams gsol 'debs dang / /nyams len sems ngo skyong rgyur bsdu skabs 'dir/ /rang sems ma bcos rig pa'i ngo bo la/ /ltos dang nam zhig 'bras bu bka med thob/ / da nas phyi rtsis 'dun ma mi byed pan/ / la gor 'chi ba soms dang blo sna thung / / phyi ma'i lam rgyags nyams len 'bad nus na/ / gtan du bde bas de ltar 'bad par mdzod/ / tshul 'di bla ma zhabs dkar slob bu yis/ / lnga lam phyogs la nye che rang nyid la/ / dran pa'i lcag 'debs ched du bris pa 'di/ / 'dren byed lam du longs dang gtan 'dun 'grub/ /'di ni bdun cu'i steng nas bris pa'i dges/ /rang gzhan yongs la phan thogs 'byung ban shog /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan grub pa'i dbang / / rig 'dzin tshogs drug dang grol spyi bor bzhugs/ /bdag dang slob ma yon bdag thams cad la/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byin rlabs dngos thub stsol/ / nol 'byor nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ / mgur chung stong skor slob ma yon bdag la/ / 'phral phugs phan pa'i bslab bya 'di ltan smra/ / dngos mjal lta bur nyon cig skal ldan rnams/ /dal 'byor bco brgyad mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i lha chos sgrubs shig lkal ldan rnams/ / yun ring mi 'dug 'chi ba myud du yong / /rnam dkar dge ba sgrubs shig skal ldan rnams/ / chos thog dus bzang tshos bcu la sogs pa/ /sngad yod nyams su ma 'jug skal ldan rnams/ /sgyung gnas bsnyen gnas ma ṇi la sogs pa/ /gong nas gong 'phel mdzod cig skal ldan rnams/ /dkon mchog mchod dang ngan slong sbyin gtong sogs/ / rgyun du dran par mdzod cig skal ldan rnams/ / blo rtse bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gtod/ / nam yang bslu ba med do skal ldan rnams/ / kun gyis kha 'khon lag 'dzing ma byed par/ / thams cad mthun par 'grogs shig skal ldan rnams/ / srog gcod rku 'phrog la sogs sdig pa'i las/ / srog la babs kyang ma byed skal ldan rnams/ /chang dang tha ma kha sogs ma rwab zas/ / dug bzhin spong bar gyis shig skal ldan rnams/ /dkar po dge ba'i phyogs la dad pa na/ /bkra shis bde legs 'byung ngo skal ldan rnams/ /bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang / / bsam pa dkad po mdzod dang skal ldan rnams/ /nga dang 'phrad kyang bslab byu 'di min med/ / 'di rnams yid la zungs shig skal ba ga1/ 2 /ba ni rgas shing lus kyi stobs nyams kyang / / khyed cag yul du 'ong ba'i

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ 1smon lam 'debs/ / gal te ma mjal shi yang kha chems la/ / 'di'i lhag bshad rgyu med do skal ldan rnams/ / dge 'dis 'brel thogs slob ma yon bdag rnams/ / gnas skabs tshe ring nad med stobs 'byor rgyas/ /mthar thug zhing khams lnga du lhan cig 'dzoms/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal thob shog /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /nang gis rang la khrel brdas byed/ /dad pa med cing sdig la dga'/ /'chi khar 'gyod 'di sgong re che/ /chog shes med par sems rgya che/ /kun slong ngan 'di pyong re che/ / thos pas khengs shing lhag la dga'/ / man ngag mi lta spyong re che/ /rlom pa'i bdud langs sgom bsran chung / /shes rab chung 'di kyong re che/ /sngags la gshe zhing dam chos spangs/ / yid ches med 'di khyong re che/ / dad pa med cing skyon la brtags/ /man ngag mi mthun pyong re che/ /dal 'byor thob kyang le lor lus/ / byus pa don med lhong re che/ /rgas pas non tshe 'chi la skrag /'chi bro chos med phyong re che/ /dang la gar 'gro'i gdeng med par1 / gzhan la chos bshad gyong re che/ / nam 'chi cha med shes ༵'dze ste /par/ dzhai ga/ byed pa pyong re che/ /de phyir da nas 'chi rag bar/ /pyong che'i gnas mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin non/ /spyi gtsug rgyal mtshan rtse la bzhugs/ /chung nas bstan pa'i sgo du zhugs/ / sdom gsum bsrung ba khe re che/ / mtshan ldan du ma'i zhabs pad bsten/ / dbang bzhi thob pa khe re che/ / yi dam bzlas pa mang du song / / nus pa thob pa khe re che/ / bla ma'i sbu g.yog ring du bsgrubs/ / thugs mnyes byung ba khe re che/ / bla ma'i drung nas yun ring bsdad/ / zhabs tog zhus pa khe re che/ / dzogs chen chos la bag chags bzhag / sems ngo 'phrod pa khe re che/ / lha khang mchon rten mang po bzhengs/ / tshogs bsags byas pa khe re che/ / sngags mang ma ṇi'i sgrub chen tshugs/ / tshos rgyun btsugs pa khe re che/ / gzhan la phan pa'i rim gro bsgrubs/ / phan thogs byung ba khe re che/ / gzhan la dbang bskur lung mang byin/ /chos rgyun mthud pa khe re che/ /dad can rnams la chos bshad byas/ /chos la bskul ba khe re che/ /dkar po dge la bskul ba yis/ /dge ba khas blangs bye sa pa rdo// // de ltar byas na phyi ma du/ / sangs rgyas thob pa khe re che/ / ces pa'ang rang la rje byen rlabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas/ / pha bla ma tshogs drug rang grol dang / /mgon grub dbang padma rang grol zhabs/ /mi bdag gi spyi gtsug rgyan du bad/ga/13 /bye gsab

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sras zung gis bskyangs pa'i bu/ / rang rgan po snang mdzad rdo rje'i ming / / blo chos la phyogs 'di bla ma'i drin/ /bur byin gyis zlobs shig bla ma rje/ /da na so rgas pa'i dus 'di du/ /lo gzhon pa'i dus bzhin dge sbyong dka'/ /lha bla ma sngags ni gsol 'debs dang / /nang nyams len sems ngo skyong la bsdu/ /tshe'i lhag ma lo re lo phyed tsam/ /de tshang che phyi ma'i lam du 'gro/ /rang 'chi khan mi 'a spyod gdeng med pas/ /da cir 'gyur bla ma yab sras mkhyen/ /tshe thog med nas bsags sdeg lhang kun/ /rang lus dang grib ltan 'grogs pas na/ /der dri med bshags rgyud chag med bsgrubs/ /sdig nyes lhung rtsad nas 'dag par shog / rang 'chi ba'i dus tshod skebs pa'i tsho/ / nang 'byung bzhi thim rim nas bzung ste/ / gzhi 'chi kha'i 'od gsal 'char gyi ban/ / kun nang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ / yang gal srid dang ngo ma zin na/ / chos nyid kyi ban do'i gnas skabs su/ / lha sgra 'od zer sogs 'char ba'i tshe/ /de rang ngo shes pan bla ma mkhyen/ /las dbang btsan srid pa bar do ru/ /rang ci bya gtol med gyur pa'i tshe/ /lha sprul sku'i zhing khams lnga la sogs/ /dbugs dbyung nas de du skye bad shog / rang las kyis mngal sgo 'grim dgos tshe/ / rigs bzang zhing chos la mos pa dang / / chos dad ba'i sa du lus blangs nas/ / slar rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal par shog / rje bla ma yab sras ma gtogs pa'i/ / skyabs re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas /bdag tshe 'dir dam chos nyams blangs nas/ /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis dang / / dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med zhabs/ /skyabs mgon tshogs drug nang grol rje/ / bla ma rnam gsum gtsug na rgyal/ / rje btsun khyed gsum bka' drin las/ /reb kong myun gling lta bu la/ /dam chos nyi 'od 'bum brdal nas/ /gsang chen bstan pa da1 rgyas mdzad/ /snga thog bskal pa bzang po'i dus/ /sngags rgan dam tshig can rnams kyis/ / bla ma bsam dang sbyon bas bsten/ / ci gsungs bka' las 'da' ba med/ / deng dus sngags zlom phal cher gyis/ / bla ma'i bka' drin mi bsam par/ / che 'di'i mthun rkyen don du gnyen/ / dam tshog rtswa ltad 'dor la thug /drin can bla mar dad pa med/ / mched grogs rnams la brtse gdung med/ / chos kyi don la brtson 'grus med/ /'grigs lam don la sha tsha med/ /sngon ma'i chos rgyun 'chad la nye/ /bla ma dman par 'dzin pa'i dus/ /spun grogs chags sdang rtsod pa'i dus1 /gsang sngags bstan pa gzugs brnyan tsam/ /kye hud dpal chen nam mkha'i mtshan/ /mi mngon dbyings ba ga ༵ dgongs/ / bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib 'di la gzigs/ / thugs bskyed smon

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /lam gang du thal/ / bdag 'dra'i 'grigs lam e yong snyam/ / sgo gsum 'bad pa chen po yis/ /ci tsam rem kyang phan ma thogs/ /da lta yid kyi re thag chad/ /sngon tshe yo rgyan chen po yis/ /bstan pa bsrung bar gnyer gtad pa'i/ /ma mgon gza' rdor yod srid na/ /bstan la bya rwa byed re ran/ /khyed rnams bstong snyoms bzhugs gyur na/ /dam sri'i dbang du 'gro nyen yod/ /de phyir thugs dam rgyud bskul lo/ /dam ldan skyongs la dam med sgrol/ /'di ltan gdung dbyungs blangs pa'i dges/ / sngags mang 'grigs lam mi nyams shing / /sngar bzhin thugs mthun khrims gtsang ngos/ / gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas pan shog /lha snying rje yi gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /bod gangs can 'dir bshes gnyen tshul 'dzin pa/ /mgon zhabs dkar de spyi bo'i rgyan bzhugs nas/ /gyod 'khrug pa 'di zhi ban byin gyis rlobs/ / dus snyigs ma yi yang snyigs deng gi dus/ / sa reb kong na khyod dang 'khrug pa mang / /sgos gling rgya dang smad pa gnyis 'khrugs nas/ /mi mang po'i tshe srog glo bur bcad/ / gyod de'i rkyen reb kong sngags mang gi / 'grigs chos thog dang ma ṇi zhor la lus/ /chos dge ba rnams sdig pa'i phyogs su bsgyur/ /dus gnas skabs kyi bya bar sems pa skyo/ /bdud gyod 'dre yi mgo 'phang dgung la reg /lha dkar phyogs rnams nus mthu med dus 'dir/ /mgon rgyal ba rnams gar bzhugs dbyings nas dgongs/ /deng mthu stobs dang nus pa bskyed re ran/ / lha mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum chos skyong rnams/ / rje thub dbang dang pad 'byung tsong kha pas/ / bka' ji ltar du bsgos pa dran mdzod la/ / bdud gyod 'dre 'di chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ / khong bstan 'dzin sgyu bla ma gong ma yi/ / chos dge rgyun 'di da bar gnas na yang / / dus deng sang 'dir chad pa ma gzigs sam/ / 'di gzigs gyur na spyod 'dre da lta thul/ /sngon rgyal ba rnams phyogs gcig bka' bgros nas/ /bdud du tra de btul bzhin da lta yang / / lha bka' brgyad dang gu du drag po yis/ / dus myur ba ru spyod 'dre 'dul bar mdzod/ / sngags bstan pa 'di bsrung bar gnyer gtad pa'i/ /lha ma mgon dang rdor legs sde brgyad dang / / gza' khyab 'jug sogs srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bdud pyod 'dre 'di da lta nyid du sgrol/ /sngon skyabs mgon rje tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /byums snying rje yis gyod 'dre btul ba ltar/ /dus da lta yang snying rjes shugs bskyed la/ / mi 'di rnams kyi rgyud kyi gyod 'dre thul/ / mi bdag gis kyang bya thabs ma snyed pa'i/ /skyabs rtsa gsum dang chos srung rgyud bskul lo/ /dus myur ba ru mthu rtsal rab skyed la/ / gyod 'khrugs pa 'di myur du zhi gyur cig / khong rdo rje yi spun ka~X phan tshun

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mthun/ /chos sgrub chen dang chos thog sngar bzhin bzung / /kun thugs mthun dang 'grigs khrims yong ba zhig / rje skyabs mgon gyi thugs rjes 'byung bar shog /rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can/ /bu yi spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /yul khams 'phung byed pyod 'dre 'di/ / myur du zhi ban byin gyis rlobs/ / sngon dus bskal pa bzang po'i dus/ /bla ma gral gyi gong na mdzes/ /dbu mdzad sked nas srog shing byas/ /rgan pa rnams kyis 'grigs lam gnon/ /kun kyang bag phebs chos dang mthun/ /de dus yin na dga' ba la/ /sngar bzhin chos thog bzung na 'dod/ /sngags mang chos dang mthun na 'dod/ /deng sang yang mtha'i dus ngan 'dir/ /bla ma bdag med thang la brgyab/ /skabs thog dbu mdzad lug rdzi byed/ / re bzhag rgan pos lce nag g.yug / sngags pa rnams kyis mtshon cha thogs/ /spun grogs phan tshun 'thab ra 'cha'/ /chos thog ma ṇi rbad kyis bcad/ /dud 'gro mang pos dmar mchod byas/ / nags phyogs lha la skyabs su 'tshol/ / rtsa gsum chos skyong res su 'khon/ / kye hud bya 'di'i rtsog(btsog)re ltos/ / a ho sngags mang bya bar stos/ /yo rgyan chen pos bka' bsgos shing / /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /ma mgon gza' rdon gang na yod/ /yod na 'di la gzigs re nan/ /gzigs nas spyod 'dre myur du sgrol/ / rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams dang / / gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung ma rnams/ / dbyings nas btang snyoms ma bzhugs par/ / yul 'di'i 'khrugs rtsod zhi bar mdzod/ /bla ma lha yi byen rlabs dang / /bdag gi bsam pa rnam dag mthus/ /mi rnams rgyud kyi zhe sdang ni/ /byams pa'i sems dang ldan pan shog /sngags pa rnams kyang chos dang mthun/ / sngar bzhin chos thog gral la 'tshogs/ / kun kung phan tshun brtse zhing dung / /tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyus shog/snying rje'i gten chen 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang / /ngur smig gar gyis rnam nol zhabs dkan rje/ /spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /yul 'di'i 'thab rtsod zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon nas 'brel ba'i bla ma'i ming 'dzin pa'i/ /nyang skyes rgan po snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ /nag rgya'i sngags mang rnams la gros 'di 'debs/ /ma yengs nyon dang mched grogs dad can rnams/ / sngo na dus bla ma mched grogs 'dzoms pa'i dus/ /sngags 'chang rnams kyis 'grigs lam zhib pa'i dus/ /mched grogs phan tshun brtse gdung che ba'i dus/ /thams cad chos dang mthun pa deng 'dir dran/ /deng dus dam sri spyod 'dres ba na|1/6 /ba lcam rnams kung phan tshun 'thab ra 'cha'/ /sdig chas mtshon la lag

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /len byed dus 'dir/ / bla rgan nga yang da lta shi na 'dod/ / sngags pa rnams kyis 'grigs lam khyad du bsad/ /chang dud lta ci mi yang gsod la thug /zer zhing kun gyis sdig la spyod pa 'di/ / dam sri spyod 'dre snying la zhugs pa'i rtags/ / khyed cag rnams nas sngon gyi srol bzang ltan/ / chang dud la sogs sdig spyod bya ba rnams/ / ma byed ces ni thal mo sbyar nas smra/ /kun gyis dang du longs shig snying gi gtam/ /las kyi dbang gis spyod nang 'gro dgos kung / /phan tshun gnyis la bsam pa bzang po dang / /bla ma'i gdams ngag dran bzhin sdig la 'dzem1 /de ltan gyis dang 'phral phugs kun tu dge /mi rgan snang mdzad rdo rje'i bslab bya 'di/ /dang du longs dang mi rgan kha chems yin/ /dge bas yul 'di'i 'khrug rtsod myur zhi nas/ / kun kyang chos la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /hūṃ bla ma mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum gyi lha/ / ma mgon gza' rdor bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dngos 'byon yid sprul mchod tshogs 'di bzhes la/ /yul khams 'phung par byed pa'i spyod 'dre 'di/ /myur du sgrol la rnam shes chos dbyings drongs/ /dmag 'khrug 'thab rtsod zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / ces pa'ang snang mdzad rdo rjes so/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i yid bzhin 'khor lo dang / / tshe dbang rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas sogs/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin tshogs rnams kyis/ /tsho dang ye shes mchog gi byin rlabs phobs/ / sku tshe mthar phyin rje btsun zhabs dkar pa'i/ / yang srid blo gros bzang po'i mnga' bdag mchog / byams brtse'i gter chen dam pa gang de yi/ / tshe chos mdzad 'phrin dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa dang / /tshe khrid brgyud pa'i bla ma'i byin rlabs mthus/ /mtshan ldan sprul ba'i sku mchog rin po che'i/ /sku che bskal brgya'i bar du brtan par shog /tshe ring ma sogs bstan srung rgya mtsho yis che yi dngos grub bstsal nas bstan don du/ /tshe lo grangs med bzhugs nas mdzad 'phrin rgyas/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /snang mdzad rdo rje dad pas kun bslangs nas/ /tsho yi snying bo 'bum phrag zung bsgrubs nas/ /dam pa'i yang srid mchog la phul ba'i dges/ /dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyur zhabs brtan shog /blo gros bzang po'i lha lam yangs po nas/ / byams brtse'i mdzad par mthar phyin chos char gyis/ /gdul bya'i lo tog spel mdzad dge ba'i bshes/ /mchog sprul dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bla ma lha dang chos srung bden pa'i mthus/ / mtshan ldan bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan cing / /gsung gi bdud rtsis 'gro rnams smin grol nas/ ḍa/ ga1 ga yongs

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyi mgon du 'gyur bar shog / ces pa 'di yang gsol dpon bstan 'dzin nor bus bskul ngor snang mdzad rdo rjes bkra shis 'khyil ba nas bris/'gro ba'i mgon po padma kā na rje/ / sna nam zlos gar dpal chen nam mkha'i mtshan/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag tshogs drug rang grol sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis dge legs stsol/ / sngon nas da bar chos thog 'grigs lam la/ / mgo nas mjug ban tshags bzung srol bzang btsugs/ / da lta dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'tshogs pa yi/ / rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i ga la bar/ /chung nas zhugs kyang chos srid mgo ma thon/ /skye sngon phra ma'i 'bras smin ngag mi btsan/ /bla ma'i ming btags don gyis dkor gnyer nas/ /rdugs thug dman pa'i mchid la dar cig gson/ / rang cag dkyil 'khor gnyan po gcig gis bsdus/ /rdo rje mtshe ma'i dam tshog la bsam nas/ / rang skyon phag tu sbas nas 'grigs lam la/ / sha tsha snying nas zhabs 'degs byas rlom yang / / nang nyid go sa dman dang 'byor mi ldan/ /blo rgongs skyon gyis sngags mang 'go 'dren la/ /ci tsam 'bad kyang gang smras brag cha ltar/ /'bras med gyun tshe bdag yid shin tu spyo/ /las sna'i khur 'dzin rnams nas dman par gzigs/ / sgrub chen yo byad mtshams res gshar rgyu sogs/ 1 bkod pa ci tsam byas kyang steng mi gnon/ / yal bar dor tshe yid kyi re thag chad/ / gzhan rnams ma rabs spyod ngan dud chang sogs/ / bkag kung thams cad 'jol nyog gyur pa'i che/ /gang ltar bsam kyang snying bo mi 'dug snyam/ /bya thabs ma byung smre sngags dbyangs su gyer/ /nang nyid 'byon bar ldan na bsdu dngos bzhi'i/ /chos srid gnyis kyis bskyangs na khar nyan kung / /gcig tu rang blo rmongs pas thabs ma mkhas/ /gnyis su zhabs tog byed pa'i rgyun ma ldan/ /gsum du skyes la gnyom chung khas dman gyur/ / de phyir 'go 'dren byed pa dka' mor gda'/ /dngos su bstod bsngags gling bus brid na yang / /lkog tu sdang dgra sogs kyi ske la bcing /skabs 'gan khengs dregs can gyis mtho gnon byed/ / gang ltar bltas kung zhabs 'dren rgyun song bas/ /khyed cag 'dus pa'i tshom bu thugs mthun sgos/ /bla rgan nga la gnang chen bka' drin skyongs/ / rang nyid gcig pur ma ṇi 'dren bzhin du/ / bsdad na rtsa lhang mi 'byung thag chod pas/ / khyed cag rnams nas blo ldan thabs mkhas shig / nga yi tshab tu 'jog rgyu'i bka' drin skyongs/ /de ltar rgongs pa'i zhu ba ma mkhas pas/ /nongs pa byung na brjod med blo 'das dbyings/ / rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i klong yangs su/ /ma bcos 'dzin pa med pa'i klong du ā/ /— 118 —

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /rmad byung mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig bsdus pa/ /bdag gzhan 'gro la rjes brtse'i mnga' bdag mchog /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa'i drung / / gus phran nyang gi sngags ban rgya mtsho yis/ / dad pas lha phyag grangs med 'tshal bzhin du/ / khyod drung mngon phyogs thal mo spyi bor bkod/ / sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'bras/ / gang sku nam mkha'i nod bu 'od po che/ / nyed 'tshe chu khur dri mas dben ngos nas/ /bka' 'phrin glegs bu rin gnyis phyogs kyi grangs/ /nyam chung spyi bod 'byor bas spro dga' 'phel/ /'din gnas slob bu'i tha shal mtshams ming nas/ /sngon byon gong ma'i lag rjes ma nyams tsam/ / bzung nas sngags mang 'go 'dren ming bzung nas/ /dge blo ma don tsam du khyod drung phyogs/ /skabs don nyid gsung dpang bzhag las sbyor gyi/ /khun blangs nang nus dang dpag brtson 'grus bskyed/ / lag len gang phyas bang mi'i ngag na gsal/ / slad nas g.yel med brtson 'grus drag po byed/ / ched zhu nang cag gdul bya'i dpal mgon du/ /myud du 'byon rgyu'i bka' drin skyong dgos zhes/ /slob bus thal mo spyar nas lan brgyan zhu/ / slad mar dpal ldan bla ma rin po che/ / mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la brtan bzhugs nas/ / bdag cag ltos bcas mi nor dang bcas pa/ / thugs dam bsrung ba'i gun nas 'dod med mkhyen/ / zhes pa'i zhu mchid na chung lus phra mas/ / kha ba'i mdangs 'dzin lha dar legs thogs nas/ /me phyogs dpal ldan bla ma bzhugs pa'i drung / /bgrod pa zung gis gar stabs bsgyur bzhin thal/ / sku phyogs mkhyen brtse'i sprul sku la phul/rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig bsdus mgon/ / gzhan phan byums brtse'i gter mnga' rdo rje 'dzin/ /gang 'dul 'gro ngon sprul ba'i gar bsgyur ba'i/ /pha gcig sprul ba'i sku mchog gang de'i drung / / 'di na ral khur 'dus pa'i tshom bu yis/ / dad pas lag pad bde chen 'khor lo yis/ / rgyan du btags nas lha phyag grangs med bcas/ / zhu yig nol mo'i mchod sprin deng 'dir spro/ /gang sbu rta ljang dbang po'i gzi 'od kyis/ /gdul bya padma'i tshal yang bzhad bzhin du/ /'dir gnas rnams la gsung skyes sbrang rtsi'i nos/ /tshim pas bka' drin bskal brgyar gzhal bar 'khum/ / skyabs 'og pad rag cod paṇa 'chang ba rnams/ /sngon byon dam pas gnang ba'i 'grigs khrims rnams/ / khun du ma song rgyan du 'dzin ngos nas/ /khyod drung mngon phyogs 'du ba snyoms mur gnas/ /skabs don nyid la bsdo ba'i sbyin skyes kyi/ / phru ma gzhom phyid 'chi med rig 'dzin sdes/ / las spyor rtse brgya'i mtshon cha gsor ba'i ched/ /g.yel med brtson 'grus drag po'i go cha spyon—/ /bye 1mi stag gi

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lo mjug bdun phrag ring / / sngon nas rtags thon ma 'bum gnad smin sgos/ / mnan gtad 'khor lo la sogs las sbyor gyi/ / mgo btsugs nang rang so so'i sngags sde nas/ /rang nang sgrub kha'i las sbyon tshad ldan dang / / rlung 'khor mnan gtad la sogs 'bad pas sgrubs/ /slad nas dgra bo kha phung btang gi ban/ /las spyon nyid gsung dpang pon bzhag nas sgrubs/ / ched zhu ring min sku dkyil nam mkha'i non/ / gdul byu re skong padmo'i tshal yangs po/ /skyong ba'i dam bca' dgongs mdzod chibs bsgyun gyi/ /bka' drin skyongs zhes lan brgyan gsol ba 'debs/ / slad mar gang sku ri dbang lhun po che/ / g.yo med rdo rje'i khri la brtan bzhugs nas/ /gsang chen theg pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa yi/ /sngags 'chang tshogs rnams thugs nas 'dor med zhu/ / de ltar zhu lhag phul ba'i rten 'brel dang / / rdo rje chos srung rgya mtsho'i mthu byen gyis/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal dkyil myun mjal nas/ /zab rgyas chos char 'bebs pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zhes pa'i zhu mchid dpyid kyi pho nya yis/ /rab dkar dar gyi 'dab gshog rab brkyangs nas/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i mdun san 'khri shing rtser/ / snyan pa'i gdangs kyis mchid 'di 'bul bar mdzod/ / sngags mang nas phul/'gro ba'i mgon po padma kā na yi/ /zhal skyin grub pa'i dbang phyug rang gzhan 'gror/ /grol byed dbang bskur stsol ba'i drin can rje/ / bka' drin 'khon med dpal ldan bla ma'i drung / / 'dir 'dus reb kong sngags mang 'dus sde nas/ / mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'bras/ / mgon khyod sngon nas mngon pan sangs rgyas kung/ / deng dus dmu rgod 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ / bshes gnyen dam pa'i tshul gyis ris med 'gro/ /thar ba'i lam la 'god bzhin bzhugs 'di rmad/ / 'din gnas sngags 'chang rnams nas sngon srol bzhin/ / 'grigs khrims zhib mor chos thog dus bzang dang / / ma ṇi gsar 'dzugs mtshams dang sgrub pa sogs/ /chos rgyun 'dzin ngos khyed drung mngon par phyogs/ /skabs don nged cag rgongs rtul slob bu rnams/ / skyabs rje zung gis res bor phyogs gzhan bzhugs/ /da nus long thang skyur mdzad 'di rab dgongs nas/ /ring min chibs kyi kha lo phyogs 'dir sgyud/ /nyam thag sgob bu byis pa'i blo can rnams/ /pha rgan khyed kyis brtse bas mi skyong na/ /byung sems bslab byu nyams par mi 'gyur ram/ /de phyir phyogs 'dir 'byon rgyu'i bka' drin skyongs/ / dam pa'i lung zin bkra shis 'khyil ba dang / / bla ma'i gdan sa khyung dgon la sogs pa/ / sa chu 'phrod pa'i bste gnas bzang po du/ / rtag pan bzhugs pa'i baX ༵na ༷ ༷nga zhu/ /bdag cag rnams nas khyed gsung dang du blangs/ /sgrub pa'i

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /mchod pa lus ngag zhabs tog sogs/ / sgrub nges legs pas myur du phebs nas kung / /bdag sogs rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ 1slad mar skyabs rje dam pa'i sku rdo rje/ /mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la brtan bzhugs nas/ /'gro ba spyi dang bye brag 'dus sde rnams/ /thugs nas mi 'don ba yi skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zhes pa'i zhu mchid ra yig gnyis pa yis/ /lha dar 'dab gshog brkyangs nas dar dir gyi/ / glu dbyangs len bzhin chos thog chen mo 1༵// /skyabs rje'i zhabs drung pad tshal bsnyegs te thal/ / bla ma padma nang grol rin po che la ༄ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rin po che/ / rab dang phul byung dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /rab mang 'gro ba'i mgon gyur sprul ba'i sku'i/ /rab tu mtho ba'i zhabs pad khri'i drung du/ /'di na skyabs rje yab sras zung gis bor/ /'di phyi'i skyabs bral mya ngam thang du lus/ /'di zhes skyabs gnas khyed las ma mchis pas/ /'dir gnas skyabs 'og sngags mang des zhu 'bras/ / mgon khyod sku dkyil nam mkha'i nor bu mchog / mtshog gsum mthu yis chu khur las grol zhing / /zhing de'i 'gro khams pad tshal rab skyong bzhin/ /bzhin ras 'dzum bzhin bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ / 'din gnas shog ga gsum gyi sngags mang ni/ /mgon bral sdug bsngal gsum gyi rgya mtshon lhang / / gong ma'i sprul sbu gsum gyis rjes bzung yang / / deng 'dir yongs 'dzin gsum po khyed la rag / skyabs rje yab sras nyi ma nub na yang / / yang dag lam ston rgya mtsho'i mar gsar mchog / mchog dman gdul byu ku mud skyong bzhin du/ /du mas gsol 'debs dgongs shig rin po che/ /mi 'gyun rdo rje'i pho brang 'di nyid ni/ / mi rtag sgyu ma'i rnam 'gyur ngom dus 'dir/ / mi 'bral gtsug rgyan sprul sbu rin po ches/ /mi gzigs gzhan na gzigs pa su zhig yin/ /dam pas lung zin bkra shis 'khyil ba yang / / dam pa du mas bon bas gnas skabs 'dir/ / dam pa khyed 'dras gzigs rtog ma gnang na/ /dam gtsang sngags mang yod kyang 'go 'dren dka'/ /mang mang 'dir gnas sngags mang thams cad nas/ /yang yang gsol 'debs dgongs nas reb kong 'din/ / myun myun phebs rgyu'i bka' drin legs bskyangs nas/ / zab zab gdams pa'i bdud rtsi stsol bar zhu/ / slad mar dam pa'i zhal spyin rin po che/ / rgyun mar mi 'jigs rdo rje'i khrin bzhugs nas/ / du man zab khyes chos 'khon bskor ba dang / / pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol byin rlobs/ /zhu mchid mchid gtam ra yig gnyis pa yis/ /lha dar dar gyi 'dab ma rab brkyangs nas/ / zhabs pad pad mo'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser 'khod 1stu 1 / —/ zhu

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs1gsol gsol 'debs tshig 'di 'bul bar mdzod/ / sku phyogs dgu nong tshang la phul/ka dag chos sku'i klong du mngon rdzogs sangs rgyus kung / /kha ba can du 'phags pa ba ku la'i gdan sa/ / ga la ba den bzhugs nas 'gro ba rnams 'dren pa'i/ / nga yi bla ma bzang po'i zhabs pad la 'dud do/ /ca co'i ngag 'khyal lab bzhin grong dgon kun nyul zhing / /cha lugs ma nges spyod pa'i grong chog la 'khyams nas/ / ja mar dkor zas sdud pa'i mtshams ngan ngas bsam nas/ / nya mo skam du thon 'dra'i skyo shas rang skyes song / / ta tha ga ta'i bstan pan zhugs pa 'di legs kyang / /tha chad rnam g.yeng lus pa 'di nyid la skyo nas/ /da lta yengs med mtshams dang sgrub pa la zhugs te/ /na 'chir bsgug nas nyams len sha stag la zhugs so/ /pa sangs ltar dkad thugs kyi brtse ba yis bzung nas/ /pha khyed zhal gdams gnang ba spyi bo du 'byor tshe/ / ba yi 'o ma be'u sa ngom med du 'thung bzhin/ /ma lus sems la blangs tshe bogs 'don du gyur song / / tsa dur grangs kyi skye rga na 'chi la bsam na/ / tsha tsag snying la rgyug kung phan pa ni med pas/ /dza ya'i gsung gi dka' gnad zhi gnas dang lhag mthong / / wa ler gsal ba'i sems ngo skyong ba de mchog go / zhwa sen dmar sogs kun la dag snang ni spyangs na/ / za ma gzhan du bzang ngan 'byed rgyu zhig mi 'dug / 'a 'ur med pa'i dben gnas bsam gtan gyi khang bun/ /ya mtshan lta ba sgom pa 'di ka nang gal che/ /ra ltar gyong ba'i nang rgyud 'dul thabs kyi gtso bo/ /la lhang btsal mi dgos par rang rig la rdzogs 'dug / sha stag 'bad pas nyams len 'di nyid la byas na/ / sa lam rtogs pa 'dun ma'i yang rtse du skebs yong / / ha cang khams po che ba'i gtam zhig tu song ba/ / a lags khyed la nyams mtshar yig lan du 'bul lo/ / a lags bzang po la phul/skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ / blo kha chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / nyang skyes rgan po snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ / tsha bo rgya mtshor kha brda tshig 'ga' bshad/ /blo ka lhas khrid gnam rdzong phyogs su song / /rtsa ba'i bla ma sna tshogs nang grol rje'i/ /thugs rjes blo kha chos la phyogs pa 'di/ / bla ma'i thugs rje yin pas gsol ba thobs ri khrod dben pa bkra shis chos gling nas/ /da lo 'dug rgyu byung ba skal ba bzang yang yang 'di ltar 'dug rgyu dka' bas na/ / sha stag brtson 'grus byed pa gal re che/ / gzhan la bsam ngan bzung na dmyal ba'i rgyu/ / bsam pa dkar po byed pa gal re che/ / gti myug gnyid 'di dge sbyon byed pa'i bdud/ /de yi dbang du mi gtong gal re che/ /yi dam bsnyen pa ༷༷ na 1dī~X ba / / bzlas pa sha stag byed pa gal re che/ / zhon la yig rtsis la sogs

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /spyangs nas su/ / de nyid mthar son byed pa nus pa che/ / mtshams nas bud dus gzhan gyi mig ngo du/ /ngo mtshar ston rgyu yod pa gal re che/ /gal re che ba bdun gyi bslab bya 'di/ /tsha bo rgya mtsho lo mtshams bsdad pa'i dus/ / a khus bris pas tsha bo chos dang mthun/ / nang gzhan yongs la phan pa'i bkra shis shog /e ma ho/ bde ba ma lus stsol ba'i bla ma rje/ / bde bas phongs pa'i bu la brtse bas dgongs/ /bde med 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /bde chen thar ba'i lam du 'khrid mdzad rjer/ / bde dung sdug dung rgyun du gsol ba 'debs/ / bde zhing spyid pa'i dngos grub deng 'din stsol/ /bde ba 'dod rnams sdug bsngal rgyu sgrub nas/ /bde ba nam yang mi myong sdug bsngal mang / /bde ba can ltar skyid pa'i skabs med pas/ /bde ba 'dod rnams dam chos rem la gyis/ / bde zhing skyid pan 'dod pa'i dad can rnams/ / bde smon la sogs kha ton 'bad pas sgrubs/ /bde legs gted chen bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /bde bad yod dus sgrubs dang 'phral phugs bde/ / bde skyid bkra shis kun 'byung glu dbyangs 'di/ / bde spyid 'dzoms pa'i bsam gtan khang bud bris/ /o rgyan thugs sprul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog / te du ka dpal nam mkha' 'jigs med rje/ /spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /slob ma yang slob shes rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /nyang skyes rgan po snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ /mgon de'i yang sprul khyung dgon ni rma kar/ / gus pas chos dang mthun pa'i bslab byu 'ga'/ / 'bul la snyan gyis gson dang sprul ba'i sku/ /sngon byon grub thob gong ma'i mtshan gyis bsngags/ /snyigs dus dmu rgod sngags ming 'dzin rnams kyi/ /gtsug tu mnga' gsol bstan pa'i khur 'dzin pa/ /skyes mchog khyed las gzhan med sprul ba'i sku/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang pa'i rin po che/ /lta bu'i sku mchog thob dus bag med du/ /ma bzhugs bag yod ngang nas nyams len sogs/ /sku na gzhon dus brtson dang sprul ba'i sku/ / rig gnas shes byu'i phyogs la gsan sbyong dang / /bshes gnyen bsten dang sngon 'gro'i rgyud sbyangs sogs/ / rang bzhin dzogs pa chen po'i nyams len la/ /bag chags ci thebs mdzod cig sprul ba'i sku/ /theg dgu'i gzhi ma so thad yol go du/ /byang sems chu dang gsang sngags dam tshig gzugs/ /'char bas de phyir sdom gsum bsten dgos pas/ /dam sdom lhod du ma 'jug sprul ba'i sku/ /nang gi rtogs pa mkha' ltar mtho na yang / /phyi yi spyod pa zhib na 'gro don 'byung / /de phyir sdom pa dam tshig gtsang gyur na/ /kun gyis gtsug tu 'khur no sprul ba'i sku1 /bla ma ba ga 2 lcebs lhar

sa /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigasa'ajug pas/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs su shugs drag pos/ /gsol ba rtse gcig btab na byen rlabs dang / / dngos grub myur du stsol nges sprul ba'i sku/ / yi dam lha yi bsnyen sgrub thebs pa na/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las kun 'grub cing / /chos srung dam can gsol na las kun 'grub/ /de phyir bsnyen sgrub gal che sprul ba'i sku/ /sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /dben par gsang sngags nyams len la 'bad na/ / gzhan don gnang dus gdul bya 'dul ba dang / / sku bsod snyan grags 'byung ngo sprul ba'i sku/ / 'di ltar bslab bya phul ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i sbu tshe bskal brgyar brtan/ /mdzad 'phrin nam mkha'i pha mthar khyab pa dang / / 'gro kams yongs la chos kyi char 'bebs shog/rgyal dbang padma'i rnam 'phrul 'gro ba'i mgon/ / sna tshogs thabs kyis gdul byu nang grol rje/ /skyabs mgon sprul ba'i sku mchog yab sras kyi/ /zhabs zung gser kyi rtsibs stong bkra ba'i drung / / 'di na 'di phyi gnyis med gyi na bas/ / tshe 'di'i tshe lo gar shor ma shes pa'i/ /rgan 'khogs rgan po mal sa'i nang du lhung 1 /khyed phyogs khyed la re bas gnas tshul zhu/ / nyid zung nam mkha'i nor bu 'od gsal ba/ / gong ma'i gdan sa gser ri'i rtse mo nas/ /byams brtse'i 'od stong 'gyed bzhin bzhugs pa las/ / bdag blo padma'i 'dab ma cung zhig phye/ /'di na nyams chung spang rgyan sru ga po nga / / nam zlas gtug nas myur du skam la khad/ /yin tshe sngags mang me tog ser chen gyis/ /mi 'khod yal bad dor la bdag yid skyo/ / ljongs 'di'i ral khur rnams kyang nang don las/ / chos kyi phyogs su 'bad pa nyin skan tsam/ / rgyu rdzas phran bu'i phyir du mched grogs 'byed/ / nga yi tshig la nyan pa nyin skan tsam/ /sngon dus mched grogs bzang po'i bka' drin las/ /bla ma'i ming btags tshig las 'da' ba med/ /da lta'i mched rnams kun gyis dman par 'dzin/ /sngar yod ma ṇi'i sgrub chen res su bor/ / de phyir rang nyid mal nas nyal ba las/ / sngags mang phyogs su 'tshang la snying bo med/ /'on kung lo gsan khyung dgon ma ṇi la/ /song nas bsngo ba sbon lam btab na 'dod/ / bdag ni na rbas mnar bas langs 'dug dka'/ / sgyu lus kog po la yang na zug mang / /de'i stabs khyed drung ma thon zhe re 'a spyod/ /de la thugs khrel ma gnang rjes su la brtso/ / spru3 sku nyi nas rnam re jig rab bsabs kyi khri/ / nyams len slob gnyer sogs rdo~X rtson pa bdag ༵khyen gas rje/ sa /nyid 'dzi bye hūṃ/ mi 'a/ —gas gdong lnga' mthon por/ /brtan par bzhugs —ka ༵༵gas rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul grub dbang rje/ /rab mang shes bya'i don rtogs sprul

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /sku dang / / rab dang phul byung sprel po'i ni ka ka / rab mtho gnam rdzong bzhugs pa rnam gsum drung / /rab dman lnga ba'i lam nye rgan 'khog gis/ /rab tu dad pas lag pad chos 'khon zum/ /rab nyung nyang gi sa nas gus pa'i mchid/ /rab rib yi ge'i lam nas gsol 'debs 'bras/ /gang sku rnam gsum mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i ngos/ /gang gi bka' 'bangs mngal khur 'dus spyi la/ /gang gis gsung shog gnang ba 'byor ba'i mod/ /gang sku dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro thob/ / skabs kyi zhu gsol sngags mang 'grigs khrims lhod/ /sngags rlom 'ga' yis chos dang dong tse brjes/ / chang dud la sogs spyod ngan byas pa'i tshe/bdag kung skyo nas sngags gral ma song bsdad/ / kun gyis shog dang 'grigs lam gang zhib byed/ / ces pas tha tshig phul tshe gral du song / dbang dang chos srung srog 'bras bu chud mi za/ /rten 'di la snying bo ma blangs na/ /gnas ngan song sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /'jigs de las skyob mkhan rtsa gsum yin/ / khyod snying nas skyabs 'gro gnad smin dang / /rang nye padma rdo rjer/ /snang mdzad rdo rjes tshig 'di bsnyad do/ /ma yengs rna ba'i bdud rtsin longs shig / dal brgyad 'byor btsu'i mi lus thob kung / / mi rtag myun du 'chi ba soms la/ /da nas dam pa'i gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas khyed drung thal/ /brtse bas gzigs nas gsung mchid bdud rtsi yis/ /nyam chung yid kyi gdung ba bsal du gsol/ / sku 'al brag dkan drung / / 'di na 'di med phyi med ban rgan ngas/ / skyabs rje zhabs 'degs sgrub rtsis bka' phebs ltan/ / deng dus mtshams kyi bcad rgya dam po la/ / gnas phyin chos gral ma yong thugs ma khrel/ /khyed cag sngags 'chang 'dus pa'i tshom bu rnams/ /rnam dag 'grigs lam la gnas 'tshogs pa 'di/ / 'di phyi gnyis kyi don chen 'grub nges bsam bsam bzang bdag gis spro ba'i me tog 'thor/ /lha dang bla mas rjes bzung sngags kyi sde/ /lha khang ri rtsa'i yon bdag rnams nas kyang / /lha chos rnam dag chos thog bzung ba 'di/ /lha mi kun gyis smon pa'i gnas su gyur/ / ya rabs dad ldan sngags 'chang tshogs rnams kyis/ / phyi rabs mos ldan rnams kyis spang bya'i mthi' / / ma rabs sdig zas dud chang jag rkus sogs/ /tshe rabs dad ldan rnams kyis legs pan spongs/ / bca' khrims dbyar gyi rnga gseng ldin ba mtshams sgrub ci gsungs dang len tshog / tshig tu ma song don 'bras ldan pa dang / / deng dus gsol gor re yang phul na legs/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin thams0 cad tshogs 'dzom por/ /bla ma'i gdan sa khyung dgon sgrub chen la/ / bla ma gong ma'i sbol bzhin phebs dgos zhes/ / bla ma'i ming 'dzin bdag gis lan brgyar zhu/ /de ltar 'os min mang du zhus pa rnams/ /thugs la 'bab min nongs na bzod par bzhes/ /bdag gis zol min snying nas re ltos na/ /thugs nas 'don min skyabs 'jug yang dag mkhyen/ / zhu tshig na chung lus phra mas/ / snyan 'jebs glu dbyungs len bzhin du/ / bsgrod pa zung gis gar bsgyud te/ mgur rtsags bzhugs so —mang 'dus spyi'i drung / / rab nyung nyang gi sa du skyes pa yi/ / dab dman mtshams ming rgya mtsho'i ming can gyis/ / rab tu gus pa'i sems kyis kun bslangs nas/ / rab gsal zhu tshig gsol ba 'debs 'bras ni/ / mang mang pad rag cod paṇa 'chang ba'i sde/ / mdzes mdzes gral du 'khod nas dus chen 'dir/ /zab zab sgrub chen don la gzhol ba yi/ /snyan snyan bstod tshig lha mi'i yul na gleng / / phran rngung bdag kyang drung der dad na yang / /yang dag lam ston bla ma'i gsung gi bka'/ / bka' gnang rab brjid phebs ltad dben pa'i gnas/ / gnas chen bkra shis 'khyil na mtshams rgyun /sngon dus dus chen ba'i ba'i bka' chos skabs/ / skyabs rje rje'i drung sngags mang 'dus spyi nas/ /mtshams rgyun rgyun mar 'dzugs zhes khas blangs pa/ /de skabs skabs 'did thugs kyis bsnyel lags sam/ /sngon dus sngon nas mtshams res 'dzugs dgos zhes/ /yang dang yang du bla mas gsung phebs pa/ /gcig nas gcig la bshad kyang don med na/ /'grigs dang 'grigs bdag bskos pa ci la dgos/ / sngon chad thog pa'i tshes nas bzung / /skyabs mgon gdan sa'i mtshams rgyun bses lung pas/ /skyabs mgon dpang bzhag 'dzugs zhes khas blangs zhes/ / skyabs mgon nyid kyi zhal nas bdag gis thos/ /da lta mtshams res nga yis btsugs mod kyang / / sngon ltar mtshams res yar nang phyogs kha nas/ / ma bsdad mtshams res bcad tshe nga ma lan/ / phyin chad mtshams ming nga nang gral nas 'bud/ /bla ma'i mdun na gnas tshe chos pa'i gzugs/ /bla ma'i zhal gsung phebs tshe khral chos gyur/ / bla mar bral tshe gsung la gral rgyag na/ / bla ma'i gsol 'debs 'don dus ngo re tsha/ / bla ma yul 'dir bzhugs zhes brtan bzhugs 'bul/ / bla ma bzhugs tshe zhal gsung mi nyan na/ / bla ma phyogs 'did bzhugs pas ci la phan/ / bla ma dgos na da res mtshams rgyun tshugs/ / bla ma'i zhal gsung dang du ma blangs na/ / bla ma'i thugs la khro 'dzin pa'i/ /rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i ga la bad/ / theg rim dgu yi dgongs don bla na med/ /yang sgos yo ga gsum gyi nyams len la/ /gzhol mdzad gong ma'i chos kyi rgyun 'dzin pan/ /'gran zla bral ba khyed rnams las gzhan kang / / snga 'byur bka' babs chu bo rnam bzhi las/ / dbang bzhi'i gdams pa stsol mdzad yongs 'dzin rnams/ / gshegs shul dbang gi chu bo gso ba la/ 1nyam chung bdag la snga ltan bslab bya phul ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ / gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rang lugs 'di/ / gong nas gong 'phel de 'dzin 'dus sde rnams/ /'phel rgyas yun du gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang tho 'ong la kha'i sngags mang la phul ba'o/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ / dug gsum zhi bar byen gyis rlobs/ / mi nga nub cig nyal dus su/ / rdo rje langs nas 'dug ma thub/ / sems la rnam rtog mang bo
