kyis mchod nus na/ /'a 'ur nyer 'tshe bar chad kun zhi nas/ /ya mtshan dngos grub dka' tshegs med par 'thob/ /da ltar spyong ba'i rang rgyud ma btul na/ / la lung gang nas bsgrubs kyang don med pas/ / sha stag sgrub la gzhol dang tshe 'di du/ / sa bcu lam lnga'i dpal yon mngon gyun 'thob/ / ha la pa lha'i gnyen po bsten mdzod dang / / a ti yo ga'i dgongs pa myun du rtogs/ / ha cang 'khon ba'i chos la mi zhen par/ / a don skye med rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog / yang cig gson dang slob bu bsod nams 'bum/ / yang yang mtshams sgrub byed pa dka' bas na/ /yang dag gsang sngags chos sgor zhugs dus 'dir/ / yang zab bsnyen sgrub mdzod cig snying gi bu/ / nab dang phul byung bgrang byu'i mtshams sgrub la/ / rab tu 'bad tshe gu du sirnyi dang / /rab khros tu sgre wa'i bsnyen pa dang / / rab 'byams las bzhin brtson dang snying gi bu/ /kha rgan bla ma snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ /kha gzhon slob bu bsod nams 'bum de la/ /kha nas gang dran gdams pa'i dge ba yis/ / kha lo chos la bsgyun ba'i bkra shis shog / rtsa gsum lha dang chos srung tshogs rnams kyis/ / slob bu'i sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /chos 'go mthar phyin tshe bsod mnga' thang rgyas/ / phun tshogs dpal la nol ba'i bkra shis sdi sdis sbyar/ ba dge ༵'di/ yang rdzong dkar slob bu bsod nams 'bum lo mtshams la bsdad dus snang mdzad rgyal dbang padma'i rnam 'phrul 'gro ba'i mgon/ / rgyul ba'i yongs bsngags rdzogs chen rang lugs 'dzin/ / rgyal khams yongs kyi gtsug gi non bu mchog / rgyal ba'i yang sprul tsho 'du'i grub chen drung / / 'di na na so rgas pa'i khun gyis non/ / chos gzugs gzugs brnyan snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ / rab dad dad pa'i lha phyag dang bcas te/ / gus gsol gsol ba 'debs pa'i don gyi 'bras/ / dam pa khyed sku rta ljang gzi 'od kyis/ / dam ldan sngags mang 'dus pa'i tshom bu la/ / dam tshog gtsang ma'i ngos nas skyong ba 'di/ / dam pa khyedaX ༷sa gci/na da ga zhig mchis/ /skyabs 'og rgan po bdag kung 'du ba stoms/ /skyabs

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /mgon zhabs 'degs rlom bzhin mal na lus/ / skyabs 'gro la sogs kha ton byed bzhin du/ /skyabs rje khyed drung mngon pan phyogs bzhin mchis/ / skabs don skabs 'dir nyid sku 'brog phyogs su/ / phebs zhes phebs rgyu'i gra sgrig byed pa thos/ / myur ba lhad du khyed drung yong nas su/ / mjal 'dod mjal du ma yong bcad rgyar gnas/ / re zhig 'brog nas bzhugs kyang ring min du/ / du ma'i 'gro la dgongs nas 'khrungs yul 'dir/ / 'dir gnas rnams kyi mgon du phebs pa mkhyen/ / mkhyen zhes thal mo sbyan nas lan brgyun zhu/ /'byod ldan nor gyis phyug pa'i sa phyogs der/ / mos ldan gdul byud 'gro don gnang ba'i skabs/ /dam ldan rig 'dzin 'dus pa spyo mtsho la/ /mdzod ldan dbyig gi gru chan 'bebs pa mkhyen/ /slad mar gang sku mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir/ /rgyun mar bzhugs nas phyogs 'dus sngags mang gi/ / bla ma byas nas chos srid gnyis kyis bskyangs/ / pha mar gyud pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar mkhyen/ /zhu mchid mchid gtam na chung lus phra mas/ /lha dar dar gyi phyag rten lag thogs nas/ /dbyangs snyan snyan tshig sku dbyungs len bzhin du/ /bgrod zung zung gi gad stabs bsgyur te thal/ / sku phyogs tsho 'du tshang la phul/sngon bsags khyung sngon skyes kyis legs drangs shing / / rigs bzang dpal gyis mtho ba'i rten thob cing / /dge la 'dun pa'i dpon phrug gang de la/ /nyang skyes rgan pos zhu tshig me tog 'thor/ / rgyud rgyal glang po rab 'bog chu gted gyi/ / bshags rgyud gcig las du mar 'phel ba'i rgyud/ / legs bskrun dam bu ra yi dbyungs snyan pos/ / phyogs kyi 'khor yug khyab 'di e ma kad/ / 'gro ba'i las nyon sdig sgrib chu khur rnams/ / khyed drin rdzi bas legs gtor 'od sto nga gis/ / thun gsum pha mthar byus pa 'di kho na/ / thob bya bla na med do yi rang 'bul/ / 'di nas khyed kyi mdzad 'phrin legs rgyas pa'i/ / skyabs 'jug yang dag rtsa gsum lha la zhu/ / slad mar gsang bstan dhwa dza srid pa'i rtser/ / legs bsgreng rten 'brel mtshan ma mngon gyur mdzod1 /zhu rten phyag yig 'khrul med jos rgod dang / /tshe ring dang bcas zla tshos dge bar phul/ / ko'u sde'i dpon phrug dge 'dun la phul/rtsa gsum kun 'dus o rgyan chen po dang / / dbyer med rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis zhabs/ / gtan gyi skyabs mgon tshogs drug rang grol sogs/ / dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ / thugs bskyed khyung sngon skyes kyis legs drangs pa'i/ /gang sku nam mkha'i non bu 'od po che/ /bstan 'gro padmo'i gnyen du byon pa yi/ /sprul sku kun mkhyen bstan 'dzin dbang po'i drung / /nyam chung thos bsam sgom pa'i nor gyis ba 1 /33 /1grang

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mtshud rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byu'i khur gyis dub pa'i rgan po yis/ /rab tu gus pas bslab bya tshig 'ga' 'bul/ /snyan gyi dbang pos gson dang sprul ba'i sku/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i dpag bsam ljon pa la/ /skyes stobs yon tan 'bras bu khun gyis brjid/ / gong ma'i mtshan gyi cod paṇa 'dzin pa'i tshe/ / bstan la bya ba gyis shig sprul ba'i sku/ / ris med gsan rnying chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /thugs kyi thig ler bkod nas nyams len sogs/ / dam pa gong ma'i rnam than ji bzhin du/ /nang don mngon gyur mdzod dang sprul ba'i sku/ /yo ga gsum gyi shel dkar bum bzang la/ /bskyed rdzogs dbang bzhi'i nyal 'gro'i bcud kyis gtams/ /khyegs chod thod rgal kha rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ /kun gyi gtsug tu stsol dang sprul ba'i sku/ /yi dam lha yi bzlas bsnyen tshad du 'khyol/ /chos srung dam can rgya mtsho bran du bkol/ /zhi rgyus dbang drag las sbyor la sogs pa'i/ / bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrub dang sprul ba'i sku/ / grangs med gdul byan mdo sngags chos kyi chan/ /nab phab dad pa'i 'dzin ma dab brlan nas/ /thugs rje'i lha gur nyams rtogs 'bras bu 'khrungs/ / 'gro ba'i gsos su skyongs shig sprul ba'i sku/ /thun mong sngon 'gro'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /dngos gzhi a ti yo ga'i lad1 bzang gi/ /khyad chos thod rgal snang bzhi mthan phyin nas/ / che gcig sangs rgyas sgrubs shig sprul ba'i sku/ /rgan 'khogs bdag kyang thugs kyi dpal be'u du/ / bzung nas dbang khrid gdams pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /che mjug 'di du lam sna zin pa dang / /'chi khan khyed thugs drongs shig sprul ba'i sku/ /de ltar bslab bya phul ba'i dge ba dang / / rang cag rtse gcig dad pas gsol btab mthus/ / bstan 'dzin nyid kyi sku tshe bskal brgyar brtan/ / 'gro don bstan pa mtha' rgyas bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di yang rgyal bo'i sprul sku kun mkhyen bstan 'dzin dbang bo'i gsung shog gi lan du/ snyoms las pa snang mdzad rdo rjes phul ba dge legs/ sarba mgi ma/skyabs gnas kun 'dus tshogs drug rang grol rje/ / 'bral med bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyun du bzhugs/ /e ma nyon dang rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams/ /'phral phugs dge ba'i bslab bya 'di la nyon/ / dal 'byon rnyed dka' thob pa da res tsam/ / mi rtag byur du 'chi ba'i tshul soms la/ / da lta nyid nas sdig spong dge ba'i las/ / sgrub dang rnam mkhyen go 'phang ring min thob/ /chos phung brgyud khri bzhi stong snying bo'i bcud/ /theg dgu'i yang rtse rdzogs chen bstan dang mjal/ /mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su bzung / / gsang sngags chos sgor zhugs pa da res tsam/ / mi nag skye bo sdig la spyod pa'i dus/ / khyem pa'i ba ga ༵sa ༷༷ gzugs bzung na/ / lha mi kun gyis smon pa'i gnas su 'gyud/ / de

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /phyir da nas dam pa'i lha chos sgrubs/ /chos thog tshogs tshe gon pa dmar po dang / / 1 dril glegs bam zhwa gos tshang pa'i ngos/ / nyi shar dus su 'tshogs nas 'grigs lam brtsis /dad gus dag snang gzhi 'dzin gal res che/ / skyabs sems nas bzung bsdu rim bad dag tu/ /lus ngag yid gsum gzhan du ma yengs pan/ /drang por bsrings nas rab kyis bskyed rim dang / /'bring gis tshig don tha mas dad pa gces/ /tshogs nas phan tshun chags ldang 'khon 'dzing dang / /gral nas langs te 'gro ba la sogs pa/ /spangs nas rdo rje spun la brtse gdung dang / / skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i thabs la 'bod/ / bzlas pa'i skabs su ngag 'khyal lab pa dang / /gnyid rmugs rnam g.yeng le lo rab spangs nas/ /sngags 'phreng 'od zer spro bsdu la sogs pa/ /bsnyen sgrub gzhung dang mthun par brtson pa gces/ /chos thog skabs su chang dang tha ma kha/ / bsngos sha la sogs gtan nas spangs pa dang / / tshogs rdzas mchod me spos sogs tshogs bsags las/ / byas na dbyengs nas rtsa gsum chos skyong mnyes/ /de ltar bca' khrims dang 'brel bslab byu 'di/ 1nyang skyes rgan po snang mdzad rdo rje bkra /shis /shog /'chang 'dus sde rnams la phan phyir spyar/ / dge bas 'du tshogs dar rgyus yang zab lam bzang mnga' dbang mdzad/ / dpal ldan bla ma zhabs dkar pas/ /bdag la zhal bzang nab bstan pa/ /yang dag lam la bzhag par 'tshal/ /rang la gnas skabs thams cad 'a / / bla mas man ngag gang gnang bar/ / rab bsam dad pa yang dag pas/ /bla ma sa rang cag phan par 'tshal/ /bla ma dam pa las gzhan pa/ /btsal na dka' ba la bsam nas/ /pha ma rnams la zhal bstan nas/ /yang dag lam la bzhag par 'tshal/ /gsang sngags bstan dang mjal ba dang / / 'bad pas nyams blangs rang cag rnams/ /'das skabs rtags bzang mi la ba dang / / rab dga'i sa la bzhag par 'tshal/ / 'di ni 'di’phyi gnyis kyi phyir/ / dus kun rgyun du sgrub nus bus/ / bde dge rten 'brel legs che ched/ /dkon mchog mchod sogs 'dod don gsol/ /'gro 'dren 'gran bral 'dren byed mdzad/ rdo rje/༈ ༵sa/ brgyan skyabs byas phyag kyang byas/ / ces pa 'di ni byu dka' ba'i tshul du snang — snying rje'i gten chen 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i gar gyis rnam nol ba/ /skyabs mgon rje btsun tshogs drug rang grol la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byen gyis rlobs/ /grub dbang skal ldan rang grol 'gro ba'i dod/ 1/dī~Xm 1zhin

sa / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sprul ba'i gar sgyur grub pa'i dbang / / slob bu'i tshul 'dzin don yod rdo rje la/ / pha rgan bdag gis gus pas bslab bya 'bul/ / thugs bskyed khyung sngon skyes kyis legs drangs pa'i/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i nam mkha'i nor bu de/ /sgrib gnyis chu 'dzin dri mas dben ngos nas/ /lhag gen shar ba'i skal bzang thob 'di rmad/ /bshes gnyen ded dpon la brten non bu'i gling / /thon nas dam chos bsam 'phel lon pa'i dus/ /dad gsum dhwa dza'i rtsen bkod gang 'dod kyi/ / gdams pa'i 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ / de phyin thun mong sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs nas/ / dngos gzhi rdzogs pa chen po'i lam bzang gi/ /sngon 'gro sgo gsum 'khon 'das du shan dang / / rigs drug sa bon sbyangs shing rgyas gdab dang / / rtsal spyangs mnyen btsal lam gzhug rdo rje yi/ / 'dug stangs sems 'tshol byung gnas 'gro gsum btsal/ / rnal dbab son gzhug la sogs khregs chod kyi/ / dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa'i thabs la 'bod/ /thod rgal sgo gsum bya ba dgu phrugs dang / /bzhugs stangs gsum dang gzigs stangs rnam gsum gyis/ / snang ba bzhi yi ye shes mngon gyud pa'i/ /gdams pas phung po 'od skur grol bar mdzod/ / de ltar rang don mngon du 'gyur ba'i thabs/ /theg pa rim dgu'i dgongs pa mthar phyin te/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i lam bzang sgos/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa don gyi 'bras/ / bzang ngan rtog tshogs blo 'das ngang du zhog /'gyu ba gang shar rig pa'i rtsal du ltos/ /grub mtha' gang la bzang ngan ma byed par/ / rang skal yo ga gsum gyi lam bzang sgrubs/ / rang don mngon gyur gzhan don dus bab che/ / ris med 'gro la bcos min snying rje dang / / de la dmigs pa'i sems bskyed smon 'jug sogs/ / skyabs rje'i rnam thad bzhin du mdzad na legs/ /dbang bzhi'i gnad don bskyed rdzogs bzlas bsnyen dang / /dab 'byums las bzhi skrub phyir chos srung mchod/ /thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas/ /skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams skyong ban mdzod/ /de ltan 'os min bslab bya phul ba rnams/ /thugs la btags na mi rgan kha chems yin/ /dge 'dis mgon khyod don gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang skal ldan sprul sku la rang lo re bdun steng phul/gsang chen snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa yi/ / dang lugs 'dzin pa'i sngags 'chang 'dus pa'i sde/ / reb kong smad pa'i sngags mang 'dus spyi nas/ / rnam dkar dge la bskul ba'i 'phrin 'di phul/ / phan bde'i 'byung gnas mchog gsum nor bu la/ / rab tu dad pa'i bstad ba 1 ༵na dkag mchog / chos srid legs tshogs dpal gyis mtho ba yi/ / hor gyi

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /sngags 'chang gnam kho snyan gson 'tshal/ / khyed rang sngon bsags bsod nams mi dman pas/ /dal ba'i rten thob gsang sngags chos la mjal/ /srid 'byor che bas tshogs bsags las la spro/ /bstod pa'i 'os su gyur zhes kun sgyus gleng / /rgyu chen 'byor ba ldan na lha chos la/ / 'bad na 'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'byung ngo zhes/ / rgyul bas gsungs phyir rnam dag dge phyogs la/ / brtson pa drag po sgrub pa gal re che/ / nged cag smad pa'i ma ṇi'i sgrub chen la/ / dkan thig zhal 'debs phul na 'dod yod ces/ / thos pa'i mod la bskul lhag me tog 'thor/ / de phyir sgrub chen cha rkyen bzang po phul/ / khyed rang stobs 'byor bsod nams che dus 'dir/ /phyag na padmo'i bum pa legs sgrub nas/ /mchod pa'i zhing du bzung na mi legs sam/ / de phyin myun du rten 'brel sgrig thobs rem/ / nged cag sngags mang tshogs kyi zhing sa 'dir/ /dad pas mthun rkyen sa bon legs btab tshe/ /bden tshig smon lam chu lud drod gsher gyis/ / legs bskyangs don gnyis snye ma g.yun du za/ / 'di ltan dge la bskul ba'i yi ge 'di/ / rnam dkar dge la dga' ba'i gnam kho la/ / zla tshes dge la phul bas sbyin bdag kun/ / bkra shis dge legs bde skyid 'byung bar shog /grangs med gong nas mngon par sangs rgyus kyang / / 'gro ba'i don du dang byung sprul ba'i sku/ / yo rgyan rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i/ / thub dbang tsho 'du'i mkhan chen mchog gi drung / 1snga 'gyur bstan pa'i khur 'dzin sngags mang nas/ /rab tu gus pas lag pad chos 'khon zums/ /dad pas lha phyag grangs med 'tshal bzhin du/ /gsol ba 'debs la thugs rje can khyod dgongs/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rtsa ba nab brtan cing / /pha nol phyin drug yal 'dab phyogs brgyun g.yo/ / yo ga gsum gyi 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ / rje btsun dpag bsam ljon shing bde legs sam/ /dbang bzhi nyal 'gro'i rgyun gyis nab tu bkang / /bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i gos kyi na bza' bklubs/ / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i kha rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i/ / rje btsun gten chen bum bzang bde legs sam/ / sngon 'gro'i lam gyi rta bdun shugs kyis drangs/ /theg rim dgu yi 'od zer phyogs brgyar 'phro/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las gdul bya'i padmo skyong / / rje btsun nam mkha'i nor bu bde legs sam/ / 'di na ral khur 'dzin pa'i sngags rlom rnams/ / khyim gyi dong na gnyen bshes sgrog gis bcings/ / rnam g.yeng le lo'i mal na lus pa yi/ / sngags rlom tshogs rnams 'du ba snyoms mur gnas/ /skabs kyi zhu gsol dam pa gang de yis/ /lo re bzhin du gsol ras ja man dang / /'bras thug sha sogs btegs pa'i khrir/ /bzhugs nas sngags mang rjes su 'dzin pa mkhyen/ /zhes pa'i zhu mchid na chung bhra ma ras/ /dam rdzas lha rdzas dri med 'dab brkyangs nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i mdun sar dī~X/ 'thung rtser/ /snyan tshig dan dir dbyangs 'di 'bul bar mdzod/ / sngags mang nas ༄ 'gro ba'i mgon po padma kā na yis/ /'gro ngon sprul ba'i zlos gad bsgyur mdzad pas/ /'gro rnams sna tshogs thabs kyis nang grol 'god/ / 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon gang de'i drung / / 'di na bgrang byas dub pa'i rgan 'khog bdag / 'di phyi gnyis med ngang la mi tshe zad/ / 'di byas ston rgyu med pa'i gyi na bas/ / 'di nas khyed la gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'bras/ /gang sku nam mkha'i non bu 'od gsal ba/ /gangs ljongs sprel rdzong padma'i dga' tshal cher/ /gang 'dul thabs kyis skyong bzhin bzhugs pa la/ /gang de'i slob 'bangs rgan pos yi rang 'bul/ / skabs kyi gsol 'debs gdan sa gser ljongs 'dir/ / 'dir gnas slob 'bangs rnam grol lam bzang la/ / la gor 'god phyin ring min chibs sgyur mkhyen/ / mkhyen zhes thal mo sbyad nas lan brgyar zhu/ / gdan sar spyod ngan rkyen gyis lha srung 'khrug / gdan sa'i rgan 'khog bdag gis dag gtsang byas/ / gdan sa deng dus legs skabs yab sras gnyis/ /gdan 'dzoms 'byon pa'i bka' drin cis kyang skyongs/ /gang sku gdan san chibs bskyod ma gnang na/ / na rgas dub pa'i rgan 'khog langs 'dug dka'/ / dka' bas khyod zhal ma mthong yid chad tshe/ / che 'dir gsen zhal ma mjal yi chad skyo/ / deng skabs skabs 'dir sprul sku rin po che'i/ / sku don don chen 'byung ba de yi phyir/ /gang sku sbu dngos phebs na 'phral yun gyi/ /zhal bkod bkod pa gnang phyin phebs pa mkhyen/ / slad mar gang sku rdo rje chos bdun du/ / du ma'i 'gro ngor brtan cing smin grol chos/ / chos chan phab nas 'gro khams rgya mtsho kun/ / kun mkhyen sa la 'god pa'i skyabs sna ni / zhu/ / zhu mchid dpyid kyi mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ /'phel zhes/ / yang yang dad pas lha phyag grangs med pas/ / yang nas yang du gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'bras/ /'di na na tshod yol ba'i rgan 'khog nga / /'dir snang 'dod yon la zhen bgrang byus dub/ / 'di phyi gnyis med ma na ma shi tsam/ / 'di na lus pa'i rgan po'i gnas tshul lags/ / gang sbu rgya mtsho'i gos can brjid chags pa/ / gang 'dul gdul bya gsed ris yongs bskon nas/ / kangs ljongs sprel rdzong dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ / gang gsungs chos char 'bebs bzhin bzhugs 'di rmad/ /gdan sa'i gnyer bas sa las 'bad mod kyang / /gdan sar ngan spyod rgyas pa'i las lan smin/ /gdan sa'i lha srung 'khrug nas bskrad pa'i mod/ /gdan sar rgan 'khog bsdad nas dag gtsang byas/ /rab mdzes gzim khang bkod legs las kyi 'phro/ /rab dang phul byung mkhan sprul rin po ches/ /rab 'bad grub nas nyid sku nam 'byon zhes/ / rab gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs bzhin mchis/ /sngon chad gnyer ngan rkyen gyis btsog btsog btsog / deng dus gzim khang bkod legs mdzes mdzes mdzes/ /ma rab jo mo bskrad pas gtsang gtsang gtsang / /de phyir myur ban phebs pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ /dung dung gdungs pas bla rgan hon log gis/ /yang yang zhus pad thugs kyis rab dgongs nas/ / myur myud gdan sa 'di du chibs bsgyun nas/ /snyan snyan gsung gi bdud rtsi stsol ba mkhyen/ /skyabs mgon thugs bskyed bde ba can gyi gnas/ /gnas skabs gtsang zhing gzim kang bkod legs grub/ /grub tshe gong ma'i srol bzhin dus rgyun gnyis la mjal na dga' ba la/ / ma mgon gza' rdor tshe ring mched lnga yis/ / ma g.yel sdong grogs mdzad nas sprul ba'i sku/ / ma thogs ring bon myur byon rgyun du bzhugs/ / ma lus 'gro rnams chos la bsgyun bar smon/ /skyabs mgon dam pa'i gdan sa bde ldan zhing / / zhing 'dir sprul ba'i sbu mchog brtan par bzhugs/ / bzhugs nas thams cad thugs mthun dam tshig gtsang / / gtsang zhing 'gro rnams dad cing 'dun pan shog /dga' bde'i gdan sar mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir/ /dga' spro'i ngang nas rdo rje chos bdun ltar/ / dga' bder bzhugs nas gdul bya ma lus pa/ /dga' skyid dpal la spyod pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ / zhu shog snyan pa'i ko li kas/ / zhu rten 'dab ma rab brkyangs nas/ / zhu phyir sprel rdzong ljon shing rtser/ / zhu don snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis phul/ / sprul sku tshang la phul ba'i zhu gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo padma 'byung / / dbyer med sna nam yang sprul nam mkha'i mtshan/ /rigs brgyu'i khyab bdag tshogs drug rang grol sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla mas byung chub ban du skyongs/ / bla ma'i ming 'dzin snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ / gsang sngags chos rgyun 'dzin pa'i 'dus pa'i sde/ /bis mdo spyan 'khod 'dus pa'i tshom bu la/ /phan pa'i bslab byu snying gtam tshig 'ga' 'bul/ /dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba'i rten thob cing / /ring du mi gnas 'jig pa'i tshul bsams nas/ /dkar nag las 'bras zhib tu brtsi ba dang / /sdig spong dge ba sgrubs shig sngags 'chang rnams/ / thun mong skyabs sems yig brgya phyag skor dang 1 / maṇḍal bla ma'i nol 'byon bsgom pa dang / / thun min du shan rnal dbab sngon song nas/ / khregs chod thod rgal sgoms shig sngags 'chang rnams/ / chos thog dus bzang la sogs 'tshogs pa'i che/ /dad pa nges 'byung skyo shas kyis bskul nas/ /rang don bzhag nas dga' zhing spro ba'i sgos/ /chos thog gral du phebs shig sngags 'chang rnams/ /na bza' dmar po ḍā dril zhwa gos sogs/ / tshang pa'i ngos nas nang rgyud la brtags te/ / rab kyis bskyed rdzogs 'bring gis tshig don bsam/ / tha mas dad pa gal che sngags 'chang rnams/ /sngar yod chos thog tshes bcu chag med dang / / gsar btsugs ma ṇi'i sgrub chen la sogs pa/ /gang gi dus su 'grigs lam gang zhib dang / / 'grigs lam kun sbyod rtsis shig sngags 'chang rnams/ /lo zla'i mtshams sgrub dka' yang bdun phrag gi/ /skrub chen thun bzhi mtshan thun 'dzin pa sogs/ /khur du ma song rgyan du legs bzung nas/ /gnyid dang ma ṇi ma brje sngags 'chang rnams/ /ma rabs dud chang g.yang gzhi rkus jag sogs/ /spangs nas kha ton bzlas brjod phyag skor 'bad/ / ya rabs rnam dkar dge la brtson pas na/ / kun gyis dang ba 'dren nges sngags 'chang rnams/ / mdor na bshes gnyen dam pa bsten pa dang / /yi dam bsnyen sgrub chos srung mchod pa sogs/ / 'bad na las bzhi'i 'phrin las kun 'grub pas/ / de ltar sgrub par mdzod cig sngags 'chang rnams/ / de ltad chos la bskul ba'i bslab bya 'di/ /snang mdzad rdo rjes bdun cu don bzhi'i steng / /sbyar ba'i dge bas rigs sngags 'chang ba'i sde/ / dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas gyud cig /sna nam zlos gan nam mkha' 'jigs med zhabs/ / rigs brgya'i khyab bdag tshogs drug dang grol rje/ 1 bka' drin gsum ldan padma rang grol sogs/ / dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams gtsug na rgyal/ / nyang skyes rgan po snang mdzad rdo rje yis/ / tho rgya'i bod skod ba ga ༵dus spyi la/ /'phral yun phan pa'i snying gtam tshig 'ga' bshad/ /ma yengs

mgur tshogs bzhugs so/ / gus pas nyon dang sngags 'chang rnams/ / dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten bzang thob na yang / /mi rtag 'chi ba nam yong cha med pas/ / skyo shas nges 'byung dad pas rgyud bskul nas/ /dam chos nyams su longs shig sngags 'chang rnams/ / dkar nag las 'bras 'khon ba'i sdug bsngal la/ /'jigs nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro dang / /sems bskyed rdor sems sgom bzlas maṇḍal rnams/ / myur du 'bad pad mdzod cig sngags 'chang rnams/ /byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / / 'brel ban phyag skod gsol 'debs sngon 'gro dang / /dngos gzhi khregs chod thod rgal la sogs pa/ /rdzogs chen don la gzhol zhig sngags 'chang rnams/ /yi dam lha yi bskyed rdzogs sgom pa dang / 1bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa grangs tshad song ba na/ / nus pa thob cing las bzhi'i 'phrin las rnams/ / gang brtsams myur du 'grub po sngags 'chang rnams/ / chos thog skabs su na bza' dmar po dang / / ḍā dril glegs bam yo byud tshang ba'i ngos/ / drang por bzhugs nas 'don pa gsungs pa na/ /skal ldan dang ba 'dren nges sngags 'chang rnams/ / tshogs nas bzhugs dus bla mar dad pa dang / / mched la dag snang phan sems bzang po'i sgos/ / cho ga chos spyod dag par 'don pa sogs/ / kun dang mthun par mdzod cig sngags 'chang rnams/ / don med long gtam nga rgyal khong khro dang / / za 'dod tshogs rdzas chang dud bsngos sha sogs/ / spangs nas tshul bzhin 'grigs lam la gnas na/ /gzhan gyis mchod cing bkun no sngags 'chang rnams/ /sngags 'phreng skabs su 'od zer spro bsdu dang / / 'don pa'i skabs su tshog rjes don la soms/ /tshogs 'khon skabs su tshim pa drug ldan sogs/ / gang gi skabs su dran mdzod sngags 'chang rnams/ /tshogs brgya bskang brgya chos skyong gsol mchod sogs/ /bsgrubs na gang bcol 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / / kun gyis mchod cing bkun ba la sogs pa/ / ci bsam don rnams 'thub po sngags 'chang rnams/ / de ltar chos dang mthun pa'i bslab bya 'di/ / snang mdzad rdo rjes don bdun steng nas bris/ / dge bas 'du tshogs gong 'phel mthun rkyen 'dzoms/ / kun kung chos la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /pa re zhig rdzo di~Xng so che/na snye pa'i rtsa lag nyang ma tsham sa pa snang ma dzad rdo rje rin po che'i gsung mgur gyi rim yo su ste/ sgrib bral gsal stong thugs ni kun gsal lha yi lam las yangs/ /'gags med nā da'i sgra dbyangs ngag dbang lha mos bsgrun nus min/ / mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar sbu yi gzis kung lhun po'i khengs pa 'phrog /srid 'dir gsang chen bstan pa'i gsos gyur khyod lags spyi bos mchod/ / snang srid ngo bo gdod nas spros dang bra1 ba rdo~X 1kyi gi/ /

ra / 1nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rang bzhin ma 'gag gsal bar ston mdzad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ / thugs rje chu zla'i nol gar rdo rje 'dzin pa sprul ba'i sku/ / sku gsum 'dus zhal mchog la mi phyed dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ / gang thugs chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang / / dmigs med thugs rjes nyam thag 'gro ba rnams/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol ba'i phyir/ /mkha' khyab sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i nol gad bsgyun/ /ma phyis gsal dwangs thugs kyi a dad sha/ /ma 'phos mdo rgyud dgongs pa'i gzugs brnyan rnyed/ /ma 'bad yongs shar mgun gyi shel bum nas/ /ma lhas 'gro la stsol mdzad bdag gi mgon/ /zab zab dgongs klong yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /long long chu 'dzin sprin gyi bla re bres/ / lhang lhang zab gsang dbyur gyi rnga gseng stong / / ldin ldir bsgrags 'di skal ldan mdongs mtha'i dpyid/ / mang mang thos pa'i rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /yang yang bsam pa'i kho lag rab brtas shing / / myun myur bsgom pa'i tshig don 'bras smin pa'i/ / gang gang 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpag bsam ljon/ / khungs ldan mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i 'jings chen las/ / rtogs ldan ded dpon bzang po'i blo gros kyis/ / gus ldan re skong mgur 'bum dbyig nor blangs/ / dad ldan gdul bya'i gtsug gi ma ṇi kaḥ rab gsal gsal stong thugs kyi shel bum las/ / nab snyan snyan 'jebs legs bshad bdud rtsi'i chus/ /rab mang mang po'i yid kyi las nyon dri/ / rab dag dag byed khrus chab bzang po yin/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gnad kyi lus zung rdzogs/ / sdeb legs pu rtse ri ka'i rgyan gyis spud/ /rnam grol bde ster mgur dbyangs lus phra ma/ /thar 'dod gzhon nu yod na grogs kyi phul/ / de ltar mod kyang brlang sems dregs pas rgyal/ / log sred kun dbang 'dod la 'di mi mdza'/ /byang chub don gnyen thar 'dod skyes bu yi/ / ma rig mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin/ / 'khor ba'i chu chen sgrol ba'i gru dang gzings/ / las nyon na kraḥmathar byed g.yas 'khyil dung / /than ba'i gser gling 'khrid pa'i mnyan pa mchog /de ltar legs pa'i yon tan dpag yas kyang / / tshun mthong byis pa bdag 'dra'i sbyod yul min/ / nang nus tsam zhig dad pa'i sor rtses bskrun/ /kwa ye grogs dag brtson 'grus ma lhod par/ /'khor lo gsum gyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar bskul/ /ku ku don med ku co'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /gre 'gyur mthon pos rjes 'jug yongs la bos1 / rang mthong grags pa 'dod pa'i phyin du min/ /rnam dag sems la slad med snya na bskul lo/ / de phyir lhag bsam mdzes ma'i 'gram chang gis/ / bstan 'gro'i bde skyid ba ku la yi kha/ / rab bzhad lung rtogs yon tan ze'u ba ga12/ /snal bzang skye dgu'i rkang drug tshim phyir bsngo/ / bdag kyang deng nas rnam

byang ma thob bar/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon dang mi 'bral zhing / /zab gsang bdud rtsi'i dpal la rtag nol nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshod bdag 'gyud shog /brtan pa sgod kyi bkra shis nor 'dzin brtan/ / g.yo ba bcud kyi bkra shis skye dgu bde/ / gnas skabs kun tu bkra shis 'byon drug rgyas/ / mthar thug mchog gi bkra shis myur thob shog /ces phyag na padmo'i rnam sprul skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa'i sras kyi thu bo/ nyang mtshams rin po che'i rnam mgun gtsug non du thob tshe/ gang de'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i blun rgongs pa ma ṇi'i ming gis lcags 'brug lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyen gcig la bris pa dza yas/ dge'o/ /

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ra 1 /skyabs mgon bla ma zhabs dkad pa rin po che'i rnam thad gsol 'debs dad pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /spe ma ho/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan das gzigs/ / 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dran pa nam mkha' dpal/ / mi la ras pa rgyal sras thogs med zhabs/ / blo gros rgyal mtshan thang stong rgyal po sogs/ / skru 'phreng rim brgyud gdul bya smin grol la/ /'god mdzad grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / / skyabs mgon dam pa tshogs drug rang grol la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /grangs med gong nas mngon par sangs rgyas kung / / 'gro ba'i don du bod yul mdo smad kyi/ / sa cha zho 'ong gnyan rgya zhes grags par/ /sku yi skye ba bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /yab rje sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam rgyal dang / / ma yum bkra shis brtsegs zhes rigs bzang mor/ / lcags glang sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga'i nyin/ /ngo mtshar ltas bcas 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khrungs dus yul la lo legs bkra shis pa'i/ / ngag dbang bkra shis zhes byun mtshan gsol zhing / / dgung lo bdun nas yi ge tshegs med mkhyen/ /thams cad ngo mtshan skyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /zho 'ong sngags mang gral bzhugs phyag len sogs/ / thugs su chud nas bstan la bya ba byas/ /chu dmad dge 'dun bkra shis rgya mtsho'i drung / / bsnyen gnas sdom pa bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpa' rdo rje'i drung nas rdzogs chen gsan/ /lo grangs gnyis la sgrub pa snying pon mdzad/ /rig gnas la sbyangs glegs bam mang po bris/ /mkhas pa'i phul du phyin la gsol ba 'debs/ / yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho la sogs pa/ / gsan rnying mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs pad brten/ / ris med dbang lung khrid gsum mang du gsan/ /thugs rgyud chos kyis gtams la gsol ba 'debs/ / sgyu ma'i nor la snying bo med gzigs nas/ / o rgyan chen po'i gser sku'i blu yon du/ / mdzo mo gnyis las med kung gcig phu' nas/ / rab gnas bsngo smon gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma 'jam dbyangs gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs la/ / mdzo rngo gcig po phul tshe thams cad kyis/ / ngo mtshar bstod ba ga 4 4 nas yi rangs mdzad/ /rgyu nor zhen pa bral la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor

skyabs mgon 'bas dkar pa'i rnamathar gsol 'debs da dpa'i sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /bar thugs skyo gnas chen mang por mjal/ / mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung bzhin du/ / yum la gnang ba zhus pas dgyes bzhin gnang / / thugs spro tshad 'das 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /yongs 'dzin ma rig dge bshes mchog gi drung / / bsnyen par rdzogs tshe byums pa chos dad zhes/ /mtshan gyis yongs bsngags ngun sprig gos kyis bklubs/ /nab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / ma sring sogs la thabs kyis gsung byon nas/ / 'khod ba'i byu ba btang nas sog phyogs kyi/ / rtse gzhung bkra shis nyams dga'i sa phyogs su/ /chos rgyal zhabs pad bsnyegs la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang pos dgyes bzhin du/ /rjes bzung dbang khrid lung gsum rdzogs par gnang / /tshogs drug nang grol zhes byur mtshan gsol nas/ / slob ma'i dwangs mar gir la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' ba'i na tha yan chi nas gcig pur bzhugs/ / lo grangs gsum la sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyang gnad/ /nyin mtshan bar med 'bad pas nyams su blangs/ /sngon 'gro'i rtags mtshan brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ / dngos gzhi khregs chod thod rgal la gzhol tshe/ / bar dor grol ba'i gdengs snyed rang don rdzogs/ / mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grol nas mgun dbyangs sogs/ /blangs nas gzhan don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bu chen padma nang grol gtso byas pa'i/ / slob ma mang 'dus rnams la bka' bzhin du/ / bka' chos gnang nas smin grol lam la bkod/ / slob tshogs bu bzhin bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ / stag rgo rdzong dang rgod rtse la sogs pa'i/ / dben par lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang / / gnas lhags ngang la bzhag nas mgur dbyangs blangs/ / mi mthun g.yul las rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /dben gnas rnams nas nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs/ / bla ma'i drung du phyir phebs rtogs 'bul byas/ /dkyes pas gsung gnang thugs bkod ji bzhin du/ /mtsho snying phyogs su chas la gsol ba 'debs/ /lam bar rnams su snying rjes thugs rgyud g.yos/ /na bza' yan chad nor med dbul bon gnang / / dka' ba spyod bzhin phebs nas mgur dbyangs blangs/ / dam pa'i rnam thar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / mtsho snying dben par lo gsum bzhugs pa'i tshe/ / phyag na padmo blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ / chos khyel wang sogs zhal gzigs gdams pa gnang / /ngo mtshar ltad mo gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprul bsgyur mang gnang mkha' la 'phur ba dang / / mtsho yi phyi nol phebs sogs rdzu 'phrul bstan/ / lkog gyur lung bstan la sogs grub rtags kyis/ / ya mtshan mdzad pa bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ / gnas der bu slob mang 'dus bka' chos gnang / 1 di ka du ba

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mang gsungs smin grol lam la bkod/ /mtsho sman zhal gzigs dngos su mthun rkyen phul/ /gdul byu char ltar babs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'du 'dzir thugs sun rma spyol gangs ri la/ /phebs pa'i lam bar rgyu nor sbyin par btang / /rkyang bu brgyad cur chos gsungs mdun du 'dus/ /skyel mi ngo mtshar skyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /gangs rir glebs tshe ngo mtshar sgra yis bsus/ / ka chen zhal gzigs gser mdog dbu zhwa phul/ / gangs can bod kyi glu dbyungs mkhan zhes pa'i/ /mtshan gyi me tog phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dre zhig 'tshub mad brdzus nas nyams tshad tshe/ / ljags mchil btab pan khros nas tshur zhugs dus/ /gtum mo'i mes bsreg dam bzhag 'og sgor phud/ / nag phyogs dam la btags der gsol ba 'debs/ / lha mang zhal gzigs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gtad/ / mgun dbyangs mang blangs zla dgur nyams len gnang / /tshur lam 'brong la zhon sogs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /thub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ / brag dkar sprel rdzong dben par zla drug bzhugs/ / slob ma sbyin bdag rnams la bka' chos gnang / / rba 'gram brag tu ma yum gshegs pa gsan/ / thugs skyo dbus su chas la gsol ba 'debs/ / dbus gtsang phyogs su phebs rgyu'i gra bsgrig phyir/ /chu bzang dben par zla ba gcig tsam bzhugs/ /sba nag kha gsum la sogs khrom 'tshogs la/ / rgyu 'bras chos bshad gnang der gsol ba 'debs/ /kun gyis dge sgrub sdig spong khas len byus/ /rdo la phyag rjes bzhag sogs rdzu 'phrul bstan/ /rgyu nor phul ba bsnams nas dbus su phebs/ / lam bar 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / lha sar thon dus jo bor mchod 'bul dang / / rgyal ba yab sras drung du 'bul chen btegs/ / der bzhugs bla ma rnams 'a 'bul ba phul/ / bka' chos mang po zhus la gsol ba 'debs/ /ser 'bras dge gsum la sogs dgon pa la/ /zhabs tog phul zhing thugs smon spyo cher gnang / / jo bo'i mdun du gser grang lnga bcu yi/ / mchod rkong khyad 'phags phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /skor lam shan pas da lug gsod pa la/ /thugs skyo jo bo'i mdun nas sdig zas sha/ / mi bzhes dam bca' phul tshe jo bo mnyes/ / gsung byon dbugs dbyung mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / chos lung phu nas lo gcig sku mtshams gnang / /bu chen skal ldan rang grol gyis phul ba'i/ /dngul rnams gser du bsgyur nas thub sku bzhengs/ / thugs smon rgya cher gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ / sprel lor tsa rir phebs pa'i lam bar nas/ / dpal kyi bsam yas la sogs dgon sde yi/ / bla ma rnams la mjal ba ka1 ༵sa zhus/ /dgon sder zhabs tog phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /tsa ri'i dkyil

skyabs mgon 'bas dkar pa'i rnamathar gsol 'debs dad pa'i sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /'khor thang nas mgur dbyangs blangs/ / nong skor lam nas thugs la skyo shas 'khrungs/ /mjal mi nyam chung nad pa la sogs pa/ /lto gos chos kyis bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /cig car yang dgon lo gcig zla gcig bzhugs/ /mgur dbyangs legs bshad gsungs tshe lha zhal mjal/ /grub chen bcu gsum chos bro rgyag pa sogs/ /zhal gzigs sna tshogs byung la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje phag mos zhal gzigs byin gyis brlabs/ /dngul ṭi lta bu che chung grangs mang gnang / /mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i slob ma mang 'byung zhes/ /mkha' 'gro'i lhang bstan thob la gsol ba 'debs/ / dwags la sgam pon zla grangs bzhi tsam bzhugs/ /der bzhugs bla ma rnams la bka' chos zhus/ / lam ban dgon sde mang por zhabs tog phul/ 1'gro don rgya cher mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / lha san lha klu phug tu zla gnyis bzhugs/ / bsam yas la phebs byang chub chen mo'i drung / / gser srang lnga bcu'i mchod rkong phul ba'i tshe/ /chos skyong sku phebs bstod la gsol ba 'debs/ /has po ri nas tshogs 'khod btang ba'i tshe/ /lha srin sde brgyad mngon sum sprin ltan 'dus/ /mchims phu g.ya' ma lung sogs mchod 'bul gnang / / sprang slong brgya phrag bskyangs la gsol za 'debs/ /dga' ldan la phebs brgya mchod mang ja btang / / yer bar o rgyan drung du tshogs 'khor phul/ /lha san phebs nas gangs dkar ti se ru/ /phebs pa'i thugs 'dun gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /yar lam byams chen snye thang mchod 'bul dang / /bkra shis lhan por skyabs mgon paṇa chen mjal/ /chos 'brel mang zhus yar phebs lam bar nas/ /mchod sbyin mang po btang la gsol ba 'debs/ / gro shod sgrol mas bstod 'bras yar mar gyi/ / phyug po rnams kyang dad nas 'bul chen phul/ /khrus sgo lho nas dgon pa'i ser 'phreng gis/ /rten 'brel legs par 'grigs la gsol ba 'debs/ / gangs dkar ti se'i rdzu 'phrul phug pa yi/ /zhabs rjes dkar mor lo gsum 'dag sbyar byas/ / che dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i dam bca' gnang / /smra bcad bcad rgya gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /de'i che mkha' 'gro seng gdong zhal gzigs nas/ /spyol sras khyed kyi phyogs phyogs gdul bya yi/ /sgo phye 'dug pas 'gro don gyis gsungs pa'i/ /lung bstan thob par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / phyogs phyogs slob ma mang 'dus thams cad la/ / bka' chos gnang zhing legs bshad mgur dbyangs gsungs/ / bde mchog la sogs lha zhal mang po gzigs/ / gangs mchod rgya ched phul la gsol ba 'debs/ / nong gi shel mo gangs rtser rdzu 'phrul gyis/ / 'phur nas sngar med dar lhog btsugs pa dang / / sra mkhregs rdo la zhabs rjes phab pa sogs114/7ngo mtshan

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rdzu 'phrul bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ / lo gsum grol nas g.yas skor rgyang grags dang / /gnyan po ri rdzong 'bri thim phug sogs su/ /gangs mchod phul che zhabs dkan pa zhes pa'i/ /mtshan snyan sa gsum khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ / gangs ri nas thon lam bar 'gro don gnang / / rgyu nor mang 'byor dge 'dun sde rnams mchod/ / chos gsungs mgur blangs 'brog pa'i sdig rgyun bcad/ /gdul bya char ltar babs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bshad sgrub gling la gser sho bdun brgyu'i rtsis/ /mchod rdzas dngul srang stong gi spyi 'jog phul/ /mkho chag jo bor gnod pa'i chu chen la/ / rags brgyab stong mchod phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /bshad 'phel gling gi bka' 'gyur lha khang du/ /mtshams la bzhugs nas dpe gzigs legs bshad brtsams/ / rdo la phyag rjes phab sogs rdzu 'phrul bstan/ / mgur dbyangs mang po blangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /phebs khar dgon pas 'bul ba mang po phul/ /ma pham g.yu mtshor gter phul mgur dbyangs blangs/ / stod smad slob ma mang pos phul ba yi/ / nor rdzas mchod sbyin gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ / lam bar hor dang gro shod la sogs pa'i/ /phyug po mang pos phul ba'i dngul srang stong / / ri dwags gsod mkhan la byen ri dwags blus/ /mi 'jigs skyabs sbyin mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / das 'a chos dgon nas sde ba dbang po sogs/ /dpon g.yog 'ga' la nor rdzas mang bskur nas/ /bkra shis lhun po sa skya dbus gtsang gi/ / dgon sde mang po mchod la gsol ba 'debs/ / dga' ldan gser gdung mdun du gser zho stong / /rgyu yi mchod rkong phul zhing mang 'byed dang / /bsam yas zhig gso'i zebs sogs mang bskun nas/ / tshogs bsags rgya cher mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / glo yul la phebs chu mig brgya rtsa dang / / rdo la me 'bar chu la me 'bar gzigs/ /'ab chen mnga' ris rdzong kha la sogs par/ / mgud gsungs 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / rje btsun mi la'i sgrub phug 'od gsal phug / rkang tshugs phug dang 'khrungs yul skya rnga rtse'i/ / ka bzhi gdung brgyad mchod rten la sogs par/ / mjal zhing mchod 'bul gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyid drung jo bon mjal zhing bal yul phebs/ /mchod rten gnyis la na bza' mchod 'bul dang / / thugs smon cher btab zla ba gcig bzhugs nas/ / rgyal sar ltad mo gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ / slar log spyid grong jo bon gser rkong phul/ / mgon gnang dben par bzhugs nas mgur dbyangs blangs/ /tshong ba dmar bkye mang po'i sdig rgyun bcad/ / 'gro don rgya cher mdzad la gsol ba ba/1/bye btsun sgrub gnas ri bo dpal 'bad dang / / rag ma byang chub skyang phan nam

skyabs mgon 'bas dkar pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs dad pa'i sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /mkha' rdzong / / brag dkad rta so da la za 'og phug / rnams nas gnas 'brel bzhag la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas chen de rnams nyams gso mchod 'bul byas/ /be rtse 'dod yon rdzong du zhag gcig bzhugs/ / gnya' nam 'phel rgyus gling dang bkra shis sgang / / brgyud nas la phyid phebs la gsol ba 'debs/ / la phyi gangs kyi rwa ban lo gsum bzhugs/ /bdud 'dul phug mo che yi gnas sgo phye/ / tshe ring mched lngas zhal gzigs sdong grogs mdzad/ / rje btsun mi la gnyis par gsol ba 'debs/ / rgya gar rdo rje gdan du phebs dgongs tshe/ / mkha' 'gro stag gi gdong can zhal gzigs nas/ / rgya gan ma phebs 'din bzhugs slob tshogs 'di/ / zhes pa'i lung bstan thob la gsol ba 'debs/ / lung bstan bzhin du grwa btsun stong phrag 'dus/ /lto gos chos kyis skyong bzhin dgon pa la/ /zhig gso zhabs tog rgya chen legs grub nas/ /'khor tshogs dga' ba bskyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /bu chen mang po brgyud nas bal yul gyi/ /mchod rten byu dung kha shor gser gyis btum/ la phyi'i phyogs nas dab gnas me tog babs/ / thams cad dang ba 'dren la gsol ba 'debs/ /brag dmar mchong lung spo mtho nam mkha' rdzong / / skyi phug nyi ma rdzong dang chu shing rdzong / /chu dban la sogs gnas 'brel zhabs tog phul/ /mchod sbyin dpag med mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /la phyi nas thon gnya' nam grod pa phug /dgon par mchod 'bul de phyogs bka' chos gnang / / ting ri gling 'khon zhi byed chos la gzigs/ / phyogs den 'gro don gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal gyi kar lo gcig mtshams la bzhugs/ /phyogs de'i dgon pa rnams la mang ja phul/ / shel dkar chos sder gser zangs lhal mtshan btsugs/ /de phyogs 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /sa skyan phebs nas zhabs tog tshad med phul/ /byang gi lha rtser 'gro don rgya chen mdzad/ /spyong gi yon mo lung nas zla gsum bzhugs/ / mchod 'bul zhabs tog phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /ri bo bkra bzang gu dur gser rkong phul/ / 'dul mo che sogs mchod 'bul rgya chen gnang / / ngor gyi dgon par dngul rkong chen mo phul/ /lam bar 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bkra shis lhun por skyabs mgon paṇa chen drung / / 'bul ba mang phul gsung gis dbugs dbyung nas/ /mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang zhig gso gyis/ / gsungs pa dang du blangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ri bo cher phebs mtshod rten zhig gso skabs/ / grwa btsun lnga brgyas legs bzhengs rgyu song la/ /rdo tshad bdun brgya'i rtsis phul legs par grub/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ / paṇa chen mchog gis gsung 'bum byin spyod ga4 /9 —/ gos

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chen la bkod bka' thog chen mo gnang / /mar phebs 'gro don gnang bzhin ri sna dgon/ /la sogs dgon sde mchod la gsol ba 'debs/ / lha sar phebs nas rgyul ba'i gser zhal mjal/ /'bul chen btegs shing bka' chos mang po zhus/ /dbus phyogs bla ma rnams la 'bul ba phul/ / chos zhus mchod 'bul mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / mkhan rdo'i dgon pan zla ba dgu tsam bzhugs/ / legs bshad mgur ma mang gsung dbang lhang gnang / /mkhar rdo'i sprul sku gdan drangs zhabs tog phul/ / dgon pad mchod 'bul byas la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha sa'i sbon lam chen mor mang ja'i thebs/ /gser zho bdun brgya'i rtsis kyi mang 'gyed phul/ / se da'i 'du khang nang du dngul rkong bzhag / tshogs bsags rgya chen bsgrubs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams zhing gyur sen 'bras dge gsum la/ /snga phyi bsdoms pa'i ja thug bcu gsum phul/ / dge 'dun sde la dngul sdi re re'i 'gyed/ / la sogs mang 'gyid phul la gsol ba 'debs/ / sprang slong stong la dngul ṭi che brgyad re/ /khyon bsdoms rgya dngul rdo tshad bsgyu lhag tsam/ /skor lam chen mo'i mu lto khye sogs la/ /sbyin pa rgya cher gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ / dga' ldan gser gdung mdun du brgya mchod phul/ /bsam yas la phebs zhag grangs bco lnga bzhugs/ / has po ri dang g.ya' ma lung sogs la/ /mchod 'bul rgya chen phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdan sa mthil bzhugs lha khang chen mo la/ /nyams gso byas shing grwa btsun lnga brgya bskyangs/ /de dus mdo smad phyogs nas gdan 'dren pa/ /prebs tshe phebs 'dun mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas mdo smad phyogs su chas pa'i skabs/ /zangs ri mkhar dmar gnas rten rnams la mjal yon bdag rnams nas phebs rdzongs mang po phul/ / kun la bslab ston gnang den gsol za 'debs/ /ne'u ring deb ri lab kyi gnas rnams 'a / /mchod 'bul byas dang 'gro don rgya chen mdzad/ / lha rgyu rir phebs chos rgyal yab yum mjal/ / chos zhus brtse bas gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ / mchad dkar chos sde rtsi thang shel brag dang / / brag g.yang 'dzoms sogs mchod 'bul zhabs tog bsgrubs/ / yo rgyun smin grol gling dang rdo rje brag / mjal zhing mchod 'bul byus la gsol ba 'debs/ / lha sar phebs nas mar 'byon grwa bsgrig dus/ /rgyal ba yab sras sogs la thon chag zhus/ / gsol ras sku gsung thugs rten mang po gnang / /dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /dga' ldan gser khri mchog nas thub dbang gi/ / gser sbu zhig gnang bstan pa'i bdag po ru/ / mnga' gso' sde 1dī ༵zhung nas bka' shog sogs/ / gnang nas rdzongs pa lhas la gsol ba

skyabs mgon 'bas dkar pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs dad pa'i sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /'debs/ /phebs kar jo bo'i mdun nas skyabs 'jug zhus/ 1 sku gsung thugs rten mang po tshags byus nas/ / lha sa nas thon slob ma mang po yis/ / bskyal nas chibs kha bsgyud la gsol ba 'debs/ /lam bar 'gro don gnang bzhin rwa sgreng mjal/ /slob ma rnams dang byes khan thang dkyil zhig / bslab byu'i mgur gnang phebs dus thugs skyo nas/ / phyi mig gzigs bzhin phebs la gsol ba 'debs/ / dpon slob 'khor bcas 'bri chu'i khar thon tshe/ /jag pas 'grul mang blangs che chu cher dkrigs/ / shor ma nyam thag mang po 'chi la thug/lto gos chos kyis bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bu chen skal ldan rang grol thugs bskyed nas/ / chu la phebs tshe de yis rkyen byus gshegs/ / thugs skyo gnang 'phral thams cad chu las bsgral/ /bde bar rang yul bskyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtsho sngon khar thon slob ma mang pos bsus/ /stong skor brgyud nas rgya yul zi ling phebs/ /am ban nas kyang shor ma bskyangs pa yi/ /drin gzo bdag rkyen gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku 'bum dgon par skal ldan dgongs rdzogs phul/ / dis tshan bla ma padma nang grol dang / / dpon tshang sku tshab sogs kyi bsu ba 'byor/ /de phyogs 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /khri kad phebs nas jo bor zhabs tog phul/ / de la reb kong phyogs kyi bsu ba 'byor/ / nong bor gdan drangs phebs nyin 'ja' tshon shan/ / kun sgyu snang ba 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ / nong bo'i bla ma rnams la 'bul ba dang / dgon par mang ja ngan slong sbyin gtong sogs/ /dpag med gnang nas rgyu chas rtsad sprugs gnang / / chags med 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / de dus reb kong stod smad thams cad kun/ / mjal du 'ongs tshe kun la byin rten gnang / /dbus gtsang phyogs kyi gtam snyan mang po gsungs/ / thams cad ngo mtshar gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam gling smad pa 'khrugs nas mi mang po/ /gsod pa'i ban phrebs gsung byon byin rlabs gnang / /phan tshun 'khrugs pa zhi nas mthun par bsgrigs/ /snying rje'i mnga' bdag mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khrungs yul zho 'ong gnyan rgyar gdan drangs phebs/ /sring mo gnyis sogs mdza' bshes mang po la/ /bka' chos bslab bya gnang tshe thams cad kun/ / dga' spro tshad 'das thob la gsol ba 'debs/ / kun gyis gsar ston byus shing gang 'byor phul/ /sngon gyi gzhis shul nad ma zhig 'dug pa/ /gzigs nas thugs skyo lha khang mchod rten bzhengs/ /yul gyi kho thag chod la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil bar phebs/ / zho 'ong dpyis sogs skye bo pho mo la/ / bka' chos gnang dus mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar/ / rten 'brel legs par ba ༵1 gaX ba

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'debs/ /dgon pa zhig gso'i phyin du reb kong gi/ /slob ma yon bdag mang pos mthun rkyen phul/ /bka' chos mang po gnang bzhin lo gcig nang / /dgon pa legs pan 'grub la gsol ba 'debs/ / dgon den gzhi phab sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs/ / dge 'dun sde tshugs phyogs phyogs slob mang 'dus/ / dbang khrid lung gsum chos kyi chan ba phab/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgar rtse ma ban the'u rkang tsha dang / /lha zhis rgan rgya klu chu thang sogs kyi/ /'brog phyogs 'gro don gnang ba'i rgyu nor kun/ /tshogs bsags sbyin gtong mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / zho 'ong brla dbye gnyis la 'gro don gnang / /kun gyis dga' ston glu gan mang po blangs/ /dgun gsum bkra shis 'khyil nas sku mtshams gnang / / dbyan thog chos 'khor bskor la gsol ba 'debs/ / phyogs phyogs bla chen dpon chen mang po dang / /reb kong skye bo pho mo stong lhag tsam/ /'dus par bka' chos gnang zhing sgyung gnas sogs/ / tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong bskul la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo bis se cang gnyis kyi 'khrug pa bsdums/ / mchod rten rnam dag chen mo zhig gso gnang / / shar rdzong gnas nas rdo yi mchod rten bzhengs/ / dgon par zhabs tog phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam gling smad pa sde 'dun nyang dan grong / /byung chub tsho 'du rgyal bo skyid tshang dang / / yan nang phyogs dang bses dor chu ma la/ / rim bzhin 'gro don gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /sha brang hon nag nong bo khres tsi sogs/ /reb kong phyogs su 'gro don rgya chen mdzad/ /thams cad bskul nas rang nang sa phyogs su/ /sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs la gsol ba 'debs/ /nong bo'i smon lam chen mo'i mang ja btang / /'jam dbyangs kun gzigs drung du dngul rkong phul/ / sgrub sde bco brgyud kyis mtshon dgon pa la/ /mang ja zhabs tog phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /sa dkar shar dang lug rwar byums chen bzhengs/ /yar mar lha khang mang por nyams gso mdzad/ /sprang slong bgrang las 'das par sbyin pa btang / / yul phyogs bde bar bkod la gsol ba 'debs/ / sprung lung mdo ba mgon shul dpyi sa dang / / dme shul mgar rtse sog yul rtse gzhung sogs/ / 'brog phyogs rnams la 'gro don rgya cher gnang / /jag khrims rkun khrims bsdams la gsol ba 'debs/ /hon dang skya bon gle ba dpal mchog dang / / bdud shul bkra tsha 'khyams ri rkang tsha'i 'brog/nang ngan hris nag than shul zhabs drung sogs/ / phebs nas chos la bsgyur der gsol ba 'debs/ / chu bzang dgon btab ma phyag dgon pa nas/ / mtshams sgrub gnang shing rgya ba rdo rdo~X dgus/ /rtsam pa nyos nas nyam thag sprang po bskyangs/ /dbus phyogs springs

skyabs mgon 'bas dkar pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs dad pa'i sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /yig bskun la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya za bong stag phyogs su 'gro don gnang / /rgyu rdzas stod smad dgon pa rnams la phul/ / khri ka'i jo bo'i mdun du dngul rkong bzhag / yar mchod mar sbyin mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / reb kong sba nag kha gsum 'khrugs pa bsdums/ /bkra shis 'khyel du phebs nas sbu mtshams gnang / / sngan med legs bshad gsungs shing chos 'khon bskor/ /rgyu nor chos phyogs btang la gsol ba 'debs/ /sog yul phebs nas bla ma'i gdan sar mjal/ / tha yan chi sogs nyams gsos mtshams rgyun btsugs/ / sog phyogs 'gro don byas nas chos la bsgyur/ /kun gyis sdig rgyun bcad la gsol ba 'debs/ /kha sog ka non btsan mor 'gro don byus/ /rdzong dkar rdzong sngon bde chen zhabs tog phul/ /slar yang gdan sar mtshams gnang legs bshad brtsams/ / mgun dbyangs mang po gsungs la gsol ba 'debs/ / hris nag gcan tsha'i 'brog la 'gro don gnang / / de phyogs blo ka dam pa'i chos la bsgyud/ / dbus gtsang phyogs su rgya dngul rdo tshad bcus/ /thog drangs nor rdzas bskur la gsol ba 'debs/ / dgu nong phu mthil gnyis la 'gro don gnang / /lha khang nyams gsos de phyogs dge rgyun btsugs/ /shing dkar dgu steng snang ra lo khog dang / / skya rengs phyogs su phebs la gsol ba 'debs/ / ri snying nas bzhugs dgon par nyams gso byus/ / sgrul lce rdo ring hris nag hor pa shi/ / 'khyams tshang lto tshang zho 'dzings ke'u chu sogs/ / 'gro don rgya cher gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ / a dar cha ga shes bzhin 'khrugs pa bsdums/ /lha khang gsar bzhengs de phyogs dge rgyun btsugs/ /bya khyung la sogs dgon par zhabs tog zhus/ / tshogs bsogs rgya chen mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /chu bzang la phebs lcang skya dpon slob mjal/ /thugs yid gcig 'dres lha khang rab gnas gnang / /kha sgang shākya bu rgyud la sogs pan/ /'gro don rgyu chen gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ / ma ra nang tsho lnga'i phyogs su 'gro don gnang / / gang phul phyogs de'i dgon par zhabs tog phul/ / bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gser khang rin po cher/ / mjal nas thugs yid 'dres la gsol ba 'debs/ /kwa thog grub chen gdan drangs bka' chos zhus/ /reb kong sngags mang bsdus nas chos thog bzung / / gsung 'bum legs bshad rnam thar dpar du bskrubs/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs la gsol ba 'debs/ / stod kyi bkra shis dge 'phel nyams pa gsos/ /grong yul so sor mtshams khang gsar du bsgrubs/ /phan tshun 'khrug pa bco brgyud thabs kyis bsdums/ / yul khams bde bar bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ ga / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo ji'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la byin 'bebs gnang / /rten bzhengs gzigs tshad rnams la rab gnas mdzad/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan la gsol ba 'debs/ / mi rnams mjal tshad rnams la dbang bskun byas/ /sems can shi tshad rnams la bsngo smon gnang / / skye 'gro bskyabs tshad rnams la mgo 'dren mdzad/ /kun gyi skyabs gnas mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro don yongs kyi slob ma brgya phrag tsam1 / sha mi za ba'i chos pa sum brgya lhag / ri khrod zin pa'i slob ma stong tsho bskyangs/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma brgya phrag du mar bka' chos zhus/ /ri khrod brgyu phrag du mar nyams len gnang / /grong dgon brgyu phrag du mad 'gro don mdzad/ /mdzad pa mthan phyin khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge sgrub sdig spongs byed pa bgrang las 'das/ /grub gnas brgyad sogs gnas chen nyams gso byas/ /gnas chen rnams su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ / bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / ma 'ongs lkog gyur thugs kyis sa ler mkhyen/ / ma zhus lhang bstan gsung gi zhor la gnang / /ma dad snang ba dam pa'i chos la bsgyur/ /ma nor lam ston dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /dam ldan snang ngor rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag /las ldan rnams la gang 'dod chos char 'bebs/ / dad ldan zhus tshe chad 'bebs gnang ba sogs/ / skal ldan re ba bskong la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhal mthong tsam gyis 'gro rnams dad cing 'dun/ / gsung thos tsam gyis ci gsung dang du len/ /thugs bkod gang gnang tshegs med lhun gyis grub/ /skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ / de ltar bla ma'i gsang gsum rnam par thar/ /rgyu mtsho che las chu yi thigs pa tsam/ / dran pas gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab mthus/ /dpal ldan bla mas rtag pan rjes 'dzin shog /da dung bdag sogs gdul byu'i mgon mdzad nas/ /rtag par bzhugs nas legs bshad mgun dbyangs kyis/ /chos char legs phab gdul bya'i 'dzin ma brlan/ / nyams rtogs myu gu myun du 'khrungs pad shog /slad yang 'gro khams rgya mtsho ma stong bar/ / mgon khyod sku tsho mi shigs rdo rje ltar/ / brtan par bzhugs nas 'gro don mdzad pa dang / / 'brel thogs thams cad smin cing grol ban shog /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /char zu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /kun kyang dam pa'i chos la spyod pa yi/ /bkra shis dge mtshan chen pos khyab gyur cig /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar ba la/ /skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skye zhing / /rdo ga/ legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis/ / bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug pan — 164 —

ra /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtsho/ /reb kong sngags mang la khrims su bcan pe'i gtam mi phyed rdo rje'i spu tshig ces byu ba bzhugs so/ /rab 'byums rgyal kun ngo bo padma 'byung / / bshes gnyen gar sgyu rnam nol nam mkha'i mtshan/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag tshogs drug rang grol rje/ /dngos brgyud bla mas byung chub bad du skyong / / lha sngags ting 'dzin mthu stobs rdo rje yis/ / log sbyor lha min rmeg med gzhom pa'i rtsal/ / rab 'jigs lcang lo'i cod pan gyis mdzes pa'i/ /rig 'dzin 'dus sdes dge mtshan shis pa stsol/ / rgyal bstan snyeng po'i bstan srung ral gcig ma/ / gsang bdag thugs sprul drang srong rā hu 'a / /mthu stobs dbang phyug badzra sa mye sogs/ /chos srung dam can spyo mtshos las kun sgrubs/ / rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i/ / rdo rje mched lcam 'dus pa'i tshom bu la / / rdo rje'i tha tshig bca' khrims 'din bsgrags na/ / rdo rje'i dam bca' dgongs la gsan par 'tshal/ /zhes ma chod pan brjod cing bkra shis pa'i tshig gis sngon du bsus nas lha sngags ting 'dzin gyi bdag po rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshom bu padma rā ga'i 'greng ba tshar du dngar ba'i drung du gang zhu na/ de yang ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po de nyid mngon pad rdzogs pan sangs rgyas nas gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa de dag kyang theg pa'i rnam grangs kyi sgo nas bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis su 'du ste/kun byed spyol po'i rgyud las/ ma tshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang / / 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa ni wa ra ṇa si dang bya rgod phung po'i ri dang / yangs pa can la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskon nas mthar mya ngan las 'da' khar/ de yang ji skad du/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskon byus nas/ / rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig / ma 'ongs dus na 'byung ban 'gyud/ /zhes 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'byung bad lung bstan pa dang mthun par dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtser 'dus nas gdung tshig nyen gsun ba ka5 du ba btab nas bde bad gshegs pa kun gyi thugs rje bskul ba las/

gas/ /reb kong sngags mang gi bca' yig mi byed rdo rje'i tha tshig bzhugs so /gsang bdag dngos su byon nas sngon ston pa kun tu bzang pos lha gnas gsum sogs su gsungs pa'i chos rnams bstan pa ltan rgyul po ka'i khang steng sogs su babs pa dang /rigs gsum mgon po nas lha klu mi yul sogs su rim par dan/ de nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa dga' dab rdo rje dang shī seng ha/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ o rgyan rin po che sogs la rim par brgyud pa la dgongs brda' snyan brgyud ces grags shing / khyad pad bod yul du lha gcig khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mkhan po bo dhi sa twa dang yo rgyan rin po che/paṇa chen bi ma mi tra sogs paṇḍi ta mang po gdan drangs/ bsam yas mi 'gyud lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag kang bzhengs/ mkhan slob chos gsum/ bee no tsa na/ rma gnyags lhog gsum sogs sprul pa'i lo tsā pa rnams kyis theg pa gong 'og gi chos rnams bsgyur nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs grub pa thob pa'ang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /slan yang o rgyan rin po che srin yul du 'byon khar gsang sngags kyi chos rnams phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams kyi don du gter du sbas pa sprul pa'i gter ston rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi bstan pa ji ltar gter nas bton cing bstan pa rgyas pa mdzad do/ /der yang ma zad reb kong phyogs 'dir gsang sngags kyi bstan pa ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ mdo khams smad kyi char gtogs pa sbas pa'i lung chen reb kong gser mo ljongs zhes bya ba 'din sngon gyi dus su slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis dgongs pa gtad cing ting 'dzin gyi drod phab/ sprul pa bkye ste lha srin dam la bstogs/ yul gru chen po 'di'i phu mtha' smug rdzong dmar nas mda' dgu chu 'khyel mo yan/ shan gnya' gong brag dkar nas nub khri ka lha dkar tshun gyi reb kong grub pa thob pa'i gnas brgyad dam dgur sprul ba'i rig 'dzin chen po dgus sgrub pa chen po sde dgu'i lha tshogs so sor zhal gzigs shing grub pa'i rtags ya mtshan pa bstan/ 'bri gung bla ma rin chen bzang po dang mtsho bzhe'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs grub thob mang po byon nas rig 'dzin brgyud pa sa la bzhag de'i rjes su grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho yab gras sogs skyes chen dam pa du ma byon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ bar du rig 'dzin chen po dpal ldan bkra shis rin po che byon nas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du phebs nas smin gling rdor brag khams srin mo rdzong sogs su phebs nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gdan drangs/reb kong phyogs kyi sngags pa rnams la dbang khrid lung gsum gnang / phyogs 'dir gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar ba'i lung bstan kyang ma nga po gnang / de'i sprul ba 1 spyi 7mdzi blo

sa / nyang skyes snang ma dzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzang tshul khrims rnam rgyul rin po ches chos thog gi srol dang bca' yig chen po sogs kyi 'jog pa gnang / der ma zad a mgrin mkhas btsun rgya mtsho rin po che/ ko'u sde'i ban sngags rdo rje rnam rgyal/ sku phyogs tsa yi tshang / dgu steng mtshams pa tshang / tsho 'du'i nyi ma tshang sogs rim par pyon nas dbang khrid lung gsum gnang ba yin no/ /de yang o rgyan rin po ches/ ma 'ongs mdo smad khams zhes bya ba yi/ / chu bo rgya gram rwa mtshams lha 'du du/ /padma nga yis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bu/ /sna nam sprul pa nam mkha'i ming can 'byung / /zhes dang / rin 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis rin po che'i lung bstan las/ lnga brgyu dus kyi tha ma na/ /mdo smad khams zhes byu ba du/ /padma dbang gi rnal 'byor ba/ /sdang mig tsam gyis phas rgol 'joms/ / chos skyong dam can dngos su khug / gsang rtags yi ge ye yis mtshan/ /padma'i chos la lhag par mos/ / mi de dbang chen dngos yin no/ / zhes dang /gnas de ka'i dbang gi phyogs nol na/ / mtsho zhes byu'i phyogs dang nye ba'i char/ / klu dam la btags pa'i ri gdong yod/ / der sngags 'chang tshe ring rgyal gyi ming / / thabs rten 'brel 'grig na 'gro don rgyus/ /zhes stag lung gi nub phyogs na khyung dgon yod pa dang de du 'khrungs zhes lung bstan pa dang mthun par sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms mi yi gzugs su shan ba thub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med rin po che nyid spyang lung du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus skye sgo dregs pa'i stobs kyis dmag ja ga gi las kyis pha nol chem la 'bebs nus pa'i dpa' rtsal thob/ 'khod bad zhen log dang thar ba don gnyed gyi blo skyes nas 'did snang phun tshogs blo yis dor nas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten/ spyang gi rwa rtse dang lhun grub dkyil rdzong sogs dben pa'i gnas rnams su dka' spyad snying dus kyis sgrub la gzhol zhing yi dam gyi lha du mas zhal gzigs/ mkha' 'gro'i lung gis bskul nas dbus gtsang khams phyogs su lan gnyis phebs nas dbang lung mang po gsan te rang yul gyi gdul bya la chos char phab/ de yang lung bstan las/ mi khyod kyi 'dug sa rdo rje'i ming / /pho brang gru bzhi logs brgyad pa/ /mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i gling / / gsang sngags bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i gling / /zhing mchog de ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / bee dkar las/ bla ma dge bshes dgon pa'i gnas/ / klu yi mig dang snyan la gdabs/ /zhes pa ltar khyung dgon nas sgan gzhi bzung / lo ltar gyi 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po 'khon ba dbyings sgrol gyi sgrub chen btsugs/ sngags pa rnams la sngar med pa'i 'griX/ la1 5sbyo sdig btsugs nas reb rkong sngags mang zhes thams cad kyis bstod bsngags

nga / /reb kong sngags mang gi bca' yig mi phyed rdo rje'i tha tshig bzhugs so/ 1brjod/ lung bstan bzhin dgu nong sogs stod smad thams cad du phebs nas ma ṇi'i sgrub chen bco lnga btsugs/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa sogs ris med kyi bla ma dpon po che dregs du mas gtsug tu bkur zhing bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol/ chos srid kyi byu ba mthar phyin nas dgung lo re lnga'i steng so mtshan ba'i grub rtags du ma bstan nas sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ / slad yang nyi zla nor bu bzhin gdan sa gsum du sprul sku rnam gsum byon cing /khyad par khyung dgon sprul sku rin po ches bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan slar bsgrengs nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thad ltar zab mo'i nyams len gnang zhing dbang khrid lung gsum gyis 'gro kun smin par mdzad nas bzhugs pa 'di'o/ /de yang gter ston bdud 'dul rdo rje'i bstan pa spyi'i lung bstan las/ dpal gyi rdo rje shan gyi phyogs su 'phur/ / nang grol ming can yang dag don la mkhas/ / byu rung kha shor mdog dang ldan par byed/ /ya rabs las ldan thams cad de la mos/ /zhes dang / karma pa nol ba'i rdo rje'i lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje/ / mdo kams shar phyogs g.yo zhing / / la phyi gangs kyi na ba/ / nyams gso legs par byed do/ / zhes dang / gten ston stag sham nus ldan rdo rje'i chos bdag lung bstan las/ dbu rtse rigs gsun drod kyis g.yeng ba'i dus/ / zab don tshogs kyi 'khon lo shar nas 'byung / / nga yi zab chos 'di dang 'phrad pa na/ / ban chad kun sel 'gro don rgya cher yong / / snying rje che zhing mthong byed gre ba can/ / the tshom ma byed nyams su longs la spel/ / zhes dang / grub dbang rdzogs chen pa kun bzang gzhan phan rin po che'i lung bstan las/ mgon bstan pa'i 'khor lo stod du 'byung / / lha phyag na padma sgyu 'phrul bzhin/ / yul de dang gzhan yul dag nas 'byung / /zhes sogs/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung dang / bka' gdams glegs bam dang yo rgyun rin po che'i lhang bstan sogs la zhib tu bltas na lhang bstan mang zhing /khyad par du rig 'dzin shī wan ma lha'i lung bstan las/ glang chen 'gying 'dra'i ri bo la/ /sprin nag 'khrigs pa'i nags tshal yod/ /ma 'ongs bkra shis 'khyil ba zhes/ /sgrub pa'i sa sde tshugs pa yong / / gnas der grub thob 'ga' tsam 'byung / / dper na nyi zla zung gcig la/ /rgyu skar tshogs kyis bskor 'dra ba'i/ /bde chen gsang ba'i sgrub sde 'byung / /zhes pa ltar 'phags pa thugs rje chen po mi yi gar gyi rnam nol skyabs mgon chos kyi rgyal po rje bla ma zhabs dkar pa rin po che 'di nyid mdo khams smad du sku 'khrungs/ sku che chung ngu'i dus 'gro la bcos min gyi snying rje thugs la mnga' zhing 'dod sred gtan nas mi mang1 rgyu ga 5 9 cu1 zad

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/las med kung mchod sbyin gnang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mang po bstan nas 'dir snang phun tshogs blo yis btang nas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs1 chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs pad bsten nas zab rgyas chos tshul rgya mtsho la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ mtsho snying dang rma chen gangs ri sogs spu sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag pa/ lkog gyur mngon du gsungs pa sogs grub rtags mang du bstan/ma yum gshegs pa gsan pas thugs skyo nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du phebs/ stod na grags che ba gangs dkan gyi rgyal po ti se seng gdong ma dkar mo'i sku'i gnas/ bar na khungs btsun pa la phyi chu dkan mo stag gdong ma dmar mo gsung gi gnas/ smad na 'gran zla bral ba tsa ri ṭa phag gdong ma nag mo thugs kyi gnas te gnas chen gsum du lo gsum re'i mtshams sgrub dang / lha sa'i jo bo'i mtshon lha khang mang pod mchod rkong gser srang brgya re'i rgyu song yod pa sogs dang / bal yul gyi mchod rten bya dung kha shor dang ri bo che'i mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gnyis la gser grang stong phrag re dang gzhan yang lha khang mang por gser srang mang po'i rgyu song gi rten bzhengs nyams gso gnang ba/ ser 'bras dge gsum gyis mtshon dbus gtsang gi phyogs kyi dgon sde ma lus pan mchod 'bul dang dbul bo nyam thag bgrang las 'das pa la sbyin gtong sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba mthar son nas dbus gtsang phyogs kyi sku gsung thugs rten mang po gdan drangs nas 'khrungs yul gdul bya'i mgon du byon/ mdo smad kyi phyogs 'dir yang lha kang mchod rten mtshams khang sogs brgya rtsa sogs sngan med pa'i rten bzhengs kyis ljongs 'di'i khyon dog por bgyis shing / gnas chen bkra shis 'khyil ba'i mtshon dgon pa mang por nyams gso dang / nong bo'i spyi dge rnam gsum sgrub sde bco brgyad kyis mtshon dgon pa so sor mchod 'bul/ dbul bo ngan slong stong phrag mang por spyin gtong / 'jam gling sogs sde ba so so'i 'khrug rtsod bsdums pa sogs 'gro don rgya chen po gnang / de yang lung bstan las/ shar gyi phyogs su 'du 'tshogs rgyas/ /zhes dang mthun par gnas chen bkra shis 'khyil ba nas reb kong phur thogs stong la bka' brgyad chos thog bzung nas 'grig lam kun spyod bsdams/ bca' yig che chung sogs bka' drin bstsal nas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa mdzad/ gzhan yang stod kyi bkra shis dge 'phel/ bar gyi bkra shis 'khyil ba/ smad kyi dgu nong sogs la yang bstan pa btsugs nas 'gro ba yongs kyi ma gon du lham mer lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa 'di'o/ /—de ༷bye0 rab cag rnams kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma padma rang grol rin po che dpon tshang ching wang rin

gas1 /reb kong sngags mang gi bca' yig mi ced rdo rje'i tha tshig bzhugs so/ /po che'i nye 'khor du sku 'khrungs/ chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po dang skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa rnam gnyis kyi zhabs pad bsten/ se dod kyi go sa dang 'dir snang phun tshogs thams cad blo yis dor nas yongs 'dzin yab sras zhal mthun pan tha yan chi nas sgrub pa mdzad nas rang don mthar phyin tsho reb kong phyogs su 'gro don mdzad dgos zhes lung bstan pa ltad reb kong phyogs su phebs/ gnas chen bkra shis 'khyil ba nas yun ring bzhugs/ de yang lung bstan las/ dben gnas brag dkan rtse rgyal nas/ / 'dab chags ma bu gsum dang bsdongs/ / zhes pa dang mthun pan thugs gras chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje dang grub dbang skal ldan rang grol rnam gnyis nas nye gnas mdzad de rgod rdzong brag dkan rtse rgyal nas lo grangs mang por sgrub pa snying bon mdzad/ dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med rin po che'i zhabs pad bsten/ gsung ltan spyang gi rwa rtse phug pa nas dka' spyad dang snying dus kyis sgrub la gzhol/ reb kong phyogs stod smad bar gsum la dbang khrid lhang gsum gyi char phab/dbus gtsang du phebs nas skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang phyogs 'dir gdan drangs/ yang lung bstan las/ nga sprul las can snying gi bu/ / rigs mthun dpa' bo rtags can dgus/ /zhes pa ltar nyid kyi zhal gdong na yo yig yod pa dang / kun gyi mthong sar rdo la phyag rjes phab pa/ drang sbong khyab 'jug chen po'i dang gzugs bstan pa/ chos skyong dam can dngos su khug pa sogs grub rtags dang rdzu 'phrul bstan/ mang ra'i phyogs su 'gro don gnang nas gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir dgung lo nga bzhi'i steng sku'i me tog thor ba'i tshul bstan to/ /der ma zad dgu nong dang a dar sgyu sprul sku rnam gnyis/ chos dbyings sto bas ldan rdo rje/ grub dbang nam mkha' rgya mtsho sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa bzhugs pa rnams kyis kyang gsang sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa lags so/ /de ltar sngon nas da lta'i bar du seṅge rgod kyi phru gu bzhin du gcig las gcig lhag pa'i bla ma skyes chen du ma dang / mthu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag sngags 'chang gong ma rnams kyi gshegs shul bla na med pa reb kong sngags mang zhes grags pa'i rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la khrims su bca' ba'i gtam cung zad cig gleng na/ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs nas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nus pa mngon du gyur nas/ 'bras bu rnam 'dren gyi go 'phang du 'god pa la/ thog ma ra chos la 'jug pa'i blo skyes shing mi rtag rgyud la skyes nas brtson 'grus kyis le lo zil gyis gnon nus pa dgos te/ mgon po1 ༈ 1sgrub kyis/

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thar dang rnam mkhyen sgrub la ma 'bad na/ / dal 'byon gru bo mi rtag 'chi bas nyen/ / ngan song sdug bsngal drag pos mnar 'gyur bas/ / de nas brtson 'thus drag po'i go pyon la/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub la nan tan mdzod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba'i bya ba btsan thabs su gcod ma nus kyang dam chos la mos pa thob pa gal che/ de la mos pa gcig pus mi chog ste/ lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung ste rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs nas/ gnas lugs khregs chod thod rgal gyi nyams len la gzhol dgos pa ni gtso bo yin la/ de la mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i drung nas dbang thob cing dbang dus khas blangs pa'i dam tshig spyi dang / khyad pad rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshogayan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu/ rtsa lhang bcu bzhi/ sbom po brgyad sogs tshul bzhin du bsrung dgos te/ rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis kyi zhal nas/ lha sgrub mi dgos dam lhag srungs/ /lha kun dam tshig rjes su 'brangs/ /dam nyams mchod pa lhas mi bzhes/ /de bas dam lhag tshul bzhin srungs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar dbang srog dam tshig gis 'dzin dgos pas/ mi dge ba bcu dang / khyad par bla mas bsgos pa'i dam tshog chang dang du ba/g.yang gzhi/ rkus jag ri dwags gsod pa sogs dug bzhin spong dgos te/ de yang chang ni gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gi rdzas yin kung rtogs pa mthon por gyun pa'i rnal 'byor pa rab kyis bsten byu las kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ dam pas 'thung na bdud rtsi'i rgyu mtsho ste/ /phal bas 'thung na dug gi rgyu mtsho yin/ / gsungs/ yo rgyan rin po ches/ sngags pa chang gis myos gyur na/ / ngu 'bod dmyar ban skye bar 'gyur/ / zhes dang / sngags pa phung byed rgyu ni chang nag yin1 / zhes sogs mang du gsungs so/ / der ma zad skyabs mgon rin po che'i gsung rmad byung sprul pa'i glegs bam na yang rgyu cher gsungs yod pa la gzigs mdzod/ de thams cad kyis tshogs chang thod phor du sod rtses blangs nas spyo0nga ba ma gtogs 'dod sred kyis 'thung na nyes pa che bas/ rje mi la ras pas/ kha za 'dod kyi tshogs 'khon bskor dang gcig gsungs mthun las che bas/ don yal nor zad 'byung 'khrug na zug bskyed cing rang re'i skyabs 'gro tsam yang 'don mi nus pa'i sbos byed chang dang / dgos med sdig zas bdud mo'i mngal khrag las 'khrungs pa'i tha ma kha 'di gnyis spang bya'i gtso bo yin zhing / gzhan dang phyir lo shan pa'i chos mthun g.yang gzhi/ rang gzhan phung la sbyor ba'i jag rkus/ nyes med sems can gyi srog ga~Xdā pa ba dug bzhin du spong pa gal che/ der ma zad dkyil 'khor gyi gral du

sa / /reb kong sngags mang gi bca' yig mi rtsed rdo rje'i tha tshig bzhugs so/ /zhugs phan chad nga rgyal dang phrag dog mi byed par rang nyid dman sems/ rgan pa dang mched lcam la dag snang dang bkur bsti bya zhing cho ga'i mtha' ma rdzogs kyi bar du ngag 'khyal dang le lo'i dbang du ma song par rab bskyed rdzogs kyi gdeng dang ldan pa/ 'bring tshig don yid la dran pa/ tha ma'ang dad pa dang yid ches kyi sgo nas 'don pa lhag chad ma song ba gal che ste/ klong chen pas/ rab kyis bskyed rdzogs gdeng dang ldan pa'am/ /'bring gis tshig don yid la dran tsam ste/ / tha ma dad pa'i shugs dang mi 'bral bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltan lus lha skun bsgoms nas g.yas g.yon du mi g.yo ba/ ngag sngags dang bzlas bsnyen la 'bad pa/ sems rig stong spros bral gyi ngang nas g.yo ba med pa sogs yo ga gsum gyi dgongs pa dang mthun pad rang nus dang bstun pas nyams su len dgos/ gang zag dbang po dab rnams kyis ting 'dzin rnam gsum gyi gzhi bzung nas skye gnas bzhi'i bag chags sbyong ba'i bskyed rim la bdag sras lnga gzhan sras brgyad/ mngon byung lnga rdo rje'i cho ga gsum sogs sa lam dang sbyan nas bsgoms dgos/ gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams kyis/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can lha'i rnam nol du blta ba dang / gang ltar yang phung kams gshegs pa gshegs ma/ dbang yul sems dpa' sems ma/ yan lag khro bo khro mo ste gdan gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba sogs rang rang gi blo kha dang mtshungs par bsgoms dgos/ sngags bzla ba'i tsho yang sngags zeng bkod pa 'od zer spro bsdu sogs dmigs gnad ldan pas bzla dgos te/ bzla tshul ni/ rngam klog las/ bzlas brjod sngags kyi brtul zhugs kyang / /sgra che ma yin chung bar min/ /mkhyogs pan ma yin bul bar min/ /drag po ma yin zhan par min/ /yig 'bru yan lag nyams pa min/ /glal sogs bad du chod pas min/ /rgyu yi sems dpa' yengs pa dang / /bzlas pa'i skyon bcu sprang nas ni/ /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma yi/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa nab tu gces/ /zhes dang /rin chen phreng ba las/ bzlas pa byed tshe long gtam kyal ka dang / /khro dang 'thab dang shag dang 'jus 'dzings dang / /zhum dang lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnam par spangs/ /smra dang rnam rtog spros pa rnam par bcad/ / lha dang sngags las gzhan la mi bsam mo/ /zhes dang / zhi ba lhas/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/ / yun ring dus su spyad na yang / / sems gzhan g.yeng bas byas pa ni/ /thams cad rig pas don med 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rngam klog las/ sems g.yeng nus pa mi 'byung ngo / / zhes gsungs pas na ma g.yeng par bzlas pa byed pa gal che/ gzhan yang thun mtshams kun tu rtsa ba'i bla ma dang yi dam ༈༵ 3pa'i lha rnga

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bo dbyer med du shes pa'i sgo nas dad gus chen pos gsol ba btab na dngos grub kyi bgo skal mchog tu thob par nges te/ kun 'dus rin po che'i rgyud las/ gang gis bskal pa 'bum phrag tu/ / lha sku 'bum phrag bsgoms pa bas/ / bla ma cung zad dran pa mchog / bsod nams 'di ni pha mtha' yas/ / zhes dang / rig 'dzin klu sgrub snying pos/ ri dbang rtse nas gang zhig lhung gyun na/ / lhang bar mi bya snyam yang lhung ban 'gyun/ / bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ / grol bar mi bya snyam yang grol bar 'gyur/ / (mtshams 'dir ma yig las ldeb gcig chad)byed pa yang / g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan pas/ / sems kyis blangs te spyi bo yi/ /gtsug tu blangs te bkun bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar srung skyob mdzad pa dang /bka' dang dam tshig khyad du bsad nas bag yangs su bzhugs na/ ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang / / de 'khor bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can/ / mi g.yel skyon mthong tsam gyis brlag par byed/ / ces pa ltar gsang sngags 'di khe nyen shin tu che bas/ 'phral gyi rkyen du'ang bka' chad mi bzad pa 'byung zhing yun gyi sgrib pan yang na rag dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung ba sogs 'phral yun kun tu thugs bzhag gnang rgyu yod pas/ spang blang 'dzol med gnang ba gal che/ de ltan bstan don snying la bcag nas chos thog gi skabs su kun gyi 'grig ༵sna snan spyod kyi rim pa la chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin mdzad par bka' drin skyong bar zhu zhu smras pa/ ston pa'i gsung rab gsang chen rdo rje theg / theg pa'i yang rtse snga 'gyur bla med chos/ /chos kyi snying po ma ti'i bstan pa mchog /mchog tu rmad byung 'dir mjal skal ba bzang / / bzang bzang bla ma du ma'i zhabs pad bsten/ / zab zab rdzogs chen bstan pa'i sgo du zhugs/ / mang mang 'du ba'i gral du chud dus 'dir/ / dung dung thugs mthun byed pa gal re che/ / sngon byon dam pa'i rnam than ji bzhin du/ / du ma'i 'gro rnams chos la bskul pa'i drig / tshig tshogs nyung ngu'i lam nas bshad pa 'di/ / 'di ltan brtsi 'dod sngags 'chang tshogs la 'bul/ /gcig tu gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgo ru chud/ /gnyis su rig 'dzin 'dus sde'i gral du chud/ / gsum du 'grig lam kun spyod zhib dus 'din/ /kun gyis dga' ba bsgoms la 'grig lam rtsis/ / 'dir 'bad dge dang 'dir tshogs nus pa'i mthus/ / rang gzhan 'gro rnams rang don mtha' du phyin/ / gzhan don 'thub cing gzhan yid dge la sbyar/ /don gnyis lhun grub don rnams mthar phyin shog /'du 'tshogs ba pheX ༵dzad ba phyogs brgyan khyab/ / kun kung chos mthun rgyal bstan dad zhing

sa / /reb kong sngags mang gi bca' yig mi phyed rdo rje'i tha tshig bzhugs so/ /'du/sa sde/ ༵kṣiṃ ba gyur ci snabs /brtan lo legs 'bru nor 'phel/ / zhing 'dir dig 'dzin ces sngags mang la khrims su bca' ba'i gtam mi phyed rdo rje'i tha tshig ces bya ba 'di ni bca' yig gi rgyab skyor du bstan pa dar tshul/ bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar nyung du dang 'brel ba'i tshogs gtam zhig dgos zhes sngags mang dbu mdzad skal bzang dang / dge bskos tshag lo/ phag mo tshe ring gsum gyis yang yang bskul ngor/ chos gos lhon pa'i btsun pa/ yo rgyan padma'i sngags phrug bya du mang pa'i khol bo/bskyed rdzogs mi shes blun po/ rig gnas mi shes mkhas ming / 'gro bsdad mang pa'i mtshams ming bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/ sde chen mang po'i pha nol/ nags ka shing ka'i tshur nol/ 'du 'dzi med pa'i grong chung / glang chen nyal 'dra'i mkhal khug rtswa shing 'dzoms pa'i sa cha nyang zhes grags pa'i ri rtse'i mtshams khang padma bde chen phun sum tshogs pa'i dben gnas nas sbyar ba'o/ / 'dis kyang sngags mang gi 'grig lam kun spyod yag por shog cig sarba mad ka/

ga / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtsho/ /bcan yig than pa'i them skas zhes byu ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig / rnam 'dren stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bden gnyis ngo bo ston pa dam pa'i chos/ / rig grol yon tan kun ldan dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyis dge legs stsol/ /chos sku 'khor 'das bdag nyid dang spyan nas gzigs/ / yo rgyan padma rdo rje bdud 'joms rje/ / gter chen legs ldan nas bzung brgyud ldan gyi/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i tshogs rnams spyi bor bzhugs/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin dpal chen nam mkha'i mtshan/ /bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun zhabs dkar pa/ / yab sras brgyud par bcas pa thams cad la/ /gus pas 'dud do byang chub bad du skyongs/ / rgyal bstan snying bo'i bstan bsrung ral gcig ma/ 1 gsang bdag thugs sprul drang srong rā hu la/ / mthu stobs dbang phyug badzra sa rgyo sogs/ / chos srung dam can rgya mtshos las kun sgrubs/ / rdo rje snying bo'i bstan pa'i sgon zhugs pa'i/ / rdo rje lcam dral 'dus pa'i tshom bu la/ /rdo rje'i tha tshig bca' khrims 'dir bsgrags na/ /rdo rje'i dam bca' dgongs la gsan pan 'tshal/ /de la 'dir byung chub sde ba'i ma ṇi'i sgrub chen la 'tshogs pa'i skal ldan 'dus pa'i tshom bu la khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge ni/ spyin spyol bstan rin chen snying bo'i sgor zhugs ste/bskyed rdzogs kyi nus pa mngon du gyur nas/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang thob pa'i thabs la/ thog mar chos la 'jug pa'i blo skyes shing mi rtag rgyud la skyes nas brtson 'grus kyis le lo zil gyis gnon nus pa gal che ste/ mgon po klu sgrub gyis/ thar dang rnam mkhyen sgrub la ma gzhol na/ / dal 'byor gru bo mi rtag 'chi bas nyen/ / ngan song sdug bsngal drag pos mnan 'gyur bas/ / des na brtson 'grus drag po'i go spyon la/ / rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub la nan tan mdzod/ / ces gsungs pa ltad/ 'khon ba'i bya ba btsan thabs su gcod ma nus kyang / dam pa'i chos la mos pa thob pa gal che/ de la mos pa gcig pus mi chog ste lam gyi gtso bo bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung ste rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i sngon du 'gro bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ dngos gzhi khyegs chod thod rgal gyi nyams len la ba da|༵ 6pa 1 don gyi gtso bo yin la/ 'on kyang sgrub chen khyad par can 'di'i 'grigs

bca' yig thar pa'i jem skas bzhugs so/ /lam kun sbyod kyi rim pa ni/ thog mar tshogs la 'tshogs dus su dad gus dag snang gi gzhi bzung nas khral chos su ma song bar dus gcig la 'tshogs dgos/ rang don dang don chung la khag bzhag nas rgyal tho tshun la ma slebs na ske la zu bum btags nas brgya phyag dang 'os bab kyi 'grigs len dgos/ nyi ma bdun gyi ring la ma 'ong na dā dmar re len dgos/gral du zhugs phan chad nga rgyal dang phrag dog mi byed par rang nyid dman sems kyis rgan pa dang mched lcam rnams la dag snang dang bkun bste bya zhing bla ma dang dge bskul gyi gsung la nyan nas 'grigs lam la gnas dgos/ sngags pa rnams kyis reb kong sngags mang gi 'grigs khrims ltan mkho ba'i yo byad zhwa gos glegs bam bgrang 'greng rnams tshang zhing rab bskyed rdzogs kyi gdeng dang ldan pa/ 'bring gis lhag don yid la dran pa/ tha ma'ang dad pa dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas 'don pa lhag chad ma song bar dbu mdzad dang bstun nas 'don dgos te/ klong chen pas/ rab kyis bskyed rdzogs gdeng dang ldan pa'am/ /'bring gis mig don yid la dran tsam ste/ / tha ma dad pa'i shugs dang mi 'bral bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsis zin pa'i ngang nas bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer spro bsdu sogs la 'bad pa dang / lus lha skun bsgom nas g.yas g.yon du mi yo ba/ngag gis 'chal gtam dang ngag 'khyal mi lab par sngags dang bzlas bsnyen la 'bad pa/sems gzhan du ma yengs pan
