rig stong spros bral gyi ngang nas g.yo ba med pa sogs yo ga gsum gyi dgongs pa dang mthun par rang nus dang bsdun nas nyams su len dgos/ phyi gral gyi ma ṇi pa rnams ma ṇi phreng ba sogs tshang pa'i ngos nas sdod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang /bcud kyi sems can thams cad 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i skur bsgom zhing / sgra grag thams cad gsung mchog ye ge drug ma'i sgra dbyangs su rgos nas dbyangs kyi rta la bskyon nas bton na byin rlabs myur du 'jug pan gsungs pas/ sems gzhan du ma g.yeng ba'i sgo nas 'don pa ma gtogs skad sna tshogs su bsgyur nas bton na dge bskul gyis tshags 'dzin byed dgos/ nye 'khor gang nas chang dang du ba 'then mi chog kha do sna do la khyad med/ chang dang du ba 'then na ras ra ya re/ 'khon 'dzing byus na ras lnga re/ dge bskul dang las sna la kha lan byus na dgu tshan gyi bshags pa len dgos/ gral bcos dang bsko bzhag byas par ma nyan na tshogs nas 'phud cing ra ya re len dgos/ tshogs sha la rnam gsum dag pa'i sha 'khyar ma gtogs de la dmigs nas srog gcod byed pa med/ las sna'i khur 'dzin dang rgan pa rnams kyis 'byor ldan btsan phyug can gyi ngo 'dzin di bya 1bye 7bya spu non

mas1 nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyi tshul du 'grigs lam gnon dgos/ 'grigs zhugs rnams kyis le lo rnam g.yeng khong khro gnyid rmugs sogs nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi gtong bar bla ma dge bskul gyis bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs sogs ji tsam gnang yang rang don dang sdig sgrib 'dag pa'i thabs su go nas 'grigs lam la gnas dgos/ mtshod dpon rnams kyis gtod ma bzo bkod phyag len thams cad ma nor ba byed dgos/ nang bzo des chog gzu lum sogs byas mi chog mdon na sgrub chen 'dir dad pa'i kun nas bslangs te spos dang mar me tshogs rdzas mang ja zhal 'debs sogs bsnyen bkur byas na gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing tshe bsod dpal 'byor rnams 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / mthar thug 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par nges pas dga' zhing spro ba'i sgo nas 'bad 'tshal/ de ltar bca' khrims 'di la mi gnas par rang don byung rgyal du spyad nas bca' khrims bshig mkhan yod na gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung ma spyi dang khyad pan chos 'di'i bka' srung gza' mchog rnam ༵ hūṃ bza~X dī sdi mgon dang byed grog ༈ mdzo rdo cig cig/ tshul bzhin chos dang mthun pa smras rno/ gangs can mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /sgrub chen la zhugs skal bzang skye bo la/ / phan phyin bsam pa thag pas kun bslangs te/ / bca' yig 'di 'dra bri la spro ba 'phel/ / e ma dam chos dar ba'i yul dbus skyes/ / chos sgor zhugs nas nyams su len pa 'di/ /bskal brgyun bsod nams bsags pa'i stobs kyis thob/ /de phyir brtson 'grus drag pos nyams su 'o ngas/ / tshe 'di'i lto rgyab phyir du mi che shor/ / dam pa'i chos la phyi bshol byus pa na/ / yang yang dal 'byor thob pa shin tu dka'/ / da res don ldan byed pa gal re che/ /tshe gcig nyams len byed pa dka' na yang / /bdun phrag tsam gyi bsnyen sgrub 'di nyid la/ /le lo ma byed yi ge drug pa 'di/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhen bzlas na gtan 'dun 'grub/ / nang gzhan dge la bskul ba'i bca' yig 'di/ /rang don yin bsam rtsis shig skal ldan rnams/ /dge 'dis chos rgyud 'dzin pa thams cad la/ /bde spyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char bar thos /bkra shis phun tshogs dge mtshan ji snyed pa'i/ /bkra shis chos mthun slob phyo gas kun khya sbyo gyur /cig/ bkra/ shis dpal gyis dus kun 'tsho ba dang / / bkra shis chen pos ces bca' yi ga thar pa'i zem skas zhes byu ba 'di ni byang chub sde ba'i gros dbang rnams kyi 'dod pa ltar/ci nyang skyes sngags btsun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am snang mdzad rdo rjes sbyar ba kun nas kun tu che bar gyur bka 1ḍi~X ༷༷/ dge legs/ sarba mad ma/ /

rdo 'bum dkar po brtsigs tshul rin chen lhan po bzhugs so/ /nas/ /rdo 'bum dkan po brtsigs tshul din chen lhun po zhes byu ba bzhugs so/ /da / /bla ma mchog dang lhag pa'i lhad/ / btud nas yul khams bde ba'i thabs/ /rdo 'bum dkan po brtsigs tshul bri/ / bla ma lha yis gnang ba stsol/ /gsam 1 ༵/ 'din brtsigs pa dkar po'am rdel 'bum du grags pa brtsigs tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes ༄ dang po ni/ lha gang dang 'brel ba'i mchod gtor bshams pa'i mdun du spog shing shug pa shar rtags ma nor ba thu bzhi yul srol ltar sbal mgo rtse mor rnam rgyal mchod rten dang / phyogs bzhir nor bu/ shan du nyi zla skan gsum dang gdugs dang nya/ lhor padma dang bum pa/ nub tu dung dang dpal pe'u/ byang du rgyul mtshan dang 'khor lo rnams padma'i lo mas brgyan pa'i mdun ngos kyi gnas lngar yo āḥhūṃ khri tīḥdang oṃ gyi thad du yo sarba bi du snya hwa/ sloḥyi thad du dbyangs gsal/ a ā/ i yī/ yu lha/ṛ ṛ/ rba lī/ e skru/ o spo/ saṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lho ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ hūṃ gi thad du/ yo badzra ā yu ṣe swā hwa dang lha gang yin gyi sngags bri/ hūṃ gi thad du1 phyogs bzhir shan du gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ring ngam gzungs thung / yo hūṃ swā hwa/ yo a mṛ ta a yur da de sgyu hā/ lhor dri med kyi gzungs ring ngam gzungs thung / yo na ma snga ya dhi kā sna/ sarba ta tha ga ta ji da ya ga rje/ dzwa la dzwa la/ dharma dha tu ga rje/ saṃ bha na ma ma ā yuḥ saṃ sha dha ya ma ma sarba pā paṃ/ sarba ta tha ga ta sa ma sto ji ṣa bi ma le bi shudhe/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ saṃ baṃ saṃ dza sruhwa/ nub tu gsang ba rang bsrel gyi gzungs ring ngam gzungs thung / yo sarba ta thā ga ta u ka'i dha tu nu twa ni/ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma stso tu bi bhu ṣe te a dhika te hu du hu du hūṃ hūṃ snya3/ byang du byang chub rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs ring ngam gzungs thung / yo sarba sto thā ga ta byā ba lo ki te sruhwa/ dza ya dza ya swāhā/ yo rgyo du dru ru dza ya lha ṣe sruhwa/ bzhi ka'i mjug tu/ gso sbyong bsdus pa ni/ bzod pa dka' thub bzod pa dam pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ / rten 'brel snying po ni/ oṃ ye dharma he tu pra bha wa te du rte ṣanta ta thā ga to tya ba da ta te khri lha yo ni no dha e waṃ pā ti ma hwa shra ma na sruhwa/ kha bsgyur ni/ shar du bdag cag dpon slob 'khon dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgriX ༷ma sgyu du 9nyaX chag

da / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad 'i ban ma dzad du gsol/ sarba pā paṃ sha sto ku du ye sta hwa/ lhor bdag cag dpon skob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i mkho dgu longs spyod gsel dngul dar zab 'bru sna bang mdzod tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags mnga' thang brgyud zas nor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ pu / ku du ye sruhwa/ nub tu bdag cag dpon slob yon bdag dang bcas pa la mkho dgu longs spyod gsen dngul dar zab 'bru bang mdzod rta nor ra lug gos dang yo byad sogs dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ pā shi ku du ye sruhwa/ byang du/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tsho ban byed pa'i rgyul bsen dam sri byad phun rbad 'dre thod gtong lo kegs zla gshed chag che nyams nga sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad zhi 'ing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ mā ra ya phaṭa dang / gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshig bcad rnams bri'o/ /lha'i thad du/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye sruhwa dang / rtsa bad sna tshogs rdo rjes btum pa nas bris pa'i g.yas g.yon du no rkyang gnyis mtshon byed du dur wa dang ku sha nyag ma re bcings pa'i phyi nas dan dman ser gyis dkris pa dang / gter bum gyi nang du bum rdzas nyer lnga/ 'bru zan dad sna sogs gter rdzas kyis bkang ba'i dbus su/ spro na lha gang yin gyi sku dang spel tshig bris pa'i kha dar gyis bkab cing dan tshon sna lngas bcings pa mi khyes ma 'gom pa'i sa nas rde'u lha gang yin gyi sngags dang / rde'u re sprags pa 'bum du longs pa 'du byus pa'i mdun du mchod pa bshams/ dad yol gyis brgyan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa lha gang yin gyi bdag bskyed dang bzlas pa'i ban dang mdun bskyed la dmigs nas mchod pa byen gyis brlab ste/ srog shing dang / bum pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las srog shing dang gter bum lha rdzas kyi bcud kyis bkang ba'i dbus su/ lha gang yin gyi bskyed la mchod gtor sogs kyi mthar/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zen 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs dang / srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad bkug nas srog shing dang gter bum la thim pas byin rlabs kyi gter chen por gyur par bsam/ lha gang yin gyi sngags bzla/ bsdu na/ bsang sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las srog shing lha'i rnam pa dang gter gyi bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bcud bzang pos bkang zhing / ci 'dod 'byung ba'i gter chen po'i bum par gyun par bsam la/lha gang yin sgyu sngags dang bum rdzas nyer lnga'am sum cu byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags 'di ltar bzla/ sman lnga la/ yo pa lha be ṣa bye āḥhūṃ/ rin chen lnga la/ oṃ pa lha ratna āḥhūṃ/ dri lnga la/ oṃ pa lha ga rte māḥhūṃ/ 'bru lnga 1/ yo pa lha be ga āḥhūṃ/ snying po lnga la/ ka pa lha ba āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi lnga la/ yo pa lha āḥsda ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa rnams mang du bzla/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag sgyu byus 1/ 1༵ ༵ba da pu ra pu ra su ra su ra ma brta ya a brta ya ho badzra sga ra ṇa ka/ zhes brlab/

rdo 'bum dkar po brtsigs tshul rin chen lhun po bzhugs so/ /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni zhes sogs bden stobs brjod/ yo ye dharma dang mchod bstod par gyu da/ na bya/ sgrub pa rdzogs pa'i nyin/ lha che ge mo 'od du zhu bas srog shing dang gter bum gyi rnam gsum pa ni sa gnad gang du bya ba'i gnas der thog mar sa bsgangs pa ni/ dkar gtor gser skyems bsang sogs 'du byus la/ kye kye/ dga' chen lhun grub nol ba'i zhing kams nas/ /dpal chen bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kun/ /mchod chen zhu ba'i mgron du spyan 'dren na/ /bde chen dngos grub stsol phyin gshegs su gsol/ /rnam 'dren rnams kyi dpang pon mkhas blangs pa/ /sa bdag sa yi lha mo bstan ma dang / /gnas 'dir gnas shing bsrung ba'i gzhi bdag rnams/ / 'khor bcas 'khor ba'i sems can don du gshegs/ /steng na bla ma rgyal ba sprin bzhin 'du/ /bar na mkha' 'gro srung ma char bzhin gtibs/ /'og tu yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad 'dus/ /dgyes shing brtse ba'i brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /kye kye/ dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i dam dzas spyan gzigs kyis/ / sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste/ / mgron du bos shing 'dus pa thams cad mchod/ /stong gsum khyab pa'i rin chen snod nang du/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i btung ba rgya mtsho dang / /ri ltar spungs pa'i zhal zas dam pa 'di/ /mchod 'os rnams la 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ / gser zhun 'bar 'dra'i me lce 'khyel ba'i klong / / dri zhim bsang rdzas brgyu phrag bsregs pa yis/ / dbang sngon dud sprin lha lam gang ba 'dis/ / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha tshogs bsang / / mchod cing brngan pas rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang / /lus rnams sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhan gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / kye kye/ stobs dang rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa'i/ /lha klu gzhi bdag tshogs rnams la/ / bdag gis sa 'di bslang bad bgyi/ / ko long du nga ma mdzad par/ /dgyes shing brtse ba'i gnang nas kyang / /las 'di 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /kye kye/ kad byung thugs rje'i sprin phung nyer dkrigs nas/ /byin rlabs 'dod dgu'i chan chen 'bebs mdzad pa/ /bla ma lha dang srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bkra shis phun tshogs dngos grub char du phobs/ / phyogs bcu'i zhing na bde legs dpal g.yang rnams/ /ma lhas de ring 'di du g.yang la pyon/ / khyad par bstan pa'i dpal g.yang nying khu rnams/ /bkra shis ldan pa'i gnas 'dir 'dus gyur cig /mkha' la nyi zla'i gzi 'od rab 'ban zhing / / sa la phun tshogs dge mtshan g.yang du 'khyel/ / bar du 'gro kun chos srid 'byor ba rgyas/ / bde legs rgyun mi chad pa'i bkra shis shog /de nas di hūṃ ga sta ga1 nam

sa / lhang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mkha'i rang bzhin stong ba nyid du gyud/ hūṃ ma hūṃ sa gzhi rdo rje phra nab kyi nang bzhin du gyud/oṃ me de ni badzra bha wa badzra bhan dha hūṃ/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i nang bzhin du bcings te brtan pad byas par gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na badzra kro dha hūṃ rdo rje khro bos bgegs rnams bcom par gyur/ de nas spro na/ long yod na lto 'phye brtags/ min na stong nyid kyi ngang nas sa rko zhing khod stoms par byus pa'i steng du dri bzang gis chag chag gdab/ padma 'dab brgyud dang 'bru tshom bkod pa'i dbus su gte1 bum bzhag la mchod pa byin rlabs dang / bum pa sgrub pa nas 'od zhu'i bar gong ltan/ de nas/ khru/srid pa dang po gang nas srid/ / dbyings las thabs kyi 'od lnga shar/ / yul lnga'i 'dzin pa thugs rje'i rtsal/ /phyi nang sgod bcud 'jig rten grub/ /srid pa'i mes po tshangs pa yis/ /'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud nor bu'i tshogs/ /mi zad dpal gyi gted du sbas/ /srid pa'i khri brgyad gter bdag bskon/ /lha dang mi dang lha min klu/ /dpal 'byon bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ / skal bzang stong gi gdul zhing gyur/ /de 'og lha dbang brgya byin dang / / rgyal po chen po sde bzhi yis/ / di rgyul lhun po'i steng 'og bar/ / nor bu'i gter kha dpag med sbas/ /gter bdag mgon po dzi bha la/ /thugs rje smon lam dbang gis grub/ /lha rnams kun gyi tshe dpal rgyas/ / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gdul zhing gyur/ / klu rgyal mtha' yas 'jog po yis/ / mtsho gling non bu'i chos gted sbas/ / snang gsal gzi byen bde skyid ldan/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing gyun/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yis/ /klong lnga mi shigs gsang sgrom du/ / rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i chos gter sbas/ / mi zad theg pa'i mdzod klong rdol/ /dpa' bo lag na rdo rje yi/ /gsang sngags ston pa'i gdul zhing gyur/ /sangs rgyas sems can mnyam par spyor/ /ngo mtshar rten 'brel rbad du byung / /de nas gangs can bod kyi yul/ /sngags 'chang padma thod 'phreng gis/ /sa gzhi byin brlabs lha srin btul/ /'byung ba bcud kyi gter sbas pa'i/ /chos rgya' mnga' ris rgyas pa dang / /mdo sngags chos kyi sgron me sbar/ /sngon byung rten 'brel ji bzhen du/ /da lta rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyis1 /nad mtshon dus 'khrugs zhi ba dang / / char chu dus bab lo phyugs legs/ / bstan pa rgyas dang sde srid brtan/ /'jig rten bkra shis dge legs phyir/ / rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa yis/ / 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gter bum 'di/ / sangs rgyas yum lnga'i mkha' dbyengs su/ /mi nub brtan pa'i btsas su sba/ /sngon gyi thugs dam deng dgongs la/ /'dzam gling yul gru sa phyogs 'dir/ / 'byung ba lnga yi bcud bsdus la/ / yul 'di'i sa bcud rgyas pa dang / / tshe dpal ting 'dzin nyams rtogs 'phel/ / bkra shis dge legs rgyas par mdzo——/ /172gaXsbas ni/ hūṃ/ skyob pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /sa yi lha mo ka bye

rdo 'bum dkar po ba migs tshul rin chen lhun po bzhugs so/ /shig / sa yi lha mo'i mkha' dbyengs su/ / rgyal bas byen brlabs bkra shis rdzas/ / snying po lnga dang rin chen lnga/ /sman lnga 'bru lnga dri bzang lnga/ /dar tshon sna lnga la sogs pa'i/ /mi zad 'dod dgu'i longs sbyod kyis/ / yongs gang gter chen 'di sped do/ / yid bzhin gten chen 'di sbas pas/ 1bdag cag yon mchod gnas yul bcas/ /nad mtshon myu ge'i skal ngan zhi/ /tshe ring nyi zla lta bud shog /bsod nams yar zla ltar 'phel shog /mnga' thang dgung dang mnyam pan shog /snyan pa phyogs brgyan grags par shog /mdor na mi non bkra shis shing / /bde spyid bsam don kun 'grub shog /gzhan yang gter chen byen rlabs kyis/ / stong gsum gnas gzhi'i bdag rnams dang / / yul 'di'i gnas bdag tshogs rnams kung / / 'jigs bral dpal 'byon phun tshogs shog / lus ngag gdug tsub zhi gyur cig / phan bde'i sems dang ldan par shog / rgyal bstan yun ring gnas par shog /rgyal khams bde dges khyab par shog / ces brjod la me tog 'thor/ bum pa'i steng du sbog shing btsugs la/ kye kye/ de ring srid pa'i gza' skan dang / / ches grangs dus tshod brtsis na bzang / /'khor lo padma nyi zla'i dbus/ /gnam sa'i bar du srog shing btsugs/ /lho sprin rlung gi dmu thag 'then/ / bar snang ljon shing lo 'dab rgyas/ / 'bras bu bum bkang rgya mtshon ba spyi la/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ / rkang gnyis mi dang rkang bzhi phyugs/ / hpha g.yang zas nor mkho dgu'i tshogs/ /'bad med 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog / ces brtan par btsugs/ rde'u rnams blugs nas brtsigs/ mdun du chu gnyis nyer sbyod bshams/ bsang spyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las mchod rten 'di nyid rnam snang dkad po zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa nang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa rin po che'i spyon dang dar gyi na bza' can zhabs rdo rje skyil thung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor yo/ mgrin pan yāḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs / dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhas dbang bskur mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan pan gyur/ oṃ dzi na dzi ga arghaṃ sogs dang / rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ / rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ / rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar hūṃ yig gi mthar bzlas byu'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad spyan drangs te sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim par gyur/ yo dzi na dzig hūṃ phaṭa/ ci 'grub bzla/ yig brgya brjod/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par ba ga gci ༷༷ la

gas/ 1nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brtan par bzhugs nas sbyin bdag dang bdag sogs sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pad snang mdzad yab yum 'od du zhu nas mchod rten sgyu rnam par gyun/ zhes dang / rgyas par rab gnas dang /bsdu na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med che dang dbang phyug dang / / mchog rnams legs par bstsal tu gsol/ / yo spe pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brtan bzhugs dang / ye dharma dang rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po sogs bkra shis kyi tshig ci rigs pa brjod nas dga' ston bya'o/ /smras pa/ rgyal 'as 'gro la phan phyir thabs sna tshogs/ /gsungs pa'i nang tshan brtsigs pa dkar po yi/ /phyag len gsal bar bkod pas 'gro ba kun/ /bkra shis phun tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ces brtsigs pa dkar po'am del 'bum dkar po sgrub tshul 'di ni/ slob bu dkon mchog non bu sogs don gnyen can mang pos bskul ngor/ nyang skyes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am snang mdzad rdo rjes nang blos ma bslad par gzhung rnams dang mthun par dge steng dgon pa'i nye 'dabs/ yul lha u zur phyug par bye sdi bye sdi 'bro/gas snyed ma da lo ༈ra gyi spyil bu nas spyan ba'o/ /bkra shis/ 'dis kyang kun la phan thogs

ci nyi bcigs tshul rab ba'i da ri rab lhan po bzhugs so/ /mtsho/ /ci ti brtsigs tshu' nab brjid di nab lhan po zhes byu pe bzhugs so/ /ra / /rgyul kun mthu stobs sra brtan ri rab kyis/ /log 'dren ldang med gnon pa'i stobs ldan pa/ / yi dam lha yi zhabs la gus btud nas/ / ci ti nag po brtsigs tshul deng 'did sbo/ /de la 'dir ci ti nag po brtsigs tshul la gsum las/ / dang po ni/ yi dam gang yin gyi mnan gzhung ltar liṅgā bris la 'brub khung du gzhug srog shing gla ba sogs drag po'i shing gi rtse mo dbal byus/phur pa'i dbyibs su bzos pa'i 'chang bzung gi ngos gsum la phyag rgya dpe'u ris ltar bris pa'i mjug tu yi dam gyi sngags dang stobs po che'i sngags/ oṃ badzra kro dha ma hwa pā la sbo ṭa sbo ṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ga rdza ga rdza ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bharnyi bharnyi hu lu hu lu tikhri tiṣṭha ba ba dhika dhika hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ gnod byed dgra bgegs dam gri 'byung bo thams cad mtshams chod cig sarba lha tsa ta ya hūṃ phaṭa gnod byed mā ra ya zlogaces bri dbal gsum gyi rgyab kyi dbal la/ oṃ badzra kro dha ma hwa pā la sbo ṭa sbo ṭa ya kyi la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rgyab nas ltag bdud ma ldangs cig sto snya ya lo nan/ g.yas kyi dbal la/ oṃ badzra kro dha ma sgyu pā la sbo ṭa sbo ṭa ya kyi la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ g.yas nas glo bun sa dgra ma ldang cig mā na ya nan/ g.yon du oṃ badzra kro dha ma hwa pā la sbo ṭa sbo ṭa ya kyi la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ g.yon nas klu dang sa bdag gdug pa ma ldang cig na sha ya mā ra ya nan/ces bris pa re bas btum/ mchod rten rnying ba'i sa dang dur thal la sna tsha dgu brgya btab ba'i nang du spro na yi dam sngags dang mnan sngags bris pa'i phyed dkan po dang phyed nag po byu/ nag po'i nang du rwam bu dang dkar po nas kyi gzungs gzhug phul/ mnan thod sogs tshang bar bsags/ gnyis pa ni/ yi dam gyi gzhungs bsrangs mnan sgrub rtags thon byus te chings su bcug gsum pa las spyor ni sa gnad gang yin du song nas gsen skyems sngon du 'gro ba'i mnan pa gzhung ltar brub pa'i steng du sru tsha nag po mgo thur bstan gtor ma nyer gcig yang bzhag pa'i steng sru tsha dkan po rnams mgo gyen du bstan pa'i steng du srog shing btsug la ci ti thu gsum du brtsigs la mdog nag por bsgyur la ngag 'don ni/ hūṃ/ bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ / gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i gzu dpang mdzod/ /bdag la sdang zhing gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /sa sna brag sna 'di nu lhan du khug / ci ti nag po 'di yi 'og tu mnan/ / nam yang ldang med mnan pa'i 'jin las mdzod/ / de nas gtad khrim bya ba ni/ yo sku las byung ba'i khro bo'i sprul ba 'gyed/ /āḥgasung las sprul ba'i dbyings nas nol ba mdzod/ /hūṃ thugs las sprul ba'i 1dhi~Xs 1sum

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dbang du sdud/ /sku gsung thugs kyi khro bo rnams/ /sprun nas bskal ba'i me chen 'ban/ /shangs nas bskal ba'i rlung nag 'tshub/ / thugs gan bharnya khrig bkang bsnams/ / sgeg mo greng sgrol glu dbyangs ni/ / hūṃ phaṭa dgra bgegs rnams la sgrogs/ / yo ka du a tsa la hūṃ bharnya hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ/ sngon gyi bskal ba dang po la/ / rgyul bo'i gdung brgyud 'chad la thug /btsun mo'i 'phel kha skam la thug / rta nod lug 'gab 'chad thug /de yang nag po bdud kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /ci dang ci yis ma thub pa/ /kong tse rgyal bos sa dpyad byas/ /sa zad sa gsum gyi mad 'dabs nas/ /ci ti brtsigs pas shi 'phro bcad/ /kong tse ston pas rab gnas mdzad/ /khro chu nag po nas bzhin gtor/ /ston pa de yi dpe bzhin du/ /de ring sa mkhan bdag nyid kyis/ / sa zad sa gsum gyi sa sna 'dir/ / bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi/ /mi yi rmang 'dre de dang gcig /phyugs kyi god 'dre de dang gnyis/ /shi ba'i shi 'dre de dang gsum/ /na ba'i na 'dre de dang bzhi/ /'gong po'i 'gong 'dre de dang lnga/ /bgegs kyi bgegs 'dre de dang drug / 'chi ba'i 'chi 'dre de dang bdun/ / mnol ba'i mnol 'dre de dang brgyad/ / tri 'dre tri gshed de dang dgu/ / 'dre dgu dgu brgyad cu rtsa gcig rnams/ / ci ti nag po'i 'og tu mnan/ / sa bdag klu gnyan khyod la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bo ma shon cig / khyod kyang phrag dog ma mdzad cig / nga ni ma lan dgra bgegs lan/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du/ /de ring gtad 'di khyod kyis longs/ 1phyugs kyi god 'dre khyod kyis longs/ /shi ba'i shi 'dre khyod kyis longs/ /ci ti 'di dang dgra 'dre gsum/ /sa bdag klu gnyan khyod la bcol/ /bcol ba'i dgra bgegs ma shon cig /tiṣṭha sa ma ya 'i nyi/ de nas ci ti la ram bu dang khro lcags gtor/ hūṃ/ khro bo'i rgyal bo stobs po che/ / sku mdog mthing nag drag po'i sku/ / g.yas g.yon ral gri zhags pa bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis gnod byed gdan la bzhugs/ /drag po'i chas kyis sku la brgyan/ /lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdud/ /sa bdag klu gnyan zil gyis gnon/ /gnod byed 'byung bo rdul du rlogs/ /che sri chung sri thal bar rlogs/ /rgyal bsen dam sri gdon bgegs rnams/ /khro bo'i rgyal bo khyod la gtad/ / hūṃ/ steng 'og phyogs bcu'i pho brang nas/ / khro bcu'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ / ming dus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ / khro bo hūṃ kar khyed la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig /ming rus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /khro chen rnal 'byor khyod la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig /ming dus bris ba gra rdo~XgaX ༷di/ /khro chen dbyug sngon khyod 'a gtad/ / gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma

ci'i brtsigs tshul rab brjid ri rab lhun po bzhugs so/ /shor cig / ming dus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ / khro chen gshin rje khyod la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig /ming rus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /khro chen mi g.yo khyod la gtad/ / gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig / ming dus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /khro chen rta mgrin rgyal bo khyod la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig /ming dus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /khro chen gzhan gyis mi thub khyod la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig / ming dus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ / khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba khyod la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig /ming rus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /khro chen khams gsum rnam rgyul khyod la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig /ming dus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /khro chen stobs chen khyod la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shon cig /ming rus bris ba'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /lha srin sde brgyad khyod la gtad/ / gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig / ming rus bris pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /yul lha gzhi bdag khyod la gtad/ /gtad pa'i dgra bgegs ma shor cig / gtad dang mnan pa nga yis bya/ / 'dzin dang sdom pa khyod kyis gyis/ /bsregs pa'i no la langs pa med/ / nyi zla gzhan du 'gyur ba med/ / rgyal ba'i bka' la 'gyur ba med/ /bden pa'i bka' las ma 'da' cig /che sri dar sri chung sri mnan/ /rta sri nor sri thams cad mnan/ / ra sri lug sri thams cad mnan/ / phug gi rdzas la gnod pa mnan/ /khyem gyi mi la gnod pa mnan/ /sgo yi non la gnod pa mnan/ / de nas re nag gi nang du ram bu blug la srog shing rked la skud pa nag pos bcings shing 'di skad do/ / kyi/ bla ma yi dam gzu dang dpang / / chos skyong srung ma gzung dang dpung / / lha klu gnyan rnams gzung dang dpang / / lha srin sde brgyud gzung dang dpang / / de ring ci ti nag po 'di/ / lha klu gnyan la ma 'phog cig / 'di ni bdud kyi thag pa yin/ / 'di ni gshin rje'i zhags pa yin/ /btsan kyis zhags pa da 'phong zhig / dgra 'dre 'gong gsum da bcing ngo 'chi bdag 'dre ni da bcing ngo / / mi yi kang 'dre da bcing ngo / / phyugs kyi god 'dre da bcing ngo / /mi kha bram mchu da bcing ngo / /shi 'dre gson 'dre da bcing ngo / /'gags 'dre dbul 'dre da bcing ngo / /na 'dre 'chi 'dre da bcing ngo / /che sri chung sri da bcing ngo yo badzra yakṣa dgra bgegs thams cad chings shig sruhwa/ hūṃ/ bdag dang rgyu 'byor yon bdag gi/ /lha rabs brgyud kyi sgab 'dre de/ / ci ti nag po'i 'og tu mnan/ / mi rabs brgyud kyi zang tse ti 'dre de/ /ci ti nag po'i 'og tu mnan/ /phyugs rabs brgyud kyi dbuX ༷dre1 bye/7 ba/༷ —

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo ji'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nag po'i 'og tu mnan/ /che sri chung sri dam sbo rnams/ /ci ti nag po'i 'og tu mnan/ /dgra 'dre gyod gsum 'gong bo rnams/ / ci ti nag po'i 'og tu mnan/ / oṃ badzra yas gnod byed sarba ba'i 1na baṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ de nas ci ti'i ltag par skyen phur gdabs la 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ de ring bla ma yi dam dgongs su gsol/ / mkha' 'gro chos skyong dgongs su gsol/ /shar phyogs dri za'i 'dre ni mgo gsum can/ /mig ni dpral ban yod pa de/ / de yang ci ti nag po khyod kyis thul/ / 'dre mig skyer ba'i phur bus thob/ / shar phyogs dgra 'dre 'gong gsum ma ldang zhig / lho phyogs gshin rje'i 'dre ni rta nag can/ / dpral ban mig gsum yod pa de/ /de yang ci ti nag po khyod kyis thul/ /'dre mig skyer ba'i phud bus thob/ /lho phyogs dgra 'dre 'gong gsum ma ldang cig / nub phyogs klu gdon 'dre ni rta mgo can/ /'dre kha na so gsum yod pa de/ / de yang ci ti nag po khyod kyis thul/ / 'dre mig skyen pa'i phur bus thob/ / nub phyogs dgra 'dre 'gong gsum ma ldang cig / byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'dre ni rta sed can/ / 'dre dpral bar mig gsum yod pa de/ / de yang ci ti nag po khyod kyis thul/ /'dre mig skyen ba'i phun bus thob/ /byang phyogs dgra 'dre 'gong gsum ma ldang cig /sdig can dgra bgegs las ngan rnams/ /phun bus thob la rdul du rlogs/ / oṃ badzra kyi li kyi la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas ci ti la rab gnas ni nam bu gtor la/ yo ge re go ya zlogake ya re zlog de nas bro ba brdung bya/ oṃ paṃ āḥlo hūṃ lo snyi bha ya paṃ dka mā ra ya nan nanaḥhūṃ/ rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo/ / lha rgyal lo lha min pham gyur cig / sangs rgyas rgyal lo bdud rnams pham gyur cig /chos rnams rgyal lo chos min pham gyur cig /dge 'dun rgyal lo mu stegs pham gyur cig / bla ma rgyal lo sku dgra pham gyur cig / bdag cag spyol lo dgra bgegs pham gyun cig /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag dang bzhi/ /rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'di dang lnga/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'di dang drug/dam pa chos skyong 'di dang bdun/ /ri rab rtse la yar la rgyal/ /rgyul lo rgyal lo lha rgyul lo/ /bdud dang mu stegs srin po gsum/ /dgra sdang 'gong bo 'di dang bzhi/ /rgyal bsen dam sri 'di dang lnga/ /che sri chung sri 'di dang drug /ming dus bris pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /ri rab 'og tu mā na ya nan/ / yo badzra yakṣa kha shā/ bro brdungs rgyas 'debs gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /rjes gcod la/ rgyang bu'i ngos la/ khrom byu khyung / rmu 'jam dpal/ dza sdig pa/ bhāḥrta mgrin/hūṃ phyag rdor rnams bskyed la yi ge lnga bris la 'dzugs/ bsrung 'khor bsgom/ rjes chog rnams gzhung ba'i na bya'o/ /'di ni dus kyi dbang gis dam nyams mang zhing sems can tshe thung / sngags pas dam tshig mi bldan /17skyi/ rdo'i 'dul khrims nyams/ skye bos dmag 'khrug byed / bud med rabs chad

ci ti bcigs tshul rab brjid ri rab lhan po bzhugs so/ /nad rigs sna tshogs 'ong ba'i dus der lha tshogs kun 'dus kyi gtad khrim chen po ci ti nag po 'di/ shi gzhug gcod pa'i sta res/ rmang 'dre 'dul ba'i thun chen/ byad ma gnon pa'i ri rab/ nad yams gcod pa'i sgyul mtshan/ dgra bo brlag pa'i mtshon cha 'di brtsigs pas nges par phan zhes yo rgyun chen pos gsungs so/ / ci ti dgu brtsigs byed na thod pa sna dgu dgos/ dang po khyi thod/ phag rta/drel/ mdzo/ rtol mgo/ mgar du/ spyang ki/ grum pa/ wa thod dgu'o/ /gla ba skyed ba srog shing byas la thun du gom pa re'i sna nas dgu brtsigs dgos so/ /smras pa/ snyigs dus 'gro kun dge sdig 'chol ba'i tshe/ / sngar med dam sri 'byung bo'i gnyen po ru/ /rab bsngags ci ti nag po brtsigs pa'i thabs/ /dam pa gong ma'i srol bzhin 'di du bkod/ /dge des ma rig dug lnga'i rnam rtog 'dre/ ṣe shes lnga ldan ri rab lhun po yis/ ldang med mnan nas 'gro kun bde ba dang / / kun kung chos la spyod pa'i rgyun gyur cig /ces ci ti brtsigs tshul rab brjid ri rab lhun po 'di ni phyi rabs sngags pa yongs la phan pa'i blos nyang sngags snang mdzad rdo rjes sbyar ba dge'o/ /

ra / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dmi/ /'ab tse'i dpangs bstod dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes byu pe bzhugs so/ /da / /'jam dbyungs kong tse'i lha la phyag 'tshal nas/ / yul lha mnyes byed lab tse'i dpang bstod bri/ /dus tshes dge bar lab tse'i mdun ngos su/ /gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du tshom bu bkod/ /dbus su rngon gton pad sdong tshigs gsum mthan/ / seṅge glang chen rta 'brug khyung dang ni/ / bya lug g.yag gsum snyan pa'i byu ba'i dang / / dkar gtor bcu gsum bsrung bzhi'i bskor ba bshams/ / lab tse'i rngon cha stag shug mda' mdung gri/ / dmu dag rtsis rdo bcu gsum bal gyis btum/ / dmu dag shel tshig 'bru zan bal tshon dang / /gser skyems bsang rdzas la sogs rgyu cher bshams/ /thog mar rang nyid lhar gsal bsang bsngos mthar/ / lab tse rngon chas kun la chab kyis bran/ / yo badzra a rde tas bsangs/swā bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las 'byung ba rim brtsegs steng / /phyi ltar sa 'dzin dbang bo'i rnam pa la/ / nang ltar lab tse'i pho brang gzhal yas khang / /'ja' sprin bla re rin chen char du 'bebs/ /bdud rtsi'i rdzing bu dpag bsam shing gis bskon/ /shin tu nyams dga' 'dod yon du mas gang / / de dbus rin chen dar zab 'bol brtsegs steng / / yu la lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas dgyes bzhin bzhugs/ / mdun du rin chen sgod du mchod gtor dang / /bsang mchod gser skyems mthun rdzas nam mkha' khyab/ / stag shug mda' mdung nal gri dmyu dag dang / / shel tshig dkar nag 'bru zan bal tshon sogs/ / lha ma'i longs spyod gzugs sgra dri no reg / bkra shis rtags rdzas rgyul srid sna bdun sogs/ / nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi yongs gang ba/ /rgya che rgyun mi 'chad pa'i gter du gyur/ /badzra sga ra ṇa ka/sngags drug phyag rgya drug dang de bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs brjod la nol mo dbyangs dang bcas pa'i 'di skad do/ /kyi/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi dam chos skyong bdag la dgongs/ / sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ / rgyul po 'khor lo drug pa des/ / sku tshe mtha' du phyin pa dang / /mi nor bsod nams spel ba'i phyir/ /kong tse spyol po spyan drangs nas/ /mo rtsis 'khrul 'khor byas pa las/ /rdo gnyan lab tse brtsigs dgos zer/ /rgyal po 'khor lo drug pa des/ / bkra shis lha yi nyi ma la/ / gser dngul dung g.yu mu tig zangs/ /byu du lcags sogs rin chen dang / /lab tse'i rngon chas sna tshogs dang / /ja chang skyemaX phuX ༵ che dgas/ / kong tse rgyal po'i phyag tu phul/ / kong tse byung chub sems dpa'

lab tse'i dpangs bstod dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so/ /des/ /bkra shis rdo gnyan dkar po la/ /srid pa'i lab tse bcu gsum brtsegs/ /bden tshig smon lam mthu ldan btab/ / spyol po'i sku tshe mthar phyin zhing / / mi nor bsod nams dpal 'byor thob/ / deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /bkra shis dus bzang nyi ma 'dir/ / lab tse'i mchod rngon rgya chen bshams/ / bden tshig smrang gi gab brda sprad/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pan shog / spyan 'dren ni/ kyi/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po yis/ / bka' dang dam la btags pa yi/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i srung ma rnams/ / mchod pa'i gnas 'din gshegs su gsol/ / gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu dang / / sa bdag 'khor los sgyur rgyal dang / / sa yi lha mo bstan ma sogs/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu dang / /yul phyogs 'dir gnas lha klu dang / / yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag sogs/ / mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'go ba'i lha lnga dgra lha dang / /sbog lus dbang klung spar spe'i lha/ / nor lha g.yang lha gter bdag rnams/ / mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / de nas bzhugs gsol ni/ kyi/ mchod pa'i yul du spyan drangs pa'i/ /mgron rnams ma lhas thams cad kun/ / dgra lha'i dpang rdzong gnyan po 'dir/ / rten la brtan par bzhugs su gso' / / mchod pa ni/ kyi/ rdo gnyan lab tse bcu gsum 'di/ /lha dang srung ma'i pho brang yin/ /pho lha dgra lha'i sku mkhar yin/ /sa bdag klu gnyan rten sa yin/ /lab tse'i dbus kyi drang shing la/ /dgra lha'i dung khyung dkar pos brgyan/ /lab tse gnyan po'i sro ga shing byus/ / gnyan shing stag pa shug pa la/ / stag gzig dom dred ba dan btags/ /lo 'dab 'bras ldan shing sna rnams/ /lab tse gnyan po'i phyogs bzhir brgyan/ / rin chen sna dgu 'bru sna dang / / sman mchog rnam pa sna tshogs dang / / gted gyi bum pa mang po rnams/ / lab tse gnyan po'i snying po byus/ / mda' mdung ral gri sba smyug dang / /sta ga pa'i pho thong la sogs pa/ /bal tshon dar gyis brgyun pa 'di/ /lab tse gnyan po'i phyi rten rngon/ / ja chang gsed skyems gtor ma dang / / shel tshig 'bru zan bal tshon rnams/ / sngags dang phyag rgyus byin brlabs nas/ / lab tse gnyan po'i mchod par bshams/ /shar phyogs dgra lha'i seṅge dkan/ /dam nyams dgra bo chem la phob/ /lho phyogs dgra lha'i g.yu 'brug sngo/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i khrim ka phyis/ /nub phyogs dgra lha'i stag tshang dmar/ / btsan dang ma mo'i dal kha chod/ /byang phyogs dgra lha'i 'brong chen nag /klu gnyan sa bdag gnod pa thul/ / steng du 'dab chags bso sgra ldir/ —/ ka 8 | sdod kha

sa 1 /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigasabazlog tu gsol/ /rtsa bar gcan gzan ri dwags 'khor/ /dgra jag chom rkun 'jigs ngo sgyur/ / de 'dra'i lab tse gnyan po 'dis/ / pho lha dgra lha gyen du bstod/ 1 rnal 'byor bdag gi ngo so stod/ /ci bsam lhun gyis 'thub par mdzod/ /bso bso cha'o lha rgyal lo/ /de nas gser skyems mchod la/ kyai/ de ring dus bzang nyi ma la/ / ja chang dkan gsum mchod pa dang / / gser skyems dam pa'i mchod tshogs 'di/ / sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs nas/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod/ /ye shes chos skyong srung ma mchod/ /gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu mchod/ / pho lha dgra lha nod lha mchod/ / khyad par yul 'di'i gzhi bdag mchod/ /gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ / bsam pa'i don rnams 'thub pan mdzod/ / bso bso cha'o lha rgyal lo/ /rngon gtor 'bul ba ni/ kyi1 rin chen yangs pa'i snod nang du/ /'bru zan sna dgu las grub pa'i/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'dis/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong non lha gter bdag dang / / dpal mgon bdun cu zo don lha/ / lha klu gzhi bdag thams cad brngan/ /khyed rnams brngan pa'i yon tan gyis/ /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /ci bsam don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /bsro bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / de nas rngon cha'i rdzas rnams kyi thog mar mkhan byu btsugs la 'di skad do/ / kyi/ bstod do srid pa'i mkhan byas brngon/ /lab tse 'di yi rtse mo la/ / mdzes pa'i mkhan byu dkar po btsugs/ / phung po mkhan shug gnyis las grub/ /mkhan la thang dkar lding ba bzhin/ /dgra lha'i mkhan byu dkar po lding / / mda' la dar dkar btags pa bzhin/ / dgra lha'i mkhan bya dkan po 'di/ /lab tse khyod kyi rten du btsugs/ /lha dang srung ma'i rten du btsugs/ /dgra lha spen ma'i rten du btsugs/ / thugs kar zo dor rten du btsugs/ / yul lha gzhi bdag rten du btsugs/ /lha klu sde brgyad rten du btsugs/ /sa bdag klu gnyan rten du btsugs/ /skyes bu lam lha'i rten du btsugs/ / mkhan byu'i brngan pa'i yon tan gyis/ / rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khon bcas kyi/ / kha 'dzin rgyab rten mgon skyabs mdzod/ / mi phyugs nad yams zhi ba dang / /ci bsam don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /bsro bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / de nas stag pa'i pho thong btsugs la 'di skad do/ / kyi/ 'dzam gling lho phyogs sman ri na/ /gnyan shing stag pa'i rtse rgyal 'di/ / rtse mo ri nab lhun por slebs/ / yal ga bar snang kun la khyab/ /lo ma sngon pos dgung sngon khyab/ /rtsa ba ma pham mtsho la thug /stag pa'i pho thong rtse mo la/ / bal tshon sna lnga thibs se thib/ / yal ga lo 'dab re re la/ / dar tshon sna lnga ba se ḍi~X / —/dung byur g.yu gsum rgyan du btags/ /de 'dra'i stag pa'i rtse rgyal 'di/ /

lab lha'i dpangs bstod dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so/ /lha dang srung ma 'go ba'i lha/ / yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang / / pho lha dgra lha za grogs lha/ /sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad la/ /stag pa'i pho thong rten du 'bul/ /tshe ring mched lnga bstan skyong bcas/ /gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu dang / /thugs kad drang mkhan zo dor dang / /sper ma dgra lha sman btsun la/ / stag pa'i pho thong rten tu 'bul/ /khyed rnams brngan pa'i yon tan gyis/ / bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ / stobs 'byon mnga' thang 'phel ba dang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /bswo bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / shug pa'i rtse rgyal btsugs la/ kyi/ bod yul de ni sog ka 'dzin/ / g.yu shug sngon po lams se lam/ /thog tu g.yu brad si li li/ /dri mchog phyogs bcur thu lu lu/ /'bras ldan lo 'dab ldems se sdem/ / de 'dra'i shug pa'i rtse rgyal 'di1 / lha dang srung ma dpal mgon dang / / yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul/ / shug pa'i rtse rgyal phul ba'i mthus/ /bdag dang yon bdag kha 'dzin mdzod/ /mi phyugs nad rims god kha zlogs/ /ci bsam don rnams 'thub par mdzod/ /bsro bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / de nas mda' 'bul ba ni/ kyai/ lha shing drang ba sba sgyug la/ / bya rgyal rgod po'i sgro yis bsgron/ / mdzes pa'i mtshal gyi ri mos brgyan/ / mi 'bral mi shigs rgyus pas dkris/ / drag po lcags kyi mde'u btsugs/ / ltong la 'bri mar sen pos byugs/ /mgul du dar tshon sna lnga btags/ / de 'dra'i lha mda' ngo mtshan can/ / lha klu gnyan dang sa bdag dang / / drang mkhan wer ma zo don dang / / pho lha dgra lha za grogs lha/ / yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul/ / mda' rngon byas pa'i yon tan gyis/ / snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas pan shog / bswo bswo cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / mdung rngon ni/ kyi/ gnyan shing stag pa mtho dgu la/ / rtse mo mdung lcags gru bzhi btsugs/ / mgul du dar tshon sna lnga btags/ / bstan pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs 'dul/ / de 'dra'i lha mdung ngo ma tshar can/ / pho lha dgra lha nor lha dang / / 'go ba'i lha lnga gzhi bdag sogs/ /ma lus 'khor bcas mdung gis brngan/ /mdung rngon byas pa'i yon tan gyis/ /sdang dgra gnod byed chem la phob/ /bsro bsro cha'o lha spyol lo/ / ral gri phul/kyi/ gnam lcags ral gri 'od po che/ / mthong ba tsam gyis dgra sdang 'joms/ / phyar ba tsam gyis me chen 'bar/ / brgyab pa tsam gyis dgra srog gcod/ / rin chen sna lngas yu ba byus/ /de 'dra'i ral gri ngo mtshar che/ / lha klu gnyan dang gzhi bdag dang / / pho lha dgra lha 'go ba'i lha1 /dpal mgon bdun cu sde brgyad sogs/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral gris brngan/ /ral gris brngan pa'i yon tan gyis/ /gnod byed dgra bo'i ba rtsa ka 8 3/ ba/ba

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / dmu dag 'then la/ kyi/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo /rgyu 'byon yon gyi bdag po yis/ / rin chen dka dag sna lnga 'di/ / rgyal ba rigs lnga'i phyag mdud yin/ /mi 'chi tshe yi dmu dag yin/ /sne mo le gu'i lha yis zungs/ /lha yi dmu dag dkar po 'di/ / yon bdag rnams kyi tshe dag yin/ / lha dang srung ma gzhi bdag dang / /'go ba'i lha lnga skyob pa'i lha/ / pho lha dgra lha thams cad kyis/ / rin chen dmu dag yar la zungs/ / rgyu 'byor yon gyi bdag po yis/ / dmu dag dkad po yar 'then pas/ / dmu dag lha dang 'phrad par shog / yon bdag che thag ring bar shog / bsro bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / rtsis rdo bstod la/ kyi/ de ring bkra shis lha yi nyi ma la/ /rin chen rtsis rdo dkar po bcu gsum 'di/ / dgra 'dre byud gsum mkhar las ma thon par/ / lab tse gnyan po'i dbus su yar la bstod/ / lha klu gnyan dang sa bdag shugs mgon dang / / gtod dang thugs kar drang mkhan wer ma'i tshogs/ /pho lha dgra lha mo lha g.yang lha dang / /yul lha rnams kyang ngo so yar la bstod/ / bsro bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / lab tse'i phyogs bzhir bal tshon bran la/ kyi/ ye shes bal tshon sna lnga 'di/ / rgyu ni bkra shis lug las byung / / 'byung ba rlung gis bskyod de btags/ / kha dog sna lnga'i tshon gyis bsgyun/ / yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang / /pho lha dgra lha zo dor lha/ /sdong grogs byed pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /ye shes bal tshon sna lnga 'bul/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ / las dang bya ba 'thub par mdzod/ /bsro bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / shel tshig gtor la/ kyi/ shel tshig khri dkar stong nag 'di dag ni/ /dkar mo lug brgya 'ba' skad lhangs se lhang / /khra bo ku du rta brgya 'tsher skad sgrogs/ / nag mo 'bri brgya ngur sgra chems se chem/ /zhur mo ra brgya sna sbrid sha na ra/ /dar zab bal tshon shing sna rnam pan bkra/ /'dab chags ri dwags g.yung dwags rtse bro 'khrab/ / gcan gzan rngu gnas nya lhong khyugs se khyug / sa bdag lha klu'i mthun rdzas shel tshig 'di/ /'bul lo sa bdag lha klu rnams la 'bul/ /bsngo'o yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan la bsngo/ / bzhes nas bdag gi bsam don ma lus sgrubs/ / lan chags byang zhing sha 'khon dag pa dang / / 'gro rnams 'dod dgu'i dpal la spyod par shog / bswo bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / 'bru zan gtor la/ kyi/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /sprel rgyal ha la mdzi yis/ /bod yul 'gro don mdzad pa'i dus/ / sems can rnams la zas med pas/ / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la zhus/ / 'bru nas sna bdun sa bon gnang / / sgron lam btab nas sa gzhi lda/ 18/༵sbyod nas 'bru zan sna dgu smin/ / 'gro ba rnams kyi zas su gyur/ / sngon tshe

la bka'i dpangs bstod dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so/ /'bru zan de ltad srid/ / de ring rgyu 'byor yon bdag gis/ / bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro dang / /dpal mgon bdun cu lha klu gnyan/ / sman gzod gtor gsum sde brgyad dang / /khyad par yul 'di'i gzhi bdag la/ /'bru zan sna dgu'i mchod pa 'bul/ /'bru zan phul ba'i yon tan gyis/ /bdag dang rgyu 'byon yon bdag gi/ /zas nor longs spyod 'phel ba dang / / 'dzad med gter la spyod par shog / bsro bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / de nas lab tso dpangs bstod bya ba ni/ yon bdag rnams kyi lag tu nas bzung nas g.yas bskor byas nas lab tse la gton zhing / kyi/ de ring bkra shis nyi ma la/ / lha dang srung ma g.yas su 'khor/ / yul lha gzhi bdag g.yas su 'khon/ / g.yas su 'khor no lha rgyal lo/ / dgung la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /lab tse gnyan po'i dpangs bstod do/ / bar snang 'ja' tshon bkra ba bzhin/ /lab tse gnyan po'i dpangs bstod do/ / gangs la seṅge 'gying ba bzhin/ / lab tse gnyan po'i dpangs bstod do/ / brag la bya rgod lding ba bzhin/ / lab tse gnyan po'i dpangs bstod do/ / mtsho la chu chen 'bab pa bzhin/ / lab tse gnyan po'i dpangs bstod do/ /nags la rgya stag 'phyo ba bzhin/ /lab tse gnyan po'i dpangs bstod do/ /mkhar la mdung dar btsugs pa bzhin/ / lab tse gnyan po'i dpangs bstod do/ / spang la me tog rgyas pa bzhin/ /lab tse gnyan po'i dpangs bstod do/ / rmog la rgod 'phru btsugs pa bzhin/ /lab tse gnyan po'i dpangs bstod do/ / pho lha dgra lha'i ngo so bstod/ / nor lha g.yang lha'i ngo so bstod/ / tshe lha sbog lha'i ngo so bstod/ / ngo so bstod do lha rgyul lo/ / de nas yon bdag rnams la dgra lha bkod nas phywa g.yang dngos grub ster ba ni/ kyi/ lha dang srung ma mchod pa'i dus/ / bdag dang dgra lha ma 'bral cig / mtsho dang nya mo 'grogs pa bzhin/ / bdag dang dgra lha ma 'bral cig / lus la go khrab gyon pa bzhin/ / bdag dang dgra lha ma 'bral cig /pha mas bu tsha skyong ba bzhin/ /bdag dang dgra lha ma 'bral cig /nor bus dgos 'dod 'byung ba bzhin/ / bdag dang dgra lha ma 'bral cig / bdag dang rgyu 'byor yon bdag gi/ / lha mi'i ngo so mtho bar shog /mi srog lcags kyi sra bar shog /mi grangs nas kyis 'phel bad shog / mi non rgyud rnams 'phel ban thog / ci bsam don rnams 'grub par shog /bsro bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ / de nas bal shugs 'bru zan gsum yon bdag rnams la byin nas/ kyi/ lha dang srung ma mchod pa'i mthus/ / rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /rgya gar rgyal pos lha g.yang phobs/ / rgya nag rgyal pos mdzod g.yang phobs/ / g.yang drung rgyal pos tshe g.yang phobs/ / smon pa'i rgyal pos phywa g.yang phobs1 / phywa dzi rgyal pos rta g.yang phobs/ / pha btsun 'phrul mos non g.yang phobs/ / phya mtsho da/da mo~X ༈ga ༷༷nga

ra / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phobs/ / rdo je legs pas ra g.yang phobs/ / zhing lha tshangs pas 'bru g.yang phobs/ /thab lha yod mos zas g.yang phobs/ /yul lha rnams kyis yul g.yang phobs/ /btsan phyug 'phan pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / phywa dang g.yang lha 'khor bar shog / bsam pa 'thub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /bsro bsro cha'o lha rgyal lo/ /zhes g.yang byin no/ /de nas brtan bzhugs dang bkra shis ni/ kyi/ yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag rnams/ / lab tse 'di la brtan par bzhugs/ / glo bur lhags pa'i mgron rnams kun/ / rang nang gnas dang rten la gshegs/ /bkra shis dge legs rgya chen 'di/ /yul phyogs kun tu khyab gyur cig /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i/ / yid bzhin non bu dpag bsam bzhin/ / sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ / bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ dga' ston rgya cher byas na lha mi dga' ba'i mchog tu 'gyur no/ /smras pa/ yul gyi lha klu gzhi bdag dgyes pa'i phyir/ / yul srol dang bstun lab tse dpangs bstod ༵rdo /ma/ /yul na 'dug pa'i rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i dges/ /yul 'dir bkra shis dge legs 'byung gyur cig/sa / /lab tse'i mjug tu dgra brub mdor bsdus ni/ g.yag ra bla rdo dgra rtswa dgra rdzas dang / / re ba thal 'jam phur bu zhags pa bsags/ / rang nyid lhan gsal 'di skad gyen bar bya/ / ye ka rwa snod gnam lcags 'brub khung gting zab nang / /dri tri las gyun gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams/ /mya ngan 'dug stangs rkang lag lcags su bcug /mngon sum lta bun gsal ba nyid du gyur/ / dgug gzhug ni/ na mo dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /rtsa gsum lha dang mkha' 'gro chos sbyong mthu/ /khyad par yul lha gzhi bdag bden mthu yis/ /dgra sri gdon bgegs thams cad myun du khug / lan gsum/ bla rtswa thogs la/ hūṃ/dam nyams dgra bo'i bla rtswa shol mo 'di/ /yar gyi lha ri'i ngos nas btus pa min/ /mar gyi sa zad gdong nas btus pa yin/ / dgra bo'i bla rtswa'i rtsa ba rtse mo chod/ / yar bsnol mar bsnol mgo bo thur du bkugs/ / 'chor med gshin rje'i zhags pa nag pos chings/ /zhes rwa la gcud/ khram la 'debs pa ni/ hūṃ/ bdud dang gshin rje khram 'debs tshogs rnams kyis/ / dam nyams dgra bo khram dang rtsis la thobs/ / mtshon chas char phobs skyob pa'i lha dang phrol/ / dgra bo ma lhas thal ba'i rdul du rlog / bla rdo gcog pa ni/ hūṃ/dam nyams nyes byed dgra bo'i bla rdo 'di/ /ye shes khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ /khro bo rdo rje tho bas thal bar brdung / / sha khrag dus gsum khang sel nang du brub/ hūṃ/ sngon tshe rigaX dzi1 ༵na po sad 'byung gis/ / ma ṭi du tra'i dpung ba bcag pa ltar/ / rnal 'byor

lab tse'i dpangs bstod dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so/ /bdag cag rgyu 'byor yon bdag la/ / dgra sri gdug can sdang sems can rnams kyis/ /dpung ba da lta nyid du da chog cig / khro bo zur sngags 'dres/ de nas dgra jos brub cing /hūṃ/ lha dang srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag gis/ / bden pa'i stobs kyis dam nyams dgra bo brub/ / sangs rgyas bstan dgra dkon mchog spyi dgra dang / / rnal 'byor sgos dgra yon bdag sdang dgra brub/ / phyi rkun thob shon nang rkun 'og leb dang / / yon bdag ngo log ya ma than log brub/ / mang gral khyad gsod nyung gral skal gcod dang / / nye ring ban gyi kha 'khyen byed pa brub/ /phu nu'i nang dme bza' tshang 'khon 'dre dang / /che sri chung sri dan sri dgra sri brub/ /phung sri god sri pyod sri kha mchu'i sri/ /'gong bo god 'dre rgyal bsen the'u dang brub/ / dgra jag chom rkun khyi spyang la sogs pa/ / mdod na gang gnod dgra sri thams cad brub/ / rdo nag del dgu glang ma glang dgu dang / / tshu sgog g.yer gsum mi kha'i jos kyis brub/ /dgra bo'i bla dang mi kha'i rdzas ngan rnams/ / rgya mtsho'i gting du 'phang ngo ma ldang cig/mā ra ya nan/ thal 'jim sogs thogs la/ hūṃ/ thal 'jim dug gi tsha tshas dong kha chod/ /bdud kyi re nag dka khebs mgo la khob/ / bdud zhags khra bos g.yo 'gul med pan chings/ /gnam lcags phud bu 'ban bas snying la thobs/ / gnam lcags rgya gram 'bar bas kha khob cig / dgra bo mnan no bcings so ste bha ya/ / de nas lab tse mi mthong ba'i gdong sna'am spyo gram sogs su khyer la/ hūṃ/ rang nyid lhar gsal mtshon chas sar bsnun pas/ / sa gzhi gas te rgyu mtsho sngo mer gyun/ / de dbus klu bdud zhal du dgra bo 'di/ /brub po mnan no bcings so snyi bha ya1 / de nas mnan pa'i steng du rdo brtsegs la/ / nam mkha' rlung me chu sas rgyas gdab po/ / dmigs med chos kyi dbyengs su sa ma dhi/ / bro brdung ni/ hūṃ/nang nyid yi dam lha yi sbu/ / phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs/ / g.yas nol bde chen thabs kyi bro/ /g.yon nol shes nab yum gyi bro/ /dgra sri'i mgo la chems se chem/ /dug lnga'i mgo la bro brdung bas/ /sbu lnga ye shes lhun gyis grub/ /rnal 'byor rgyal lo lha rgyal lo/ /smras pa/ rnam thar sgo gsum hom khung du/ / dgra bgegs dug gsum brub pa'i dges/ / me shes sku gsum rtsal rdzogs nas/ / 'gro ba'i dug gsum dag gyur cig /ces lab tse'i dpangs bstod dang dgra brub mdor bsdus 'di yang / yul phyogs 'dir mkho ba che snyam bsgrigs 'dun yod thog sngags rgan ngag dbang dang lha khang dbu mdzad gnyis kyis bskul ngor/nyang gi gcig ban ral ba ༵na rgya mtsho'i ming gis sbyar ba mthong thos kyi yul la bkra shis dge mtshan 'byung ban gyur —ga sarba mad —/ / — 187 —

ga / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dmi/ /lha rten gnas di sogs 'a khrus gso' byed tshu' nab dkan she' gyi bum bzang zhes byu ba bzhugs so/ /ra / /bla ma lha la phyag 'tshal nas/ / khrus kyi cho ga mdor bsdu bri/ / bum pa me long khrus gzhong sogs/ / 'du byus skyabs sems lan gsum bya/ / āḥ rang sems ma bcos stong ba'i rang rtsal las nang rig rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang spyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa snang la rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa/ lhan grub 'od kyi skur lam me/ stong gsal 'dzin pa med par shig ge gsal la phyogs lhung med par dwangs sa ler gsal bar gyun/ces dar cig sems bzung / oṃ badzra a sbo tas bsangs/ su bha was spyangs/ mdun gyi bum pa mi dmigs pa stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang 'a sa baṃ las byung ba'i bum pa dkan po lto ba che ba mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha jos kyi gos kyis mgul ba dkris shing dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa dwangs shing gsal ba'i nang du 'od lnga'i thig ler 'khrigs pa'i gzhal yas khang du nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog shel gyi ri bo la nyi ma shad ba lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdon dril 'dzin pa'i yum dang gnyis su med pad sbyod ba'i sku dwangs gsal gyi thugs kan yi ge brgya ba'i sngags 'bru rnams kha dog dkar po g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zen 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs thams cad tshur bsdus nas bum pa'i chu la thim pas dag byed kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya ———sogs yig brgya ci mang bzlas mthar/ yo badzra sa twa arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hūṃ/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bum lha 'od zhu bum pa'i chu dang dbyen mi phyed par gyun/ de nas lha rten gnas ri mthong sar phyin la/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag / gseg ma la sogs med pa dang / /lag mthil ltar mnyam bee zu lha'i/ /rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig / ri khrus sbyo tshe/18༵ba kyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od sprin phung 'khrigs pa'i klong / / mchod 'os

lha rten gnas ri sogs la khrus gsol byed tshul shel gyi bum bzang bzhugs so/ /skyabs gyud dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha/ / dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ /gsal stong 'od zen 'phro bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ / yul 'di'i gnas ri lha rten gzhi bdag rnams/ / rang rang 'khor tshogs dang bcas gsal ba la/ / dag byed khrus kyi sri zhu bkyi lags na/ / dgyes shing dwangs pa'i sems kyis 'khod pan gyur/ / spyan 'dren ni/ma lhas sems can kun gyi mgon gyun cing / / bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ / dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyun pa'i/ / bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'din gshegs su gsol/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam lha tshogs skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / tshe ring mched lnga bstan skyong bcas/ /gangs can gnas pa thams cad dang / /khyad par yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i/ /yul lha gzhi bdag gshegs su gsol/ / khrus khang bskyed pa ni/ khrus kyi khang ba shin tu dri zhim pa/ / shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing mdzes pa ltar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ / mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der/ / khrus gsol ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bcom ldan sku khrus gsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shī ye āḥhūṃ/chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyen med kung / / gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ / thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ / rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la sku khrus gsol/ / yo sarba ta thā ga ta ma bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shī ye āḥhūṃ/ mthun pa'i smon lam mchog tu rmad byung zhing / /spyad pa spyod tshe na'ang mched gyur la/ /bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la sku khrus gsol/ / yo sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shī ye āḥhūṃ/ kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shī seng / /o rgyan padma rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ / bka' gter brgyud ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ / 'dren mchog yab sras rnams la sku khrus gsol/ / yo sarba ta thā ga sto a dhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shī ye āḥhūṃ/ bltas pa tsam gyis srid gsum dbang du sdud/ /bsdigs pa tsam gyis sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ / bsam pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs/ / o rgyan rin po che la sku khrus gsol/ / yo sarba ta thā ga nye a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya thi ye āḥhūṃ/ che mchog yang dag gshin rje padma dbang / / phur pa ma mo rig 'dzin mchod bstod dang / / drag sngags bka' sdod bdun brgya nyi shu sogs/ /bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la sku khrus gaX/189/yo ༷༷ ta

gas/ nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shī ye āḥhūṃ/ ma mo mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mo ste/ / bad chad sel mdzad rdo rje phag mo yum/ /rigs kyi lha mo gsang ba ye shes dbyings/ /ma brgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shi ye āḥhūṃ/ sngon tshe slob dpon padma'i spyan snga du1 /chos bzhin sgrub par mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /ma g.yel bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la sku khrus gsol/ /yo sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shi ye āḥhūṃ/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gten mnga' zhing / /nor sbyin nor bdag mang bo kun sgyu gtso/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzambha la/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ / yo sarba ta thā ga ta ma bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya thi ye āḥhūṃ/ gdengs ka nor bu 'ban ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa ma lus sel mdzad cing / /bstan la nab dga' mthu rtsal bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khon dang bcas la sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shī ye āḥhūṃ/ tshe ring mched lnga bstan skyong bcas/ / gangs can gnas pa thams cad dang / / khyad pan yul phyogs 'din gnas pa'i/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la sku khrus gsol/ / yo sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūṃ/ rgyul ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / / sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa spyangs slad du/ / rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ / sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a snyi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shri ye māḥhūṃ/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i nang bzhin chu/ / ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ / tshul 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / / bsrung ba dri yi legs bgos zus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /byums pa dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /rtsom pa dri yis legs bgos chus/ / khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ / 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhen chu/ / rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / / ting 'dzin dri yis legs bgos chus/ / khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gso' / / 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /ye shes dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ / 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ / thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /ba ba 1 ༵ sheX ༷ yis ni/ /ci 'dod dngos grub bstsal lha rten gnas ri sogs la khrus gsol byed tshul shel gyi bum bzang bzhugs so/ /bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūṃ/ khrus ras kyis phyi zhing / de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ / gtsang la dri rab bgos pa'i sku phyi'o/ / oṃ hūṃ hūṃ tīḥ.āḥka ya sti shā dha na ye sruhwa/slar yang khrus gsol zhing / ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag chags tshul gyis dam las 'gal/ /gsang sngags dam tshig 'gal gyur pa/ /byang sems bslab pa nyams gyun pa/ /nyan thos 'dul khrims nyams gyur pa/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga/ /log pa'i lam la spyad pa yis/ /bla ma yi dam lha yi tshogs/ / mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang / /yul lha gzhi bdag dkar po'i tshogs/ / nyams grib mi gtsang phog gyun pa/ / nyon mongs dri ma dag gyur nas/ /bag chags dri ma dag gyur cig /shes bya'i dri ma dag gyud cig /nyams chags dri ma dag gyun cig /phyi bgrus dung las dkar gyur cig / nang ba thus mchong las dmar gyur cig /phyi nang dri ma dag gyur cig / shel gong bzhin tu dri med shog nyams grib skyon gos dag gyun cig / byang bar gyun cig stong bar gyur/ / zad par gyur cig mi snang gyun/ /chos dbyings chen por gnas gyur cig / yig brgya'i mthan/ yo sarba ta tha ga ta sa bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūṃḥ sa phyogs yul phyogs 'di zhes bya ba'i/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag rang rang gi ming brjod pa dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa dang 'gal zhing sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags su gyur pa dang snod bcud kyi legs tshogs la sgrib par byed pa'i sdig pa thams cad sharnyi ku du ye sruhwaḥsgrib pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥ nad thams cad sha sto ku ru ye sruhwaḥ gdon thams cad sharnyi ku ru ye swāhāḥ dgra thams cad sharnyi ku du ye swāhāḥ bgegs thams cad sharnyi ku du ye sruhwaḥ rims thams cad shanti ku du ye sruhwaḥ dug thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥdam grib thams cad sharnyi ku du ye sruhwaḥ dkod krib thams cad sharnyi ku du ye sruhwaḥ dme grib thams cad sha sto ku ru ye sruhwaḥ yul grib thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥ 'khon grib thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥ na 'a grib thams cad sharnyi ku du ye sruhwaḥ rtsog grib thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥ mdze grib thams cad shanti ku ru ye sruhwaḥ ro grib thams cad shanti ku du ye sruhwaḥ nyams grib la sogs pa'i mi gtsang rigs thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥkhyad par du yul phyogs 'di la gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag thams cad kyi lus sems la gnod pa'i phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shanti ku du ye sruhwaḥ sa gnyan brkos pa/ ri gnyan slog pa/ shing gnyan bcad pa/ chu gnyan dkrugs pa sogs la brten nas byung ba'i gnod pa dang 'khon thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥ mdze dang phol mi1 ka gyi 1 skya bab

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzhog skam zha 'theng sha bkra sogs sha dus pags pan gnas pa'i nad thams cad sha ni ku du ye sta hwaḥ bye tshan dang mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa drag sngags mnan gtad sogs kyis gdungs pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye swāhāḥ yul lha rnams la gnod pa'i rkyen las byung ba'i mi phyugs kyi nad yams mtha' dag sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥ sad ser than pa dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang kha char sa g.yos 'byung ba'i khams kyi gnod pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥ gza' dang rgyu skan rgyal po dang chom rkun gyi gnod pa sogs mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba thams cad shanti ku du ye sruhwaḥ pha nol gyi byad kha phun kha rbi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad sharnyi ku du ye sruhwaḥ yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa mas kyi sri langs pa/ bar gyi 'byung ba 'khrugs pa thams cad sha sto ku ru ye sruhwaḥ pha tshan gyi lha 'dre ma bu'i byun 'dre snga 'dre rnying ba da 'dre gsar ba yul 'dre 'khyams po thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥ lo skogs zla skegs zhag skogs za ma'i skegs mo ngan phyogs ngan spar spe bdun zur byud kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i rigs ngan pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwaḥ zhes khrus chu phyogs mtshams rnams su gtor rdo// bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa du ma brjod nas me tog gi char dbab par byu'o/ /zhes lha rten gnas ri sogs la khrus gsol byed tshul rab dkar shel gyi bum bzang 'di yang rang slob dkon mchog nor bu sogs don gnyen can du mas yang yang bskul ngor/ skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa rin po che'i gsung rdor sems byabs khrus dang / bag chags stobs 'joms/ khri gung thang ba'i gsung ༈༵ spyi1 ba'o / / la /ga'i byas/ yongs grags spyan 'dren khrus gsol gyi 'gros ltar nyang sngags snang mdzad rdo

bcu gsum 'khor zhag gi de'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so /mtsho/ /bcu gsum 'khon zhag gi rde'u 'phen tshu' gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so/ /nga / /na mo gu du mdzi lho ga ya/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /(gtsug lag)rtsis kyi yang zhun mchog / bcu gsum 'khor zhag brtsi tshul gyi/ / lag len(bri la)gnang ba stsol/ /ma hwa gser gyi dus sbal gyi/ /mgo bo lhor blta mjug ma byang / /gzhogs g.yas shan la gzhogs g.yon nub/ / yan lag mtshams bzhir brkyangs nas gnas/ /de la lo yi ngos 'dzin ni/ /byi glang stag yos 'brug sprul rta/ /lug sprel bya khye phag bcu gnyis/ / shing me sa lcags chu lngar phye/ / pho mos bsgyun bas drug cu 'byung / / dang po srog gi lde mig ni/ /stag yos srog shing rta sbrul me/ /bya sprel lcags la bye phag chu/ /khye 'thug glang lug bzhi po sa/ /gnyis pa lus kyi lde mig ni/ /shing gi byi glang shing rta lhag /chu yi stag yos chu bya sprel/ /lcags kyi 'brug sbrul lcags khyi phag /lus ni lcags yin the tshom med/ / ma lus shing la bu lus chu/ / dgra lus sa la grogs lus me/ / bla ni srog gi ma du bzhed/ /gsum pa dbang thang lde mig ni/ /gnam gyi lo de pho shar tshe/ /gcig bcu nang la gnyis gsum ma/ /ba'i lnga dgra la drug bdun grogs/ /brgyud dgu bu du shes par byu/ /gnam gyi lo de mo shar tshe/ / gcig gnyis rang la gsum bzhi ma/ / lnga drug dgra la bdun brgyad grogs/ / dgu bcu bu du shes par bya/ / bzhi ba klung rta'i sde mig ni/ / byi 'brug sprel gsum klung stag shing / / byu glang sprul gsum klung phag chu/ /khye rta stag gsum klung sprel lcags/ /phag lug yos gsum klung phag chu/ /span kha li me khon sa dang / /twa lcags khen gnam kham chu dang / /gin ri tsin shing zon rlung ste/ /skyes pa li nas g.yas bskon khon/ /bud med kham nas khen g.yon bskor/ /gcig dang bcu gsum nyed lnga dang / /so bdun zhe dgu re gcig sogs/ / spe ba gcig dkar gnyis nag dang / / gsum mthing bzhi ljang lnga ser dang / / drug dkan bdun dmar brgyad dkan dang / / dgu dmar la sogs bskor ba'i tshe/ /dbus nas gnam lcags ri bo dang / /me chu sa shing rlung rnams gnas/ /spar kha li yi pho mo dang / / gre ba lo yi pho mo ste/ / gcig bcu bcu dgu nyer brgyad dang / / so bdun zhe drug nga lnga dang / /re bzhi don gsum tshe na dbus/ /de nas gre sdo sgyu kyi kyi nas/ /

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pho drug gin nas g.yon bskor dang / / mo drug zon nas g.yas su bskor/ / gar babs de la spe ba bzung / /shing me sa lcags chu ma bu/ / me chu sa shing lcags dgra grogs/ / ma dang 'phrad na dkar po gsum/ /bu dang 'phrad na dkar nag gnyis/ /dgra dang 'phrad na nag po gnyis/ /grogs dang 'phrad na dkar po gnyis/ / sa rngu nang 'phrad dkar po gcig /me lcags shing gsum nag po re/ /lus kyi 'byung ba 'thab dus su/ /'byung chung gdams pa dran pan bya/ / de nas skor mgo bcu gsum gyi/ / rde'u 'phen tshul 'di ltar no/ / gnam lo'i srog lus dbang klung blar/ /brtsi bya'i sbog lus dbang klung blas/ /'thab che phyi yi rde'u lnga/ /brtsi bya span kha li yin na/ /pho ni me rta mo me sprul/ /twa la pho ni lcags sprel dang / /mo ni lcags mo bya la 'thab/ /kham la pho ni chu byi dang / /mo ni rngu mo phag la 'thab/ /tsin la pho ni shing stag dang / /mo ni shing mo yos la 'thab/ /mtshams bzhi pho mo gnyis ka 'dra/ /khon la sa lug khen sa khye/ /gin la sa glang zon sa 'brug / brtsi bya 'thab pa'i de'u lnga/ /de nas log men brtsi tshul ni/ /skyes pa bu(me)stag steng nas thur/ /bud med ma(bye)sprel steng nas gyen/ / lo grangs gar phyin brtsi byas 'thab/ / skyes dar srog gces rgan byis lus/ /bud med dbang thang yon tan can/ / klung rta gces pa rnam bzhi yin/ / log min gar babs la 'thab pa'i/ /man lnga dbang thang yar lnga srog /'thab pas rde'u bcu gsum mo/ /bcu gsum rde'u'i 'bras bshad ni/ /gcig bab srog gi rde'u yin/ /'di la dkar po gnyis bab na/ / spyin gyi srog la bar chad med/ / sgos su byi ba lo bar bzang / / 'og dus sbal sen po'i sa gzhi bsrung / /nub ma pham g.yu mtsho sngon po la/ /nya gshog drug can sgyu g.yang zhig phab/ / gzhi khang khyem dpal mkhar brtsigs la bzang / / g.yu'i sprang ma 'phur ba'i rkang ba la/ /rtsi me tog padma'i bcud cig 'gos/ /zas non spyi dang shar phyogs nas/ /rta dkar po lag tu 'ong ba'i ngo / /lho mon yul kha thag ring na yang / /bya khu byug mar snyed mgo la grags/ / mgron po myun du slebs pa'am/ / yang na skad snyan thos pa'i ngo / /thal phung nang nas g.yu rnyed yin/ /rma rgyul(ma sgred)gseng nas bu gsum rnyed/ /mo btsun dar ma'i rtsis la bzang / /gzhi rtsis yin na phugs su bzang / /nad rtsis yin na sos ngo yin/ /che thar thongs la bsang khrus byu/ /srog rdel dkar po gcig babs na/ / sbog gi 'byung ba grogs dang 'phrad/ / g.yung drung tshe yi rgyu ma thob/ / shing shing gto yi dgos ma mchis/ / mya ngan byun gyi thag pa chad/ / gzhi bya srog byu gnyis la bzang / / 'go ba'i lha ba nga |༵ ba / bya thang dkar rgod kyi phru gu re/ / mtho brag dkar rtse rgyal logs na

bcu gsum 'khor zhag gi rde'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so/ /rtse/ /bu dang tsha bo'i tsho srog brtan pas bzang / /srog rdel dkan po gsum babs na/ /byi ba lo ba dag la bzang / /khyad par bu tsha che la bzang / /zangs skam nang du 'o ma 'khyel1 /'breng pyong mar khus thub pa 'dra/ /tho skam zho la btsugs pa yin/ /gzhi phywa yin na shin tu bzang / / don phywa yin na ci bsam 'grub/ / nad rtsis yin na rlung gi ngo / / gcod dang bskang gsol byas na bzang/ / yang na phad phyin drug po 'don/ / klu dga' bo'i mdzod kyi bum pa'i bcud/ /lha dbang pos dga' spros zas su za/ /nad pa yin na sos pa'i ngo /srog gi rgya gram 'og na brtan/ / lcags kyi 'khor los steng nas skyob/ / dgra dang bral bas dgra med yin/ /nyi ma shar phyogs dag gi ni/ /rta dkan lag tu 'ong na bzang / /mgron phywa yin na mgron po slebs/ /bros pa yin na zin ngo yin/ /klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen gyi/ /nor bu bor ba rnyed pa yin/ / bon ba yin na rnyed ngo yin/ / lab tse btsugs na phugs su bzang / / dman rgyu ba zhig gi 'dug tshul gyi/ / g.yu drug dkad mar snyed rtsa nas rnyed/ /sri phywa yin na bu tsha skyes/ /sri 'dzin yin na thub pa yin/ /bsrung ba'i 'khon lo btags na bzang / /phyag rgya bris la sgo la btsugs/ /blo phywa don sgyur gang bsam 'grub/ /dgra dang bgegs kyis mi tshugs bzang / / srog rdel nag po gcig babs na/ / spyir gyi srog la bar chad yod/ /sgos su byi ba lo bar tsub/ /'og rus sbal ser po'i sgul bskyod kyis/ /steng ri rgyal lhun po cud zad 'dar/ /'dug sa mi brtan 'gro sdod ngo / /phag nag po zhig gi sna rdog gis/ / shing ljon pa zhig gi rtsa ba slog / bu dang tsha bo'i srog la gzan/ / khyad pan bu tsha che la ngan/ / sa rim pa dgu yi 'og zhig na/ / 'dre rnga mong kam pas 'khun skad 'don/ /khyod la phung sri ldang nyen yod/ /de la sri mnan byed pa gal/ /lha 'dre 'thab rtsod byas pa yin/ / 'byung ba srog gi ljon shing chag / tshe la bar chad 'ong ba'i ngo / / bla blu che 'gugs drag tu bya/ / glo gri lhung bas rang la zug / yang na chu chen chu phran nam/ / yang na thang chen ri lung nas/ /skran dang glo bur nad kyis zin/ /yang na nyi ma shar nub bam/ /lho nas rdzas nag sha chang dang / /bsen mo ze'u rang gnod pa yin/ /de la drag po'i gtor rgyag gyis/ /nad pas rmi lam zang zing spi/ /mgo dang no stod glo snying gzer/ /rgyal mdos byabs khrus brgya bzhi bsngo/ / blo phywa don phywa srog phywa sogs/ / 'di nyid babs na shin tu ngan/ /sbog rdel nag po gnyis babs na/ / lha yis btsong la 'dre yis gso/ / 'phags pa 'jam dpal de nyid kyis/ /bdud rgya mi nag 'thab pa gzigs/ /rgya de bdud kyis 'khyen ba gzigs/ /mgon po nag po'i gtor zor dang / /lha mo nag mos ba ga kyi du1/ /

mas1 /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgya de phyir la blangs pa yin/ /mgon po'i bskang gsol byus na bzang / /bdud rlung 'tshub nag po langs nyes kyis/ / tshe thang shing sdong bo rtsad nas 'gyel/ / srog gser kyi zam chen rked nas chad/ /tshe sgrub tshe thar che 'gugs bya/ /don phywa mi 'grub rmi ltas 'tshub/ /mgron phywa tshong phywa kha 'a spyod che/ /dgra rkun yong ngam gri ngo yod/ /rgya chu ma mkhan gyi mkhar sgo na/ /bya shang shang rgod po gdon gyis zin/ /skad grog grog leng nge yong rgyu med/ /mi khyod la btson ngo 'dug pas gzob/ / dbang tshe sgrub 'chi blu bdud bzlog gyis/ / srog rdel khra bo babs gyun na/ /lha sman bzang mo byu ba dang / /nag po bdud kyi khyer ba gnyis/ /rin chen srog la cho lo byed/ / na ngo yod kyang 'chi ngo med/ / tshe dbang tshe thar srog blu sogs/ / rim gro byas na bzlog pa'i ngo / / ma gshin phur gsum bzlog pa dang / / yum dang nyi khri lnga ba 'don/ / rnam 'joms gdugs dkar bton na bzang / / gzhi phywa mgron phywa kun la 'bring / /lus rdel dkan po gnyis babs na/ / glang lo ba yi gnas yin te/ / khyad par bud med dar mar bzang / / ma sgred co nas gsen rnyed yin/ / dpag bsam shing gi rtsa ba na/ /g.yu yi chu mig g.yas su 'khyil/ /lus nad yod na sman gyis sos/ /gnag phyugs lag tu 'ong ba'i ngo / /lha srung dga' bas gzhi phywa dang / /srog phywa don phywa sogs la bzang / /'byung ba lus kyi rten phur tshugs/ / lus la gdon gyis mi tshugs sam/ / sems la sdug bsngal ming yang med/ / kha 'dzin mgon skyabs lha yis byed/ / lus stobs che la nad mi ldang / /yugs sa'i lus la 'dzem pa dang / /lha srung mchod na lhag pan bzang / /lus del dkar po gcig babs na/ /lus nad sems kyi sdug bsngal med/ /glang lo ba la bzang bar bshad/ / ma pang gcig na bu gsum yod/ / bu gsum lag na gzhu gsum yod/ / g.yang skyob mchod rten brtsigs na bzang / /gsed tog gzungs gsum bris na bzang / /lha rta lha 'bri btsan na bzang / / bsang dang sku mkhar bcu gsum gsol/ / tshe gzungs dar lcog gdugs dkar 'don/ / gzhi phywa mgron phywa srid myur bzang / / ma bsam sa nas zas non snyed/ / dgra 'dre pyod gsum med pas bzang / / lus rdel dkar po gsum babs na/ /glang lo ba la bzang bar bshad/ /spyid kyi dpag bsam ljon shing de/ /yal ga brgyu la lo ma stong / / gri'u yong ba'i ngo yin pas/ / da lo med kyang phyir lo yong / /lho g.yu ri'i sked la na bun 'thibs/ /sa dog mon 'bras dkar myu gu 'khrungs/ /g.yang gi na ba gang ba yin/ /'bru zad bsog pa mar khun 'khyil/ / ra ma bsogs pa 'bri yi song / / bong bu bsogs pa rta ༷ ༷nga 1/96/ ༷༷ shis brtsegs mdo 'bri ba dang / / mar me brgya 'jog tsha 'bum ldug 1

bcu gsum 'khor 'ag gi de'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so/ /gzhi phywa don phywa mgron ston bzang / / shar na rgya stag dmar po zhig / ngar skad byang shar phyogs nas 'don/ / shar nas dgra rkun ldang nyen yod/ / phyi nas mtshon cha'i char phab kyang / /khrib rmog rgyun thag ma chad pas/ / khong khrag phyi du mi 'pho bzang / / lus rdel nag po gnyis babs na/ / glang lo ba la ngan pan bshad/ / phugs pa'i shā 'od drag po log nyen yod/ / mdo yi nya tshang glo bur skam la bton/ / phyugs kyi na ba stong nyen che/ / 'byung ba lus kyi rten phun phud/ /mgo dang sems la na tsha yod/ /nad phywa la ni lho nub nas/ /lug gam de yi sha ldags gnod/ / lag ngar sngas dang byin pa gdon/ / sman la zas bya nad yun ring / /khyod kyi pha dun lad pa yin/ /gad pa mig 'dra yod pa yin/ /chu mig mthong san dur lad yod/ /rgyul bsen dam sris gnod pa yin/ /g.yas g.yon rtsib ma gzer ba'o/ /tsha ba chen po 'ong ba yin/ /tshe gzungs 'don zhing sa tsha gdab/ /lus bsgyun ming brje sdom pa blangs/ /sku dkar gsol zhing lam 'phrang bcos/ /sman bla'i cho ga dbang brgya dang / /yang na drag po'i sbyin sreg bya/ / rta rgyug 'dod 'gros glang gi bul/ / dgra mi dal rta dal 'khum nas 'dug /do tshigs khyod la dgra med yin/ /lus rdel nag po gcig babs na/ /sri phyed 'dre la shor ba yin/ /bde ban bsdad pas 'gro 'dod dang / /'gro ba'i tshe na 'dug snying 'dod1 / snying mi dga' zhing sems sdug ngo / / lus bsgyur sdom pa len pa dang / /bskang bshags rim gro drag tu bya/ / lus rdel khra bo babs gyur na/ / lha yi bu dang dmu yi bu/ /lhas gcig steng na rtsal 'gran byed/ / glo bur skrag dngangs 'ong ba'am/ / yang na phyi nol 'byung bzhi 'khrugs/ / bud med yin na bu tsha spyid/ / lus bskyed bsrung 'khor gto chog bya/ /yum dang nyi khri rnam 'joms 'don/ /shar ram nub kyi rdzas dmar dang 1 /rdzas khra gdon pas dag gtsang bya/ / dbang thang del dkar gnyis babs na/ / stag lo ba yi gnas yin gyi/ / rdza khra khra zhig gi ri zhol na/ / rkyang kha dkad ma brgya bu brgya 'dzer/ / ku ru rta yi 'phel kha dar/ /'brog srin gyi nang du phyug mo na/ /'brong bre ser gcig la 'brong phrug brgya/ /be'u'i gdang phur ring mo thebs/ /stod yul na gangs dkan 'bol le yod/ /de'i steng na kha ba bu yug 'tshub/ / lug gcig lug brgyar 'phel ba'i rtsis/ / smad mdo na thang shing ldem mer yod/ /de'i steng khu byug sngon mo grags/ /lo tog 'bru drug snye ma smin/ /zas nor dgos dgu dbang du 'du/ /bu rta chung gsum nor gyi sgo/ /'byung ba spyid kyi ra ba gang / / 'dod yon longs spyod rtsi tog rgyas/ / mtha' yi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang / / nya mo gser mig bu dang 'phrad/ / bya spyol khyung gi tshang nang du/ / klu yi rgyal dag ga sta gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ma rmos lo tog 'phel ba'i ngo / /lo yag phyugs 'phel shin tu bzang / /phu yi glag mo gzan 'tshol de/ /ri zhol 'khon bas sha dang 'phrad/ /tshong byed mkhan de khe dang 'phrad/ /rgyab gang gos gyon kha gang zos/ / mig gang ltad mo byugs ma 'tsho/ / rten bzhengs gsung rab bris na bzang / /dbang rdel dkar po gsum babs na/ /phu na lha yi g.yang chags yin/ /sgo na nor gyi g.yang chags yin/ / lhag par bud med dar mad bzang / / ma gcig pang na bu gsum rtse/ / bu gsum lag na gzhu gsum thogs/ / srid phywa la ni bu mang skye/ / kha rje za thang che ba dang / /tshong byas khe che phywa g.yang 'khor/ / rta mdzo byes su song na yang / /srab mda' sna thag yul nas 'dzin/ /non rdzas dgras khyen phyir la 'ong / /zhing khang rgyal sa tu bzang / /dbang rdel nag po gnyis babs na/ /stag lo ba dang bu rta nor/ /sogs la ngan pas yum dang ni/ /nyi khri brgya bzhi myur du bya/ /dpal gyi zo stong g.yang ral bab/ /zas non sris la 'gong bo dang / /nor dang phyugs la god kha 'ong / / dbang thang na ba mtha' nas nal/ / longs spyod zo ba zhabs nas rdol/ /sder nas zas 'chor ma pang nas/ /bu 'chor rta dang sgo khyi 'chi/ /de la gton ma drag mdos bya/ / byu ston byis ston sprang sbyin gtong / / g.yang 'bod tshogs bsags tshogs brgya bskor/ / dbang rdel nag po gcig babs na/ / mna' ma bu mo stag lo ba/ /mi nor chung gsum spyi la tsub/ /zhag ni rta mig tsam zhig la/ /'gong bo g.yag shad tsam zhig rgyu/ /ltogs 'dre 'gong 'dre zas la brku/ /'og rta 'gel mdzo bu tsha 'chi/ /btsal na mi rnyed ston na 'grib/ /dgra dang jag pa 'ong ba yin/ /nad pa yun ring glo srog na/ /mad me brgya 'jog lam 'phrang bsal/ / dge 'dun sde la che dbang zhus/ / sngags pa'i sde la tshogs brgya bskor/ /zam pa 'dzugs shing g.yang 'bod bya/ /dbang rdel dkar nag gnyis babs na/ /longs spyod res yod res med 'ong / /dkar nag rgyas 'bring 'dres pa yin/ /srid dang dpal gnyis gnyen po byed/ / nam mkha' khyung chen ma 'phur yod/ / bar snang rlung gis ma zin yod/ / sa gzhi sbrul gyi ma bkrags yod/ / lcags spyang ri dwags spyang sha ba/ 19/skyi kas gdon pas rim gro byed/ / thel 'gong bkan zhing gter sgrub byed/ /

bcu gsum 'khor 'ag gi de'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so/ /klung rdel dkar po gnyis babs na/ /yos bu lo ba dag la bzang / /ka tsha la byu zhus gong kha na/ /bya ngang ba ser pos skad snyan sgrogs/ /ban bon yin na yon tan 'phel/ /rgya stag dmar po 'dzum drug rgyas/ /pho skyes dpa' bo khrom thog chod/ /mo skyes dpa' bo gtam snyan thos/ /btsal bas nor rnyed dgra las thad/ / gsol na phan 'phen/ /mgon po dgra lha mchod gyun na/ / dgra bo'i bla tshe nang la 'khor/ / grub rgyal ma yi rjes gnang bya/ / bla rdel nag po gcig babs na/ / bla ni bdud kyis 'khyen dogs yod/ / rdzas dmar snod kha yi bye'u 'dra/ /phyi nang gar 'gro mi shes pas/ /bsrung bzlog rim gro myur du sdig/ 20/:ba nga god kha 'ong nyen yod/ /rdzas rigs sed po 'od can gdon/ / nang

bcu gsum 'khor zhag gi rdo'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so/ /srog rdel dkan po gnyis babs na/ /srog gi 'byung ba grogs dang 'phrad/ /don phywa bsam dgu yid bzhin 'grub/ / kha gang zas za lus gang gos/ / bsod nams 'phel bas lha bsang byu/ / stag gzig nags skong rdzong la zhen/ / 'ug pa brag dmar logs na nyal/ /skyes pa dar ma'i srog phywa ni/ /lcags kyi sdong bo bsgril ba 'dra/ /gdon bgegs 'byung bos tshugs pa yin/ / bud med dar ma'i kang mdud grol/ / sbog shing btsugs na bzang ba yin/ /sbrul lo ba la lhag par bzang / /nang srog rdel dkan po gsum babs na/ /kang po bu dang 'phrad pa yin/ / mdos pa'i glang rnga zin pa yin/ / dbul bo gted dang 'phrad pa yin/ / rmang gi mdud pa grol ba yin/ / da lo med kung phyi lo yod/ / gzungs chen sde lnga bris na bzang / / nang sro ga rdel dkar po gcig babs na/ / skyes pa dar ma thams cad dang / /khyad par sprul lo ba la bzang / / mi g.yang khyem du lon pa dang / / phyugs g.yang ra bad lon pa yin/ / bu mo mna' ma gnyis la bzang / / tshe than bsang rngon mchod rten brtsigs/ / na bza' phul na shin tu bzang / / nang srog rdel nag po gnyis babs na/ /thang shing sdong bo lo rgyus ma/ / mon pa star thogs gcig gis gcod/ / sbrul lo ba dang bud med kyi/ /tshe srog rlung nang mar me 'dra/ /sbrul lo ba dang bud med kyi/ /srog la ngan pas che sgrub gyis/ /bdud kyi sdug bsngal 'ong ba dang / /btsan gyi jag pa 'ong ba dang / /nad pa yin na shin tu ngan/ / gdon dang yams kyi ngo yin pas/ / bdud gcod drag srung myud du skrubs/ / g.yu yi ne tso lce bde bo/ / gzeb kyi nang na bshad rgyu mang / / mi rgod btson du 'jin dogs yod/ / tshe mdo sgrol dkan rnam spyol bsgrub/ / tshe bdud nag po'i zlog mdos gyis/ /nang srog rdel nag po gcig babs na/ /yur ba'i chu mig than pas skam/ /srog la brku bas phung sri langs/ / rdzas nag dman ngan nag po gdon/ / tsho gzungs skal bzang 'chi blu bya/ 1 blo phywa don phywa kun la 'bring / / bsang dang g.yang 'bod g.yang 'bum 'don/ / nang srog rdel khra bo babs gyun na/ / blo phywa don phywa kun la 'bring / / nad pa la ni nad yun ring / /ma gshin phun gsum bzlog pa dang / /yum dang nyi khri lnga ba 'don/ /nang lus rdel dkar po gnyis babs na/ / pha khu che rgan thams cad dang / /khyad par rta lo ba la bzang / /lus la nad dang sdug bsngal med/ /glang chen thal dkar mche ba gzengs/ /seṅge dkar mo'i g.yu ral bsig khus la stobs dang yang rtsal bskyed/ /sngon a myes bzang po skyes ring la/ /sa bcos bzang po byus pa yod/ /da dung khyod la bzang ba yin/ /nyin gyi byi ba lag dkad gyis/ / ri rab gseng nas gser rnyed yin/ / ba ra ༵)'a lda nag

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdorje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs—la bzang / / sri phywa yin na byis pa skye/ / mdo chen rta yi ra sgo sra/ / rta drel rgod ma lag tu 'ong / / nor phywa tshong phywa kun la bzang / / nad pa mi 'chi sman gyis sos/ / srog shing btsugs na shin tu bzang / /nang lus rdel dkan po gsum babs na/ /dbul bos gsen rnyed 'gro kun tshom/ /yon tan can gyis rgyal khams za/ /mi nub tshe yi g.yung drung thob/ /man me lha mchod phul na bzang / / nang lus rdel dkar po gcig babs na/ / gzhi phywa don phywa la sogs pa/ / thams cad gong ltan bzang ba yin/ /gsen tog gzungs gsum 'don
