pan bya/ / nang lus rdel nag po gnyis babs na/ / rta lo ba dang phu nur rtsub/ / 'og rta 'gel mdzo gnyis la ngan/ / rta gzungs nor gzungs ci mang 'don/ / rta la chag thum rngo sgal 'byung / / lus la na tsha drag po'am/ / yang na las ka chen pos non/ / de min thag ring 'gro sdod ngo / /nad pa la ni byung phyogs nas/ /rdzas sngon brlan can skyes nag dang / /mo mgron gnod cing bsen mo dang / / the'u rang 'khod ba'i khyim du nyal/ / snod ni kha chag bug ral gdon/ / bsen mo dgu mdos thel mdos bsngo/ / nang lus rdel nag po gcig babs na/ / re nag gos nag zangs nag gdon/ / nad pa la ni ngan par bshad/ /gdugs dkan rnam 'joms khri tshan 'don/ /tshe gzungs dan lcog 'dzugs par bya/ /nang lus rdel khra bo babs gyur na/ / lha nad gying 'thib 'ong ba'i ngo / / grib sel grib mdos byabs khrus dang / /tshe thar gtong zhing bla blu bya/ /nang gi dbang thang rdel dkan gnyis/ /babs na snyug lo sngo ljang dang 1 /khyad par mo btsun dar man bzang / /'byung ba skyid kyi ra ba gang / / 'dod yon longs spyod ci 'dod rgyus/ / ma rmos pa yi lo tog 'phel/ / rmang bo dbul po gnyis la bzang / / ma bsam sa nas zas nor rnyed/ / nub nas rta dkar lag tu 'ong / / de la tshe thar brtson na bzang / / rmang bo bu dang 'phrad pa yin/ / nang dbang rdel dkar gsum babs na/ / mo btsun dar ma thams cad dang / / khyad par lug lo ba la bzang / /g.yu drug dkar byi ba'i tshang nas rnyed/ /sman lug lo ma la bu gsum skye/ /rmang gi mdud pa grol ba yin/ /rkyang ga ma zhig gi sna shugs kyis/ /rkyang ma bu brgya yi mgo 'don byas/ / bud med dan ma'i sbog phywa brtan/ / ka sbom ra'i mgo la gangs dkar chags/ /phyugs la lug brtsis byed nyin bzang / /g.yang mo lug gi 'phel kha dan/ /rta phyugs gnyis la bzang bar bshad/ / thigs pa bsags la rgya mtsho 'phel/ / tshong ba 'gro ba'i rtsis la bzang / /gser dngul gos dan nor 'bru 'phel/ /byu lhal khyung gi tshang nang du/ /klu rgyal ba 'u ༵ra ga sad/ /gted sgrub byed pa'i rtsis la bzang / /mi nor zas gsum dbang

bcu gsum 'khor zhag gi de'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so /du 'du/ / bar snang glag mo gzan 'tshol gyis/ / ri zhol 'khor bas sha dang 'phrad/ /mgron phywa grogs phywa gnyis la bzang / /dgra phywa dag la nub phyogs nas/ /dgra rkun ldang ngam mi ka 'ong / / bsang dang lab tse dgra brub byu/ / lha gsol tshe thar 'bum khang dang / /mchod rten brtsigs na shin tu bzang / / nang dbang rdel dkar gcig babs na/ / gong dang 'dra ste shin tu bzang / / sdong skam shing la lo ma skye/ / rdo skam brag la shug pa skye/ /mchod pa 'bum dang lam 'phrang bsal/ / nang dbang rdel nag po gnyis babs na/ /lug lo ba dang bud med kyi/ / dbang thang na ba mtha' nas ral/ / ngam sgyu khyi nag lcags mgo des/ /srid kyi 'bri man sen po za/ /rma sbom na'i gangs dkar than pas 'ju/ /do tshigs mi 'ju sang phod 'ju/ / mi'i dbang thang bu de 'dre yis 'phrog / longs spyod zo ba zhabs nas brdol/ / zas non mi rnyed pho ba ltogs/ / tshong phywa khe rgyal phar la 'chon/ / don phywa grogs phywa gnyis la ngan/ / dkon mchog mchod dang sbyin gtong dang / / nor sgrub g.yang sgrub g.yang 'bod byu/ / nad pa dam sri rgyal 'gong dang / / 'khon dang 'dus pa lang long gnod/ / byud kha'i ngo yod gtor bzlog dang / / rgyal mdos brgya bzhi sri mnan sgrub/ /gdugs dkan rnam 'joms 'ur 'don bya/ /nang dbang rdel nag gcig babs na/ /dgra dang kha mchu 'ong ba'i ngo / / skye nag rdzas nag dmar ngan gnod/ / nad pa nad gzhi che ba na/ /bcos pa gang gis mi phan zer/ / gcod dang bdun gcod rgyal mdos byu/ / nang dbang del khri bo babs gyur na/ /las nad yin kyang 'chi nad min/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtor bzlog dbang brgya dang / / tshe thar chu sbyin brgya rtsa thon/ / rdzas khra zhig la 'dre 'khril 'dus/ /gzhi phywa la sogs kun 'bring ngo / /nang klung rdel dkar po gnyis babs na/ /ya nabs tshang gi bla dpon dang / /spre'u lo ba dag la bzang / / rta ngang ba'i mgo 'phang dgung la reg /grogs skyi ser rlung gis kha lo byed/ /de bla ma mi dpon klung rta dan/ /dung dkar po g.yas 'khyil lan gsum 'bud/ / bdud phung byed nag po lan gsum pham/ / ban de yin na grwa slob dang / /chos kyi gdan sa chen po thob/ /mi skya yin na zhing sa dang / /dmag dang 'bangs kyi bdag po byed/ /nub nas zas dang longs spyod rnyed/ /do tshigs khyod kyi lha ngo mtho/ / dgra pham rang rgyul snyan grags thob/ / shar dung ri'i mgo la nyi ma shar/ / lho 'dzam bu gling gi mun pa sel/ /dkar po dge las bya nyin bzang / /gzhi phywa dag la rab tu bzang / / rin chen gser gyi sa gzhi la/ 1 g.yu yi myu gu 'khrungs pa yin/ / rmang po yin na sri la bzang / / ri rtse gsum la snying gter sbas/ / lung gsum mad pa ༵ba 0 3 ༷༷na

sa / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdorje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/spyobs/ / dgra ngo yod pas dgra brub byu/ /lam phywa bgrod bde don kun 'thub/ / tshong phywa khe che nad pa sos/ / mtho dman 'bring gsum kun la bzang / / nang klung rdel dkar po gsum babs na/ /mang dkar sgo bas bsrung ba yin/ /nya mo rgyu mtshos srung ba yin/ /ngur bas na spang srung ba yin/ / gzhi phywa bzang la dgra phywa 'bring / / dgra brub mi kha brub na bzang / /bsang rngon mad me lha khrus bya/ / thams cad gong ltar bzang ban bshad/ / nang klung del dkad gcig babs na/ / gong gi dpyad pa bzhin du bya/ / tshe thar dang ni bskang gsol bya/ /nang klung rdel nag po gnyis babs na/ /sprel lo ba dang bla dpon dang / /yon tan can la lhag pan ngan/ / dung dkar po'i khog pa 'bu yis za/ / sgra snyan 'dod skad de rna bar 'dzer/ /bla dpon che la ban chad dam / /yang na mthon po'i sa nas lhung / /yang na rgol ba dag gis pham/ / de min chos gtam 'chad dogs yod/ / bya 'i ta nog mo 'phur nyes kyis/ / rgod thang dkar gcig gis dang dus phud/ / dpa' bo g.yul 'khrug nang du lhang / /yang na jag pa rgyug nyen yod/ /do tshigs klung rta rgud pa yin/ /phu du phyin na jag pas 'phrog /mdo du song na rkun mar 'phrad/ /nyi ma nub nas dgra sa dar/ /de la dgra brub dgra chings gyis/ / gto nag dgra zon gtor bzlog 'phongs/ / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan 'don/ /nad phywa bu mo mag pa'i sar/ /ngan zhing phur kha rims yams 'ong /lho nas mdog dmar rdzas spyad gnod/ /'bar ma gdugs dkar bzlog bsgyur dang / /man me brgya dan bskal bzang 'don/ / nang klung rdel nag po gcig babs na/ / yugs sa'i rdzas la 'dzem par bya/ / mar gyi nang nas dus 'dzer dang / / zas kyi nang na dug yod ltar/ /ma mo rkod gtong gnod pa yin/ / de la ma mo'i zod mdos 'phen/ / nad pa la ni nag gsum gdon/ / glo mchin bar na tsha ba yod/ / nad mgo res lci nad mjug mchi/ /de la sman bla'i dbang brgya dang / / mkha' 'gro'i gtor rgyag byas na phan/ / nang klung rdel khra bo babs pa na/ /rdzas khra sgod na bzhag pa'am/ /dar nag zangs nag rdzas nag gdon/ /gzhi phywa la sogs kun la 'bring / /nad phywa srog sgyur 'bring yin pas/ /nad ngo yod kyang 'chi ngo med/ /rim gro zas nor sbyin pa btang / /tsha tsha nyi khri bskal bzang bklag /'bum dang mchod rten brtsigs na bzang / / nang gi bla rdel dkar po gnyis/ / babs na ma phyi che rgan dang / /bya lo ba la rab tu bzang / /din chen gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /g.yu yi myu gu 'khrungs pa yin/ / mi phyugs rmang por sri phywa 'phel/ / gzhi phywa don phywa nor phywa sogs/ / bya ba kun la ba ༵0 ka—/ /bsang rngon byas na shin tu bzang / /nang bla rdel dkar po gsum babs

bcu gsum 'khor zhag gi de'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so/ /na/ / khyim la g.yang gi mtsho mo 'khyil/ / zho la mar gyi snying bo chags/ / padma'i ze'u 'bru 'khrungs pa yin/ /spyi yi bzang dpyad gong dang 'dra/ /nang bla rdel dkad po gcig babs na/ /gzhi phywa srog phywa kun la bzang / /che rgyud dar la chung rgyud 'phel/ /ma bsam sa nas zas non 'ong / /do tshogs lo la bzang ba yin/ /nang gi bla del nag po gnyis/ /babs na byu lo ba la ngan/ /bsen mo the'u rang gnod pa yin/ /ma phyi rgan rgon dud sa 'gul/ /rmi lam zub cing sems mi dga'/ / ltas ngan cho 'phrul byud kyi ngo / / byad bzlog the'u nang bsen mo bkar/ /khyod la do tshogs gza' nad dam/ /yang na thog glog 'bab pa'i ngo /rnam 'joms khri tshan bla 'gugs bya/ / nang bla rdel nag po gcig babs na/ / nad pa la ni skrag ngo yin/ /rdzas nag rgyal 'gong dam sri gnod/ /bya rgod rnyi dang byi'u chung khras/ /zin pas ma gshin phur gsum dang / /nag po mgo gsum rgyal mdos byu/ /bsrung bzlog drag po byas na bzang / / nang bla rdel khra bo babs gyur na/ / gnam sgo bcad cing gnam khyi bcos/ /log men rdel dkar gnyis babs na/ / khyi lo ba la shin tu bzang / / dgung a sngon dkyil du lho sprin 'thibs/ /lho sprin gyi klong nas g.yu 'brug grags/ /dgra lha'i lha zhal dung las dkar/ /lha dang srung ma ngo so mtho/ /srog phywa nyi zla gnyis la mnyam/ /lus stobs gangs kyi seṅge 'dra/ / dbang thang klu yi nor la 'gran/ / klung rta gser gyi 'khor bsgyur bzhin/ /dgra la rgol na dgra gzhi lon/ /bla 'di mchod rten bang rim 'dra/ /chos pa yon tan gong du 'phel/ /rtsis 'di khyab 'jug 'phrul dang 'dra/ /dpa' bos dgra sde zil gyis gnon/ / lhag par khyi lo ba la bzang / / sngon rgya mtsho bsags pa thigs pas song da thigs pa bsags pa rgya mtshor 'gro/ / byes su song na khe yag yin/ / yul du bsdad na dgra med yin/ /khyod la nyi ma byang phyogs na/ /mchod rten lab tse dur sa gsum/ /gang dung yod pas bde skyid 'byung / / jag la 'gro na dgra med yin/ / rta nor lhag gsum thob ngo yin/ /sngon dpal ldan mgon po'i bang chen gyis/ / lha ma yin gyi g.yul ngo bzlog / dgra pho brgya mtshon gyi rtse la rlog / tshur la rgol na rang nyid rgyul/ / nad pa mi 'chi sman gyis sos/ /mgon po mchod na shin tu bzang / / log men rdel dkar gsum babs na/ / gtso bo kha rgan rtsis la bzang / /'brong rgan mgo la du thur skye/ /shā rgan rtsi thog da dung bzang / /tsha'u go mtha' bskon ba yod/ / sman khyi lo ma la bu gcig skye/ / khyod la byang na mchod rten dang / / pha dur gang dung yod na legs/ / byang phyogs de du mchod rten brtsigs/ / shar phyogs 'dre la mnan pa spyobs/ /log men rdel dkar gcig babs na/ —/ka ༵ bstod pa

ra / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzhin du shes/ / mchod rten dag la sku dkar gsol/ / log men rdel nag gnyis babs na/ /khyi lo ba la ngan par bshad/ /dam nyams dme grib lha la phog / dung khyung dkar mo'i tshang nang du/ / dug sprul nag po mgo dgu zhugs/ / lha dang srung mi'i bka' chad 'ong / /byang phyogs lung par shing spen ma/ / sa nag brag rdo gad pa'am/ / lam gyi 'og na sa lad yod/ /yang na dun ri mnan gtad yod/ /des skyon gzhi phywa don sgyur ngan/ /rims yams gnyan gyis gnod pa na/ / srung ma gsol zhing dgra lha bstod/ / bdud bzlog bya zhing snying gten sba/ /log men rdel nag gnyis babs na/ /shar phyogs bon po bud med gnod/ /nad pa la ni nad gzhi che/ / gzhi la nad ngo yams kyi ngo / / shar dang lho nas dar gos nag/non ni dre le gzhung sen 'dzem/ / bsrung ba drag po lhar du gyis/ / log men rdel khra babs pa na/ / phu lha bya gong mos yad shog dang / / mdo 'dre byu sreg pas man shog zer/ / yar 'then mar 'then gnyis kyi mtshams/ /nad pa shi sos rtsis la bzang / /na ngo yod kyang 'chi ngo med/ /bye long sngon mo 'dzol las thar/ /ri bong glag dang sprang kis lug /'phar bas shā ba mi zin than/ /dme bo'i lcags spyad rdzas khra gdon/ /gdugs dkar rnam 'joms khri tshar dang / / bsen mo'i mdos sogs 'phang na bzang / / mar lnga'i del dkad gnyis babs na/ / sa gzhi 'dzin pa'i rtsis la bzang / / phag lo ba la 'bring tsam yin/ / hod yan pa jag pa skya bdun gyis/ / gzhu mchog dkar bdungs nas rta sga bstod/ / do tshigs khyod la dgra zhig ldang / / dgra ldang gi mi tshad byang nas ldang / / mgron phywa la ni nad phywa dang / /tshe srog dag la 'bring tsam yin/ /tshe than dgra mdos dgra brub dang / /legs ldan dgra chas btang na bzang / /mar lngar rdel dkar gsum babs na/ /zas non mi la 'chor dogs yod/ /dgra brub mgon po'i dgra chas dang / /bsang dang lab tse dgra zor 'phen/ /mar lnga rdel dkar gcig babs na/ / gong ltar bshad pa dgra brub dang / / lam 'phrang bsal zhing che than byu/ / mar lnga del nag gnyis babs na/ / gzhi phywa mi brtan 'pho 'gyud ngo / / mthu byed gcig gi rtsis la bzang / / dgra yi snying la phur bu thebs/ / spyang 'phar ba nag po'i rgyug tshul gyis/ /rkyang ka dkar ma bu glo bur gton/ / jag pa 'gro ba'i rtsis la bzang / / rta brgya lug stong 'phel kha yod/ / do tshigs chos byus rtsis la bzang / / dgra mgo re bas btum pa yin/ /rim gro byed pa'i rtsis la bzang / /'dre ka yas kyis bcad pa ༵na/ / mar lnga rdel nag gcig babs na/ / gong ltar rim gro byas gyur na/ / 'dre kha rdo —ba lha ༵6 yi1/ / mad lnga rdel khra babs pa na/ / lha bya pho nog nag po dang / /'dre bya

bcu gsum 'khor zhag gi rde'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so/ —'ug pa mig sen gnyis/ /phu nas grags gi mdo nas grags/ /skad cha bzang ngan gnyis ka bsgrig/ /dgra phywa grogs phywa gnyis ka mnyam/ /zas nor mi la 'chor nyen yod/ /gdugs dkan khro bcu'i zlog pa bya/ /bcu gsum mar lngar rdel dkar gnyis/ /babs na bla dpon sa la bzang / / snga rabs gsum gyi ngos 'dzin yin/ / phyi rabs gsum gyi rtags 'jog yin/ /rtse 'dzin mtha' 'am nam phugs bzang / / sngon bcom ldan 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis/ /sngar lo padma'i ze'u 'bru gsol/ /phyid lo padma stong ldan rgyas/ /ze'u 'brus khams gsum sems can gsos/ /zas med rnams kyi mgon du gyur/ /dbul bo rnams kyi nor du 'phel/ /phyi rabs phugs su bzang bad bshad/ /sngon pha myes bzang po skyes pa des/ /lha rten chos gsum bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /da dung phyi rabs dan ba yin/ /dpag bsam ljon shing skyes pa yin/ /rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs pa yin/ /klu rgyal nor bu rnyed pa yin/ /gzhi phywa la sogs kun la bzang / / rtse 'dzin rdel dkar gsum babs na/ / shing dpag bsam sdong bo'i yal ga 'khyil/ / bya khyung rgyal po'i khyung tshang byas/ / chos skyong dgra lha'i ngo so mtho/ /steng g.yu 'brug sngon mo ngan skad che/ /skad rma bya de pho'i sems la phan/ /bla ma rgyal bo snyan grags rgyus/ /ya rabs yon tan dpal gyis skyong / /gcan rgya stag dmad po 'dzum drug rgyas/ / stag sha ra'i dpa' skad rgyang na grags/ / chu thigs pa bsags pa rgya mtshor 'phel/ / dbang thang zas nor ra ba 'gengs/ / lung pa skam por chu mig brdol/ / rmang bo che la bu gsum skye/ / mgron phywa dgra med don bcas skebs/ / sbog gi dka thag lha yis bzung / /nad pa mi 'chi nad las thar/ /bya ba kun la shin tu legs/ /rdel dkar gcig babs gong ltar dpyod/ /bcu gsum rdel nag gnyis babs na/ /steng na bdud byu nag po grags/ / 'og na dam sri'i khyi nag zug / gza' bdud zhig gi 'khor nyes kyis/ / lha nyi zla mun pad btson du bzung / / nyi ma mun pas bkab pa yin/ / skar phran tshom bu yal ba yin/ /mdun zhu mgo la pyon nyes yod/ /mi chen yon tan can la ngan/ /tshe ring gsum gyis tshe g.yang 'gugs/ / tshe thung gsum gyis glud ma bor/ / mchod rten bcu gsum sku dkan gsol/ /tsho than dkar po bcu gsum brtson/ /lha bsang chen po bcu gsum phul/ /dpal mkhan lab tse bcu gsum bstod/ /lha srung mchod cing lam 'phrang bsal/ /rdel nag gnyis babs gong ltar dpyod/ /bcu gsum rdel khra babs pa na/ /lha yi dbang bo brgya byin dang 1 /lha min gnod sbyin thags bzang gnyis/ /dpag bsam shing la rtsod pa byed/ /pho lha dung khyung dkar po dang / / ngam gyi sol bya nog mo 'gros/ / bka' spyo ba2 ༵stam ༷༷na

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/klog sogs/ /rim gro stobs chen byas na bzlog /srog gi babs lan gnyis ka dkan/ /gnyis ka'i 'bras bshad bsres te smra/ / de yi rigs 'gres gzhan la sbyar/ / srog rdel gcig dkan gcig nag na/ / phyi yi khral so'i rgyun chad kung / / nang gi gsen thag mi chad pas/ /tshe sgrub 'chi blu srog blu byu/ /lus rdel gcig dkar gcig nag na/ /thang shing lo ma rnyid na yang / /rtsa yi sdong bo ma skam pas/ /tsha tsha tshogs bsags sbyin gtong 'bad/ /dbang rdel gcig dkar gcig nag na/ dbang thang zo yi zhabs brdol kung / / mdun gyi chu mig ma skam pas/ / g.yang 'bod gten sgrub nor lha mchod/ / klung rdel gcig dkan gcig nag na/ / rta pho'i 'gros te bul na yang / / rkang lag sgrog tu ma tshud pas/ / klung bskyed dar 'phru dgra bzlog bya/ /kun la del dkar babs pa na/ /'go ba'i lha ni ma dga' ste/ /gnam du yar bas thab gzhob dang / / btsog mnol no pags 'khon gyi rtsod/ /phyi nang mi gtsang lha la phog / mi yis 'dzem bag chung bas na/ / lha srung khros pas chag grum ni/ /mi la 'brel bas mi gtsang dang / / 'khon la gzab cing yo bcos bya/ / kun la rdel nag babs pa na/ /gnam gyi snang ral sa'i gzhung nal/ /ri bo rtse nas nyil ba dang / /rgya mtsho gting nas skam pa yin/ /bla shing sked chag bdud khrom btab/ /pha mes sri tshan za 'dre langs/ /che du shi chad 'ong ba dang / /chung ngu na tsha yong nyen yod/ /rmi lam mi ltas ngan pa mang / /'bum kyang khri klog byed pa dang / / sa smo rigs lnga gdab par bya1 /yul du mi sdod phyis su bros/ / gcig drug nag por song ba na/ / tshe la bar chad yong ba yin/ / tshe sgrub tsho than bla blu dang / /dze bdud nag po'i bzlog mdos bya/ /gnyis bdun nag por song ba na/ /lus la na tsha 'ong ba yin/ /dbang zhu mchod rten lus tshad dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gton ma bsngo/ / 'char kha nag po'i bzlog mdos bya/ / gsum brgyad nag por song ba na/ / god kha stor brlag 'ong ba'i ngo / / g.yang skyabs che g.yang ka sprod dang / /god brub gser 'od stong tshan 'don/ /bzhi dgu nag por song ba na/ /ma lan kha mchu pyod kyi ngo / /gto nag dgra brub spyod gto 'phen/ /grib sel bya zhing grib bsrung bzlog /lnga bcu nag por song ba na/ / gza' dang thog gi 'jigs pa yong / / thog dang gza' bsrung 'khod lo 'dogs/ /'o ga men gnam sgo la babs tshe/ /gnam dal 'babs nyen yod pas na/ / gnam sgo sdom pa'i gto chog bya/ / ba gam mi 'dogs thog mi 'bug / dkar mi 'dzem zhing mna' mi skyel/ / thog rbab la 'dzem khyi mi gso/ / nam mkha'i snying bo'i mtshan ba 'u0/ 8 /ba gtor stong 'don brgya bzhi dang / / bon kyi nam mkha' dgu 'phar

bcu gsum 'khor 'ag gi de'u 'phen tshul gyi 'bras bshad bzhugs so/ /bya/ /sa sgo la babs phung sri ldang / /dpal gyi sa nas ngan shoms dang / 1klu nad mdze shu phol 'bras 'ong / / khang rmang mi 'ding sa mi rko/ / gsen 'od dang ni tog gzungs klogs/ /phung sri mnan zhing sa sgo sdoms/ / dus pa mi gcig mi nyes pa/ / hpha bya'i gzungs tshar bcu gsum 'don/ / bye bral la babs bza' tshang 'thab/ / rtsod pa bza' 'khon dag la gzab/ /yang na na ngo btson ngo yod/ / gza' mi bye bral gto bcos bya/ / chos chen kha phye zhag gsum bzhag /tshe dbang zhu zhing zor mdos gtong / /chag can shi tshul shi sgra gtong / /phung spyod na ba pyod kha 'ong / / phyis su 'gro na tshong nyes dang / / dgra rkun la 'dzem sa tsā gdab/ /dgra zlog 'bum dang non rgyun sgrub/ /yul lha mchod cing god sri mnan/ /rus gcod la babs gleng gzhi'am/ /pha tshan nang na 'grib chags 'bab/ /phan rgol jag chom 'thab rtsod dang / /ka mchu che chung las rnams spangs/ /rdo rje sden mo gtsug tod 'don/ /phyir bzlog brgya bzhi mi ka sgyur/ /dgra mnan dgra brub gtor bzlog 'phen/ /'byor ba la babs shin tu bzang / / gsol na lha 'go btsal ba na/ / nor rnyed bsgrubs na dgra bo 'chi/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag chad pa na/ / nam mkha' dgu 'phar cho ga dang / / nam mkha' 'then mdos bla blu bya/ / sa yi rten phur byung ba na/ / sa tstsha lo grangs gdab la mchod/ /brtsi bya gcig tu ma nges pas/ /bcos pa gzhi yi sgo nas dpyad/ /spyid ni de dag thams cad la/ / shing gi pha khu mes gsum brtsi/ / me yi bu tsha ma smad brtsi/ / sa yi ma byi yul mkhar brtsi/ /lcags kyi non grogs lha srung brtsi/ / chu yi gnyen po mtha' bzhi brtsi/ / shing gi khyi 'brug steng babs na/ /pha khu'i sa ru gnam sgo phye/ /de yis kun la rtogs pad bya/ /log men nang lo'i steng du phyin/ /rang gi lus kyis rang mi theg /mi theg pa yi khur bo 'bab/ /ma yi lo thog khyo bo phyin/ / hom du chud de chung mar ngan/ / khyo bo'i lo thog chung ma phyin/ /la zhu pyon zhes khyo la ngan/ /pha yi lo thog bu phyin na/ /do ma khrid de pha la ngan/ /bu lo steng du pha phyin na/ /pha bu'i ro 'dzin bu la ngan/ /lo dkad thog tu phyin pa na/ /nye bar mya ngan yong nyes yod/ /bdun zur thog tu phyin gyur na/ /srog gcod mdun sar khreb re ngan/ /pha ma shi ba'i lo thog sleb/ / gshin gyi sring bar phyin de ngan/ /lcags bzhi me brgyad phyin pa dang / /gnam lo lcags bzhi me brgyad 'doms/ /de nyid rab tu ngan pa yin/ /srog dgra thog tu bdud gcod ngan/ / bcu dang drug dang bzhi gsum po/ / khye sam che 'bring chung gsum yin/ / de gsum dkar po babs pa na/ / bzang zhing nag na rang rang gto/ / cha ga che mdun ngo yin pas na/ / gto nag dgra zor 'phen pa dang / / mad kad 2gtor 0 9 dkag

ga / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'phang na bzang / / gsum dang dgu dang bcu gcig gsum/ / pho sa che 'bring chung gsum ste/ /dkar na bzang zhing nag na ngan/ /khyi no rta rdo 'bri no dud/ /gnyis lnga dgu dang bcu gnyis bzhi/ / phyogs bzhi'i dgra sa yin pas ngan/ / dgra na dgra lha dpang bstod do/ /mgon po'i gton bzlog dgra brub byu/ /gcig bzhi brgyad dang bcu gcig rnams/ /3 ma phyogs bzhi'i don gnyer lo/ / dkan na bzang zhing nag na ngan/ / cang se'i bsang rngon lam lha mchod/ /dgra lha wen ma'i sdongs grogs bya/ /phyi yi srog del lus rdel dang / /bla rdel nang gi srog gi rdel/ /klung rdel bla rdel drug po de/ /dkar na zangs dkar 'o ma de/ /kha lhud yin pas 'phod 'dod yin/ /phyi yi srog rdel bla del dang / /nang gi klung rdel gsum dkar na/ / shā ba ra rgyas 'phog 'dod yin/ /phyi yi srog del lus rdel gnyis/ /dkar na mi rgan se do phud/ / phyi yi srog lus dbang klung bzhi/ / nag na gla ba khyes 'ded yin/ /phyi yi bla rdel nang srog lus/ / dbang thang de'u gsum nag na/ / sbul nag thur du rgyug 'dra yin/ /phyi yi dbang rdel nang gi lus/ /log men rde'u gsum nag na/ /re ba'i ske rags bcings 'dra yin/ / 'di rnams kha lan rgyang lan gyi/ / ngos 'dzin yin no shes ldan dag/

ser bsrung me yi gur khang bzhugs so/dag/ /son bsrung me yi gun khang zhes byu ba bzhugs so/ /nga / /na mo gu du ha ya kṛ lha sgyuḥ khyed mtshan thos pa'i mod la bdud sde'i dpung / /gzhom mdzad / rdo rdo1 'di rdo hūṃ ༈sdu bye/tud /nas/ / skye 'gro'i gsos sman lo tog bsrung ba'i tshul/ / sed bsrung me yi de la 'dir ser bsrung gi rim pa la gsum las/ dang po ni byang gter rig 'dzin rgod ldem can sgyu gter kha'i ser bsrung gnam lhags gur khang ltar kyi phur pa sogs bca' tshul dang mnan pa'i bri tshul/lo/ sa/ pa phur thun bsgrub pa dang mnan pa'i 'don 'grigs/ gsum pa mnan pa brub dang tho slong tshul dang po ni/ meng ldeng skyer pa sogs kyi shing gi rtse bzhogs la/ dbal byas pa'i phun pa 'chang bzung zum po sgyu mdud gnyis/ dbal zur gsum pa bcu'i dbus kyi 'chang bzung la/ oṃ dzi na dzigaḥyul 'di'i sa ris su bcad pa la ser ba'i gnod pa las srungs shig dkaḥ ces sngags shan gyi phur pa la/ slobadzra byeg hūṃḥ gong ltar bri/ lho'i phur pa/ yo ratna rnyig hūṃḥ gong ltar nub la/ yo padma byeg hūṃḥ gong ltar byang la/ yo ka me lhag hūṃḥ bzhi bo la sa ris sogs gong ltar/ mtshams bzhi'i phun pa la/ masaḥhūṃ dang spel tshog gong ltar bri/ phun pa bcu'i dbal la/yo badzra kyi lī kyi la yaḥ be ma la ra tsa niḥm hwaḥkro ta niḥbharnya bharnyaḥha na ha na hūṃ phaṭaḥces bri/ thams cad kyi mgul du 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyis brub pa'i thun rdzas dang / dge slong gtsang ma'i chos dum bu dang / grum pa'i spu tshom re rnams tshon sbud sna lngas bcings mi yi rtsibs ma bcu la/ oṃ ting ting sto rā hu la rbad stoḥ ti pa ti dgra bo mā ra yaḥ ya ka la rbad sbyoḥ sa ris su bcad pa sogs gong ltar spel tshig bris pa dang / bsregs pa'i tsha tsha khong thus pa'i nang du 'khor lo mu khyud gsum du bskor/ lte ba'i dbus dang phyogs ba'i na/ lo re baṃ paṃ saṃ lnga/ de'i phyir rtsibs bzhi la shar du mu la shal rde snying dzaḥ lhor/ pra ma rag sha na ga na gaḥ nub tu/ snying kha rag nan snying ma tun sbyoḥ byang du1 sha ma la te snying dza ba la de snying la dza nanaḥ rtsibs mchan bzhi la/ ma ri ya riḥ ces bris/ mu khyud phyi ma la/ yo yi dharma dang / ser ba ma nanaḥsti bha ya nanaḥ sen ba mā ra ya zlog zlogaḥ ces bris/ sa tsha'i nang du bcug zhabs bsnams/rdo 'khor la/ rdo nag la/ dbus nas ba'i mas pas yig mgo nang bstan gyis/ ke ka ke tu naḥshri ya ma dka dzaḥ mun ti jiḥ tri shu snying la rbadaḥ sarba du jiḥ yud dzoḥ211ha — rdud

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs1nanaḥ srog la myog rbadaḥ sarba nā ga tsitta bud nanaḥ ka shag bsgyunaḥ sarba tsitta gzer thumasaḥ trig nan sbyo bzlogaḥ yul 'dir ser ba'i gnod pa phyid la bzlogaḥgazhan du bsgyunaḥ pha ri la shadaḥ pha ri la bzlogaḥ pha ri stoḥ badzra kro ta 'grims 'grimasaḥ ces sbul dkris su bris tsha tsha dang rdo 'khor gnyis la rab gnas bya/ gzhan yang sha thod kyi 'khor lo dang dus sbal nal gri mda' gzhu sogs gzhung ltan bris na legs/ phur bu dang rtsibs ma rdo 'khor sogs phyogs ma log par/ nas bre gang gi khar btsugs pa/ tshon skud sna lngas dkris shing / de'i thun thag rwang gis bzung chog pa bya/ ser thun ni/ mchod rten byin rlabs can gyi/ bla ma'i gdung thal/dkyil 'khon rdul tshon rnams sa spyin dang spyar ba'i nang du sgrub pa'i thun rdzas rnams bsres pa'i ser thun/phug non sgong ba tsam rnams 'du byas/ mnan pa'i dgos bcos ni/ dug shog la liṅgā mtshan nyid tshang ba'i lto bar tri dzaḥganyis kyi lte ba'i phyogs bzhir e hur thums dzaḥ mtshams ba'i da mā ra ya rbad/lika'i lkog ma'i thad nas/ yig mgo phyir bstan gyis/ oṃ du li bra ma ni ser gtong 'byung bo kha tham mā na ya rbad nan/ sen gtong 'byung bo'i lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs nus pa thams cad 'byung bo'i stobs kyis sti bha ya rbad nan/ ces tri yig gi steng nas rdzogs par bris/phyi rol du/ mgo nas yig mgo nang bstan gyis yo padma tan krita/ ser gtong 'byung bo'i srog la myogs rbad tsitta gzir nan/ e hur thums trig nan rbad dzaḥ sen gtong 'byung bo sdong zla rgyab brten dang bcas pa mā na ya nan sti bha ya lo nan/ ces pa'i mthar/ dzaḥkhri nyer gcig gis bskor/ khrus dang dug khrag gis byugs/ tshon skud sngo dmar gyis bcings la/ brub khung bcug mnan thod re ba tshon skud nang thag ya thod la ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bris pa/ no g.yam la rgya gram sogs mnan chas rnams 'du byas/gnyis pa bsgrub pa ni/ yi dam gyi las kung gzhung ltar bsrang / spyan 'dren kyi gong du phun thun sogs bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las dbus kyi phur pa dpal chen rta mchog nol ba rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ shar gyi phur pa mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lho'i phur pa rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/nub kyi phun pa snang ba mtha' yas dmar po padma dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ byang gi phur pa don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mtshams kyi phur pa rnams hūṃ las las kyi khro bo sku mdog dman po zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba g.yas kyi dang po rlung gi 'khor los ser sprin gtor ba/ g.yon gyi dang po'i me yi 'khon los ser ba bsregs pa/ tha ma gnyis ka'i phun pa 'gril nas ser gdon tshar gcod pa/ phur pa gtso 'khor thams cad sku stod dun khrod kyi chasaX /sa ༵mi ༷༷/ khro rngam dang ldan pa/ smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa mgar gyi so mal

mer bsrung me yi gur khang bzhugs so/ /nas bton pa lta bu tsha rngam dang ldan pa'o/ / rtsibs ma rnams sbyo las keng dus kyi khro bo shin tu 'jigs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa kun kyang ye shes kyi me dpung dab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / rdo 'khor rnams kung yig 'bru langs pa'i tshul can me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ser thun rnams hūṃ las rdo rje rtse gsum pa me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ban gyun/ bdag mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi spyi bon yo dkar po/ mgrin pan āḥdamar poḥ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas padma 'od kyi gzhal yas kang nas dpal rta mchog nol ba khro bo bcus bskor ba badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren pa/ bstod pa dang 'dzab dmigs nas bzlas pa sum brgya tsam dang / de nas gzungs thag bzung la/ rang lhan gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng gzungs thag la 'khril te song phur thun rtsibs rus rdo 'khon rnams la phog de las 'od zen phyogs bcun 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod cing thugs rgyud bskul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad sku khro bo gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byon nas rten rnams la thim pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi byin rlabs nus ldan du gyur/phun pa la/ yo badzra kyi lī kyi la ya bi ma la ra tsa ni ma hwa kro ta ni bharnya bharnya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭaḥstong tsho gcig rtsibs ma la/ oṃ ting ting sbyoḥ rā hu la rbad sbyoḥ ti pa ti dgra bo mā ra ya:ya ka la rbad sbyoḥ sum brgya ser thun la dmigs nas/ yo na mo bha ga wan tsa na ya tsa na dha ka tu ha da ya sa ra sa ra su ru su du surya kha ga sarba tra sha sa ma ha ra pa lha ni swāhāḥ brgya bzlas/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal mchod bstod sogs gzhung ltar no/ /thun bzhi phye na 'don 'grig gong ltar la/ phyi thun chos skyong gi gton bsngos tshogs chad bstan dang / srod la bkra shis kyis par bya'o/ / rten rnams la brtan bzhugs bya/ zhag grangs rdzogs pa dang / gzungs thag la 'ur cha mi lngags sdi mthil can brga'/thun rdzas snye bur blugs/ mnan sgrubs ni/ gser skyems bshams la/ re yi kha/ yo āḥhūṃḥhūṃḥ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang / / bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ / gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams/ / gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed/ /ma mgon lcam bral tshe ring mched lnga dang / /dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras/ / bka' nyan bran g.yog mngags gzhug bcas pa rnams/ /gser skyems 'di ba'i sa rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang / / sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag / lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha/ /bser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed/ / gzu dpang ni/ hūṃḥ rtsa gsum lha dang chos srung sde brgyad dang / / yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs ba'i gsan cing dgongs/ / bdag gis gzhan phan sems bskyed dang blangs dag/21/3'ad ba 'a

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs1gsos sman lo tog bsrung ba la/ / gnod cing 'tshe ba'i ser gtong 'byung bo rnams/ /bsgral bar phye na gzu dang dpang mdzod cig / brub khung bskyed pa ni/ phaṭaḥ stong ba'i ngang las e las brub khung zur gsum pa'i nang du tri las ser gtong 'byung bo lus rid cing nyam thag pa gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ dgug gzhug ni/na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ / khyad pan rta mchog nol ba'i lha tshogs dang / / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin bslu med bden mthu yis/ /yul phyogs 'di yi lo tog la gnod pa'i/ /sen gtong 'byung bo sdong zla rgyab rten bcas/ /gang na gnas kung liṅgā 'di nyid la/ / khug cig badzra oṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ sko nas chings shig badzra pā sha hūṃḥ yan lag sdoms shig badzra sbo ṭa 6ཿ spyos pan gyis shig badzra kaṇḍi hoḥphyes shig badzra pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ dbyer med stims shig ma be sha yaḥ gnod byed sen gtong a karsha ya dzaḥ zhes brgya'am nyer gcig sogs kyis 'gugs/ rtsa sngags mthar/ oṃ du lu pra ma ni ser gtong 'byung bo ā karsha ya dza dzaḥ zhes chig dril du bzla/ bsad nan ni/ hūṃḥkhrag 'thung khros pa drag po'i mtshon/ /ser gtong gzugs phung 'ben la yaḥ sha dus tshal ba dum bud gtub/ / gnod byed bsad cing mnan par mdzod/ / yo padma da krita sen gtong 'byung bo'i srog la sbogs rbadaḥ tsitta gzir nan e hud thums trig nan rbad dza nanaḥ ces bzla/ thun mthar/ thun gtor bsngo/ de ltar nan tan gyis sgrub 'phral liṅgā dang nya bo bshams/ yi dam bsgral las rgyas pa'i mtshon thun skabs su liṅgā bsgral tshul dang nya bo gtub/ zhal soga~X 'a du bya'o/ tu li/ga mnan thod du brub/ re bas dril/ tshon skud kyis dkris/ ri gling dang rgya gram gsum pa ser tho brtsigs pa ni/ gang du brtsigs pa'i sar tho bca' rnams khyer la/ bsang brgyag brngan no/ /glu gton/ gsen skyems sogs bsngos/ spro na lto 'phye brtags/ de nas mtshon cha thogs la/ rang nyid rta mchog nol bar gsal ba yis/ / phyag mtshan mtshon cha bsnun pas sa gzhi gas/ / phyi yi rgya mtsho sngo mer gsal par gyur/ / ces mnan pa dang po bskol/ de dbus klu bdud nag po ti pa tsa/ /chu srin 'bad ba'i gdong can yad la bzhengs/ /gnam sa bgrad pa khyod kyi kha nang du/ /gnod byed ser gtong log 'dren 'byung bo rnams/ /zas su gtad do bstab po dri tri dzaḥ dgug gzhug byas mnan thod dong du skyur la/ khong zud sa bdag klu gnyan kun dga' zhing / / phru gu thams cad tsitta din dir sgrogs/ / mnan pa'i las sbyar ser gtong 'byung bo rnams/ / bskal pa ma stong ban du mi thad ban/ / spin nag hūṃ gi dang gnad/ rgya ༵rdo'i gzhang / / ri bdun sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer sogs/ / de nas sas

ser bsrung me yi gur khang bzhugs so/ /lcibs/ me rngu rgyas 'debs ri gling dang rgya gram gyis 'gebs/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ri rab 'og/mnan pa yin pas ldang bar ma byed cig / sangs rgyas don yod grub pas rgyas btab po/ /mi dmigs chos kyi dbyengs su sa ma dhi/ / de nas mi mngon par byus la bro brdungs/ de'i steng du tho brtsigs pa'i nang du rtsibs ma rdo 'khor thun gtor sbu phun rnams bzhag dkar rtsi byugs/ mthar mchod pa bshams/ tho bsangs sbyang / stong ba'i ngang las tho gnam lcags las grub pa'i ri dab me lce 'bar ba de nyid khro rgyal rta mchog nol ba la khro bcu 'bar ba'i 'khon dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ shad gyi tho'i 'khor du nom par rgyal ba sogs dang / shar lhor dbyug sngon/ lhor gshin rje/lho nub mi g.yo/ nub du rta mgrin/ nub byung du gzhan gyis mi thub/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/byang shar gyi tho'i 'khor du khams gsum rnam sgyul sogs/ phyogs mtshams su khro bo yab yum 'khor bcas su gsal 'ad sgyun/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod sngags ci rigs par bzlas la me tog gtor/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs dang / khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas srungs/ khongs su gtogs pa'i dkar po dge ba'i lo tog 'di la bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ yo su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhāḥ zhes brtan bzhugs dang bsrung 'khor bsgom la shis brjod rgyas pan sge'o/ / phyogs bzhir tho bzhi brtsigs la rgyul chen sde bzhir bskyed/ mchod gtor 'bul zhing 'dod gsol dang brtan bzhugs bya/ ston mjug lo bsdus pa'i gtang rag bsangs rngon bya zhing tho gshegs/ gun pa sogs do dam byas so/ / mchod gral du bzhugs du gsol/smras pa/ de ltan skye 'gro'i gsos sman lo tog la/ / chu 'khyag ser bas gnod pa bsrung ba'i thabs/ /ser bsrung me yi gur khang zhes bya 'di/ / gter gzhung dang ni dam pa'i gsung bzhin sbyar/ /'dir 'bad dge bas lo legs 'bru 'phel zhing / / rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston ngom pa dang / /chos srid legs tshogs 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /ces ser bsrung me yi gur khang 'di ni/ nang gzhan la phan phyir 'bri 'dun yod pa'i khar/ slob bu padma rdo rje sogs sngags pa mang pos bskul ngor/ ser bsrung gnam lcags gur kang dang de'i sgrub chog bya bral padma 'phrin las kyi gsung sor bzhag dang mnan pa'i 'don cha rigs mthun nas blangs te/ snang mdzad rdo rjes rang lo don lnga'i steng du sbyar ba'o/ / mad maḥ

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtsho/ /zab chos 'khon ba dbyengs sgro' sgrub sten gyi phyag len zin bris padma dkan kro'i phreng ba zhes byu ba bzhugs so/ /nga / /na mo gu du lo ki shā da sgyu: 'od dpag med mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / / o rgyan padma sna nam legs ldan rje/ / dbyen med dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med la/ / gus pas 'dud do brtse bas gnang ba stsol/ / zab chos khyad 'phags 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi/ / sgrub chen skabs kyi phyag bzhes me tog phreng / / sngon rabs dam pa'i gsung gis rab brgyan nas/ /rjes 'jug blo gsal gzhon nu'i mgul rgyun spro/ /ye ma skal ldan blo gsal gzhon nu rnams/ / thog mar sgrub khang byi dor legs pan bya/ / sku gsung thugs rten bkrams shing dkyil 'khon gyi/ / stegs bu bkod legs sa brlan gnam rgyan bkram/ / de nas gtsang sbra dang ldan gtor rtsam nang / / bdud rtsi chos sman btab nas legs pad brdzis/ /sgod gtsang nang du zlum gtod phyogs bzhi ru/ /pad 'dab bzhi dang mtshams bzhir ril bu bzhi/ /rtse rgyan bum pa padma shel greng dang / /rta mgos mtshams par rgyun spros rig pas dpyad/ /mtshon don gtso gtor zhi khro'i gtso bo gnyis/ /phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab bzhi ba rigs bzhi la/ / mtshams bzhi'i mtheb kyu khrag 'thung rigs bzhi mtshon/ /g.yas g.yon sman raka dang bcas bkod mdzes bya/ / chos skyong gtor ma gtor snod so so ru/ /drang srong gton ma g.yas gcus mig gis mdzes/ /gdong mo g.yon gcus mtshams bzhir theb ril brgyad/ / baṃ no dpyangs pa nyi zla me ris brgyan/ / mgon po'i gtor ma zur gsum 'grims lam can/ /'khor brgyad mtheb kyu re res spras pa'o/ /sngags srung dpal gtor 'khor ni zur gsum bdun/ /g.yas gcus gcig ste zhing chung dbyug pas brgyun/ / sngags bdag 'bar ma zur gsum 'khor bdun dang / / dmag zor ma la zun gsum 'khod drug bskor/ / dam can mkhar thabs steng du zur gsum gcig / mkhan thabs steng gi zur bzhin zum po bzhi/ /rtsa ba'i zur bzhin zlum po bzhi dang ni/ / shar du skum po gsum dang lho nub byang / / zur gsum gsum ren gtso 'khor na mgos mdzes/ /ba rna~Xḍi du sa mtheb kyu re res brgyan/ / gzhan yang rtsa gsum chad bstan spyi gton

'khor ba dgyings sgrol sgrub chen gyi phyag len zin bris pad dkar zeng ba bzhugs so/ /sogs/ / spyi ltan bca' zhing rgyan spros gang mdzes bya/ / sngon 'gro'i skabs su dgos pa'i cog brgyud dang / /lha bshos brgyad dang bgegs gton gnyis kung bca'/ /phyi nol rgyal tho bzhi dang sgo byung gnyis/ / dam sri'i liṅgā mnan snod thun rdzas dang / / ma ṭi mgo gsum lag drug nang khrol ldan/ / nyer spyod bdun la sogs pa sta gon bya/ / dkyil 'khor bum pa me long rig tsaka dang / /rdod dril mda' dan me long brgyan pa bzhi1 /ral gri phur bu bzhi re rgyal mtshan bzhi/ /'phan bzhi gdugs dang gzungs thag sna lnga bsags/ /mchod pa zhi drag gnyis dang zla gam dang / /'dod yon lnga dang rtags dzas sna bdun gyi/ /tsaka li rnams dang bsgral mchod ling phur dang / /zho dang mar rtsi bsres pa'i sbyor mchod bdog /dngos grub skabs kyi 'brang rgyas klum po dkar/ /rdo rje mtshan dang ser po gru bzhi ba/ /nor bu zla gam dmar po padmas mtshan/ / gru gsum nag po ral gri'i rtse rgyan can/ / rin chen zur brgyad nor bus mtshan pa'am/ / yang na rim bzhin ma dkar ma ser po/ / a dmar ha nag oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan/ /tshe 'brang bum gzugs rdo rje rtse lnga dang / /hūṃ gis brgyan pa tshe ril gyis bskor ba/ /bza' bca' sna tshogs dang bcas sta gon bya/ /da yang skal ldan mchod dpon kun gyis nyon/ /tshogs la 'tshogs rnams bla ma'i rnal 'byon mthar/ /dkyil 'khon go sar tshom bu gtod ma dang / /mchod pa las bum bshams te sa chog byu/ /de nas mchod pa bsdus nas bgegs gtor bshams/ /bsngos 'phral phun gdan bshams shing 'bru snod du/ /phur bu gcig bzhag sbyangs mthan phur gdan dang / / phur bu dang bcas bsdus shing de nas slad/ /khro bcu'i phur gdan phyogs mtshams brgyad dang ni/ /shar gyi shar dang nub kyi nub tu bkod/ / phun bu bcu yang rim pa bzhin du bshams/ / tho ba phur bu slob dpon phyag tu phul/ 1shan gyi shar nas rim bzhin btab pa'i mjug / re zhig phur gdan dang bcas bsdu bar bya/ / de nas spos phor ging bas sna drangs nas/ / dung dkar zangs dung cha dang gdugs rgyul mtshan/ /nol mo dang bcas mjug tu slob dpon dang / /dpon slob 'khor bcas ser spreng dang bcas te/ / sgrub khang shar du 'khyogs gsum dga' 'khyil bcas/ /rgyal tho'i rtsad slebs mchod gtor legs par bshams/ / gser skyems dkar gtor bsngos 'phral rgyal tho bslang / / de bzhin lho nub byang du rim bzhin phebs/ / sgo drung dong brus gser skyems liṅgā sogs/ / bshams nas dam sri'i mnan pa gzhung ltar mnan/ / sgo byang gnyis kyi drung du mchod gtor bshams/ / thog man phyi sgo de nas nang byang 'dogs/ /thams cad 'tshogs shing rdo rje slob dpon nyid/ / dkyil 'khor mdun 1 'a~Xbye ga pa ṭi

gas/ 1nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bshams/ / ging ba khro bo gnyis kung ker ldog byu/ / ma ṭi bsgral mthan yan lag phyogs mtshams bkod/ / de nas dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod bya ba ni/ / dkyil 'khon bkrams shing dbus su bum pa dang / / me long rig tsaka rdo dril rtse dgu bshams/ / dkyil 'khor nub tu sman dka gtor gsum bkod/ / phyogs mtshams rnams su khro bcu'i phur pa bshams/ /phyogs bzhi ral gri zun bzhi mda' dar bzhi/ / sgo bzhir las mdog phun pa bzhi yang 'dzugs/ / grwa bzhir 'phan bzhi zun bzhir rgyal mtshan bzhi/ / steng du gdugs sogs bkod pa mdzes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor shar du chu gnyis nyer spyod dang / /lho du 'dod yon lnga dang rtags rdzas brgyad/ / byung du drag po'i mchod pa bsgral mchod bcas/ / shan lhon las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas dngos thub dzas/ /lho nub 'brub khung liṅgā thun rdzas sogs/ /nub byang bka' sdod gtor ma bshams gsungs kyang / / phyag len pho rgyud g.yas dang mo rgyud g.yon/ / byang shad dgang blugs la sogs legs par bshams/ / mtha' mar stag gzig sgab bskor yol bas brgyan/ / gzungs thag sna lnga bum pa'i nang nas drangs/ / dkar po shar dang ser po lho dang ni/ / sngon po dbus dang ljang gu byang du 'then/ / dmar po rdo rje slob dpon phyag tu 'bul/ / de nas bsang bdug bsang chu gtor bar bya/ / las bskos skabs su bdud rtsi chas sogs 'bul/ /bdud rtsi 'grems shing las bskos bskor bar bya/ /de rnams sngon 'gro sbyon ba'i rim pa'o/ / da yang skal ldan sngags phrug tshogs rnams nyon/ /'tshogs pa rnams kyis 'don pa gsung ba'i skabs/ / mchod gtor bshams shing gral du bsang bdug bya/ / dkar bgegs gtor ma gral mthar bshams nas bsngo/ / sman mchod skabs su bla mar nang mchod 'bul/ /kun la bdud rtsi sman mchod bkram par byu/ /bzlas pa'i skabs su kun thub ging ba dang / / byin 'bebs skabs su spos bdug bdud rtsi 'grems/ /de nas bsang gsur tshogs rdzas sta gon bya/ / tshogs phud spro tshe tshogs gton mdun ngos nas/ / thog mtha' ban gsum bcad cing de yi 'phror/ / rtse nas bla ma de nas gnam phud dang / / de rjes gtsang lhag len pa phyag len no/ / tshogs rdzas 'bul dus dang po 'bul len dang / / g.yas grwal btung ba g.yon grwal bza' ba 'grems/ / lhag ma gral mtha' nas bsdus gtsang lhag bsnan/ / bsngos 'phral dkyil 'khor byang shar btson du 'dzin/ /chad bstan bsngos 'phral gral nas mchod rdzas bsdu/ / mchod pa kha gso dgong thun cho ga 'don/ /phyi nyin nangs pan mtshod pa gsar du brje/ /dkad gtor rgyal chen gtor ma dgaga~X ḍi~X ༷shams/ / bsngos 'phral nang mchod bla ma'i mdun du 'bul/ / bzlas

'khor ba dbyings sgrol sgrub chen gyi phyag len zin bris pad dkar zeng ba bzhugs so/ /pa'i mjug tu kun thub byin 'bebs skabs/ /mchod rdzas 'grem pa la sogs kun la 'gre/ /gsar du thon pa rnams la bgegs gton dang / / las bum gyis ba thu thun mgo so so du/ /mchod pa gsar du brje ba man ngag go/ gung thun skabs su chos srung gtod bsngos skabs/ /gtod ma rgyas par bshams shing bsang gsur dang / / tshogs kyi bsgral ba'i skabs su phun skon skabs/ /ki ging gnyis thung sta gon bya ba gnad/ /bzhengs bskul skabs su gton ma gral mthan bshams/ /gtod zhal sbrub khung dag la phyogs nas khyer/ /chos srung gtod ma yang steng 'bul ba dang / /bskul ba'i skabs su phyi nol gtor ma 'phen/ /chos srung rnams kyi zhal 'bag spyon nas 'khrab/ / chad tho'i mjug tu sgob dpon gyis sna drangs/ / dpon slob 'ga' dang 'cham pa thams cad kyang / /sgo yi phyi nol byon nas 'cham rngam bya/ /bshal zus bstan ma bskyangs 'phral bro ra'i skabs/ / 'cham pa rnams kyis lag cha tshur la len/ /cho ga bsdus 'phral gral nas mchod rdzas bsdu/ /de ltan nyin zhag gcig gi phyag len ltar/ /sgrub zhag ma tshang bar du 'phyug med khya/ /grol ba'i snga nyin kha skong sbyin bsreg skabs/ /phyag len zin bris logs su bris la ltos/ /grol rgyu'i snga thun skabs su dngos grub kyi/ /rdzas dang 'brang rgyas thod chang la sogs bshams/ / stegs bu gzhan du dbus su che bum bkod/ /g.yas su tshe ril g.yon du tshe chang dang / / mdun du che mda' la sogs sta gon bya/ / byin 'bebs rjes su gzungs thag bsdus pa'i mthar/ /dngos thub rdzas dang ril bu 'grems par bya/ / de rjes mchod rdzas bkrams shing ser sbreng gi / sta gon dang ni ril bu bkrams pa'i mthad/ /mad me smon lam skabs kyi man me bsags/ /phyi nyin cho ga'i skabs su rgyul tho bsdu/ /bye ༈bye/ phya/ga len phra zhib legs btab nas/ / skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i bka' drin srus pa/ mang mang rgyu che'i gzhung las bsdus pa'i bcud/ /bzang bzang sngon rabs dam pa'i zhal bzhes rgyun/ / zab zab 'di ko bdag gis bkod pa 'dis/ / myur myur bstan 'gro'i gsos su 'gyun 'di rmad/ /dang po rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gral ma zhig /bar du sgrub rdzas chom bu'i rgya ma yal/ /tha ma dam sel g.ya' yis ma gos pa/ / 'di ko pha rgod bla ma mchog gi drin/ / phyi rabs las ldan 'byung dang 'byung 'byur rnams/ / sla chos khral 'degs sgeg chos ma byed par/ / nom dag phyag len phra zhib bslab gyu1 na/ge / gsang chen rim chen phogs bcar ma bar nges/ / grub mo (bad byem ring da dung ltar yi / ༵bye dge shis rdo/ge ma/༵rdo phyo snas shā chen sgyur ༈ḍi gyu rdo cig rgyas/ pa dang / /zab 'a sgrub na nga du gnas pa —/ /ces pa 'di yang sgrub chen gyi mchod dpon tshe dbang rin chen dang / rin chen dgal2/19gsab chen/
) ma/ bla ma skyabs rnams nas yun ring bskul ngor nyang gi bla ming bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos

gas/ 'khor ba dpyings sgrol sgyu kha skong sbyin sreg 'od snang 'bum brdal bzhugs so/ /mtsho/ /zab 'am 'khon ba dbyengs sgro' kyi ka skong spyin sreg gi cho ga thod snang 'bum bda' zhes byu ba bzhugs so/ /ra / /na mo lo ki shā ra ye/ ngo bo 'gyur med chos sku snang mtha' yas/ / rang bzhin ma 'gags longs sbu 'jig rten dbang / /thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku padma 'byung / /dbyer med nam mkha'i mtshan can gtsug gis mchod/ / sna nam yang sprul gter ston legs ldan rjes/ / spyan drangs zab chos byin bye 1 rlobs/ sgol/ gyi/ /sgrub chen kha skong sbyin sreg 'dir brjod na/ /rtsa gsum lha yis bka' gnang de la 'dir zab chos 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi sgrub chen kha skong 'i ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga la gsum las/dang po sbyor za ni/ zhi ba la shis pa'i gza' skar dus sbyor bkod la bsnyen sgru' kyi kha skong sogs la sa chog grub zin pa'i dbang gis mi dgos la/ ma dul ba'i rigs la sa chog ji ltar bya tshul ni/ sa lha'i gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis dang nyen sbyod bshams la/ rang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ re yi ka/oṃ ma hūṃ gis mchod gtor brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mo brgyangs pa'i rdo rje dang bcas pa las kha sbub tu bzhag ste/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i lag pa sa la brdab pa'i rkyen gyis sa gzhi'i dbus nas sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas te byon par gyur/ hūṃḥ ji ltar sngon tshe dbang mdzad ltaraḥ bdag ni byung chub nges pan sgrubaḥ mchod 'bul dpung mdzod sa 'di zhuḥ 'byung bo sa yi bdag po rnamasaḥ gnas rten gzhan du khyod song laḥs gzhi bkra shis mdzad du gsolaḥ sarba bhu ta snu dza kha hiḥ sha sto ku du ye swāhāḥ zhes gton ma phyir btang / sa lha'i gnang ba byin nas sa la thim pas sa phyogs ga med gyi rang bzhin du gyun/nag phyogs pa rnams la bgegs gtor gzhung ltar btang / rtsa sngags dang hūṃ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/gu gul gyis bdug yungs kan gyis brab/ rdo rje rtse lnga ba'i phyag rgya sa la gtugs shing / yo su bha wa kaḥ nang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ka yi khaṃ spros pas de las ye shes kyi me rlung chu gsum byung ste dngos 'dzin dag pan gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ / rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje spyi bsdams las/ gung mo gnyis rtse gug pa tshigs gnyis par sbyar mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyes so sor bsgreng ba'o/ / bri tshul ni/ sa steng 'doms gang thu bzhi ba 'thas par sar bcag pa la thig chen brgyad spyi ltar btab pa'i lte ba sor bzhi'i zum skor dang de rgyab sor bzhi'i padma 'dab bzhi/22bye phyir sor

da / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzhir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ de rgyab mu ran kha khyer gnyis sor bzhi re klum skor/ bzhi tshon rnams dkan po 'ba' zhig la bcad rnams dman skya lta bus bya/ lte bar thig le mdun rgyab zung 'brel du gtso bo gnyis dang / pad 'dab ba'i ra thig le rigs bzhe/ rtsibs bzhin rta mgrin bzhi/ rtsibs rtsen sgo ba bzhi'i phyag mtshan nam snying po tshon spungs ci rigs byu/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i zeng ba dang stegs bu'i grwar zla byed rdo rje rtse lnga nang bstan bri/ nu ran la srog chags med pa'i ba glang gi lci ba skam po shug pa sogs kyis skum skor mtho gang brtsigs pa'i nang gi dbus sam shar lhor zan gyi ting lo mar khus bkang ba'i me tshang bca' 'ing 'o ma can sogs 'i bar shis pa'i shing bu phra mos zang zang du bkang / slob dpon gyi g.yas su stegs bu gtsang ma ras dkar gyis bkab pa la sreg rdzas 'o ma can gyi shing lnga dngos mi 'byor ngan rung /bal bu shug pa lcang skya 'om bu kham bu ste lnga bo gang rigs kyi yam shing son bcu gnyis sam brgyad pa rtsa rtse spos mar gyis byug pa dang / mar khu zho zan la/ mar 'o ma mngar gsum btab pa'i zas mchog til dun lnga/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ ku sha/ yungs kan gos dar sna tshogs/ khyad pan ba'i rdzas spungs sogs 'das ma 'das kyi cha gnyis spreng tshar du 'das lha'i rdzas rgyab dang / me lha'i rdzas de las nyung ba mdun byus bshams g.yon du stegs kyi khar 'das ma 'das kyi dkar gtor zlum po pad 'dab can che chung gnyis dang / nyer spyod lnga tshar gnyis steng 'og gam rgyab mdun du bsgrigs/ mdun du me yol gangs ri chu rgyun 'khyil ba bris la chu'i sa bon can me dug gzhil ba'i phyir kha phar bstan pa'i ljog tse'i khan bsang chu'am las bum/ rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba/ rgyas par spro na me mtshams kyi mda' dar lnga/ las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas/ me lha'i gtor ma zum lnga/ ḍa ma du/ 'thor nas sogs pa'i~X/da bshoms /'khor dang mi 'brel na sman gtor rakta nyer spyod tsam la brten te las gzhung bsrangs gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ stan la 'dug ste brgyud 'debs nas bzung las gzhung bsrang / gter srung mchod/ tshogs 'khor thog mtha' bar gsum rnams song rjes/ rang nyid kha shar du phyogs pa'i stan la byin pa g.yas par byin pa g.yon bzhag ste pus mo gnyis smad/ padma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug ste chos dkar po dang ldan pa'i las bum la/ yo mṛ tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang du nyi ma'i dbus su ā dkan po de las 'od zer 'phros/'og min nas bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus te bum chu la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ yo āḥhūṃ/ brgya rtsa dang / yo kro ti shā ri sarba tra bye shodha ya oṃ āḥhūṃḥ lan bdun gyis sgrub/ de nas ngag bcad/ rdor dril bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rdo rje dang dril bu/ kun tu bzang po bde bar gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum/ sems dpa' sems ma/ gsang ba'i yum bzhi/ shes rab kyi pha nol tu sdod ma2/22rdo sbyo'i rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang bcas pa don dam ye shes

mas/ /'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi kha skong sbyin sreg 'od snang 'bum brdal bzhugs so/ /rang bzhin rtogs pa'i rdo rje dang / sems can rnams ma rig pa'i gnyid las slong zhing a li kā li'i chos dbyangs sgrog pa'i dril bun gyur/ hūṃ/ mi 'gyur thugs kyi rdo rje niḥ thugs kar rtag tu bsten byas lasaḥ thugs kyi ye shes rdo rje yinaḥ gsor bas gdon bgegs thams cad 'jomasaḥ yo ā hūṃ badzra tiṣṭha 4 na sa ma ye hūṃ swāhā/ zhes thugs kar gson/dril bu la/ hūṃ1 shes rab dbyings kyi sgra sgrogs paḥ mtshan ma'i dngos po sgrogs mthan stongaḥ srid gsum dang bzhin nyid kyi ngangaḥ dngos po thams cad stong nyid ngangaḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ snyu ku la rnyi ri bhaṇḍi ā hūṃḥ zhes dkun brten cing dkrol rjes pad skor dang 'khyud rgya bya'o/ /ḍa ma ru la/ rnga āḥdang rnga lcags hūṃ las byung ba'i kun bzang yab yum mkha' gsang sbyar ba'i byung sems chos sgra gdangs su shar bas stong gsum gang bar bsam la/ hūṃ/ rnal 'byon mchog gi ḍa ma duḥ yul nyid ma skyes chos kyi dbyingasaḥ 'dzin rtog bral ba'i ye shes kyiḥ theg chen chos kyi sgra chen sgrogasaḥ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ dharma ḍa du hūṃ hūṃḥ zhes dkrol/ dgang blugs bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi tshul du bkug ste gzar bu gnyis la thim/ de zhu ba las hūṃ las blug gzar rdo rje dang / ā las dgang gzar dril bu'i rnam pa can yongs su gyur pa las khro rgyal rta mgrin dmar po rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin cing yum phag mo mthing nag gri thod 'dzin par snyoms pan zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'od du zhu nas blug gzar dang dgang gzan gyi rnam pan gyur/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ thabs kyi blug gzar thogs la/ yo thabs kyi nol ba las byung ting 'dzin gyisaḥ dpa' bo rdo rje snod mchog g.yas su thogasaḥ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ tī ā/ yo khri shī no be shu da ye sruhwa/ g.yon shes rab kyi dgang gzar thogs la/ ā shes nab bde stong dga' bzhi stoms 'jug giḥ dpa' mo zab lam chos 'byung g.yon du thogasaḥyo rlu waṃ hūṃ tai yo shrī hūṃ tā ti shu swāhā/ tshes kha sbyar/ mi spro na tshigs bcad tsam dang sngags kyis brlabs kung chog de nas mchod rdzas dang bsregs rdzas bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las hūṃ las rin po che'i sdod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūṃḥ de bzhin du pa hūṃ nas sha lha'i bar du mchod rdzas dang / lag gnyis khu tshur sbyar ba'i gung mdzub gnyis bsgrengs te rtse spud pa/ rdzas rnams la dngos su reg par mos te1 yo yo sruhwa/ zhes rdzas rnams ba'i sna par bsam/ yo āḥsruhwa/ yam shing / yo shī swāhāḥ mar khu/ yo dzi sruhwas 'bru rnams/ — ku du ku du sruhwas rdzas gzhan rnams la'o/ / de ltar lan gsum gyis nyes skyon spyangs pad bsam/ thab khung bsangs spyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung spyom po dkar la 'od mi 2 ༵za ba mu

ra / 1nyab snyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs ba bsgrigs/ran kha khyer dang bcas pa/ kha khyer rdo rjes mtshan pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing bzang pos yongs su gang ba'i dbus su sna las me 'od dkar po rab tu 'bad bad gyud/ zhes dpal 'ban gyi dkar me sogs zhi ba las byung ba'i me lag tu thogs te/ oṃ padma ka kro te kyis sbyangs/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zed bcas rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog sgod kyi rlung cher g.yos/snang zhing bskyed pa'i me la tsha ba'i ngar thon/ de'i me lha'i 'khor gyi lha mo gsal byed bzhi la phog pas 'byung bzhi nam mkha' lnga'i me sgron dang bzhin du sban bar gyud/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ bhā: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab la/ thab kyi phyogs bzhi dbus lngar g.yas skor du gzhug cing /hūṃ shad nas nad gdon zhi ba'i meḥ me long ye shes ngang du sbadaḥ lho nas tshe bsod rgyas pa'i meḥ mnyam nyid ye shes ngang du sbaraḥ nub nas khams gsum dbang sdud meḥsod rtog ye shes ngang du sbaraḥ byang nas dgra bgegs tshar gcod meḥ bya grub ye shes ngang du sbadaḥ dbus nas chos dbyings ye shes meḥ ka dag zang thal ngang du sbaraḥsku lnga rang byung lhun grub meḥ de bzhin ngang gis me sbar noḥ oṃ badzra da sna padma karma budha dzñā na sa ma ye sruhwa/ yo badzra dzwa la re sna hūṃ phaṭa/ ces khyab par sbar la mar khus kyang bran/ de bzhin du rlung g.yab cing / hūṃ shan phyogs dkar rgo g.yo ba moḥ byams pa chen pos rlung g.yob cigaḥ lho phyogs bde ba spel ba moḥ snying rje chen pos rlung g.yob cigaḥ nub phyogs dang grol g.yo ba moḥ dga' ba chen pos rlung g.yob cigaḥ byang phyogs thogs med g.yo ba moḥ btang stoms chen pos rlung g.yob cigaḥ dbus phyogs skye med stong ba moḥ ye shes chen pos rlung g.yob cigaḥ oṃ yi yi yu pa ra na 4 na yi yi swāhā/ de nas rgyas par spro na mi bcad pa ni/ bsdu na mi dgos so/ / dang gi thugs ka nas 'phrin las kyi sgo ma lnga'i nang bzhin can phyogs bzhi dbus lngan 'phros pas 'byung ba lnga mi 'khrug cing / 'phrin las lnga'i bar bsrung bar gyur/ me mtshams kyi mda' dar lnga rim bzhin gzhug cing / hūṃ ye shes me yi dkyil 'khod duḥ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brtsams pa laḥ bdud dang bad du gcod pa rnamasaḥshar phyogs sgo mas me mtshams srungasaḥ lo badzra tsakra tikhyi ye su hā/ hūṃ ye shes me yi do da ru/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg brtsams pa la/ / bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ / lho phyogs sgo mas me mtshams srungs/ / oṃ da sna tsakra tsakra tiṣṭha ye sruhwa/ hūṃ ye shes me yi dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang gi sbyin sreg brtsams pa la/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /nub phyogs sgo mas me mtshams srungs/ / yo padma tsakra tsakra teṣṭha ye su hā/ hūṃ ye shes me yi dkyil 'khor du/ /drag po'i sbyin sreg brtsams pa la/ /bdud dang bad du gcod pa rnams/ /byang phyogs sgo mas me ༵bka srungs/ /oṃ dharnya tsakra tsakra ba ye sruhwa/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod

ra /'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi kha skong sbyin sreg 'od snang 'bum bdal bzhugs so/ /pa ni/ thab khung sna tshogs padma'i lte bar re dkad po yongs su gyur pa las da gyur te de las 'od zed 'phros 'dus pa las me lha pā ba ka zhes bya ba sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gsus pa che ba dal ba'i thor gtsug can phyag gnyis kyis gu snyen dang bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa rgyan gos thams cad dkar po ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pa/ gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zed 'phros pas/ shad lho nas me lha drang srong 'khon dang bcas pa khro badzra sa ma ya dza/ dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ hūṃḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi/ / tshur gshegs tshur gshegs drang srong mchog / dang gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du/ /'bar ba'i nang du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ asne ye de wa ye gye hi sa ma ya dza dza/ bzhugs gsol ni/ gzi brjid 'bad ba me yi lha/ / 'dod pa thams cad sgrub mdzad cing / /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'bad ba'i nang du bzhugs su gsol/ /padma ka ma la ye sdi/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ oṃ badzra sa twa ā/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying bo mchog /tshangs pa'i dbyings dag byed pa ste/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed yin/ / de yis bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / bgegs rnams med cing zhi bad mdzod/ / ces rang gi g.yon jib kyi g.yas ngos te lho dang lho nub dang nub byang sogs rim pa'i chos skor du bstan snga mas phyi ma'i rtsa ba non par bkram mo/ / de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/hūṃḥ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog / sems can don la dam tshig dgongs/ / gzi brjid che zhing thugs rje ldan/ /bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ya ti su ho pra ti tsu hoḥlas bum gyis me long ngos la khrus gsol zhing / ma sde'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / / bdag sogs sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs slad du/ /sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /mi gtsang skyon sbyo dri ma dag kyun cig / oṃ ma sde ye de wa pra wa ra pad ka ri pra te sbyo sprad/ mchod pa ni/ hūṃḥ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ / yon chab me tog bdug spos dang / / snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas sgra/ /me lha drang srong 'khor bcas la/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na/ /thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /khro asnye ye ma lha nas/ shad snu dza me snya sa mu twa sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃḥ zhes dang / hūṃ drang srong chen pos sngon chad ma bstar ba'i/ / ting 'dzin dbang bsgyur zhal zas bdud rtsi 'di/ /dag cing gtsang mar bshams pa 'bul lags kyi/ /ye shes thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ / sgon zin/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa dang dgang blugs kyi rtse la da yig gis mtshan par gyun/ rdo dril dang bcas lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcing ba'i steng nas mab bong bkab pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshun gyis mdzub mo brgyangs te gan rkyal du bsdig pa~X )du ba

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzung / g.yas pa de ba'i na gshegs pa'i khu tshur byas pa'i mdzub mo brgyangs pa thur du spubs pas blugs gzar gyi yu ba bzung / g.yon pa'i mdzub mo'i thad kar g.yas pa'i khu tshur bzhag nas dgang gzar gyi blugs gzar gyi mgo bzhag ste 'dzin pa byang chung mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ oṃ ma sde ye sruhwa/ zhes lan bdun mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang ba lag pa gnyis pus mo'i khong las mi 'dan ban g.yas bskor du/ yo asne ye ma dī sgyu a dī byā a be sha ma be sha ma hwa shi ye ha bya ka bya ba na ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thad ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad par ting 'dzin mi gsal zhing bzlas brjod lhag chad du gyur pa sogs bsnyen sgrub kyi nyes skyon thams cad sha sto ku du ye sgyu hāḥlan gsum gyi 'bul lo/ /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ a sde chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa'i don rnams nab bsgrub cing / /thugs rje'i sems can don mdzad pa/ /sbyin sreg mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ / zhes brjod la bsreg rdzas kyi thog mar yam shing lag g.yon gyis bzung /g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bzung ste 'og nal bskor ba'i mchod pa ni phyag rgyus 'bul zhing / yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin du gyur/ yo ma sde ye sruhwa/ bo dhi prikṣa ye sruhwaḥbadag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la ban du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad pan gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bad du gcod pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwa/ mar khu la/ yo asne ye sruhwa/ zhes me lha'i sngags kyi mgo drangs thams cad 'dra la/ yo asne ye swā hwa/ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang /khyad pan 'byon ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad ba ku du ye sruhwa/ zho zan la/ oṃ sarba saṃ bha te swāhā/ bdag cag dpon 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thad ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad pan bde ba mchog la bar du gcod pa thams cad sharnyi ku du ye swā hwa/ til la/ oṃ sarba pa paṃ da ha na badzra ye sruhwa/ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad par sdig sgrib zhi ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwa/ dur ka la/ yo badzra a yu ṣe sruhwaḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad par tshe phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye snya hā/ 'bras la/ yo badzra pus ye sruhwaḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde ba ka ༵ rnaX kyi thad ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad

ma / /'khor ba dgyings sgrol gyi kha skong sbyin sreg 'od snang 'bum brdal bzhugs so/ /dang / khyad par bsod nams rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad ba ku du ye sruhwa/ so ba la/ yo badzra bi dza ye swāhā/ bdag cag dpan slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi than ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad par nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dri ku du ye sta hwaḥ nas la/ yo ma hā be snya ye sruhwaḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la ban du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad pan myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwa/ sran ma la/ yo ma hwa ba la ye swāhā/bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la ban du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad pan stobs rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad ba ku du ye sta hā/ grol/ oṃ badzra lha sma ri sruhwaḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad par nad thams cad zhi ba'i bar du gcod pa thams cad sha sna ku du ye swā hwa/ ku shal/ oṃ ma pra ti ha da badzra ye sruhwaḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi than ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad pan bsrung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad ba ku du ye sruhwa/ yo sarba atpa sa dha ye sruhwaḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la ban du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad pan bgegs thams cad sgrol ba'i bar du gcod pa thams cad shanti ku du ye sruhwa/ gos sna tshogs la/ yo badzra was twa ye sruhwaḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thad ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad par bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwa/ khyad par ba la/ oṃ ku nu ku du ye sruhwaḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams kyi thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / khyad pan mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sha sto ku du ye sruhwa/ 'dir kha skong gtso bor bgyis pa'i gzhan spel tshig gang dgos skabs thob shes dgos/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong bcu cha'i sbyin sreg la til gtso bor 'bul/ 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ yam shing 'khor la 'bul bya ste/ / til zho nas ni phyag tu'o/ / ku sha dur wa gtsug tor la/ / mar khu nas 'bras so ba dang / /ma sha la sogs zhal du 'bul/ /khu ba'i rdzas kun de bzhin no/ /spos rnams shangs la me tog spyan/ / dri mchog thugs kar me 'od/ / mchod yon thor 'thung zhal du 'bul/ / bdud rtsi ljags la gos mchog sku/ /rin chen 'phreng ba dbu dang snyan/ /nol mo'i rdzas rnamaX ༷ka lhag/ ——/zhes

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsungs pa ltar no/ / thub na lha sngags rdzas sngags spel tshig gsum sbyar bas rdzas re re bzhin 'bul/ de ltar ma grub na lha sngags rdzas sngags gnyis sprel ba dang / de yang ma grub na thog mtha' gnyis su lha sngags rdzas sngags spel tshig sbyan zhing bar rnams su lha sngags kho nas phud kyang chog go /bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo yam shing du zhun mar 'bul theb re re la sngags re sbyar ba sbyin sreg re re'i grangs su brtsi ba yin zhing / man khu blugs gzar re re bgrang par bya/ blugs gzar re grangs kha nas thon tshad byas na lha la bsru ba'i bsam pas 'gro ba'i rgyu sgrub pan mi bya'o/ / de nas slar yang / slobadzra ma ste sogs/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃḥtshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang sbong mchog /'byung bo yan lag skyob pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul ba/ /rig pa grub pa'i drang sbong mchog /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rwab 'od/ / bskal ba'i me ltad gzi brjid 'ban/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul ba'i theg pa chibs/ /bgrang 'phreng 'dzin cing rig sngags gsung / / bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gu ste bsnams/ / chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs pan spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kung mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kung thugs rje che/ / de la bstod de phyag kung 'tshal/ / bcom ldan 'das dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes me'i bdag nyid 'byung ba chen po me'i nang bzhin ma sde chen po khyod kyis bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bsreg pa dang / bsod nams spel ba dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi bar bya ba'i phyir mchod rdzas zhal du stob la 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ oṃ bros shā pra tī tsā sruhwaḥ zhes bsang gtor dang / oṃ pa khyo pra tī tstsha sruhwaḥ zhes zhabs bsil gtor/ me lha'i ye shes sa steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pan gyur/ dam tshig pa me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che bad gyur/ de nas ye shes me lha mchod pa ni/ yo ga rnam gsum gyi sgrub thabs ma hwa yo ga'i mngon rtogs ltar/ oṃ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med yi ge hriḥ zhes sogs bskal me rab 'bar baṃ chen steng na 'gying / / yo padma ka krita tya lha wa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar gyis me lha'i lto bar thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom la/ spyan 'dren ni/ bhāḥ dbyings kyi 'od khyim rnam dag po ta la/ /zhes sogs/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal gyi/ / na mo pu du sha ya hoḥ zhes pa'i ban las byang ltar btang / de nas byon zin/ ye shes pa'i me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa dang dgang blugs kyi rtse la re yig gis mtshan par gyur/oṃ ma sde ye sruhwaḥ lan bdun gyis gong ltan mar khus bkang ba g.yas su bskor te/ yo ā hūṃ hri oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃḥ yo padma ga krita khru kṛ wa hūṃḥ bdag cag sogs spel lhag gong ltar btags la gsud kas2 dī~Xl/—deXnas/ jiḥ rig gdangs thugs rje'i lha tshogs la/ / zhes pa nas/

mas/ /'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi kha skong sbyin lhag 'od snang 'bum brdal bzhugs so/ /ye shes sku mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / zhes pa'i bar dang / bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/hūṃ a yig nang byung me hom duḥ ho yig byang chub bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ / rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug gi/ / bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul/ / byang chub shing dang rtsi mngar bcud/ /zas mchog 'bru sna til du/ / dan zab sman sna rin chen sogs/ /'dod dgu'i rdzas mchog ma lus pa/ / ye shes lnga yi nang bzhin bcud/ / thogs med nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du/ / gus pa'i blo yis 'bul lags na/ / gnyis su med pan bzhes nas kung / /nad gdon sdig sgrib dgra bgegs sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi ban mdzod/ /tshe dang ye shes rgyas pa dang / /phyi nang snod bcud dbang du sdus/ /log 'dren bdud rigs rtsa nas chod/ / phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / dzas kyi thog ma yam shing / yam shing byang chub kyi shing gi nang bzhin du gyun/ yo ā hūṃ bhāḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃḥ oṃ padma ka krita kye sgro wa hūṃḥ yo bo dhi bris ye sogs kyis rdzas rnams gong ltar 'bul/ rdzas rdzogs pa dang / ārya lo ke shā ra tya sgre wa sa pā ri wa na arghaṃ so gas kyis mchod la/ zhi khro yi dam 'dus pa'i dang bzhin can/ /dngos grub rtsa ba thugs rje spyan ras gzigs/ /rta mgrin dbang chen 'khor 'das spyi dpal gtso/ / yi dam sku mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas bstod/ de nas rgyas par spro na/ las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas dgang blugs kyis mar khu dang bcas 'bul zhing / bsdu na mi dgos/ hūṃḥ rdo rje dbyings kyi pho brang chen po nas/ / rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khod rgya mtsho dang / /thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bskul/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi ba'i dus la bab1 /nad gdon rkyen ngan zhi ba'i dus la bab/ /mi mthun 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dus la bab/ /'byung bo'i gdug tsub zhi ba'i dus la bab/ /dam sri'i ka rlangs zhi ba'i dus la bab/ / dus la bab po rgyal ba thugs rje can/ / dam rdzas dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ / ma dungs bdud dgra zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / de yis zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med/ / zhi mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / hūṃḥ rin chen 'bar ba'i pho brang chen po nas/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang / /thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bskul/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i dus la bab /gsang sngags theg chen rgyus pa'i dus la bab/ /tshe bsod dbang thang rgyas pa'i dus la bab/ /chos dang snyan grags lhas pa'i dus la bab/ /dpal dang 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dus la bab/ /dus la bab po rgyal ba thugs rje can/ /dam rdzas dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /rgyal bstan 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / de yis rgyas par ma gyur gang sdung med/ /rgyas mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / hūṃḥ ba ༵lha~X ༷༷ pho

mtsho/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brang chen po nas/ / rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang / / thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tshogs dus la bab/ /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i dus la bab/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i dus la bab/ /tshe chos zas nor sdud pa'i dus la bab/ /bsod nams phywa g.yang sdud pa'i dus la bab/ / longs spyod mnga' thang sdud pa'i dus la bab/ / lha 'dre mi gsum sdud pa'i dus la bab/ /dus la bab po rgyal ba thugs rje can/ /dam rdzas dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ / skye 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzod/ / de yi dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med/ / dbang mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / hūṃḥ'aphrin las drag po e yi pho brang nas/ / rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyu mtsho dang / /thugs rje zhi khro'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bskul/ / sangs rgyas bstan dgra bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /rnal 'byor dgos dgra bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /bla ma'i sku dgra bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /sdig can dam nyams bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /ma dungs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ / keg dang phung sri bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ / dus la bab po rgyal ba thugs rje can/ / dam nyams dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ / zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i 'jin las mdzod/ /de yis bsgral ban ma gyud gang yang med/ /bsgral mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces phul/ de nas gtor ma/ ji yi ka oṃ ā hūṃḥyo lo ki shā ri tu bye wa me dam ba ling ta kha kha khye khyi/ zhes lan gsum gyi phul/ 'dod gsol ni/ho/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la 'phrin las su gsol ba ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i dgra gnod pa'i bgegs1 rno ba'i mtshon/sbyon ba'i dug nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu / ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu/ rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ spyor ba tsub pa/ lo zla zhag skegs/mo ngan rtsis tsub/ mi kha bram mchu la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po thams cad lhan ba nyid du zhi bad mdzad du gsol/ sha sto ku du swā hwaḥ slar yang byon skyems ltar gshegs skyems 'bul de nas dngos grub kyi rdzas 'o thug sgrub par spro na/ 'o ma 'bras mar sbrang rtsi ka ra ste rdzas lnga bo hūṃ las byung ban mos nas snod nag po ma yin pa tsa ldan dkar po sogs las mthun gyi dri dbyung ba mgul bar me tog gi phreng ba bcings/ rab thab khung gi me la ma lha'i steng du bzhag pa'i nang du blugs gzar gyis blugs la rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bzla 'ing bskon te bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas 'o thug de la/ yo di ba asne sa ma dhi spre na pri na rte sruhwaḥ zhes sngags la las gzhung gi/ hūṃḥbhāḥ skye med chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /thugs rje 'gags med zhi khro'i lha/ / mnyam nyid dbyings nas skur bzhe——sa ༵3/ 0 /bka gsum yongs rdzogs dngos grub stsol/ / yo ā hūṃḥ ma hā sirnyi hūṃḥ

gas/ /'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi kha skong sbyin sreg 'od snang 'bum brdal bzhugs so/ /zhes thams cad la bkram 'ing nol/ nongs bshags ni/ padma sa twa sbyar ba'i yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthad/ hoḥ nang rig rnam dag sgrub gzhung las/ / ———rtogs par shog / ces dang / hoḥ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs ma lus la/ / sbyin bsreg mchod pa 'di phul bas/ /bdag gis 'gal 'khrul ci spyad pa/ / de dag thams cad bzod pan gsol/ /nyams chag sdig grib thams chad sha sto ku du ye swāhāḥ zhes dang / 'dod gsol smon lam gang 'dod btab/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs sho lo ka gcig gi rjes su/ oṃ badzra snyu/ me lha'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyun/gsum pa rjes kyi byu ba la/ nam mkhan bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa me lha dam tshig la thim pan gyur/ yam shing 1sa gos zung bar bdun nam gsum tsam 'bul/ pyon skyems ltar gshegs skyems phul/gtor ma/ re yi khaḥ yo ā hūṃḥ yo mas ye de wa ye dam ba ling ta kha kha khye khye/ zhes lngas 'bul/ me mtshams kyi mda' dar bsdu ba ni/ me lha'i gtor ma rnams rim par 'bul zhing mda' dan bsdu/ bsdu na mi dgos/ hūṃḥ shan phyogs zhi ba'i 'phrin las sku/ / me long ye shes me lha la/ /dam rdzas rgyun gyi mchod gtor 'bul/ /zhe sdang me phung dbyengs su bsdu/ / shan gyi sgo ma'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / ces shar gyi mda' dar bsdu/ de bzhin du/ hūṃḥ lho phyogs rgyas pa'i 'phrin las sku/ / mnyam nyid ye shes me lha la/ / dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod gton 'bul/ / nga rgyal me phung dbyengs su bsdu/ / lho yi sgo ma'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / hūṃḥnub phyogs dbang gi 'phrin las sku/ / sor rtog ye shes me lha la/ / dam jos rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'bul1 / 'dod chags me phung dbyengs su bsdu/ / nub kyi sgo ma'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃḥ byang phyogs drag po'i 'phrin las sku/ /bya grub ye shes me lha la/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'bul/ / phrag dog me phung dbyengs su bsdu/ / byang gi sgo ma'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / hūṃ: dbus phyogs chos dbyengs 'phrin las sku/ /he du ka ba me lha la/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod gton 'bul/ / gti myug me phung dbyings su bsdu/ /dbus phyogs bdag mo'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / ces bskul/ de nas/ yo asne ye arghaṃ sogs dang /'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras/ / me lha rgyal po ḍa khri'i dbang bsgyur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg / 'dzin byed me lha khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gshegs gsol ni/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byen za khyod kyi mdzad legs kyis/ /tshim zhing dbyes par mdzad nas kyang / /rang gnas bzang por gshegs su gsol/ /yo ma sde ye gatstsha/ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ bsngo smon mdon bsdus bya/ bsnyen pa'i kha bskang lta bur me ma shi dod du lha ci1 steX ༷ ba

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chu klung du gshegs/ glo bur ba yin na me 'o mas gzhil la/ oṃ ru du sbu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha pa twa ni sruhwaḥzhel bsdu'o/ / de nas las byang gi lhag gtor man dkyus bzhin gtong ba yin no/ /de ltar 'phags mchog 'khon ba dbyings sgol gyi/ / bsnyen sgrub kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'di/ /sgrub chen skabs su mkho bas bris pa'i dges/ / gsang chen bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyun cig /ces zab lam 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi kha skong sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od snang 'bum brdal zhes byu ba 'di ni sgrub chen sgyu kha skong gi skabs mkho ban snyam nas/ bya bral padma 'phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i 'khon ba dbyings sgrol gyi sbyin sreg dri med zla shel ga'i na bzhag rta mgrin gyi sbyin sreg ye shes 'od 'ban/ phun pa'i sbyin sreg ye shes 'od phung sogs rigs mthun gyi sbyin sreg du ma nas kha bskangs te/ skyabs mgon dge~X /dka/na dge 'o / / po/ rdo lo/'i gnang ba ltan sngags ban bstan 'dzin sgyu mtshos spyar ba dge'o/ /

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lag len gsal byed me long bzhugs so/ /mtsho/ /bka' ba byed bde gshegs 'dus pa'i kag len gsa' byed me long zhes byu ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang dpal chen te du ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi dbyengs 'gyur med ngo bo kun tu bzang / /rang bzhin gsal ba kha sbyor longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku padma dang / /dbyer med drin can bla ma gtsug na rgyal/ /khrag 'thung khro nol 'phrin las zab mo'i don/ / ma 'dres gsal byed me long zhes bya ba/ / sngon byon dam pa'i gsung bzhin 'dir bkod na/ / chos bdag bsrung mas gnang ba'i skabs dbye zhig /de la 'dir khro bo nol ba'i gtor bzlog gi gshom sgyu lag len ni/ gnas khang sa rgyan gnam sgyun sogs kyis brjid chags pan byas/ dpal dgu'i sku rten bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu sum rim khebs ldan gyi steng / dang po'i dbus su che mchog gi dpal gtod dmar po 'khon nang 'dra brgyad kyis bskon ba'i mtshams su mtheb kyu ril bus brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas su gtod snod gcig tu dbus su legs ldan de'i g.yas su mgon po phyag bzhi ba/g.yon du ma ning legs ldan gyi mdun du gter mgon zhal bzhi ba de'i g.yas su bdud mgon seng gdong can/ g.yon du sde dpon sum cu/ legs ldan gyi rgyab du lha chen gza' rnam sras phur srung bcu gnyis bcas gtso 'khon bcu/ che mchog gi g.yon du gton sgod gcig tu dbus su mo rgyud kyi gtso mo sngags srung ma'i gtor ma de'i g.yas su dur khrod bdag mo/g.yon du spyol po/ sngags srung ma'i mdun du brag btsan/ de'i g.yas su 'bad ba spun bdun/ g.yon du bdud btsan klu gsum/ sngags srung ma'i spyob tu sman btsun ma rdod legs gter bdag spyi gtor/ ga'i bdag spyi gtor bcas gtso 'khor bcu/ de'i g.yas su bdud rtsi/ g.yon du rakta stegs bar ma'i dbus su bshos bu dmar nag bdun gyi g.yas su chad tho gru gsum mdun ngos mtheb kyu gsum gyi steng du gnyis dang de'i steng du gcig brtsegs pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis su mtheb kyu gyen ling bcas bsgyud can/ g.yon du bstan ma dbus su gru gsum nag po/ g.yas su gru bzhi dmar po/ g.yon du zlum po dkad po de gsum la rang 'dra'i dbyibs kyi mtheb kyu sum brtsegs re/ stegs 'og ༵ ༵ 3phyi nang gi

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nyer spyod bshams/ gter chen gyi gshom bkod la/ mdun du las dkyil ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi khrag chang gis chag chag gdab cing dur khrod sol gyis nag por byas pa'i steng du tshangs zur gyi thig gdab/ lte bar cha phran gnyis/ mu khyud cha phran gcig rtsibs cha chen gcigardo na cha phran gcig me ri cha chen gcig lte bar chos 'byung la/ nub kyi tshangs thig dang skor thig dang 'dzoms pa nas lte bad tshad la bskor thig dang po'i gnas g.yon du byu rjes btsal/ shar gyi tshangs thig nas bskon/ thig nang man bya rjes btsal te gdabs/ tshon ni/ gru gsum mthing / zla gam dmad/ myu khyud thod phreng dkar/ rtsibs brgyad sngo/rtsibs mchan dmar/ rdo ra ser/ me ri dman/ ma ṭi sngo skya mgo lho nub tu bstan pa/lte ba dang rtsibs brgyad kyi hūṃ dgu'i rang mdog byas pa'i dbus su ma ljo che ba la/ gdan 'khor gyi lte ba'i yig mgo nub tu phyogs pa'i steng du lhags snod du nas nag sran ma bra bo sogs bsres pa'i rjen btags la bdud rtsi lnga lug dang 'phyi ba ma gtogs pa'i khrag sna dang chang gis sbus pa'i gton zor zun gsum rno dbal can khru gang las mi chung ba lto khra can/gtso bo'i sum cha'i tshad du skebs pa'i 'khor rang 'dra brgyad pa'i mtshams su khrag kong sogs bcad kha phyin bstan gyi mtheb kyu khrag gis byugs pa'i bskon ba/ de bzhin du rtsibs steng du sgod so so'i mthil du ma gtor ba'i 'khor lo gyen bstan du bkram pa'i khar dpal brgyud po gtso bo'i gtor ma las lnga cha'i dman pa dang / de las bka' sdod lnga cha'i dman pa/ rang 'dra'i 'khor ma mo la lnga gzhan rnams la bzhi bzhis bskor ba'i mtshams su khrag kong sogs gong ltar/ gton rgyan me ri mtshe yungs/ rtsangs dmar rgyu zlon sogs kyis brgyan thams cad la sku rtsangs dgu re/ lcags ri'i khar che mchog la rtsangs re bzhi/ 'khor rnams la nyer brgyad re/ so so'i srog shing gi rtsen khyung so so'i lto 'khon gtso bo la rgyas/ gzhan rnams la lto 'khon chung ba re bcas 'khon lo so so'i srog yig mgo gyen bstan byas nas lte ba'i srog shing gi rtsed dkris pa'i phyi nas bya khyung mthing nag g.yas g.yon gshog sgro lnga lnga/ mjug sgro brgyad sogs mtshan nyid tshang ba/ gtso bo khyung mthing / shan dang shar lho dkar/ lho dang lho nub ser/ nub dang nub byang dmar/ byang dang byung shar ljang gu byas pa'i lto bar khyung 'khod 'ong ba byu/ mchu byung ni khyung dbus khyung se rgod/ de bzhin zangs shar dang sngon lho/ chu shing nub/ tsa ldan byung / glang ma lho/ seng sding lho nub/ gla ba nub byang /skyer ba byung shar de so so'i sngags byang bris pa btags/ lho byung ni khyung so so'i lto ban ka ba ra ḍi~X khyud pa rgyas bsdus gnyis ka dang / gzhan brgyad la re re bcas khyung gi lto ba'i

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lag len gsal byed me long bzhugs so/ /ngos su spyan/ gtso khyung la ral byang gshog byung mjug byang sogs kha byung ltar la gshog byang g.yas yig mgo thur bstan dang / g.yon lhan bstan byed/ gtso khyung gi phrag gong g.yas gshog la mdun du rgyab g.yas bcas pan stag pa'i khram shing gsum dang / g.yon gshog mdun du rgyub g.yon bcas par glang ma'i khram shing gsum ste so so'i sngags bris pa gsum re 'phyan stabs/ mjug mar skyen ba'i khram shing sngags bris pa bcas tshon sgyus byugs pa btsugs la gtso bo'i gtor ma'i sbog shing gi rtser bskyon pa'i rgyab nas smyug ma sogs kyi sgrom gyi rtse mon gtso bo'i rgyal mtshan gtor gdugs mthing khra/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'khor ni khyung gi lto 'khor yin phyir 'di'i mtshams gtso bo'i khyung gshog tsam stong bar bzhag pa'i
