mjug ma'i thad kar 'phrin las 'khor lo 'ong pan byu khyung gi g.yas g.yon dang 'grigs pa'i sgyug ma rgya gram du byas pa'i rtser g.yas su pho rgyud 'khor lo dang / g.yon du mo rgyud 'khor lo btsugs/ gtor chen gyi rtser sku rten tsakhri/ g.yas su che mchog gi bsrung bzlog rgyab sprod can bzlog 'khor mdun bstan dang / g.yon du spyi zlog mtshon cha can btsugs/ steng na bsrung ba sprin chen 'khod lo'i lte ba'i hūṃ gi mgo mdun bstan dang bde gshegs bka' 'khor sprags pa'i gdugs dbub pa'i steng du bsrung skud bzhag gtod chen gyi rgyab ngos smad chad gru gsum brus pa'i nang du bsad bzlog gi 'khor lo mtshon ltebs su byus pa byad thag sngo dman gyis skud sne srog yig rgyab tu bzhag nas byin ka log tu rgyu gram bcings/ slar yang phyogs kyi rtse mo rnams nas dkris te byad thag gi sne mo lika'i mgo nas phyir dpyangs pa mgo slob dpon la phyogs pan btsugs pa'am/ yang na ma lha'i kan spyi'i bsad 'khor rtsibs rtser nang bstan rtsibs drug 'khor lo gyen bstan du brtsegs pa'i khar bsad 'khor spubs/ de'i khar gdan 'khon gyi steng du gtor ma bzhag kyang chog dpal brgyad por smyug ma'i sgrom gyi rtser so so'i rgyal mtshan khyung mdog dang mtshungs pa'i gtor gdugs bsrung bzlog 'khor lo rgyab sprod byas pa'i bzlog 'khor nang bstan brtsigs/ so so'i srog shing la khyung bskyon pa'i 'og tu so so'i sku rten tsakhri gzugs/ bka' sdod la 'khon brgyad rgyal mtshan gtor gdugs sngo skya/bsrung bzlog 'khod lo bcas sngar ltad dang / dpal brgyad bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i gtod ma'i smad chad ling rkyang re sngad ltan bcug bca' bshams bsdus pa khyung gcig ma'i tshe gtor chen gyi mthad dpal brgyad kyi gton mas bskor zhing / bsrung bzlog gi 'khor lo tsakhri sogs sngar ltar la khyung gcig la lto byang mchu byang sogs 'dogs pa ma gtogs 'dra'o//bka' sdod gtor ma byang shar/ bka' brgyad po'i phyed kyi ma ka'i steng du dzod2/35ba kyu

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bdun brgya nyer lnga'i grangs ni/ che mchog lha tshogs sum cu rtsa gnyis/ yang dag lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ 'jam dpal lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa dgu/ rta mgrin lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ phur pa'i lha tshogs bdun cu rtsa gnyes/ ma mo'i lha tshogs bdun cu rtsa gnyis/rig 'dzin lha tshogs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ mtshod bstod lha tshogs sum cu rtsa gnyis/ drag sngags lha tshogs nyi shu tham pa/ bka' sdod lha tshogs nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gcig bcas bdun brgya nyer lnga'i mtheb kyu lha tshogs so so dang / khyung gcig ma'i che gtor chen gyi mthar rdo ra'i steng du dbang mo nyer brgyad kyi skong zon rtsangs btsugs pa/ shan du dkar mo bdun/ lhon sen mo bdun/ nub tu dmar mo bdun/ byang du nag mo bdun te bcas phyogs ma log par bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shad du bde gshegs zhi ba'i gtor ma zlum po padma sgal tshig ma bzhi'i bskor ba'i mtshams su ril bu re/ de'i g.yas su khyung gtor dpal gtor 'dra ba 'khon nang 'dra brgyad can g.yon du dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i gtor ma/ de gsum gyi g.yas g.yon tu sman raka gnyis sgron thun dang bcas pa/ lhor rgyas pa'i gtor ma gru bzhi padma khrag nyag ma bzhis bskor ba ser po/ shar lho nas rim pa bzhin dza gad kyi bum pa shing lo'i kha rgyan can/ zla gam ni padma 'dab bzhi'i steng gor leb kyi steng du nyi ma dmar po zla ba dkan po kha sbyar gyi steng rdo rje rtse lnga ba nyi zla sogs rgyan spras can/ tshe zan bum gzugs ril bus bskor ba'i khar rgya gram dang nyi zla sogs rgyan spras can dmar spreng gi rakta bcas nub tu dbang gi gtor ma dpal gton mdun zla gam dbyibs padma mchu ring bzhis bskor ba byang du drag po'i gtor ma zur gsum kri ris can 'khor rang 'dra brgyad kyis bskor ba/ zod rdzas ni/ skong zor la rgyu phung brul dud khrod g.yul bkyed dul 'dre can sogs phung ba sna tshogs dug sna dang lung dgu'i chus sbrus pa'i kong bu zun gsum spyo dpangs son bzhi ba gdengs kha gyen bstan ka ba can bzhi'i nang du/ ru mtshon/ stag pa'i pho khram rdo rje can/ glang ma'i mo khrim padma can/ yul mkhan shing ris/ mda' khri 'phang khra/ skyen ba'i rtsangs phun/phun bu g.yab dar btags pa/ nal gri/ bal rgyang / bal rgyang nam mkha'/ tshon skud sna lnga'i byud thag mche yungs kan/ phung shul gyi sa/ rabs chad khang ba'i dud pa/ sha sna khrag sna/ sbang ma rta tshil/ dpal 'bad/ lung dgu'i sa dang chu sna/ zangs lcags phye ma/gri bo'i shal ma1 yugs sa'i don ma/ phab rtsi/ dug sna ram gyi phyi mo ste shing ram du grags pa/ gu gul/ dred mong sbar rjes sa/ skyer tsher/ 'bru sna/ thun rdzas/ sho chung /ba nga ༵ḍi6sa rngo / mi kha'i rdzas ni/ btso tshur/ zhu mkhan/ sha nu/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lag len gsal byed me long bzhugs so/ /gsob sgong nga / nam/ skag bra bo/ sbang ma/ so ba/ nyung ma/ zwa lo/ du ba/btsong / la phug sgog skya/ g.yer ma/ skra bshad/ 'bab cha/ ze long / sga skya rnams na grod kyis btum pa rnams/ tshang bad bsags pa'i kong zon bzhi/ srin zhal bkod pa'i gtod zon bzhi/ 'ug pa khra pho nog srin bya bzhi'i sgros brgyan pa'i mda' gri can lcags kyi mde'u btsugs pa/ dme khrag dang dug chus byugs shing drag sngags dang po lnga ba bzhi dang / mi rtsibs kyi gzhu zhing dus kyi drangs dang bcas pa zhing thigs kyi mthil dang yug skra'i 'jag can khrag zon ni thod pa mtshan ngan nam/ ma 'dzoms na rgyu dbyibs sogs gong dang mtshungs pa'i skong bu'i nang du khrag sna tshogs tshad khrag rlon gyis bran pa bzhi/ mchod pa ni/ rgyas pan lha grangs dang min kyang phyogs bzhir zhi mchod g.yas bskon dang drag mchod g.yon bskon byas bshams/ bsdu na/ byang shan du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du khrig gi marghaṃ/ shar lhor dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ lhor dbang po'i me tog lho nub tu sha chen gyi spos ring / nub tu zhu chen dang 'bru mar gyi mar me/ nub byang du mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ byang du sha chen gyi sbags pa'i zhal zas bcas g.yas bskor du bshams/ stegs bu'i mthar stag lpags dngos sam de'i ri mo bkra ba'i dkyil 'khor sgab dkri bya'o/ / las phran gyi skor ni/ khro bcu'i rdzas bzlog la/ lcags slang du zan gyi nya bo bcu zan la nya mkhris bsre ba'i nya chung bcu/ zan la mchod rten rnying pa'i sa bsres pa'i btsun chung bcu/ zan la rang ngam yon bdag gi za 'phro bsres pa'i mtheb kyu bcu/ zan la yos tshig bsres pa'i mi mo bcu/ kham par dung bsres pa'i sho chung bcu/ skyer ba'i phur bu g.yab dar btags pa bcu/zan la rin chen bsres pa'i bum pa bcu/ zan la sbang ma bsres pa'i bzhang chung bcu/zan la mi mo nal can bcu bcas ma 'dres par bkod/ rnga mong khyung gzhon gyi rdzas ni/ sa spyin bzang por rnga mong gi sha dang pags pa dus pa spu rnams bsres pa'i dug khrag gis sprus pad rnga mong gi gzugs skye mched dod pan byas pa'i dpral ban skyes pa stag chas can dgu/dpung ba g.yas su sngags pa thal mo rdeb pa dgu/ dpung ba g.yon dge slong thal mo rdeb pa dgu/ dpyi g.yas byis pa 'ur thogs dgu/ g.yon du bud med dud mo rdeb pa dgurtsibs logs g.yas la bon po btso 'phen dgu rtsibs logs g.yon la ngar klud rkang dmar dgu/ rgyab steng du bag zan la bya khyung nag po'i ral ban dred mong sbar 'dzings bcu gsum/g.yas kyi ga thog sgro lngar dang por seṅge 'brug 'thab/ gnyis par stag seng 'dzings pa/gsum pa bud med ral 'dzings/ bzhi ba dbyeg gi nor bu/ lnga bar ri sdeb bye ༵ched kang /

sa / nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/g.yon gyi gshog dang por/ rgya mtsho sprul 'khyil/ gnyis par stag mo mkhar mchong /gsum par bya rgod sder 'dzings/ bzhi bar g.yu sha sngon po/ lnga bar gri mdung hpha bya g.yu sgong lcags ser mjug sgro brgyad la bse sgong ngar glud dgu rnams bris pa/ lto bar lto 'khor che chung gnyis ka blteb srog yig mgo mjug ma log par bcug de dag gi mthar skong zon bcu gsum/ so sor rtsa phur re btsugs pas bskor/ ra grod du chu sna dgu byugs pa btab cing khrag gis ka mig bris la rnga mong rke la btags dkyil 'khor gyi lho nub tu bkod/ srin mo za lam gyi rdzas ni/ nas sran ma/ bra bo rnams kyi ngar phye zan du byas pa cha gsum du bgos pa cha gcig la mi mo dmar nag ral ba can/ dar nag gi gos spyon pa mtshan ma bsgrad pa g.yas gton zon dang g.yon skong zor thogs pa/ nu ma 'phyang zhing khro tshul rngam brjid thod skam sogs kyis brgyan pa gcig cha gcig la skong zor khrag gis bkang ba bcu gsum dang /cha gcig la du gtor dmar po gru gsum rtsangs phur btsugs pa bcu gsum byus pa'i mi rgo'i mthar spal dman bkod/ ded sha sna khrag sna rin po che dang sman phud nya mkhris rnams kyang sdud pa ra'i g.yang gzhi'i steng du dkyil 'khon gyi byang du bkod/ glud bcos pa ni/ zangs ma rin po che'i snod du 'bru sna'i ngar phye la glud gzugs skye mched dod pa khru gang las mi chung bar yon bdag gi gos dri ma can gyis g.yogs pa/ bza' bca' btung ba dkor nor tshogs tshad kyis bskon/ nam mkha' rgyang bu/ mda' khra/ 'phang khra sogs kyis brgyan pa dkyil 'khor gyi shar lhor bkod/ bong zhon ma bca' thabs khungs gsal kha ma rnyed kung /dpe ris snod gcig tu 'dre mo nag mo gcen bu zhing lhags kyi gos can/ bong shā pa kha dkar ldags bka' ba la zhon pa/ g.yas khram shing g.yon mtshe dang mchan khung g.yon par nad rkyal can/ mdun du spyang ki ngu ba/ mon mo glu len/ g.yon du spre'u gar byed/ rgyab du wa mo brgyal ba/ spyi bor 'ug pa 'khun pa byus la dkyil 'khon gyi nub byang du bkod/ las phran rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mi shong na gang 'os su bzhag chog 'brub khung du lid lnga tshan ltebs bcings byas pa sngar gtod chen gyi smad char gzhug rgyu dang 'dra ba bkod pa'i steng du dgra bo nang gi zag rdzas bdud rtsi lnga gang 'byor ram sha nya sha bu ram sbrang ril re zas lnga bsres ba'i zan ling bcas dar nag gis bkab/ bsgral chas ni snod du don brgyad ma'i bsgral chas/ lcags kyu thang khrom gu gul ma lnga dbye ba'i rdzas gu gul nag po/ dri chen/ mi tshil/ khyi lud/ yugs sa'i zhabs ma/ mdze bo'i lham 'bol/ mi zi nag po glang gi ra ba mi ༵'i ༷༷ bu 'am phur ma/ bya nog dang 'ug pa'i sgro/ sgrol gri/ snod gcig tu

bka' brgyad bde gzhegs 'dus pa'i lag len gsal byed me long bzhugs so/ /dbab rdzas yungs dkan nag dang mi rgod kyi lag pa/ 'ching rdzas yugs skra dang ban bun gyi lag nas byung ba'i tshon skud spun man dkris pa/ sgod gcig tu btsan dug da dug spyon pa'i khrag thang khrom 'bras bu'i khu ba rnams khrig dang sbyan ba'i dug khrag phur bu gzi byin bskyed rdzas gu gul yungs dkan rakta/ thun mdun man/ lcags phud/ rakta1 yungs kan kong bu/ mtshe'i phon po/ dug sna tshogs tshad/ lcags phye rbab rdo'i phye ma sgod so son bkod pa/ lcags phur/ ral gri/ tho ba/ hom gzad/ skam pa/ snod gcig tu lcags phye zags phye rdo phye gsum/ gzhan yang spyi'i thun rdzas snod gcig tu yungs dkan nag sko tse/ shing tshe/ lcags zangs phye ma/ mi bsad rbab rdo'i phye ma dug khrag gis ngar btab pa'i khar dad nag bkab pa sogs 'du bya'o/ / 'din dgos pa'i rdzas dang yo byad thams cad lhag chad dang go rim sogs rang bzo gzu lum du ma song bar gsang ba spyi'i phyag bzhes rnam dag gi yig cha dang mthun pan 'du byas la/ yol ba sogs kyis brgyan pad bya'o/ /slob dpon gyi mdun du g.yon nas rim bzhin/ nang mchod khebs ldan gyi gdan bcas/dril gdan la rdo rje dril bu/ g.yab dan nag po/ rkun chen gyi lag pa dad sna btags pa/ḍa ma du/ nas bzed thun nye/ sgrub phur gdan bcas bsgrigs/ nye logs su tshogs gtor tshogs rdzas/ chad tho bstan ma/ gshegs gton la rgyas pan pho brgyud mo brgyud gnyis dang bsdu na gtod spungs thin raka dang bcas pa/ chos skyong gi zod bskul ba'i grangs/ dkar bgegs bcas bshams/ nyin tha ma la/ yang thog tu cog tse khebs ldan gyi dbus su yi dam gyi g.yas su bla ma g.yon du chos skyong gtor spungs g.yas g.yon sman rakamadun du lha mo bdun tshan gtor ma ni snod gcig tu rgyas par byed na dmar gtor gru gsum dkan rgyan can nyer brgyad/ bsdu na gru gsum dmar po bzhi la so sor mtheb kyu drug re spyar/mdun nyer sbyod bcas bshams/ gzhan yang dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang par bya'o/ /zhes bka' brgyad bde bshegs 'dus pa'i lag len gsal byed me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ reb kong sngags mang gi gtor bzo ba rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ nyang sngags bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am snang mdzad rdo rjer 'bod pas/ bla ma'i phyag len dang gsal byed lag len smin gling zhe chen ring skya sogs kyi zin bris rnams la gzhi byus rang bzos ma bsgad par/ rwang gnas bkra shis chos gling nas sbyar ba'o/ /'di yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyan du 'gyur bar gyur cig / dge legs 'phel/

sa / 1nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtsho/ /rta 5ga yid bzhin non bu'i zhi ba'i spyin sreg ye shes me 'od ces byu ba bzhugs so/ /nab 'byums rgyal kun 'dus zhal pad 'byung dang / /dbyen med skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang / /byang chub ban du rigs kyi bdag pon bsten/ /bdag sogs 'gro la byin rlabs dngos grub stsol/ / rgyal kun gsung gi 'phrin las byin za'i mes/ /nyon mongs bla dī 'i zha ༵lunga~X zhin du sdu/nga gi/ lha/ / rta phag yid bzhin non bu'i sbyin sreg gi/ / cho ga de la 'dir rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byu ba'i tshul la gsum/dkyil 'khor bri ba/ yo byad bshams pa/ cho ga dngos so/ / dang po dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ sngar ma sbyangs pa'i sa yin na sa chog byas la stegs bu mda' gang la tshangs zur gyi jig spyi ltar btab pas thig skud khru phyed kyi zlum por bskon ba thab kyi nang dang / de la son bzhi bzhi bsnan te bskor bas mu ran kha khyer dang / de'i phyi nol du sor do bsnan te dbus tshad kyi tshangs thig nas zur thig la bya rjes btsal la gru bzhir bcad pa stegs bu'i thig go / thab kyi dbus su padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga ba dang kha khyer la rdo rje zeng bas bskon ba/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse nang bstan bri/ mu ran gyi steng du tsa ldan dkar po shug pa sogs 'o ma can gyi shing ngam srog chags med pa'i ba glang gi lci ba skam pos bud shing rmyam po brtsigs pa'i me tshang ting lo dang bcas pa bzhag go /gnyis pa ni rang kha shar du phyogs pa'i gdan gyi g.yas su bsregs jos/ 'o ma can gyi shing lnga dngos su mi 'byor bas tshab dung ba lu shug pa lcang skya 'om bu kham bu ste lnga bo gang rigs kyi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i yam shing sbom phra mthe'u chung gi tshad srid du son brgyad pa'am bcu gnyes pa rtso rtse mar khus sbags pa gang mang / me srog 'dzin pa'i jos mar khu/ til/zho zan/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ du rlu/ ku sha/ yungs dkar/ shing togakhyad par ba'i rdzas me tog sna tshogs 'bru sman dad zab bsres pa/ ko yu stod ja sbyar ba'i so rtsi/ gos zung dkar po sogs rdzas rnams so sor 'jig rten pa dang 'das lha so son cha bgos te bshams/ thab kyi g.yon du 'das ma 'das kyi dkar gtor zum po pad 'dab bzhi ba che chung gnyis/ sman raka nyer spyod lnga tshan gnyis bcas steng 'og gam rgyab mdun du bsgrigs/ mdun du me yol la gangs ri mtsho bcas baṃ yig gis mi 4 0 pa me dug gzhil ba'i phyir kha phar bstan pa'i nang lhog tse'i khar las bum/ rdo dril gyi ban

rta phag gi zhi ba'i sbyin speg ye shes me 'od bzhugs so/du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba/ ḍa ma ru/ 'thor nas/ dpal 'bar/ rlung g.yab/ kha khyer la bkram rgyu'i ku sha brgyad sogs ma tshang ba med pan bshams/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na nab/ yang na snan gtor rakta nyen spyod tshogs chad bstan sogs bshams pa la brten te/ bdag gi rnal 'byor gyi ngang nas las byang gzhung bsrang nas bzlas pa tshogs kyi bar btang / gsum pa cho ga dngos ni chas gos dkan po dang ldan pas 'khod la ngag bsdams/ las bum bsangs sbyangs/ las bum du skad cig gis bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zen 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas sku'i cha thams cad nas dag byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bad gyur/ yo badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces brgyu bzlas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas sha lha'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/sku gsung thugs ldan mnyam nyid bdud rtsi 'khyilaḥ dug gsum bdud rtsir bsgyur mdzad sman pa'i mchogaḥ bdud rtsi lta bu'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'iḥ khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan pan gyunaḥ zhes sgrub/ rdor dril byin rlabs ni/ rdo rje thogs la/ hūṃḥ mi 'gyur thugs kyi rdo rje niḥ thugs kar rtag tu bsten byus lasaḥ thugs kyi ye shes rdo rje yinaḥ gson bas gdon bgegs thams cad 'jomasaḥ yo āḥhūṃ badzra tiṣṭha dzā na sa ma ye swā hwaḥ zhes thugs kar gson/ dril bu la/ hūṃḥ shes rab dbyings kyi sgra sgrogs paḥ mtshan ma'i dngos po sgrogs mthar stongaḥ srid gsum nang bzhin nyid kyi ngangaḥ dngos po thams cad stong nyid ngangaḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ thu ku la sto ri gas āḥhūṃḥ ḍa ma du la/ hūṃḥ rnal 'byon mchog gi ḍa ma duḥ yul nyid ma skyes chos kyi dbyengasaḥ 'dzin rtog bral ba'i ye shes kyiḥ theg chen chos kyi sgra chen sgrogasaḥ yo ā:hūṃ dharma ḍa ru hūṃ hūṃḥ rdor dril dang bcas blugs gzar thogs la/ yoḥ thabs kyi nol ba las byung ting 'dzin gyiḥ dpa' bo rdo rje snod mchog g.yas su thogasaḥ yo āḥhūṃ hūṃ tīḥ.āḥ yo khri shi nod bi shu ta ye sru hwaḥ g.yon pas dgang gzar thogs la/ āḥ shes rab bde stong dga' bzhi snyoms 'jug giḥ dpa' mo zab lam chos 'byung g.yon du thogasaḥ yo hūṃ lī ka hūṃ te yo e shi tri tra ti shu swā hāḥ zhes kha sbyar/ de nas mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las las mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod yon gyi 'od zer spro bar gyur//mo badzra arghaṃ āḥhūṃ sogs shasta āḥhūṃ ma hwa pa lha rakta bha li rto āḥhūṃ lag gnyis rdo rje rtse gcig gi phyag rgyas rdzas rnams la g.yas bskor du reg pas yo yo swā hwaḥ yo āḥswā hwaḥ yo shī sru hwaḥ oṃ dzi sta hāḥ yo ku nu ku nu swā hāḥ yo āḥhūṃḥ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab po/ /de nas dpal 'bar gyi mes brtsen pa bsangs sbyangs ye shes kyi me lce 'od gsal bar gyur / 2༵ 1badzra pa la

ra / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dzwa la hūṃḥgis brlabs nas me tshang gi mdun nas bskor bas mdun du bcug ste sbar la rlung g.yab kyis g.yab cing / hūṃ shar gyi phyogs nas me sbar masaḥ dri za'i lag nas me longs laḥ zhi ba'i me ni sban bar mdzodaḥ lho nub mtshams nas shing 'thu masaḥ rlung lha'i yul nas shing 'thus laḥ rlung gi lha mos rlung g.yob cigaḥ oṃ asne ye dzwa la re jiḥ zhes brjod/ oṃ ma sde ye snya hāḥ lan gsum gyis me gso/ me thab bsangs spyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung zla ba chu shel gyi dang bzhin dkar zlum dwangs shing dri ma med pa'i 'od zed 'phro ba/kha khyer rim pa gsum ldan gyi mchun pad 'dab brgyad pa/ grwa bzhin zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs spu rdzogs pa'i nang du me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la re yig las byung ba'i drang sbong me lha dkan gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ril ba spyi blugs dang g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bgrang phreng 'dzin pa drang srong gi chas can ra skyes la gnas pa 'khor tshogs du mas bskor ba'i spyi bor yo/ mgrin par āḥthugs kad hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi me lha 'khon dang bcas pa spyan drangs par gyur/ me dar dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas g.yab cing / oṃ tshun byon tshud pyon 'byung bo cheḥ me lha'i spyol bo drang srong mtshogaḥ bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad duḥ'abar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ oṃ asne ye a karsha ya dza dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ kun thogs te/ yo ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dgeḥ tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yinaḥdakon mchog gsum po mnyes byed paḥ sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snyingaḥ bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad niḥ zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol snya hāḥ zhes thab kyi mthar bkram/ oṃ a sde ye sa pā ri wa na arghaṃ pra titsu ye snya hāḥ mchod yon dang / de bzhin du pa kyi spyan ba'i zhabs bsil phul/ yo ma sde ye sa ma ya snyiḥ zhes dam la bzhag dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med pad gyud/ yo a sde ye sa pā ri wa da pukhre nas sha lha'i ban gyis nyen spyod 'bul1 hūṃ gzi brjid chen po me yi lhaḥ 'dod pa thams cad gsal mdzad paḥbadag gzhan don sgrub sa la bzhugs: 'dzin byed me lha nyid la bstodaḥ ces bstod/byon skyems ni/ dgang blugs kha la hūṃ yig mtshanaḥ me lha cung zad zhal gdangs pa'iḥljags la ji yig gis mtshan pasaḥbasreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyuraḥ yo asne ye swā hāḥzhes lan bdun gyis bkang ba'i dgang gzan kha sprad pa g.yas su bskor la yo a sde yeḥ a ti byuḥpa ti zaḥ a be sha ya ma hwa shī ya ha bee ka bee pā ha na ye sga hwaḥ 'dod gsol/ bdag cag dpo1 slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sha sto ku du sa sgyu2 ka 2 bzhes lan gsum phul/ de nas yam shing phul la/ yo ma sde ye a ti byeḥ sogs

rta phag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ye shes me 'od bzhugs so/ /me lha'i sngags mthar/ yo bo dhi srid ye bdag cag sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang khyad pan du gzi brjid phun spem tshogs pa la bad tsā gcod pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye snya hwaḥbasnyen pa'i kha skong la/ bdag cag sogs mi mthun pa' phyogs thams cad dang khyad pan du ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing bzlas brjod lhag chad du gyur pa dang sogs bsgyur ba thams cad la 'dra/mar khu la/ me lha'i sngags dang / yo mad ye bdag cag7 khyad pad du 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la7 til la/ yo sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra yeḥ bdag cag〉 sdig sgrib zhi ba la7zho zan la/ yo sarba saṃ bha te/ bdag cag7 bde ba mchog la7 'bras la/ yo badzra pus ye/bdag cag7 dpal 'byod phun sum tshogs pa7 so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dza yeḥ bdag cag〉 non dang 'bru phun sum tshogs7 nas la yo ma hwa be ga yeḥ bdag cag7 myur ba'i shugs 'phel ba la7 sran ma la/ yo ma hā ba la yeḥ bdag cag〉 stobs rgyas pa la〉 gro la/ yo badzra ga sma riḥ bdag cag7 nad zhi bar byed pa la7 dun la/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣeḥbadag cag7 tshe phun tshogs〉 ku sha la/ yo a pra ti ha da badzra yeḥ bdag cag7 mi mthun pa'i bsrung ba phun sum tshogs pa〉 yungs dkan la/ yo sarba mtho sa dha yeḥ bdag cag7gdon bgegs 'joms pa la7 shing tog la/ yo badzra ṣe wa yeḥ bdag cag7 rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa〉 khyad par ba la/ yo ku du ku du sru hwaḥ bdag cag7 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sha sto ku du ye swā hāḥ de nas/yo a sde ye ma lha sogs dang ma hā pa lha rakta bha lidha khri nyiḥ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad gsal mdzad pa/ /bdag gzhan don sgrub sa la bzhugs/ /'dzin byed me lha nyid la bstod/ / 'dod gsol ni/ hoḥ drang srong chen po khyed la phrin las su bcol ba ni bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor 'khon dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i dgra gnod pa'i bgegs/ gdug pa'i mtshon/ spyod ba'i dug nad bzhi brgyu rtsa bzhi/gdon stong phrag brgyad cu/ ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu/ thi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/mtshan ma ngan pa/ sbyon ba lhab pa/ lo zla zhag keg mo ngan rtsis tsub/ mi kha bram mchu la sogs pa mdod na bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol sha sto ku ru ye swā hwa/ blugs gzar gyis mar khu 'bul zhing yo badzra dzwa la ji me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/de nas bud shing bsnan nas bsang chu 'thon la/ ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klongaḥ hūṃ las ye shes pho brang gsalaḥ rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'iḥ gru bzhi sgo bzhi brtsigs pa lngaḥzhes pa nas/ rtsa gsum lha la phyag 'tshal loḥ na mo pu du sha ya hoḥ zhes pa'i bar las byang bzhin dang / yo padma ma hā kro dha arghaṃ pra titsu ye swā hwa/ oṃ padma ma hā kro da pa hūṃ ༵ ci na swā

ra / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigasahwaḥ zhes pas mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul la bzhugs gsol bya/ byon skyems ni/ dgang blugs ka la hūṃ yig mtshan/ / dkyil 'khod lha tshogs ljags la yang / / hūṃ yig dag gis mtshan pa las/ / bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur/ / dgang blugs mar khu rtsa sngags bdun gyis bkang la/ yo padma ma hwa kro dha ma ti sgyuḥ pa ti sgyuḥ ma be sha ya ma hā shrī ya ha bee ka bee pa ha na ya swā hwaḥ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ 'dod gsol/ bdag cag rgyu sbyon 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen ngan phyi nang gi bad du gcod pa dang bsnyen sgrub mi gsal zhing bzlas brjod lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad sha sto ku du ye swā hwa zhes yungs dkar 'thor/ de nas bsregs rdzas 'bul ba ni/ dgang blugs thogs la/ hūṃ a yig dang byung me hom duḥ ka yig byang chub bdud rtsi'i rgyunaḥ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug giḥ bde ba chen po'i mtshod pa 'bulaḥ byung chub shing dang rtsi mngar bcudaḥ 'bru sna zas mchog til du rluḥ dar zab sman sna rin chen sogasaḥ 'dod dgu'i jos mchog ma lus paḥye shes lnga yi rang bzhin bcudaḥ thogs med nam mkha' mdzod bzhin duḥ gus pas blo yis 'bul legs naḥ gnyis su med par bzhes nas kyangaḥ nad gdon sdig sgrib dgra bgegs sogasaḥ mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzodaḥ de nas yam shing la/ oṃ badzra krodha pa te pa te hūṃ phaṭaḥ oṃ bo dhi prikṣa ye/ sogs yam shing nas shing tog dang khyad par ba'i bar gong ltan 'bu' / de yang rgyus par byed na lha sngags rdzas sngags 'dod gsol bcas la grangs 'dzin/'bring thog mtha' gnyis la lha sngags 'dod gsol dang / bar du lha sngags dang rdzas sngags la grangs 'dzin/ tha ma thog mtha' gnyis la lha sngags rdzas sngags 'dod gsol re dang lha sngags kho nas 'bul ba'o/ /yang na bsreg rdzas rnams bsres nas lha sngags kyis phul na yang chog cing / bsnyen sgrub kyi bcu cha'i kha skong du til kho na phul bas tshar bcu re'i mtshams su 'dod gsol byas mas tshar bsags pas 'thus/de nas yo badzra khri bu la ye swā hāḥ zhes so rtsi phul/ yo badzra was twa ye sgyu hāḥzhes gos zung 'bul lo/ /mthar mar khu lan gsum dang / bhāḥbla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro laḥ sogs mchod pa'i mjug tu/ gtor ma sman raka bcas sngags tshig gis dgang gzar gyis 'bul/ de nas snya na tsakra snu dza kha hi zhes tshogs phul 'bul/ jiḥ chos sku skye med ngang nyid lasaḥ sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams sku mdog kunda ltar dkan ba'i thugs ka'i sngags zeng zla ba'i 'od zer lta bu 'phros pas bdag sogs kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs ma lus pa zhi bar gyud/ tsho sngags kyi mjug sharnyi ku du ye snya hāḥ btags pa brgya rtsa bzla/ mchod bstod byu/ hoḥ dkyil 'khon gyi lha tshogs rnams la 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ bdag cag sogs gong2 ka 4 'dod don gsol/ skabs 'din mar khu 'o thug zas sna rnams thab kyi steng nas bzung la/

rta phag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ye shes me 'od bzhugs so/ /hūṃ bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i klongaḥ sogs kyis dngos thub len/ yig brgya lan gsum bzla zhing / bhāḥrtsa gsum yongs 'dus dkyil 'khon duḥ sogs kyis bzod par gsol/brtan bzhugs bya/ yo khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim pan mos/ slar yang mar khu lan gsum gyis/ oṃ badzra dzwa la re zhes me gso/me lha cha byud yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa la/ mas sde ye swā hwaḥ zhes mar khu lan gsum dang /yam shing nas bzung rdzas lhag rnams 'bul/ gtor ma dgang blugs khan bzhag pa la sngags kyis bsangs ma ka nos brlab/ me ste sreg bya za ba'i lhaḥ drang sbong rgyal bo gdon gyi bdagaḥ shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas nomasaḥ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog ces gtor ma me nang du 'bul oṃ badzra haṃ bu la ye sgyu hwa oṃ badzra was hra ye swā hwaḥ zhes so rtsi dang gos zung 'bul/ mchod bstod bya yig brgya tshan gsum dang ma 'byon ba dang sogs/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ / sgrub byed sreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji bzhin du ni tshur byon la/ / bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs/ /ya nyi ba rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a shad la thim par bsam/ me dal gyis bya 1 dī na no pha/ na bye/ da thebs sam chu klung du dor/ tshogs lhag thugs dam bskul ba sogs mthar chags su smras pa/ de ltan rta phag yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /sbyin sreg cho ga bla mas bkas gnang ltar/ /sbyar ba 'di'i dges 'gro ba'i las nyon spyangs/ / rnam mkhyen gdod ma'i sa la 'god par shog /ces rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i sbyin sreg ye shes me 'od ces bya ba 'di ni/ lha 'di'i bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol ba'i sog tsha'i ri khrod pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyis 'di lta bu zheg dgos zhes bskul ba dang /skyabs mgon 'bas dkar rdo rje 'chang rin po che'i gsung gis 'di ltar bsgrigs dgos zhes gnang ba thob pa la brten/ nyang skyes mtshams ming snang mdzad rdo rjes gter kha gong ma'i phur pa'i bsregs blugs bdud rtsi zil mngar lagazhi byas rigs mthun gyis kha cung zad bskangs te sbyan ba'o/ / sarba mad ma/

gas/ 1nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtsho/ /seng gdong gtso 'khon gsum gyi gton bzlog byu tshu' gnam lcags 'bad ba'i thog rgod bdud dpung phye man 'thag byed ces bya pe bzhugs so/ /ra / /na mo badzra seng ha mu kha ye/ skye med dbyings kyi yum chen kun tu bzang / /'gag med nol ba'i rtsal snang wa ra hi/ /sna tshogs gan bsgyun seng ha mu kha dang / /dbyer med drin can bla mar gus pas 'dud/ / mthu stobs drag stor rdo rje rtse brgya yis/ / phas rgol sbyin skyes 'joms mdzad seng gdong ma'i/ /'phang ba zor gyi lag len 'dir 'god na/ /rtsa gsum srung mas bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs/ /gsam 1 ༵/ 'den seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum pa'i 'phang sbyor gyi lag len 'god pa la spyor dngos rjes ༄ dang po sbyor ba la/ sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan zhing bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags mtshan rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gang du bya ba'i gnas su sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkrams/ stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng du dpal gyi gtor ma zun gsum gtso 'khor gsum gyi g.yas g.yon du sman raka dang chos srung gi mchod gtor bshams pa'i mdun du nyen spyod bshams/ de'i mdun du gdug pa'i sa la dug khrig gis chag chag btab pa'i no sol gyis nag pon byugs pa'i steng du chos 'byung gru gsum nag po nang dmar thu chad ljang gu zur mdun bstan gyi mthan skum bskor gnyis la rdo ra me ri bris pa'i khar ma lha'i steng du lcags snod du 'bru nag rjen 'thag gi phye las gtor ma zur gsum rdo dbal can khru gang las mi chung ba gtso 'khon gsum pa mthar bcad kham phyir bstan dang khrig gong gis bskor ba khrig gis byugs pa'i rtsang dang mtshe yungs sogs kyis bsgyun pa'i rtser gtor gdugs nag po gsum la so so'i tsaka li btsugs pa'i mthar drag po'i nyer spyod khrag gi maste dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog sha chen gyi bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi 'al zas/ rkang gling gi nol mo/ sman raka sogs bshams/ chos srung ༵ rgyud dī mas ca/da tshogs par bya da/ kar bzhegs/ zan ling thun gtor/ 1 dril rnga nol sogs mkho ba'i gnyis pa dngos ga'i la/ sngon bskal ma lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs sems ni/ hūṃ/rtsa ba gsum bdag mkha' 'gro mar/ / gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro/ / bla med byang chub la 'god phyir/ / bdud 'dul seng gdong bsgrub par bgyi/ / lan gsum/yan lag bdun pa ni/ hūṃ/ rtsa gsum ḍa khri'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag ba 2 4 du sdig bshags dge bskul rjes yi rangaḥ chos 'khor bskon bar

seng gdong gtor bzlog gnam lcags thog rgod bdud dpung phyer 'thag bzhugs so/ /gsol ba 'debasaḥ dge rtsa 'khor gsum yang dag bsngoḥ 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shogaḥ de nas dkar bgegs gnyis bshams la/ dkar gtor sbyi ltar bsngo/ bgegs gton chab kyis bran la/ re yi ka/ bgegs kyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyun/oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dgug gzhug lan gsum dang / bsdu na/ sarba ji snya 1na a karsha ya dza/ lan gsum/sarba bi snya 1na e dam ba lidha kha kha ka hi khri nyi zhes bsngos la/ hūṃ/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khon 'dir/ / sgrub la bar gcod gdon bgegs rnams/ / mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim byos la/ /'di du ma 'dug gzhan du song / /nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag pan 'gyun1 / 1ka kro dhi su sna ni———/ bsrung 'khor ni/ hūṃ/ ye shes 'bar ba'i rgyu gram guraḥ snang stong mtshon cha 'od du 'baraḥ steng 'og bar gcod 'byung bo kunaḥ bsrung ba'i 'khor los mtshams bcad doḥ badzra rakṣa hūṃḥ byin 'bebs ni/ hūṃ/ ma bcos lhun grub gsang chen klong yangs nasaḥ mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mo 'khor bcas rnamasaḥ thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ bdag la dbang bskur sgrub por byen chen phobasaḥ 1khri ni sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ mchod pa byen rlabs ni/ hūṃ/ bde chen ye shes ting 'dzin gyi/ / rnam nol las byung mchod pa'i sprin/ /sman raka gton ma nyer spyod tshogs/ /dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar spel/ /oṃ ma hwa pa lha a sbo ta rakta bha li rto pu lha āḥhūṃ/ de nas bdag mdun byer tshig gcig pas/hūṃ stong nyid dbyengs las bsrung pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus/ / e las chos 'byung mthing nag gzhal yas su/ / padma nyi ma bam no'i gdan steng du/ / hūṃ yig sngon po de las 'od 'phros pas/ /dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad tshar bcad cing / / bde gshegs rgyal ba'i byin rlabs nus mthu bsdus/ /hūṃ la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ /dbus su mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seng ge'i gdong / / g.yas su ye shes mkha' 'gro stag gi gdong / / g.yon du mkha' 'gro dom gyi gdong ba can/ / gsum ka mgrin pa man chad sbu ma dog mthing / / zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar la zlum/ / zhal gdangs lngags 'gril khro mo'i cha lugs rdzogs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang / / g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang thugs kar 'dzin/ / thu mor thabs kyi rang bzhin kha ka bsten/ / thod skam dbu rgyan zhing glang stod g.yogs byus/ / mgo greng dus spyon stag sham dur khrod chas/ / g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gad gyis bam chen brdzis1 /'khor du mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sdes bskon/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan las 'od zer 'phros/ /mkha' spyod gsang chen nol ba'i dur khrod nas/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro lha tshogs 'khod dang bcas/ / thogs med sprun drangs ༵1 7sa ma dzaḥ

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigasaspyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ sbyoḥ dus gsum rgyul ba ma lus bskyed mdzad ma/ / dam nyams dgra bgegs thal bar brlag mdzad ma/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can ma/ /bstan srung chen mo 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ / badzra sa ma ya dza/ dzaḥhūṃḥbaṃḥhoḥbazhugs gsol ni/ hūṃ dur khrod gsang chen nol ba'i gnas 'di duḥ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong 'khor bcas rnamasaḥ chos 'byung pad nyi no yi gdan steng duḥ dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan pan bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūṃ chos dbyings skye med ngang las ma g.yos kungaḥ gang 'dul zil gnon bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'iḥ dpal chen myun mgyogs mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas laḥ brkyang bskums 'gying bag gar gyis phyag mtshal loḥ sa ti pu hoḥpra ti tstsha hoḥ mchod pa ni/ dīḥchos dbyings rnam dag gzhal yas khangaḥ dur khrod pho brang dam pa 'diraḥ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bulaḥ me tog bdug spos mar me driḥ zhal zas sgra snyan phyi mchod 'bulaḥ gzugs sgra dri no reg bya sogasaḥ rang byung dbang po'i nang mchod 'bulaḥkhrig zhag dbang bo'i me tog dngaḥ gsur chen bdug spos zhun chen meḥ rdo rje dri chu mkhris pa'i driḥ dri chen paṃ sa zhal zas mchodaḥ rkang gling thod rnga glu gan dbyungasaḥbyang sems mkha' gsang bde ba'i mchogaḥ gnyis med mnyam spyor byang chub semasaḥ zhu bde lhan skyes mchod pa 'bulaḥ bdud rtsi sman dang gtor mar bcasaḥ rakta byung sems 'o ma'i mtshoḥ 'dod don tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bulaḥ dam skong dgyes pa chen pos bzhesaḥ dam sri bdud 'gong 'dul ba dngaḥ dgra bgegs thal bar brlags pa dngaḥdabang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsolaḥ seng ha 1glu ni arghaṃ — shad rū pa— sprad ma hā pa lha rakta bha li rto kha nam kha hi: bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i mthu stobs can/ / sgrub pa po la ma yis bu bzhin gzigs/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes dngos/ / 'jigs dung mkha' 'gro'i gzugs su shar ba yi/ / seng ge'i gdong can gtso 'khor rnam gsum dang / / bka' sdod bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs la bstod/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul las/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seng ge'i gdong can zhes/ / mthu dang byad sogs bgegs rigs bzlog pa la/ / mchog tu bsngags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / gdong can gnyis dang bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs/ / seng ha nu kha'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong ba dang / /bcol ba'i 'phrin la~X ༵ lus 'grub par mdzod/ / bzlas pa ni/ bdag gi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan

seng gdong gtor bslog gnam lcags thog rgod bdud dpung 3ra 'thag bzhugs so/ /steng du/ /hūṃ yig mthing nag tsha ngar me ltar 'bar/ /sngags greng mgal me g.yas su 'khor ba lasaḥ 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba mchodaḥ byin rlabs 'od 'phros bdag lus la thim pasaḥ slar yang drag sngags thog ser me stag 'phrosaḥ khams gsum bdud tshogs ma lus kun bsgral nasaḥ sgod bcud 'od zhu srid zhi'i dwangs bcud kunaḥ'od zer rnam par bdag la thim par gyuraḥ maḥkaḥsaḥmaḥrwaḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces bzlas pan byu/ bsrung dmigs ni/ rta phyugs gsal/ hūṃ/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs srog hūṃ yig gi/ /klad kon nang du bla ma dang / /khog par rang nyid gsal ba yi/ /g.yas g.yon bsrung byu pho mo dang / /mdun rgyub bu slob rta phyugs gsal/ /phyi nol rdo rje mtshon cha dang / /me dpung gis bskor gzhom med kyi/ /mi shig bsrung pa'i 'khor lor gyur/ /maḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ma ma ka wa tsi raka ku ru hūṃ zhes bzla/ bzlog dmigs ni/ hūṃ/ rang nyid bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /phyi nol bsrung ba'i 'khor los gtams/ / phyogs mtshams khro bo khro mo ni/ / mtshon cha thogs pa grangs med kyi/ /zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i sngags/ /'brug stong ldir ba ltan bzlas pas/ /pha nol dgra bgegs byad ma rnams/ /gsad bcad gtubs te brlag par gyun/ /aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥnaḥsaḥmaḥn:yaḥphaṭaḥ da na ba du ka wa tsi dka ku du hūṃ/ dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad sbyo zlog ces bzla/thal deb ni/ rang nyid seng gdong skur gsal pa'i/ /phyag gnyis nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /drag tu brdab pas dgra bgegs kun/ /thal pa'i rdul bzhin brlags par gyur/ /na mo bla ma yang dag par yongs 'dzin dge ba'i gshes gnyen rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byung chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon dam pa'i chos skyong pa'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong ba can la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byen gyis brlabs pa la brten nas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khod dang bcas pa rnams la snang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang bsam pa ngan pa sbyor ba sgyub pa thams cad phyir zlog sbyo/ lan gsum/ mkha' 'gro bye ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / dgra bgegs byud ma thams cad kyi/ / lus srog tha' ba'i rdul du rlogs/ la rna~X lte~X chos kyi

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dbyings su spor/ / lan gsum/ de nas thun gtor ni/ hūṃ/ rtsa gsum bden mthus dmigs bya dam nyams kyi/ /bla srog gtor ma 'di dang gnyis med bstim/ /pho nya'i tshogs kyis gzugs phung dum bur gtubs/ /sha khrag mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol par gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ka'i kro ti seng ha mu kha e de ba li rte kha kha khri nyi 'i nyi/ lan gsum/ hūṃ/ drag mo seng ge'i gdong can 'khor bcas kyis/ / dgra bgegs sha khrag gton ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khon dang bcas pa la/ / sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung gdon bgegs dgra/ / byud phur thod gtong chags che nyam nga kun/ / bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / ces phul dbyangs gsal zhabs bstogs ma dang yig brgya lan gsum/ oṃ snyon 1khri ni arghaṃ sogs dang / mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas —— sogs kyis bstod/skabs 'dir dmigs bsal gyi chos srung gi gtor bsngos byu/ de nas tshogs mchod ni/ hūṃ/ bdag gi thugs las sna yi ka/ /'phros pas ma dag bsregs gtod bkrus/ /slar yang 'bru gsum 'phros pa las/ / 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin tu gyud/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hri/ spyan 'dren ni/hūṃ o rgyan yul dang rnga yab glingaḥ dud khrod e yi gzhal yas nasaḥ bdud 'dul drag mo 'khor dang bcasaḥ ma lus tshogs la sprun 'dren gshegasaḥ badzra sa ma ya dza/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spros la/ dang po 'bul ba ni/ jiḥ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ / gzugs sgra dri no reg ldan pa/ / gus pas blo yis 'bul lags na/ /bzhes nas kun tu dgyes pan mdzod/ / badzra snya ṇa tsakra pu lha 'i nyi/ zhes phul/ bar ba bshags pa ni/ hoḥ 'dod yon mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis/ / bdud 'dul drag mo'i thugs dam bskang / /bdag cag mi shes 'khrul ba'i blos/ /bag med 'gal 'khrul thams cad bshags/ / yig brgya bzla/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ rgyun khyen la mdor bsdus tsam gyis chog cing 'dir ni bzlog bsad kyi las gtso bor 'don pas cung zad spro na/ dpung bsdu phyir thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūṃ sbyo/ chos dbyings ye shes drag po'i zhing khams nasaḥ skye med dbyings nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs paḥ bdud 'dul drag mo 'khon bcas dgra bgegs gshedaḥmangon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad phyir bskulaḥ bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shingaḥ rtsa gsum lha tshogs bsten cing mchod de sgrubaḥ zhing bcu dam nyams dgra bos ban du bcadaḥ re zhing ltos pa'i lha tshogs nam zlar bskulaḥ dbang mnos dam tshog bsrung ba dam ma chungaḥ bsnyen sgrub lha tshogs bsten pa chud ma zaḥ chos skyong srung ma rnams kung mthu ma chungaḥ brgyud pa'i rig 'dzin bsrung ma rtsal ma zhanaḥ yul lha gzhi ba lha~X0 kya1 bang ma bulaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub pad mdzodaḥ ces

seng gdong gtor bslog gnam lcags thog nod bdud dpung zur 'thag bzhugs so/ /bskul/ gser skyems ni/ hūṃ/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lhaḥ khyad par bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdongaḥ bka' sdod srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogasaḥ gser skyems 'di bzhes sngags 'chang mthu dpung bskyedaḥ gtsang ris dpal mgon snang srid lha klu sogasaḥ gnyug mar gnas dang glo bud lhags pa kunaḥ gser skyems 'di bzhes sngags 'chang mthu dpung bskyedaḥ sa bdag rje blon 'bangs 'khor bcas pa dngaḥ lo zla zhag dus gnas 'gyur legs nyes stonaḥ ko long sdom pa'i rigs kun gser skyems bzhesaḥru nga kun spong mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzodaḥ gzu dpang ni/ hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor kun bdag mchog gsum bla ma dang: yi dam zhi khro nab 'byams mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaḥ khyad pad bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong ཿ 'khod bcas bdag la dgongs shing gsan du gsolaḥ bdag ni zol med don gyi rnal 'byor pasaḥ ma nyes ma lan ye shes lha yi tshogasaḥ sdig can las ngan rgyal bstan spyi dgra 'disaḥ sangs rgyas bstan bshig dkon mchog dbu 'phang smadaḥ bla ma'i thugs dkrugs dge 'dun sde la bsdosaḥ khyad pan rnal 'byon bdag cag 'khon bcas laḥ snga dgra lag bdad phyi dgra bsam par 'changaḥ da dgra sbyor ba'i dgra bgegs gnod byed kunaḥ sa /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs1dgra bgegs byad ma rnams kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa gang na gnas kyang rang dbang med pad dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig sgrub sngags sham bur/ ma karsha ya dza dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'gugs gzhug nan tan byu/ pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ dzaḥkhro mo bdud 'dul seng gdong ma'i/ /las byed bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /khyed kyi dam tshog ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ / thams cad ma lus myur du khug/ lcags kyu can gyis snying nas khug / zhags pa can gyis yan lag chings/ / lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms/ / dril bu can gyis myos su chug /skad cig de ni yud tsam la/ /rang dbang med pan khrid la shog / ṇi tri badzra mdu sha dza dza/ / lha dbye ni/ hūṃ/ dbye byed las kyi pho nya'i tshogs/ / dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di'i/ / bsrung skyob byed pa'i lha dang phrol/ / gnod byed gshed ma'i bdud dang sprod/ / ṇḍi tri de ba yu tsa ta ya phaṭa/ nyes pa bsgrags pa ni/ hūṃ/ dug lnga'i dbang gyur sdig can khyod/ / bsgral ba'i zhing bcur rdo rje'i thun char gyis/ /dgra bgegs lus sems 'ben la ya/ / dgra bgegs dzwa la pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ phun thun ni/hūṃ/ bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma'i/ /sras mchog khro mo kyi lā ya/ /gdengs pa tsam gyis khams gsum 'gum/ /bsgril ba tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar/ / btab na lha yang brlag pan byed/ / dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos/ / yo badzra kyi lha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ral gri thogs la/ hūṃ/ gnam lcags ral gri tsha tsha 'phro/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro khros pa'i mtshon/ /lnga phung thal ba rdul du rlogs/ / dgra bgegs ma lus dum bur gtubs/ / sto sbyo ma da ya rbad/ces bsgral/ ling no hom gzar du btegs la/ ji yi ka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyun/ yo ā hūṃ/ hūṃ/ bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong/ / 'khor bcas rngams pa'i zhal phye la/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag dus/ /bzhes shig seng gdong gtor bzlog gnam lhags thog rgod bdud dpung zur 'a ga bzhugs so /tshogs kun tshang ba/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bskang rdzas sna tshogs kyis/ /bla ma yi dam chos srung thugs dam bskang / / mkha' 'gro seng ha mu kha'i thugs dam bskang / / 'khon tshogs bye ba 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag sos gyur nas/ /bar gcod kun sel dngos grub stsol ba dang / /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhar du bsgrub pan mdzod/ /tshogs la nol/ tshogs lhag ni/ re yi ka/ ha ho lha phe pheḥ hūṃ/ sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam lhag bzhin/ / dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi nyul ba'i/ / lhag gtor dbang ba'i srung ma rnams/ /'di bzhes bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / yo lha tsitta ba kang ta kha nyi/ lhag ma btson 'dzin byed pa'am yang na phyi nol du don/ de nas bzlog pa ni/ ling no gtor chen la 'bul zhing /hūṃ stoḥ chos dbyengs drag mo'i ye yi pho brang duḥ chos 'byung pad nyi dregs pa pho mo'i stengaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus paḥ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog bdud 'dul drag mo rtsalaḥ sku mdog mthing nag rngam brjid 'ban ba'i skuḥ seng zhal rngam pa'i sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigasaḥ phyag g.yas gri gug skye shi rtsad nas gcodaḥ g.yon pa chags med bhan dmad khrig bkang bsnamasaḥ rngam brjid dun khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis bklubasaḥ sbu ni mi bzad gar gyi nyams dgur ldanaḥ gsung gi nga no 'brug stong ltar rngam sgra: thugs ni chos dbyings spros bral snying rje'i ngangaḥ yon tan mchog thun dngos grub gter gyi mdzodaḥ 'phrin las gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i gshedaḥ bde gshegs khro mo kun gyi rje mo cheḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro mang po'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥ khyod kyis mi bzlog mi bsgyun gang yang medaḥdeng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag cag 'khor bcas kyiḥmi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad dgra bgegs kunaḥ do nub bzlog cing bsgyur pa'i 'phrin las mdzodaḥ g.yas phyogs mkha' 'gro chen mo stag gi gdong / /g.yon du mkha' 'gro dom gyi gdong ba can/ /'khon tshogs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo dam tshog can/ / phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs byud ma bod gtong bzlog / hūṃ/sngon tshe rgyal ba shāka thub kyis/ / bsam gtan bdud rtsi bsten pa'i che/ / slob dpon pra bha ha ste yis/ / khyod sbran mu stegs pham par byas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal rnga brdung / /de 'og bal yul ya nga le shod/ / grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams kyis ni/ / yang dag phyag rgya che sgrub tshe/ /bar du gcod pa sna tshogs byung / /khyod sgrub mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /de 'og bod yul mun pa'i gling / /btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /chos 'khor bsam yas bzhengs pa'i che/ / lha 'dre gdug pas bar du bcad/ / sngags 'chang padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /khyod bskul mnga' bdag bzhed pa bsgrubs/ /da lta rig 'dzin bdag ༵ḍi3 noms/ /

rtseng gdong gtor bzlog gnam lcags thog rgod bdud dpung phyer 'thag bzhugs so/ /kyi g.yul ngo zlog /mi mthun rkyen dang ban chad sol/ /'phrin las drag po'i dus la bab/ /dus la bab po las mdzod cig / hūṃ sbyoḥ phyi ni rtsang phur drag po'i nang bzhin la/ /nang du gdug zub 'ban ba'i pho nya 'phro/ / gsang ba sbu gsum ye shes don dang ldan/ /'khon 'das gnyis su med pa'i nang bzhin can/ / yar rtse chos dbyings stong pa'i dbyings su khyab/ / mar rtse gdon bgegs byad ma'i snying la gzer/ / sked pan rigs drug sems can nyi li li/ /mi sdug bshan pa sna tshogs cho 'phrul ston/ /nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pan byed/ /sprul ba'i za gsod pho nya khyed rnams kyis/ /mthun jos drag po'i mchod gton 'di bzhes la/ /sdang dgra gnod byed bgegs kyi g.yul ngo zlog /nad mug mtshon kha dus kyi 'khrug rtsod zlog /mtha' dmag rgya 'dre 'gong po'i kha rlangs zlog /nad rims gdon bgegs dus min 'chi ba zlog /mi phyugs nad yams btsa' sad ser gsum zlog /rmi ltas mtshan ngan rbad 'dre thod gtong zlog / byad kha phur kha than dang cho 'phrul zlog /gzhan gyi ngan sems mi kha bram mchu zlog / dgra 'dre byur gsum phas kyi rgol ba zlog /mdon na mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /bzlog bsgyur 'phrin las gnyan po'i dus la bab/ / sdang dgra gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du sbyo/ / sto bzlog dus la bab po sa ma ya/hūṃ stoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba niḥ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khon bcas laḥganod cing bar du gcod pa yiḥ ltas ngan brgya bcu rtsa bzhi zlogaḥ ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu zlogaḥ dus min 'chi dang 'jigs ba spyod zlogaḥ glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu zlogaḥbagegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlogaḥ gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad zlogaḥ skeg chen sum brgya drug lce zlogaḥ lha chen drag po'i gdug tsub zlogaḥ lha ma yin gyi sgyu stobs zlogaḥ mgon pos bar bu bskor ba zlogaḥ gshin rjes 'khrul 'khor bcas pa zlogaḥdrang srong bram ze'i dmod pa zlogaḥ gza' yi ki ka 'phen pa zlogaḥ btsan nad gzer kha gtong ba zlog: sa bdag klu yi mdze nad zlogaḥ brnyes 'bum bskor byed pa zlogaḥsngags pas sngags zor 'phen pa zlogaḥ bon gyis btso dmar 'phen pa zlogaḥ mu stegs ngan sngags byed pa zlogaḥ byad phud rbod gtong zug pa zlogaḥ mnan gtad bsreg 'phang byas pa zlogaḥ mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ngan zlogaḥ snga zhags mda' ltad 'phen pa zlogaḥphyi zhags gru gur 'thul ba zlogaḥ mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun zlogaḥ bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlogaḥ bsgyur no seng gdong mthu yis bsgyuraḥ zor no dgra dang bgegs la zonaḥ bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ dam rdzas mi du du ma 'di

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzhes laḥ byad dang rbod gtong bsgyur ba dngaḥ bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzodaḥ de nas thun gtor bshams la dgug gzhug bya/ rtsa sngags la gton sngags btags pas bsngos la/ sto/ drag mo seng ge'i gdong can 'khon bcas kyis/ / dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / rnal 'byon bdag cag 'khon dang bcas pa la/ / sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung gdon bgegs dgra / byad phur rbod gtong chags che nyam nga kun/ /bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub pan mdzod/ / ces dgra phyogs su 'phangs/ sgrub zhag sprel na nyin snga ma rnams la mtshams 'di nas chad bstan bro brdung nas shis brjod kyi ban bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ sgrub zhag rjogs pa'i tshe thun gtor yan grub nas/ gtor ma'i lha tshogs la bstod/ bzod gsol sges la/ gton chen gyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha/zhes tsaka lir bstems/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim/ slar yang gtod chen zor rdzas dang bcas pa skad cig gis mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mo 'khor mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can srid gsum gang ba/dgra bo sgrol ba'i las la rngams pa'i skud bzhengs par gyur/ rtsa sngags /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og na/ /sde brgyud lha klu gzhi bdag rnams/ /gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /zor lam phye la sku bzur cig /kun kyang grogs mdzod zon lam phye/ / 'khon bcas drag rgyu/ / mkha' 'gro ging dang shugs 'gro dang / / lha srin sde brgyud pho nyar bcas/ / dam can rgya mtsho sku bzhengs shig / dam rdzas gton ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byer can gyi nyams rtogs spel/ /tshe dpal dbang bsgyur mthu stobs dang / /mngon shes mkha' spyod rdzu 'phrul skyed/ /dgra bgegs gnod byed thal bar rlogs/ / gang brtsams 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ / ces bskul1 skabs 'dir chos srung rnams gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mo'i lha tshogs rnams/ / sbin las mthad phyin skye med āḥ slar yang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/bsrung 'khor dang bcas skad cig gsal/ smon lam ni/ ho/ dge za 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal zhing / /rim gnyis lam 'bras mthan phyin nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog / bkra shis ni/ byin rlabs kun 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /bdud 'dul drag mo yi dam rgya mtsho'i lha/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dī~Xn/ par/ bya'o/ shidi phyogs bcu kun tu khyab pan shog / ces shis brjod ci rigs kyis mtha' smras pa/ rgyal kun 'phrin las gnam lcags 'phrul 'khor gyis/ / phas rgol 'joms la ches dpa' bdud 'dul ma'i/ / las spyon drag sbyor rdo rje rtse brgya 'dis/ / ma dung sbyin skyes klad bum 'gem par nges/ /smin byed dbang gis rgyud smin dus grangs kyi/ /bsnyen pa rtags thon song ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /lag len yin gyi rted bkun phrag dog gis/ / bsgrungs na de yi snying khrig mkha' 'gros nol/ / de ltar 'bad pa'i mthu yi rnam dkan dges/ / rtog med ye shes gri gug non po yis/ / yid srubs bdud sde'i mgo bo nyer bcad pa'i/ / dpa' rtags gad rgyangs phyogs bcur khyab par shog /ces mkha' 'gro seng gdong gtso 'khon gsum gyi gtor bzlog bya tshul gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog rgod bdud dpung phyer 'thag ces khya ba 'di ni/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa mtshams pa dge 'dun nor bu dang / ser rgya'i ma mchod thun mong nas/ yang yang rna ba gzir ba'i rkyen gyis/ dus mtha'i sngags btsun snang mdzad rdo rjes snga 'gyur rigs mthun gyi cho ga mang po nas bsdus te nag 'gros su bkod pa 'dis kyang bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs 'byung ban gyur cig / sarba mad lo/

skyes bu chen po rdo ji legs pa'i gsol mchod 'khyer bde/ra / /skyes bu chen tho rdo rje legs pa'i gsol mchod 'khyen bde/ra / /tīḥ rnam snang thugs sprul rdo rje legs/ / gsang bdag bka' nyan skyes bu che/ /padma'i dge bsnyen dam tshig can/ /rta mgrin dbang gi gten srung mtshog /bdud kyi rgyul bo mgan ba nag / rā skyes kham pa'i gdan la nol/ / ma nges cir yang rdzu 'phrul 'gyed/ / bdud btsan ging dang sman mos bskor/ / ma thogs ring po'i tshul gyi nas/ /byon zhing brten dang bzhugs mdzod la/ / gya nom mchod tshogs du mas bskang / / bka' 'gal dam nyams lta bas bshags/ /mtsho skyes padma'i bka' ci bzhin/ /bstan pa srungs la bstan 'dzin skyongs/ /rig 'dzin brgyud ba'i bka' nyan bzhin/ /g.yar dam dgongs la 'phrin las sgrubs/ / srog dang dam tshog gnyis med gcig / mthun rkyen bsam dgu'i re smon sgrubs/ / yang zab gter gyi gnyer ga gyis/ / gsang ba'i dga' ston gsad spel mdzod/ /snying nas bdag gi grogs su brten/ / gang la bya ba ci bgyis mdzod/ / dngos grub dga' ston gsang ba che/ / dus rnams kun tu gang dang gang / / bkra shis dge legs stsol ba dang / / gsang bstan rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces skyes bu chen po rdo rje legs pa'i gsol mchod 'khyer bde ru bkod pa 'di ni sngar gyi nyams snang sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor dpa' bo'i dga' ston 'di nas gnas mchog padma'i rdzong nas ngos sgob skal ldan 'ga' la mkho ba'i phyin du/ padma'i bu ston snang mdzad rdo rje'i mdzad pa'o/ / bkra shis/— 259 —

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtsho/ /mgon po'i dbal chu bskol tshul dag byed bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na / /na mo shī ma hā ka la ye/ spyan ras gzigs dbang khros pa'i gar/ / bsgyur mdzad ye shes mgon po la/ /brgyud nas dbal chu bskol ba'i thabs/ /'god la bsrung mas bka' gnang stsol/ /de la 'dir mgon po'i dbal chu bskol bar 'dod pas/ gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du nas bre gang gi khar mda' dar btsugs/ dbal snying byugs pa'i chun po la gser g.yu dung gsum btags pa dang /dbal lcags dbal skyed dbal zangs dbal chu phye mar sogs 'du byas la/ nang nyid yi dam bdag bskyed dang bzlas 5 bya/ de nas mtshams gcod ni/ hūṃ/ lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /yi dam lha tshogs nus mthu dang / / dpal ldan mgon po'i drag rtsal gyis/ / yon bdag pho mo 'di rnams la/ / gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa yi/ / rgyal bsen the'u rang 'gong bo sogs/ /gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ / gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ 1 sprul ba'i khro tshogs mang po yis/ / rdul du brlag pan gdon mi za/ / yo su sto ni ——phaṭaḥ srung 'khor ni/ hūṃ/ ye shes lnga yi mtshon cha'i gur/ / steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun nas gtams/ / bar chad kun gyis mi bshig pa'i/ / gzhom med rdo rje'i gur du gyud/ / badzra rakṣa hūṃ/ ga'i 'ding ni/ hūṃ/ phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i gling khams su/ /dar tshon sna lnga'i lha gzhi bting / /'bru sna lnga yi tshom bu bkod/ /mda' dar sna lnga rten du btsugs/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams/ / lha gzhi 'di la spyan 'dren no/ / mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ / rnal 'byor bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod/ / yon bdag rnams la srung du gsol/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las thub par mdzod/ / de nas snyed 'dzugs ni/ rdo dkar gsum gyi sgred pu btsugs la 'di skad do/ / bsro/ shar gyi phyogs nas rdo blangs pa'i/ /zhe sdang bdud rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ / rin chen dngul rdo'i sgyed pu btsugs/ / zhi ba'i ngang du brtan gyun cig / bsro/ lho yi phyogs nas rdo blangs pa'i/ / nga rgyal bdud rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /din chen gser rdo'i sgred pu btsugs/ / rgyas pa'i ngang du brtan gyur cig /bsro—/ snre~X ༈ phyogs nas rdo blangs pa'i/ /'dod chags bdud rnams 'dul ba'i phyin/ /

mgon po'i dngal chu bskol tshul dag byed bdud mi'i rlabs zeng bzhugs so/ /rin chen zangs rdo'i sgyed pu btsugs/ / dbang gi ngang du brtan gyur cig / bsro/ byung gi phyogs nas rdo blangs pa'i/ / phrag dog bdud rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rin chen lcags rdo'i sgyed pu btsugs/ / drag po'i ngang du brtan gyur cig / bsro/ mtshams bzhi dbus lnga'i rin chen rdo/ /dug lnga bdud rnams 'dul ba'i phyin/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga yi rdo/ /dug lnga 'dul phyin brtan gyun cig /dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs rje las/ /dug gsum 'dul phyid sgred pu gsum/ /sku gsum ngang du brtan par btsugs/ /sku gsung thugs su lhun thub shog / dbal zangs mdun du bzhag la/ bsro/ dbal zangs dang po gang nas byung / /sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /dregs po lha chen legs ldan dang / /yum chen dka' zlog nol ba las/ /rdzu 'phrul sgo nga dgu du sprul/ /sgong dgu brdol ba'i nang shed nas/ /dpal ldan mgon po mched dgu byung / /sgong shun mgon po'i dbal zangs la/ /sgong chu dbal chu khol ma byas/ / phyogs bzhir sgo nga brdol ba las/ / zhi rgyas dbang drag dbal zangs byung / /sngon tshe dbal zangs de ltan srid/ /de ring rgyu sbyod yon bdag gis/ /rin chen rgyu las grub pa'i snod/ /smon lam stobs las byung ba'i snod/ /ye shes lnga ldan dbal zangs 'di/ /mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / de nas mda' dar lag tu thogs la mda' rtses dbal zangs nang du ni bris/ hūṃ/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas/ / 'gugs byed khro bo khro mo 'phros/ / gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung bo rnams/ / dbal zangs gnyan po'i nang du khug / ces dgug gzhug bya/ dbal chu la/ bswo/ shar gyi phyogs nas chu blangs pa'i/ /stag skya'i kha nas 'bab pa'i chu/ /dpyid chu dkar po thigs se thig /dbal zangs nang du bdud rtsin bskyil/ / bsro/ lho yi phyogs nas chu blangs pa'i/ /'brug sngon kha nas 'bab pa'i chu/ /dbyun chu dkan po thigs se thig / dbal zangs nang du bdud rtsir bsgyil/ /bsro/ nub kyi phyogs nas chu blangs pa'i/ /ka byu'i khar 'bab ston gyi chu/ /ston chu dkar po thigs se thig / dbal zangs nang du bdud rtsid bskyil/ / bsro/ byang gi phyogs nas chu blangs pa'i/ / rus sbal kha nas 'bab pa'i chu/ / dgun chu dkar po thigs se thig /dbal zangs nang du bdud rtsir bskyel1 /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro yi/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun mi 'chad pa/ / sngon yang ye nas dag pa'i chu/ / da ltan dbal zangs nang du bskyes ba/ /zhes chu btsugs/ de nas dbal snying mda' ltong du bzung la/ bsro/ phyogs bzhi dbus lnga' po brang nas/ / mgon po'i lha tshogs spyan 'dren no/ / dpal ldan mgon po rigs lnga ni/ /dkar ser dmar nag sngon po la/ /nang rang mdog mtshungs rta la zhon/ /'khor ni 'bum phrag mang pos bskor/ /mdung dar 'phyar zhing ki sgra sgrogs/ /do nub dkal ༵ sgyu gas

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mdzod/ / bsro/ gser g.yu dung gsum dpal gyi rten/ / dpal ldan mgon po'i rten du 'bul/ /bla mtsho'i nang du pho brang thob/ /dbal chu bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes dbal zangs nang du dbal snying phul lo/ / de nas dbal zangs btsugs la/ bsro/ dbal zangs ri rab rtse la btsugs/ /gnod byed gdon bgegs zil gyis gnon/ /las pa gyad kyi rgyal po yis/ / dpal dang ldan pa'i dbal zangs 'di/ / sku gsum ldan pa'i sgyed pur btsugs/ /mi g.yo brtan pan bzhugs su gsol/ / zhes btsugs/ me 'bud pa ni/ bsro/me byung dang po gang nas byung / /sngon tsho bskal pa dang po la/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga yi/ / thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pa'i/ / yi ge ji gyi 'phro 'du las/ / ye shes lnga yi me byung ste/ /dug lnga'i phung po gtan nas bsregs/ /ye shes lnga du byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes me sbar/ de nas lhar bskyed pa ni/ bsro/ rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las/ /e las dbal zangs bdud rtsi khol pa'i klong / /pad nyi bdud dang ru tra bsgol ba'i steng / /hūṃ las dpal ldan ye shes mgon po ni/ /mthing nag phyag gnyis bing dang thod khrag 'dzin/ /dar nag ber gsol khro chas sag lham gsol/ / dud khrod chas rdzogs me dpung klong na bzhugs/ / yum chen khro mo yakta bee ta li/ / sku gsung thugs mgon phyogs bcu sde brgyad mgon/ /lha dmag bye ba dung phyur 'khon gyis bskor/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes lha tshogs badzra sa ma dzaḥ bsro/ tshos dbyings rnam dag pho brang nas/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / /gsang sngags bka' brgyud srung ma'i tshogs/ /byin gyis brlob phyin gshegs su gsol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /nang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yi dam rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams/ /dad pa'i sems kyis spran 'dren na/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la gshegs su gsol/ / bswo/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig gnas nas bzhengs/ / mgon po 'khon bcas gnas nas bzhengs/ /sku mdog nag po char sprin mdog / dal ba kham nag gyen du 'ban/ /mche ba gangs ri bsnol ba 'dra/ /sku la ber chen nag po gsol/ /phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phyar/ /stag gzig dom dred rjes su 'brang / /bya nag mang po klad na lding / /rgyal chen sde bzhi pho nyar 'gyed/ /'khor ni mgon po'i dmag tshogs kyi/ /nyi khri 'bum phrag 'khor gyis bskor/ / las spu 'dre gdon 'byung bo 'dul/ / mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /dam nyams 'byung bo rdul du rlogs/ /mgon po bzhengs shig mthu dang bzhengs/ /khro bo gsanga~X du 2 ༷༷ dang bzhengs/ / phur bu bzhengs shig dbal dang bzhengs/ / yungs

mgon po'i dbal chu bskol tshul dag byed bdud rtsi'i rlabs zeng bzhugs so/ /kar bzhengs shig mthu dang bzhengs/ / bsro/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ / tshur gshegs tshud spyon mgon po'i tshogs/ /dur khrod 'ban ba'i dkyil 'khon 'dir/ /'khor bcas ma lhas gshegs su gsol/ / lha chen dpal 'bar gshegs su gsol/ / mna' zan gshed ma gshegs su gsol/ /mthu chen bdud 'dul gshegs su gsol/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug gshegs su gsol/ / rnal 'byor dgra lha gshegs su gsol/ / rig 'dzin srung ma gshegs su gsol/ /lha yi ded dpon gshegs su gsol/ /dam nyams srog gcod gshegs su gsol/ / yum chen ya ka bee ta gshegs su gsol/ / sbu gsung thugs mgon gshegs su gsol/ / phyogs bcu'i mgon po gshegs su gsol/ / sde brgyud mgon po gshegs su gsol/ /lha dmag bye ba dung phyun gshegs su gsol/ / shī ma hwa kā la sa ma ya dzaḥ tiṣṭha lhan/ bsro/ do nub lha srung rnams ni rten la byon/ / srung ma rnams ni rten la byon/ /dgra lha rnams ni rten la byon/ /mda' dar g.yab mo g.yab kin byon/ /mchod do mgon po gser gyis mchod/ / mi 'bru gser gyis bzang ban shog / mchod do mgon po dung gis mchod/ /mi ngo dung gis dkar bar shog /mchod do mgon po g.yu yis mchod/ /mi 'bru g.yu yis 'phan par shog /mchod do mgon po zangs kyis mchod/ /mi ngo zangs kyis dmar bar shog / mchod do mgon po lcags kyis mchod/ / mi srog lcags kyis sra bar shog /mchod do mgon po mchong gis mchod/ / mchong 'bru bzhin du yag pad shog / thab bsangs ni/ re yi ka/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bsro/ ma g.yel ma g.yel lha srung tshogs/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel gnas 'dir byon/ /sman sna 'bru sna zas sna dang / /mkhan shug sur dkar tsa ldan dang / / lha shing bsang rdzas dud pa 'dis/ / rgyud kyi lha srung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /dpal ldan mgon po yab yum bsangs/ / sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po bsangs/ / phyogs bcu'i sde brgyad mgon po bsangs/ /lha dmag bye ba dung phyur bsangs/ /lha klu gnyan dang gzhi bdag bsangs/ /pho lha dgra lha yul lha bsangs/ /khyem lha thab lha g.yang lha bsangs/ /byes lha mgron lha nor lha bsangs/ / bsang mchod dam pa 'di bzhes la/ / bdag cag rna mis kyi sdong grogs mdzod/ / nyams grib mi gtsang dag pa dang / / 'gal rkyen kun zhi tshe bsod rgyas/ / snang ba dbang bsdus dgra bgegs sgrol/ / bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bswo/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / / lha rta lha g.yag lha lug sogs/ / dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ / sdang ba la ༵6 kyi kad

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thul/ / dbal zangs nang du brtan par bzhugs/ / dbal chu bdud rtsir bsgyur du gsol/ / btso gzhung ni/ bsro/ bzhengs shig mgon po 'khon bcas bzhengs/ / sprul ba mang po'i 'khor dang bzhengs/ /mgon po bing chen tshogs dang bzhengs/ /phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma byang phyogs pha gi na/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs gshib pa'i pho brang nas/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i mgon po bsro/ / bsro de ni bing du dza/ bsro/ do nub mgon po'i dmag tshogs bsro/ /do nub 'khor gyi ma mo bsro/ /do nub tsa ldan bing chen bsro/ /do nub yungs kan dbal gyi bsro/ / mgon dmag nyi khri chig stong bsro/ / bsro/ do nub gnod byed gdon rnams rdul du rlogs/ / bsro/ byang phyogs rlung gi pha mtha' na/ / rdo rje brag nag gdan steng nas/ /seṅge bsnol ba'i khri steng nas/ /ma hwa ku la gnas 'dir bzhengs/ /legs ldan nag po gnas 'din bzhengs/ /mgon dmag nyi khri chig stong da bzhengs shig /'khon gyi ma mo 'bum sde da bzhengs shig / do nub dgra bgegs 'byung bo rdul du rlogs/ /oṃ ma hwa ku la dka dzaḥdzaḥ ma hwa ku la sirnyi sa ma ya du dzaḥ ma hwa kā la dka ya ma du dzaḥdam sri 'byung bo'i srog la mā na ya phaṭaḥ bsro/ dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil nas1 /dman nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ / khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar po bskyil/ / zhing chen gsar rnying bla re bres/ /thod rus gsar rnying mkhan du brtsigs/ /byu nag g.yag nag lug nag gi / tsitta sna tshogs gcal du bkram/ / bzhengs shig nag po chen po bzhengs/ /bzhengs shig legs ldan dgra 'dul bzhengs/ / do nub dgra bgegs steng du dmag sna drongs/ /dam nyams 'byung bo rdul du zlogs/ / klu gdon gnod byed rdul du rlogs/ / ma hwa kā la sa ma ya/ bsro/ do nub 'dre srin steng du dmag sna drongs/ / byung shad mgon po bzhengs su gsol/ / bsro/ dpal ldan mgon po bzhengs su gsol/ / tsa ldan bing chen bzhengs su gsol/ /dpal ldan mthu chen bzhengs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bos pa'i tshe/ /tshogs kyis rnga brdung dung bus tshe/ /dmag tshogs dpung dang da bzhengs shig /rta ba can gyi tshogs rnams bzhengs su gsol/ / shing rta can gyi tshogs rnams bzhengs su gsol/ / dpung gcig dmag gi tshogs rnams bzhengs su gsol/ / bsro/ keng rus 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khon nas/ / yum chen yakta dgra 'dul bzhengs su gso' / / keng dus brtsigs pa'i gzhal yas nas/ / dkar mo spyan gsum bzhengs su gsol/ / dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /ma hwa ku la bzhengs su gsol/ /rdo rje brag ri'i gdan steng nas/ /ba ka du 4 po bzhengs su gsol/ / sha chen spungs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ / 'jigs

mgon po'i dbal chu bskol tshul dag byed bdud rtsi'i rlabs zeng bzhugs so/ /byed kang ka ta ri bzhengs su gsol/ /rakta 'bab pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /brag lha mgon po bzhengs su gsol/ / shugs 'byung sku yi sprul ba las/ / me dpung de ni 'bar ba byung / /shugs 'byung zhal gyi sprul ba las/ / rlung nag de ni 'tshub ma byung / / shugs 'byung thugs rje'i sprin phung las/ /gnam lcags khro chu khol ma byung / /me chu rlung 'phros mtshon cha yis/ /dgra bgegs 'byung bo rdul du rlogs/ / bdud kyi du mtshon da chod cig / bgegs dpung shigs la bdud dpung choms/ / bsro/ do nub tshogs kyi gling bzhi nas/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams bsro/ / ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bsro/ / ma hwa kā la'i tshogs rnams bsro/ / tsa ldan bing chen tshogs rnams bsro/ / dgra bgegs 'byung bo gnod byed thul/ /dbal zangs nang du brtan pad bzhugs/ /dbal chu bdud rtsin bsgyud du gsol/ /bstod pa ni/ bsro/ mnyam nyid mthu mnga' gtum chen 'bar ba 'a thugs/ / rngams chen gtum po rgyad gnon chen po'i sku/ /'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs srid gsum yongs la sgrogs/ /dpal ldan ma hwa kā lan phyag 'tshal bstod/ / btso bskol ni/ bswo/ dbal chu skol ba gang nas srid/ / rngams chen drag po'i bdud 'dul phyir/ /dbal gyi btso bskol yan yar bskol/ / ri gsum rtse la yar yar bskol/ / dbal gyi btso bskol yar yar bskol/ / ya ma yur gyi gong du yar yar bskol/ / dbal gyi btso bskol yar yar bskol/ / bla ri brgyad kyi rtse la yar yar bskol/ / dbal ka btso bskol yar yan bskol/ / bla brag brgyud kyi rtse la yar yar bskol/ /dbal gyi btso bskol yar yar bskol/ /ri rab gling bzhi'i ngos la yar yar bskol/ / dbal gyi btso bskol yad yar bskol/ / gling phran brgyad kyi rtse la yar yan bskol/ / dbal gyi btso bskol yar yar bskol/ / dur khrod brgyad kyi gling 'a yar yar bskol/ / dbal gyi btso bskol yan yar bskol/ / gsed sgyu ri bdun rtse la yar yar bskol/ /dbal gyi btso bskol yar yar bskol/ / nam mkha' stong ba'i dbyings su yar yan bskol/ / dbal gyi btso bskol yar yar bskol/ / bar snang khams kyi ngang du yar yar bskol/ / dbal gyi btso bskol yar yar bskol/ / gser gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su yar yar bskol/ / spros pa dpag bsam/ shing gis spro/ / 'dul ba lha srin sde brgyad 'dul1 / 'dre sri thams cad rdul du rlogs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ / gdon 'dul ba ni/ bsro/ ma g.yel ma g.yel mgon po'i lha/ / ma g.yel ma g.yel srung ma'i lha/ / ma g.yel ma g.yel bsten pa'i lha/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel lus kyi lha/ /tshogs bdag nag po chen po khyod/ /ston pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /dgra bgegs thams cad ༷du~X ༵5 da1 / /

mas1 /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yon bdag rnams la bsrung ba dang / /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /rnal 'byon bdag la dngos grub stsol/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ / bsro/ do nub mgon po'i lha tshogs bsro/ /thing gsum bsro yis ma btab na/ / mgon po'i las la le lo byed/ / le lo ma byed da tshur spyon/ / do nub lha mda' ltong dkar rten la byon/ / dar tshon sna lnga mgul du btags/ / gser g.yu dung gsum sgron ma dang / / pags spu dkan po'i sgron ma dang / / dar dkan yug gcig sgron ma dang / /bya nag g.yag nag lug nag 'di/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'byon pa'i rten/ /nag po chen po 'byon pa'i rten/ / legs ldan dgra 'dul 'byon pa'i rten/ / mgon po mched gsum 'byon pa'i rten/ /tsa ldan jing chen 'byon pa'i rten/ / brag lha mgon po 'byon pa'i rten/ / yum chen yas gdon 'dul 'byon pa'i rten/ / 'jigs byed kang ka ta ri 'byon pa'i rten/ / mgon dmag nyi khri chig stong 'byon pa'i rten/ / bsro/ do nub thub pa'i dpung dang bcas te byon/ /gcod pa'i ngar dang bcas te byon/ /'dre gdon 'byung bo'i gnya' gnon mdzod/ / bsro/ do nub mgon chu khol ma 'di la byin gyis zlobs/ / mgon skyed shel gyi mchod rten 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon me ye shes 'ban ba 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor bdag la dngos grub stsol/ /gnod byed 'byung bo rdul du rlogs/ /bzlas pa ni/ yo shī ma hwa ka la shā sa na lha ba ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa ma pa'i tsi ma hwa ku lo/ a yi skru dzwa ratna tra ya/ a ba ka ri tri/ ya ti bra ti rnyi sma ra si/ ta da i dzwa du / / kha kha khri hi 'i nyi/mā ra mā da/ kṛ ka kṛ da/ ban dha ban dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa de na me ke 1 mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sruhwa/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs las 'od zer 'phros/ /mdun gyi mgon po'i lha tshogs thugs kar phog / thugs rgyud bskul ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /char ltad babs nas dbal zangs gang bad gyud/ / slan yang 'od zed mtshon cha'i rnam pan 'phros/ / dbal chun thim pas rdo rje me char gyis/ / gnod byed bsregs shing bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / nyams chags sdig sgrib dag pa'i mthu ldan gyun/ / yo shi ma hwa kā la dka du thing dzaḥ zhes bzlas/ bswo/ beng ri li li thums dza dzaḥ jing sngags dang /oṃ thi ma hwa kā la hūṃ phaṭaḥ oṃ ma hwa kā la raka dzaḥ yo shī ma hwa ku la sirnyi ya ma du dzaḥ oṃ shi ma hwa ku la dka ya ma du dzaḥ dam sri 'byung bo'i srog la mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces las sngags gang 'tshams bzla/ gzhan bon gyi btso sngags chu'i ngan gsod pa'i sngags sogs yig rnying na 'dug pa rnams bzlas na dbal chur mi 'gro bas/ dbal zhes pa ni tsha ba'i dbal la ngos 'dzin dgos/ btso zhes ༷༷ ka du du ༷༷ pa tsha ba'i ming du bshad pa'i phyir no/ / de bas na sngags de rnams bzla mi dgos/

mgon po'i dbal chu bskol tshul dag byed bdud rtsi'i rlabs greng bzhugs so/ /de nas btso lcags thogs la/ thab kyi g.yas phyogs su yar langs te/ spro na yi dam gyi mngon rtogs rgyas pa dang bsdu na skad cig grong bskyed lta bu'i rjes su sngon bskal ma dang rtsa sngags bzla bzhin/ dbal chu dang dbal lcags la bsngags/ de nas/ bsro/ steng spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng nas/ / drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma gnas 'dir gshegs/ / mgon chu khol ma'i phud cig yar la bzhes/ /dbal chu ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs/ / bsro/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i pho brang nas/ /yi dam dkyil 'khon lha tshogs gnas 'dir gshegs/ /mgon chu khol ma'i phud cig yan la bzhes/ /dbal chu ye shes bdud rtsin byin gyis rlobs/ /bsro/ dang rang so so'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ / mthu ldan chos skyong srung ma gnas 'dir gshegs/ / mgon zu khol ma'i phud cig yan la bzhes/ / dbal chu ye shes bdud rtsin byen gyis rlobs/ / bsro/'og min rnam snang gangs chen thugs ka nas/ / dpal ldan mgon po'i lha tshogs gnas 'dir gshegs/ / mgon chu khol ma'i phud cig yar la bzhes/ / dbal chu ye shes bdud rtsin byin gyis rlobs/ / bsro/ byang shar mtshams kyi phar mtha' nas/ / tsub 'gyun tshal gyi dun khrod du/ / dpal ldan ye shes mgon po ni/ / mthing nag beng dang thod khrag bsnams/ / 'khor du mgon dmag 'bum gyis bskor/ / do nub bskul lo 'phrin las mdzod/ /dbal chu bdud rtsir bsgyud ba dang / / gnod byed rnams la me chan phobs /tsan na bing chen 'phyan tsam na/ / lha dmag mang po shigs se shig / dbal chu rdo rje me chan 'dis/ / gnod byed gdon ngan rdul du rlogs/ / bsro/ do nub mgon chu khol ma'i phud/ /ye shes lha la mchod pa yis/ / nyams chag gsos shing dngos grub stsol/ / chos skyong gzhan la mchod pa yis/ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag byung / /rnal 'byor bdag la phog pa yis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /yon bdag rnams la phog pa yis/ /nad gdon zhi zhing tshe bsod sgyus/ /gnod byed bgegs la phog pa yis/ /drag po'i dbal gyis thal bar rlogs/ / bsro/ do nub mgon chu tsha dbal phugs la 'phen/ / phugs la gnas pa'i phugs lha ge thung khyod/ / lha khyod ma dngangs ma 'drog dgyes par bzhugs/ /bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / dam sri rgyal 'gong bse reg rdul du rlogs/ /bsro/ do nub mgon chu tsha dbal thab la 'phen/ /thab la gnas pa'i thab lha yod mo khyod/ /lha khyod ma dngangs ma 'drog dgyes par bzhugs/ /bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / thab sri thab 'dre ngo nag rdul du rlogs/ / bsro/ do nub mgon chu tsha dbal sgo la 'phen/ / sgo la gnas pa'i sgo lha stag g.yag khyod/ / lha khyod ma dngangs lda 'drog dgyes par bzhugs/ / bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gaX/26/7nad ba

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/god 'dre 'dur lam bcad du gsol/ / bswo/ mgon po'i dbal gyi chu/ /skyes pa rnams la 'phen/ / pho lha dgra lha khyod/ / ma dngangs ma 'drog cig / chu 'di phog pa na/ / ye shes bdud rtsi'i sman/ /pho sri nal chen la/ /phog na rdul du rlogs/ /bsro/ mgon po'i dbal gyi chu1 /bud med rnams la 'phen/ /mo lha mo sman khyod/ /ma dngangs ma 'drog cig/chu 'di phog pa na/ / ye shes bdud rtsi'i sman/ / mo gri shul phud la/ / phog na rdul du rlogs/ /bsro/ mgon po'i dbal gyi chu/ / byis pa rnams la 'phen/ / srid lha dpral dkan khyod/ /ma dngangs ma 'drog cig /chu 'di phog na/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i sman/ /zung sri kha dmad la/ / phog na rdul du rlogs/ / bsro/ mgon po'i dbal gyi chu/ /ma lhags 'gro'i rta la 'phen/ /rta lha 'phan po khyod/ /ma dngangs ma 'drog cig /chu 'di phog pa na/ / ye shes bdud rtsi'i sman/ / rta sri kang 'byam la/ / phog na rdul rlogs/ /bswo/ mgon po'i dbal gyi chu/ /gos 'dzin lug la 'phen/ /lug lha rmun po khyod/ /ma dngangs ma 'drog cig / chu 'di phog pa na/ / ye shes bdud rtsi'i sman/ / lug sri gtal ba la/ / phog na rdul du rlogs/ / bsro/ mgon po'i dbal gyi chu/ / tshen mo na la 'phen/ /ra lha tser mo khyod/ /ma dngangs ma 'drog cig / chu 'di phog pa na/ / ye shes bdud rtsi'i sman/ /da sri skong po la/ /phog na rdul du rlogs/ /bswo/ mgon po'i dbal gyi chu/ / gnag phyug non la 'phen/ /nor lha g.yang lha khyod/ / ma dngangs ma 'drog cig/chu 'di phog pa na/ / ye shes bdud rtsi'i sman/ / nor sri god 'dre la/ / phog na rdul du rlogs/ / bsro/ do nub mgon po mched gsum thugs kyi sprul ba las/ / byu nag mang po kad na lding / / bya nag lcags kyi mchu sder can/ / 'chum pa nad dang gdon la 'chum/ /nad gang na yod kyang drongs la shog /gdon gang na yod kyang rdul du rlogs/ /stag gzig mang po phyi na 'brang / / 'jab pa nad dang gdon la 'jab/ / nad gang na yod kung drongs la shog / gdon gang na yod kung rdul du rlogs/ / rgyal chen sde bzhi pho nyan 'gyed/ / pho nya'i sprul ba 'khor bcas kyis/ /nad gang na yod kyang drongs la shog /gdon gang na yod kung rdul du rlogs/ / mgon dmag nyi khri chig stong las la 'khod/ / pho nya sprul ba yang sprul tshogs rnams kyis/ /nad gang na yod kung drongs la shog /gdon gang na yod kyang rdul du rlogs/ /dpa' bo seng ge'i yang rtsal can/ /rtsal chen nad dang gdon la che/ /nad gang na yod kyang drongs la thog / gdon gang na yod kyang rdul du rlogs/ / g.yu 'brug me yi gshoX/ pa ༵ḍi8/ ——/ kha na glog dmar khyugs se khyug / glog gi ngar zhags dgra dang gdon la

mgon po'i dbal chu bskol tshul dag byed bdud rtsi'i rlabs zeng bzhugs so1 /spyobs/ /nad gang na yod kyang drongs la shog /gdon gang na yod kyang rdul du rlogs/ /lha g.yag dkad po ze ba can/ / mgo na rwa brdad zangs se zang / / rwa brdad na nad dang gdon la brdar/ / nad gang na yod kyang drongs la shog / gdon gang na yod kyang rdul du rlogs/ /bsro/ mgon po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis/ /rgyu sbyod yon gyi bdag po yi/ /mgo nad 'thib dang mig nad long / /sna nad 'tshub dang rna nad 'on/ /mgon chu khol ma'i zen gyis thul1 / thul zhig gnod byed gdon ngan thul/ / lce nad sbugs dang ske nad 'khyogs/ /lud pa glo ba mchin pa'i nad/ /mgon chu khol ma'i zer gyis thul/ /thul zhig gnod byed gdon ngan thul/ / rgyu ma mkhal ma srog rtsa'i nad/ / lhags bzhi rkang lag na ba de/ / mgon chu khol ma'i zed gyis thul/ / thul zhig gnod byed gdon ngan thul/ / lhas stobs nyams dang dbang po pyos/ / dran nyams lus po lci ba'i nad/ / mgon chu khol ma'i zen gyis thul/ / thul zhig gnod byed gdon ngan thul/ / spyi gtsug man dang rkang mthil yan/ / na tsha gzer zug gang yod pa/ / mgon chu khol ma'i zer gyis thul/ / thul zhig gnod byed gdon ngan thul/ / nad kyi ma bu bshig tu gsol/ / gzer gyi mkhun bu da phud cig / 'dre yi 'brel thag da chod cig / gdon gyi rdzu 'phrul da shig cig / grib kyi mi gtsang dag gyur cig /bcol ba'i 'jin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bsro/ mgon chu khol ma'i zen gcig 'di/ /steng gi lha la mi 'phen no/ /bar gyi gnyan la mi 'phen no/ /'og gi klu la mi 'phen no/ / bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ / mthu dang dpung la gshegs su gsol/ 1 mgon chu rdo rje me chan 'di/ / pho gdon rgyal po'i snying la spyob/ / mgon chu rdo rje me chad 'di/ /mo gdon bsen mo'i snying la lhob/ /mgon chu rdo rje me char 'di/ /dam sri the'u ring snying la spyob/ /mgon chu rdo rje me char 'di/ /za 'dre shi gshed snying la spyob/ /mgon chu rdo rje me char 'di/ / 'gong bo bse reg snying la spyob/ / mgon chu rdo rje me char 'di/ /sri ngan 'byung bo'i snying la spyob/ / mgon chu rdo rje me char 'di/ / gdon bgegs 'byung bo'i snying la spyob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /dbang du sdus la rdul du rlogs/ / na mo rje btsun co ba dang rgyu 'bras bsru ba med pa'i bden pa dang / khyad par yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams dang dpal ldan ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i mthu la brten nas sbyin bdag pho rmo 'di rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i mi'i rmang 'dre phyugs kyi god 'dre rgyal bsen the'u rang 'gong bo 'gong 'dre sri ngan sogs 'din ma gnas pan gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na mags dī bye bye da char

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyis rdul du brlag par gdon mi za/ yi dam gyi sngags dang mgon po'i las sngags mthar/ thu bha ni sogs bden brjod byus la yon bdag pho mo rnams la btso lcag gis dbrab/ dbal zangs kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dngos grub ni/ bsro/ dpal ldan mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams/ / ye shes dbyings su badzra mu/ / dam tshig 'od zhur bdud rtsir gyur/ / dpal ldan ye shes mgon po yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams/ /bum bzang non bu dpag bsam tshul/ /grub pa brgyad sogs dngos grub rnams/ / dus 'din yon bdag rnams la stsol/ / zhes btso snying yon bdag mo la byin/ de nas bden brjod sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi nang thams cad la dbal chu gtor zhing srung 'khor bsgom/ btso lcag sgo'i ya them la 'dogs/ nang du log nas me tog 'thor zhing /bsro/ ye shes mgon po'i byen rlabs gangs ri las/ / bsod nams stong gi chu bo 'bab pa'i rgyun/ / 'khyel ba'i dzing bun don gnyis 'khod lo'i lag / dga' ston mgrin pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs gyud cig / bkra shis dge legs chad ltan 'bab pa yis/ / 'did 'dus phog tshad skal ldan tshogs rnams la/ / gnas skabs nad gdon zhi ba'i bkra shis shog /tshe dpal 'byor ba rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i bkra shis shog /gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i bkra shis shog / mthar thug sangs rgyus 'thob pa'i bkra sbyo~X/ shog/ / ces bkra shis brjod/ dbal zangs nang du 'o ma blugs phye mar brdzis la dga' ston smras pa/ dug gsum rang grol sku gsu ma sgyed pu'i khar/ /ma bcos lhun rdzogs chos dbyings zangs chen nang / /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi nab bskol bas/ /'gro ba'i las nyon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig/ces mgon po'i dbal zu bskol tshul ye shes bdud rtsi zhes byu ba 'di ni/ sngags mang dbu mdzad skal bzang skyabs dang / tshe mgon skyabs gnyis kyis bskul ngon/ nyang gi mtshams ming bstan 'dzin rgyu mtshos btso gzhung khungs dag 'ga' dang bstun nas sbyan ba'o/ / dge'o/ / bkra shis/

snyamagrin gsang sgrub kyi dgra 'ching dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i zhags pa bzhugs so/ /nas/ /rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dgra 'ching dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i zhags pa zhes byu ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru tya sgyu wa ye/ dpal rta mgrin 'phrin las kyi sgo nas/ dgra 'ching byu bar 'dod pas/sde brgyud sogs kyi thebs yod pa'i dus/ g.yag nog po'i rwa dong g.yon pa rnyed na rab/ ma rnyed na rwa gang rung dang / ga'i ma nag po'i steng du de'u nag po brgyad cu co gcig na rtswa shol mo/ me chu sa rlung /phur bu thun ru/ thal 'jam/ re ba nag po'i dmu khebs/ zhags pa khra bo/ rdo leb steng du ri rab bang rim bzhi
