ba bris/ 'og tu rgya gram bris pa/ de rnams sta gon bya/ rang nyid yi dam gang rung bsgom pas/ yo sta bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las yi ge ka nag pod yongs su gyur pa las lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po phyi na me 'bar ba/ nang na mun pa 'thib pa gting zab pa/ 'og gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa 'phel kha che ba sgrol byed kyi bshan pa'i tshogs kha khyer dang logs la 'grim pa las dge sdig gi ngo mi shes pa de'i nang du yi ge khyu tre yongs su gyur pa las dgra sri gdug pa can lus rid pa phung khams skye mched thams cad tshang pa nyams chung ba yan lag lhags sgrog gis bsdams pa 'dar hod ted byed pa gcig tu gyur/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa/ chos kyi bka' bden pa/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa/ bka' gsang sngags rig sngags snying bo phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin sgyu bka' bden pa/ chos nyid gdod nas stong yang chos can rgyu 'bras bsru ba med pa'i bka' bden pa/ khyad par du khro bo'i rgyal bo rta mchog no' ba'i dkyil 'khor sgyu lha tshogs 'khon dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa/chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa/ bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas rnal 'byon pa bdag cag dpon slob khyim sgo lam srang 'di nyid la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas tshur la dgra jag rkun gsum shoms pa shags lan dpung gsum byed pa/ snga dgra lag gis bstar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/da dgra thad du ldang ba'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs byad ma rbad 'dre bod gtong dang bcas pa'i bla sbog rnam par shes pa/ sa 'og sa steng sa da / ༵༵ srid ga'i

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rtse mo/ dma' rgya mtsho'i gting bar gling bzhi gling phran gang na gnas kung / skyob par byed pa'i lha dang phrol la rang dbang med pan bye'u khris ded pa bzhin du gzugs liṅka ming byang bu bla rtswa bla rdo dang bcas pa 'di la khug cig bstem cig yo tīḥpadma da krid badzra kro dha tya snri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa dgra bgegs sarba du / a karsha ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dmigs pa dang bcas lan bdun nam gsum tsam brjod/ de nas/ hūṃḥdakon mchog gsum po gzu dpang mdzod/ /bla ma yi dam gzu dpang mdzod/ / dpal chen rta mgrin gzu dpang mdzod/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gzu dpang mdzod/ /chos skyong srung ma gzu dpang mdzod/ /gzu dang dpang bor ma nor mdzod/ /mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis/ /dgra bgegs 'ching brub mnan pa'i las/ /da ltar myun ba nyid du mdzod/ /hūṃḥ dpal chen rta mgrin 'khon dang bcas/ 1chos skyong dam can lha tshogs rnams/ /snyan gson thugs kyis dgongs mdzod 'tshal/ /gzu dang dpang bzhugs gang bden gzigs/ /rnal 'byor dam ldan mthu dpung mdzod/ /nyes can dgra la chad pas chod/ /bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa pos/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /tseng chub snying bo bsgrub 'dod kyang / /bstan bshigs dam nyams dgra bo dang / /gnod byed bgegs kyis ban chad byung / / khyad par sdig can dgra bo 'di/ / nyes pa med pan dgra du langs/ /chags pa med par bu lon bkal/ /gnod pad byed pa'i bsam sbyor brtsams/ /zhe sdang dbang gis thog tu rgyug /thabs tshul du mas gnod pa byas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bshigs / ma nyes sems can du ma bsad/ / da ltar mthu stobs dus la bab/ /dus las ma 'da' 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃḥ dpal chen rta mgrin 'khor dang bcas/ / sprul ba 'byed pa'i dus la bab/ / dbang gi rgyal bo'i thugs ka nas/ /lcags kyu can rnams glog ltar 'khyug / zhags pa can rnams sprin ltar gtibs/ / lcags sgrog can rnams thog ltar phobs/ /dril bu can rnams ser ltar bsgril/ /dam can rgya mtsho seng ltan 'gying / / sde brgyad dregs pa rlung ltar 'tshub/ / dam nyams dgra sri sdig can rnams/ / rang dbang med par 'dir khug la/ / 'brub khung las kyi pho brang 'dir/ /gzugs la bstems la chings shig sdoms/ / mngon spyod las kyis myur du sgrol/ /hoḥdagongs su gso' lo/ / bla ma yi dam rnams ni gzu dang dpang la mkhas pa/ ma mo mkha' 'gro ni sha dang khrag la dgyes pa/ chos skyong srung ma rnams ni mthu dang col che ba/bka' sdod lha srin sde brgyad rnams ni srog gcod kyi las la mkhas pa/ ma mgon lcam dral ni ba ka 7rdo na pa mkhas pa/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje ni skye 'gro'i rtsis la 'debs pa/

rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dgra 'ching dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i 'gas pa bzhugs so1 1nag po bdud kyi sde tshogs ni zhe nag pa/ drag po gza' bdud chen po ni myur mgyogs che ba/dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa ni legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin la gnas pa/ dmad po btsan gyi sde tshogs ni rgyug 'dur rgod pa/ glen pa klu'i sde tshogs ni gdug tsub che ba/ yul lha gzhi bdag ni dkad po'i phyogs skyong ba/ khyed rnams yang cig drag po'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas 'o dod du 'bod/ snyan gsan du dbab/ gtad gnyen du byu/ 'phrin las su bskul ba'i mdo ni/ rtswa 'di shar dung ri dkan po nas btus pa'i rtswa ma yin/ lho gsed ri ser po nas btus pa'i rtswa ma yin/ nub zangs ri dman po nas btus pa'i rtswa ma yin/ byung g.yu ri sngon po nas btus pa'i rtswa ma yin/ dbus ri rgyal lhun po nas btus pa'i rtswa ma yin/ lha khang dang mchod rten nas btus pa'i rtswa ma yin/ lha lung dang dpal lung nas btus pa'i rtswa ma yin/ khyim sgo dang lam grang nas btus pa'i rtswa ma yin/ rtswa 'di yar sna zad kyi mad sna/mar sna zad kyi bzhi mdo/ gla ba nog po'i nyal rtswa/ sdig phag grog mo nog zhar nang gi na rtswa shol mo 'di/ sngon yang dgra bo'i bla rtswa/ da yang dgra bo'i bla rtswa/ da yang dgra pha nyes bu nyes jag nyes dgra ka btsan che ba shag gis mi thub pa/ dgra dpung btsan che ba 'gran gyis mi thub pa/ dgra sngon nas sgul zer mi/ rgyab nas 'ded zen mi/ thad nas 'phrog zed mi/nyes po med pad dgra du ldang ba'i dgra bo tshe zad dam nyams gzhi lam byes gsum gang nas thad sor babs pa'i dgra bo/ bu dpa' bo mtshon non po mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i rtse mo gting nas breg pa yin pas/ de ring rtswa rtse rgyal gyi rtse mo bcad pa ma yin/ dgra rtse rgyal gyi rtse mo bcad pa yin/ rtswa sked can gyi sked pa bcad pa ma yin/ dgra sked can gyi sked pa bcad pa yin/ rtswa rteng can gyi rting ba bcad pa ma yin/ dgra rteng can sgyu rting ba bcad pa yin/ da rtswa bsnol ba ma yin/ dgra rtswa bsnol ba yin/ dgra rgod po dom 'dra ba/mgyogs pa khra 'dra ba/ bde mo glag 'dra ba/ sprung po spyang 'dra ba/ glen pa glang 'dra ba/rmun po lug 'dra ba'i dran pa'i dbang bo/ blta ba'i mig 'gro ba'i rkang ba/ snyobs pa'i lag pa/ phyin chan bsgol cig rga sha rga sha/ brag thal brag thal/ snying chod snying chod/ya ya tsi tsi nan nan/ kha la dka rbad/ snying la dka rbad/ dran rig la raka rbad/ dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum chings shig sdoms shig lan gsum brjod la/ tshes gcig bcu gcig nyi shu gcig /gcig gsum dag la dgra bo ma ldang cig /tshes gcig dgra ya ngan pa rnams/ /bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / /tshes gnyis bcu gnyis nyi shu gnyis/ /gnyis gsum dag la dgra bo ma ldang cig / nyin gcig 'thab yang ngo dman de/—/ snro sta ba dang

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mnyam du 'ching / / tshes gsum bcu gsum nyi shu gsum/ / gsum gsum dag la dgra bo ma ldang cig / gnyan po dgra ya ngo nag de/ / bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / / tshes bzhi bcu bzhi nyi shu bzhi/ / bzhi gsum dag la dgra bo ma ldang cig / dgra bo yon bdag ngo log de/ /bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / /ches lnga bco lnga nyi shu lnga/ /lnga gsum dag la dgra bo ma ldang cig / dgra bo nad pa sos log de/ / bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / / tshes drug bcu drug nyi shu drug / drug gsum dag la dgra bo ma ldang cig / dgra bo ya ma thad log de/ / bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / / tshes bdun bcu bdun nyi shu bdun/ / bdun gsum dag la dgra bo ma ldang cig / dgra bo le'u lha log de/ / bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / / ches brgyad bco brgyad nyi shu brgyad/ / brgyad gsum dag la dgra bo ma ldang cig/dgra bo dra ba dam log de/ / bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / / tshes dgu bcu dgu nyi shu dgu/ /dgu gsum dag la dgra bo ma ldang cig /dgra bo bran 'khor sdos gcod de/ /bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / / phyi rkun thob shor byed pa rnams/ / bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / /nang rkun 'og leb byed pa rnams/ /bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / /bzang byas lan la ngan byed rnams/ / bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / / dgu ba'i dgu mig ngan pa de/ /bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / /dgu dgu brgyad cu gya gcig la/ /bsam ngan sbyon tsub ngan pa rnams/ / bla rtswa 'di dang mnyam du 'ching / / dam nyams dgra bo'i 'byung bzhi khob/ / zhing chen rgyu mas kha chings shig / g.yag nag ko bas kha sdoms shig / dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ / de nas khrim la 'debs pa ni/ bsro/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / / dpal chen rta mgrin mthu stobs kyis/ /phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi 'dul bar mdzod/ /dgra mi thub khram la 'debs par mdzod/ /dgra bstan pa'i spyi dgra khram la thob/ /slob dpon sku dgra khram la thob/ /dam pa'i chos dgra khram la thob/ /rnal 'byor dgos dgra khram la thob/ /sngon yang sdang dgra khram la thob/ /bon po ngo dmar khram la thob/ /gnyan po ngo nag khram la thob/ /nyag med rkun po khrim la thob/ / phu nu gong shon khram la thob/ / chung ma snying log khram la thob/ / nye bo bsam log khrim la thob/ / dra ba dam log khram la thob/ / nad pa sos log khrim la thob/ /ya ma thad log khrim la thob/ /yon bdag ngo log khram la thob/ /bran g.yog sdos gcod khrim la thob/ / rtsis 'debs gshin rje'i rtsis la thob/ / srog bdag rgyal bo'i bla srog long / /dpa1 ka 7rdol 1sa bsgral du gsol/ 1 bsro/ steng rdo dang po lha yi rdo/ / 'og rdo

rta mgrin gsang spub kyi dgra 'ching dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i zhags pa bzhugs so/ /gnyis pa bdud kyi rdo/ / lha bdud gnyis kyi kha bar du/ / dgra bo'i dpung ba byud kyis chog/steng rdo dang po g.yu yi rdo/ / 'og rdo gnyis pa mchong gi rdo/ / g.yu mchong gnyis kyi kha bad du/ /dgra bo'i dpung ba byad kyis chog / steng rdo dang po zangs kyi rdo/ / 'og rdo gnyis pa lcags gyi rdo/ / zangs lcags gnyis kyi kha ban du/ / dgra bo'i dpung ba byad kyis chog /steng rdo dang po dri yi rdo/ /'og rdo gnyis pa dur gyi rdo/ /dri dur gnyis kyi kha bad du/ /dgra bo'i dpung ba byud kyis chog / steng rdo dang po rabs chad rdo/ /'og rdo gnyis pa yugs sa'i rdo/ /nabs yugs gnyis kyi kha bar du/ /dgra bo'i dpung ba byad kyis chog /steng rdo dang po nyin gyi rdo/ / 'og rdo gnyis pa srib kyi rdo/ / nyin srib gnyis kyi ka bar du/ / dgra bo'i dpung ba rdul du rlogs/ / bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / hūṃḥ rdungs shig dgra bgegs dpung ba rdung / / khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ / rdo rje tho bas brdung byas pa'i/ / lha yang dung ste brlag tsam na/ / dgra dang bgegs la sbos ci dgos/ / dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/ / bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/ / sha dus phye mar btang ba 'di/ /zag med bdud rtsin byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal chen rta mgrin zhal du bstems/ / 'bul ba bdag gis mi nor no/ / bzhes pa khyed kyis ma nor cig / bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ / rwa dong du tshig dang bstun pa'i tshig re'i mtshams su rde'u brub pa sbrag la 'phen/ hūṃ dzaḥ khug cig dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug / non cig lika'i lto la non/ /stems shig mtshan byang ming la bstems/ /thob cig phung bo lnga la thob/ /phye cig dgra sri lha dang phye/ / chings shig dgra bgegs dbang bo chings/ / lhags kyu can kyis snying nas zungs/ /zhags pa can gyis skod nas chongs/ /lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms/ /dril bu can gyis myos su chug /mgyogs byed rnams kyis sna nas khrid/ /mtshon thogs rnams kyis rgyab nas ded/ / rang dbang med par 'did khug la/ / bla rdo 'di la bstems par mdzod/ /ka/ rwa sgod 'di ni gnam lcags dong / /zabs su dpag tshad brgyad khri yod/ /dgra sri mgyogs por thur bstan brub/ / lha rnams bden pa'i stobs kyis brub/ / yi dam bden pa'i stobs kyis brub/ /dpal chen rta mgrin nus mthus brub/ /chos skyong srung ma'i rtsal gyis brub/ / drang srong bden pa'i tshig gis brub/ / tshangs pa'i be con bden pas brub/ /dbang bo rdo rje bden pas brub/ /khyab 'jug 'khon lo'i bden pas brub/ /tshogs bdag thod pa'i bden pas brub/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i gting du brub/ /snga dgra phyi dgra da dgra brub/ / bza' btung gos la gnod pa brub/ / longs spyod tshe ba lha ༵ bru1/ /

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/snyan grags rnyed la gnod pa brub/ / chos spyod bcu la gnod pa brub/ / yul mkhan zhing la gnod pa brub/ / lo tog mdzod la gnod pa brub/ / khe tshong mgron la gnod pa brub/ /bkur ste bstan la gnod pa brub/ / yags kyi 'phrod kha bsnol ba brub/ / nyes kyi 'phrod ka bsgrigs pa brub/ / blo la ban du gcod pa brub/ / dgra yi dpung grogs byed pa brub/ /gdon gyi sna 'dren byed pa brub/ /dbang chen 'phrog rlom byed pa brub/ /mi 'bab khral chen 'beb pa brub/ /mi nus las ka bcol ba brub/ /sgo gsum gdug pa'i bsam spyor brub/ /mi shes mi mkhas zer ba brub/ / ngan rab thu rab brjod mi bru'/ / dmag jag rkun gsum shoms mi brub/ /'dug na nan gyis 'phud mi brub/ /'gro na thabs kyis bshol mi brub/ /mdor na 'tshogs sar skal gcod brub/ / nyung nyung nang du skal 'phrog brub/ / ma nyes kha yog 'gel ba brub/ / mkhar khyim na ba kha sprod brub/ / zhing la snye ma gcod mi brub/ / rka dang 'gyed chu 'phrog mi brub/ /mdza' gnyis bar du rdzun bshad brub/ /mthun gnyis ban du dbyen skyel brub/ /lha 'dre bka' chad gtong ba brub/ /kyi/ deng 'dir lha tshogs dam can rnams/ /dgra sri sdig can khug la 'chings/ /brub dang mnan pa'i las mdzod cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / snga dgra lag gis byas pa brub/ / phyi dgra bsam zhing sbyor ba brub/ /da dgra thad du ldang ba brub/ /zas kyi ma la du dug g.yos brub/ /nyal ba'i gnas su rtsang 'dzugs brub/ / sngon nas yib cing sgug pa brub/ / rgyub nas rang san 'ded pa brub/ /zungs shig sod cig zer ba brub/ /choms shig 'phrog cig zer ba brub/ 1dmag jag rkun gsum thoms pa brub/ / mi 'os ma bshags zer ba brub/ / ma bstod ma bkud zer mi brub/ / kha 'jam khong sgyub byed mi brub/ / chings brub non cig mā ra ya/ /kyi/ shar phyogs rgya yi dgra sri mā ra ya/ /lho phyogs 'jang gi dgra sri mā ra ya/ /nub phyogs mon gyi dgra sri mā ra ya/ / byang phyogs hor gyi dgra sri mā ra ya/ / ge ser dmag gi dgra sri mā ra ya/ / mi zhim sdug kun sten ba mā ra ya/ / mi theg khun ngan khur ba mā ra ya/ / brgya kha mang gi gleng ba mā ra ya/ /stong mig nang gi lta ba mā ra ya/ /byams pa'i gnyen rnams 'a spyod pa mā ra ya/ /dgra sdang khong dgod 'chor ba mā ra ya/ /pho brgyus mda' ltar gsor ba mā na ya/ /mo brgyas 'phang bal ltan g.yeng mā ra ya/ /kyi/ btsun pas ja gral gleng ba mā na ya/ /sngags pas tshogs gral gleng ba mā ra ya/ / skye bos mda' gral gleng ba mā ra ya/ / bud med thag bran gleng ba mā ra ya/ /mgron pos lam nas gleng ba mā na ya/ /tshong mas chang gral gleng ba lda na ༵/76/gsan pos sgrub gral gleng ba mā ra ya/ /mgad bas so mal gleng ba mā ra ya/ /

rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dgra 'ching dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i zhags pa bzhugs so/ /jag pas skung sar gleng ba mā na ya/ / kyi/ byud kha phur kha bod gtong mā ra ya/ / rmas ngo mdun ngo spyod ngo mā na ya/ / sde brgyad gdug pa'i bod gtong mā na ya/ /gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems mā na ya/ /mi mthun gnod pa thams cad mā na ya/ /lo zla zhag dus bkrags ngan mā ra ya/ / spur spe lo yi gegs zub mā ra ya/ / rgan gzhon dar ma'i sri rnams mā da ya/ /phyugs kyi god 'dre god sri mā ra ya/ / zas la gang stong zhugs pa mā ra ya/ / srid la byun 'gong zhugs pa mā ra ya/ /rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa mā ra ya/ /kyi/ dgra bo'i rigs rgyud thams cad mā na ya/ / dgra bo'i phung khams skye mched mā ra ya/ / dgra bo'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis mā na ya/ /dgra bo'i mgon skyabs lha rnams mā ra ya/ /dgra bo'i bsrung 'khod sngags nus mā ra ya/ / dgra bo'i kha rje dbang thang mā ra ya/ / dgra bo'i tsho dang bsod nams mā na ya/ /dgra bo'i zas skal 'thung skal mā ra ya/ /dgra bo'i blo ngan bsam sbyor mā na ya1 /dgra bo'i 'ju thag rten phur mā ra ya/ /dgra la mi 'dod sna dgu thongs/ /hūṃḥ dpal chen rta mgrin 'khor dang bcas/ / bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / sdang dgra gdon bgegs bar chad tshogs/ /dgra ngo dgra sri dgra bdud rnams/ /zungs cig chings shig rnam par sdoms/ / khug cig drongs shig dbang du bsdus/ / sod cig sgrol cig rengs par gyis/ /phye cig non cig rmugs par gyis/ /thul cig choms shig rnam par shig /rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ / ces sngags brjod/ de nas phyag len la me thog tu chu blugs la sa rlung la sogs pa'i 'byung ba'i 'i mnan pa 'di brjod do/ / ka/ dgra bo'i me khams thams cad ni/ /'byung ba chu yis gtan la sod/ /re/ dgra bo'i sa khams thams cad ni/ /'byung ba me yis bsregs la shig /yi/ dgra bo'i chu kams thams cad ni/ /'byung ba rlung gis skoms la gtor/ / lo/ dgra bo'i rlung khams thams cad ni/ / 'byung ba sa yis khob la non/ /khams bzhi 'byung bzhis thal ban rlogs/ /saṃ/ thal 'jam gnam lcags ri dab 'dis/ /dgra bo brub rjes dong kha chod/ /mun pa nag po'i gling du chug /lnga phung ri rab 'og tu non— / phaṭa/ gdug pa'i re nag dmu khebs 'dis/ / dgra bo dgra sri sdig can sgyu/ /mgo la khob la sbos su chug / rmongs dang bcings dang brgyul bar mdzod/ / hūṃḥbadud dang gshin rje'i zhags pa 'dis/ / dgra sri gdug pa'i ske mgul chings/ /yan lag lcags sgrog dam pas sdoms/ /g.yo 'gul med par khug 'a chings/ /hūṃḥ drag po'i phur bu stobs ldan 'dis1 / dgra sri gdug pa'i snying la gzir/ / dran pa'i dbang bo myos su chugs/ / phung khams skye mched rdul du rlogs/ /yo badzra kyi li kyi la ya ba sri ka 1 7 ༷ can

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thams cad kyi tsitta la baṃ baṃ sarba du / mā ra ya rbad rbad/ hūṃḥ dbang chen bka' sdod dam can rnams/ /gzugs kyi ye shes spyan ma rtul/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs rtsal ma zhan/ /phyag mtshan mtshon cha ngar ma chung / / bos pa'i dus su snyan ma sra/ / bsten pa'i dus su rgyang ma ring / /rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung 1 1dus la bab po sa ma ya/ /bcol ba'i phrin las thub par mdzod/ / bskul lo dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / dpang bor bzhag go gang bden gzigs/ /gzu bod bzhag go drang bad chod/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor thugs rjes zungs/ /bdag la gang brnyas khyod la brnyas/ / dgra sri nyes can de rnams kyi/ / kha sbyor phyed la don snying phyungs/ /rgyu ma drongs la sko nags mdzod/ /pags pa bshus la g.yang gzhi mdzod/ /rnam shes 'og min gnas su drongs/ /phung bo dam can tshogs kyis nol/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ / rgya gram gyis kha bcad/ ri rab kyis mnan la/ mdun gyi dam can rnams kyi dmag tshogs dang / dang nyid kyi sku las spros pa'i dam can gyi tshogs thams cad chas te/ gnon pa'i sa gnas der song bar gyur/ mdun gyi chos skyong srung ma'i lha tshogs dang rang nyid 'khor bcas kyis dgra bo dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi ban du/ g.yo 'gul med par mnan par bsam la gnon pa'i sa gnas der song nas mnan par las sngags brjod/hūṃḥ mnan ni ri rab 'og tu mnan/ / rdo rje rgya gram 'bar bas mnan/ / 'khon lo rtsibs stong ldan pas mnan/ /bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong du/ /nam yang ldang bar ma gyun cig / 'phang ngo rgya mtsho'i gting du 'phang/ / gtad do gshin rje'i lto ban chug / sbyin no klu bdud za ban sbyin/ / bskal pa'i mtha' las ban du mnan/ / mnan no ldang du med par mdzod/ /yo sro bha ni sri bha ni/ gro sna grotna / gritna pa ya gro sna pa ya/ ma na ya ho/ bha ga wan/ sgyi na tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ yo ma/ āḥlo/ hūṃ lo/ ste bha ya rakṣa mā na ya nan/ de nas bro brdung ba ni/ hūṃ/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i spyi gtsug nas/ /mkha' lding rgyal bos bro gcig brdung / / dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mgrin pa nas/ / rta mgrin rgyal bos bro gcig brdung / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i snying ga nas/ /phyag na rdo rjes bro gcig brdung / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i lte ba nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nus bro gcig brdung / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gsang gnas su/ /yasga me dbal bro gcig brdung / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gzugs gzhi la/ / rgyal chen sde bzhis bro gcig brdung / / dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khog pa la/ /lha srin sde brgyad bro gcig brdung / / rnal 'byor rkang ba g.yas bas bro gcig brdung / / pho ba tha~X byed daX du rlogs/ / rnal 'byor rkang ba g.yon pas bro gcig brdung / / mo

rta mgrin gsang spub kyi dgra 'ching dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i zhags pa bzhugs so/ /bdud thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/ /thabs shes gnyis kyis bro gcig brdung / /gdon bgegs thal ba'i rdul du zlogs/ /brdung ni chos nyid ngang du brdung / /dgra bgegs thams cad mā na ya nan/ dgra ba1gas thams cad snyi bha ya nan/de nas zlog pa byus la bsrung 'khon bsgoms pa ni/ nang gi thugs ka' hūṃ las 'od zen 'phros pas 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i na ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur/ phyi nol gyi steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad ye shes kyi 'od zer bskal pa'i me lta bus bskor bar gyun/ de nas lam rgyu gram mam/ lab btses sam/ mchod rten gyi 'og gam gang 'thad pan mnan/ nang du 'ong nas phyin zlog bya/ bsrung 'khor bsgom pa sogs byu'o/ /ces rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dgra 'ching dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i zhags pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rnal 'byor pa padma badzra gyis mdzad pa'i mgon po'i 'phrin las kyi dgra 'ching la gzhi byas kha bsgyur cung zad byus te bkod pa 'dis dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon chan shog cig / nyang snang mdzad rdo rjes so/ /

nga / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom rtsogs bsgrigs/zur bkod/nga / /gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje din po che'i sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thad byung tshul utpa la'i chun po1na mo gu ru badzra dha na ya/ spros bral gdod ma'i dbyings nas kun tu bzang / /kha spyon yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje sems/ / sna tshogs sprul ba'i gad bsgyur padma 'byung / / rnam gsum dbyen med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gser ljongs chu lhar phyogs pa'i pyon khung du/ /gsang chen chos kyi sgron me 'degs pa po/ /rig 'dzin chen po shrī wan mgi yi/ /skru drin dran tshe snying nas dad pa g.yo/ / sna nam zlos gan ho du ka dpal mchog / snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rtsa lag rig pa 'dzin/ /dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med ces grags pa'i/ /grub dbang 'khor lo'i mgon po phyag gi yul/ / snying rje'i rang gzugs phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /ngur sprig zlos gar bsgyur ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ / gtan gyi skyabs gcig tshogs drug rang grol rje/ /mi 'bra' spyi gtsug 'khon lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ / snang srid zil gnon padma ku da yi/ / thugs rje'i zlos gar gsang chen bstan pa'i bdag /drin can sna tshogs rang grol 'di phyi'i mgon/ /snang grag rigs gsum chos dbyings chen por rtogs/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i mdzad 'phrin phyogs brgyar rgyas/ /snga 'gyur gsang chen rdo rje zeg pa yi/ / bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos byang chub bar du skyongs/ /gang de'i gsang gsum yon tan kun gsal mtha'/ / 'tshol la mkhas dbang ga du ṭa ngal na/ /bdag lta'i pha wang rmongs pas gshog brkyangs tshe/ /mkhas pas mthong tshe khyel ba'i gad mo bro/ /'on kung dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /bdag cag rjes 'jug tshogs gnyis yol ba'i phyir/ /zhing khams gzhan du gzigs pa yol ba'i tshul/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig yi ger 'god pa la/ /rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs sprin phung 'thibs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i glog 'od kun tu 'khyug /gsang gsum yon tan dbyun skyes rnga chen sgras/ /dad ldan mdongs mtha'i tshogs gnyis mngal khur sprum/ / phan bde'i dpal la 'god pa'i chan rgyun gyis/ / rjes 'jug gdul bya'i zhing sa sim gyur nas/ / byang chub sems gnyis snye ma ba za ḍi~X / —/ don gnyis 'bras bu smin par byen gyis rlobs/ /

gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje'i sku tshe tha ma'i rnam zar/g.yun za zhing / / don gnyis 'bras bu smin pad byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' du ma'i rnam 'phrul yin par gor ma chag cing lung 'dren kung yod la/ khyad pan rtsod med kyi lo tsā ba chen po bee no tsa na dang / bla ma rin chen bzang po la sogs par sku'i skye ba bzhes tshul/ gzhan yang grub dbang tsho 'du ba padma klong yangs rin po ches dam pa 'di nyid kyi skyes 'phreng gsungs yod pa tshor bltas na snga mo nas mngon par byung chub kyang / dag dang ma dag pa'i gdul bya'i snang ngod gang 'dul gyi skun bstan nas 'gro don mdzad pa mtha' yas shing / rang cag gi dpal du byon pa'i sku tshe 'di nyid kyi rnam thar dkas rim tsam zhig rje nyid kyis mdzad pa ltan las/ gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan rmad po che blun rmongs bdag 'dra'i brjod bya'i yul las 'das shing / 'di lta bu 'bri ba la spobs pa'i mthu dpal dang bral yang spyi brtol bskyed de/ dam pa mchog gi bka' drin rjes su dran zhing thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir dang / ma 'ongs gdul byu rnams la dad gdung mos pa bskyed phyir sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar 'bri ba la yid phyogs so/ / de ci ltar 'bri na rnam pan thar ba mdon bsdus kyis mtshams sbyar te mya ngan las 'das pa la nye zhing mngon par phyogs pa'i tshul/ yang dag don la gzhol ba rnams brtson pa ches cher bskyed pa dang /rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba sogs dgos pa du ma zhig la brten nas glo bur du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul/ sbu gdung rin chen dkyil 'khor spyo mtsho'i bdag por byas nas gdul bya mchog dman kun gyis mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing zhugs la spyangs te sku gdung ring bsrel phebs pa rnams nang cag gi tshogs rdzogs shing skye rgu'i zhing mchog tu mchod sdong rin po che bskrun te dge tshogs gong 'phel bsngo smon shis brjod dus gsum gzigs pa'i brda bar ༵ st+ri/nga za/da ngom slad bka' bstsal ba'i mtha' brten pa'i tshul dang gsum gyi sgo nas bri de yang gsang chen bstan pa'i rtsa lag gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po nyang gi mtshams pa zhes grags snyan nam mkha'i glang bo'i sgra ltar ldir ba'i skyes mchog chen po 'di nyid kyi rnam than rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu las chu thigs tsam zhig dad pa'i lhag phran gzhon nus 'thor na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bshes gnyen zhi ba dul ba nyer zhi ba/ / yon tan lhag par brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs la smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba srungs la brten/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dul ba tshul khrims kyi bslad pa ka 8 1/ bka ba

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang / nye bar zhi ba shes rab kyi bslab pa ste/ bslab gsum nor bu'i rgyan gyis spras shing / 'phags non rin chen bdun gyis phyug pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid chung dus nas dam pa'i chos sgon zhugs shing / dab tu byung ste bsnyen par rdzogs nas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mang du bsten cing khyad par nges pa don gyi rdo rje 'chang chen po skyabs mgon zhabs dkan pa rin po che rigs kyi bdag po du brten/ sras kyi thu bor gyun cing bka'i bsdu ba po mdzad/ phyogs kyi phal mo che'i gdul byu spyi dang / mtsho g.yas g.yon/rma phan tshur/ nong 'brog pa kun la phebs nas rang rang gi mos ngor 'tsham pa'i zhi lhas dbang drag gi las rab 'byums kyi sgo nas gdul bya mang po la phan bde bstsal cing / khyad par reb kong gsen mo ljongs kyi sngags mang phur thogs stong dang lnga brgyus mtshon dad ldan gyi slob ma yon bdag rnams la zab mo gdams pas gang 'dod kyi re ba bskang zhing las ldan gyi gdul bya phal cher smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ skal ldan las snang dag pa'i snang ngon sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba du ma bstan cing / khyung dgon sgyu 'du khang gsar bzhengs byed pa'i skabs1 lnga ba'i tshes dgu'i snga mo ka kha bslang dus sprin 'thibs nas char chen po 'bab la khad byas tshe/ yo rgyan zlos gar sna tshogs rang grol rin po ches/ dam pa 'di nyid la de ring char babs na ka kha bslang mi thub pas dkad gtor dang gsor skyems btang yang / nag phyogs bdud rigs kyi 'tshe ba rtsom pas/ ngas bdud 'dul gyi sgo nas gzir/ khyod kyis drang sbong dri med lo ka'i nga rgyal gyi sgo nas gzid ces gsungs pas/ de bzhin mdzad tshe nam mkha'i sprin rnams glo bur du yal/ nyi ma yang 'od lam gyis shan 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo zhig kyang 'then byung bas sbu phyogs rin po che'i zhal nas/ de ring char chen po ma babs pad ka kha bslangs shing thams cad kyi ston mo byed thub pa 'di ni nyang mtshams rin po che'i sku drin yin/ khong gi gzigs snang la dam pa 'di nyid drang sbong dri med khro bo'i sku yongs rdzogs su snang zhing / dam sri gdug pa can dang ban gcod byed pa rnams tshan bcad cing dbang du bsdus pa sogs mngon sum du mthong ngo zhes khong gi zhal nas thos/yang tho rgya'i ya myun gyi sku rim zhig la phebs skabs/ lha 'dres brlams pa'i rgya mo zhig gis da reb kyi dpon 'di la mig gsum yod pa ral ba'i gseb nas rta skad 'tshen zhing rta'i kha nas me 'bar te/ nged rang tsho 'dug pa'i gnas med pa'i chu chen po'i pha nol tu song zer bas/ ma song na snying len par 'dug pas da nga'i 'khor na yod pa thams cad shog zer zhing ngu ༷༷da ༵8 spya da— bcas mkhar gyi phyi nol du bros nas kha spub tu 'gyil lo/ / de nas yun

gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mtshud rdo ji'i sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar/ring gi ban du shi 'dres mi gnod pa byung bas spyo mi thams cad dad cing gus par gyur to/ /yang dan grong la sdong nge dang skyi tshang nas kha mchu byung skabs mi ngan zhig gis gces phrug 'ga' phyi lag sprad yod pa'i thog tu dar grong gi dmag chas tshe/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis gsan nas chos 'jig rten gyi bslab ston gnang yang kha nas nyan khul byus te lkog nas 'gro bar thag bcad pa'i tshe/ da ci tsig byed snyam/ skad cig de nyid la/ 'phags mchog lo ki shā ra'i skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zen 'phros/ yul lha u zur gyi snying kan phog pas sngon gyi dam bca' rjes su dran par bsgoms te yul lha'i sku 'bag gi mgo thog tu skyabs mgon rin po che'i gsung 'bum bzhag nas dam brdan byas te yul du phebs rjes nas yul lha sku babs pas/dar grong gi kha drag can gyi tsho steng gi mi gsum mdun du bos te/ khyed dang mi rnams la khrel med/ nged tshos dam bcas pa mi 'dor bas byums brtse'i gten chen skyabs mgon yab gras kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing / na gsum dmar mchod byed pa 'di tshe thar gyis/ kha mchu yang nges pan 'grigs dgos/ gal srid khyed rnams kyis dmar mchod dang dmag 'khrug gi las byed na/ ngas khyod rnams skyabs 'og nas bral 'ongs zhes zhal gsungs drag po phebs tshe thams cad skrag nas ra gsum tshe thar du phul/ myur bar kha mchu 'grigs su bcug go /yang bkra shis 'khyil ba na bzhugs skabs gnyer ba blo bzang bstan pas/ a lags nor bu rin po che'i drung nas sha bcad gong chigs chag med du byed pa mdun du 'khod tsho/bka' las khyod kyis sha mi za ba dang gong tshogs chab len byed pa shin tu legs kyang / sang gnangs da tsam jo mo nol du khrid cing / jo phrug pang du bzung ste gsang rdon gyi steng du bse dug gi nad kyang 'byung ngam gsungs tshe/ khos bzhad gad cig btang ste de 'dra mi byed thag chod yin lags zhus tshe/ 'o de yin na bzang gsungs/ phyir lo de 'dra'i spyod ngan byas pas ji lta ba byung bas 'gyod de dam pa'i drung nas bshags pa yang yang byas skad/yang rkun ma zhig la 'u gas gnyis kyi bslab bya gnang ste khyod kyis rkus dang me mda'i 'phrul 'khor gyi tshong ma byed dang bzang / khad mi nyan na lo gsum gyi 'phro nas khyod rang gzhan gyis bsad yong gsungs tshe/ 'phral zhal gsung ltar byus kung / zla ba gnyis gsum ༈ bye shi na/ sa ngan lang du song nas yang mi 'tsham pa'i las byas pas lo gsum gyi 'phro nas mtshon yang dge steng thang gi 'brog pa na bzhugs skabs/ sku mdun la mjal du song tshe/bdag la spis dkar gyi mtha' la khyod kyis chu lo zhig brkos/ do nub nya1 mi ༵༵3 paX ༷ra

sa / /nyang skyes snang mtshud rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thog chen po zhig yong nyen gda' gsungs pas/ bdag gis chu rka brkos tshe/ padma thar zer ba'i bon rgan zhig gis gnam thang yod pa la chu rkas ci byed zed bas/ mtshan mo glo bud du thog 'brug glog gsum dang bcas te sen ba drag po babs pas/ bon rgan gyis bkag nas ma khog tshe kha nang du 'don pa yang ma 'ong bar shal shal sbogs myogs lta bu bton tshe/ dam pa mchog gis rtse mtshar du sha sha sbogs sbogs zen lugs kyis/ lhag rnams nang bar sha pyogs du btang nas bzhag na nam langs dus ltad mo sna tshogs lta rgyu yod/ gsungs nas bzhad pan gda'/ nam langs tshe lug gnyis gsum re shi nas khyi dang lug rdzi gnyis kyis 'then res byed pa dang / de'i bar la glang thug cig dang g.yag gnyis brdung res byas pas bon rgan tshang gi sbos tse 'ang rdzogs nas thams cad kyis dbyug pa dang phyags ma thogs nas 'ur 'ur chem chem byas tshe dam pa'i zhal nas a nog yar longs dang ltad mo sna tshogs snang gsungs che nga rang sbos dkar gyi sgor bud nas bltas pas/ bon rgan gyis lug mgo zhig bzung / rdzi bos khyi'i kha nas 'phrog pa'i sha pags de bzung nas thon/ g.yag cig gis sbos tse rwa mgor khur nas 'gro ba mthong che dgod kha chen po zhig dbang med du shor/ den sngar nyin gyi gsung de dur gyis dran nas dad pa dung dung ba zhig skyes so/ /yang nyes can gyi dgra zhig la mngon spyod kyi las bgyis pas/ dgra bo kho rang gis ma bzod pan dam pa'i drung du bshags pa byed du 'ongs tshe glo bud du 'tshub ma nag po zhig gis 'un sgra dang bcas te dgra de nyid la bskor pas kha spub tu 'byel te sna khrag mang po byung zhing re zhig dran med du brgyal ba'i rjes nas dran pas zin tshe lhag pan skrag cing snying nas bshags pa byas te 'di skad zer/ bla ma rin po che'i mdun nas mi nag po 'jigs su dung ba/ mig nas 'od 'phro ba lag na mda' gzhu thogs pa zhig mthong bas skrag ste brgyal song zer/ de'i skabs mdun na gling rgya'i mi grags can snying lo zer ba'i dpa' rtsal can zhig yod pa de yang nyid rin po che la shin tu dad pan gyur nas 'di skad zer/ a bla ma mkhyen chos skyong mngon ༈rdo /yod zen ba 'di 'dra los yin/ phyin chad thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor zen yang nyin gcig mdun na 'khod pa rnams la/ de ring lo tog 'joms pa'i ser ba drag po zhig 'bab nyen yo da gsungs tshe/ dar grong rdo rje tshe lo zed ba'i rgad po mkhas pa zhig yod pa des/ bla ma rin po che bzhugs thog lo 'bras ser bas bcom na gling na bu rab dang /ba rta2 bye~X med rtags red zhus che/ khyed tshos rin chen byen pa'i chung ma la kha mi 'gro

gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje'i sku tshe za ma'i rnam thar/dus/ bdag gis gtum chen 'bar ba'i sde ba spyod la kha 'gro ba'ang dka' gsungs tshe/thams cad bzhad gad thag ge ba zhig byung / phyi dro de la thog sgra glog zhags dang bcas ser ba drag po babs pas/ dam pa mchog gis 'bru bcud lo tog thams cad bsrung ba'i gud khang du bcug pas/ spyo lam gyi gong yul lha lcang shar gyi ri ngogs la ser ba gangs ri ltan chags na'ang / lam 'og na zhing yod pa'i lo thog gi nang la ser ba yungs 'thu tsam yang ma babs pas thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /yang smad pa sde bdun dang gling rgya gnyis sgod la thug skabs shig ri rtsa'i sngags 'chang gu du skyabs la rtse mtshan du ka pa la yi steng du thog ltar spyob zer bas ka phreng go ldog gi bskul ba zhig gsungs pas/ kho rang rnam rtog langs nas kha mchu'i bar 'dir de 'dra mi gsungs pad zhu zhus tshe/ zhal nas 'dzum bzhin rnam rtog ma mang ban bla ma la snying nas gsol ba thobs dang mgo bo lcags las kyang sra ba'i skyabs 'jug lha la byed gsungs/ rjes nas dmag la song dus mgo la me mdas phog kyang skyon ma byung bas bla ma'i thugs rje yin snyam dad gus che ru song skad/ gzhan yang lha khang mtshams pa mkhar 'bum byams/ ya du'i sngags 'chang rgya mtsho/ dad ldan rin chen 'bum/ nag rgya'i sngags 'chang tshe brtan/ bis mdo'i slob bu sangs rgyas dpal/ 'ja' mo'i lha bzo klu 'bum rgyal/ rdzong dkar dad ldan bsod nams 'bum/ rang cag la sogs pa la bka' gang bstsal rnams kyis lkog gyur mngon du mkhyen te dad gus bla lhag tu 'phel ba byung / dkan rtse gdong sde bas mtshon nong 'brog gi dgon grong phal chen la ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan gnang ba thams cad kyi thog tu khel cing kun la dad gus dag snang gong 'phel du gyur/ de lta bu'i gsang ba gsum gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i rmongs pa bdag 'dras lta ci/ gsung gi dbang phyug la dbang 'byod ba dag gis kung dpog par dka' ba'i gnas so/ /de ltar ngo mtshad rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa mtha' yas pa bstan zhing re zhig zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs nas tha ma'i mdzad pa ston pa la nye ba'i skabs shig slob 'bangs kyi tha shal ba bdag mjal du song bas nyid kyis gsung 'bum la gzigs rtog gnang ba'i skabs shig la thon pa'i phyag gsum 'tshal nas mjal byen rlabs gnang mthar bka' las/ 'o bu khyod kyis nga'i rnam mgur gyi mjug bsdu dgos/ gzhan mkhas pa tshos/ bdag lta bu'i gsung 'bum gyi bsdu ba mi byed/ rang yang rgan po 'chi la nye ba'i rtsom khom med gsungs zhus pa bdag ni skyes spyangs kyi yon tan dman zhing bka' yi bsdu ba po mdzad pa'i spobs ldas ka 8 1 5 dben te/

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/da dung rnam mgur gyi mjug bsdu ba'i tshad min lags zhus pas/ zhal rgyan dang mag tshom dkar po du song ba tsho bstan nas e go gsungs/ rmongs pa bdag gis yid la cang ma shar bar bdag la dregs pa so drug gi 'khon lo'i man ngag dang sngags sdebs rnams gsung rgyu'i bka' drin 'tshal zhus tshe/ tshems bul song ba tsho bstan nas/ da ban du ci la bsdad/'chi kha de 'dra mi gsungs lo rjes ma la shog dang rgyas pa zhig byas nas bshad gsungs/ da dung nyid rin po ches dus rgyun ku re gnang ba de yin pa 'dra snyam pas sems la cang ma dran/khyod la dgos na 'di gnang gsungs nas zab lam rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang / gnas lugs don gyi rang ngo skyong tshul sogs zhal gdams kyi mgur zhig kyang gnang ba byung /yang reb kong sngags mang la zhal gdams 'di bris nas bstsal byung / mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpal gyis mtshan/ / sna nam zlos gar nam mkha' 'jigs med zhabs/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag tshogs drug nang grol rje/ / dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis dge legs stsol/ / sngon nas da bar sngags mang 'grigs lam la/ / sha tsha snying nye'i ngang nas sha stag tu/ /tshags bzung srol bzang btsugs shing dar rgyas byas/ /mi rgan 'chi kha'i gtam la cung zhig gson/ / dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'tshogs pa'i skal ldan rnams/ / lus sems bde dus dam chos rem la gyis/ / na rgas non tshe byed 'dod 'byung na yang / / sgrub par dka' 'o 'di yang snying gtam yin/ / chos thog ma ṇi'i sgrub chen ji bzang thongs/ / chos min bya spyod ngan pa dug bzhin spongs/ / chos khrims bca' yig nang ltar brtsi ba las /chos 'gal ma byed 'di yang snying gi gtam/ /las sna'i khur 'dzin rnams nas sha stag gis/ /bstan pa rin chen rgyas pa'i thabs la 'bod/ /'tshogs tshad kun gyis bla ma dge bskul gyi/ /zhal gsungs sgrub dgos 'di yang snying gi gtam/ /mdor na mang po smra la dgos pa chung / /skyabs mgon dam pa'i gsung mgur nang ltar rtsis/ / bdag la 'brel thogs gang zag pho mo rnams/ /dag pa'i zhing khams lnga ru mjal bar shog /da 'di khyer la sngags mang gi 'dus tshogs steng du phul/ bdag 'dras ci tsam bshad kyang ka la nyan mkhan dkon/ 'on kyang dad ldan re gnyis la phan par snyam nas bris pa yin gsungs/yang nang sku mdun na yod skabs shig la tshos srid kun la blo gros rgyas shing rtogs ldan don gyi rnal 'byon pa chen po sbas pa'i tshul 'dzin sngags 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang /rnam dpyod blo mig yangs pa'i padma rig 'dzin gnyis mjal du yong nas/ ma ṇi'i sgrub chen sgyu sdig le~X byeng— / dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa/ lto 'phye'i thig rnams slob dgos tshul zhus

gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje'i sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar/pas/ tsha bo rgya mtsho dang / nged rang rnams la dgyes bzhin bslabs nas 'o da ni rigs kyi bu khyod rnams kyis nga'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa las rgyu 'bras dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgoms/dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis/ khyad pad sngags mang gi chos srid gang la dngos sam brgyud nas phan gang thogs la rem/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan la khyod rang nga'i bla tshab gyis la bca' yig gi nang ltar 'grigs lam kun spyod sdoms/ tshags 'dzin dang do dam gang drag gyis la ji legs je spyos su thongs dang phan thogs yong gsungs nas phyag dpe 'ga' gnang zhing 'di khyer la gang thad nas bstan pa la phan thogs pa zhig gyis gsungs che/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan nyid rin po che gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i skyes bu chen po yin gshis lo brgya phrag cig la ci nas kyang bzhugs dgos/ bdag lta bu'i rang don tshags su ma chud pas gzhan gyi 'go 'dren byed pa 'di shin tu dka' bas dam pa nyid nas sngar rgyun ltar thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ bka' las mi rgan nga rang gi bya ba mtha' dag tshar nas da ni ngal gso ba'i dus la babs khyed rnams kyis skyabs mgon chos kyi rgyal bo'i rnam thar rjes su kha mig yar blta byed e thub ltos/ de min kyang ngas gang bshad pa tsho ma brjed par sems la chongs/ de min bshad rgyu med gsungs pas thams cad kyi sems pham po zhig byung zhing byin rlabs zhus te rang yul du log de nas ya ru'i dbyar chos kyi steng du phebs nas sngags mang la 'di ltar gdams/ 'o dmar sprig cod pan 'chang ba'i rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshom bu la cung zad cig zhu rgyu/ khyed rnams la phan du re nas sngan ngas gang bshad pa de las lhag cig zhu rgyu med mod/ 'on kyang rang yang na so rgas nas 'chi la nye bas da khyed rnams kyis chos srid legs tshogs dang bstan pa rin po che rgyas par 'dod na 'grigs lam kun sbyod thams cad chos dang mthun pa zhig byed dgos/ khyad pan bca' yig gi nang ltar 'grigs lam rtsis la ma ṇi'i sgrub chen dang chos thog je bzang du thongs/sngon byon skyes chen mang po'i gsung dang sngags rgan gong ma tsho'i phyag bzhes bzang po ma nyams pa gyis/ ngas dus rgyun bshad pa tsho sems la bzhag nas/ nab kyis ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal bsten nas gong ma'i rnam thar skyong ba/ 'bring gis lo mtshams zla mtshams la bsdad nas zab mo'i sgom sgrub la gzhol ba dang / tha mas kyang rang nus kyis dge sbyor la ci spyogs byed pa las ma rabs kyi bya ba sbog gcod rkus dang / dud chang la sogs pa gtan nas mi byed pa gal che/ nga'i bla tshab tu rig bzang blo gsal kun dga' rgyal mtshan bzhag yod pas dad gus dag snang gyis la gsung brtsi dgos/ bla rgan nga'i rang don rdoga~X ༵ chud kas

ga / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan gdul bya mang po la dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs pa byung / da phyin chad chos thog gi mgor yang 'ong bar dka' bas skyabs mgon rin po che dang rje btsun sna tshogs rang grol bka' drin can glo bun du zhing khams gzhan du dgongs tshul sogs gsungs nas sprun chab 'byin zhing thams cad kyi mig nas mchi ma byung zhing sems sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba ma gtogs ci yang zhu ma nus so/ /yang dgu ba'i nyer bzhi'i nyin bdag mjal du song tshe dus rgyun du zhal ras 'dzum bzhin bsu ba las/ de'i nyin thugs shin tu skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas phyag g.yas pa bdag gi mgo thog tu bzhag ste slob bu khyod kyi sems na ci yod/ 'chi bdag gi bdud po kho thog tu byung tshe gzhan gang gis kyang byol ban dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang khyad par nam 'chi cha med yin tshul soms la dam pa'i chos la brtson cig gsungs te yar bzhengs nas khyod kyis bzhugs gdan 'di khyer la phyi rol gyi sa gzhi khod yangs sa zhig nas thongs gsungs tshe btings pas der bzhugs/ de dus dar grong gi sangs rgyas bkra shis la sogs pa 'ga' yang 'ongs/ padma bstan 'dzin dang rang cag rnams mdun du 'khod che/ skyabs mgon rin po che zhing khams su phebs tshul cung zad gsungs shing / khyad par skye 'chi la rang dbang 'byor ba'i o rgyan chen po'i zlos gad rje btsun sna tshogs nang grol rin po che dus ngan gyi byu spyod la thugs skyo zhing / lha min gyi brtul zhugs 'chang ba la dga' ba sbyin phyir glo bur du gshegs pa la thugs rab tu skyo ste/ a ho ho mi rgan nga da ban du ci la bsdad gsungs nas sprun chab mang po bsil cing / 'di skad gsungs/ bla ma dran pa sems kyi dbyengs su thims/ /sems nyid ma bcos skye med klong du a/ /zhes gsungs shing spyan gyi lta stangs nam mkhar gzigs nas yun ring zhig bzhugs te/ de nas 'o khyed rang rnams lus sems bde dus gti mug no nyal dang rnam g.yeng le lo'i dbang du ma gtong bad 'chi ba mi rtag pas rgyud bskul la nang rang gang mos kyi chos la 'bad pa gal che bas/ slob dpon chen po nas/ na so gzhon dus dam chos rem la sgyus/ / rgas nas byed 'dod 'byung yang chun par dka'/ /gsungs pas/ dge sbyor la nyin mtshan kun du 'bod/ chos 'jig rten gang byed kyang bsam pa bzang po 'di'i sgo nas gzhan la phan thogs pa re gyis/ de min kyang sdig spyod kyi las dang ma rabs kyi bya ba ngan pa dug bzhin du spongs/ mdor na 'chi kha mi 'gyod pa zhig ci nas kung byed dgos pas thams cad kyis yid la chongs/ nga rang rgas pa'i mtshan mas non ba ya~X bye mchog gi gshegs shul du bsnyegs thub pa zhig byung na dga' gsungs tsho ston

gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje'i sbu tshe tha ma'i rnam thar/mtha'i me tog spang rgyan sngon po zhig phyag gis blangs nas 'di skad gsungs/ sa nas skyes pa'i me tog / sa la phyi chags ma byed/ / sa gzhi blo yis thongs la/ / sar gnas dkon mchog mchod cig /nyang nas skyes pa'i mtshams ming / /ming dang don la ma zhen/ /zhen pa nang nas chod la/ / la gor zhing khams stogs shig / gsungs pas/ sangs rgyus bkra shis dang / padma bstan 'dzin nged nang sogs kyis/ lags da dung de 'dra'i zhal gsung mi gnang ban zhu/ dad ldan gyi gdul byu dang rang cag gi mgon skyabs dam pa du yun ring bar du bzhugs dgos/ zhabs brtan zhig sgrub dgos na nyid kyis ci gsung dang myur du sgrub lags zhus tshe/ nga la zhabs brtan sgrub mi dgos/ nangs bar nyer lnga'i nyin mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas tshogs brgya zhig thongs dang bzang gsungs tshe/ phyi nyin tshogs brgya zhig btang /bsam lhun dang bar chad lam sel/ che sgrub dang / sgrol ma sogs bton nas mjug tu bdag gis rin po che lags khong gi zhal gsung gi bab la brtags na ha cang yid mi ches pas/zhabs brtan gang dgos dang mkha' 'gro'i bsun bzlog cig 'phang na lags zhus pas/ 'o nga la de 'dra'i dgos pa med mod/ khyed tsho'i bar chad sel ba dang / bsam pa'i re 'dod skong phyir de 'dra zhig sgrub na'ang sgrubs gsungs tshe/ sngags 'chang padma rdo rje dang / tsha bo rgya mtsho rang cag la sogs pa'i dad 'dus 'gas zhabs brtan 'ga' yang bsgrubs/ mkha' 'gro'i bsun bzlog cig kyang 'phangs/ de nas lha rdzas dang lha phyag bcas te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan du btab kung / bka' las kho bo bsdad na los 'dod kung 'chi ba'i dus la bab tshe/ gzhan su zhig gis kyang bzlog pan dka'/ lo yang bdun cu don bdun red/ da lo gsum bsdad na brgyad cud bud pa yin kung / lo gsum las zla ba gsum la tshe bsrings thub pa yang dka' mor gda'/ da nga rang che lo mthar phyin lo kha shas bsdad pa la dgos pa med/ 'on kung khyed rnams kyi mos ngor re zhig bar du 'dug pa'i 'dun pa byed/ mda' dar zhig khyer la shog dang mi rgan ngas phywa g.yang zhig 'bod gsungs/der 'khod pa rnams dga' nas mda' dar phyag tu phul tshe/ tshe 'gug dang g.yang 'gug la sogs pa byas nas/ 'o khyed rang rnams kyis nga la zhabs brtan phul nas yun ring bzhugs dgos tshul zhus pa'i rten 'brel gyi mthus/ 'jig rten gyi khams na 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes mchog ji snyed cig mchis pa rnams kyi sbu tsho bskal brgyar brtan zhing rnam dkan gyi mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur sgyus pa dang / yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad la char chu dus su babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs shing / lo yang brgyad cur ba ka 8 1 9 phywa g.yang

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang / nga'i rgyud na yon tan gang yod pa rnams khyed slob ma yon bdag tsha bo yang tsha rnams la byin pa yin pas/ gser srang brgya byin pa las dga' ban mdzod cig gsungs pas/thams cad kyis khong gi gsungs de dogs gzhi can zhig yin pa 'dra snyam ste sems la skyo dga' sna tshogs pa zhig shan ba las gzhan ci zhu ma spobs/ phyi nyin yul du yong skabs tshe rabs kyi zeng ban rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug dang byin rlabs zhus nas mang po ngus che/ da ngu mi dgos sngan bshad pa tsho sems kyis ma brjed par gyis rjes nas skad cig btang dus shog gsungs pas lhag par ngu rgyu zhig byung nas 'bral mi phod bzhin rang yul du log der phyis su mi mjal ba sems kyis tshor ba'ang 'dra/ yang tsha bo gnyis kyis khong gi gsung la brtags na sems mi bde bas zhabs brtan gang drag cig sgrub na lags zhus tshe/ nga rang phung bo bde gsu ḍi~X ༵/ brta/na mi dgos/ khyed rang gnyis la rgyu nom yod na dgos pa'i skabs shig yod ༄ smras pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes dmar sen ral gri can/ / brtse ba'i thugs rje phyag na pad dkar dngos/ / nus mthu'i tsha dbal phyag rdor dang mtshungs pa'i/ / rigs gsum ngo bo mtshan ldan bla mas skyongs/ / gang gi gsang gsum yon tan rmad po che/ / blun rgongs bdag 'dra'i gzhal byu'i yul min yang / / dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs dang rang cag gi/tshogs gnyis spel phyid yi ge'i ris su bkod/ / mgon po gang de chung ngu'i dus nas bzung / /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan phul du gyur/ / gzhon nu'i dus nas mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs bslab gsum rgyan gyis spros/ /mdo sngags gzhung bzhin nyams len byas tshul sogs/ / bka' yi glegs bu'i ngos la nags rim bkod/ / skabs 'gan las snang dag pa'i snang ngo ru/ /sku lus yi dam lha du gsal ba mthong / /dgon grong gang gi mos ldan 'ga' zhig la/ /lkog gyur lung bstan gsungs pa'i thog tu khel/ /thams cad ngo mtshar skyes nas dad cing 'dun/ /skal ldan phal cher smin grol lam la bkod/ /tha ma'i rnam thar skyong la nye ba'i tshe/ / sngags mang spyi la zhal gsungs thugs bkod gnang / /rang cag rnams la spyi dgos bslab bya dang / / mi rtag skyo mgur la sogs zhal gdams bstsal/ /zhabs brtan sgrub ces nan gyis zhus pa'i tshe/ / nga la zhabs brtan mi dgos nyer lnga'i nyin/ / mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas tshogs brgya btang na bzang / / yang zhus mkha' 'gro'i bsun bzlog cig kyang 'phangs/ / brtan bzhugs phul tshe mi nga tshe mthar phyin/ / mi lo ba 'u ༵tsho dzo phywa g.yang dang / /bdag gi rgyud na mchis pa'i yon tan rnams/ /khyed

gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje'i sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar/dang rnams la byin pas dga' bar mdzod/ / ces pa la sogs zhal gsungs dogs gzhi can/ /der 'khod rnams la gsungs tshe som nyir zhugs/ / rje btsun bla ma'i rnam than tha ma ru/ / zhugs pa'i tshul gyi brjod pa de ltad lags/ / da lta bzhugs dang ma 'ongs 'byon 'gyur gyi/ /las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul byu yis/ / tshul 'dir rjes su yi rang bsgom byas la/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis sgrub la brtson par mdzod/ /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ni/ dam pa gang des sbu rlung lta bu'i bsnyung tshul cung zad bstan pa yar mar gyi slob ma yon bdag dad can rnams kyis go nas sku la sbun gzhi ched med kyang / snyun 'dri dang mjal du 'ongs pa la/ zhal gdams dang bka' bsgo byin rlabs gnang ste re 'dod bskang / de nas bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin tsha bo padma bstan 'dzin dang / rgyu mtsho gnyis la gang ci'i thugs bkod gnang zhing / skar yig khyer shog dang khyed tsho'i gnyen ston gyi skar ma la blta gsungs/ 'di'i bco lnga'i nyin bzang /ston mo snga dro gyis la phyi dro nang yul du shog dang do gal chen po zhig yod gsungs/ bdag nyid chen po 'di lta bu la skar ma bzang ngan la re ltos med kyang tshur mthong gi blo ngor gshegs skar la bltas pa'ang 'dra/ de nas tshes bcu'i nyin tshogs 'khor rgyas pa zhig thongs gsungs tsho/ de bzhin byas pas/ tsha bo rgya mtsho la rgyun du zhal 'don byed pa'i dri med bshags rgyud dang / bgrang phreng 'di gnyis yad la zhog gsungs/ ci 'tshal lags zhus tshe/ ngal gso ba'i skabs su bab/ gtor ma brgya rtsa chag med du gtong ba'ang de ring nas mjug bsdus pa yin/ rtsa gsum chos skyong rnams la gtor bsngos byed rgyu'i glegs bam zhig yod pa yang rgya mtsho'i mgo thog tu bzhag nas/ da 'di khyed dang rnams kyis thon dang / las bzhi'i 'phrin las 'grub cing / legs tshogs gong 'phel du 'ong gsungs che/ sems la cang ma dran par khyed kyis cig gsungs dang / nged tshos de 'dra zhig mi 'ong lags zhus tshe/ zhal chems kyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ / rnam 'dren ston pa jo bo tsong kha ba/ / skyabs mgon tshogs drug rang grol la sogs pa'i/ / bshes gnyen zhing gshegs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyang skyes rgan po bdun cu'i hon log gis/ /smra lce bde dus kun la kha chems 'jog / skyes nas ma shin lus pa gcig kyang med/ / rgan po nga yang 'chi ba'i lam la phyogs/ / khyed rnams ma shi gong du lha chos sgrubs/ / 'chi khar dran kyang 'a spyod pa las med do/ /bla ma bsten nas dbang lung nyan pa tsho/ /bla maX ༷ka~X ga gam

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshig srog ltar srungs/ / nga dang 'grogs pa'i sngags mang thams cad kyis/ / cho ga'i phyag len bslabs tshad ma nor zhig / yun ring 'grogs pa'i grwa nogs grogs mched rnams/ /kun dang mthun par 'grogs la brtse gdung mdzod/ / drin gyis bskyangs pa'i bu slob thams cad kyis/ /nga yis gang bshad ma brjed sems la zungs/ /rang yul sde ba tsho ba thams cad kyis/ /mthun par 'grogs nas ka 'go yod par gyis/ /tsha bo yang tsha rnams nas sngon ma'i srol/ /bskang gsol dus gtor la sogs ma chag mdzod/ /rig gnas yon tan bsnyen sgrub mdzad pa dang / /reb kong sngags mang chos thog kun la song / /sngon brten lha dang srung mar blo gtod dang / / 'phrin las myun 'grub nga yi gdan sa zin/ / khyim tshang rnams nas rgan la bkur bsti dang / / mnyam la 'grogs shes nang don ma 'phyug mdzod/ / kun gyis rnam dkar dge la dad pa dang / / ma rabs dud chang rkus sogs dug bzhin spongs/ /mdor na gson dus gang bshad ltar gyis dang / / de las lhag pa'i kha chems 'jog rgyu med/ / ma shi gong 'did lha chos myur du sgrubs/ /kun kung tshe ring nad med smon lam 'debs/ /bdag dang 'brel thogs bu slob nye du rnams/ / ma 'ongs zhing khams lnga du mjal bar shog /gsungs pas/ da dung 'di 'dra'i zhal chems gnang nas kyang / rlung shas lta bu'i sbun gzhi cung zad tsam las med pas myur du gshegs pa la dgongs yod pa cang ma 'tshal/ de nas bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i ban shin tu spros pa med pa'i klong du mnyam pad 'jog pa las zhal 'don kung mi gsungs par bzhugs/ bco lnga'i snga bar gsol ja drangs tshe/ khyed rang rnams dar grong du song la gnyen ston gyis/ nga rang gi khams yang bde song / ha cang nyi ma nub rag gi bar du ma 'dug par shog gsungs tshe/ thams cad kyis ston mo byus nas rang yul du 'ongs nas/ rin po che nyid la dkar skyems zhig drangs tshe gsol nas zhal gsungs snyan mos/ de ring mi dga' lha dga' byas ston mo yag po zhig byas sam gsungs pas/byus lags zhus pas/ 'o mi dga' ba tshos yin da bzang bzang gsungs/de yang dgung lo don bdun gnam lo shing khyi mgo'i zla ba11'brug gi nyi ma2spre'u'i dus tshod la bab tshe/ gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rang gzhan kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam pa gang de'i zhal lho nub tu gzigs te/ zhabs gnyis skyil kung / phyag gnyis sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya dang bcas gzugs sbu'i bkod pa chos dbyengs gdod ma'i klong du mnal ban gyur to/ /de dus 'od phung chen po zhig shar nas nyi zer dang bcas nub phyogs su ba / 29/sbyo char gam du 'khod pa rnams dang / dad grong nas 'ongs pa'i drag zhan thams

gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje'i sku lha tha ma'i rnam thar/cad kyi mig nas mchi ma byung ste/ smre sngags dbyangs su byed cing / kyi ma gu du/ kyi ma bla ma/ rang cag gi mgon skyabs dam pa gang du gshegs/ thugs rje chung lags sam/thugs kyis 'dor phod dam la sogs pa'i 'o dod drag pos 'bod cing thams cad sdug bsngal sgyus non pa byung / slob ngan bdag la dam pa mchog gis bco lnga'i nyin sku mdun du shog ces zhal gsungs bskud ba 'byor kyang / nang nyid bsod nams dman pa'i stabs kyis byis pa zhig la 'brum nad drag po byung bas gzhan dbang du gyur te bco lnga'i nyin 'gro ma thub pas/mtshan mo mi lam du khyod kyi 'dren mchog zhing khams su phebs so zer bas/ gnyid sad tshe sngan nyin gyi skad dang rmi lam 'di la bltas na/ rin po che gshegs song ba 'dra snyam/ phyi nyin snga bar langs nas brel stabs kyis song ste nags 'dabs su thon dus nyang gi sde ba'i thad kyi nam mkha' na 'ja' gur chen po zhig yod pa mthong bas/ gtam 'dri sa'ang ma rnyed par gdan sar sbebs pas gang gi dgongs pa chos dbyengs su bsdus song bas/ bzod glags med pa'i mya ngan chen po byas mang po ngus/ phyogs phyogs nas 'ongs pa thams cad kyis kyang mig nas mchi ma char ltan babs shing / ngag gis gdung dbyangs drag pos gsol 'debs byed pa dpag tu med do/ /smras pa/ rgyal kun snyeng rje'i dang gzugs pad dkar 'chang / / bshes gnyen dam pa'i rnam nol zhabs dkar pa'i/ / bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad pa'i gsung sras mchog / drin can bla mas byang chub ban du skyongs/ /gang de'i gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gyi rigs/ /dam pa'i chos la myur du bskul ba'i phyin/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul/ /blo ldan rnams kyi dran pa'i gsos su 'bul/ / gang gi sku la rlung shas lta bu yi/ / snyung tshul cung zhig bstan pa dad ldan 'gas/ /thos 'dzin yul du gir tshe mjal du 'ongs/ /bka' bsgo byin rlabs zhal gdams gang rgyas bstsal/ / ches bcu'i nyin pan tshogs 'khor rgya chen gnang / / de yan zhal 'don brgya rtsa chag med mdzad/ / tsha bo gnyis la gang ci'i bslab bya dang / / zhal chems la sogs gsung gi bdud rtsi phab/ / bcu gcig nas bzung bco lnga'i ban dag tu/ /shin tu spros med ngang la mnyam par bzhag /bco lnga'i phyi dro gsol ja drangs pa'i tshe/ / khyod tshos ston mo bzang po e byas gsungs/ / byas lags zhus tshe mi dga' chos yin pas/ / bzang bzang gsungs te nyi zer bsdu ba'i skabs/ / lho nub mtshams su zhal gzigs skyel thung bcas/ / phyag gnyis sa gnon mnyam bzhag dang bcas te/ / ngo mtshan ltas dang cho 'phrul ston bzhin du/ / gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi ba ༵ 9ci1/ /

gas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo rje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/der 'khod rnams nas smre sngags 'o dod kyis/ /kye hud mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /bdag cag bzhag nas zhing khams gang du thal/ / byams brtse'i thugs kyi klong nas 'don phod dam/ /zhes pa la sogs smre sngags du ma bton/ yab rje drin can bla ma gang de yi/ /gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul/ /cung zad yi ge'i ris su bkod pa lags/ /skal ldan slob ma dad ldan yon bdag rnams/ / skyo shas nges 'byung drag pos rgyud bskul nas/ /chos la ban chad med pa'i dben gnas su/ /yengs med rtse gcig dge la brtson pan mdzod/ / ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa sku gdung rin po cher mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing / mjug tu bsngo sbon gyis rgyas btab pa'i tshul ni/ de yang rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag dam pa mchog gi sku gdung rin po che'i mdun du/ dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gi mchod pa rgya chen po bshams shing mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol 'debs la 'bad/ skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs pa'i skabs yin pas/ tshur phebs rgyu ma song bas/ sku mdun du/ kha btags nang mdzod che legs dang sku gsung thugs rten 1 dril shel mig na bza' cha tshang / cibs rta sga stan srab gsum sogs tshan grangs sum cu phul/mchog sprul rin po ches dam pa 'di nyid kyi gnas skabs dang mthan thug gi thugs kyi bzhed don mtha' dag 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug dang bsngo smon yang dag pa byas nas sprul sku byur 'byon kyang gsungs nas dkad shog la btab ste tshun la gdung mchod du rta gcig dang kha btags bcas bstsal byung / khyung dgon sprul sku rin po che phebs nas/ rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ sku gdung rin po che dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad par bskyed nas mtshod bstod bdag 'jug blangs/ sprul sku myur 'byon gsungs/thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo smon rgya cher btab/ khong la kha btags 'jam dar ring po gcig kheb bu su'i bzhugs gdan/ das dā dang g.yag gcig bcas phul/ tshud gdung mchod du mar rgya ma bcu phul/ rgyal bo'i sprul sku rin po che la sku gzan gcig dang kha btags bcas phul/ rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa chen po rig 'dzin mi bskyod rdo rje gdan drangs/ zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas tshogs brgya bskang brgya bdag dbang len pa dang / bstan 'gro'i don la 'khrul bral gyi sprul sbu myur du 'byon pa'i gsol 'debs nan cher bgyis zhag gsum bzhugs/ de'i bar la sa dkar shan/ba nga 1༵sa gi dge 'dun pa gdan drangs ja thug gis mnyes pan byas/ dge 'dun pa

gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje'i sku tshe tha ma'i rnam bar/re re la ras kha bzhi re phul spyi 'jog tu dong tse khron gnyis gsum tsam re phul/ reb kong sngags mang gis zab lam 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi sgo nas tshogs brgya bskang brgya bdag dbang len pa dang / bstan 'gro'i dpal du sprul sku myur 'byon bton cing gsol 'debs gnad smin byas/ sngags pa re re la nas kha gsum re phul/ tshun gdung mchod la sngags mang gis gos chen gcig dang ras dā dgu/ zho bong sngags mang gis dong tse khron brgyad dang kha btags/ bis mdo'i sngags mang gis nas dā gsum/ hor gtsang sngags mang gis dngul srang do/ dang cag la sogs pa dad ldan 'gas gos dang ras dā dong tse mar la sogs pa gdung mchod du phul/ gzhan yang smad pa gling rgya zho bong byang chub stag yan la sogs pa'i sngags sde so so nas kha btags dong tse ras kha khur ba sogs mang po phul/ zla ba de'i nyer gcig gi tho nangs kyi cha la sku gdung rin po che zhugs la sbyangs rgyu'i nyer bsdogs ma tshang ba med par 'du bgyis te pun khang du spyan drangs pa na/ shar phyogs nas 'ja' ka dog lnga ldan yin pa cung zad dkan shas che ba zhig pud khang gi steng du 'then pa byung / grub dbang rin po ches zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gdung sgrub dang pud sbyong sa'i cho ga lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi ngar dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mchod pa'i bye brag bsam kyis mi khyab pa spud de/ zhugs la sbyangs pa'i tshe gdung dud dang me lce la sogs pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos su snang zhing shad phyogs kyi 'ja' de yang ji gsal du song ba dang / me tog dkad po'i char yang nam mkha' nas 'khor cing cung zad sa la babs pa byung / der 'tshogs pa thams cad la mthong snang mi 'dra ba mang po byung bas/ bla ma la dad gdung bla lhag tu 'phel lo/ /de nas grub dbang rin po che la 'jam dar zhig padma mthong grol gyi dbu zhwa dngul gyi tog can gcig kheb bu su'i sga khebs/ gos kyi cod pan/ ras dā dang rgod ma gcig bcas phul/ tshun gdung mchod du phrug gcig dang kha btags phul/ gzhan yang 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog a nol rin po che dang / sku phyogs bde chen tshang / rgyal mkhan chen rin po che tshang / tsho 'du'i thub chen rin po che la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams la gos chen ser po'i sku gzan kha btags 'jam dan dang ras dā la sogs pa phul/ a mchod la gos gcig dang 'jam dar dā dmar dang ba mo gcig bcas phul/ reb kong sngags mang gi spyi 'jog tu ka btags 'jam dad che ba spub cha bzang po dong tse khron bcu drug zho bong dang bes mdo'i sngags mang la kha btags spub cha das dā dang bcas spyi 'jog bzhag khyon bsdoms pas dong tse khron nyer lnga ras dā sum cu lhag kha bstogs che chung brgya lhag gos sdig nyu 9 5 / —snum

mas/ /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdo ji'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nag dkan yol brgya/ man rgya ma brgyud cu/ bye rtsam do bo nyer lnga lhag tsam gdung mchod du phul/ de'i tshe bla ma dang grwa btsun sngags mang noms bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor ba bzhin phyogs phyogs su gyes song tshe/ slob ngan bdag gi bsam pa la skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa rin po che shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing du phebs/ rje btsun sna tshogs rang grol bka' drin can yang padma 'od zhing du gshegs/ re sa'i mgon skyabs dam pa 'di nyid kyang glo bud du dag pa'i zhing khams su gshegs song bas/ da ni mtshan ldan gyi bla ma de la gang nas mjal bsams te mang po ngus pa'i mthan gdung dbyangs 'di phul lo/ / rje rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /ma nyam thag 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ / bu bdag gi gtsug nor khong ba'i snying / /pha bka' drin 'khor med drin can rje/ / mtshan yongs grags snang mdzad rdo rje'i zhabs/ /dus da lta dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ /bu skal chad 'khor ba'i 'dam du lus/ /sems sdug bsngal mun pa'i khung bun tshud/ / pha mtshan ldan bla ma sku drin can/ / ngag 'o dod drag pos rgyang nas 'bod/ /'di gsan nam bla ma rin po che/ /bu'i gdungs pa sol cig bka' drin can/ / steng 'dod lha'i brten pa dpag bsam shing / / glo bur du rmang nas 'byel ba byung / /lha'i yul khams thams cad stong bar bzhag / dgos 'dod kyi 'byung gnas gang du byed/ /'og ma dros klu yi snyeng gi nor/ /glo bur du nag phyogs chom pos khyer/ /klu'i yul khams thams cad stong ban bzhag /klu dbang tsho nyen 'tsho su yis byed/ /rang cag gi phyag mchod bstod pa'i zhing / /glo bun du chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /bar yul khams 'di yang stong ban bzhag/ mchod bstod kyi zhing sa gang du bgyi/ / rta bdun gyi bdag po 'od stong can/ /dus da lta nub kyi ri la yib/ /blo dman kun mun pa'i khung bud tshud/ 1'od stong gi sgron me su yis 'degs/ /dgos 'dod kyi re skong yid bzhin nor/ / dus da lta chu yi gting du bying / /dbul bo rnams re sa'i yul dab bral/ / bkres skom gyi gdung ba su yis sel/ /rang gang 'dod gdams pa zhu ba'i yul/ / dus da lta mi mngon dbyings su gshegs/ / bu skal med chos kyi sbong 'phro chad/ /man ngag dang gdams pa gang la zhu/ /kye ma hud drin can bla ma rje/ /snying khong nas gsol ba drag tu 'debs/ /'di dgongs sam pha rgan chos kyi rje/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig bka' drin can/ / gdong mig gi mkha' na sprin med kyang / / mchi ma yi char bas bzhin ras non/ /bdag yid na bud shing med na yang / /sdug bsngal gyi me chen drag tu 'bar/ /'di gzigs sam byums brtse'i mnga' bdag rje/ /bu'i gdung ba sol ba ka ༵na can/ / phas ston cing ma yis bor ba'i bu/ / bu dwa phrug bdag gis ci zhig

gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rje'i sku tshe za ma'i rnam thar/byu/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs rje can/ /thugs byums brtse'i klong nas ma 'don ban/ /zhing dag pa nab 'byums gar bzhugs kung / /bu bdag la zhal ston sems gso mdzod/ /shad gnya' shing gser ri'i phrag pa nas/ /'od lam lam shar ba'i nyi ma bzhin/ /sku'i yang sprul gsal po myun byon nas/ /bstan 'gro ba'i dpal du 'gyur bar shog /bdag deng nas byung chub ma thob bar/ / mgon dam pa mchog gis rjes bzung ste/ / sa lam gyi yon tan mthan phyin nas/ / sku gsum gyi go 'phang myun thob shog /de nas gdung zhal phye ste sku gdung ring bsrel phebs pa ni 'di lta ste/ lha sku dang phyag mtshan yig 'bru 'dra ba mang du byung zhing / khyad pan rta phag yab yum gyi sku dang sngags gsal po zhig babs pa de dang gdung dus rnams za ma tog tu bzhugs su gsol te/ mdun nas tshogs 'khor dang spyan 'dren khrus gsol phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul la sogs pa byus/ rjes nas dri bzang po'i shug pa la byang chub mchod rten khru do lhag tsam bskrun te/ grub dbang dam pa rig 'dzin mi bskyod rdo rjes mkhas grub du ma'i phyag srol ltar/ sku gsung thugs rten byin can dang gdung ring bsrel phebs pa rnams/ mchod sdong chen pon bzhugs su gsol te rab gnas kyang mdzad/ gser shog stong bam gnyis tsam la blo rig rnam dpyod yangs pa'i 'jam mo'i sngags 'chang klu 'bum rgyal gyis legs par bzhengs te/ dang cag drag zhan thams cad kyis phyag dang mchod pa'i zheng du bkod de/ skyes chen du mas dab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor 'ing bsngo sbon gyis mtshams sbyor kyang byus so/ / de ltar gang gi thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir khyem gzhir gang 'byor dang / yan mar nas gdung mchod du phul ba rnams kyang chud zos su ma btang ban/ yar dkon mchog la mtshod pa dang / bar dge 'dun la bsnyen bkun/ mar dbul phongs la sbyin gtong sogs byas/ de ltar bkyis pa'i dge tshogs bsngo ba smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor rgya chen byas te 'khor gsum yongs dag chen po chos dbyings zad pa med pa'i klong du rgyas btab pa'o/ /smras pa/ mkhyen pa'i shes byu kun la rmongs pa med/ / brtse ba'i gdul bya mang po thabs kyis 'dul/ /skyob pa'i nus mthus bdud bzhi'i rgol ba 'joms/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid drin can rje/ /zhing 'din dad ldan gdul bya'i dpal du byon/ /las ldan phal chen zhi bde'i lam la bkod/ / 'brel tshad don ldan mtshan ldan sprul ba'i sku/ / da ni dngos su de 'drar gang nas mjal/ /shul na lus pa'i grwa slob nye du yis/ /dam pa'i thugs kyi bzhed don 'grub pa'i phyir/ / sku gdung mdun du mchod sprin dpag me1 phu~X/97 /bzhil

sa / /nyang skyes snang mdzad rdorje'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'khon rgya mtsho'i gtso bon byas nas mchod/ / sku pur zhugs la sbyangs tshe shar phyogs nas/ /'ja' tshon ka dog lnga ldan nub tu 'then/ /lha yis me tog dkar po'i char kung phab/ /kun gyi snang ba bsgyur cing lhag par dad/ / gdung nus dngos la rta phag yab yum dang / / yig 'bru rang byon gsal bo babs pa byung / /nang cag rnams kyi bgo skal zhing du bstsal/ /tshul 'di bsam gyin dad gus gting nas skyes/ / khyim gzhi'i zas non dngos po gang 'byor dang / /gzhan nas phul ba rnams kyang mchod 'bul byas/ /gdung rus lha sku yig 'bru phebs pa rnams/ /gser gyis spras pa'i mchod sdong legs po bzhengs/ /mdun nas tshogs 'khor byin 'bebs rab gnas dang / /'khor gsum yongs dag smon lam rgya chen btab/ /dam pa'i mdzad bzang rin chen 'byung gnas las/ / tha ma'i rnam thar chu thigs lta bu zhig /dad pas sor rtser blangs nas cung zhig bkod/ /nongs pa gang mchis bla ma lha la bshags/ /de las byung ba'i rnam dkar dge tshogs 'dis/ / yab rje dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / / skye ba'i zeng bar khyod kyis rjes bzung ste/ / sgo gsum log pa'i lam du mi 'phyan par/ /zung 'jug mchog gi go 'phang mngon gyun nas/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal thob shog / rnam than 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bu 'dis/ / bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa dang / / yul la char chu dus 'bab 'thu nor 'phel/ / rdzogs ldan dpal gyis dus kun 'tsho bar shog /bla ma lha yi bkra shis sprin du 'khrigs/ /dgos 'dod dbyig gi bkra shis char du bsnyil/ /dus kun bde skyid bkra shis lo 'dab rgyas/ /don gnyis lhun thub bkra shis 'bras smin shog /ces gsang chen bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa mchog gi sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar byung tshul utpa la'i chun po zhes bya ba 'di ni rang nyid la rnam than 'bri ba'i blo gros kyis dpen na'ang / snga mor rin po che nyid kyis bka' phebs pa dran pa'i khar gang gi tsha bo padma bstan 'dzin dang / rnam dpyod blo mig yangs pa'i rgya mtsho lci 1 1 3 1 1 1 1 ba'i ngo ma ldog par slob 'bangs kyi tha shal sdu ma ka'i ming nas rjeb par sbyongs 1 gang 1chis ra ci sna ma lha/ dge hūṃ/na snyed ge'o/sa/ rdo ge'o/gas /shing / skye ba 'a zeng bar dam pas sa su 'a na pa' rgyur — 298 —
